label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching7
en: Please! Please say that you will accept me as your apprentice!
et: Palun! Palun ütle, et võtad mu oma õpipoisiks!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: Oh… I'm delighted!
et: Oh… Mul on nii hea meel!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I don't wish to waste your time, so please advise me on this.
et: Ma ei taha sinu aega raisata, seega palun anna mulle selles asjas nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: I plan to take a BATTLE TOWER challenge soon.
et: Kavatsen peagi BATTLE TOWERis kätt proovida.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: However, there are two levels…
et: Aga seal on kaks taset…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode7
en: Which would be most suitable for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kumb mulle kõige paremini sobiks? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: {STR_VAR_1} is your choice! I see. I will do my best!
et: {STR_VAR_1} on sinu valik! Selge. Ma annan endast parima!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks7
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}. I hope I can count on you again. Please take care!
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}. Loodan, et saan ka edaspidi sinu peale loota. Hoia end!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Eek! Eek! {PLAYER}! You spoke to me! I… I'm overjoyed!
et: Iik! Iik! {PLAYER}! Sa rääkisid minuga! Ma… Ma olen ülirõõmus!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Me! My name is {STR_VAR_1}! I just became a TRAINER!
et: Mina! Minu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}! Ma sain just TRAINERIKS!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: I'm delighted I met you, {PLAYER}, the big name in POKéMON circles!
et: Mul on nii hea meel, et sind kohtasin, {PLAYER} — sa oled POKéMONide maailmas suur nimi!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Oh-oh-oh, I know! May I ask a huge favor, {PLAYER}?
et: Oh-oh-oh, ma tean! Kas tohin paluda üht suurt teenet, {PLAYER}?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach8
en: Please take me in as your apprentice! I want to learn from you!
et: Palun võta mind oma õpipoisiks! Ma tahan sinult õppida!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: Waaaah! {PLAYER} turned me down… It… It's an invaluable experience!
et: Vaaaah! {PLAYER} ütles ära… See… See on hindamatu kogemus!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: {PLAYER}, please! I want to hear an affirmative answer this time!
et: {PLAYER}, palun! Seekord tahan ma kuulda jaatavat vastust!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching8
en: I beg you for your guidance!
et: Ma anun: juhenda mind!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Hieeeeh! {PLAYER} said yes! {PLAYER} said yes!
et: Hiieeeh! {PLAYER} ütles jah! {PLAYER} ütles jah!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: I won't be able to sleep tonight… Thank you ever so much!
et: Ma ei saa täna öösel kindlasti und… Suur-suur aitäh!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: Then, here's my question!
et: Siis nüüd minu küsimus!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode8
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, what is right for me, Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Mis sobiks mulle BATTLE TOWERis — Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: {STR_VAR_1}! Perfectly understood! I understand perfectly! I'm deliriously delighted!
et: {STR_VAR_1}! Täiesti selge! Ma sain täiesti aru! Ma olen õnnest pöörane!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks8
en: I hope you'll be willing to teach me some more another time.
et: Loodan, et õpetad mulle mõni teine kord veel midagi.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Whoa! Could you be… Might you be… {PLAYER}{KUN}?! That strong and famous TRAINER? Well, hello, aren't I just the luckiest!
et: Ohoo! Kas sa oled… Kas sa tõesti oled… {PLAYER}{KUN}?! See tugev ja kuulus TRAINER? No küll mul alles vedas!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: Hello, the name's {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Tere, mina olen {STR_VAR_1}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: I've been on the lookout for a POKéMON teacher.
et: Ma olen endale POKéMONI-õpetajat otsinud.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: And with impeccably good timing, along came you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ja just õigel hetkel astusid sina lagedale, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach9
en: So, there you have it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let me apprentice under you!
et: Nii et asi ongi selge, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Võta mind oma õpipoisiks!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Gwaaaah! You're quite cool and tough…
et: Gvaaah! Sa oled ikka kõva ja külm käsi…

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching9
en: Don't be that way, please. I'm asking you!
et: Ära ole nii, palun. Ma ju palun sind!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: Oh, yeah! That's a solid reply! Excellent, I might add!
et: Oo jaa! Kõva vastus! Lausa suurepärane!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: So how about a first piece of advice on the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Kuidas oleks siis esimese nõuandega BATTLE TOWERi kohta?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode9
en: If I were to go, what would be better? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma sinna läheksin, kumb oleks parem? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: Uh-huh, {STR_VAR_1} it is! OK, A-OK! I'll go show my mettle, like, jam!
et: Ahaa, siis {STR_VAR_1}! OK, täitsa OK! Lähen ja näitan, mis mul sees on, nagu, põmm!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks9
en: All right, I'll look to you as my mentor! Adios!
et: Hea küll, sina oled nüüd minu mentor! Adios!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}, right? The police were looking for you!
et: Oo, hei, {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks ju? Politsei otsis sind taga!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: … … … Of course I'm lying!
et: … … … Muidugi ma valetan!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: Me, I'm {STR_VAR_1}. Despite the way I look, I'm the POKéMON CHAMPION! …That's a lie, too!
et: Mina olen {STR_VAR_1}. Kuigi välimuse järgi ei ütleks, olen ma POKéMON MEISTER! …Ka see on vale!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: This is no lie, though. I'm not very good at battling.
et: Aga see pole vale: võitlemises ma eriti hea pole.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach10
en: So, how about you becoming my master about all things POKéMON?
et: Mis sa arvad, kas hakkaksid minu meistriks kõiges, mis POKéMONidesse puutub?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: If you're going to act cold like that, I'll show you what I'll do!
et: Kui sa nii külmalt käitud, siis ma näitan sulle!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Waaah! Waaah! Waaah! Hiccup!
et: Vaaah! Vaaah! Vaaah! Luks!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Hahaha, that was my FAKE TEARS!
et: Hahahaa, see oli minu FAKE TEARS!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching10
en: Come on, will you please be my POKéMON master?
et: No kuule, kas sa oleksid palun minu POKéMONI-meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Yippee! I'll buy you a boat for that!
et: Jipii! Ma ostan sulle selle eest paadi!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Of course I'm lying again! But… Thank you, master!
et: Muidugi ma valetan jälle! Aga… Aitäh, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: You know how there's Level 50 and Open Level at the BATTLE TOWER?
et: Tead ju, et BATTLE TOWERis on Tase 50 ja Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: I'm having trouble deciding which level I should challenge…
et: Ma ei suuda kuidagi otsustada, kummal tasemel kätt proovida…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode10
en: Can you decide for me, master?
et: Kas otsustaksid minu eest, meister?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Okay, so {STR_VAR_1} is better! I'll go to the other level, then!
et: Selge, {STR_VAR_1} on parem! Siis lähen ma hoopis teisele tasemele!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Nali muidugi! Ma teen täpselt nii, nagu õpetasid, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks10
en: Thanks, master! I hope you'll keep teaching me!
et: Aitäh, meister! Loodan, et õpetad mind edasi!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy, and it means hi!
et: A-H-O-I! Kokku teeb see ahoi ja tähendab tere!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: I'm {STR_VAR_1}, the rappin' SAILOR am I!
et: Mina olen {STR_VAR_1}, räppiv SAILOR olen ma!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Your turn now, tell me a little about yourself, give it a try!
et: Nüüd sinu kord — räägi endast veidi, proovi julgelt!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Uh-huh, uh-huh! {PLAYER}{KUN}'s your name, and POKéMON's your game!
et: Ahaa, ahaa! Nimeks sul {PLAYER}{KUN} ja alaks sul POKéMON!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: And you're at a delicate age when all the world's your stage!
et: Ja sa oled õrnas eas, mil kogu maailm on su lava!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Anyway, I just want to say, that you're the tenth TRAINER I've spoken to today.
et: Igatahes tahan öelda, et sa oled täna juba kümnes TRAINER, kellega ma räägin.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach11
en: Let's make that a celebration! Become my mentor for commemoration!
et: Tähistame seda! Hakka mu mentoriks — see olgu mälestuseks!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: But! You have to work with me!
et: Aga! Sa pead mulle vastu tulema!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching11
en: Don't be such a tease! Become my mentor, please!
et: Ära narri mind nii! Hakka mu mentoriks, ole hea!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: That's it! {PLAYER}, you've got the spirit!
et: Just nii! {PLAYER}, sinus on õiget vaimu!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: So here's my first question that begs your suggestion!
et: Nii et esimene küsimus, mis ootab sinu soovitust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: It's about the BATTLE TOWER, and it hinges on my power!
et: See käib BATTLE TOWERi kohta ja sõltub minu jõust!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode11
en: Level 50 and Open Level there be, which is the one that's good for me?
et: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase on seal — kumb neist mulle sobib hästi?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: Okay, {STR_VAR_1} it is, you say! I'll go and take it on my way!
et: Olgu, siis {STR_VAR_1}, ütled sa! Lähen ja võtan selle ette!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks11
en: If it's advice I ever need, {PLAYER}, your word I'll always heed!
et: Kui mul kunagi nõu vaja läheb, {PLAYER}, siis sinu sõna ma kuulan!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Say, hey, aren't you {PLAYER}? What should I do? Talk to you? Why not? I'm already talking to you!
et: Kuule, hei, kas sa pole mitte {PLAYER}? Mis ma nüüd teen? Räägin sinuga? Miks ka mitte — ma ju juba räägin!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, are you surprised at me? I'd better tell you who I happen to be!
et: {PLAYER}, kas oled üllatunud? Parem ütlen kohe, kes ma selline olen!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {STR_VAR_1} is what you can call me. The brightest star in guitardom, that's me!
et: Mind võid kutsuda nii: {STR_VAR_1}. Kitarrimaailma eredaim täht — see olen mina!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: Are you receiving me? You are receiving me!
et: Kas sa võtad mind vastu? Muidugi võtad!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: My luck's at its best, I'll hit you with a request!
et: Mul veab täna hullult, nii et esitan sulle ühe palve!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach12
en: {PLAYER}, let me be your underling! I want you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, võta mind oma tiiva alla! Ma tahan, et õpetaksid mulle kõike!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: You're turning me down, then? I'll just have to ask you again!
et: Nii et sa ütled ära? Siis küsin lihtsalt uuesti!

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching12
en: {PLAYER}, I beg to be your underling! I need you to teach me everything!
et: {PLAYER}, ma anun — võta mind oma tiiva alla! Sa pead mulle kõik selgeks õpetama!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Lucky, yeah, woohoo! Should I pop a question to you?
et: Vedas, jaa, uuhuu! Kas viskan sulle kohe ühe küsimuse?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Since we're near the BATTLE TOWER, how about a question about its power?
et: Kuna me oleme BATTLE TOWERi lähedal, siis küsingi kohe selle kohta!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode12
en: Of the choices you see, which is the right one for me?
et: Kumb neist valikutest on see õige just minu jaoks?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: If {STR_VAR_1} is what you suggest, it must be the very best!
et: Kui sina soovitad {STR_VAR_1}, siis on see kindlasti kõige parem!

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me.
et: Noh, {PLAYER}, mind ootab vaba tee, aga ära sa mind unusta.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks12
en: See you again, my smart friend!
et: Näeme jälle, mu tark sõber!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: Oh, hi! You there! Can I get you to massage my shoulder?
et: Oo, tere! Sina seal! Kas masseeriksid mu õlga?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: …Yes, there! That's it! Ouch, ouch! Oooh, that feels great!
et: …Jah, just sealt! Just nii! Ai, ai! Ohh, kui hea tunne!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: My name's {STR_VAR_1}. I take karate training, but my body's not built to take the abuse…
et: Minu nimi on {STR_VAR_1}. Ma käin karates, aga mu keha ei pea sellele koormusele vastu…

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: I decided I'll battle POKéMON and toughen myself up.
et: Ma otsustasin, et hakkan POKéMONidega võitlema ja teen end kõvemaks.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN}, aren't you? The POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMP?
et: Sa oled ju {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks? POKéMON LIIGA MEISTER?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach13
en: Listen, can I get you to give me advice?
et: Kuule, kas sa annaksid mulle nõu?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
en: Oh, why?
et: Oh, aga miks?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching13
en: I won't be a big bother, I promise! Please?
et: Ma ei hakka väga tüütama, ma luban! Palun?

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: Thank you. Mighty good of you! …Cough! Cough!
et: Aitäh. Väga kena sinust! …Köhh! Köhh!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: Oogh, I have to toughen up quick…
et: Uhh, ma pean kähku kõvemaks saama…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode13
en: I'll be heading off to the BATTLE TOWER right away, but what would be better for me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Lähen kohe BATTLE TOWERisse, aga kumb oleks mulle parem? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: Hm, all right. That's {STR_VAR_1}. I'll go there right away.
et: Hm, hea küll. Olgu siis {STR_VAR_1}. Lähen kohe sinna.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks13
en: I hope I can keep hitting you up for help--after all, you're my mentor!
et: Loodan, et saan sinult ikka abi küsida — sa oled ju nüüd minu mentor!

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?
et: Öö… Ömm… {PLAYER}{KUN}…?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all self-conscious.
et: Palun ära vaata mind niimoodi. Ma lähen sellest hoopis araks.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I… I'm {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Ma… Ma olen {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm really embarrassed to say this, but I explore ancient ruins and such.
et: Mul on pisut piinlik seda öelda, aga ma uurin muistseid varemeid ja muud sellist.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: I'm even more embarrassed to admit I'm interested in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Veel piinlikum on tunnistada, et mind huvitab BATTLE FRONTIER.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have a reputation as a tough TRAINER…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sind tuntakse kui kõva TRAINERIT…

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: It's hard for me to say this, but I want to ask something.
et: Mul on raske seda välja öelda, aga ma tahaksin midagi küsida.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach14
en: Could you become my teacher and give me advice?
et: Kas sa hakkaksid minu õpetajaks ja annaksid mulle nõu?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please don't brush me off like this! I can't live with the humiliation.
et: Palun ära tõuka mind niimoodi eemale! Ma ei elaks seda häbi üle.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching14
en: Please become my teacher! I need your advice!
et: Palun hakka minu õpetajaks! Ma vajan sinu nõu!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: Th-thank you…
et: A-aitäh…

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: But please don't look at me like that. It makes me all flustered.
et: Aga palun ära vaata mind niimoodi. Ma lähen sellest täitsa segadusse.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: Please, answer me without looking at my eyes.
et: Palun vasta mulle nii, et sa mulle silma ei vaata.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode14
en: At the BATTLE TOWER… Which level should I attempt?
et: BATTLE TOWERis… Kumba taset peaksin proovima?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try my hand at that.
et: Oh… Olgu! Siis proovingi seal kätt.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: I hope I can make a valiant challenge without getting all flustered…
et: Loodan, et suudan vapralt võidelda ega lähe täitsa segadusse…

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. If we meet again, I hope you will be as helpful.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Kui me jälle kohtume, loodan, et aitad mind samamoodi.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really real?
et: Hm? Sa näed välja nagu {PLAYER}{KUN}… Aga kas sa oled ikka päris?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: You may call me {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Mind võid kutsuda nii: {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: I have been toying with the idea of apprenticing under a strong TRAINER.
et: Ma olen mõlgutanud mõtet hakata mõne tugeva TRAINERI õpipoisiks.

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: So, I must say I'm lucky you came along! …You really are {PLAYER}{KUN}, yes?
et: Nii et mul vedas, et sa just siia sattusid! …Sa oledki tõesti {PLAYER}{KUN}, jah?

label: gText_ApprenticePleaseTeach15
en: No, no, if you are real, it's fine. I merely want you to recognize me as your apprentice.
et: Ei-ei, kui sa oled päris, siis on kõik hästi. Ma soovin lihtsalt, et võtaksid mu oma õpipoisiks.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Oh? But what would compel you to refuse?
et: Oo? Aga mis sind küll keelduma paneb?

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: I apologize for being skeptical about your identity.
et: Vabandan, et sinu isikus kahtlesin.

label: gText_ApprenticeRejectTeaching15
en: Please accept my apology and accept me as your apprentice.
et: Palun võta mu vabandus vastu — ja võta mind oma õpipoisiks.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: You really are accepting me? I don't wish to celebrate prematurely.
et: Sa võtad mu tõesti vastu? Ma ei tahaks enneaegselt rõõmustada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If it is true, I apologize. But now, I need your advice.
et: Kui see on tõsi, siis vabandust. Aga nüüd — ma vajan sinu nõu.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhichLevelMode15
en: If I were to enter the BATTLE TOWER, what would be worthy of me? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Kui ma astuksin BATTLE TOWERisse, kumb oleks mind väärt? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}? Are you certain?
et: {STR_VAR_1}? Kas oled kindel?

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I see. If that's the case, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Selge. Kui nii, siis olgu nii. Tänan sind aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: I realize I can annoy, but it delights me that you have accepted me.
et: Ma tean, et oskan tüütu olla, aga mul on hea meel, et sa mu vastu võtsid.

label: gText_ApprenticeLevelModeThanks15
en: Let us meet again!
et: Kohtume jälle!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: Sigh… Sob… Oh, {PLAYER}!
et: Ohh… Nuuks… Oh, {PLAYER}!

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: I'm all tangled up in a dilemma that I can't decide.
et: Mul on üks valik ees ja ma ei suuda kuidagi otsustada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: I can't decide what I should make my {STR_VAR_1} hold.
et: Ma ei suuda otsustada, mis eset minu {STR_VAR_1} hoidma peaks.

label: gText_ApprenticeWhatHeldItem0
en: Please tell me, {PLAYER}. What item should I make it hold?
et: Palun ütle sina, {PLAYER}. Mis eset ta hoidma peaks?

label: gText_ApprenticeHoldNothing0
en: Oh, really? I shouldn't make my {STR_VAR_1} hold anything?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's what I should say, huh? Then, I'll stay away from that!
et: Seda ma peaksin ütlema, mis? Siis ma hoian sellest eemale!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Just kidding! I'll obey your teaching, master!
et: Teen nalja! Ma kuuletun su õpetusele, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Thanks for teaching me all this time, master!
et: Aitäh, et sa mind kogu selle aja õpetasid, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm finally understanding what being a TRAINER is about.
et: Ma hakkan lõpuks taipama, mida TRAINERIKS olemine tähendab.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: I'm going to go out and win battles against any TRAINER.
et: Lähen nüüd lahinguid lööma ja võidan iga TRAINERI ära.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: Maybe it'll be you one day, master!
et: Ehk oled see ühel päeval sina, meister!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks10
en: That's all! Farewell, my master!
et: Ongi kõik! Hüvasti, mu meister!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: A-H-O-Y! And that spells ahoy!
et: A-H-O-I! Ja see teeb kokku ahoi!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: The rappin' SAILOR am I! This will be my last question, don't you cry!
et: Räppiv SAILOR olen mina! Viimane küsimus see on, ära sa nuta, oh ei!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: It's a saying question that begs your suggestion!
et: See on ütluseküsimus, mis anub sinu ettepanekut!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech11
en: If I win a match, what can I say in a real cool way?
et: Kui ma matši võidan, mida ütleksin siis tõeliselt lahedalt?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Perfect! That's what I'll use. I was right to make you choose!
et: Täiuslik! Seda ma kasutangi. Hästi tegin, et sind valima panin!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: And now, I think it'd be best, if I were to fly the nest!
et: Ja nüüd on vist parim aeg, et pesast välja lennata!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: Thanks for all you taught me. I'll be off on a battle spree!
et: Aitäh kõige eest, mida mulle õpetasid. Lähen nüüd lahinguid lööma!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks11
en: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! And that spells bon voyage, to you this is my homage!
et: B-O-N-V-O-Y-A-G-E! Ja see teeb kokku bon voyage — see on mu austusavaldus sulle!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Oh, yeah, {PLAYER}! I found you again today!
et: Oh jaa, {PLAYER}! Leidsin su täna jälle üles!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: What should I do? Ask you again? Why not? I'm already asking you!
et: Mis ma teen? Küsin sinult jälle? Miks mitte? Ma juba küsingi!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Anyways, {PLAYER}… Are you receiving me? You are receiving me! I need some more advice for me!
et: Igatahes, {PLAYER}… Kas sa kuuled mind? Sa kuuled mind! Ma vajan jälle veidi nõu!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: It's about what I should yell. Something cool to holler when a battle ends well.
et: Jutt on sellest, mida ma hõikama peaksin. Midagi lahedat, kui lahing hästi lõpeb.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech12
en: Come on, I wanna hear you say it!
et: No kuule, ma tahan kuulda, kuidas sa selle ütled!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: All right, all right! I'll use that because it's so tight!
et: Hea küll, hea küll! Seda ma kasutan, sest see on nii vinge!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: I'm out of things to ask you. Waving bye is all that's left to do.
et: Mul pole sulle enam midagi küsida. Üle jääb ainult hüvasti vehkida.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But maybe one day we'll meet, with one destined to go down in defeat.
et: Aga ehk me ühel päeval kohtume ja üks meist peab kaotuse vastu võtma.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: But, it really is time to say farewell.
et: Aga nüüd on tõesti aeg hüvasti jätta.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Well, {PLAYER}, I have to roam free, but don't you forget about me!
et: Noh, {PLAYER}, mind ootab vaba rändurielu, aga ära sa mind unusta!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks12
en: Take care, {PLAYER}! Love ya!
et: Hoia end, {PLAYER}! Sa oled parim!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'm finished… My nose won't stop dripping…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mul on lõpp käes… Mu nina ei lakka tilkumast…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: I was trying to think up something cool to say when I win a battle.
et: Üritasin välja mõelda midagi lahedat, mida lahingu võites öelda.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: It inspired me so much, it made me cry, and now my nose won't stop running…
et: See läks mulle nii hinge, et ma nutma hakkasin, ja nüüd ei lakka mu nina jooksmast…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: So, things being this way, I need you to decide for me, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Nii et asjalood on sellised — otsusta sina minu eest, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech13
en: When I win a battle, what should I say?
et: Kui ma lahingu võidan, mida ma siis ütlema peaksin?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: … … …That's good. No, it's awe inspiring! It's bringing fresh tears to my eyes!
et: … … …See on hea. Ei, see on lausa aukartustäratav! Mul tulevad pisarad silma!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: But in spite of my tears and runny nose, I will use that saying!
et: Aga pisaratest ja tilkuvast ninast hoolimata võtan ma selle ütluse kasutusele!

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: I'm plumb out of things to ask you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Mul pole sinult enam midagi küsida, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks13
en: From now on, we're rivals! Thanks for everything!
et: Nüüdsest oleme rivaalid! Aitäh kõige eest!

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Er… Um… {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: Ee… Ähm… {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: Please, don't look at me that way. You're making me all nervous.
et: Palun ära vaata mind nii. Ma lähen sellest närvi.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: I… I need your advice again. I'll make it my last, though…
et: Ma… Mul on jälle su nõu vaja. Aga see jääb viimaseks korraks…

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech14
en: It's really embarrassing to ask, but what if I win a battle? What should I say?
et: Seda on tõesti piinlik küsida, aga mis siis, kui ma lahingu võidan? Mida ma ütlema peaksin?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Oh… Okay! I'll try to say that! I might be too nervous to say it…
et: Oh… Olgu! Ma proovin seda öelda! Kuigi ma võin selleks liiga närvis olla…

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: Thank you, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I have to say good-bye now.
et: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Ma pean nüüd hüvasti jätma.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks14
en: I'll obey all that you've taught me, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and do the best I can.
et: Ma järgin kõike, mida sa mulle õpetasid, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ja annan endast parima.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Hm? You appear to be {PLAYER}{KUN}… But are you really? Perhaps a clever {PLAYER} DOLL?
et: Hm? Sa paistad olevat {PLAYER}{KUN}… Aga kas ikka oled? Ehk hoopis osav {PLAYER} NUKK?

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: Oh, no, no, no, don't worry! If you really are real, please forget about my rudeness.
et: Oh ei, ei, ei, ära muretse! Kui sa oled tõesti päris, siis palun unusta mu ebaviisakus.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: No need to be so angry. All I wish for is more of your fine advice.
et: Pole vaja nii vihastada. Ma soovin vaid veel su häid nõuandeid.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: It concerns a saying.
et: See puudutab üht ütlust.

label: gText_ApprenticePickWinSpeech15
en: More precisely, what should I say if I win a battle?
et: Täpsemalt, mida ma peaksin ütlema, kui lahingu võidan?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: … … … … … … When I win a match…
et: … … … … … … Kui ma matši võidan…

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: {STR_VAR_1}
et: {STR_VAR_1}

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: …Are you serious?
et: …Kas sa räägid tõsiselt?

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I see. If you are serious, that's fine. I thank you for your time.
et: Selge. Kui sa tõsiselt räägid, siis on hästi. Tänan sind su aja eest.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do hope even I will be able to put that saying to good use.
et: Loodan väga, et isegi mina suudan seda ütlust hästi ära kasutada.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I seem to have run dry on what advice I need.
et: Näib, et mul pole enam midagi nõu küsida.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: I do believe it's high time I bid you farewell and strike out on my own.
et: Ma usun, et on ülim aeg sulle hüvasti jätta ja omal jõul teele asuda.

label: gText_ApprenticeWinSpeechThanks15
en: Thank you, my mentor! I apologize for my skepticism!
et: Aitäh, mu mentor! Palun vabandust oma kahtluste pärast!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Swap rules are listed.
et: Lahinguvahetuse reeglid on kirjas.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three POKéMON.
et: Lahinguvahetuse üritusel tohid kasutada ainult kolme POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Whether you are renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same POKéMON.
et: Olgu sa rentimas või vahetamas — su meeskonnas ei tohi olla kahte ühesugust POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap POKéMON only with the TRAINER you have just defeated.
et: POKéMONe tohid vahetada ainult selle TRAINERIGA, kelle just alistasid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap for only those POKéMON used by the beaten TRAINER.
et: Vahetada saad ainult nende POKéMONide vastu, keda alistatud TRAINER kasutas.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's POKéMON.
et: Pärast iga võidetud lahingut võid vahetada ühe oma alistatud vastase POKéMONi vastu.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: You will not be able to swap POKéMON with the third TRAINER in the event.
et: Sa ei saa ürituse kolmanda TRAINERIGA POKéMONe vahetada.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping POKéMON.
et: POKéMONide vahetamisel tuleb silmas pidada kahte olulist asja.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the POKéMON you are about to receive.
et: Esiteks, vahetuse ajal ei näe sa selle POKéMONi näitajaid, kelle sa vastu saad.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: Second, the POKéMON on your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
et: Teiseks, su meeskonnas seisavad POKéMONid selles järjekorras, milles sa nad rentisid.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotes
en: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
et: See järjekord ei muutu ka pärast vahetusi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The POKéMON of the SLATEPORT BATTLE TENT are all rentals.
et: SLATEPORTI BATTLE TENTis on kõik POKéMONid renditavad.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: All rental POKéMON are kept at Level 30.
et: Kõik rendi-POKéMONid on tasemel 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed2
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTi reeglid on kirjas.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.
et: Siin VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTis peavad POKéMONid ise mõtlema ja võitlema.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
et: Erinevalt metsikutest käituvad inimeste juures elavad POKéMONid oma loomuse järgi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.
et: Mõni POKéMON eelistab oma loomuse tõttu iga hinna eest rünnata.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.
et: Mõni teine eelistab end igasuguse kahju eest kaitsta.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
et: Kolmandale meeldib vastaseid ärritada ja segadusse ajada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.
et: Loomusest olenevalt on POKéMONil lemmikvõtted, mida ta oskab hästi kasutada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainNatureRules
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.
et: Mõnda võtet ta jälle ei salli ning nende kasutamine ei õnnestu tal hästi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.
et: On ründevõtteid, mis teevad vastasele otsest kahju.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
et: On kaitsevõtteid, millega valmistutakse vastase rünnakuteks või taastatakse HP.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.
et: On ka veidramaid võtteid, mis nõrgestavad vastast näiteks mürgi või halvatusega.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainMoveRules
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.
et: POKéMON kaalub võtteid kõigist kolmest rühmast.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.
et: Kui POKéMON pole TRAINERI käsu all, ei pruugi ta teatud võtteid tõhusalt kasutada.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
et: Võtet, mida POKéMON ei salli, ta hästi kasutada ei oska.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainUnderpoweredRules
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
et: Kui POKéMON oskab ainult võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi, jääb ta sageli oma võimetest kaugele.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
et: Olenevalt loomusest võib POKéMON hädas hakata kasutama võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainWhenInDangerRules
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
et: Kui POKéMON hakkab kitsikuses veidralt käituma, jälgi teda hoolikalt.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: At this BATTLE TENT, the levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON.
et: Selles BATTLE TENTis kohandatakse vastaste tasemed sinu POKéMONide tasemega.

label: BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainLevelRules
en: However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 30.
et: Ühelgi TRAINERIL ei ole siiski POKéMONe alla taseme 30.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT rules are listed.
et: VERDANTURFI BATTLE TENTi reeglid on kirjas.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: DAD: Hi, {PLAYER}!
et: ISA: Tere, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GiveEnigmaBerry
en: I just received a very rare BERRY. I'd like you to have it.
et: Sain just ühe väga haruldase marja. Tahan selle sulle anda.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy soil, feel free to take them.
et: Kui näed mullas kasvamas marju, võta need julgelt.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: But make sure you plant a BERRY in the same spot. That's common courtesy.
et: Aga istuta kindlasti samasse kohta uus mari. Nii on viisakas.

label: Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis
en: Here, I'll share this with you.
et: Võta, ma jagan sinuga!

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: The way you look, you must be a TRAINER, no?
et: Sa näed välja nagu TRAINER, kas pole?

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: TRAINERS often make POKéMON hold BERRIES.
et: TRAINERID lasevad POKéMONidel tihti marju kaasas kanda.

label: Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBerries
en: It's up to you whether to grow BERRIES or use them.
et: Kas marju kasvatada või ära kasutada, on sinu otsustada.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: I watered the plants every day. They grew lots of flowers.
et: Kastsin taimi iga päev. Neile kasvas palju õisi.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: And they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.
et: Ja marju andsid nad mulle ka palju.

label: Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeBerry
en: Here you go! You can have it!
et: Säh, palun! Võta see endale!

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I'm going to try really hard and make BERRIES in different colors.
et: Ma pingutan kõvasti ja kasvatan eri värvi marju.

label: Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentColorBerries
en: I hope you try hard, too!
et: Pinguta sinagi kõvasti!

label: Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForToday
en: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look for today?
et: Huvitav, mis värvi marju ma täna otsin?

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine, so I'm collecting BERRIES.
et: Mulle meeldib BERRY CRUSH masinaga mängida, seepärast kogun marju.

label: Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBerry
en: I'll share one with you, if you'd like.
et: Kui tahad, annan sulle ühe.

label: Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends
en: You should try the BERRY CRUSH machine with your friends.
et: Proovi BERRY CRUSH masinat kindlasti koos sõpradega.

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: Which BERRY should be planted? Should you use or hoard BERRIES?
et: Millise marja istutada? Kas marju kasutada või koguda?

label: Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries
en: It's fun to think about.
et: Selle üle on lõbus mõelda.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.
et: Marjad kasvavad päikesevalgust endasse imedes.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: We help the BERRIES grow by watering them regularly.
et: Meie aitame neil kasvada, kastes neid korrapäraselt.

label: Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsntIt
en: It's an expression of love, isn't it?
et: See on armastuse väljendus, kas pole?

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: Yes, yes. You understand what I mean.
et: Jah, jah. Sa saad aru, mida ma mõtlen.

label: Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand
en: You should take this.
et: Võta see endale.

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: Oh… But it is important to make your own impressions, I guess…
et: Oh… Aga vist on tähtis, et sul tekiks oma arvamus…

label: Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions
en: You can have this.
et: See on sinu.

label: Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare
en: I think that BERRY is rare. I hope you raise it with loving care.
et: Arvan, et see mari on haruldane. Kasvata seda armastusega!

label: Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerryMaster
en: I'll get more BERRIES from the BERRY MASTER.
et: Ma saan BERRY MASTERi käest veel marju.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: The same way suits suit me perfectly, a crisp breeze suits the sea.
et: Nii nagu ülikond sobib minule, sobib merele värske tuuleiil.

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: And you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”…
et: Ja sinule sobib mari nagu valatult…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BerrySuitsYou
en: Why should that be so?
et: Miks see nii on?

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_BecauseYoureTrainer
en: It's because you're a TRAINER!
et: Sellepärast, et sa oled TRAINER!

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: When it gets right down to it…
et: Kui asi tõsiseks läheb…

label: LilycoveCity_Text_PokeblocksSuitPokemon
en: The way dignified simplicity suits me, {POKEBLOCK}S perfectly suit POKéMON.
et: Nii nagu väärikas lihtsus sobib mulle, sobivad {POKEBLOCK}id täiuslikult POKéMONidele.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.
et: Mind võid kutsuda nimega BERRY MASTER.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: I dream of filling the world with beautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES and hand them out to everyone.
et: Unistan maailmast, mis on täis kauneid lilli, seepärast kasvatan marju ja jagan neid kõigile.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDeservingOfBerry
en: You're deserving of one!
et: Sa väärid üht!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_WhyBeStingyTakeAnother
en: Why be stingy? Take another!
et: Milleks olla ihne? Võta veel üks!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL flower shop near RUSTBORO.
et: Külasta kindlasti PRETTY PETAL lillepoodi RUSTBORO lähedal.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Täitku lilled maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: I'm done for today. Come again another day.
et: Tänaseks on mul kõik. Tule mõnel teisel päeval uuesti.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForToday
en: Let flowers fill the world!
et: Täitku lilled maailma!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: The way my husband grows BERRIES, oh, he's the best in the world.
et: Kuidas mu mees marju kasvatab — oh, ta on selles maailma parim.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: He makes me proud, that he does.
et: Ma olen tema üle nii uhke, jah!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGoodSayingLately
en: Incidentally, child, have you heard a good saying lately?
et: Muuseas, lapsuke, kas oled viimasel ajal mõnda head ütlust kuulnud?

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: Ah! What a remarkable saying! Inspirational, it is!
et: Ah! Milline tore ütlus! Päris inspireeriv!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_InspirationalTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Võta see endale, palun.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: Oh! A good saying it is. You're quite remarkable.
et: Oh! Tore ütlus küll. Sa oled päris eriline.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayingTakeThis
en: I want you to have this.
et: Võta see endale, palun.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Our four grandchildren should become more accomplished than my husband.
et: Meie neli lapselast peaksid mu mehestki osavamaks saama.

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNeverGoesOutOfMyLife
en: Joy never goes out of my life!
et: Rõõm ei kao mu elust kunagi!

label: Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Ah
en: Ah…
et: Ah…

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ThisIsPrettyPetalFlowerShop
en: This is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop. Spreading flowers all over the world!
et: See on PRETTY PETAL lillepood. Levitame lilli üle kogu maailma!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_LearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas tahaksid marjadest rohkem teada?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: Your name is?
et: Ja sinu nimi on?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}. That's a nice name.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}. See on kena nimi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_IntroLearnAboutBerries
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you like to learn about BERRIES?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas tahaksid marjadest rohkem teada?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: BERRIES grow on trees that thrive only in soft, loamy soil.
et: Marjad kasvavad puudel, mis lokkavad ainult pehmes mullas.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: If you take some BERRIES, be sure to plant one in the loamy soil again.
et: Kui korjad marju, istuta kindlasti üks uuesti mulda.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: A planted BERRY will soon sprout, grow into a plant, flower beautifully, then grow BERRIES again.
et: Istutatud mari idaneb peagi, kasvab taimeks, õitseb kaunilt ja annab jälle uusi marju.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: I want to see the whole wide world filled with beautiful flowers. That's my dream.
et: Tahan näha, kuidas terve maailm on kauneid lilli täis. See on mu unistus.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_BerriesExplanation
en: Please help me, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Plant BERRIES and bring more flowers into the world.
et: Aita mind, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Istuta marju ja too maailma rohkem lilli.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_FlowersBringHappiness
en: Flowers bring so much happiness to people, don't they?
et: Lilled toovad inimestele nii palju õnne, kas pole?

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: Hello!
et: Tere!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: The more attention you give to flowers, the more beautifully they bloom.
et: Mida rohkem tähelepanu lilledele pöörad, seda kaunimalt nad õitsevad.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_YouCanHaveThis
en: You'll like tending flowers. I'm sure of it. You can have this.
et: Sulle hakkab lillede eest hoolitsemine meeldima, olen selles kindel. Võta see endale.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: While BERRY plants are growing, water them with the WAILMER PAIL.
et: Kuni marjataimed kasvavad, kasta neid WAILMER PAILi abil.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Oh, another thing.
et: Oh, veel üks asi.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: If you don't pick BERRIES for a while, they'll drop off onto the ground. But they'll sprout again.
et: Kui sa marju tükk aega ei korja, kukuvad need maha. Aga uued idanevad jälle.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_WailmerPailExplanation
en: Isn't that awesome? It's like they have the will to live.
et: Kas pole äge? Justkui oleks neil eluisu sees.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: I'm trying to be like my big sisters. I'm growing flowers, too!
et: Ma tahan olla nagu mu suured õed. Minagi kasvatan lilli!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_ImGrowingFlowers
en: Here you go! It's for you!
et: Säh, palun! See on sulle!

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big, or you can make a POKéMON hold it.
et: Marja võid istutada ja suureks kasvatada või anda selle POKéMONile kaasa.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: But now they have a machine that mixes up different BERRIES and makes candies for POKéMON.
et: Aga nüüd on olemas masin, mis segab eri marju ja teeb POKéMONidele komme.

label: Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_Text_MachineMixesBerries
en: I want some candy, too.
et: Minagi tahan veidi komme.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: Hi, what's your name?
et: Tere, mis su nimi on?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: … … … … … … … … … Okay. That's nice!
et: … … … … … … … … … Olgu. See on kena!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My name is KIRI.
et: Mu nimi on KIRI.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: My mommy and daddy named me that so I would grow healthy and warmhearted. That's what they wished.
et: Mu emme ja issi panid mulle selle nime, et ma kasvaksin terve ja soojasüdamlik. Seda nad soovisid.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfThese
en: You can have one of these.
et: Võta üks neist endale.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo
en: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too! I really like it lots!
et: KIRI annab sulle ka selle marja! Mulle see hirmsasti meeldib!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatKindOfWishInYourName
en: I wonder what kind of wish is included in your name.
et: Huvitav, milline soov sinu nimesse peidetud on.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
et: Kevad, suvi, sügis ja talv.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn
en: If you're born in springtime, do you like the spring, and if you're born in the summer, do you like the summer?
et: Kui oled sündinud kevadel, kas siis meeldib sulle kevad, ja kui suvel, siis suvi?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Then KIRI was born in the autumn, so I love the autumn!
et: KIRI on sündinud sügisel, seepärast mulle sügis väga meeldib!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThenILoveAutumn
en: Which season do you like?
et: Milline aastaaeg sulle meeldib?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: Oh… It doesn't matter…
et: Oh… Pole tähtis…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter
en: There's so much that I want to know…
et: On nii palju, mida ma teada tahan…

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!
et: Tere! Vabandust, et pidid ootama!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: Welcome to the world of POKéMON!
et: Tere tulemast POKéMONide maailma!

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: My name is BIRCH.
et: Mu nimi on BIRCH.

label: gText_Birch_Welcome
en: But everyone calls me the POKéMON PROFESSOR.
et: Aga kõik kutsuvad mind POKéMONI PROFESSORIKS.

label: gText_Birch_Pokemon
en: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”
et: Seda me nimetame „POKéMONiks.”

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: This world is widely inhabited by creatures known as POKéMON.
et: Seda maailma asustavad kõikjal olendid, keda kutsutakse POKéMONideks.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: We humans live alongside POKéMON, at times as friendly playmates, and at times as cooperative workmates.
et: Meie, inimesed, elame POKéMONide kõrval, vahel sõbralike mängukaaslastena ja vahel koostööaltide töökaaslastena.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: And sometimes, we band together and battle others like us.
et: Vahel aga lööme käed kokku ja võitleme teiste endasugustega.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: But despite our closeness, we don't know everything about POKéMON.
et: Aga hoolimata meie lähedusest ei tea me POKéMONide kohta kõike.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: In fact, there are many, many secrets surrounding POKéMON.
et: Tegelikult ümbritseb POKéMONe väga-väga palju saladusi.

label: gText_Birch_MainSpeech
en: To unravel POKéMON mysteries, I've been undertaking research. That's what I do.
et: POKéMONide saladuste lahtiharutamiseks teen ma uurimistööd. See ongi minu töö.

label: gText_Birch_AndYouAre
en: And you are?
et: Ja sina oled?

label: gText_Birch_BoyOrGirl
en: Are you a boy? Or are you a girl?
et: Kas sa oled poiss? Või oled tüdruk?

label: gText_Birch_WhatsYourName
en: All right. What's your name?
et: Hea küll. Mis su nimi on?

label: gText_Birch_SoItsPlayer
en: So it's {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Nii et {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: Ah, okay!
et: Ah, olgu!

label: gText_Birch_YourePlayer
en: You're {PLAYER}{KUN} who's moving to my hometown of LITTLEROOT. I get it now!
et: Sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}, kes kolib minu kodukanti LITTLEROOT LINNA. Nüüd saan aru!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: All right, are you ready?
et: Hea küll, kas oled valmis?

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Your very own adventure is about to unfold.
et: Sinu enda seiklus on kohe algamas.

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Take courage, and leap into the world of POKéMON where dreams, adventure, and friendships await!
et: Kogu julgust ja hüppa POKéMONide maailma, kus ootavad unistused, seiklus ja sõprus!

label: gText_Birch_AreYouReady
en: Well, I'll be expecting you later. Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.
et: Noh, ootan sind hiljem. Tule minuga POKéMON LABis kohtuma.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: BLEND MASTER: Indeed I am! The BLEND MASTER am I!
et: SEGAMISMEISTER: Tõepoolest! Mina olengi SEGAMISMEISTER!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendWithTheBlendMaster
en: Blend with me, and you shall witness the mastery I bring to blending!
et: Sega koos minuga ja sa näed, mida tõeline meisterlikkus tähendab!

label: BerryBlender_Text_SeeMyMasteryInAction
en: BLEND MASTER: Hmmm! So, you wish to see my mastery in action?
et: SEGAMISMEISTER: Hmmm! Nii et tahad mu meisterlikkust oma silmaga näha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: So, you are too busy now, I see!
et: Nii et praegu on sul kiire, ma näen!

label: BerryBlender_Text_TooBusyNowIsee
en: But fear not! I shall be here all day! Hurry back from your errand!
et: Aga ära karda! Ma olen siin terve päeva! Tule oma asjaajamiste järel kähku tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: You haven't got a single BERRY!
et: Sul pole ainsatki marja!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoBerries
en: I shall be here all day! Hurry back with some BERRIES!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Tule kähku marjadega tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Of course! Of course!
et: Muidugi! Muidugi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterKnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Incidentally… You do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S from BERRIES?
et: Muuseas… Sa ju tead, kuidas marjadest {POKEBLOCK}e segada?

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: Ah, but it is a simple process!
et: Ah, aga see on ju imelihtne!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When the BLENDER's arrow comes to your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDERI nool jõuab su tähiseni, vajuta lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: That's all you have to do.
et: See on kõik, mida sa tegema pead.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterExplainBerryBlending
en: When you see how precisely I press the A Button, you will understand.
et: Kui näed, kui täpselt mina A-nuppu vajutan, saad kohe aru.

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Fine!
et: Hea küll!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterLetsBerryBlender
en: All together with the BLEND MASTER, let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Kõik koos SEGAMISMEISTRIGA — BERRY BLENDER tööle!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: You don't appear to have gotten the {POKEBLOCK} CASE!
et: Näib, et sul pole veel {POKEBLOCK} CASE karpi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterNoPokeblockCase
en: I shall be here all day! Obtain the {POKEBLOCK} CASE and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Hangi {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Hmmm!
et: Hmmm!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE appears to be full!
et: Näib, et su {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_BlendMasterPokeblockCaseFull
en: I shall be here all day! Use some {POKEBLOCK}S and hurry back!
et: Ma olen siin terve päeva! Kasuta mõned {POKEBLOCK}id ära ja kiirusta tagasi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhoaAwesome
en: Whoa! Awesome!
et: Ohoo! Äge!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WickedlyFast
en: Wickedly fast!
et: Pööraselt kiire!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatAnExpert
en: What an expert!
et: Milline meister!

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeAmazingPokeblocksWithMaster
en: When I blended with the MASTER, we made amazing {POKEBLOCK}S!
et: Kui ma MEISTRIGA segasin, tegime hämmastavaid {POKEBLOCK}e!

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Eyes that track the arrow with machinelike intensity…
et: Silmad, mis jälgivad noolt masinaliku täpsusega…

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: A hand that taps the A Button with clockwork-like precision…
et: Käsi, mis toksib A-nuppu kellavärgi täpsusega…

label: BerryBlender_Text_QualitiesOfBlendMaster
en: Possessing these qualities makes the BLEND MASTER truly great.
et: Just need omadused teevadki SEGAMISMEISTRIST tõelise suurkuju.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: The BLEND MASTER's supposed to work on his skills deep in the mountains.
et: Räägitakse, et SEGAMISMEISTER lihvib oma oskusi sügaval mägedes.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MasterWorksOnSkillsInMountains
en: Sometimes, he comes to LILYCOVE to blend BERRIES all day long.
et: Vahel tuleb ta LILYCOVE LINNA, et terve päev marju segada.

label: EventTicket_Text_ShowEonTicket

label: EventTicket_Text_BrineyLetsSail

label: EventTicket_Text_OddTicketGetOnBoard

et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ma olen sinust juba kuulnud!

en: It seems your POKéNAV's been upgraded with MATCH CALL.
et: Näib, et sinu POKéNAV on saanud MATCH CALL uuenduse.

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: Well, I should register, too!
et: Nojah, siis pean minagi end kirja panema!

label: MatchCall_Text_BirchRegisterCall
en: That way, I'd be able to examine your POKéDEX even while you're out in the field.
et: Nii saaksin su POKéDEXi vaadata isegi siis, kui sa parajasti ringi rändad.

label: MatchCall_Text_RegisteredBirch
en: Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
et: PROF. BIRCH registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: MatchCall_Text_UnusedProfBirch
en: PROF. BIRCH: When one has both the POKéDEX and POKéNAV, studying POKéMON becomes more fun, eh?
et: PROF. BIRCH: Kui on nii POKéDEX kui ka POKéNAV, on POKéMONide uurimine palju põnevam, eks?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Since you called me, the POKéNAV must be working properly!
et: Kui sa juba helistad, siis POKéNAV vist töötab kenasti!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Other people will be registered, so try calling them up, too!
et: Sinna lisandub teisigi inimesi, nii et proovi ka neile helistada!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Good! Good! You seem to be quite happy!
et: Tore! Tore! Sa paistad päris rõõmus olevat!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Hm… How could I know that?
et: Hm… Kust ma seda tean?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: It's because I'm looking down at you from my office window!
et: Sellepärast, et ma vaatan sind oma kabineti aknast!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone1
en: Wahahaha! See you again!
et: Vahahahaa! Näeme jälle!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: What's wrong? Have you forgotten about that little errand of mine?
et: Mis lahti? Kas oled mu väikese ülesande hoopis unustanud?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: I need you to deliver my letter to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
et: Vii mu kiri DEWFORDIS STEVENILE ära, palun.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: After that, deliver our parcel to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.
et: Ja pärast seda vii meie pakk SLATEPORTIS CAPT. STERNILE.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: You remember, don't you?
et: Sa ju mäletad, eks?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone2
en: Now, since I am a busy PRESIDENT, I have to go! Bye-bye!
et: Aga nüüd — kiire PRESIDENDINA pean ma minema! Tšau-tšau!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: Ah, so you've met STEVEN! I'd better reward you, then!
et: Ahaa, nii et STEVENI leidsid üles! Siis pean sulle tasuma!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: When you visit RUSTBORO again, come see me at my office.
et: Kui sa jälle RUSTBOROS oled, astu minu kabinetist läbi.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone3
en: I'll be waiting for you!
et: Ma ootan sind!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: Did you know that DEVON was digging the RUSTURF TUNNEL?
et: Kas teadsid, et DEVON kaevas RUSTURF TUNNELIT?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: But we shut down the operation to protect the POKéMON in the area.
et: Aga me lõpetasime töö ära, et selle kandi POKéMONe kaitsta.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: It's a no-brainer, really.
et: See on ju enesestmõistetav.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone4
en: It's more important to let POKéMON live in peace than worry about our own convenience.
et: Tähtsam on lasta POKéMONidel rahus elada kui mõelda omaenda mugavusele.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: MR. STONE: Hello, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. STONE: Tere, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: I heard from someone in PETALBURG that you're NORMAN's child!
et: Kuulsin PETALBURGIS ühelt inimeselt, et sa oled NORMANI laps!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone5
en: No wonder you're such a capable being!
et: Pole ime, et sinus on nii palju jõudu!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: MR. STONE: What's that?
et: MR. STONE: Mida ma kuulen?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: You battled your own father and defeated him?
et: Sa astusid omaenda isaga vastamisi ja alistasid ta?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: That's astounding!
et: See on ju vapustav!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone6
en: I had no idea that I befriended someone so special! Wahaha!
et: Mul polnud aimugi, et olen sõbrunenud nii erilise inimesega! Vahahaa!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Hello! This is DEVON CORPORATI… Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
et: Tere! Siin DEVON CORPORATI… Oi, tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Our PRESIDENT was here a little while ago, but he's gone out.
et: PRESIDENT oli veel hetk tagasi siin, aga läks välja.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone7
en: Our PRESIDENT is busy, but you seem to be just as busy, {PLAYER}.
et: Meie PRESIDENDIL on kiire, aga sinul näib olevat sama kiire, {PLAYER}.

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: …Huh? …What's that?
et: …Ah? …Mis asja?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: GROU… Yes? …DON?
et: GROU… Jah? …DON?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: You're breaking up… …can't hear…
et: Kõne läheb katki… …ei kuule…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone8
en: BZZZZ…
et: BZZZZ…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: …Huh? …What's that?
et: …Ah? …Mis asja?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: Seaflo… Yes? …Caver…?
et: SEAFLO… Jah? …CAVER…?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: You're breaking up… …can't hear…
et: Kõne läheb katki… …ei kuule…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone9
en: BZZZZ…
et: BZZZZ…

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's me!
et: MR. STONE: {PLAYER}{KUN}! See olen mina!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: You were apparently involved in all sorts of things, but I, being busy, haven't a clue exactly what!
et: Sa olevat igasugustesse seiklustesse sattunud, aga mul on nii kiire, et ma ei tea täpselt, millistesse!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: However, I urge you to take the road you believe in and walk it.
et: Aga mine kindlalt seda teed, millesse sa ise usud!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone10
en: I'll always be in your corner! Take care!
et: Ma olen alati sinu poolel! Hoia end!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: MR. STONE: … … … … … … Is this maybe {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: MR. STONE: … … … … … … Kas see on ehk {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: Your voice is so full of confidence, I didn't recognize you right off!
et: Su hääl on nii enesekindlust täis, et ma ei tundnud sind kohe ära!

label: MatchCall_Text_MrStone11
en: Hm! You must come visit us at DEVON sometime!
et: Hm! Tule meile DEVONISSE kunagi külla!

label: GiddyText_SoPretty
en: so pretty!
et: nii kena!

label: GiddyText_SoDarling
en: so darling!
et: nii armas!

label: GiddyText_SoRelaxed
en: so relaxed!
et: nii lõdvestunud!

label: GiddyText_SoSunny
en: so sunny!
et: nii päikeseline!

label: GiddyText_SoDesirable
en: so desirable!
et: nii ihaldusväärne!

label: GiddyText_SoExciting
en: so exciting!
et: nii põnev!

label: GiddyText_SoAmusing
en: so amusing!
et: nii lõbus!

label: GiddyText_SoMagical
en: so magical!
et: nii maagiline!

label: GiddyText_Is
en: is
et: on

label: GiddyText_DontYouAgree
en: Don't you agree?
et: Kas pole nii?

label: GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation
en: I so want to go on a vacation. Would you happen to know a nice place?
et: Tahaks nii väga puhkusele minna. Ega sa mõnda toredat kohta ei tea?

label: GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors
en: I bought crayons with 120 colors! Don't you think that's nice?
et: Ostsin 120 värviga vahakriidid! Kas pole tore?

label: GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat
en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could float away on a cloud of bubbles?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui saaks mullipilve peal minema hõljuda?

label: GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach
en: When you write on a sandy beach, they wash away. It makes me sad.
et: Liivarannale kirjutatu uhutakse minema. Mul hakkab sellest kurb.

label: GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike
en: What's the bottom of the sea like? Just once I would so love to go!
et: Milline küll merepõhi on? Tahaks kas või korra sinna minna!

label: GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt
en: When you see the setting sun, does it make you want to go home?
et: Kas loojuvat päikest nähes tekib sul tahtmine koju minna?

label: GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass
en: Lying back in the green grass… Oh, it's so, so nice!
et: Lamada selili rohelisel murul… Oh, see on nii-nii hea!

label: GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful
en: SECRET BASES are so wonderful! Can't you feel the excitement?
et: SALABAASID on nii vahvad! Kas sa ei tunne seda põnevust?

label: MoveTutor_Text_ThisMoveCanOnlyBeLearnedOnce
en: This move can be learned only once. Is that okay?
et: Seda võtet saab õppida ainult üks kord. Kas sobib?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: Heh! My POKéMON totally rules! It's cooler than any POKéMON!
et: Heh! Minu POKéMON on lihtsalt võimas! Ükski teine POKéMON pole nii lahe!

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: I was lipping off with a swagger in my step like that when the CHAIRMAN chewed me out.
et: Ma kelkisin just niimoodi uhkeldades, kuni ESIMEES mulle sõnad peale luges.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: That took the swagger out of my step.
et: See võttis mul uhkustamise isu ära.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTeach
en: If you'd like, I'll teach the move SWAGGER to a POKéMON of yours.
et: Kui tahad, õpetan ühele su POKéMONile võtte SWAGGER selgeks.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerDeclined
en: What, no? Can't you get into the spirit of things?
et: Mis, ei taha? Ega sa mängu kaasa ei tule või?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerWhichMon
en: All right, which POKéMON wants to learn how to SWAGGER?
et: Hea küll, milline POKéMON tahab võtte SWAGGER selgeks saada?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SwaggerTaught
en: I'll just praise my POKéMON from now on without the swagger.
et: Edaspidi kiidan ma oma POKéMONi ilma igasuguse uhkeldamiseta.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: Did you know that you can go from here a long way in that direction without changing direction?
et: Kas teadsid, et siit saab tolles suunas pika maa otse edasi minna?

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: I might even be able to roll that way.
et: Ma võiksin sinnapoole lausa veereda.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: Do you think your POKéMON will want to roll, too?
et: Kas arvad, et su POKéMON tahab ka veereda?

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach
en: I can teach one the move ROLLOUT if you'd like.
et: Kui tahad, õpetan ühele neist võtte ROLLOUT.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined
en: You don't need to be shy about it. Let's roll!
et: Pole vaja häbeneda. Hakkame veerema!

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon
en: Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if the POKéMON looked like me.
et: Ehehee, muidugi! Oleks tore, kui POKéMON minu moodi välja näeks.

label: MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught
en: Rolling around in the grass makes me happy. Come on, let's roll!
et: Mulle meeldib rohus ringi veereda. Tule, veereme koos!

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: There's a move that gets stronger when you keep using it in a row.
et: On olemas võte, mis muutub tugevamaks, kui kasutad seda järjest.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: It's a BUG-type move, and it is wickedly cool.
et: See on PUTUKA-tüüpi võte ja pööraselt lahe.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach
en: It's called FURY CUTTER. Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?
et: Selle nimi on FURY CUTTER. Kas õpetan selle mõnele su POKéMONile?

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined
en: We're not on the same wavelength.
et: Me pole samal lainepikkusel.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon
en: Yay! Show me which POKéMON I should teach.
et: Jee! Näita, millist POKéMONi ma õpetama pean.

label: MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught
en: I get a thrill watching to see if the move keeps hitting in succession!
et: Nii põnev on vaadata, kas võte tabab ikka järjest edasi!

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: Ah, young one!
et: Ah, nooruke!

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: I am also a young one, but I mimic the styles and speech of the elderly folks of this town.
et: Ma olen ka ise nooruke, aga matkin selle linna vanarahva olekut ja kõnepruuki.

label: MoveTutor_MimicTeach
en: What do you say, young one? Would you agree to it if I were to offer to teach the move MIMIC?
et: Mida kostad, nooruke? Kas võtaksid vastu, kui pakuksin sulle võtte MIMIC?

label: MoveTutor_MimicDeclined
en: Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC to your POKéMON!
et: Oh, kahju! Ma tahtsin su POKéMONile võtte MIMIC selgeks õpetada!

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon
en: Fwofwo! And so I shall! Let me see the POKéMON you wish me to teach.
et: Fvofvo! Nõnda ma teengi! Näita mulle seda POKéMONi, keda õpetada.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
en: MIMIC is a move of great depth.
et: MIMIC on väga sügavamõtteline võte.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught
en: Could you execute it to perfection as well as me…?
et: Kas sina suudad seda sama täiuslikult sooritada kui mina…?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: I want all sorts of things! But I used up my allowance…
et: Ma tahan nii palju asju! Aga taskuraha sai otsa…

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: Wouldn't it be nice if there were a spell that made money appear when you waggle a finger?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui oleks loits, mis sõrme vibutades raha välja võlub?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: If you want, I can teach your POKéMON the move METRONOME.
et: Kui tahad, õpetan su POKéMONile võtte METRONOME.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach
en: Money won't appear, but your POKéMON will waggle a finger. Yes?
et: Raha sellest küll ei tule, aga su POKéMON vibutab sõrme. Sobib?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined
en: Okay. I'll be here if you change your mind.
et: Olgu. Ma olen siin, kui meelt muudad.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon
en: Okay! I'll teach it! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Olgu! Õpetan ära! Keda ma õpetama pean?

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
en: When a POKéMON waggles its finger like a METRONOME, all sorts of nice things happen.
et: Kui POKéMON vibutab oma sõrme nagu METRONOME, juhtub igasuguseid toredaid asju.

label: MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught
en: Wouldn't it be nice if we could use it, too?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui meiegi saaksime seda kasutada?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN POWER to stay awake.
et: Hmpf! Minu naine loodab ärkvel püsimiseks võttele HIDDEN POWER.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: She should just take a nap like I do, and SLEEP TALK.
et: Võtaks parem nagu mina uinaku ja kasutaks SLEEP TALK.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach
en: I can teach your POKéMON how to SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?
et: Ma võin selle asemel õpetada su POKéMONile võtte SLEEP TALK. Huvitab?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined
en: Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake with HIDDEN POWER, too…
et: Oh, hea küll, hea küll. Sinagi tahad HIDDEN POWERiga ärkvel püsida…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon
en: Ah, an appreciative child! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Ah, tubli laps! Keda ma õpetama pean?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
en: I've never once gotten my wife's coin trick right.
et: Ma pole kordagi oma naise münditrikki õigesti välja teinud.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught
en: I would be happy if I got it right even as I SLEEP TALK…
et: Oleks tore, kui see õnnestuks kas või unes, võtte SLEEP TALK abil…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: When I see the wide world from up here on the roof…
et: Kui ma siit katuselt seda avarat maailma vaatan…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: I think about how nice it would be if there were more than just one me so I could enjoy all sorts of lives.
et: …mõtlen, kui tore oleks, kui mind oleks mitu, et saaksin elada mitut eri elu.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: Of course it's not possible. Giggle…
et: Muidugi pole see võimalik. Hihii…

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach
en: I know! Would you be interested in having a POKéMON learn SUBSTITUTE?
et: Ma tean! Kas tahaksid, et mõni su POKéMON õpiks võtte SUBSTITUTE?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
en: Oh, no?
et: Oi, ei taha?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined
en: A POKéMON can make a copy of itself using it, you know.
et: Selle võttega saab POKéMON endast koopia teha, tead küll.

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteWhichMon
en: Giggle… Which POKéMON do you want me to teach SUBSTITUTE?
et: Hihii… Millisele POKéMONile ma võtte SUBSTITUTE õpetan?

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
en: We human beings should enjoy our own lives to the utmost!
et: Meie, inimesed, peaksime oma elu täiel rinnal nautima!

label: MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught
en: I hope you'll get that way, too!
et: Loodan, et sinagi oskad kunagi nii elada!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: I can't do this anymore!
et: Ma ei suuda seda enam!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: It's utterly hopeless!
et: See on täiesti lootusetu!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER, so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM no matter how hard I try!
et: Ma olen KAKLUS-tüüpi TRAINER, nii et ükskõik kui kõvasti ma ka ei pinguta, MOSSDEEP SAALIS ma ei võida!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch! Punch!
et: Argh! Löök! Löök! Löök! Löök! Löök! Löök!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: What, don't look at me that way! I'm only hitting the ground!
et: Mis on, ära vahi mind niimoodi! Ma lihtsalt taon maad!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach
en: Or do you want me to teach your POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?
et: Või tahad, et õpetaksin su POKéMONile võtte DYNAMICPUNCH?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined
en: Darn! You're even making fun of me? Punch! Punch! Punch!
et: Pagan! Sa veel naerad minu üle? Löök! Löök! Löök!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon
en: What? You do? You're a good person! Which POKéMON should I teach?
et: Mis? Tahad tõesti? Sa oled tore inimene! Keda ma õpetama pean?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught
en: I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM using that DYNAMICPUNCH!
et: Võida selle võttega DYNAMICPUNCH MOSSDEEP SAALIS minu eest ära!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really lovably admirable.
et: SOOTOPOLIS SAALI JUHT on nii armas ja imetlusväärne.

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: But that also means I have many rivals for his attention.
et: Aga see tähendab ka, et mul on tema tähelepanu pärast palju rivaale.

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: He's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE. I couldn't even catch his eye.
et: Ta võlub kõiki võttega DOUBLE-EDGE. Mina ei suutnud isegi ta pilku püüda.

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach
en: Please, let me teach your POKéMON the move DOUBLE-EDGE!
et: Palun, lase mul õpetada su POKéMONile võtet DOUBLE-EDGE!

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined
en: Oh… Even you rejected me…
et: Oh… Isegi sina ütlesid mulle ära…

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon
en: Okay, which POKéMON should I teach DOUBLE-EDGE?
et: Olgu, millisele POKéMONile ma võtte DOUBLE-EDGE õpetan?

label: MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught
en: I won't live for love anymore! I'll become tough!
et: Ma ei ela enam armastuse nimel! Minust saab kõva tegija!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
en: I don't intend to be going nowhere fast in the sticks like this forever.
et: Ma ei kavatse igavesti niimoodi maakolkas paigal tammuda.

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
en: You watch me, I'll get out to the city and become a huge hit.
et: Küll sa näed — ma lähen linna ja löön seal läbi!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
en: Seriously, I'm going to cause a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!
et: Ausõna, minu populaarsus lööb lahti nagu EXPLOSION!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach
en: If you overheard that, I'll happily teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!
et: Kui sa seda pealt kuulsid, õpetan hea meelega su POKéMONile võtte EXPLOSION!

label: MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined
en: Gaah! You're turning me down because I live in the country?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
en: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?
et: Kas sul on juba SALABAAS tehtud?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
en: I went here, there, everywhere before choosing this place.
et: Ma käisin siin ja seal ja igal pool, enne kui selle koha välja valisin.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Intro
