en: Since you're already here, how would you like to battle?
et: Kui sa juba siin oled, kas võitleme?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0AcceptBattle
en: Okay! Here we come!
et: Olgu! Läheb lahti!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0DeclineBattle
en: Hunh? Oh, you can't now…
et: Häh? Ah, praegu ei saa…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0Defeated
en: Waaargh! You're too strong! About me losing… Please keep it secret!
et: Vaaargh! Sa oled liiga tugev! Et ma kaotasin… Palun hoia seda saladuses!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PostBattle
en: What do you think of my SECRET BASE? Come visit me again tomorrow.
et: Mis sa mu SALABAASIST arvad? Tule homme jälle külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
en: Have you made a SECRET BASE already?
et: Kas sul on juba SALABAAS tehtud?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
en: I went here, there, everywhere before choosing this place.
et: Ma käisin siin ja seal ja igal pool, enne kui selle koha välja valisin.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer0PreChampion
en: Feel free to hang out!
et: Tunne end nagu kodus!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
en: There're a lot of places where you can make a SECRET BASE.
et: SALABAASI saab teha paljudesse kohtadesse.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
en: But I like this spot best. Don't you think it's nice?
et: Aga mulle meeldib see koht kõige rohkem. Eks ole tore?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Intro
en: Oh, would you like to have a battle?
et: Oh, kas tahad võidelda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5AcceptBattle
en: Okay, here goes!
et: Olgu, läks lahti!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5DeclineBattle
en: Oh… You can't now, okay.
et: Oh… Praegu ei saa, selge.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5Defeated
en: Hmmm… It's our loss… But don't tell anyone! It's a confidential secret!
et: Hmmm… Me kaotasime… Aga ära kellelegi räägi! See on ülisalajane saladus!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PostBattle
en: If you're in this area again, I hope you'll visit me.
et: Kui sa jälle siia kanti satud, tule mulle külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
en: There're a lot of places where you can make a SECRET BASE.
et: SALABAASI saab teha paljudesse kohtadesse.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer5PreChampion
en: But I like this spot best. Don't you think it's nice?
et: Aga mulle meeldib see koht kõige rohkem. Eks ole tore?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
en: This is a popular spot. It's always taken.
et: See on populaarne koht. Alati on keegi ees.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
en: Oh! Were you thinking about taking this spot, too?
et: Oh! Kas sinagi tahtsid selle koha endale võtta?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Intro
en: I'll tell you what, you can have this spot if you can beat me.
et: Teeme nii: kui sa mind võidad, saad selle koha endale.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1AcceptBattle
en: Okay! I'm going to defend my SECRET BASE!
et: Olgu! Ma kaitsen oma SALABAASI!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1DeclineBattle
en: Hunh? Is that right? You're not interested in this spot?
et: Häh? Tõesti? See koht ei huvita sind?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1Defeated
en: I can't keep going! I surrender!
et: Ma ei jaksa enam! Ma annan alla!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PostBattle
en: Okay, when I move one day, this place will be yours!
et: Olgu, kui ma ükskord ära kolin, jääb see koht sulle!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
en: This is a popular spot. It's always taken.
et: See on populaarne koht. Alati on keegi ees.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer1PreChampion
en: I waited a long time for it to open. I finally got to use it!
et: Ma ootasin kaua, et see vabaneks. Lõpuks sain selle endale!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.
et: Tere tulemast minu POKéMON LABORISSE.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: I carry out research on battling in secrecy.
et: Ma uurin siin salaja võitlemist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Intro
en: Would you like to see how strong I am?
et: Kas tahad näha, kui tugev ma olen?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6AcceptBattle
en: I'm going to go all out!
et: Ma annan endast kõik!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6DeclineBattle
en: Oh. Some other time, then!
et: Oh. Siis mõni teine kord!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6Defeated
en: Hmm… I've still got lots to learn. I have to study some more.
et: Hmm… Mul on veel palju õppida. Pean rohkem uurima.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PostBattle
en: Thanks for battling with me. Please come back again tomorrow.
et: Aitäh, et minuga võitlesid. Tule homme jälle.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
en: Welcome to my POKéMON LAB.
et: Tere tulemast minu POKéMON LABORISSE.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer6PreChampion
en: I carry out research on battling in secrecy.
et: Ma uurin siin salaja võitlemist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: A big mansion is nice, but I like this sort of place more.
et: Suur häärber on küll tore, aga mulle meeldib selline koht rohkem.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: I like it because all kinds of people come visit me.
et: Mulle meeldib, et siia tuleb igasuguseid inimesi külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Intro
en: So, how would you like a battle?
et: Nii et kuidas oleks ühe lahinguga?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2AcceptBattle
en: That's the way!
et: Just nii!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2DeclineBattle
en: When you're ready, give me a shout!
et: Kui oled valmis, anna märku!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2Defeated
en: Aww! Done in! But it's still fun to battle!
et: Ohh! Läbi olen! Aga võidelda on ikka lõbus!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
en: Well, anyway, I should go buy some decorations and furniture.
et: Noh, igatahes peaksin minema kaunistusi ja mööblit ostma.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PostBattle
en: I want my SECRET BASE to be a place other people can enjoy.
et: Ma tahan, et mu SALABAAS oleks koht, kus ka teistel on tore olla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
en: A big mansion is nice, but I like this sort of place more.
et: Suur häärber on küll tore, aga mulle meeldib selline koht rohkem.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer2PreChampion
en: I like it because all kinds of people come visit me.
et: Mulle meeldib, et siia tuleb igasuguseid inimesi külla.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: I simply adore shopping for decorations and furniture.
et: Ma lihtsalt jumaldan kaunistuste ja mööbli ostmist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: I also love raising POKéMON just as much.
et: Ja POKéMONide kasvatamist armastan ma täpselt sama palju.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Intro
en: If you would be so kind, will you battle with my POKéMON?
et: Kui sa oleksid nii lahke, kas võitleksid mu POKéMONidega?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7AcceptBattle
en: Thank you. Shall we begin?
et: Aitäh. Kas alustame?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7DeclineBattle
en: Oh. How disappointing…
et: Oh. Kui kahju…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7Defeated
en: I concede…
et: Ma annan alla…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PostBattle
en: That was all in good fun! I should go enjoy shopping now.
et: See oli puhas lõbu! Nüüd lähen naudin ostlemist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
en: I simply adore shopping for decorations and furniture.
et: Ma lihtsalt jumaldan kaunistuste ja mööbli ostmist.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer7PreChampion
en: I also love raising POKéMON just as much.
et: Ja POKéMONide kasvatamist armastan ma täpselt sama palju.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
en: Some people make their SECRET BASES in hard-to-find places. Do they want to just lie low?
et: Mõned teevad oma SALABAASI raskesti leitavasse kohta. Kas nad tahavad lihtsalt varju jääda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Intro
en: But since you found me, how about we have a battle?
et: Aga kuna sa mind üles leidsid, kuidas oleks ühe lahinguga?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3AcceptBattle
en: I'm not going down easily!
et: Nii kergelt ma alla ei anna!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3DeclineBattle
en: Oh… Are you maybe tired from searching for this place?
et: Oh… Kas sa väsisid selle koha otsimisest ära?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3Defeated
en: I went down…
et: Ma sain lüüa…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PostBattle
en: Where's your SECRET BASE? I should go visit you there.
et: Kus su SALABAAS on? Peaksin sulle sinna külla tulema.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer3PreChampion
en: Some people make their SECRET BASES in hard-to-find places. Do they want to just lie low?
et: Mõned teevad oma SALABAASI raskesti leitavasse kohta. Kas nad tahavad lihtsalt varju jääda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: People have told me that you can get decorations in several ways.
et: Mulle on räägitud, et kaunistusi saab hankida mitut moodi.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: We should have a race to see who can get nicer decorations and furniture!
et: Võistleme, kumb saab endale ilusamad kaunistused ja mööbli!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Intro
en: In the meantime, want to battle?
et: Seniks aga – tahad võidelda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8AcceptBattle
en: This is my SECRET BASE. I can't lose!
et: See on minu SALABAAS. Ma ei tohi kaotada!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8DeclineBattle
en: I'll battle with you anytime.
et: Ma võitlen sinuga millal tahes.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8Defeated
en: Huh? Did I just lose?
et: Huh? Kas ma just kaotasin?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PostBattle
en: I won't lose at collecting decorations. Come visit again!
et: Kaunistuste kogumises ma küll ei kaota. Tule jälle külla!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
en: People have told me that you can get decorations in several ways.
et: Mulle on räägitud, et kaunistusi saab hankida mitut moodi.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer8PreChampion
en: We should have a race to see who can get nicer decorations and furniture!
et: Võistleme, kumb saab endale ilusamad kaunistused ja mööbli!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
en: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up with my favorite decorations.
et: Leidsin koha, mis mulle meeldis, ja kaunistasin selle oma lemmikkaunistustega.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
en: I raise my favorite POKéMON and grow stronger with it.
et: Ma kasvatan oma lemmik-POKéMONi ja saan koos temaga tugevamaks.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Intro
en: That's what I do. Want to battle with me?
et: Nii ma elan. Tahad minuga võidelda?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4AcceptBattle
en: Show me what you're made of!
et: Näita, mida sa suudad!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4DeclineBattle
en: I guess there are times when you're not into it.
et: Eks ikka ole aegu, kui pole tuju.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4Defeated
en: I know exactly what you're made of now.
et: Nüüd ma tean täpselt, mida sa suudad.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PostBattle
en: We can both become stronger. Let's keep at it!
et: Me mõlemad võime tugevamaks saada. Pingutame edasi!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
en: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up with my favorite decorations.
et: Leidsin koha, mis mulle meeldis, ja kaunistasin selle oma lemmikkaunistustega.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
en: I raise my favorite POKéMON and grow stronger with it.
et: Ma kasvatan oma lemmik-POKéMONi ja saan koos temaga tugevamaks.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer4PreChampion
en: Every day is a great day.
et: Iga päev on suurepärane päev.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
en: You can learn a lot about the taste and sense of people by the kinds of decorations they have, and how they display them.
et: Inimese maitse ja tunnetuse kohta saab palju teada sellest, millised kaunistused tal on ja kuidas ta need välja paneb.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
en: What do you think of my taste? Are you speechless?
et: Mis sa mu maitsest arvad? Oled sõnatu?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Intro
en: Want to see my taste in battling?
et: Tahad näha, milline on mu maitse võitlemises?

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9AcceptBattle
en: There's no holding back!
et: Ma ei hoia end tagasi!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9DeclineBattle
en: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style anytime.
et: Ma näitan oma stiili hea meelega millal tahes.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9Defeated
en: You're supremely talented! Your power seems to be limitless…
et: Sa oled ülimalt andekas! Su jõud näib piiritu…

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PostBattle
en: What did you think of my style? I'll keep on polishing it!
et: Mis sa mu stiilist arvasid? Ma lihvin seda edasi!

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
en: You can learn a lot about the taste and sense of people by the kinds of decorations they have, and how they display them.
et: Inimese maitse ja tunnetuse kohta saab palju teada sellest, millised kaunistused tal on ja kuidas ta need välja paneb.

label: SecretBase_Text_Trainer9PreChampion
en: What do you think of my taste? Are you speechless?
et: Mis sa mu maitsest arvad? Oled sõnatu?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
en: Are you planning on going deep in there?
et: Kas kavatsed sinna sügavale minna?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
en: How about bringing me back some SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?
et: Ega sa tooks mulle sealt veidi SHOAL SALTi ja mõned SHOAL SHELLid?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_AreYouPlanningOnGoingInThere
en: I can make you something good if you bring me the ingredients.
et: Kui tood mulle koostisosad, meisterdan sulle midagi head.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
en: If you bring me four each of the SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS, I can make you a SHELL BELL…
et: Kui tood mulle neli SHOAL SALTi ja neli SHOAL SHELLi, meisterdan sulle SHELL BELLi…

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_BringMe4ShoalSaltAndShells
en: You can get those ingredients every day.
et: Neid koostisosi saad iga päev.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
en: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS! And enough of them, too!
et: Oh, kuule! SHOAL SALT ja SHOAL SHELLid! Ja täpselt piisavalt!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WouldYouLikeShellBell
en: Would you like me to make you a SHELL BELL with them?
et: Kas tahad, et ma teen sulle nendest SHELL BELLi?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
en: All righty, then! I'll make you a SHELL BELL right away.
et: Hea küll! Meisterdan sulle kohe SHELL BELLi.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_MakeShellBellRightAway
en: There! Done!
et: Nii! Valmis!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: Have a POKéMON hold on to that. It'll love it, that's for certain.
et: Anna see mõnele POKéMONile hoida. Talle see kindlasti meeldib.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: Why, the SHELL BELL's chime… It's simply sublime!
et: Oi, SHELL BELLi helin… See on lihtsalt taevalik!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_ExplainShellBell
en: You can get its ingredients every day, so I can make you more.
et: Koostisosi saab iga päev juurde, nii et võin sulle neid veel teha.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_WantedToMakeShellBell
en: Oh… Is that so… I wanted to make a SHELL BELL…
et: Oh… Või nii… Ma tahtsin SHELL BELLi teha…

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
en: You don't have space in your BAG if I were to make it for you.
et: Kui ma selle sulle teeksin, poleks sul KOTIS ruumi.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom_Text_NoSpaceInYourBag
en: You should make room and come back for a SHELL BELL.
et: Tee ruumi ja tule siis SHELL BELLi järele tagasi.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoalSaltNowNothing
en: There was some SHOAL SALT here. But, there's nothing here now.
et: Siin oli veidi SHOAL SALTi. Aga nüüd pole siin midagi.

label: ShoalCave_Text_WasShoallShellNowNothing
en: There was a SHOAL SHELL here. But, there's nothing here now.
et: Siin oli SHOAL SHELL. Aga nüüd pole siin midagi.

label: gText_WantToUseSurf
en: The water is dyed a deep blue… Would you like to SURF?
et: Vesi on sügavsinine… Kas tahad SURFida?

label: gText_PlayerUsedSurf
en: {STR_VAR_1} used SURF!
et: {STR_VAR_1} kasutas SURF!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinIntro
en: If you have POKéMON with you, then you're an official POKéMON TRAINER! You can't say no to my challenge!
et: Kui sul on POKéMON kaasas, siis oled sa ametlik POKéMON TRAINER! Minu väljakutsest ei saa sa keelduda!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinDefeated
en: Arrgh, I lost… I should have trained mine more…
et: Arrgh, ma kaotasin… Oleksin pidanud omasid rohkem treenima…

label: Route102_Text_CalvinPostBattle
en: Listen, you. If you're strong, you should have told me before!
et: Kuule, sina. Kui sa nii tugev oled, oleksid võinud enne öelda!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
en: I've been working hard at this since I saw you before.
et: Sellest ajast, kui me viimati kohtusime, olen ma kõvasti vaeva näinud.

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegister
en: I'd like to battle you again, so can you register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Ma tahaksin sinuga uuesti võidelda. Kas registreerid mu oma POKéNAVi?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRegisterShort
en: I'd like to battle you again, so can you register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Ma tahaksin sinuga uuesti võidelda. Kas registreerid mu oma POKéNAVi?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchIntro
en: Ever since I lost to you, I desperately trained my POKéMON. You can't say no to my challenge!
et: Pärast seda, kui ma sulle kaotasin, olen ma oma POKéMONe meeleheitlikult treeninud. Minu väljakutsest ei saa sa keelduda!

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchDefeated
en: Arrgh, I lost… Is my training method not right?
et: Arrgh, ma kaotasin… Kas ma treenin valesti?

label: Route102_Text_CalvinRematchPostBattle
en: If you're going to get stronger, I'll get stronger, too.
et: Kui sina tugevamaks lähed, lähen minagi tugevamaks.

label: Route102_Text_AllenIntro
en: Did you just become a TRAINER? We're both beginners!
et: Kas sa said alles äsja TRAINERIKS? Siis oleme mõlemad algajad!

label: Route102_Text_AllenDefeated
en: I called you because I thought I could beat you…
et: Ma hõikasin sind, sest arvasin, et suudan sind võita…

label: Route102_Text_AllenPostBattle
en: I haven't won once yet… I wish I would win soon…
et: Ma pole veel kordagi võitnud… Kui ma ometi varsti võidaks…

label: Route102_Text_RickIntro
en: Hahah! Our eyes met! I'll take you on with my BUG POKéMON!
et: Hahah! Meie pilgud kohtusid! Ma võtan su ette oma PUTUKA-POKéMONidega!

label: Route102_Text_RickDefeated
en: Ow! Down and out!
et: Ai! Maas ja läbi!

label: Route102_Text_RickPostBattle
en: If you lock eyes with a TRAINER, you have to challenge! It's a rule!
et: Kui su pilk kohtub TRAINERI omaga, pead talle väljakutse esitama! Nii on reegel!

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
en: I'm going to keep winning and aim to be the best TRAINER.
et: Ma kavatsen aina võita ja saada parimaks TRAINERIKS.

label: Route102_Text_TianaIntro
en: Help me further my career!
et: Aita mul oma karjääri edendada!

label: Route102_Text_TianaDefeated
en: I ended up furthering your career…
et: Lõpuks edendasin hoopis sinu karjääri…

label: Route102_Text_TianaPostBattle
en: To keep winning my way up, I see that I have to catch more POKéMON.
et: Näen, et tippu võitmiseks pean rohkem POKéMONe püüdma.

label: Route103_Text_DaisyIntro
en: Did you feel the tug of our soul-soothing fragrance?
et: Kas tundsid, kuidas meie hingekosutav lõhn sind ligi tõmbas?

label: Route103_Text_DaisyDefeated
en: You weren't led astray by our aroma…
et: Meie aroom ei viinud sind eksiteele…

label: Route103_Text_DaisyPostBattle
en: Aromatherapy is a form of mental healing that works with fragrances.
et: Aroomiteraapia on vaimse tervendamise viis, mis kasutab lõhnu.

label: Route103_Text_AmyIntro
en: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!
et: AMY: Ma olen AMY. Ja see on mu väike õde LIV. Me võitleme koos!

label: Route103_Text_AmyDefeated
en: AMY: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: AMY: Oi-oi, me kaotasime.

label: Route103_Text_AmyPostBattle
en: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.
et: AMY: Kahe TRAINERI vastu võideldes tuleb igasuguseid asju läbi mõelda.

label: Route103_Text_AmyNotEnoughPokemon
en: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.
et: AMY: Oi-oi, sul on kaasas ainult üks POKéMON. Niimoodi sa meiega võidelda ei saa.

label: Route103_Text_LivIntro
en: LIV: We battle together as one team.
et: LIV: Me võitleme koos ühe meeskonnana.

label: Route103_Text_LivDefeated
en: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister…
et: LIV: Oh, õde, me kaotasime…

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
en: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister…
et: LIV: Mina ja mu vanem õde teeme täiuslikku koostööd…

label: Route103_Text_LivPostBattle
en: But we still lost…
et: Aga me ikkagi kaotasime…

label: Route103_Text_AmyLivRegister
en: LIV: Really, we're a lot better… It's true! We'll show you next time!
et: LIV: Tegelikult oleme me palju paremad… Ausalt! Järgmine kord näitame sulle!

label: Route103_Text_LivNotEnoughPokemon
en: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!
et: LIV: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, peab sul olema kaks POKéMONi! Muidu pole aus!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchIntro
en: AMY: I'm AMY. And this is my little sister LIV. We battle together!
et: AMY: Ma olen AMY. Ja see on mu väike õde LIV. Me võitleme koos!

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchDefeated
en: AMY: Aww, boo! We couldn't win again…
et: AMY: Oh, kahju! Me ei võitnud jällegi…

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchPostBattle
en: AMY: You have to think about all kinds of things when you're battling against two TRAINERS.
et: AMY: Kahe TRAINERI vastu võideldes tuleb igasuguseid asju läbi mõelda.

label: Route103_Text_AmyRematchNotEnoughPokemon
en: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one POKéMON with you. You can't battle us like that.
et: AMY: Oi-oi, sul on kaasas ainult üks POKéMON. Niimoodi sa meiega võidelda ei saa.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchIntro
en: LIV: We battle together as one team.
et: LIV: Me võitleme koos ühe meeskonnana.

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchDefeated
en: LIV: Awww, we lost again… Big sister…
et: LIV: Ohh, me kaotasime jälle… Õde…

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
en: LIV: We work perfectly together, me and my big sister…
et: LIV: Mina ja mu vanem õde teeme täiuslikku koostööd…

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchPostBattle
en: But why did we lose again?
et: Aga miks me jälle kaotasime?

label: Route103_Text_LivRematchNotEnoughPokemon
en: LIV: If you want to battle us, you have to have two POKéMON! It's not fair if you don't!
et: LIV: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, peab sul olema kaks POKéMONi! Muidu pole aus!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewIntro
en: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up! I'm getting frustrated and mean! That's it! Battle me!
et: Gah! Mu õngenöör on täitsa sassis! Ma lähen närvi ja tigedaks! Aitab! Võitle minuga!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewDefeated
en: Gah! Lost it! I'm even more annoyed now!
et: Gah! Kaotasin! Nüüd olen veel rohkem närvis!

label: Route103_Text_AndrewPostBattle
en: Gah, I'm still boiling mad… Grrrrr…
et: Gah, ma keen ikka veel vihast… Grrrrr…

label: Route103_Text_MiguelIntro
en: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable! Don't be shy--I'll show you!
et: Mu POKéMON on lausa hurmavalt armas! Ära häbene – ma näitan sulle!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelDefeated
en: Oh, my gosh! My darling POKéMON!
et: Oh, heldeke! Mu kallis POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelPostBattle
en: My delightful POKéMON looks darling even when it's fainted!
et: Mu hurmav POKéMON on armas isegi minestanuna!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRegister
en: I'll get you to come out and look in on my delightful POKéMON again!
et: Ma kutsun su veel mu hurmavat POKéMONi vaatama!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchIntro
en: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable POKéMON has become more darling!
et: Tere, sina seal! Mu hurmavalt armas POKéMON on läinud veel armsamaks!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchDefeated
en: Oh! My darling POKéMON!
et: Oh! Mu kallis POKéMON!

label: Route103_Text_MiguelRematchPostBattle
en: The more I spend time with it, the more adorable my POKéMON becomes.
et: Mida rohkem ma temaga aega veedan, seda armsamaks mu POKéMON muutub.

label: Route103_Text_PeteIntro
en: This sort of distance… You should just swim it!
et: Selline vahemaa… Selle võiks lihtsalt läbi ujuda!

label: Route103_Text_PeteDefeated
en: Oh, that's good going!
et: Oh, tubli sooritus!

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
en: Oh, I understand where you're coming from now.
et: Oh, nüüd ma saan sinust aru.

label: Route103_Text_PetePostBattle
en: If I had a POKéMON that trusty, I'd want to SURF on it, too!
et: Kui mul oleks nii usaldusväärne POKéMON, tahaksin ka tema seljas SURFida!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleIntro
en: Watch where you're going! We're going to crash!
et: Vaata ette! Me põrkame kokku!

label: Route103_Text_IsabelleDefeated
en: Groan…
et: Oeh…

label: Route103_Text_IsabellePostBattle
en: I'm a poor swimmer so I was practicing… Sorry for almost crashing into you.
et: Ma olen kehv ujuja, nii et harjutasin… Vabandust, et äärepealt sulle otsa sõitsin.

label: Route103_Text_RhettIntro
en: Whoa! How'd you get into a space this small?
et: Ohoo! Kuidas sa nii kitsasse kohta ära mahtusid?

label: Route103_Text_RhettDefeated
en: Whoa! The kid can rock!
et: Ohoo! See põnn oskab rokkida!

label: Route103_Text_RhettPostBattle
en: Do you like cramped quarters like this?
et: Kas sulle meeldivad sellised kitsad urkad?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosIntro
en: Did my guitar's wailing draw you in?
et: Kas mu kitarri ulg meelitas su siia?

label: Route103_Text_MarcosDefeated
en: My one-man show is ruined…
et: Mu sooloetendus on rikutud…

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
en: I was playing my guitar where few people were around, but a lot of fans have gathered.
et: Ma tulin kitarri mängima sinna, kus rahvast vähe, aga fänne on ikka hulgi kokku jooksnud.

label: Route103_Text_MarcosPostBattle
en: Heh, maybe I should turn pro.
et: Heh, ehk peaksin profiks hakkama.

label: Route104_Text_GinaIntro
en: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our POKéMON!
et: GINA: Olgu, võitleme oma POKéMONidega!

label: Route104_Text_GinaDefeat
en: GINA: Losing upsets me!
et: GINA: Kaotamine ajab mind närvi!

label: Route104_Text_GinaPostBattle
en: GINA: You are strong! We have to train lots more!
et: GINA: Sa oled tugev! Me peame palju rohkem treenima!

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
en: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON? Then, we don't battle with you.
et: GINA: Oh? Ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me sinuga ei võitle.

label: Route104_Text_GinaNotEnoughMons
en: If there's only one POKéMON, it will be lonesome. That's not nice.
et: Ühel POKéMONil oleks üksinda kurb. See poleks kena.

label: Route104_Text_MiaIntro
en: MIA: We are twins, so we battle POKéMON together.
et: MIA: Me oleme kaksikud, seepärast võitleme POKéMONidega koos.

label: Route104_Text_MiaDefeat
en: MIA: We battled together, but we both lost…
et: MIA: Me võitlesime koos, aga kaotasime mõlemad…

label: Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle
en: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more and be strong like you.
et: MIA: Me treenime oma POKéMONe veel ja saame sama tugevaks kui sina.

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
en: MIA: You want to battle with us?
et: MIA: Sa tahad meiega võidelda?

label: Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons
en: It's a big no-no if you don't have two POKéMON with you. We're too strong for you!
et: Ilma kahe POKéMONita ei tule kõne allagi. Me oleme sinu jaoks liiga tugevad!

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
en: Why keep it a secret? I'm the WATER POKéMON expert!
et: Milleks seda varjata? Mina olen VEE-POKéMONide ekspert!

label: Route104_Text_IvanIntro
en: Huh? You don't know me?
et: Huh? Sa ei tunne mind?

label: Route104_Text_IvanDefeat
en: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may say so, but I guess not… Bleah…
et: Ma pidasin end päris heaks, kui tohib öelda, aga ju siis mitte… Bläh…

label: Route104_Text_IvanPostBattle
en: I got too into fishing. I forgot I had to raise my POKéMON…
et: Ma jäin kalapüügiga liialt hoogu. Unustasin, et POKéMONe tuleb ka kasvatada…

label: Route104_Text_BillyIntro
en: Leaving footprints in the sand is so fun!
et: Liivale jälgede jätmine on nii lõbus!

label: Route104_Text_BillyDefeat
en: Waah! I got sand in my runners! They're all gritty!
et: Uaah! Mul on liiv tossude sees! Kõik krõbiseb!

label: Route104_Text_BillyPostBattle
en: I want to leave my footprints in the sand everywhere, but they disappear quickly…
et: Ma tahaksin jätta oma jäljed igale poole liivale, aga need kaovad nii kähku…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
en: Should I… Or shouldn't I?
et: Kas peaks… Või ei peaks?

label: Route104_Text_HaleyIntro
en: Okay, sure, I will battle!
et: Olgu, hea küll, ma võitlen!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyDefeat
en: I shouldn't have battled…
et: Poleks pidanud võitlema…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostBattle
en: If you're faced with a decision and you let someone else choose for you, you will regret it, however things turn out.
et: Kui pead otsuse tegema ja lased kellelgi teisel enda eest valida, kahetsed seda hiljem, ükskõik kuidas ka ei läheks.

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
en: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't…
et: Sa oled tugev… aga kas peaksin sind oma POKéNAVi kirja panema? Äkki ei peaks…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister1
en: Okay, sure, I will register you!
et: Olgu peale, panen su kirja!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
en: You're strong, but should I register you in my POKéNAV? Maybe I shouldn't…
et: Sa oled tugev… aga kas peaksin sind oma POKéNAVi kirja panema? Äkki ei peaks…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRegister2
en: Okay, sure, I will register you!
et: Olgu peale, panen su kirja!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchIntro
en: Come on, battle with me!
et: No kuule, võitle minuga!

label: Route104_Text_HaleyRematchDefeat
en: Ohh… I thought I could win…
et: Ohh… Ma arvasin, et võidan…

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
en: I made the decision to battle, so I can accept this loss with grace.
et: Otsuse võidelda tegin ma ise, nii et suudan kaotusega väärikalt leppida.

label: Route104_Text_HaleyPostRematch
en: I am still upset about losing!
et: Aga ikka veel on kaotuse pärast paha tunne!

label: Route104_Text_WinstonIntro
en: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge. I have a lot of money.
et: Oh, muidugi võtan su väljakutse vastu. Raha on mul küllaga.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonDefeat
en: Why couldn't I win?
et: Miks ma küll ei võitnud?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle
en: There are some things money can't buy. That's POKéMON…
et: On asju, mida raha eest ei osta. Näiteks POKéMONid…

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
en: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.
et: Hm? Ah, sul on POKéNAV käes.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1
en: I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.
et: Panen su hea meelega kirja. Raha on mul ju küllaga.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
en: Hm? Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.
et: Hm? Ah, sul on POKéNAV käes.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2
en: I will gladly register you. After all, I have plenty of money.
et: Panen su hea meelega kirja. Raha on mul ju küllaga.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro
en: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch of things about POKéMON.
et: Pärast sulle kaotamist õppisin POKéMONide kohta hulga uut.

label: Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat
en: I lost again? Why couldn't I win?
et: Kaotasin jälle? Miks ma küll ei võida?

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
en: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't seem to win at POKéMON…
et: Ma olen pööraselt rikas, aga POKéMONidega ma kuidagi ei võida…

label: Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch
en: It's so deep, the world of POKéMON…
et: Sügav asi see POKéMONide maailm…

label: Route104_Text_CindyIntro
en: We must have been fated to meet. May I ask you for a battle?
et: Meile oli vist saatusest määratud kohtuda. Kas tohin sind lahingusse kutsuda?

label: Route104_Text_CindyDefeat
en: Oh, my!
et: Oh, heldeke!

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostBattle
en: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.
et: „Tere” on „hüvasti” algus. Loodetavasti kohtume veel.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
en: Hello, we meet again.
et: Tere, kohtume taas.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister1
en: We seem to be drawn together. Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.
et: Näib, et miski tõmbab meid kokku. Paneme teineteise oma POKéNAVidesse kirja.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
en: We should commemorate how we seem to be drawn to each other.
et: Seda, kuidas miski meid teineteise poole tõmbab, tasuks tähistada.

label: Route104_Text_CindyRegister2
en: Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.
et: Paneme teineteise oma POKéNAVidesse kirja!

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchIntro
en: Hello, we meet again. May I ask you for a battle?
et: Tere, kohtume taas. Kas tohin sind lahingusse kutsuda?

label: Route104_Text_CindyRematchDefeat
en: Oh, my… I did the best that I could…
et: Oh, heldeke… Ma andsin endast parima…

label: Route104_Text_CindyPostRematch
en: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.” I hope we meet again.
et: „Tere” on „hüvasti” algus. Loodetavasti kohtume veel.

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
en: I fished up a tough-looking POKéMON!
et: Õngitsesin välja ühe kõva olemisega POKéMONi!

label: Route104_Text_DarianIntro
en: It has this magical quality to it! It surely looks tough, yes it does!
et: Selles on midagi maagilist! Kõva välja ta näeb, jah, näebki!

label: Route104_Text_DarianDefeat
en: What the…
et: Mis asja…

label: Route104_Text_DarianPostBattle
en: Hey, MAGIKARP, you sure don't live up to your name, do you?
et: Kuule, MAGIKARP, oma nime sa küll ei õigusta, mis?

label: Route105_Text_FosterIntro
en: There's supposed to be a mystical rock around here. Do you know anything about it?
et: Siin kandis peaks olema müstiline kivi. Kas tead sellest midagi?

label: Route105_Text_FosterDefeated
en: I was thinking too much about that rock, while my POKéMON remained weak…
et: Mõtlesin liiga palju sellele kivile ja mu POKéMON jäi seetõttu nõrgaks…

label: Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle
en: I can spend hours and hours staring at a nice rock without growing bored.
et: Ma võin ilusat kivi tundide kaupa vahtida, ilma et igavaks läheks.

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
en: Whew! I was worried that a kid was drowning when I saw you.
et: Ohh! Kui sind nägin, kartsin juba, et mõni laps upub.

label: Route105_Text_LuisIntro
en: You seem to be okay, so what do you say to a battle?
et: Sinuga on vist kõik korras — mis sa arvad, kas lööme lahingu?

label: Route105_Text_LuisDefeated
en: Glub… Glub…
et: Glub… Glub…

label: Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle
en: If you are drowning, the signal is to wave one arm toward the beach.
et: Kui oled uppumas, anna märku — vehi ühe käega ranna poole.

label: Route105_Text_DominikIntro
en: Swimming the deep blue sea… It feels the greatest!
et: Ujuda sügavsinises meres… Pole midagi paremat!

label: Route105_Text_DominikDefeated
en: I lost… Now I'm feeling blue…
et: Kaotasin… Nüüd on tuju päris morn…

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
en: Why is the sea blue?
et: Miks on meri sinine?

label: Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle
en: I learned about that at the MUSEUM in SLATEPORT, but I forgot.
et: Sain sellest SLATEPORTI MUUSEUMIS teada, aga unustasin ära.

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro
en: My body feels lighter in the water. It's as if I've gotten slimmer!
et: Vees tundub keha kergem. Nagu oleksin saledamaks jäänud!

label: Route105_Text_BeverlyDefeated
en: I'm floating…
et: Ma hulbin…

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
en: Your body weight is reduced to just one tenth in the water.
et: Vees jääb kehakaalust alles vaid kümnendik.

label: Route105_Text_PostBattle
en: That would make me… Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!
et: See teeks minu puhul… Uups! Oma kaalu ma sulle küll ei ütle!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniIntro
en: The blue, blue sky… The vast sea… It's so peaceful…
et: Sinine, sinine taevas… Avar meri… Nii rahulik…

label: Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated
en: I lost while I was lounging!
et: Kaotasin otse lösutades!

label: Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle
en: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be with. Giggle.
et: Tahaks kuulda, et minuga on mõnus lõõgastuda. Hihii.

label: Route105_Text_AndresIntro
en: I'm convinced that the sea keeps secrets from us.
et: Olen kindel, et meri varjab meie eest saladusi.

label: Route105_Text_AndresDefeated
en: Yes… I am no good at battling…
et: Jah… Võitlemine pole minu tugev külg…

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
en: I'm sure there are many secrets to be discovered in the world's seas.
et: Kindlasti on maailma meredes veel palju saladusi avastada.

label: Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle
en: I mean to find them all!
et: Ma kavatsen need kõik üles leida!

label: Route105_Text_AndresRegister
en: Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing to register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Häh? Ma olen ju nii nõrk — ja sina tahad mu POKéNAVi kirja panna?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro
en: I've told you that I'm weak… Are you sure you want to do this?
et: Ma ju ütlesin, et olen nõrk… Oled sa ikka kindel?

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated
en: Yes… I didn't think I could win.
et: Jah… Ma ei arvanudki, et võidan.

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
en: I may be weak at battling, but my drive to explore can't be bested.
et: Võitlejana olen ehk nõrk, aga avastamisjanus ei ületa mind keegi.

label: Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle
en: I will travel the seas all around the world!
et: Ma sõidan läbi kõik maailma mered!

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
en: I'm exhausted from swimming. I'm just not used to it.
et: Ujumine võttis mu täiesti läbi. Ma lihtsalt pole sellega harjunud.

label: Route105_Text_JosueIntro
en: I need a battle for a change of pace!
et: Vahelduseks kuluks üks lahing marjaks ära!

label: Route105_Text_JosueDefeated
en: I lost because I battled at sea.
et: Ma kaotasin, sest võitlesin merel.

label: Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle
en: Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better match than the sea.
et: Jah, minu jaoks sobib taevas palju paremini kui meri.

label: Route106_Text_ElliotIntro
en: Which do you prefer, fishing in the sea or a stream?
et: Kus meeldib sulle rohkem kala püüda — meres või ojas?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated
en: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost spectacularly!
et: Nagu süvamerepüügil — kaotasin suure kolinaga!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle
en: Fishing is the greatest whether it's in the sea or a stream. You agree with me, right?
et: Kalapüük on parim asi, olgu meres või ojas. Oled minuga nõus, eks?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRegister
en: Fishing's great, but so is battling. If you don't mind, can we meet again?
et: Kalapüük on tore, aga võitlemine ka. Kui sa ei pahanda, kas kohtume veel?

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro
en: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing. I'll show you an impressive battle!
et: Püüdsin õngega hunniku POKéMONe. Näitan sulle nüüd muljetavaldavat lahingut!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchDefeated
en: I lost again spectacularly!
et: Jälle kaotasin suure kolinaga!

label: Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle
en: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest! You agree with me, right?
et: Võit või kaotus — POKéMONid on ikka parimad! Oled nõus, eks?

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
en: What do people do if they need to go to a washroom?
et: Mida inimesed teevad, kui neil on vaja tualetti minna?

label: Route106_Text_NedIntro
en: What if my ROD hooks a big one while I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
et: Mis siis, kui ROD otsa jääb suur kala just siis, kui ma tualetis olen? Ei saa kuidagi minna…

label: Route106_Text_NedDefeated
en: I lost because I'm trying to not go to the washroom…
et: Kaotasin sellepärast, et püüan tualetti mitte minna…

label: Route106_Text_NedPostBattle
en: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook a big one!
et: Oh ei! Mul on tunne, et kohe jääb suur otsa!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasIntro
en: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in the water you can't catch me!
et: Hahahaa! Jooksja olen vilets, aga vees sa mind kätte ei saa!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasDefeated
en: I give up!
et: Ma annan alla!

label: Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle
en: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
et: Ujumises ma sulle küll alla ei jääks…

label: Route106_Text_KylaIntro
en: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going to take it easy because you're a kid!
et: Meri on mu koduõu. Ma ei hakka sind säästma lihtsalt sellepärast, et oled laps!

label: Route106_Text_KylaDefeated
en: Did you take it easy on me by any chance?
et: Kas sa äkki hoidsid mind natuke?

label: Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle
en: Drifting along with the waves… I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
et: Lainetega kaasa triivida… Ma armastan seda! Proovi sinagi!

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
en: Yawn…
et: Haigutus…

label: Route107_Text_DarrinIntro
en: I must have drifted off to sleep while I was drifting in the waves.
et: Vist suikusin lainetel triivides magama.

label: Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated
en: Ahaha, I lost… I'll take a snooze, I think…
et: Ahahaa, kaotasin… Teen vist väikese uinaku…

label: Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle
en: Floating and being rocked by the waves--it's like sleeping in a plush, comfy bed.
et: Hulpida ja lasta lainetel end kiigutada — see on nagu magamine pehmes mugavas voodis.

label: Route107_Text_TonyIntro
en: The sea is like my backyard. Let's battle!
et: Meri on nagu mu koduõu. Võitleme!

label: Route107_Text_TonyDefeated
en: I lost on my home field… I'm in shock!
et: Kaotasin oma koduväljakul… Olen šokis!

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
en: I swim the seas with a heart full of dreams…
et: Ujun mööda meresid, süda unistusi täis…

label: Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle
en: It's a song! Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
et: See oli laul! Igatahes — ujun veel natuke.

label: Route107_Text_TonyRegister
en: You've shocked me to the bone! Well, so you won't forget me…
et: Sa vapustasid mind üdini! Noh, et sa mind ei unustaks…

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro
en: Swimming in the big, wide sea, my POKéMON has grown stronger!
et: Suures avaras meres ujudes on mu POKéMON tugevamaks muutunud!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
en: What a shock!
et: Milline šokk!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated
en: My POKéMON has gotten stronger, but I stayed weak as a TRAINER!
et: Mu POKéMON on tugevamaks saanud, aga mina olen TRAINERINA ikka nõrk!

label: Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle
en: What you learn in battle makes you a stronger TRAINER. The waves taught me that.
et: Lahingus õpitu teeb sinust tugevama TRAINERI. Seda õpetasid mulle lained.

label: Route107_Text_DeniseIntro
en: Do you know a little town called DEWFORD?
et: Kas tead väikest linna nimega DEWFORD?

label: Route107_Text_DeniseDefeated
en: I hate this!
et: Ma vihkan seda!

label: Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle
en: A weird saying is getting really trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
et: DEWFORD HALLIS on üks veider ütlus tõsiselt moodi läinud.

label: Route107_Text_BethIntro
en: Did you want to battle me? Sure, I'll go with you!
et: Kas tahtsid minuga võidelda? Olgu, olen mängus!

label: Route107_Text_BethDefeated
en: I wasn't good enough for you.
et: Sinu jaoks jäin ma nõrgaks.

label: Route107_Text_BethPostBattle
en: I think you're going to keep getting better. I'll go for it, too!
et: Ma arvan, et sinust tuleb aina parem. Ma pingutan ka!

label: Route107_Text_LisaIntro
en: LISA: We challenge you as a sister and brother!
et: LISA: Esitame sulle väljakutse — õde ja vend koos!

label: Route107_Text_LisaDefeated
en: LISA: Awesome. You're in a different class of tough.
et: LISA: Vinge. Sa oled hoopis teisest puust kõva tegija.

label: Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle
en: LISA: Do you have any friends who would go to the beach with you?
et: LISA: Kas sul on sõpru, kes tuleksid sinuga randa?

label: Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon
en: LISA: If you want to battle with us, bring more POKéMON.
et: LISA: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, võta rohkem POKéMONe kaasa.

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
en: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me and my sister.
et: RAY: Meie õega võitleme alati POKéMONidega.

label: Route107_Text_RayIntro
en: I always lose, but we can beat you 2-on-2!
et: Mina kaotan alati, aga 2 vastu 2 saame sinust jagu!

label: Route107_Text_RayDefeated
en: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level than us!
et: RAY: Ohoo, sa oled meist tükk maad üle!

label: Route107_Text_RayPostBattle
en: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON. I raised it, and now it's my important partner!
et: RAY: Selle POKéMONi sain ma õelt. Kasvatasin ta üles ja nüüd on ta mu tähtis kaaslane!

label: Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon
en: RAY: If you want to battle us, go bring some more POKéMON!
et: RAY: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, mine too veel POKéMONe!

label: Route107_Text_CamronIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm nowhere near tired!
et: Ma olen keset triatloni, aga väsimusest pole veel märkigi!

label: Route107_Text_CamronDefeated
en: That exhausted me…
et: See võttis mu täiesti läbi…

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
en: I still have swimming and running left to do after this.
et: Pärast seda on mul veel ujumine ja jooks ees.

label: Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle
en: Am I going to be okay?
et: Kas ma ikka pean vastu?

label: Route108_Text_JeromeIntro
en: My dream is to swim the world's seven seas!
et: Mu unistus on läbida ujudes maailma seitse merd!

label: Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated
en: I won't be able to swim the seven seas like this…
et: Niimoodi ei suuda ma seitset merd läbi ujuda…

label: Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle
en: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of the pleasures of swimming!
et: Mere-POKéMONidega mängimine on üks ujumise mõnusid!

label: Route108_Text_MatthewIntro
en: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to the ABANDONED SHIP, too?
et: Ahoi! Kas sinagi lähed ABANDONED SHIPi juurde?

label: Route108_Text_MatthewDefeated
en: I'm sinking! Glub… Glub…
et: Ma upun! Glub… Glub…

label: Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle
en: Some people even go inside that ABANDONED SHIP.
et: Mõned lähevad isegi ABANDONED SHIPi sisse.

label: Route108_Text_TaraIntro
en: My liar of a boyfriend told me that I look great in a bikini…
et: Mu valetajast poiss-sõber ütles, et bikiinis näen ma suurepärane välja…

label: Route108_Text_TaraDefeated
en: Oh, boo!
et: Oh, pagan!

label: Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle
en: Even if it's a lie, I love being told I look great… We girls are so complex…
et: Isegi kui see on vale, meeldib mulle kuulda, et näen hea välja… Meie, tüdrukud, oleme keerulised olevused…

label: Route108_Text_MissyIntro
en: I love the sea! I forget all my worries when I swim!
et: Ma armastan merd! Ujudes unustan kõik oma mured!

label: Route108_Text_MissyDefeated
en: When I lose a battle, I get all stressed out!
et: Kui ma lahingu kaotan, lähen üleni stressi!

label: Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle
en: Work off your stress by swimming! It's so healthy!
et: Uju stress välja! See on ju nii tervislik!

label: Route108_Text_CoryIntro
en: I love WATER-type POKéMON. I love other POKéMON, too!
et: Ma armastan VEE-tüüpi POKéMONe. Ja teisi POKéMONe armastan ka!

label: Route108_Text_CoryDefeated
en: Waaah! I lost! Waaah! Waaah!
et: Vaaah! Ma kaotasin! Vaaah! Vaaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle
en: Shouting is good for me! It uplifts me!
et: Karjumine teeb mulle head! See annab hoogu juurde!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRegister
en: I love tough TRAINERS, too! Register me in your POKéNAV!
et: Ma armastan ka kõvasid TRAINEREID! Pane mind oma POKéNAVi kirja!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro
en: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!
et: Võit või kaotus — merel võidelda on ikka mõnus!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated
en: Waaah! I lost again! Waaah! Waaah!
et: Vaaah! Ma kaotasin jälle! Vaaah! Vaaah!

label: Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle
en: If you're faced with a challenge, try shouting at the sea!
et: Kui sul on raske, proovi merele karjuda!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro
en: I take huge pride in my POKéMON. We'll show you one speedy battle!
et: Ma olen oma POKéMONi üle ülimalt uhke. Näitame sulle välkkiiret lahingut!

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaDefeated
en: That wasn't cute at all.
et: See polnud üldse armas.

label: Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle
en: Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
et: Kui ma juba merel olen, paneks vahel selga roosa sagaratega ujumistrikoo…

label: Route109_Text_DavidIntro
en: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs! This is what you call “cut”!
et: Hijaa! Vaata mu raiutud kõhulihaseid! Just seda nimetataksegi vormiks!

label: Route109_Text_DavidDefeated
en: Aiyah! Flubbed out!
et: Aiaa! Läks untsu!

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
en: Hiyah!
et: Hijaa!

label: Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle
en: My sculpted abs have nothing to do with POKéMON battles!
et: Mu voolitud kõhulihastel pole POKéMON-lahingutega mingit pistmist!

label: Route109_Text_AliceIntro
en: Are you properly protected against the sun?
et: Kas oled päikese eest korralikult kaitstud?

label: Route109_Text_AliceDefeated
en: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
et: Ai, ai, ai!

label: Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle
en: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
et: Põsed põlevad päikese käes kõige kiiremini ära!

label: Route109_Text_HueyIntro
en: I've laid anchor in ports around the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
et: Olen ankrusse heitnud sadamates üle kogu maailma, aga SLATEPORT on parim.

label: Route109_Text_HueyDefeated
en: You're the best!
et: Sa oled parim!

label: Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle
en: In the best port was the best TRAINER…
et: Parimas sadamas oligi parim TRAINER…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondIntro
en: Urrrrppp… Battle? With me?
et: Örrrrpppp… Lahing? Minuga?

label: Route109_Text_EdmondDefeated
en: Urp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Urrrrpppp…
et: Örp… Ooooooohhhhhh… Örrrrpppp…

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm usually stronger than this! I'm just seasick as a dog!
et: Tavaliselt olen palju tugevam! Lihtsalt olen kohutavalt merehaige!

label: Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle
en: I'm a SAILOR, but…
et: Ja mina veel SAILOR, ohh…

label: Route109_Text_RickyIntro
en: I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
et: Mul on janu… Kuluks ära üks SODA POP seal SEASHORE HOUSE juures…

label: Route109_Text_RickyDefeated
en: Groan…
et: Ohhh…

label: Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle
en: I'm getting famished… My inner tube looks like a giant doughnut…
et: Kõht läheb tühjaks… Mu ujurõngas näeb välja nagu hiiglaslik sõõrik…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRegister
en: Will you have another match with me when I'm not all thirsty?
et: Kas võitleme uuesti, kui mul enam janu pole?

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro
en: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in me for a battle!
et: Kõht on tühi, aga lahinguks jagub mul hoogu küll!

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated
en: I lost… It's because I'm hungry…
et: Kaotasin… Kõik sellepärast, et kõht on tühi…

label: Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle
en: When you eat on a beach, everything seems to taste a little better.
et: Rannas süües maitseb kõik kuidagi paremini.

label: Route109_Text_LolaIntro
en: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like a giant flower?
et: Kas rannavari ei näe välja nagu hiiglaslik lill?

label: Route109_Text_LolaDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle
en: If you look at the beach from the sky, it looks like a big flower garden!
et: Kui vaadata randa taevast, näeb see välja nagu suur lilleaed!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRegister
en: Me? I'm here every day!
et: Mina? Ma olen siin iga päev!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro
en: I'm not losing to you again! That's why I have my inner tube!
et: Sulle ma teist korda ei kaota! Just selleks mul ujurõngas ongi!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchDefeated
en: Mommy!
et: Emme!

label: Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle
en: If I have an inner tube, me and my POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
et: Ujurõngaga on nii mina kui ka mu POKéMON kohe palju armsamad!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaIntro
en: I can't swim without my inner tube, but I won't lose at POKéMON!
et: Ilma ujurõngata ma ujuda ei oska, aga POKéMONides ma ei kaota!

label: Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated
en: Did I lose because I have an inner tube?
et: Kas ma kaotasin sellepärast, et mul on ujurõngas?

label: Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle
en: My inner tube is a fashion item. I can't be seen without it.
et: Mu ujurõngas on moeese. Ilma selleta ei tohi mind näha.

label: Route109_Text_GwenIntro
en: Hi, big TRAINER. Will you battle with me?
et: Tere, suur TRAINER. Kas võitled minuga?

label: Route109_Text_GwenDefeated
en: Oh, you're strong.
et: Oh, sa oled tugev.

label: Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle
en: How did you get to be so strong?
et: Kuidas sa nii tugevaks said?

label: Route109_Text_CarterIntro
en: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch himself a big one!
et: Vahahaa! See mees püüab endale kohe suure saagi!

label: Route109_Text_CarterDefeated
en: This dude just lost one…
et: See mees lasi just ühe käest…

label: Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle
en: This dude thinks you're a big one. No, you're a big-one-to-be!
et: See mees arvab, et sina oled suur saak. Ei — sinust alles tuleb suur saak!

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.
et: PAUL: No nii, tuju on rikutud.

label: Route109_Text_PaulIntro
en: I wish you wouldn't disturb our precious time together.
et: Sa võiksid meie kallist kahekesiolemist mitte segada.

label: Route109_Text_PaulDefeated
en: PAUL: Well, I give up.
et: PAUL: No nii, ma annan alla.

label: Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle
en: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that we're here. This is just our private world of two!
et: PAUL: No nii, ära räägi kellelegi, et me siin oleme. See on ainult meie kahe oma maailm!

label: Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon
en: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: PAUL: Me oleme täiesti ja sügavalt armunud. Just seepärast võitlevad meie POKéMONid koos.

label: Route109_Text_MelIntro
en: MEL: We're, like, totally in love. Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu täiesti armunud. Meie romanss kütab kogu HOENNI kuumaks!

label: Route109_Text_MelDefeated
en: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault! PAUL will hate me!
et: MEL: Me kaotasime ja see on minu süü! PAUL hakkab mind vihkama!

label: Route109_Text_MelPostBattle
en: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me? Please don't be angry.
et: MEL: Öö, PAUL, kas sa oled minu peale vihane? Palun ära ole vihane.

label: Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon
en: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love. That's why we make our POKéMON battle together.
et: MEL: Me oleme nagu sügavalt ja päriselt armunud. Just seepärast võitlevad meie POKéMONid koos.

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro
en: Tadaah! See? My inner tube's round!
et: Tadaah! Näed? Mu ujurõngas on ümmargune!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerDefeated
en: Oh, oh! Too bad!
et: Oh, oh! Kahju küll!

label: Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle
en: After I showed you my round inner tube, too…
et: Ja mina veel näitasin sulle oma ümmargust ujurõngast…

label: Route109_Text_HaileyIntro
en: I can't swim, so I'm pretending to swim.
et: Ma ei oska ujuda, nii et teesklen ujumist.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated
en: I thought so! I didn't think we could win.
et: Ma arvasingi! Ma ei arvanud, et suudame võita.

label: Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle
en: When I learn how to swim, I think my POKéMON will become tougher.
et: Kui ma ujuma õpin, läheb mu POKéMON vist ka kõvemaks.

label: Route109_Text_ElijahIntro
en: For a guy as macho as me, this kind of POKéMON is the perfect match!
et: Minusuguse matšo mehe jaoks sobib just selline POKéMON ideaalselt!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated
en: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
et: Isegi kaotades olen lahe, mis?

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: For a guy as macho as me, a port is the perfect setting!
et: Minusuguse matšo mehe jaoks on sadam just õige paik!

label: Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle
en: I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
et: Ma vist suundun SLATEPORTI.

label: Route110_Text_JacobIntro
en: Whoa! Watch it! I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
et: Oi! Vaata ette! Sa pole vist rattavõiduajamisega harjunud.

label: Route110_Text_JacobDefeated
en: Whoa! My brakes failed!
et: Oi! Mu pidurid ütlesid üles!

label: Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle
en: Flat tires and brake problems can cause serious injury! Inspect your BIKE for problems!
et: Tühjad rehvid ja katkised pidurid võivad tõsiseid vigastusi tuua! Kontrolli oma ratas alati üle!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro
en: Yo, you! Can you keep up with my speed?
et: Jou, sina! Kas pead mu kiirusega sammu?

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyDefeated
en: Crash and burn!
et: Prõmm ja põhjas!

label: Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle
en: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON. I need to reconsider this…
et: Ainuüksi kiirusega POKéMONides ei võida. Pean asja üle mõtlema…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro
en: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
et: Ära satu paanikasse, kui ratas kiiresti kihutab!

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated
en: I shouldn't panic during POKéMON battles…
et: Ma ei tohiks POKéMON-lahingute ajal paanikasse sattuda…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanitseda ega stressata. Võta rahulikult. Aega on küllaga.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister
en: I'll keep chugging on without stressing. Give me a shout if you're up to it.
et: Ma vuran rahulikult edasi, ilma stressita. Hõika, kui tuju tuleb!

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro
en: Aren't you going a little too fast? Take it easy and let's battle.
et: Kas sa ei sõida veidi liiga kiiresti? Võta rahulikult ja peame lahingu.

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated
en: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
et: Ma ei paanitsenud, aga kaotasin ikkagi…

label: Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle
en: There's no need to panic or stress. Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
et: Pole vaja paanitseda ega stressata. Võta rahulikult. Aega on küllaga.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.
et: Triatlon on tapvalt raske.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailIntro
en: You have to complete the three events of swimming, cycling, and running.
et: Sa pead läbima kolm ala: ujumise, rattasõidu ja jooksmise.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailDefeated
en: POKéMON battles are hard, too!
et: POKéMON-lahingud on ka rasked!

label: Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle
en: I'm exhausted, so I need a break. It's important to get proper rest.
et: Olen läbi, vajan pausi. Korralik puhkus on tähtis.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRegister
en: You know, I like you! Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
et: Tead, sa meeldid mulle! Peame revanši JALGRATTATEEL.

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro
en: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while cycling?
et: Kas pole tore pidada lahingut rattaga sõites?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated
en: Wow… How could you be so strong?
et: Ohoo… Kuidas sa küll nii tugev oled?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: Were you going after a record?
et: Kas sa jahtisid rekordit?

label: Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle
en: I'm sorry if I held you up!
et: Vabandust, kui ma sind kinni pidasin!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineIntro
en: I've been riding without stopping. My thighs are like rocks!
et: Olen peatumata sõitnud. Mu reied on kõvad nagu kivi!

label: Route110_Text_JasmineDefeated
en: I'm worried about muscle cramps…
et: Kardan, et hakkavad krambid…

label: Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle
en: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES? No wonder you're so strong!
et: Ohoo, sul on juba SAALIMÄRKE? Pole ime, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardIntro
en: I have foreseen your intentions! I cannot possibly lose!
et: Nägin su kavatsusi ette! Ma ei saa kuidagi kaotada!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated
en: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
et: Omaenda kaotust ma küll ette ei näinud!

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: I see your future…
et: Ma näen su tulevikku…

label: Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle
en: Hmm… I see a shining light…
et: Hmm… Ma näen helendavat valgust…

label: Route110_Text_JaclynIntro
en: Ahahahaha! I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
et: Ahahahaa! Ma pimestan sind oma imedega!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynDefeated
en: I wondrously lost!
et: Imelisel kombel kaotasin!

label: Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle
en: You managed to win only because it was a wonder! Yes, a wonder! Don't think you can win all the time!
et: Sa võitsid ainult tänu imele! Jah, imele! Ära arva, et võidad alati!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma tohiksin su POKéMONi näha? Ainult üks pilguke, palun!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated
en: I wanted to complete my collection…
et: Ma tahtsin oma kogu täis saada…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle
en: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know, my passion as a collector is ignited!
et: Kui ma näen tundmatut POKéMONi, lööb mu kogujakirg lõkkele!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRegister
en: I like collecting MATCH CALL registrations, too…
et: Mulle meeldib koguda ka MATCH CALL kontakte…

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?
et: Tere, kas oled püüdnud uusi POKéMONe?

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro
en: Could I see your POKéMON? Just one look, please?
et: Kas ma tohiksin su POKéMONi näha? Ainult üks pilguke, palun!

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchDefeated
en: Your POKéMON… I envy you.
et: Su POKéMON… Ma kadestan sind.

label: Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle
en: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON mine!
et: Oh, kuidas ma tahaksin kõiki haruldasi POKéMONe endale!

label: Route110_Text_DaleIntro
en: Hey! Don't sneak up behind me like that!
et: Hei! Ära hiili niimoodi mu selja taha!

label: Route110_Text_DaleDefeated
en: I lost! Drat!
et: Ma kaotasin! Pagan!

label: Route110_Text_DalePostBattle
en: Fishing is all about concentration. You have to focus on the floater.
et: Kalapüügis on kõik keskendumine. Silm peab püsima ujukil.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelIntro
en: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show off my delightful POKéMON.
et: Ahahaha! Ma läheksin kas või maailma otsa, et oma veetlevat POKéMONi näidata.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelDefeated
en: Oh, dear, this won't do.
et: Oh, heldeke, nii see ei lähe.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle
en: Rather than battling, perhaps I should show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.
et: Võib-olla peaksin võitlemise asemel oma POKéMONi hoopis FAN CLUBIS näitama.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
en: That wasn't close to what I could do to show off my POKéMON.
et: See polnud veel midagi — ma oskan oma POKéMONi hoopis paremini näidata.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRegister
en: I'll have you as my captive audience as often as possible!
et: Ma võtan sind oma publikuks nii tihti, kui vähegi saab!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro
en: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show off my POKéMON as often as you like!
et: Ahahahaa! Ma näitan sulle oma POKéMONi nii tihti, kui sa vähegi soovid!

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchDefeated
en: Oh, dear, this won't do.
et: Oh, heldeke, nii see ei lähe.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
en: I don't think that I could ever stop from showing off my POKéMON.
et: Vaevalt ma suudan iial lõpetada oma POKéMONi näitamist.

label: Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle
en: But I like to battle, too!
et: Aga mulle meeldib ka võidelda!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyIntro
en: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass around here!
et: Ma leidsin siinkandi rohust mõned lahedad POKéMONid!

label: Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated
en: Being cool isn't enough to win…
et: Ainult lahedusest võiduks ei piisa…

label: Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle
en: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you just caught.
et: Värskelt püütud POKéMONidega on raske võidelda.

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
en: I fell off CYCLING ROAD…
et: Ma kukkusin JALGRATTATEELT alla…

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro
en: I'll get over my embarrassment by battling with you!
et: Sinuga võideldes saan oma piinlikkusest üle!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaDefeated
en: Oops! I ended up losing!
et: Uups! Kaotasin ikkagi ära!

label: Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle
en: Falling… Losing… This is so humiliating for me!
et: Kukkusin… Kaotasin… Kui alandav!

label: Route110_Text_JosephIntro
en: Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't groove, you get left behind!
et: Olgu! Täisgaasi aeg! Kui sa hoogu sisse ei saa, jääd maha!

label: Route110_Text_JosephDefeated
en: You got into the groove all right…
et: Sa said hoo sisse küll…

label: Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle
en: This isn't going to bring me down! Losing has made me a better man!
et: See mind maha ei murra! Kaotamine on teinud minust parema mehe!

label: Route110_Text_KalebIntro
en: When cute POKéMON help each other… You won't see a more adorable sight!
et: Kui armsad POKéMONid üksteist aitavad… Armsamat vaatepilti sa ei näe!

label: Route110_Text_KalebDefeated
en: Have you no compassion or pity?
et: Kas sul pole kaastunnet ega halastust?

label: Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle
en: Okay, okay, you've done the best you could, my pretties.
et: Olgu, olgu, te andsite endast parima, mu kaunikesed.

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
en: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you. But I think they look better on me.
et: Oh, tere! Need GO-GOGGLES prillid sobivad sulle. Aga minu peas näevad nad ikka paremad välja.

label: Route111_Text_DrewIntro
en: Let's decide who they look better on with a battle!
et: Otsustame lahinguga, kellele nad paremini sobivad!

label: Route111_Text_DrewDefeat
en: I couldn't see what was happening at my sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.
et: GO-GOGGLES varjas mu külgvaadet — ma ei näinud, mis kõrval toimub.

label: Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle
en: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to get through sandstorms. That makes me happy!
et: Tänu GO-GOGGLES prillidele saab liivatormist läbi. See teeb mind rõõmsaks!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
en: I'm having a picnic in the desert.
et: Mul on kõrbes piknik.

label: Route111_Text_HeidiIntro
en: You can always find a TRAINER, so I can enjoy a battle here, too!
et: TRAINERit leiab alati, nii et ma saan siinki lahingut nautida!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiDefeat
en: Ohhh! You're mean!
et: Ohhh! Sa oled õel!

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
en: When you're battling in a sandstorm, watch out for your POKéMON's HP.
et: Kui võitled liivatormis, hoia oma POKéMONi HP hoolega silma peal.

label: Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle
en: It can faint if you don't keep an eye on it!
et: Ta võib minestada, kui sa tal silma peal ei hoia!

label: Route111_Text_BeauIntro
en: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me feel like a superhero. Right now, nobody can beat me!
et: Nende GO-GOGGLES prillidega tunnen end superkangelasena. Praegu ei suuda keegi mind võita!

label: Route111_Text_BeauDefeat
en: I can't win on spirit alone…
et: Ainuüksi vaimustusest võiduks ei piisa…

label: Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle
en: I'm going to be a real hero one day. I'm going to work harder to make me and my POKéMON stronger.
et: Ühel päeval saan ma päris kangelaseks. Pingutan kõvemini, et nii mina kui mu POKéMONid tugevamaks saaksid.

label: Route111_Text_BeckyIntro
en: I heard there are fossils to be found in the desert. Where could they be?
et: Ma kuulsin, et kõrbest leiab fossiile. Kus need küll olla võiksid?

label: Route111_Text_BeckyDefeat
en: I came up short…
et: Jäin napilt alla…

label: Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle
en: If they can find fossils in the desert, it must have been a sea before.
et: Kui kõrbest leitakse fossiile, siis pidi siin enne meri olema.

label: Route111_Text_DustyIntro
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins! I am to be challenged?
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid! Ja nüüd tahetakse minuga võidelda?

label: Route111_Text_DustyDefeat
en: While I have searched for ruins, I've not searched for strong POKéMON.
et: Varemeid olen ma otsinud küll, aga tugevaid POKéMONe mitte.

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle
en: No, wait, was that forty years? Which was it now?
et: Ei, oota, kas see oli nelikümmend aastat? Kumb see nüüd oli?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
en: I haven't been searching for any tough POKéMON.
et: Ma pole ühtki kõva POKéMONi otsinud.

label: Route111_Text_DustyRegister
en: But, for some reason, I sure do like POKéNAVS.
et: Aga millegipärast meeldivad mulle küll POKéNAVID.

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro
en: No, wait, was that forty years? Anyway, am I to be challenged?
et: Ei, oota, kas see oli nelikümmend aastat? Igatahes — kas sa tahad minuga võidelda?

label: Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat
en: I've found no ruins, nor have I found any strong POKéMON…
et: Ma pole leidnud varemeid ega ka ühtki tugevat POKéMONi…

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: For thirty years I have searched for ancient ruins!
et: Kolmkümmend aastat olen ma otsinud muistseid varemeid!

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: No, wait, was that forty years I've searched?
et: Ei, oota, kas ma otsisin nelikümmend aastat?

label: Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch
en: Hmm… It could even be fifty… How long have I been at this?
et: Hmm… Võib-olla isegi viiskümmend… Kui kaua ma seda küll teinud olen?

label: Route111_Text_TravisIntro
en: I'm full of pep! And my POKéMON is peppy, too!
et: Ma olen hoogu täis! Ja mu POKéMON on ka hoogne!

label: Route111_Text_TravisDefeat
en: My POKéMON lost its pep…
et: Mu POKéMON kaotas oma hoo…

label: Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle
en: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep, I can't help looking.
et: Kui ma näen hoogsat TRAINERit, ei saa ma lihtsalt silmi pealt.

label: Route111_Text_IreneIntro
en: I don't know where you're going, but would you like to battle?
et: Ma ei tea, kuhu sa lähed, aga kas sooviksid võidelda?

label: Route111_Text_IreneDefeat
en: Oh, you're disgustingly good!
et: Oh, sa oled vastikult hea!

label: Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle
en: I'm thinking that I should go to MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around here is very nice, too.
et: Mõtlen, et peaks MT. CHIMNEY otsa minema, aga ka siinne vaade on väga kena.

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro
en: To train myself, I challenge all whom I meet!
et: Et end treenida, esitan ma väljakutse kõigile, keda kohtan!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukeDefeat
en: Uncle! I give up!
et: Aitab, aitab! Ma annan alla!

label: Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle
en: All I can do is keep training until I can defeat strong TRAINERS such as yourself.
et: Mul ei jää muud üle, kui treenida edasi, kuni suudan alistada sinusuguseid tugevaid TRAINEREID.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonIntro
en: Show me how much you've toughened your POKéMON.
et: Näita mulle, kui palju sa oma POKéMONe karastanud oled.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat
en: I see, you've toughened them considerably.
et: Ma näen, sa oled neid tublisti karastanud.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
en: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much through battling.
et: POKéMONid ja TRAINERID õpivad võideldes palju.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle
en: What's important is to never give up even if you lose.
et: Tähtis on mitte kunagi alla anda, isegi kui kaotad.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
en: There is much to be learned from your training style.
et: Su treeningstiilist on palju õppida.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRegister
en: I request a rematch if it behooves you.
et: Ma palun revanši, kui see sulle sobib.

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro
en: We're training here to elevate our game to the next level. Stay and train with us!
et: Me treenime siin, et jõuda järgmisele tasemele. Jää ja treeni meiega!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonRematchDefeat
en: Ooh, you're decent!
et: Ohoo, sa oled päris tubli!

label: Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch
en: Since you're that strong, you should aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Kuna sa oled nii tugev, võta sihiks POKéMON LIIGA.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeIntro
en: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious actors. I have to ask you for an engagement.
et: Oh, su POKéMONid on nagu tõelised näitlejad! Ma lihtsalt pean teid esinema kutsuma.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat
en: They didn't just look strong, they are strong!
et: Nad ei näinud ainult tugevad välja — nad ongi tugevad!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle
en: I thought I was raising my POKéMON diligently, but, oh no, there is still much to be done.
et: Arvasin, et olen oma POKéMONe usinalt kasvatanud, aga ei — tööd on veel palju.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRegister
en: I wish I could become friends with more strong people like you!
et: Tahaksin saada sõbraks veel paljude sinusuguste tugevate inimestega!

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
en: You can make POKéMON stronger or weaker depending on the moves you teach them.
et: POKéMON võib jääda tugevamaks või nõrgemaks just selle järgi, milliseid võtteid sa talle õpetad.

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro
en: What kinds of moves do your POKéMON know?
et: Milliseid võtteid su POKéMONid oskavad?

label: Route111_Text_BrookeRematchDefeat
en: You've taught them good moves!
et: Sa oled õpetanud neile häid võtteid!

label: Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch
en: Maybe I should have stopped my POKéMON from evolving until they learned better moves…
et: Vahest oleksin pidanud POKéMONide arengut pidurdama, kuni nad paremad võtted selgeks saavad…

label: Route111_Text_CeliaIntro
en: I shouldn't have come to a place like this for a picnic!
et: Poleks pidanud sellisesse kohta piknikule tulema!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat
en: Aww! I really shouldn't have come!
et: Ohh! Ma tõesti poleks pidanud siia tulema!

label: Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle
en: In a sandstorm like this, I can't set the places for a picnic even with my GO-GOGGLES on…
et: Sellises liivatormis ei saa ma piknikulauda katta isegi GO-GOGGLES prillidega…

label: Route111_Text_BryanIntro
en: How tough are you? We shall expose that secret!
et: Kui kõva sa oled? Me paljastame selle saladuse!

label: Route111_Text_BryanDefeat
en: Oh! Your strength! It is shrouded in mystery!
et: Oh! Su jõud! See on mõistatuse loori taga!

label: Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle
en: This desert hoards mysteries in its shifting sands!
et: See kõrb peidab mõistatusi oma tuiskavas liivas!

label: Route111_Text_BrandenIntro
en: I'll give you some of my sandwich if you'll lose.
et: Ma annan sulle veidi oma võileiba, kui sa kaotad.

label: Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat
en: Tch! I thought a sandwich would be enough of a bribe…
et: Tsäh! Ma arvasin, et võileivast piisab altkäemaksuks…

label: Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle
en: My SANDSHREW loves eating my sandwiches.
et: Mu SANDSHREW armastab mu võileibu süüa.

label: Route111_Text_TyronIntro
en: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!
et: See on just minu lemmiksorti POKéMON!

label: Route111_Text_TyronDefeat
en: Wait! Did you get a good look at my POKéMON?
et: Oota! Kas sa vaatasid mu POKéMONi hoolega?

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
en: When having a battle, I get a kick out of showing off my POKéMON.
et: Lahingus on kõige lahedam just oma POKéMONi näidata.

label: Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle
en: I bet everyone feels that way when they enter a battle!
et: Vean kihla, et kõik tunnevad nii, kui nad lahingusse astuvad!

label: Route111_Text_CelinaIntro
en: Show me how to put a little excitement into my life.
et: Näita mulle, kuidas oma ellu veidi elevust tuua.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat
en: Oh… My… That was too much excitement.
et: Oh… Heldeke… Seda elevust oli juba liiga palju.

label: Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle
en: My pulse is still racing. You're one fabulous TRAINER.
et: Mu pulss peksleb ikka veel. Sa oled üks vapustav TRAINER.

label: Route111_Text_HaydenIntro
en: When you're as famished as I am, there is no room for pity!
et: Kui oled sama näljane kui mina, pole ruumi halastusele!

label: Route111_Text_HaydenDefeat
en: Groan…
et: Oiii…

label: Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle
en: My stomach is grumbling! Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…
et: Mu kõht koriseb! Ehk saan mõned marjad ära grillida…

label: Route111_Text_BiancaIntro
en: Did you come from MAUVILLE? Then you should be full of energy!
et: Kas tulid MAUVILLEST? Siis oled sa kindlasti energiat täis!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat
en: Ooh lala! That's a lot to take!
et: Ooh-lalaa! Seda on juba liiga palju!

label: Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle
en: This road here… You have quite a ways to travel.
et: See tee siin… Sul on omajagu maad rännata.

label: Route112_Text_BriceIntro
en: Hahahaha! How about we have a battle? You and me! Hahahaha!
et: Hahahaa! Kuidas oleks, kui peaksime lahingu? Sina ja mina! Hahahaa!

label: Route112_Text_BriceDefeat
en: I lost! Hahahaha!
et: Ma kaotasin! Hahahaa!

label: Route112_Text_BricePostBattle
en: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose! Hahahaha-hatchoo!
et: Hahahahaa! Miski lendas mulle ninna! Hahahaa-atšuu!

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
en: My legs are solid from pounding up and down the mountains.
et: Mu jalad on kõvad nagu kivi — olen mägedes üles-alla tampinud.

label: Route112_Text_TrentIntro
en: They're not going to buckle easily, friend!
et: Nii kergelt need alla ei anna, sõber!

label: Route112_Text_TrentDefeat
en: Ouch! My legs cramped up!
et: Ai! Mul läksid jalad krampi!

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
en: Try hiking, and I mean really pounding, on these mountain trails with a heavy pack weighing dozens of pounds.
et: Proovi ise neil mägiradadel matkata — ja ma mõtlen päris tampimist — kümnete kilode raskuse seljakotiga.

label: Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle
en: That, my friend, will get your body into serious shape.
et: Sellest, sõber, saab keha alles korraliku vormi!

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
en: Ow, my legs have cramped up. Can you grab me some bandages from my backpack?
et: Ai, mul läksid jalad krampi. Kas ulataksid mu seljakotist sidemed?

label: Route112_Text_TrentRegister
en: No, that's my POKéNAV! Oh, fine, I'll register you.
et: Ei, see on mu POKéNAV! Oh, hea küll, ma registreerin sind.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro
en: I've been keeping fit by hiking. Power, I have in spades!
et: Ma olen end matkates vormis hoidnud. Jõudu on mul kuhjaga!

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchDefeat
en: I got trumped in power?
et: Mind löödi jõuga üle?

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
en: I hear there are some seriously tough TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et MT. CHIMNEY tipus on päris kõvasid TRAINEREID.

label: Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle
en: I intend to get up there and give them a challenge!
et: Ma kavatsen sinna üles jõuda ja neile väljakutse esitada!

label: Route112_Text_LarryIntro
en: I'm strong. I won't cry if I lose.
et: Ma olen tugev. Ma ei nuta, kui kaotan.

label: Route112_Text_LarryDefeat
en: Waaaah!
et: Üäääää!

label: Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle
en: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy! Snivel…
et: Ma ei nuta sellepärast, et ma emmet igatsen! Nuuks…

label: Route112_Text_CarolIntro
en: When you're out on a picnic, why, you simply have to sing! Come on, sing with me!
et: Piknikul tuleb ju lihtsalt laulda! No tule, laula minuga kaasa!

label: Route112_Text_CarolDefeat
en: Oh, you're so strong!
et: Oh, sa oled nii tugev!

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
en: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad at singing or POKéMON.
