et: Pole tähtis, kas oled laulmises või POKéMONides hea või halb.

label: Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle
en: If you have the most fun, you win!
et: Kellel on kõige lõbusam, see võidabki!

label: Route112_Text_BryantIntro
en: I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH! Take a look!
et: Ma püüdsin FIERY PATHIS tulikuumad POKéMONid! Vaata!

label: Route112_Text_BryantDefeat
en: What a bumpy ride that was!
et: Küll see oli konarlik sõit!

label: Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle
en: I like the way you battle. It has a certain flair to it.
et: Mulle meeldib, kuidas sa võitled. Selles on teatud hõngu.

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro
en: Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER! Please, I need a romantic battle! I'm somewhat decent!
et: Oi, milline armas TRAINER! Palun, ma vajan romantilist lahingut! Ma olen päris osav!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat
en: Oh, how strong you are! You've given me quite a shock!
et: Oh, kui tugev sa oled! Sa oled mind päris ära vapustanud!

label: Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle
en: Are you busy right now? I was thinking that maybe we can have a rematch right now… But it's all right if you're busy.
et: Kas sul on praegu kiire? Ma mõtlesin, et ehk saame kohe revanši pidada… Aga pole viga, kui sul on kiire.

label: Route113_Text_JaylenIntro
en: Can you guess why it's so cool around here?
et: Kas oskad arvata, miks siin kandis nii jahe on?

label: Route113_Text_JaylenDefeat
en: Peeuuw! That stinks!
et: Ptüi! See haiseb!

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
en: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it doesn't get very warm.
et: Vulkaanituhk varjab päikest, nii et eriti soojaks ei lähe.

label: Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle
en: That's good for me--I can't stand heat!
et: See on minu jaoks hea – ma ei talu kuumust!

label: Route113_Text_DillonIntro
en: The volcano's eruption is proof that the earth is alive.
et: Vulkaani purse on tõestus, et maa on elus.

label: Route113_Text_DillonDefeat
en: You're some kind of strong!
et: Oled sa alles tugev!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Ouch! Owww! I can't see! I got ashes in my eyelashes!
et: Ai! Auu! Ma ei näe! Mulle sai tuhka ripsmetesse!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Get it? Ashes and eyelashes?
et: Said aru? Tuhk ripsmetes — tuhkripsmed!

label: Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle
en: Okay, that was bad, sorry…
et: Olgu, kehv nali oli, vabandust…

label: Route113_Text_MadelineIntro
en: I use this parasol to ward off this filthy, yucky volcanic ash from my dear NUMEL.
et: Ma kaitsen selle päikesevarjuga oma kallist POKéMONi NUMEL räpase vulkaanituha eest.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineDefeat
en: Huff, huff… I am exhausted…
et: Ähh, ähh… Ma olen kurnatud…

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle
en: You're very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
et: Sa oled selles väga hea. Pean ütlema, et oled mulle muljet avaldanud!

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRegister
en: Here, slide under my parasol. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Tule minu päikesevarju alla. Las ma registreerin su oma POKéNAVi.

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro
en: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while? May I invite you to battle?
et: Oh, tere, kas pole tükk aega möödas? Kas tohin sind lahingule kutsuda?

label: Route113_Text_MadelineRematchDefeat
en: Oh, how super!
et: Oh, kui super!

label: Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch
en: You've remained very good at this. I must say I'm impressed!
et: Sa oled endiselt väga hea. Pean ütlema, et oled mulle muljet avaldanud!

label: Route113_Text_LaoIntro
en: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
et: Tuha seest hüppan välja! Hijaa! Ma kutsun sind võitlusse!

label: Route113_Text_LaoDefeat
en: With honor I admit defeat!
et: Auga tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle
en: I must refine the art of concealment. I bid thee farewell.
et: Pean peitumise kunsti veel lihvima. Jätan sinuga hüvasti.

label: Route113_Text_LaoRegister
en: Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja technique of POKéNAV registration!
et: Jiijaah! Vaata muistset nindžatehnikat — POKéNAVi registreerimist!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro
en: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah! I challenge thee!
et: Tuha seest hüppan välja! Hijaa! Ma kutsun sind võitlusse!

label: Route113_Text_LaoRematchDefeat
en: With honor I admit defeat!
et: Auga tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
en: My flawless concealment was let down by my immature battle skills…
et: Mu peitumine oli laitmatu, aga võitlusoskus veel toores…

label: Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch
en: I bid thee farewell.
et: Ma jätan sinuga hüvasti.

label: Route113_Text_LungIntro
en: Thanks for finding me! But we still have to battle!
et: Aitäh, et mind leidsid! Aga me peame ikka võitlema!

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
en: I'll use my ninjutsu on you… “VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!
et: Ma kasutan sinu peal oma nindžutsut… „VULKAANITUHA KEERIS-KEEP”!

label: Route113_Text_LungDefeat
en: …What? It's already over?
et: …Mida? Kas juba läbi?

label: Route113_Text_LungPostBattle
en: You know what's crummy about hiding? It's lonely if no one comes along.
et: Tead, mis on peitumise juures halb? Kui keegi ei tule, hakkab üksi igav.

label: Route113_Text_ToriIntro
en: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.
et: TORI: Me mõlemad kogume tuhka. Me võitleme ka POKéMONidega.

label: Route113_Text_ToriDefeat
en: TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going to get some more ashes.
et: TORI: Me kaotasime… Igav on, lähen kogun parem veel tuhka.

label: Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle
en: TORI: How much ash do we have? Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.
et: TORI: Kui palju tuhka meil on? Loodetavasti piisab, et saada WHITE FLUTE.

label: Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons
en: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we didn't, we would lose!
et: TORI: Me tahame 2-vastu-2 võidelda. Muidu me ju kaotaksime!

label: Route113_Text_TiaIntro
en: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes. We battle POKéMON, too.
et: TIA: Me mõlemad kogume tuhka. Me võitleme ka POKéMONidega.

label: Route113_Text_TiaDefeat
en: TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring, so I'm getting some more ashes.
et: TIA: Me ei suutnud võita… Igav on, lähen kogun veel tuhka.

label: Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle
en: TIA: We have a lot of ashes! I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!
et: TIA: Meil on palju tuhka! Vist juba piisavalt, et saada WHITE FLUTE!

label: Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons
en: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2. If we don't, we won't win!
et: TIA: Me tahame 2-vastu-2 võidelda. Muidu me ei võida!

label: Route113_Text_CobyIntro
en: Pfft, with these wings I can flick you away!
et: Pff, nende tiibadega ma pühin su minema!

label: Route113_Text_CobyDefeat
en: A… What?
et: A… Mida?

label: Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle
en: I don't know what to say when I get beaten so easily…
et: Ma ei tea, mida öelda, kui mind nii kergesti võidetakse…

label: Route113_Text_SophieIntro
en: The warmth here is making me drowsy. Battle with me so I can stay awake.
et: Siinne soojus teeb mind uniseks. Võitle minuga, et ma ärkvel püsiksin.

label: Route113_Text_SophieDefeat
en: This is a dream. I'm sure of it…
et: See on unenägu. Ma olen selles kindel…

label: Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle
en: Losing burns me up… I'm just going to sleep right here! Zzz!
et: Kaotamine ajab marru… Jäängi lihtsalt siinsamas magama! Zzz!

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro
en: Were you maybe in the middle of gathering volcanic ashes?
et: Kas sa parajasti kogusid vulkaanituhka?

label: Route113_Text_LawrenceDefeat
en: Ehehe. We got beaten cleanly.
et: Ehehee. Meid löödi puhtalt üle.

label: Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle
en: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.
et: Ma peaksin ka tuha alla peitu pugema.

label: Route113_Text_WyattIntro
en: Y-you want to battle with me? Even though I just caught my POKéMON?
et: Sa… sa tahad minuga võidelda? Kuigi ma just püüdsin oma POKéMONi?

label: Route113_Text_WyattDefeat
en: Y-you're all happy to win? Even though it's only me?
et: Su… sul on hea meel, et võitsid? Kuigi vastas olin ainult mina?

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
en: Oh, so now you want to say a word to the loser?
et: Ahaa, nüüd sa tahad kaotajale midagi öelda?

label: Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle
en: Aren't you just the coolest? Humph!
et: Oled sa alles lahe, mis? Hmpf!

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
en: Yodelayhihoo!
et: Jodelaihihuu!

label: Route114_Text_LennyIntro
en: You're supposed to shout “yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't echo here!
et: Sa pead hüüdma „jodelaihihuu”, sest siin ei kaja!

label: Route114_Text_LennyDefeat
en: Yodelayhihoo!
et: Jodelaihihuu!

label: Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle
en: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there was someone copying me and shouting back, “Yodelayhihoo.”
et: Kui ma väike põnn olin, uskusin ma, et keegi matkib mind ja karjub vastu: „Jodelaihihuu.”

label: Route114_Text_LucasIntro
en: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't be up in the mountains!
et: Kui sa pole valmis, pole sul mägedes asja!

label: Route114_Text_LucasDefeat
en: The mountains are unforgiving…
et: Mäed ei anna andeks…

label: Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle
en: In the winter, mountains turn deadly with blizzards and avalanches.
et: Talvel muutuvad mäed surmavaks: tuisud ja laviinid.

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
en: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast marshmallows, and tell spooky stories!
et: Telkimine on lõbus! Sa saad kalastada, vahukomme röstida ja jubedaid lugusid rääkida!

label: Route114_Text_ShaneIntro
en: But the best of all are the POKéMON battles!
et: Aga kõige parimad on POKéMON-lahingud!

label: Route114_Text_ShaneDefeat
en: Way too strong!
et: Palju liiga tugev!

label: Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle
en: I think it's great that I can go camping with my POKéMON.
et: Minu meelest on tore, et saan oma POKéMONidega telkima minna.

label: Route114_Text_NancyIntro
en: I need to exercise after a meal. Let's have a match!
et: Pärast söömist on vaja liikuda. Peame ühe lahingu!

label: Route114_Text_NancyDefeat
en: Oh, no!
et: Oh, ei!

label: Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle
en: I just had a tasty meal. I'm getting drowsy…
et: Sõin just maitsvalt. Nüüd hakkab uni peale…

label: Route114_Text_SteveIntro
en: Ufufufufufu… Want to battle against my POKéMON?
et: Ufufufufufu… Tahad võidelda mu POKéMONi vastu?

label: Route114_Text_SteveDefeat
en: M-My POKéMON…
et: Mu… mu POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
en: A big body that's all lumpy and hard, enormous horns, and vicious fangs…
et: Suur keha, mis on üleni muhklik ja kõva, tohutud sarved ja õelad kihvad…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostBattle
en: Ufufufufu… I wish I had a POKéMON like that…
et: Ufufufufu… Ma sooviksin, et mul oleks selline POKéMON…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRegister
en: Don't forget what you've done to me! I'll make it so you can't forget!
et: Ära unusta, mida sa mulle teinud oled! Ma teen nii, et sa ei saa unustada!

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro
en: Ufufufufufu… Come on, battle my POKéMON…
et: Ufufufufufu… No kuule, võitle mu POKéMONiga…

label: Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat
en: I feel so lucky getting to see your POKéMON…
et: Ma tunnen end nii õnnelikuna, saades näha su POKéMONi…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
en: Ufufufufufu…
et: Ufufufufufu…

label: Route114_Text_StevePostRematch
en: When I see POKéMON battling, I get all shivery and shaky…
et: Kui ma näen POKéMONe võitlemas, lähen ma üleni värisema ja judisema…

label: Route114_Text_BernieIntro
en: If you're lighting a campfire, make sure you have water handy.
et: Kui teed lõket, hoia kindlasti vesi käepärast.

label: Route114_Text_BernieDefeat
en: Thanks for dousing my fire!
et: Aitäh, et mu tule kustutasid!

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
en: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.
et: Metsas tuleb igasuguse tulega tõesti ettevaatlik olla.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle
en: Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
et: Ära kunagi alahinda tule jõudu.

label: Route114_Text_BernieRegister
en: You set my spirit on fire. Let's register each other!
et: Sa süütasid mu hinge põlema. Paneme teineteise kirja!

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro
en: Have you learned to keep water handy for campfires?
et: Kas oled juba õppinud lõkke juures vett käepärast hoidma?

label: Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat
en: I got hosed down before I could flare up, I guess.
et: Mind kasteti märjaks, enne kui ma üldse lõkkele lüüa jõudsin.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
en: You really do have to be careful with any sort of fire in a forest.
et: Metsas tuleb igasuguse tulega tõesti ettevaatlik olla.

label: Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch
en: Don't ever underestimate the power of fire.
et: Ära kunagi alahinda tule jõudu.

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro
en: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand a chance against me. So, bring on your POKéMON!
et: Kui me kala püüaksime, poleks sul minu vastu mingit lootust. Aga olgu — too oma POKéMONid välja!

label: Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat
en: If we were fishing, I would've won…
et: Kui me kala püüaksime, oleksin mina võitnud…

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
en: I think I'll try my luck at landing a big one at METEOR FALLS.
et: Vist lähen METEOR FALLSI suurt kala õngitsema.

label: Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle
en: There has to be something in there. I just know it.
et: Seal peab midagi olema. Ma lihtsalt tean seda.

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
en: I like to fish. But I also like to battle!
et: Mulle meeldib kalastada. Aga mulle meeldib ka võidelda!

label: Route114_Text_NolanIntro
en: If anyone challenges me, I'm there, even if I'm fishing.
et: Kui keegi mulle väljakutse esitab, olen ma kohal, isegi kui ma kalastan.

label: Route114_Text_NolanDefeat
en: I like to battle, but that doesn't mean I'm good at it…
et: Mulle meeldib võidelda, aga see ei tähenda, et olen selles hea…

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
en: This time I'll do it!
et: Seekord ma teen ära!

label: Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle
en: I always think that, so I can't walk away from fishing or POKéMON.
et: Nii ma alati mõtlen — seepärast ma ei suudagi kalapüüki ega POKéMONe sinnapaika jätta.

label: Route114_Text_TyraIntro
en: TYRA: Well, sure. I'm in the mood for it. I'll teach you a little about POKéMON.
et: TYRA: Noh, muidugi. Mul on tuju. Ma õpetan sulle veidi POKéMONidest.

label: Route114_Text_TyraDefeat
en: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!
et: TYRA: Milline hämmastav võitlusstiil!

label: Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle
en: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY about POKéMON.
et: TYRA: Ma õpetasin POKéMONide asju oma noorele õpilasele IVY.

label: Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons
en: TYRA: Giggle… If you want to battle with us, just one POKéMON isn't enough!
et: TYRA: Hihii… Kui tahad meiega võidelda, ühest POKéMONist ei piisa!

label: Route114_Text_IvyIntro
en: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?
et: IVY: Kes õpetas sulle POKéMONidest?

label: Route114_Text_IvyDefeat
en: IVY: What an amazing battle style!
et: IVY: Milline hämmastav võitlusstiil!

label: Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle
en: IVY: I started training POKéMON because TYRA, my student mentor, taught me!
et: IVY: Ma hakkasin POKéMONe treenima sellepärast, et vanem õpilane TYRA mind õpetas!

label: Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons
en: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON? I think it must feel lonesome.
et: IVY: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Küllap on tal üksi igav.

label: Route114_Text_KaiIntro
en: I landed a big one! A huge one, I tell you!
et: Sain suure kala! Hiiglasliku, ma ütlen sulle!

label: Route114_Text_KaiDefeat
en: What was that about? Did mine lose in size?
et: Mis see nüüd oli? Kas minu oma jäi suuruse poolest alla?

label: Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle
en: Okay! I'll just fish me a bigger one!
et: Olgu! Ma püüan endale lihtsalt suurema!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro
en: Me! I'm not just a pretty face!
et: Mina või! Ma pole ainult ilus nägu!

label: Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat
en: That wasn't cute in the least!
et: See polnud vähimalgi määral armas!

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
en: I don't want a POKéMON that's just cute.
et: Ma ei taha POKéMONi, kes on lihtsalt armas.

label: Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle
en: I adore cute ones that have a quirk or two!
et: Ma jumaldan armsaid, kellel on üks-kaks veidrust!

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro
en: Have you made your POKéMON evolve very much?
et: Kas oled oma POKéMONe palju arenema pannud?

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat
en: Oh, I see. That's good to know.
et: Ah soo. Hea teada.

label: Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle
en: Some POKéMON change so much when they evolve, it's startling!
et: Mõned POKéMONid muutuvad arenedes nii palju, et see on jahmatav!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyIntro
en: Hm… You seem rather capable… Let me keep you company!
et: Hm… Sa paistad päris osav… Las ma hoian sulle seltsi!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat
en: You're much stronger than I'd imagined!
et: Sa oled palju tugevam, kui ma ette kujutasin!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle
en: There is no such thing as a born genius. It all depends on effort! That is what I believe…
et: Sündinud geeniusi pole olemas. Kõik sõltub pingutusest! Nii ma usun…

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
en: Hmm… A loss this thorough has been a distant memory.
et: Hmm… Nii põhjalikku kaotust pole ma ammu tundnud.

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRegister
en: If you would allow it, I wish for another opportunity to do battle.
et: Kui sa lubaksid, ma sooviksin veel üht võimalust võidelda.

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro
en: Hm… As always, your agility speaks for itself. Come, keep me company!
et: Hm… Nagu ikka, su väledus räägib enda eest. Tule, hoia mulle seltsi!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyRematchDefeat
en: As strong as ever!
et: Sama tugev kui alati!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
en: All it takes is effort!
et: Vaja on ainult pingutust!

label: Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch
en: I lost because I haven't put in enough effort!
et: Ma kaotasin, sest ma pole piisavalt vaeva näinud!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: You!
et: Sina!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: My MACHOP!
et: Mu MACHOP!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiIntro
en: Demand a battle!
et: Nõuab lahingut!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiDefeat
en: Ouch, ouch, ouch!
et: Ai, ai, ai!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
en: My MACHOP crew!
et: Mu MACHOPide kamp!

label: Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle
en: So long as they seek power, I will grow strong with them!
et: Niikaua kui nad jõudu otsivad, saan ma nendega koos tugevaks!

label: Route115_Text_NobIntro
en: My strongest skill is busting bricks with my forehead!
et: Mu kõige kõvem oskus on telliste lõhkumine otsaesisega!

label: Route115_Text_NobDefeat
en: Ugwaaaah! My head is busted!
et: Ugvaaaah! Mu pea on lõhki!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
en: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.
et: Ma olen oma POKéMONidele karatet õpetanud.

label: Route115_Text_NobPostBattle
en: It looks like they'll get a lot better than me. I'm excited about that.
et: Näib, et nad saavad minust palju paremaks. Ma olen selle üle põnevil.

label: Route115_Text_NobRegister
en: You impress me! Give me a rematch after I redo my training!
et: Sa avaldad mulle muljet! Treenin end uuesti üles — siis anna revanš!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro
en: After you beat me, we trained hard to improve our skills. Come on, give us a rematch!
et: Pärast su võitu treenisime kõvasti ja lihvisime oskusi. No tule, anna meile revanš!

label: Route115_Text_NobRematchDefeat
en: Ugwaaah! We lost again!
et: Ugvaaah! Me kaotasime jälle!

label: Route115_Text_NobPostRematch
en: My POKéMON will grow stronger! I'll redouble my training!
et: Mu POKéMON saab tugevamaks! Ma kahekordistan oma treeningut!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyIntro
en: This beach is my secret training spot! Don't come butting in!
et: See rand on mu salajane treeningpaik! Ära tule vahele trügima!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyDefeat
en: I haven't trained enough!
et: Ma pole piisavalt treeninud!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle
en: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce impact and prevent injury. This is the perfect place to train.
et: Liiv toimib padjana, et vähendada põrutust ja vältida vigastusi. See on ideaalne koht treenimiseks.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRegister
en: Okay, fine, you're free to come here. In return, I'd like to battle you again.
et: Olgu, hea küll, sa võid vabalt siia tulla. Vastutasuks tahaksin sinuga jälle võidelda.

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro
en: Okay, let's get this battle on!
et: Olgu, läheb lahti!

label: Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat
en: I can battle but my POKéMON…
et: Ma oskan võidelda, aga mu POKéMON…

label: Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch
en: Even when I lose, I still get some enjoyment out of it. It must be that I love POKéMON.
et: Isegi kaotades on mul natuke lõbus. Küllap ma lihtsalt armastan POKéMONe.

label: Route115_Text_HectorIntro
en: I have a rare POKéMON! Would you like me to show you?
et: Mul on haruldane POKéMON! Kas tahad näha?

label: Route115_Text_HectorDefeat
en: You… You want my POKéMON, don't you?
et: Sina… Sa tahad mu POKéMONi, kas pole?

label: Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle
en: I have this rare POKéMON. It's enough to keep me satisfied.
et: Mul on see haruldane POKéMON. Sellest mulle piisabki.

label: Route115_Text_KyraIntro
en: I'll battle while I'm running! Try to keep up with me!
et: Ma võitlen joostes! Püüa minuga sammu pidada!

label: Route115_Text_KyraDefeat
en: Gasp, gasp…
et: Ähh, ähh…

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
en: I made the mistake of trying to battle while running!
et: Tegin vea, et üritasin joostes võidelda!

label: Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle
en: I should take a run to calm down…
et: Ma peaksin jooksma minema, et maha rahuneda…

label: Route115_Text_JaidenIntro
en: Take that! Ultra POKéMON ninja attack!
et: Võta seda! Ultra POKéMONi nindža-rünnak!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenDefeat
en: Waaah! Our strategy failed!
et: Vaaah! Meie strateegia vedas alt!

label: Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle
en: But my POKéMON were ultra, weren't they?
et: Aga mu POKéMONid olid ultra, kas polnud?

label: Route115_Text_HeleneIntro
en: My POKéMON have black belt-level strength!
et: Mu POKéMONidel on musta vöö tasemel jõud!

label: Route115_Text_HeleneDefeat
en: This is too humiliating!
et: See on liiga alandav!

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
en: I rarely meet anyone who's better than me…
et: Ma kohtan harva kedagi, kes on minust parem…

label: Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle
en: I get it now! You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?
et: Ma saan nüüd aru! Sa oled SAALI JUHT, kas pole?

label: Route115_Text_AlixIntro
en: Our eyes met! There's no getting away now!
et: Meie pilgud kohtusid! Nüüd pole enam pääsu!

label: Route115_Text_AlixDefeat
en: Gah! Not bad!
et: Gah! Pole paha!

label: Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle
en: Oh, well. I think I will TELEPORT home.
et: Oh, hea küll. Ma vist TELEPORTin koju.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneIntro
en: You've disturbed my meditation… You'll be punished for it.
et: Sa segasid mu meditatsiooni… Selle eest saad karistada.

label: Route115_Text_MarleneDefeat
en: You've broken my concentration!
et: Sa lõhkusid mu keskendumise!

label: Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle
en: I was meditating with my POKéMON. But this place isn't very peaceful…
et: Ma mediteerisin oma POKéMONiga. Aga see koht pole eriti rahulik…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkIntro
en: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then I'll just go over the top.
et: Kui tunnelit läbi ei tule, lähen lihtsalt mäe otsast üle.

label: Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat
en: Gasp… Gasp… Losing made me tired…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Kaotamine väsitas mu ära…

label: Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle
en: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel. To a HIKER, mountains are roads!
et: Pole midagi hullu, kui tunnelit pole. HIKERI jaoks on mäed teed!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyIntro
en: My POKéMON rule! Check them out!
et: Mu POKéMONid on parimad! Vaata neid!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat
en: Ouch! A scrape! I have to put on a bandage!
et: Ai! Kriimustus! Pean sideme peale panema!

label: Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle
en: Bandages are signs of toughness! I've got another one!
et: Sidemed on kõvaduse märgid! Mul on veel üks!

label: Route116_Text_JoseIntro
en: My BUG POKéMON are tough! Let's battle!
et: Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid on kõvad! Võitleme!

label: Route116_Text_JoseDefeat
en: I lost! I thought I had you!
et: Ma kaotasin! Ma arvasin, et sa oled käes!

label: Route116_Text_JosePostBattle
en: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. So they get strong quickly, too.
et: PUTUKA-POKéMONid arenevad kiiresti. Nii saavad nad ka kiiresti tugevaks.

label: Route116_Text_JaniceIntro
en: Let me teach you how strong my adorable POKéMON is!
et: Las ma näitan sulle, kui tugev mu armas POKéMON on!

label: Route116_Text_JaniceDefeat
en: You're a notch above me…
et: Sa oled minust astme võrra üle…

label: Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle
en: POKéMON that possess cuteness and power, that's ideal, I think.
et: Minu meelest on ideaalne POKéMON korraga armas ja tugev.

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
en: We learn all sorts of things at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
et: Me õpime TRAINERI KOOLIS igasuguseid asju.

label: Route116_Text_JerryIntro
en: I want to test things out for real!
et: Ma tahan asju päriselt katsetada!

label: Route116_Text_JerryDefeat
en: I slacked off in school… That's why I lost.
et: Ma logelesin koolis… Just seepärast ma kaotasin.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle
en: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
et: Ma pean TRAINERI KOOLIS mõned kursused uuesti läbi tegema. Kui ma ei tee, on ROXANNE vihane.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
en: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.
et: Ma õppisin TRAINERI KOOLIS, et POKéNAV saab TRAINEREID registreerida.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister1
en: I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
et: Ma ei saa päris hästi aru, mida see tähendab — kas võin lihtsalt proovida?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
en: I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.
et: Ma õppisin TRAINERI KOOLIS, et POKéNAV saab TRAINEREID registreerida.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRegister2
en: I don't really get what that means, so can I just try it?
et: Ma ei saa päris hästi aru, mida see tähendab — kas võin lihtsalt proovida?

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro
en: I've been studying seriously at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. I won't lose like I did last time.
et: Ma olen TRAINERI KOOLIS tõsiselt õppinud. Ma ei kaota nagu eelmisel korral.

label: Route116_Text_JerryRematchDefeat
en: Hunh? I studied diligently.
et: Häh? Ma õppisin usinasti.

label: Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch
en: I'll have to redo some courses at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL. If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
et: Ma pean TRAINERI KOOLIS mõned kursused uuesti läbi tegema. Kui ma ei tee, on ROXANNE vihane.

label: Route116_Text_KarenIntro
en: I study at school, and I study on the way home, too!
et: Ma õpin koolis ja õpin ka koduteel!

label: Route116_Text_KarenDefeat
en: I'm in shock--I lost?
et: Ma olen šokis – ma kaotasin?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle
en: Awww, I'll never become an elegant TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
et: Ohh, ma ei saa niimoodi kunagi elegantseks TRAINERIKS nagu ROXANNE!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister1
en: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
et: Oh, ohoo! Kas pole see POKéNAV? Mul on ka! Palun registreeri mind!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRegister2
en: Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV? I have one, too! Please register me!
et: Oh, ohoo! Kas pole see POKéNAV? Mul on ka! Palun registreeri mind!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro
en: I studied a whole lot since I saw you. You must see my achievements!
et: Ma olen pärast meie kohtumist kõvasti õppinud. Sa pead mu edusamme nägema!

label: Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat
en: I'm in shock. I lost again?
et: Ma olen šokis. Ma kaotasin jälle?

label: Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch
en: You've beaten ROXANNE? I can't beat you, then. Not yet.
et: Sa oled ROXANNE alistanud? Siis ma sind ei võida. Veel mitte.

label: Route116_Text_SarahIntro
en: Just so you know, I've never once been bested by anyone at anything.
et: Tead, mind pole keegi veel milleski üle löönud.

label: Route116_Text_SarahDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. This is a new experience for me.
et: Oh, heldeke. See on mulle uus kogemus.

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
en: My life of luxury affords me all that I could possibly desire.
et: Mu luksuslik elu annab mulle kõik, mida vähegi soovida oskan.

label: Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle
en: However, when it comes to POKéMON, my wealth has no meaning.
et: Ent kui asi puudutab POKéMONe, pole mu rikkusel mingit tähendust.

label: Route116_Text_DawsonIntro
en: When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's gorgeous fur, their beauty will render you helpless!
et: Kui näed mu POKéMONide uhket karva, muudab nende ilu su abituks!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat
en: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!
et: Oh, kullake, ütle, et see pole nii!

label: Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle
en: Oh, no, no, no! You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur! You've ruined my hairdo, too! I'll have to call my stylist now!
et: Oh, ei, ei, ei! Sa sassisid mu POKéMONi karva! Sa rikkusid ka mu soengu! Ma pean nüüd oma stilisti kutsuma!

label: Route116_Text_DevanIntro
en: We'll rock you hard!
et: Me raputame sind kõvasti!

label: Route116_Text_DevanDefeat
en: Aiyiyi! No contest at all!
et: Aijaijai! Polnudki mingit heitlust!

label: Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle
en: I should try different POKéMON types, that's what I ought to do.
et: Peaksin proovima teistsuguseid POKéMONi tüüpe — just nii ma teengi.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro
en: It's a dead end up here. I'm bored, so can we battle?
et: Siin üleval on ummiktee. Mul on igav, nii et kas võitleme?

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat
en: That was fun even though I lost.
et: See oli lõbus, kuigi ma kaotasin.

label: Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle
en: Want to stay here and keep me company?
et: Tahad siia jääda ja mulle seltsi hoida?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacIntro
en: Listen, could I get you to battle the POKéMON I'm raising?
et: Kuule, kas võitleksid POKéMONidega, keda ma kasvatan?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacDefeat
en: You've raised yours superbly…
et: Sa oled omad suurepäraselt üles kasvatanud…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
en: POKéMON isn't all about power.
et: POKéMONide juures pole tähtis ainult jõud.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle
en: Polishing a unique aspect of one's character is another way of enjoying POKéMON.
et: Mõne iseäraliku iseloomujoone lihvimine on samuti üks viis POKéMONe nautida.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRegister
en: I'm going to redouble my training. Would you come look in on us?
et: Ma kavatsen oma treeningut kahekordistada. Kas tuleksid meid vaatama?

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro
en: The POKéMON I've been raising are looking good, just like before.
et: Mu kasvandikud näevad ikka sama head välja kui enne.

label: Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat
en: You know how to raise them properly. You might have DAY CARE skills…
et: Sa oskad neid õigesti kasvatada. Sinust saaks kohe DAY CARE kasvataja…

label: Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch
en: Your POKéMON are growing good! You should enter them in CONTESTS.
et: Su POKéMONid kasvavad kenasti! Peaksid nendega VÕISTLUSTEL osalema.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaIntro
en: Please, allow me to evaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.
et: Palun luba mul hinnata, kas oled oma POKéMONe õigesti kasvatanud.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaDefeat
en: Yes, they are growing properly.
et: Jah, nad kasvavad õigesti.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle
en: Try raising POKéMON with more attention to their character traits.
et: Pane POKéMONe kasvatades rohkem tähele nende iseloomu.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRegister
en: I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you. I hope to see you again.
et: Mul on hea meel, et kohtasin sinus suurepärast TRAINERit. Ma loodan sind jälle näha.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro
en: Allow me to reevaluate if you have raised your POKéMON properly.
et: Luba mul uuesti hinnata, kas oled oma POKéMONe õigesti kasvatanud.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaRematchDefeat
en: They are growing admirably.
et: Nad kasvavad imetlusväärselt.

label: Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch
en: POKéMON seem to like different kinds of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.
et: Näib, et igale POKéMONile meeldivad tema loomuse järgi eri {POKEBLOCK}id.

label: Route117_Text_DylanIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, whatever, let's have a battle!
et: Ma olen keset triatloni, aga ah, ükskõik — peame lahingu!

label: Route117_Text_DylanDefeat
en: I ran out of energy!
et: Mul sai energia otsa!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
en: I may have blown it…
et: Ma võisin selle untsu ajada…

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle
en: I might have dropped to last during that battle…
et: Vist langesin selle lahingu ajal viimaseks…

label: Route117_Text_DylanRegister
en: POKéMON have to be strong, too? I'd like you to train me!
et: POKéMONid peavad ka tugevad olema? Ma tahaksin, et sa mind treeniksid!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro
en: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon, but I'm comfortably ahead. Let's make this a quick battle!
et: Ma olen just keset triatloni, aga edu on mul kindel. Teeme kiire lahingu!

label: Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat
en: I ran out of energy again!
et: Mul sai jälle energia otsa!

label: Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch
en: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but I'm not quite that confident with POKéMON yet.
et: Ma olin ujumises ja rattasõidus tipus, aga POKéMONide osas pole ma veel päris nii kindel.

label: Route117_Text_MariaIntro
en: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON, so I'm pretty confident about my speed.
et: Ma treenin triatloniks koos POKéMONidega, nii et oma kiiruses olen üsna kindel.

label: Route117_Text_MariaDefeat
en: I need to get more practices in, I guess.
et: Ma pean vist rohkem harjutama.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
en: Training is meaningful only if you keep it up regularly.
et: Treeningust on kasu ainult siis, kui seda regulaarselt teha.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle
en: Okay! I'll resume my training! Tomorrow!
et: Olgu! Ma jätkan oma treeningut! Homme!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRegister
en: You appear to be training properly… If you'd like, I'll battle you later!
et: Näib, et sa treenid õigesti… Kui soovid, ma võitlen sinuga hiljem!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro
en: Are you keeping up with your training? I sure am! Let me show you the evidence!
et: Kas oled treeninguga järje peal? Mina küll! Las ma näitan tõendeid!

label: Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat
en: I need to get more practices in, I guess.
et: Ma pean vist rohkem harjutama.

label: Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch
en: I'll resume training tomorrow. Let's battle again sometime!
et: Ma jätkan homme treeningut. Võitleme kunagi jälle!

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
en: Once a BUG CATCHER! And now a BUG MANIAC!
et: Kunagi BUG CATCHER! Ja nüüd BUG MANIAC!

label: Route117_Text_DerekIntro
en: But my love for POKéMON remains unchanged!
et: Aga mu armastus POKéMONide vastu jääb muutumatuks!

label: Route117_Text_DerekDefeat
en: My ineptitude also remains unchanged…
et: Mu saamatus jääb samuti muutumatuks…

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
en: All I did was follow my heart, and now they call me a BUG MANIAC…
et: Ma tegin vaid seda, mida süda käskis, ja nüüd hüütakse mind nimega BUG MANIAC…

label: Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle
en: Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON, so it's only natural that they call me a BUG MANIAC.
et: Ometi olen ma PUTUKA-POKéMONide ekspert, nii et pole ime, et mind hüütakse nimega BUG MANIAC.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaIntro
en: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner. I have to do good!
et: ANNA: Mul on kaaslaseks kena noorem õpilane. Ma pean hästi hakkama saama!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat
en: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student partner! Let me win!
et: ANNA: Mul on kaaslaseks kena noorem õpilane! Las ma võidan!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
en: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.
et: ANNA: Su POKéMONidel on mõned head kombinatsioonid.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle
en: I'd say you're second only to us!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa jääd alla ainult meile!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister
en: ANNA: We can't take this lying down! You will come back, won't you?
et: ANNA: Me ei lepi sellega niisama! Sa tuled ju tagasi, kas pole?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons
en: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.
et: ANNA: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, too kaks POKéMONi kaasa.

label: Route117_Text_MegIntro
en: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super senior student partner and beat you!
et: MEG: Ma löön käed kokku oma ägeda vanema õpilasega ja võidan su ära!

label: Route117_Text_MegDefeat
en: MEG: Oh, no! I'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…
et: MEG: Oh, ei! Vabandust, ANNA! Ma vedasin sind alt…

label: Route117_Text_MegPostBattle
en: MEG: I dragged ANNA down… If I didn't, she would have won!
et: MEG: Mina vedasin ANNA alt… Ilma minuta oleks ta võitnud!

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
en: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then.
et: MEG: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me ei saa sinuga võidelda.

label: Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons
en: We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
et: Me tahame pidada 2-vastu-2 lahingu.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro
en: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of my junior partner, right?
et: ANNA: Ma ei saa oma noorema partneri ees aina kaotada, eks?

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat
en: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.
et: ANNA: Ma ei saanud hoogu sisse.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
en: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good combinations.
et: ANNA: Su POKéMONidel on mõned head kombinatsioonid.

label: Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch
en: I'd say you're second only to us!
et: Ma ütleksin, et sa jääd alla ainult meile!

label: Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons
en: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring two POKéMON with you.
et: ANNA: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, too kaks POKéMONi kaasa.

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro
en: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my senior partner and win this time!
et: MEG: Ma löön käed kokku oma vanema partneriga ja võidan seekord!

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchDefeat
en: MEG: Too strong!
et: MEG: Liiga tugev!

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
en: MEG: I battled together with my senior partner, but we lost…
et: MEG: Ma võitlesin koos oma vanema partneriga, aga me kaotasime…

label: Route117_Text_MegPostRematch
en: That's so discouraging…
et: See on nii heidutav…

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
en: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON? We can't battle with you, then.
et: MEG: Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON? Siis me ei saa sinuga võidelda.

label: Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons
en: We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
et: Me tahame pidada 2-vastu-2 lahingu.

label: Route117_Text_MelinaIntro
en: Isn't it nice? To battle while looking at pretty flowers?
et: Kas pole tore? Võidelda ja vaadata samal ajal ilusaid lilli?

label: Route117_Text_MelinaDefeat
en: Oh, that's quite impressive!
et: Oh, see on päris muljetavaldav!

label: Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle
en: It feels wonderful to go for a jog while looking at flowers.
et: Sörkida ja lilli vaadata — imeline tunne.

label: Route117_Text_BrandiIntro
en: Let me demonstrate the power hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!
et: Las ma näitan, milline jõud peitub VAIMSES POKéMONis!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiDefeat
en: Astonishing!
et: Hämmastav!

label: Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle
en: PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex. You should try catching some.
et: VAIMSED POKéMONid on keerulised. Proovi mõni endale püüda.

label: Route117_Text_AishaIntro
en: Concentrate on getting the win. That's how I battle!
et: Keskendu võidu saamisele. Nii ma võitlen!

label: Route117_Text_AishaDefeat
en: I don't waste any time being angry over a loss--I would rather train.
et: Ma ei raiska aega kaotuse pärast pahandamisele – pigem treenin.

label: Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle
en: I think that if you worry about losing, you're more likely to lose.
et: Minu meelest kaotad seda kindlamini, mida rohkem sa kaotamise pärast muretsed.

label: Route118_Text_RoseIntro
en: The aroma of flowers has a magical power. It cleanses us body and soul.
et: Lillelõhnal on maagiline vägi. See puhastab nii keha kui hinge.

label: Route118_Text_RoseDefeat
en: Oh, dear me. I seem to have lost.
et: Oh, heldeke. Näib, et ma kaotasin.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
en: Flowers, POKéMON… I love whatever smells nice.
et: Lilled, POKéMONid… Ma armastan kõike, mis hästi lõhnab.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostBattle
en: Stinky things… I'll pass.
et: Haisvad asjad… Ei, aitäh.

label: Route118_Text_RoseRegister
en: Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV! We must register each other!
et: Nuhh… See lõhn – see on POKéNAV! Me peame teineteise registreerima!

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro
en: Were you drawn here by the sweet aroma?
et: Kas sind tõmbas siia magus aroom?

label: Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat
en: The power of aroma… It didn't seem to do much.
et: Lõhna vägi… Sellest polnud vist suurt abi.

label: Route118_Text_RosePostRematch
en: If you use a sweet aroma properly, POKéMON will be attracted by it.
et: Kui kasutad magusat aroomi õigesti, tõmbab see POKéMONe ligi.

label: Route118_Text_PerryIntro
en: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in the sky… They're the best!
et: LINNU-POKéMONid, kes taevas elegantselt lendavad… Nad on parimad!

label: Route118_Text_PerryDefeat
en: Urgh… I crashed…
et: Urgh… Ma kukkusin…

label: Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle
en: You've got great POKéMON. I'll have to train mine better.
et: Sul on suurepärased POKéMONid. Ma pean oma omi paremini treenima.

label: Route118_Text_ChesterIntro
en: Take flight! My BIRD POKéMON!
et: Lendu, mu LINNU-POKéMONid!

label: Route118_Text_ChesterDefeat
en: They did take flight…
et: Nad tõusidki lendu…

label: Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle
en: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able to fly more freely…
et: Kui nad tugevamaks saaksid, suudaksid nad vabamalt lennata…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyIntro
en: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER. I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.
et: Ma olen FISHERMAN, aga ka TRAINER. Kasvatan POKéMONe, keda ise püüdsin.

label: Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat
en: I thought I was doing okay in my training…
et: Ma arvasin, et treening läheb mul päris hästi…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
en: I couldn't win by training POKéMON while I fished…
et: Kalapüügi kõrvalt POKéMONe treenides ei suutnud ma võita…

label: Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle
en: Was I doing things in half measures?
et: Kas ma tegin kõike ikka poolikult?

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
en: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.
et: FISHERMANi jaoks on kõige tähtsam varustus.

label: Route118_Text_WadeIntro
en: But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients are POKéMON and heart, of course!
et: Aga TRAINERI jaoks on tähtsaimad muidugi POKéMONid ja süda!

label: Route118_Text_WadeDefeat
en: I was beaten in heart?
et: Kas ma jäin alla südame poolest?

label: Route118_Text_WadePostBattle
en: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.
et: Kui järele mõelda, ongi kalapüük lahing FISHERMANi ja POKéMONi vahel.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonIntro
en: Let my melody rock your soul!
et: Las mu meloodia raputab su hinge!

label: Route118_Text_DaltonDefeat
en: La-lalala…
et: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
en: An electric guitar doesn't always have to be noisy…
et: Elektrikitarr ei pea alati lärmakas olema…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle
en: It can be strummed to squeeze out this heart-stirring melody…
et: Sellest saab näppides välja meelitada südantliigutava viisi…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRegister
en: When I compose better melodies, you have to come listen, okay?
et: Kui ma paremaid viise loon, tule kindlasti kuulama, eks?

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro
en: A melody from my POKéMON and me… Let us deliver it to your soul.
et: Meloodia minult ja mu POKéMONilt… Las see jõuab sulle hingepõhja.

label: Route118_Text_DaltonRematchDefeat
en: La-lalala…
et: La-lalala…

label: Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch
en: When I play, my emotions should reach you through my electric guitar…
et: Kui ma mängin, peaksid mu tunded elektrikitarri kaudu sinuni jõudma…

label: Route118_Text_DeandreIntro
en: Go, go, go! POKéMON 1, 2, and 3!
et: Läks, läks, läks! POKéMON 1, 2 ja 3!

label: Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat
en: Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay? POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!
et: Kuuldel, POKéMONid! Kas kõik on korras? POKéMON 1, 2 ja 3?!

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
en: Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON battle team?
et: Kas pole lahe, et mul on oma POKéMONide lahingumeeskond?

label: Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle
en: You can copy me--I don't mind!
et: Sa võid mind matkida – ma ei pane pahaks!

label: Route119_Text_BrentIntro
en: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! We MIMIC what you do!
et: Meie oleme MIMIC CIRCLE! Me MATKIME kõike, mida sa teed!

label: Route119_Text_BrentDefeat
en: Whoopsie! I lost!
et: Uupsti! Ma kaotasin!

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
en: What's so good about mimicry?
et: Mis matkimises siis nii head on?

label: Route119_Text_BrentPostBattle
en: Fufufu… You'll never understand…
et: Fufufu… Sa ei mõista seda kunagi…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldIntro
en: So, we finally meet! My BUG POKéMON will keep you company!
et: Lõpuks ometi me kohtume! Mu PUTUKA-POKéMONid hoiavad sulle seltsi!

label: Route119_Text_DonaldDefeat
en: I wish we'd never met…
et: Parem, kui me poleks kunagi kohtunud…

label: Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle
en: I want to MIMIC you some more. Can you hurry up and move?
et: Tahan sind veel MATKIDA. Kas liigutaksid natuke kiiremini?

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
en: If you step forward, we step forward.
et: Kui sina astud sammu ette, astume meiegi.

label: Route119_Text_TaylorIntro
en: If you turn right, we turn, too…
et: Kui sa pöörad paremale, pöörame meiegi…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat
en: But if you win, I lose…
et: Aga kui sina võidad, siis mina kaotan…

label: Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle
en: I can't MIMIC you winning the match. That's just impossible… It's burning me up…
et: Ma ei suuda MATKIDA seda, kuidas sa võidad. See on lihtsalt võimatu… See ajab mind marru…

label: Route119_Text_DougIntro
en: Yep, you've finally caught me! Or were you trying to avoid me?
et: Jaa, lõpuks ometi said mu kätte! Või üritasid sa hoopis mind vältida?

label: Route119_Text_DougDefeat
en: Whoop, that was a great match!
et: Ohoo, see oli suurepärane matš!

label: Route119_Text_DougPostBattle
en: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE! I hope you enjoyed our performance.
et: Me oleme MIMIC CIRCLE! Loodetavasti meie etendus meeldis sulle.

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
en: You don't know who I am, do you?
et: Sa ei tea, kes ma olen, ega?

label: Route119_Text_GregIntro
en: But, I also don't know you. So, we'll battle!
et: Aga mina ei tunne ka sind. Niisiis — võitleme!

label: Route119_Text_GregDefeat
en: You're pretty strong!
et: Sa oled päris tugev!

label: Route119_Text_GregPostBattle
en: Until you go away somewhere, we'll keep on mimicking your every move.
et: Kuni sa siit minema ei lähe, matkime iga su liigutust.

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
en: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people who like to MIMIC.
et: MIMIC CIRCLE sai alguse inimestest, kellele meeldib MATKIDA.

label: Route119_Text_KentIntro
en: A battle starts the instant we meet!
et: Lahing algab samal hetkel, kui me kohtume!

label: Route119_Text_KentDefeat
en: I give up!
et: Ma annan alla!

label: Route119_Text_KentPostBattle
en: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?
et: Kas sa ei tahaks meie MIMIC CIRCLE liikmeks hakata?

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
en: Who has the knowledge and the technique for survival?
et: Kellel on ellujäämiseks teadmised ja oskused?

label: Route119_Text_JacksonIntro
en: POKéMON RANGERS, that's who!
et: POKéMON RANGERID, kellel siis veel!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat
en: I didn't have enough POKéMON know-how…
et: Mul jäi POKéMONide tundmisest puudu…

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
en: To break away from civilization and awaken the wild spirit within!
et: Murda tsivilisatsioonist lahti ja äratada endas metsik vaim!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle
en: That's our vision.
et: See on meie nägemus.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRegister
en: I hope you'll give me a rematch without mocking my lack of knowledge.
et: Loodan, et annad mulle revanši ega pilka mu kesiseid teadmisi.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro
en: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by being together with POKéMON.
et: Ma leian oma metsiku vaimu tagasi, olles koos POKéMONidega.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonRematchDefeat
en: You've remained strong!
et: Sa oled endiselt tugev!

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
en: Believe in your POKéMON. Believe in yourself.
et: Usu oma POKéMONidesse. Usu iseendasse.

label: Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch
en: The road will reveal itself to you.
et: Siis avaneb tee sinu ees.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
en: Oh? Look at you.
et: Ohoo? Vaata aga sind.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineIntro
en: For someone on an adventure, you're traveling awfully light.
et: Seiklejaks reisid sa küll kohutavalt kerge pambuga.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat
en: Accidents happen when you're not prepared!
et: Õnnetus ei hüüa tulles, kui sa valmis pole!

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
en: You're traveling light but you have everything you need.
et: Sa reisid kergelt, aga sul on kõik, mida vaja.

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle
en: You're on top of things mentally and physically, too.
et: Ja heas vormis oled sa nii vaimselt kui ka füüsiliselt.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
en: Do you have a POKéNAV? It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.
et: Kas sul on POKéNAV? See asi peab igal TRAINERIL olema.

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRegister
en: Oh, you do have one! Let's register each other, then!
et: Oo, sul ongi! Registreerime siis teineteist!

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro
en: How's your journey with POKéMON going?
et: Kuidas su teekond POKéMONidega läheb?

label: Route119_Text_CatherineRematchDefeat
en: I'm still missing something…
et: Mul on ikka veel midagi puudu…

label: Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch
en: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER, rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON rely on you.
et: Nii nagu sina TRAINERINA loodad oma POKéMONidele, loodavad nemad sinule.

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
en: The vast sky holds untold promise!
et: Avar taevas on täis lõputuid lubadusi!

label: Route119_Text_HughIntro
en: Nothing can compare to the sheer exhilaration of flight!
et: Miski ei võrdu lendamise joovastusega!

label: Route119_Text_HughDefeat
en: Down and out!
et: Pikali ja mängust väljas!

label: Route119_Text_HughPostBattle
en: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of flying come true!
et: Mu LINNU-POKéMONid tegid mu lendamisunistuse teoks!

label: Route119_Text_PhilIntro
en: I'll show you the true potential of me and my BIRD POKéMON!
et: Ma näitan sulle, milleks mina ja mu LINNU-POKéMONid võimelised oleme!

label: Route119_Text_PhilDefeat
en: We lacked potential…
et: Meil nappis potentsiaali…

label: Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle
en: Ever since I was a little kid, I always admired BIRD POKéMON…
et: Juba väikese põnnina imetlesin ma LINNU-POKéMONe…

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
en: To lurk in shadows, and live in darkness… That is my destiny.
et: Varitseda varjudes ja elada pimeduses… See on mu saatus.

label: Route119_Text_YasuIntro
en: I emerge to challenge you!
et: Astun varjust välja — võitleme!

label: Route119_Text_YasuDefeat
en: I admit defeat!
et: Ma tunnistan lüüasaamist!

label: Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle
en: Those defeated in battle withdraw quietly back into the shadows. That, too, is destiny…
et: Need, kes lahingus lüüa saavad, taanduvad vaikselt tagasi varjudesse. Ka see on saatus…

label: Route119_Text_TakashiIntro
en: If you're not on your guard, you're in for some pain!
et: Kui sa valvas pole, saad kõvasti haiget!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiDefeat
en: You're surprisingly good!
et: Sa oled üllatavalt hea!

label: Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle
en: My surprise attack ended in failure…
et: Mu üllatusrünnak kukkus läbi…

label: Route119_Text_HideoIntro
en: To hide a tree, use a forest!
et: Puu peitmiseks kasuta metsa!

label: Route119_Text_HideoDefeat
en: I bow to your superiority.
et: Ma kummardan su üleoleku ees.

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
en: To hide a tree, use a forest! To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!
et: Puu peitmiseks kasuta metsa! POKéMONi peitmiseks kasuta POKéMONi!

label: Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle
en: There is no deep, hidden meaning to that.
et: Sellel pole mingit sügavat varjatud tähendust.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
en: You spoke to me… So you want to challenge me!
et: Sa kõnetasid mind… Järelikult tahad mulle väljakutse esitada!

label: Route119_Text_ChrisIntro
en: Sure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught while SURFING!
et: Muidugi! Ma proovin POKéMONe, keda ma SURFIDES püüdsin!

label: Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat
en: I don't have a clue about what it takes to win.
et: Mul pole aimugi, mida võitmiseks vaja on.

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…
et: Lähed oma POKéMONi seljas SURFIMA…

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: Then fish off its back…
et: Ja kalastad siis tema seljast…

label: Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle
en: It's an indescribably luxuriant moment!
et: See on kirjeldamatult mõnus hetk!

label: Route119_Text_FabianIntro
en: Hit me with a power chord! Victory is mine! It's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!
et: Anna mulle üks võimas akord! Võit on minu! Nüüd on meie aeg särada, ohoo, jaa!

label: Route119_Text_FabianDefeat
en: You showed me who's the boss! We'll have to take the loss, oh, no!
et: Sa näitasid, kes on boss! Meile jäi kaotus, oh ei!

label: Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle
en: Hit me with another power chord! Leave me alone! Your win you have to atone!
et: Anna veel üks võimas akord! Jäta mind rahule! Oma võidu eest pead sa vastust andma!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonIntro
en: Hohoho! I like kid TRAINERS! Let's have a good one!
et: Hohoho! Mulle meeldivad noored TRAINERID! Teeme ühe korraliku matši!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonDefeat
en: You're pretty amazing! Hohoho!
et: Sa oled päris hämmastav! Hohoho!

label: Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle
en: Hohoho! I'll try emulating the pep of kid TRAINERS like you!
et: Hohoho! Võtan sinusuguste noorte TRAINERITE hoo eeskujuks!

label: Route119_Text_RachelIntro
en: Wherever and whenever I may be, I always have my parasol in hand.
et: Kus ja millal ma ka ei oleks, on mul alati päikesevari käes.

label: Route119_Text_RachelDefeat
en: Oh, but… That's not fair.
et: Oh, aga… See pole aus.

label: Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle
en: You're asking if my parasol is heavy? Your BAG is filled with more junk than I ever carry around.
et: Küsid, kas mu päikesevari on raske? Sinu KOTT on rohkem kola täis, kui mina iial kaasas kannan.

label: Route120_Text_ColinIntro
en: Do you have any moves that can strike a flying POKéMON?
et: Kas sul on mõni võte, mis suudab tabada lendavat POKéMONi?

label: Route120_Text_ColinDefeat
en: You soared above me!
et: Sa tõusid minust kõrgemale!

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
en: The move FLY is convenient, don't you think?
et: FLY on ikka mugav võte, eks ole?

label: Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle
en: While the POKéMON is flying, almost no moves can strike it.
et: Kui POKéMON on õhus, ei taba teda peaaegu ükski võte.

label: Route120_Text_RobertIntro
en: My POKéMON is strong! How about yours?
et: Mu POKéMON on tugev! Aga sinu oma?

label: Route120_Text_RobertDefeat
en: Your POKéMON were stronger…
et: Su POKéMONid olid tugevamad…

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle
en: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.
et: POKéMONi peale, kes ühtlaselt kasvab, võib alati loota.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRegister
en: You can be counted on to get better. I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!
et: Sinu peale võib loota — sa lähed aina paremaks. Tahaksin sind oma POKéNAVi registreerida!

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro
en: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one you can count on.
et: POKéMONi peale, kes ühtlaselt kasvab, võib alati loota.

label: Route120_Text_RobertRematchDefeat
en: Your POKéMON are seriously strong.
et: Su POKéMONid on tõsiselt tugevad.

label: Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch
en: My POKéMON are growing stronger. I have to grow stronger, too.
et: Mu POKéMONid saavad tugevamaks. Ma pean ka tugevamaks saama.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro
en: I'll check your POKéMON and see if they're fit for the outdoors.
et: Vaatan üle, kas su POKéMONid on looduses hakkamasaamiseks vormis.

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat
en: With POKéMON that strong, you're in no danger of needing rescue!
et: Nii tugevate POKéMONidega ei jää sa kunagi päästmist ootama!

label: Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle
en: To travel wherever your heart desires with POKéMON… That's the joy of being a TRAINER.
et: Rännata koos POKéMONidega sinna, kuhu süda ihkab… See ongi TRAINERI elu võlu.

label: Route120_Text_JennaIntro
en: How's your physical fitness? If you're not fit, you could have a rough time in critical situations.
et: Kuidas su füüsilise vormiga lood on? Kehvas vormis võid kriitilisel hetkel hätta jääda.

label: Route120_Text_JennaDefeat
en: I'm totally fit, but…
et: Ma olen täiesti vormis, aga…

label: Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle
en: Fitness training is in my routine. I always run with my POKéMON.
et: Trenn käib mul iga päev juurde. Jooksen alati koos oma POKéMONiga.

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyIntro
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Tahad võidelda?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyDefeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostBattle
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder…
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Ma pingutan rohkem…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRegister
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Do you have a POKéNAV…?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Kas sul on POKéNAV…?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchIntro
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … Want to battle again?
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Tahad jälle võidelda?

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyRematchDefeat
en: … … … … … … I lost again…
et: … … … … … … Ma kaotasin jälle…

label: Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch
en: … … … … … … … … … … … … I'll try harder… For my precious BUG POKéMON…
et: … … … … … … … … … … … … Ma pingutan rohkem… Oma kalli PUTUKA-POKéMONi nimel…

label: Route120_Text_JenniferIntro
en: POKéMON have many special abilities. If you want to become a first-class TRAINER, learn about them.
et: POKéMONidel on palju erivõimeid. Kui tahad tipp-TRAINERIKS saada, õpi neid tundma.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferDefeat
en: You're obviously thinking.
et: On näha, et sa mõtled peaga.

label: Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle
en: The special abilities of POKéMON will make battle styles change.
et: POKéMONide erivõimed muudavad kogu lahingustiili.

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
en: Who might you be?
et: Kes sina olla võiksid?

label: Route120_Text_ChipIntro
en: Are you perhaps searching for ancient ruins that are rumored to possibly exist according to legend?
et: Kas sa otsid ehk muistseid varemeid, mis legendi järgi kuskil siin olema peaksid?

label: Route120_Text_ChipDefeat
en: What a disgraceful setback…
et: Milline häbiväärne tagasilöök…

label: Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle
en: That giant rock… I would like to believe it may indeed contain ancient ruins. But I see no entrance.
et: See hiiglaslik kivi… Tahaksin uskuda, et selle sees peituvad tõesti muistsed varemed. Aga sissepääsu ma ei näe.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
en: Why am I carrying this parasol?
et: Miks ma seda päikesevarju kannan?

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro
en: I'll tell you if you can win against me.
et: Ütlen sulle, kui suudad mind võita.

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat
en: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON attacks…
et: Päikesevari ei suuda POKéMONide rünnakuid tõrjuda…

label: Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle
en: I don't think strong sunlight is good for my POKéMON. So I shield them with my parasol.
et: Kange päike ei tee mu POKéMONidele head. Seepärast varjan neid päikesevarjuga.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
en: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol…
et: Mina, POKéMON ja mu päikesevari…

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro
en: If any one of them is missing, the picture of beauty will be ruined.
et: Kui üks neist puudub, on kogu see ilupilt rikutud.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaDefeat
en: You've completely ruined my beauty…
et: Sa rikkusid mu ilu täielikult ära…

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
en: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.
et: Päikesevari ei sobiks sulle sugugi.

label: Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle
en: Why, something like this would only get in your way.
et: No selline asi ainult segaks sind.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoIntro
en: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON and create new ninja techniques.
et: Ma võtan POKéMONide liigutused üle ja loon uusi nindžakunste.

label: Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat
en: The creation of new ninja techniques is but a distant dream…
et: Uute nindžakunstide loomine on veel kauge unistus…

label: Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle
en: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under a ninja sensei.
et: Ehk peaksin minema mõne nindžameistri juurde õpipoisiks.

label: Route120_Text_RileyIntro
en: We ninja conceal ourselves under our camouflage cloaks. I bet you didn't know where I was!
et: Meie, nindžad, peidame end maskeerimiskeepide alla. Kihla vean, et sa ei aimanudki, kus ma olin!

label: Route120_Text_RileyDefeat
en: I lost! I should camouflage my shame!
et: Ma kaotasin! Peaksin oma häbi ära maskeerima!

label: Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle
en: Our camouflage cloaks are all handmade.
et: Meie maskeerimiskeebid on kõik käsitsi tehtud.

label: Route120_Text_CallieIntro
en: If you don't pay attention, you could get hurt!
et: Kui sa tähelepanelik ei ole, võid viga saada!

label: Route120_Text_CallieDefeat
en: Ouch! I was the one to get hurt.
et: Ai! Hoopis mina sain viga.

label: Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle
en: I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON? They're cute the way they are, though.
et: Huvitav… Kas lasta oma POKéMONidel areneda? Praegusena on nad ju nii armsad.

label: Route120_Text_LeonelIntro
en: Your party POKéMON… Do you have different types?
et: Sinu POKéMONid… Kas sul on seas eri tüüpe?

label: Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat
en: I've seen your policy in action!
et: Nägin su põhimõtet töös!

label: Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle
en: I think it's awesome you're so strong battling with your favorite POKéMON.
et: Minu meelest on äge, et sa oled oma lemmik-POKéMONidega nii tugev.

label: Route121_Text_VanessaIntro
en: Will you play with my delightfully pretty POKéMON?
et: Kas tuled mängima mu imekauni POKéMONiga?

label: Route121_Text_VanessaDefeat
en: This isn't what I meant!
et: Ma ei mõelnud seda niimoodi!

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
en: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.
et: Ma lähen LILYCOVE LINNA VÕISTLUSELE.

label: Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle
en: My POKéMON should have no problem sweeping the MASTER CLASS.
et: Mu POKéMON peaks MEISTRIJÄRGU mängleva kergusega ära võtma.

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
en: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners.
et: Koos oma POKéMONidega olen rännanud maailma kõikidesse otstesse.

label: Route121_Text_WalterIntro
en: You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.
et: Võib öelda, et oma võimetes olen ma üsna kindel.

label: Route121_Text_WalterDefeat
en: Ah, well played.
et: Ah, hästi mängitud.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle
en: I would like to circle the globe once again with my POKéMON.
et: Tahaksin koos oma POKéMONidega veel kord ümber maakera reisida.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRegister
en: Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable. Allow me to register you as a memento.
et: Su osavus POKéMONidega on tähelepanuväärne. Luba mul sind mälestuseks registreerida.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
en: With my POKéMON, I have traveled to the world's four corners.
et: Koos oma POKéMONidega olen rännanud maailma kõikidesse otstesse.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro
en: You might say I have some confidence in my abilities.
et: Võib öelda, et oma võimetes olen ma üsna kindel.

label: Route121_Text_WalterRematchDefeat
en: Ah, well played.
et: Ah, hästi mängitud.

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
en: Your POKéMON and you…
et: Su POKéMON ja sina…

label: Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch
en: Your prowess together will be considered strong, even overseas.
et: Teid kahte peetaks tugevaks isegi teisel pool merd.

label: Route121_Text_TammyIntro
en: There are powers beyond our understanding in the world…
et: Maailmas on jõude, mida me mõista ei suuda…

label: Route121_Text_TammyDefeat
en: I have lost…
et: Ma kaotasin…

label: Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle
en: MT. PYRE… There is a mysterious power at work there…
et: MT. PYRE… Seal mõjub salapärane jõud…

label: Route121_Text_KateIntro
en: KATE: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
et: KATE: Koos ei karda me midagi! Näitame sulle, kui kõvad me oleme!

label: Route121_Text_KateDefeat
en: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior student partner…
et: KATE: Ma vedasin alt oma noorema koolikaaslase ees…

label: Route121_Text_KatePostBattle
en: KATE: When someone's relying on me, I get this urge to look cool in front of them…
et: KATE: Kui keegi minu peale loodab, tahan ma tema ees kangesti lahe olla…

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
en: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON, we can't battle with you.
et: KATE: Kui sul on ainult üks POKéMON, ei saa me sinuga võidelda.

label: Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons
en: That would be bullying.
et: See oleks kiusamine.

label: Route121_Text_JoyIntro
en: JOY: Together, we're fearless! We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
et: JOY: Koos ei karda me midagi! Näitame sulle, kui kõvad me oleme!

label: Route121_Text_JoyDefeat
en: JOY: Please forgive me, KATE!
et: JOY: Palun andesta mulle, KATE!

label: Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle
en: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE, my senior student partner, again.
et: JOY: Ehehe, pean oma vanema koolikaaslase KATEGA jälle trenni tegema.

label: Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons
en: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON if you're going to challenge us!
et: JOY: Sul on vaja vähemalt kahte POKéMONi, kui kavatsed meile väljakutse esitada!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaIntro
en: Stop! Have a good look at my precious POKéMON!
et: Seis! Vaata hoolega mu kallist POKéMONi!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat
en: Oh, how dare you! Don't take it so seriously!
et: Oh, kuidas sa julged! Ära võta seda nii tõsiselt!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle
en: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
et: Ehk lähen SAFARISSE veel POKéMONe püüdma.

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRegister
en: I took it easy on you this time! It won't be that way the next time!
et: Seekord ma säästsin sind! Järgmine kord nii hästi ei lähe!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro
en: My precious POKéMON grew! Have a good look!
et: Mu kallis POKéMON on kasvanud! Vaata hoolega!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat
en: Oh, how dare you! You still won't take it easy!
et: Oh, kuidas sa julged! Sa ei säästa mind üldse!

label: Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch
en: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at the SAFARI.
et: Ehk lähen SAFARISSE veel POKéMONe püüdma.

label: Route121_Text_CristinIntro
en: I have this routine. Defeat five TRAINERS a day. Guess what? You're number five!
et: Mul on selline komme: alistada päevas viis TRAINERIT. Ja tead mis? Sina oled viies!

label: Route121_Text_CristinDefeat
en: No! You're horrid!
et: Ei! Sa oled kohutav!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle
en: I didn't expect to lose this easily… I'll win next time!
et: Ma ei oodanud, et nii kergesti kaotan… Järgmine kord võidan mina!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRegister
en: That was total humiliation! I won't forget you… Hand over your POKéNAV!
et: See oli täielik alandus! Ma ei unusta sind… Anna oma POKéNAV siia!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro
en: I have this new routine. Defeat ten TRAINERS a day. Guess what? You're number ten!
et: Mul on uus komme: alistada päevas kümme TRAINERIT. Ja tead mis? Sina oled kümnes!

label: Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat
en: Wait! That's nasty! I demand a rematch!
et: Oota! See on jälk! Ma nõuan revanši!

label: Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch
en: An opponent I just can't beat… Snivel… I can't believe this is happening…
et: Vastane, keda ma lihtsalt võita ei suuda… Nuuks… Ma ei suuda seda uskuda…

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
en: Can't you see that I have all this stuff with me?
et: Kas sa ei näe, et mul on kogu see kraam kaasas?

label: Route121_Text_CaleIntro
en: Despite that, you still insist that we battle?
et: Ja ikkagi tahad sa, et me võitleksime?

label: Route121_Text_CaleDefeat
en: Of course I lost! I'm holding stuff in both hands!
et: Muidugi ma kaotasin! Mul on mõlemad käed kraami täis!

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
en: I bought too much stuff at the LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.
et: Ostsin LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE poest liiga palju kraami.

label: Route121_Text_CalePostBattle
en: It's up the road from here. I wish I had a BAG like yours.
et: See on siit mööda teed ülespoole. Oleks mul ka selline KOTT nagu sinul.

label: Route121_Text_MylesIntro
en: There's nothing I love more than checking out other people's POKéMON!
et: Miski ei lähe mulle üle teiste inimeste POKéMONide uudistamise!

label: Route121_Text_MylesDefeat
en: Super awesome!
et: Ülimalt äge!

label: Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle
en: They're great, your POKéMON! How do you raise them?
et: Vahvad on su POKéMONid! Kuidas sa neid kasvatad?

label: Route121_Text_PatIntro
en: I want everybody to see the POKéMON I've raised!
et: Tahan, et kõik näeksid, millised POKéMONid ma olen kasvatanud!

label: Route121_Text_PatDefeat
en: Wow! Spectacular!
et: Ohoo! Vapustav!

label: Route121_Text_PatPostBattle
en: I raise every POKéMON with the same love and care--I don't pick favorites.
et: Ma kasvatan iga POKéMONi sama armastuse ja hoolega – ma ei vali lemmikuid.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelIntro
en: My POKéMON have never tasted defeat! On their next win, I'm entering them in CONTESTS.
et: Mu POKéMONid pole kunagi kaotust maitsnud! Järgmise võidu järel panen nad VÕISTLUSTELE.

label: Route121_Text_MarcelDefeat
en: Oh, now what happened here?
et: Oh, mis nüüd siin juhtus?

label: Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle
en: I may have to train my gang some more before entering any CONTEST.
et: Enne VÕISTLUSELE minekut peaksin oma kampa vist veel treenima.

label: Route123_Text_WendyIntro
en: Want to determine how strong you are? I'll be the test!
et: Tahad teada, kui tugev sa oled? Mina olen sulle proovikiviks!

label: Route123_Text_WendyDefeat
en: You passed with flying colors!
et: Sa läbisid katse hiilgavalt!

label: Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle
en: To best even me… Your strength is marvelous!
et: Isegi mind alistada… Su jõud on imekspandav!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
en: You seem to have a big collection of GYM BADGES.
et: Näib, et sul on juba kena kogu SAALIMÄRKE.

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro
en: Let me see if you're actually worthy of those BADGES!
et: Vaatame, kas sa neid MÄRKE tõesti väärid!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonDefeat
en: Oh, you're worthy, all right!
et: Oo, väärid küll, väärid!

label: Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle
en: You did your BADGES proud in that match!
et: Sa tegid oma MÄRKIDELE selles matšis au!

label: Route123_Text_VioletIntro
en: They say that good times are filled with good aromas.
et: Öeldakse, et head ajad on täis häid aroome.

label: Route123_Text_VioletDefeat
en: Oh… I smell the bitter scent of misery…
et: Oh… Ma tunnen viletsuse kibedat lõhna…

label: Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle
en: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled with uplifting fragrances.
et: BERRY MASTERI aed on täis ülendavaid lõhnu.

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
en: Being a psychic is about willpower.
et: Selgeltnägijaks olemine on tahtejõu asi.

label: Route123_Text_CameronIntro
en: I've willed myself not to lose to anyone. That makes me strong!
et: Olen endale sisendanud, et ma ei kaota kellelegi. See teebki mind tugevaks!

label: Route123_Text_CameronDefeat
en: I feel sad…
et: Mul on kurb…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle
en: Being a psychic is about willpower. I thought I wouldn't lose to you…
et: Selgeltnägijaks olemine on tahtejõu asi. Ma arvasin, et sulle ma ei kaota…

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
en: I sense it! You and I shall battle again! I can't tell if I'll win, though…
et: Ma aiman seda! Me võitleme veel! Kas ma võidan, seda ma küll ei näe…

label: Route123_Text_CameronRegister
en: Let's see your POKéNAV.
et: Lase näha su POKéNAVi.

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro
en: I've convinced myself that I won't lose anymore. That makes me strong!
et: Olen end veennud, et rohkem ma ei kaota. See teebki mind tugevaks!

label: Route123_Text_CameronRematchDefeat
en: I feel sad…
et: Mul on kurb…

label: Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch
en: I should train at MT. PYRE… I'll never beat you this way…
et: Peaksin MT. PYRE mäel treenima… Niimoodi ma sind iial ei võida…

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
en: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON develop psychic powers.
et: Ära rõõmusta liiga vara, kui su POKéMONidel tekivad vaimsed jõud.

label: Route123_Text_JackiIntro
en: You need to refine those powers to make them really useful.
et: Neid jõude tuleb lihvida, et neist ka tõelist kasu oleks.

label: Route123_Text_JackiDefeat
en: Overwhelmed!
et: Sa olid lihtsalt üle jõu!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle
en: We all have psychic powers. We've just forgotten how to use them.
et: Vaimsed jõud on meil kõigil. Me oleme lihtsalt unustanud, kuidas neid kasutada.

label: Route123_Text_JackiRegister
en: I would like to face you again. Is that okay with you?
et: Tahaksin sinuga veel kord vastamisi astuda. Kas sobib?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro
en: Have you awoken the psychic powers within you?
et: Kas oled endas vaimsed jõud üles äratanud?

label: Route123_Text_JackiRematchDefeat
en: Astounding!
et: Hämmastav!

label: Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch
en: Your power with POKéMON… That could be a psychic power, too.
et: Sinu vägi POKéMONidega… Ka see võib olla vaimne jõud.

label: Route123_Text_MiuIntro
en: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your POKéMON won't cry when they lose.
et: MIU: Tere, TRAINER. Ma loodan, et su POKéMONid ei nuta, kui kaotavad.

label: Route123_Text_MiuDefeat
en: MIU: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: MIU: Oh-oo, me kaotasime.

label: Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle
en: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are strong because you are friends.
et: MIU: TRAINER, su POKéMONid on tugevad, sest te olete sõbrad.

label: Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons
en: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
et: MIU: Pole lõbus võidelda, kui sul pole kahte POKéMONi.

label: Route123_Text_YukiIntro
en: YUKI: Okay! We're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!
et: YUKI: Nii! Me võidame selle TRAINERI POKéMONid ära!

label: Route123_Text_YukiDefeat
en: YUKI: Uh-oh, we lost.
et: YUKI: Oh-oo, me kaotasime.

label: Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle
en: YUKI: Why are you so strong? We've never lost before.
et: YUKI: Miks sa nii tugev oled? Me pole kunagi varem kaotanud.

label: Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons
en: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
et: YUKI: Pole lõbus võidelda, kui sul pole kahte POKéMONi.

label: Route123_Text_KindraIntro
en: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep… Will your POKéMON sleep?
et: MT. PYRE… Kus POKéMONide vaimud magavad… Kas su POKéMONid jäävad magama?

label: Route123_Text_KindraDefeat
en: Overflowing with vitality…
et: Sa lausa pakatad elujõust…

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
en: MT. PYRE… Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep…
et: MT. PYRE… Kus POKéMONide vaimud magavad…

label: Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle
en: It must overflow with a power that soothes spirits…
et: Seal peab voogama jõud, mis vaime rahustab…

label: Route123_Text_FernandoIntro
en: I'll turn your lights out while I rip through this tune!
et: Ma kustutan su tuled, kui ma selle loo maha mängin!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat
en: Hey, hold it! I was still playing the intro!
et: Kuule, oota! Ma alles mängisin sissejuhatust!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle
en: You're rock steady. I'd like to write a tune about you.
et: Sa oled kõigutamatu nagu kalju. Tahaks sinust loo kirjutada.

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRegister
en: The next time, lend your ears to the full tune, will you?
et: Järgmine kord kuula lugu lõpuni, eks?

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro
en: Today's the day I'm going to do it! I'll turn out your lights before I finish singing my song!
et: Täna see päev ongi! Ma kustutan su tuled enne, kui laul otsa saab!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat
en: Hey, hold it! I haven't even hit the chorus!
et: Kuule, oota! Ma pole veel refräänigi jõudnud!

label: Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch
en: I thought you'd be so enthralled by my tune, you'd lose.
et: Ma arvasin, et sa oled mu viisist nii lummatud, et kaotad.

label: Route123_Text_DavisIntro
en: This is my awesome BUG POKéMON! My big brother got it for me.
et: See on mu äge PUTUKA-POKéMON! Mu suur vend tõi selle mulle.

label: Route123_Text_DavisDefeat
en: Waaaah! You meanie!
et: Bääää! Sa oled õel!

label: Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle
en: Don't tell my brother I lost. You have to keep it a secret!
et: Ära ütle mu vennale, et ma kaotasin. Sa pead seda saladuses hoidma!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynIntro
en: My confidence will get a boost by beating someone obviously strong!
et: Kui alistan kellegi selgelt tugeva, kasvab mu enesekindlus kohe!

label: Route123_Text_JazmynDefeat
en: There goes my confidence…
et: Sinna ta läks, mu enesekindlus…

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
en: They say that you can't judge a person by their appearance.
et: Öeldakse, et inimest ei saa hinnata tema välimuse järgi.

label: Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle
en: But often, their looks don't lie…
et: Aga tihti välimus siiski ei peta…

label: Route123_Text_FrederickIntro
en: Hello, child! Can you spare some time?
et: Tere, laps! Kas sul leiaks hetk aega?

label: Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat
en: Ah, a mighty capable child! Let me contribute to your allowance.
et: Ah, tubli laps! Lase mul su taskuraha veidi täiendada.

label: Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle
en: Contribute to your allowance? Wasn't the prize money enough?
et: Taskuraha täiendada? Kas auhinnarahast ei piisanud?

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
en: I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON are my obsession!
et: Ma pean sulle ütlema, et LINNU-POKéMONid on mu kinnisidee!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro
en: Birds are cool! They're the best!
et: Linnud on lahedad! Nad on parimad!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat
en: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!
et: Isegi kaotuses on LINNU-POKéMONid lahedad!

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
en: I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that scatter during battles.
et: Ma kogun LINNU-POKéMONide sulgi, mis lahingute ajal laiali pudenevad.

label: Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle
en: I'm going to make a hat with BIRD POKéMON feathers.
et: Ma teen LINNU-POKéMONide sulgedest mütsi.

label: Route123_Text_EdIntro
en: When there are no TRAINERS around, I let my POKéMON battle each other. I watch them.
