et: Kui ühtki TRAINERit läheduses pole, lasen ma oma POKéMONidel üksteisega võidelda. Ma jälgin neid.

label: Route123_Text_EdDefeat
en: I kind of like your POKéMON.
et: Su POKéMON mulle kuidagi meeldib.

label: Route123_Text_EdPostBattle
en: Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas! I think they'll make me better.
et: Hehe, ma näppan su lahingunipid ära! Arvan, et need teevad minust parema.

label: Route123_Text_JonasIntro
en: I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has landed in my trap!
et: Ma olin varitsuses ja üks TRAINER kukkuski mu lõksu!

label: Route123_Text_JonasDefeat
en: If you don't lose, how am I supposed to have fun playing ninja?
et: Kui sina ei kaota, mis lõbu on mul siis nindžat mängida?

label: Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle
en: I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking TRAINER next time.
et: Järgmine kord varitsen mõnda nõrgema väljanägemisega TRAINERIT.

label: Route123_Text_KayleyIntro
en: I just bought this parasol. My cuteness should be up by a third!
et: Ma just ostsin selle päikesevarju. Mu armsus peaks kolmandiku võrra tõusma!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat
en: You're better than me by about five times!
et: Sa oled minust umbes viis korda parem!

label: Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle
en: Using accessories effectively is the secret behind fashion appeal.
et: Moeka välimuse saladus peitub oskuses aksessuaare kasutada.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
en: Hey, are you lost at sea?
et: Hei, kas oled merel ära eksinud?

label: Route124_Text_SpencerIntro
en: If you can beat my POKéMON, I can serve as your pilot.
et: Kui võidad mu POKéMONid ära, olen sulle teejuhiks.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat
en: I lost my bearings in battle!
et: Ma kaotasin lahingus suunataju!

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
en: Many people lose their bearings at sea.
et: Paljud inimesed kaotavad merel suunataju.

label: Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle
en: If you're that sort, you should refer to the POKéNAV's MAP.
et: Kui oled ka selline, vaata POKéNAVi KAARTI.

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
en: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead of swimming yourself…
et: Hm! Sa sõidad POKéMONi seljas, selle asemel et ise ujuda…

label: Route124_Text_RolandIntro
en: I am envious!
et: Ma olen kade!

label: Route124_Text_RolandDefeat
en: Oh! I can't…
et: Oh! Ma ei saa…

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
en: I'm getting chilled… I've been in the water too long…
et: Mul hakkab külm… Ma olen vees liiga kaua olnud…

label: Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle
en: I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…
et: Oleks minulgi POKéMON, kelle seljas sõita nagu sinul…

label: Route124_Text_JennyIntro
en: If you just float in the sea like this, POKéMON come around to play.
et: Kui niimoodi lihtsalt meres hulbid, tulevad POKéMONid mängima.

label: Route124_Text_JennyDefeat
en: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.
et: Oh, pagan. Võtsin ja kaotasin ära.

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
en: While swimming, I noticed that some POKéMON attack, and some just watch.
et: Ujudes märkasin, et mõned POKéMONid ründavad ja mõned lihtsalt vaatavad.

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle
en: I guess POKéMON have personalities of their own.
et: Vist on POKéMONidel igaühel oma iseloom.

label: Route124_Text_JennyRegister
en: It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get you to register me in your POKéNAV.
et: Puhtalt tuju pärast — äkki registreerid mu oma POKéNAVi?

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro
en: If you just float in the sea like this, TRAINERS challenge you!
et: Kui niimoodi lihtsalt meres hulbid, tulevad TRAINERID sulle väljakutset esitama!

label: Route124_Text_JennyRematchDefeat
en: That's strange… I lost again…
et: See on kummaline… Ma kaotasin jälle…

label: Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch
en: This has nothing to do with anything, but maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.
et: Pole sellega küll mingit seost, aga äkki lähen TRICK HOUSE majja.

label: Route124_Text_GraceIntro
en: I'm growing bored of swimming… How about a battle?
et: Mul hakkab ujumisest igav… Kuidas oleks lahinguga?

label: Route124_Text_GraceDefeat
en: I had no idea that you were this strong!
et: Mul polnud aimu, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: Route124_Text_GracePostBattle
en: All the effort you put in must have made you this strong.
et: Küllap oled sa nii tugev just tänu kogu sellele vaevale.

label: Route124_Text_ChadIntro
en: Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater to go deep under cover. Plumbing the depths is where I excel!
et: Fufufufu… Ma sukeldun sügavale vee alla, et jääda märkamatuks. Sügavused on just minu ala!

label: Route124_Text_ChadDefeat
en: Glub, glub, glub… I'm sinking…
et: Glub, glub, glub… Ma vajun…

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
en: I have it on good authority that there's a DIVE spot around here.
et: Usaldusväärsetel andmetel saab siin kandis kasutada võtet DIVE.

label: Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle
en: It gives me the urge to go deep again…
et: Kohe tahaks jälle sügavusse sukelduda…

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother!
et: Siin ma olen meres, aga kes on minuga? Mu väike vend!

label: Route124_Text_LilaIntro
en: Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on that!
et: Võitleme, et ma ei peaks sellele mõtlema!

label: Route124_Text_LilaDefeat
en: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost! You're in for it later!
et: LILA: ROY! See on sinu süü, et me kaotasime! Sa saad hiljem kõvasti kuulda!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle
en: If only it wasn't my little brother next to me, but a nice boyfriend…
et: Oleks mu kõrval väikevenna asemel kena poiss-sõber…

label: Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons
en: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.
et: LILA: Sa kavatsed meiega võidelda? Mitte enne, kui sul on kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
en: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on POKéMONidega kõva tegija!

label: Route124_Text_RoyIntro
en: Don't cry when you lose!
et: Ära nuta, kui kaotad!

label: Route124_Text_RoyDefeat
en: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out…
et: ROY: Oh-oo… Mu suur õde sõimab mu läbi…

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
en: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on tõesti hirmus, kui ta vihaseks saab.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle
en: That's why she doesn't have a boyfriend.
et: Just seepärast pole tal poiss-sõpra.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister
en: ROY: Will you battle with us again? But take it easy next time, okay?
et: ROY: Kas võitled meiega jälle? Aga võta järgmine kord rahulikult, eks?

label: Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons
en: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.
et: ROY: Kas tahtsid meiega võidelda? Too siis kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: Here I am in the sea, but who's with me? My little brother!
et: Siin ma olen meres, aga kes on minuga? Mu väike vend!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro
en: Oh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle so I won't have to dwell on things!
et: Oo, tere, ammu nähtud. Võitleme, et ma ei peaks sellele kõigele mõtlema!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
en: LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost again!
et: LILA: ROY! See on sinu süü, et me jälle kaotasime!

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat
en: We're having a training session later!
et: Meil on hiljem treening!

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
en: LILA: Sigh…
et: LILA: Ohh…

label: Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch
en: If I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat anyone with lovely combinations…
et: Oleks mul kena poiss-sõber, võidaksime kena koostööga kõiki…

label: Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons
en: LILA: You're planning to battle us? Not unless you have two POKéMON.
et: LILA: Sa kavatsed meiega võidelda? Mitte enne, kui sul on kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro
en: ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck. I'm going to go totally all out!
et: ROY: Kui me kaotame, saan ma pähe. Ma annan kõik, mis suudan!

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat
en: ROY: Uh-oh… My big sister will chew me out again.
et: ROY: Oh-oo… Mu suur õde sõimab mu jälle läbi.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
en: ROY: My big sister is really scary when she gets angry.
et: ROY: Mu suur õde on tõesti hirmus, kui ta vihaseks saab.

label: Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch
en: She's going to make me train really hard with POKéMON later…
et: Ta paneb mind hiljem POKéMONidega tõesti kõvasti treenima…

label: Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons
en: ROY: Did you want to battle us? Bring two POKéMON, then.
et: ROY: Kas tahtsid meiega võidelda? Too siis kaks POKéMONi.

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
en: Here I am swimming by my lonesome on this wide, beautiful sea.
et: Siin ma siis ujun üksipäini sellel avaral ilusal merel.

label: Route124_Text_DeclanIntro
en: There's no other word for it. This is pathetic!
et: Muud sõna selle kohta polegi. See on lihtsalt hale!

label: Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat
en: I'm feeling blue. Blue as the sky…
et: Mul on nukker meel. Sinine nagu taevas…

label: Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle
en: I should chat up lady SWIMMERS and invite them on a long swim.
et: Peaksin naissoost SWIMMERITEGA juttu tegema ja neid pikale ujumisele kutsuma.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro
en: I'm not going to lose to some surfer TRAINER.
et: Ma ei kavatse mingile surfarist TRAINERILE kaotada.

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat
en: I've only got sweat in my eyes! I am not crying!
et: Mul on lihtsalt higi silmis! Ma ei nuta!

label: Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle
en: You can find pretty colored shards of things around here.
et: Siin kandis leiab ilusaid värvilisi kilde.

label: Route125_Text_NolenIntro
en: I heard you approaching, so I hung around for you!
et: Kuulsin sind lähenemas ja jäin sind ootama!

label: Route125_Text_NolenDefeat
en: I surrender!
et: Ma alistun!

label: Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle
en: Sound travels faster in water than it does through air.
et: Heli liigub vees kiiremini kui õhus.

label: Route125_Text_StanIntro
en: Hey, there! Check out my sweet POKéMON!
et: Hei, sina seal! Vaata mu vahvat POKéMONi!

label: Route125_Text_StanDefeat
en: I floundered…
et: Ma siplesin…

label: Route125_Text_StanPostBattle
en: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm, so I started swimming, too.
et: HORSEA võlus mu ära ja nii hakkasin isegi ujuma.

label: Route125_Text_TanyaIntro
en: I'm tired of swimming. Are you up for a battle with me?
et: Ujumisest on mul kõrini. Kas oled valmis minuga võitlema?

label: Route125_Text_TanyaDefeat
en: You're too much!
et: Sa oled lihtsalt liiga hea!

label: Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle
en: Whew… Which way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?
et: Uhh… Kummas suunas on MOSSDEEP LINN?

label: Route125_Text_SharonIntro
en: How would you like to take on the WATER-type POKéMON I raised?
et: Kas tahad jõudu katsuda VEE-tüüpi POKéMONidega, keda ma olen kasvatanud?

label: Route125_Text_SharonDefeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin…

label: Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle
en: Your power… You're the real deal. I'm amazed!
et: Sinu jõud… Sa oled ehtne tegija. Ma olen jahmunud!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestIntro
en: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR! I've braved the world's seas!
et: Ahoi! Ma olen turjakas ja kõva SAILOR! Olen trotsinud maailma meresid!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestDefeat
en: Gwrroooar! I couldn't win!
et: Gwrroooar! Ma ei suutnud võita!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
en: The tide ebbs and flows inside the SHOAL CAVE.
et: SHOAL CAVE koopas vesi tõuseb ja mõõnab.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle
en: By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Did you know?
et: Muide, tõusust mõõnani läheb umbes kuus tundi. Kas teadsid?

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRegister
en: Register me in your POKéNAV, and I'll tell you something good.
et: Registreeri mind oma POKéNAVi ja ma ütlen sulle midagi head.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro
en: It's high time I get my payback from you! Come on, we're battling!
et: On viimane aeg sulle tasa teha! Tule, võitleme!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat
en: I couldn't win! I flat out couldn't win!
et: Ma ei suutnud võita! Ma lihtsalt ei suutnud võita!

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: The SHOAL CAVE…
et: SHOAL CAVE…

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: There are places you can and can't get to depending on the rise and fall of the tide.
et: Vesi tõuseb ja alaneb — mõnda kohta pääseb ainult õigel ajal.

label: Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle
en: By the way, it's about six hours from high tide to low tide. Don't forget!
et: Muide, tõusust mõõnani läheb umbes kuus tundi. Ära unusta!

label: Route125_Text_KimIntro
en: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE. Someone told me. Are you going to see him, too?
et: KIM: SHOAL CAVE koopas elab üks naljakas vanamees. Keegi rääkis mulle. Kas sinagi lähed teda vaatama?

label: Route125_Text_KimDefeat
en: KIM: I thought we would win.
et: KIM: Ma arvasin, et me võidame.

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
en: KIM: A funny old man lives in the SHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?
et: KIM: SHOAL CAVE koopas elab ju naljakas vanamees, kas pole?

label: Route125_Text_KimPostBattle
en: Let's go see him, IRIS!
et: Lähme teda vaatama, IRIS!

label: Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons
en: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON, or it's just no good!
et: KIM: Ei, ei, ei! Sul peab olema kaks POKéMONi, muidu ei tule midagi välja!

label: Route125_Text_IrisIntro
en: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're looking for out here?
et: IRIS: KIM, äkki ütled, mida me siin õieti otsime?

label: Route125_Text_IrisDefeat
en: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.
et: IRIS: Oh, me olime peaaegu kohal.

label: Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle
en: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into the SHOAL CAVE? We'll get all wet.
et: IRIS: KIM, kas me tõesti läheme SHOAL CAVE koopasse? Me saame üleni märjaks.

label: Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons
en: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do anything like a 2-on-1 battle.
et: IRIS: Oi ei, kahekesi ühe vastu me küll võidelda ei saa.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyIntro
en: Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me come out to the sea?
et: Miks küll minusugune BIRDKEEPER merele tuleb?

label: Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat
en: Okay. I'll tell you why I'm here.
et: Olgu. Ma ütlen sulle, miks ma siin olen.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
en: I put a message in a bottle and put it out to sea.
et: Ma panin sõnumi pudelisse ja lasin selle merre.

label: Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle
en: I'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will find it!
et: Olen kindel, et mõni tüdrukust SWIMMER selle leiab!

label: Route125_Text_AuronIntro
en: Hey! Was it you throwing garbage into the sea?
et: Hei! Kas see olid sina, kes prügi merre viskas?

label: Route125_Text_AuronDefeat
en: Oh, you weren't throwing trash into the sea.
et: Oh, sa ei visanud prahti merre.

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
en: I found an unsightly bottle bobbing in the waves earlier.
et: Leidsin äsja lainetel hüplemas ühe inetu pudeli.

label: Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle
en: It angers me that someone would pollute the sea!
et: Mind ajab marru, et keegi merd reostab!

label: Route126_Text_BarryIntro
en: Swimming is a full-body workout! You will get fit!
et: Ujumine paneb kogu keha tööle! Nii saab vormi!

label: Route126_Text_BarryDefeat
en: I admit it! You win!
et: Tunnistan! Sina võitsid!

label: Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle
en: Thanks to my daily swimming routine… Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!
et: Tänu igapäevasele ujumisele… Vaata! Naudi seda keha!

label: Route126_Text_DeanIntro
en: This towering white mountain of rock is SOOTOPOLIS CITY.
et: See kõrguv valge kaljumägi on SOOTOPOLIS LINN.

label: Route126_Text_DeanDefeat
en: I was done in?
et: Kas mind saadigi jagu?

label: Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle
en: I can't find the entrance to SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?
et: Ma ei leia SOOTOPOLIS LINNA sissepääsu. Kus see küll on?

label: Route126_Text_NikkiIntro
en: Ufufufufu! I'm a mermaid!
et: Ufufufufu! Ma olen merineitsi!

label: Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat
en: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble! Blub, blub, blub…
et: Mu unistus lõhkes nagu mull! Blub, blub, blub…

label: Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle
en: You thrashed me… I want to disappear in a wave of despair…
et: Sa tegid mu pihuks ja põrmuks… Tahaks meeleheitelainesse kaduda…

label: Route126_Text_BrendaIntro
en: Hello, kiddo! Want a battle with me?
et: Tere, põnn! Kas tahad minuga võidelda?

label: Route126_Text_BrendaDefeat
en: Oh, noooooh!
et: Oh, eiiiii!

label: Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle
en: I love frolicking with POKéMON in the sea like this!
et: Mulle meeldib niimoodi POKéMONidega meres hullata!

label: Route126_Text_PabloIntro
en: Check out this sculpted body! I'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!
et: Vaata seda voolitud keha! Mu lihased on kõvemad kui mõnel BLACK BELT võitlejal!

label: Route126_Text_PabloDefeat
en: Whoops! Too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!
et: Uups! Liiga tugev! Pole paha! Pole üldse paha!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle
en: Losing to you stimulated my senses! I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!
et: Sulle kaotamine turgutas mind! Treenin nüüd end ja oma POKéMONe veel kõvemini!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRegister
en: Yep, you're not bad at all! I'd like to get to know you more!
et: Jah, sa pole üldse paha! Ma tahaksin sind rohkem tundma õppida!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro
en: Check out this beautiful body! I'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!
et: Vaata seda kaunist keha! Ma olen vormikam kui mõni SWIMMER!

label: Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat
en: Whoops! Really too strong! Not bad! Not bad at all!
et: Uups! Tõesti liiga tugev! Pole paha! Pole üldse paha!

label: Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch
en: I'm going to train even harder! You're a great motivator! You have to come back again!
et: Hakkan veel kõvemini treenima! Sa annad mulle hoogu! Tule kindlasti tagasi!

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
en: I couldn't even swim last year, but now I'm a decent SWIMMER.
et: Ma ei osanud eelmisel aastal isegi ujuda, aga nüüd olen ma korralik SWIMMER.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro
en: I think I'm capable of anything now.
et: Ma arvan, et olen nüüd kõigeks võimeline.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat
en: Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do a thing for me.
et: Ptüi, ahnusest polnud mulle mingit kasu.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
en: If you practice at something, you will get better at it.
et: Kui midagi harjutad, muutud selles aina paremaks.

label: Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle
en: You're young--don't be afraid to try all sorts of things!
et: Sa oled noor – ära karda kõike järele proovida!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelIntro
en: If seawater gets up your nose, doesn't it feel terrible?
et: Kui merevesi ninna satub, kas pole see kohutav tunne?

label: Route126_Text_IsobelDefeat
en: Ack! Why, you… Glub!
et: Ähh! No sina küll… Glub!

label: Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle
en: Ooh, I choked on some water! It's bitter! It's salty!!
et: Ooh, ma tõmbasin vett kurku! See on mõru! See on soolane!!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaIntro
en: I'm throwing my whole heart into this!
et: Ma panen sellesse kogu oma südame!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaDefeat
en: You had more heart!
et: Sul oli rohkem südant!

label: Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle
en: I need to cool down now… I think I'll go for a dive.
et: Ma pean nüüd maha jahtuma… Ma vist lähen sukelduma.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenIntro
en: I can see it in your face. You want to challenge me.
et: Ma näen seda su näost. Sa tahad mulle väljakutse esitada.

label: Route127_Text_CamdenDefeat
en: Awawawawawa…
et: Awawawawawa…

label: Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle
en: A well-played match leaves me feeling refreshed and serene.
et: Hästi peetud matš jätab hinge värske ja rahuliku.

label: Route127_Text_DonnyIntro
en: Do you have a rival whom you just hate to lose against?
et: Kas sul on rivaal, kellele sa mitte mingi hinna eest kaotada ei taha?

label: Route127_Text_DonnyDefeat
en: Arrrgh! I hate losing!
et: Arrrgh! Ma vihkan kaotamist!

label: Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle
en: If you have a rival, don't you get the feeling that you have to keep getting better?
et: Kui sul on rivaal, kas sul ei teki tunne, et pead aina paremaks saama?

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
en: Through fishing, I have attained a state of becalmed serenity…
et: Kalapüük on toonud mu hinge täieliku rahu…

label: Route127_Text_JonahIntro
en: Please, allow me to demonstrate…
et: Luba mul seda sulle näidata…

label: Route127_Text_JonahDefeat
en: Though I have lost, my heart remains calm…
et: Kuigi ma kaotasin, jääb mu süda rahulikuks…

label: Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle
en: It matters not that I catch nothing. The line remains in the water…
et: Pole tähtis, et saaki pole. Õngenöör jääb vette…

label: Route127_Text_HenryIntro
en: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged a SURFING POKéMON?
et: Uups! Ega ma ometi haakinud õnge SURFIVAT POKéMONi?

label: Route127_Text_HenryDefeat
en: I can't keep up!
et: Ma ei jõua sulle järele!

label: Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle
en: It'd be a handful if I hooked your tough POKéMON!
et: Oleks omajagu tegemist, kui haakiksin su kõva POKéMONi!

label: Route127_Text_RogerIntro
en: Well, hey! This is a match between a POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!
et: No vaata! See on matš POKéMONi-fänni ja kalamehe vahel!

label: Route127_Text_RogerDefeat
en: No! My line's all tangled! The party's over!
et: Ei! Mu õngenöör on sassis! Pidu läbi!

label: Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle
en: My fishing line's doing a dance! The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!
et: Mu õngenöör tantsib! Sasitango! Hahaha, sõlm!

label: Route127_Text_AidanIntro
en: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision. They spot prey from great heights.
et: LINNU-POKéMONidel on suurepärane nägemine. Nad märkavad saaki suurelt kõrguselt.

label: Route127_Text_AidanDefeat
en: Whew… I give up.
et: Uhh… Ma annan alla.

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
en: There're lots of diving spots in the sea around here.
et: Siin kandi meres on palju sukeldumiskohti.

label: Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle
en: You can spot them easily from the sky because of their darker color.
et: Taevast paistavad nad tumedama värvi tõttu hästi välja.

label: Route127_Text_KojiIntro
en: Run in your bare feet. That will toughen up your soles!
et: Jookse paljajalu. See karastab su jalataldu!

label: Route127_Text_KojiDefeat
en: Yowch! I got a pebble under a toenail!
et: Auh! Kivike läks varbaküüne alla!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle
en: Going barefoot feels great. But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.
et: Paljajalu on hea käia. Aga sinu RUNNING SHOES on ka lahedad.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRegister
en: This is what I do to people who beat me! I hope we can do this again.
et: Nii ma teen kõigiga, kes mind võidavad! Loodan, et saame veel kord kokku.

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro
en: I still run in my bare feet daily. My soles are tough!
et: Ma jooksen ikka veel iga päev paljajalu. Mu jalatallad on kõvad!

label: Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat
en: Yowch! Pebbles dug into my arches!
et: Auh! Kivikesed puurisid end mu jalavõlvi!

label: Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch
en: Want to go barefoot for a while? So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?
et: Kas käiksid natuke paljajalu? Siis saaksin sinu RUNNING SHOES jalga proovida.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaIntro
en: We should have a slow and methodical match.
et: Me peaksime pidama aeglase ja metoodilise matši.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat
en: You didn't give me the chance to do any strategizing.
et: Sa ei jätnud mulle üldse aega strateegiat mõelda.

label: Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle
en: When I'm surrounded by the blue sea and sky, it feels as if time slows down.
et: Kui mind ümbritsevad sinine meri ja taevas, tundub, nagu aeg aeglustuks.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro
en: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways away…
et: EVER GRANDE LINNANI on veel pikk maa…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat
en: My first victory seems to be far away, too…
et: Näib, et ka mu esimene võit on kaugel…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle
en: My whole life has been about losing, but I will never give up!
et: Kogu mu elu on olnud üks kaotamine, aga alla ma ei anna!

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
en: I know I'm not good now, but I think I can win eventually.
et: Tean, et praegu ma hea pole, aga kunagi ma ikka võidan.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister
en: Please register me in your POKéNAV.
et: Palun registreeri mind oma POKéNAVi.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro
en: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on swimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.
et: Ma tunnen end ikka hästi. Ma ujun edasi EVER GRANDE LINNA.

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat
en: I've yet to taste my first victory…
et: Ma pole veel oma esimest võitu maitsnud…

label: Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch
en: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY where I can eventually win…
et: Ma jõuan lõpuks EVER GRANDE LINNA, kus ma lõpuks võita saan…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
en: You have to swim, cycle, and then run a marathon in a triathlon.
et: Triatlonis pead ujuma, rattaga sõitma ja siis maratoni jooksma.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynIntro
en: It's a grueling race that consists of three events.
et: See on kurnav võistlus, mis koosneb kolmest alast.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat
en: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…
et: POKéMON-lahing on ka kurnav…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle
en: I have to ride a BIKE next, but… I'm about to throw in the towel…
et: Järgmisena ootab BIKE, aga… Ma olen juba käega löömas…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRegister
en: Well, I may as well make the best of this. I'd like a rematch sometime.
et: Noh, võtan sellest siis parima. Tahaksin kunagi revanši.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro
en: A triathlon is long. But I guess the road to become the POKéMON CHAMPION is also a long and grueling one.
et: Triatlon on pikk. Aga küllap on ka tee POKéMON MEISTRIKS pikk ja kurnav.

label: Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat
en: A POKéMON battle really is harsh and unforgiving…
et: POKéMON-lahing on tõesti karm ja andestamatu…

label: Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch
en: You should give serious thought to challenges on VICTORY ROAD.
et: Sa peaksid tõsiselt mõtlema VICTORY ROAD katsumustele.

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
en: We've been working so hard to mount a POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…
et: Me oleme nii kõvasti pingutanud, et POKéMON LIIGASSE pääseda…

label: Route128_Text_AlexaIntro
en: We can't afford to lose now!
et: Me ei saa endale nüüd kaotust lubada!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaDefeat
en: Oh! How could this happen?!
et: Oh! Kuidas see juhtuda sai?!

label: Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle
en: After all I've done to get here, I won't give up after one setback.
et: Pärast kõike, mis ma siia jõudmiseks teinud olen, ei anna ma ühe tagasilöögi pärast alla.

label: Route128_Text_RubenIntro
en: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!
et: Pole tugevamat TRAINERit kui mina!

label: Route128_Text_RubenDefeat
en: This can't be!
et: See ei saa tõsi olla!

label: Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle
en: There probably is no stronger TRAINER than you!
et: Vist polegi sinust tugevamat TRAINERit!

label: Route128_Text_WayneIntro
en: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I caught myself a POKéMON that knows the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.
et: Tahan EVER GRANDE juurde minna, nii et püüdsin endale POKéMONi, kes oskab WATERFALLi — nii pääseb koskest üles.

label: Route128_Text_WayneDefeat
en: I'm crestfallen!
et: Ma olen norgus!

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
en: Awww, phooey!
et: Ohh, pläh!

label: Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle
en: My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
et: Mu POKéMON oskab WATERFALLi, aga mul pole SOOTOPOLIS SAALIMÄRKI!

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro
en: You're looking awfully tough. I wonder if I can win?
et: Sa näed hirmus kõva välja. Huvitav, kas ma üldse võidan?

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat
en: Ouch! I guess it was impossible to win.
et: Ai! Võita polnud vist mingit võimalust.

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
en: There are tough TRAINERS galore around EVER GRANDE.
et: EVER GRANDE ümbruses on kõvasid TRAINEREID küllaga.

label: Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle
en: Do you think I may be out of my league?
et: Kas ma olen sinu meelest lihtsalt liiga nõrk?

label: Route128_Text_CarleeIntro
en: The sunlight seems to be more harsh in this area.
et: Päike paistab siinkandis kuidagi kõrvetavamalt.

label: Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat
en: I couldn't see very well because of the sun's glare.
et: Päike pimestas mind, ma ei näinud korralikult.

label: Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle
en: I should go back soon. I need to reapply my sunscreen.
et: Peaksin varsti tagasi minema. Pean päikesekreemi uuesti peale määrima.

label: Route129_Text_ChaseIntro
en: This is my first triathlon. I'm all tense and nervous!
et: See on mu esimene triatlon. Ma olen üleni pinges ja närvis!

label: Route129_Text_ChaseDefeat
en: Wroooaaar! I failed to win!
et: Vrooaaar! Mul ei õnnestunud võita!

label: Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle
en: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to give it my all.
et: Kui ma olen krampis, ei suuda ma endast kõike anda.

label: Route129_Text_AllisonIntro
en: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but, sure, why don't we battle?
et: Mul on triatlon pooleli, aga olgu, võitleme pealegi!

label: Route129_Text_AllisonDefeat
en: I was sure I'd win!
et: Ma olin kindel, et võidan!

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
en: Do you know what's the greatest thing about triathlons?
et: Kas tead, mis on triatloni juures kõige ägedam?

label: Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle
en: Testing the limits of your own strength and endurance against Mother Nature!
et: Katsuda oma jõu ja vastupidavuse piire emakese looduse vastu!

label: Route129_Text_ReedIntro
en: Say hey, hey! Let's get on with it!
et: Kuule, hei! Hakkame pihta!

label: Route129_Text_ReedDefeat
en: Beat, I'm beaten. That's it, done!
et: Läbi, ma olen läbi. Ongi kõik!

label: Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle
en: There's nothing for a loser. Time for me to beat it home.
et: Kaotajale ei jää midagi. Aeg on kähku koju vupsata.

label: Route129_Text_TishaIntro
en: What's the hurry? Let's take it slow and easy.
et: Milleks kiirustada? Võtame aeglaselt ja rahulikult.

label: Route129_Text_TishaDefeat
en: Oh, my. I wanted to relax a little more…
et: Oh heldeke. Oleksin tahtnud veel veidi lõõgastuda…

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
en: Don't you hate making mistakes when you're in a rush?
et: Kas pole tüütu, kuidas kiirustades tulevad vead sisse?

label: Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle
en: That's why I try to take things slowly.
et: Just seepärast ma püüan asju aeglaselt võtta.

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro
en: Surfing isn't as easy as it seems, isn't that right?
et: Surfimine pole nii kerge, kui paistab, kas pole nii?

label: Route129_Text_ClarenceDefeat
en: Winning sure isn't easy.
et: Võitmine pole tõesti kerge.

label: Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle
en: You have your sights on the POKéMON LEAGUE? Keep at it!
et: Sa sihid POKéMON LIIGAT? Ära anna alla!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
en: What a surprise! I didn't expect to see a TRAINER out in the sea.
et: Milline üllatus! Ma ei osanud oodata, et kohtan keset merd TRAINERit.

label: Route130_Text_RodneyIntro
en: I think we should battle!
et: Ma arvan, et me peaksime võitlema!

label: Route130_Text_RodneyDefeat
en: This kid's awfully tough…
et: See laps on ikka hirmus kõva…

label: Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle
en: Your eyes have that look of someone who's experienced harsh challenges and won. It suits you well!
et: Su silmis on selle pilk, kes on karmid katsumused läbi teinud ja võitnud. See sobib sulle hästi!

label: Route130_Text_KatieIntro
en: In the deep blue sea, my shattered blue heart finds comfort among waves.
et: Sügavsinises meres leiab mu purustatud sinine süda lainete seas lohutust.

label: Route130_Text_KatieDefeat
en: Like the vast blue sea, the world of POKéMON spans depths beyond belief.
et: Nagu avar sinine meri, ulatub POKéMONide maailm uskumatute sügavusteni.

label: Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle
en: The world's children dream of one day becoming the POKéMON CHAMPION.
et: Kõik maailma lapsed unistavad, et neist saab ühel päeval POKéMON MEISTER.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro
en: Floating on the open sea like this… It's peaceful.
et: Niimoodi avamerel hulpida… See on nii rahulik.

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat
en: I needed to be a little less peaceful!
et: Ma oleksin pidanud olema veidi vähem rahulik!

label: Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle
en: Swimming and battling like this… I'm one happy guy…
et: Niimoodi ujuda ja võidelda… Ma olen üks õnnelik sell…

label: Route131_Text_RichardIntro
en: The sea is teeming with POKéMON. It's not easy swimming, I tell you.
et: Meri kubiseb POKéMONidest. Usu mind, kerge ujuda siin pole.

label: Route131_Text_RichardDefeat
en: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are seriously tough…
et: TRAINERITE kasvatatud POKéMONid on tõsiselt kõvad…

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: Gasp… Gasp… I'm wiped out…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Ma olen läbi…

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: The going's easy. It's the leaving that's the hard part.
et: Siia tulla on kerge. Raske on siit ära saada.

label: Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle
en: Will I have any energy left to make the return trip?
et: Kas mul jätkub üldse jõudu tagasiteeks?

label: Route131_Text_HermanIntro
en: The sea… The sea… The sea… The sea as far as these eyes can see! I'm sick and tired of the sea!
et: Meri… Meri… Meri… Meri nii kaugele kui need silmad näevad! Mul on merest kõrini!

label: Route131_Text_HermanDefeat
en: Bleah!
et: Ptüi!

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
en: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.
et: Igav on mul merest, aga ujuma pean.

label: Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle
en: I'm a born swimmer! That's what I am.
et: Ma olen sündinud ujuja! Seda ma olen.

label: Route131_Text_SusieIntro
en: Hi, sweetie, wait! We should battle, you and I!
et: Tere, kullake, oota! Me peaksime võitlema, sina ja mina!

label: Route131_Text_SusieDefeat
en: You're tough in spite of the way you look!
et: Sa oled oma välimusest hoolimata kõva!

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
en: Did you see a guy over there who whines that he's bored of the sea?
et: Kas nägid seal tüüpi, kes viriseb, et tal on merest igav?

label: Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle
en: That's all talk. He's hopelessly in love with the sea!
et: See on ainult jutt. Tegelikult on ta lootusetult merre armunud!

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
en: Why do men love bathing suits so much?
et: Miks mehed nii väga ujumistrikoosid armastavad?

label: Route131_Text_KaraIntro
en: They all ogle me!
et: Nad kõik jõllitavad mind!

label: Route131_Text_KaraDefeat
en: I'm out of my depth!
et: Ma olen üle pea vees!

label: Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle
en: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that makes men look. It must be my beauty!
et: Ehk polegi asi mu ujumistrikoos. Küllap see ongi mu ilu!

label: Route131_Text_ReliIntro
en: RELI: We'll work together as siblings to take you on!
et: RELI: Me astume sulle vastu koos — õde ja vend!

label: Route131_Text_ReliDefeat
en: RELI: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
et: RELI: Me ei suutnud võita, kuigi tegutsesime koos…

label: Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle
en: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are together with the sea and POKéMON from the time they are born.
et: RELI: PACIFIDLOGI rahvas elab mere ja POKéMONidega koos juba sünnist saati.

label: Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons
en: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON? We can't enjoy a battle, then.
et: RELI: Sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Siis pole lahingust rõõmu.

label: Route131_Text_IanIntro
en: IAN: I'm doing my best together with my sis!
et: IAN: Ma annan endast parima koos oma õega!

label: Route131_Text_IanDefeat
en: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but we still couldn't win…
et: IAN: Ma andsin oma õega endast parima, aga me ikka ei suutnud võita…

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
en: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is a floating town?
et: IAN: Tead ju, et PACIFIDLOG on hõljuv linn?

label: Route131_Text_IanPostBattle
en: So, wherever there is the sea, that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!
et: Nii et kus iganes on meri, see on osa PACIFIDLOGIST!

label: Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons
en: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll take you on!
et: IAN: Kui sul on kaks POKéMONi, siis astume sulle vastu!

label: Route131_Text_TaliaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I'll give you some great information!
et: Kui suudad mind võita, räägin sulle midagi ägedat!

label: Route131_Text_TaliaDefeat
en: Oh? Did I lose?
et: Oh? Kas ma kaotasin?

label: Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle
en: There is an odd place nearby. There's a huge tower there. Why don't you go take a look?
et: Siin lähedal on üks veider koht. Seal seisab hiiglaslik torn. Mine ikka vaata!

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
en: The people of PACIFIDLOG are a peaceful bunch.
et: PACIFIDLOGI rahvas on rahulik seltskond.

label: Route131_Text_KevinIntro
en: They never get angry. That goes for me, too.
et: Nad ei saa kunagi vihaseks. See kehtib ka minu kohta.

label: Route131_Text_KevinDefeat
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
en: Tch! …Oh, wait. I'm not angry. Honestly!
et: Tsäh! …Oh, oota. Ma pole vihane. Ausõna!

label: Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle
en: But, boy, you're strong! Hahaha!
et: Aga sina oled ikka tugev! Hahahaa!

label: Route132_Text_GilbertIntro
en: I used to catch colds all the time as a kid, but I became totally fit after I started swimming.
et: Lapsena olin ma pidevalt külmetunud, aga kui ujuma hakkasin, sain päris tugevaks.

label: Route132_Text_GilbertDefeat
en: I crave more power…
et: Ma ihkan rohkem jõudu…

label: Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle
en: TRAINERS travel the fields and mountains, so they must be fit, too.
et: TRAINERID rändavad üle väljade ja mägede, nii et nemadki peavad tugevad olema.

label: Route132_Text_DanaIntro
en: I try not to swim where the currents are too strong.
et: Ma püüan hoiduda kohtadest, kus vool on liiga tugev.

label: Route132_Text_DanaDefeat
en: Oh, please, no!
et: Oi ei, palun!

label: Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle
en: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my sense of place…
et: Kui vool mind minema kannab, kaotan ma igasuguse suunataju…

label: Route132_Text_RonaldIntro
en: Win or lose, you'll never know until you try!
et: Võit või kaotus — enne kui proovid, sa ei teagi!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldDefeat
en: Waah! I sank in defeat!
et: Vaah! Ma läksin põhja!

label: Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle
en: I never battle when I know I'll win. I like to battle at the razor's edge of victory and defeat!
et: Ma ei võitle kunagi siis, kui tean, et võidan. Mulle meeldib võidelda võidu ja kaotuse noateral!

label: Route132_Text_KiyoIntro
en: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day. How could you possibly beat me?
et: Ma mõtisklen POKéMONide üle 24 tundi ööpäevas. Kuidas sa saaksid mind võita?

label: Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat
en: I lose. I will concede defeat.
et: Ma kaotasin. Tunnistan lüüasaamist.

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
en: Urggh… You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?
et: Urggh… Sa oled POKéMONi-fanaatik, kas pole?

label: Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle
en: You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day, don't you?
et: Küllap sa mõtiskled POKéMONide üle 24 tundi ööpäevas, kas pole?

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro
en: I'm always with my husband, but I can win even without him.
et: Ma olen alati oma mehega koos, aga ma võidan ka ilma temata.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat
en: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.
et: Oh, ma vist polnud piisavalt hea.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
en: That young man over there looks just like my husband when he was young.
et: See noormees seal on täpselt nagu minu mees noorena.

label: Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle
en: He's making me blush!
et: Ta paneb mind punastama!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanIntro
en: Someone's been watching me intently. Was it you?
et: Keegi on mind tähelepanelikult jälginud. Kas see olid sina?

label: Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat
en: Wow! That's pretty strong, all right!
et: Ohoo! See on päris tugev küll!

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
en: I can't shake this feeling that someone's watching me.
et: Ma ei saa lahti tundest, et keegi mind jälgib.

label: Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle
en: I can't concentrate!
et: Ma ei suuda keskenduda!

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro
en: Now where could my wife have gone? I'm always with her. I wonder if I can win on my own.
et: Kuhu mu naine küll jäi? Ma olen alati temaga koos. Huvitav, kas ma üksi ka võidan.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat
en: Ah, I see that I couldn't manage to win on my own after all.
et: Ah, üksi ma siis ikka võita ei suutnudki.

label: Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle
en: My wife must be looking for me. I'd best go find her right away.
et: Küllap naine otsib mind juba taga. Parem ma lähen ta kohe üles otsima.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyIntro
en: I liked training here by myself. It's awful that all these people came!
et: Mulle meeldis siin üksinda treenida. Kohutav, et kõik need inimesed siia tulid!

label: Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat
en: Okay! I won't complain about other people being here.
et: Olgu! Ma ei kurda selle üle, et teised inimesed siin on.

label: Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle
en: I suppose I can partner up with that old man and challenge that other team.
et: Ma vist saan selle vanamehega paari lüüa ja teisele meeskonnale väljakutse esitada.

label: Route133_Text_FranklinIntro
en: Did the currents carry you here, too? This must have been fated. Let's battle!
et: Kas voolud tõid sinugi siia? See on vist saatus. Võitleme!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinDefeat
en: Strong! Too much so!
et: Tugev! Liiga tugev!

label: Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle
en: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER like you would drift here… I must be cursed…
et: Muidugi pidi just sinusugune kõva TRAINER siia triivima… Küllap olen ma neetud…

label: Route133_Text_DebraIntro
en: I've led a life of woe and misery… I've been cast away, and this is where I've drifted…
et: Mu elu on olnud üks häda ja viletsus… Mind heideti kõrvale ja siia ma triivisingi…

label: Route133_Text_DebraDefeat
en: Another loss…
et: Veel üks kaotus…

label: Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle
en: A life adrift… I don't want it anymore!
et: Triiviv elu… Ma ei taha seda enam!

label: Route133_Text_LindaIntro
en: Welcome! I've been expecting you!
et: Tere tulemast! Ma olen sind oodanud!

label: Route133_Text_LindaDefeat
en: No! Please!
et: Ei! Palun!

label: Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle
en: A strong child TRAINER… That's so annoying!
et: Tugev TRAINER, kes on alles laps… See on nii tüütu!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenIntro
en: I want to win like everyone else, but I won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.
et: Ma tahan võita nagu kõik teised, aga ma ei kasvata POKéMONe nagu kõik teised.

label: Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat
en: Darn it! My way is still too slack!
et: Pagan! Mu moodus on ikka veel liiga lodev!

label: Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle
en: It's way more fun to do things the way I want than to be like everybody else. I mean, that's obvious!
et: Palju lõbusam on teha asju omamoodi kui olla nagu kõik teised. No see on ju ilmselge!

label: Route133_Text_BeckIntro
en: I came all the way out here with my BIRD POKéMON.
et: Ma tulin oma LINNU-POKéMONiga terve selle tee siia.

label: Route133_Text_BeckDefeat
en: You… You're stunningly cool!
et: Sa… Sa oled jahmatavalt lahe!

label: Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle
en: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've grown to like this place, too.
et: Ma tahaksin FORTREESSE tagasi minna, aga see koht on mulle ka armsaks saanud.

label: Route133_Text_MollieIntro
en: I must have battled thousands of times. I've lost count.
et: Olen vist tuhandeid kordi võidelnud. Arv on ammu kaduma läinud.

label: Route133_Text_MollieDefeat
en: I may have lost thousands of times, but a loss still stings.
et: Olen ehk tuhandeid kordi kaotanud, aga kaotus teeb ikka haiget.

label: Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle
en: Keep at this, youngster. So you can become like my husband and me.
et: Pea vastu, nooruke. Siis saad ükskord minu ja mu mehe moodi.

label: Route133_Text_ConorIntro
en: Young people are too happy to go with the flow. They're without direction.
et: Noored lasevad end liiga meelsasti vooluga kaasa kanda. Neil pole mingit sihti.

label: Route133_Text_ConorDefeat
en: You have a firm sense of purpose.
et: Sul on kindel siht silme ees.

label: Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle
en: Don't let others lead you astray. Don't lose direction as you grow older.
et: Ära lase teistel end eksiteele viia. Ära kaota suunda, kui vanemaks saad.

label: Route134_Text_JackIntro
en: Even those POKéMON that can swim are carried along by the rapid currents.
et: Isegi neid POKéMONe, kes ujuda oskavad, kannavad kiired voolud kaasa.

label: Route134_Text_JackDefeat
en: Aiyeeeeh!
et: Aiiiih!

label: Route134_Text_JackPostBattle
en: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running currents around these parts.
et: Ma arvan, et POKéMONid naudivad siinkandi kiireid voole.

label: Route134_Text_LaurelIntro
en: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun match. Will you join us?
et: Mu LUVDISC otsivad lõbusat lahingut. Kas lööd kaasa?

label: Route134_Text_LaurelDefeat
en: Oopsie!
et: Uupsuke!

label: Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle
en: There's a collector who's after the SCALES of LUVDISC.
et: Üks koguja jahib LUVDISCi SOOMUSEID.

label: Route134_Text_AlexIntro
en: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang! It's time for a match!
et: Olgu-olgu! Puhkus läbi, kamp! Nüüd on lahingu aeg!

label: Route134_Text_AlexDefeat
en: Tuckered out again…
et: Jälle läbi…

label: Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle
en: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after a long flight…
et: Mu LINNU-POKéMONid väsivad pärast pikka lendu kiiresti…

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER. No need for words. We battle now.
et: Sa oled POKéMON TRAINER. Sõnu pole vaja. Võitleme kohe.

label: Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle
en: It was I who challenged you, and yet I lost. I am deeply shamed…
et: See olin mina, kes sulle väljakutse esitas, ja ometi ma kaotasin. Mul on sügavalt häbi…

label: Route134_Text_AaronIntro
en: The savage tide in this area serves to make us stronger than ever.
et: Siinkandi metsik tõus teeb meid tugevamaks kui iial enne.

label: Route134_Text_AaronDefeat
en: I willingly concede defeat.
et: Ma tunnistan lüüasaamist meelsasti.

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
en: We will return for more training at METEOR FALLS.
et: Me läheme METEOR FALLSI tagasi edasi treenima.

label: Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle
en: If you'd like, you should go, too. It will definitely toughen you up!
et: Kui soovid, peaksid sinagi minema. See karastab sind kindlasti!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinIntro
en: O-our boat! The tide carried it away!
et: Meie… meie paat! Tõus kandis selle minema!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinDefeat
en: Awawawawah! Please, stop! Please!
et: Avavavavah! Palun, lõpeta! Palun!

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
en: If we can't SURF, how are we supposed to get home?
et: Kui me ei saa SURFida, kuidas me siis koju saame?

label: Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle
en: Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON can still SURF, but it feels wrong.
et: Tegelikult ma tean, et minestanud POKéMON saab ikka SURFida, aga see tundub vale.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyIntro
en: Can your POKéMON dodge our lightning-quick attacks?
et: Kas su POKéMON suudab vältida meie välkkiireid rünnakuid?

label: Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat
en: I never knew such a technique existed! You've defeated us thoroughly.
et: Ma ei teadnudki, et selline tehnika olemas on! Sa alistasid meid täielikult.

label: Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle
en: I haven't lost my passion for speed. I will try harder.
et: Ma pole kaotanud oma kirge kiiruse vastu. Ma pingutan rohkem.

label: Route134_Text_ReynaIntro
en: My POKéMON can't be taken down easily!
et: Minu POKéMONe ei murra niisama kergelt!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat
en: You're kidding! Explain how I lost!
et: Sa teed nalja! Seleta, kuidas ma kaotasin!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
en: Haha! You won, all right!
et: Haha! Sa võitsid küll!

label: Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle
en: I'll work my way back up by taking on TRAINERS I happen to meet!
et: Ma närin end tagasi tippu ja astun vastu igale TRAINERILE, keda kohtan!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonIntro
en: Listen, have you seen another SAILOR around here?
et: Kuule, kas sa oled siinkandis mõnda teist SAILORit näinud?

label: Route134_Text_HudsonDefeat
en: Now, that's something!
et: Vaat see on midagi!

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
en: Our boat drifted out to sea.
et: Meie paat triivis merele.

label: Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle
en: My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm worried about him.
et: Mu semu on arglik sell, nii et ma muretsen tema pärast.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: Oh, hello! You were in a POKéMON CONTEST, weren't you? It's easy to tell from your POKéMON.
et: Oh, tere! Sa käisid POKéMON VÕISTLUSEL, kas pole? Su POKéMONi järgi on see kohe näha.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: I'm a reporter. I'm working on a story on POKéMON CONTESTS.
et: Ma olen reporter. Ma teen lugu POKéMON VÕISTLUSTEST.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: If I may, would you be willing to answer a few questions?
et: Kui tohin, kas oleksid nõus paarile küsimusele vastama?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
en: Oh, you will? Thank you.
et: Oh, oled nõus? Aitäh.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_DescribeContest
en: Briefly, how would you describe the CONTEST you just entered?
et: Lühidalt — kuidas sa kirjeldaksid VÕISTLUST, kus sa just osalesid?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: Ah, I see. That's a very edifying comment.
et: Ah, selge. Väga õpetlik kommentaar.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: You get a good feel for what the CONTEST was like.
et: Selle põhjal saab hea ettekujutuse, milline VÕISTLUS oli.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: I've got one last question.
et: Mul on üks viimane küsimus.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhatImageWhenYouHearX
en: When you hear the word “{STR_VAR_2},” what image do you get?
et: Kui kuuled sõna „{STR_VAR_2}”, milline kujutluspilt sul tekib?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: I see!
et: Ah nii!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: So that's how you imagine the concept of “{STR_VAR_2}” to be.
et: Nii sa siis kujutadki ette mõistet „{STR_VAR_2}”.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: Thank you! You've given me some good ideas.
et: Aitäh! Sa andsid mulle mõne hea mõtte.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: I think I can write a good story on POKéMON CONTESTS now.
et: Ma arvan, et suudan nüüd kirjutada hea loo POKéMON VÕISTLUSTEST.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ThatsAllForInterview
en: Maybe, just maybe, this story will even make it to television. I hope you'll look forward to it!
et: Võib-olla, ainult võib-olla, jõuab see lugu isegi telekasse. Loodetavasti ootad seda pikisilmi!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
en: Oh, too bad…
et: Oh, kahju…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDoShareStoryWithMe
en: Well, if you come across a good story, please do share it with me.
et: Noh, kui sul mõni hea lugu ette juhtub, räägi see kindlasti mulle ära.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LookingForwardToNextContest
en: I'll be looking forward to your next POKéMON CONTEST.
et: Ma ootan su järgmist POKéMON VÕISTLUST pikisilmi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: Hello! You're the TRAINER who just had a battle, right?
et: Tere! Sa oled TRAINER, kel just lahing oli, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: I'm gathering interviews with TRAINERS all over the place.
et: Ma kogun igalt poolt TRAINERITE intervjuusid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_InterviewRequest
en: May I get a few words from you about your impressions on battling?
et: Kas räägiksid mulle paari sõnaga oma muljetest lahingust?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
en: You will? Really? Thank you! Then, uh…
et: Oled nõus? Tõesti? Aitäh! Siis, öö…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
en: How did things turn out in the BATTLE TOWER today?
et: Kuidas asjad täna BATTLE TOWERIS välja kukkusid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_HowDidBattleTowerTurnOut
en: Were you satisfied with the battle? Or are you unhappy?
et: Kas olid lahinguga rahul? Või oled õnnetu?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SorryWeDisturbedYou
en: Oh… Sorry we disturbed you.
et: Oh… Vabandust, et sind häirisime.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SorryWeDisturbedYou
en: Please give us an interview the next time you visit the BATTLE TOWER.
et: Anna meile intervjuu järgmine kord, kui BATTLE TOWERISSE tuled.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
en: Well, of course!
et: Noh, muidugi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
en: That unmistakable look of satisfaction on your face…
et: See eksimatu rahulolu su näol…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ObviousYouHadGreatBattle
en: It's obvious that you've had a great battle.
et: On ilmselge, et sul oli suurepärane lahing.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned
en: Oh, I see…
et: Ah, selge…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DifficultToMakeBattleTurnOutAsPlanned
en: Well, it certainly is difficult to make a battle turn out exactly as planned.
et: Noh, lahingut on tõesti raske täpselt plaanipäraselt läbi viia.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle
en: Oh, oh, may I ask one more question?
et: Oh, oh, kas tohin veel üht asja küsida?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_DescribeYourBattle
en: If you were to describe your impressions about this battle with one saying, what would it be?
et: Kui sa peaksid oma muljed sellest lahingust ühe ütlusega kokku võtma, mis see oleks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine
en: Oh, that is stunningly cool!
et: Oh, see on jahmatavalt lahe!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine
en: That's a great line! I hope you'll do great next time, too.
et: See on suurepärane lause! Ma loodan, et sul läheb järgmine kord ka suurepäraselt.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ThatsGreatLine

en: SAFARI FAN CLUB!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText00
en: REPORTER: All right, mates! Tossing them SAFARI BALLS, are you?

label: gTVSafariFanClubText00
en: You can bet I am here in the SAFARI ZONE chock-full of amazing POKéMON!
et: Mina olen siin SAFARI ZONE alal, kus hämmastavaid POKéMONe on pilgeni täis!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText00
en: Let's get with it and have a chat with this good fellow of a SAFARI GUIDE!
et: Asume asja juurde ja ajame juttu selle tubli SAFARI GIIDIGA!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText00
en: All right, mate, how are the visiting TRAINERS looking?
et: Noh, sõber, kuidas siinsed TRAINERID välja näevad?

label: gTVSafariFanClubText01
en: GUIDE: Everyone seems to be going hard at it.
et: GIID: Paistab, et kõik pingutavad kõvasti.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText01
en: {STR_VAR_1} is doing especially well.
et: Eriti hästi läheb TRAINERIL {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText01
en: Why, before, {STR_VAR_1} caught {STR_VAR_2} POKéMON.
et: Just enne püüdis {STR_VAR_1} lausa {STR_VAR_2} POKéMONi.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText02
en: The TRAINER is clever with {POKEBLOCK}S. Used {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.
et: TRAINER oskab {POKEBLOCK}idega nutikalt ümber käia. Vist kasutas tol korral just {STR_VAR_2}.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText03
en: The TRAINER didn't use a single {POKEBLOCK}! Not a one!
et: TRAINER ei kasutanud ainsatki {POKEBLOCK}i! Mitte ühtegi!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText03
en: There's an expert for you.
et: Vaat see on alles asjatundja.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText04
en: REPORTER: Is that right, then?
et: REPORTER: Ah nii või?

label: gTVSafariFanClubText04
en: Sounds like our mate {STR_VAR_1} is a stout SAFARI master!
et: Kõlab nii, nagu oleks meie sõber {STR_VAR_1} tõeline SAFARI meister!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText04
en: GUIDE: I hope the TRAINER comes back and shows us that great technique.
et: GIID: Loodan, et TRAINER tuleb tagasi ja näitab meile veel seda vahvat oskust.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText05
en: GUIDE: No one seems to be doing very well.
et: GIID: Paistab, et kellelgi ei lähe eriti hästi.

en: {STR_VAR_1} had it especially bad.
et: Kõige kehvemini läks TRAINERIL {STR_VAR_1}.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText07
en: The TRAINER does use {POKEBLOCK}S. Used {STR_VAR_2} that time, I think.
et: {POKEBLOCK}e TRAINER küll kasutab. Vist kasutas tol korral just {STR_VAR_2}.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText07
en: But, boy, I wish the TRAINER would get a bit better at this.
et: Aga oh, kui TRAINER ometi selles veidi osavamaks saaks.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText08
en: I think the TRAINER would have better luck using {POKEBLOCK}S, which weren't used at all that time.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText09
en: REPORTER: Is that right, then?
et: REPORTER: Ah nii või?

label: gTVSafariFanClubText09
en: Sounds like our mate {STR_VAR_1} needs more SAFARI seasoning.
et: Kõlab nii, nagu vajaks meie sõber {STR_VAR_1} veel SAFARI kogemust.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText09
en: GUIDE: I hope the TRAINER visits over and over to get the hang of it.
et: GIID: Loodan, et TRAINER käib siin ikka ja jälle, kuni asjale pihta saab.

label: gTVSafariFanClubText10
en: REPORTER: Quite right, it is! Facing up to challenges is important!
et: REPORTER: Täpselt nii! Tähtis on end proovile panna!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText10
en: Viewers, come on down to the SAFARI and make the challenge yourself!
et: Vaatajad, tulge ka ise SAFARISSE ja pange end proovile!

label: gTVSafariFanClubText10
en: Until next time, cheerio!
et: Järgmise korrani — head aega!

et: {STR_VAR_2} oli võte, mille TRAINER meie lahingus viimasena kasutas.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText03
en: The move {STR_VAR_2} is {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_3}'s sign of friendship!
et: Võte {STR_VAR_2} on {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_3} sõpruse märk!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: …I lost confidence in myself as a result of our encounter.
et: …Pärast seda kohtumist kadus mul endasse usk.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: We were beaten before we could launch a single attack. Ohhh… Snivel…
et: Meid löödi puruks, enne kui jõudsime ainsatki rünnakut teha. Ohhh… Nuuks…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: In spite of that, {PLAYER}'s battles are worth seeing.
et: Sellest hoolimata tasub {PLAYER} lahinguid vaadata.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText04
en: I recommend confident TRAINERS to challenge {PLAYER}.
et: Soovitan enesekindlatel TRAINERITEL {PLAYER} välja kutsuda.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: There's only one thing to be said. Don't you dare throw a POKé BALL during a TRAINER battle!
et: Üht asja tuleb siiski öelda. Ära julge TRAINERI lahingu ajal POKé PALLI visata!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: {PLAYER} is certainly strong, but has no clue about the basic rules.
et: {PLAYER} on küll tugev, aga põhireeglitest pole tal aimugi.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: To our TV audience, I have a request.
et: Mul on meie vaatajatele üks palve.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText05
en: If you see {PLAYER}, please caution the TRAINER!
et: Kui näete {PLAYER}, siis palun hoiatage seda TRAINERIT!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
en: {PLAYER} is adept at reading the opponent's actions.
et: {PLAYER} oskab vastase käike hästi ette aimata.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText06
en: The timing of item usage was remarkably effective!
et: Esemeid kasutati tähelepanuväärselt õigel hetkel!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: Honestly speaking, I thought that I might even be pretty good.
et: Ausalt öeldes arvasin, et olen ka ise päris hea.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: While we did end up losing, we did have a hotly contested battle.
et: Kaotasime küll, aga lahing oli tuline.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText07
en: But if you're struggling against me, you have a ways to go, {PLAYER}!
et: Aga kui sul on minu vastu raske, siis on sul veel tükk maad minna, {PLAYER}!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: After our battle, we asked {PLAYER} for a succinct summary.
et: Pärast lahingut palusime, et {PLAYER} teeks lühikese kokkuvõtte.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: The TRAINER replied, “{STR_VAR_1}.”
et: TRAINER vastas: „{STR_VAR_1}.”

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: {PLAYER}'s POKéMON {STR_VAR_2} and {STR_VAR_3}… And “{STR_VAR_1}”…
et: {PLAYER} POKéMONid {STR_VAR_2} ja {STR_VAR_3}… Ja „{STR_VAR_1}”…

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: Mmm! That's deep! There's deep significance behind that quote!
et: Mmm! Sügav! Selle lause taga peitub sügav mõte!

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: It's no surprise--a good TRAINER has good things to say.
et: Pole ime — heal TRAINERIL on head sõnad varuks.

label: gTVInSearchOfTrainersText08
en: That's all for today! See you again on our next broadcast!
et: Tänaseks kõik! Kohtume järgmises saates!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
et: WATTSON, MAUVILLE SAALI JUHT, kasutab ELEKTRI-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you challenge him with WATER-type POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!
et: Kui lähed talle VEE-tüüpi POKéMONidega vastu, saavad nad säru! Bzzt!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And, he's put in switch-controlled doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!
et: Ja ta on terve SAALI täis pannud lülititega uksi! Veidrik!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, go for it!
et: Hei, anna minna!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoa, you're electrifying! You've powered the door open!
et: Ohoo, sa oled lausa elektriseeriv! Said ukse vooluga lahti!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro
en: My electric soul, it'll shatter your dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
et: Mu elektrihing purustab su unistused, ohoo-jeeah!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat
en: That was plugged in, amped up, over-driven electric, man!
et: See oli sisse lülitatud, võimendatud ja üle keeratud elekter, mees!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle
en: POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart, whoa-yeah!
et: POKéMONid ja rokk — kõik käib südamest, ohoo-jee!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro
en: I trained under WATTSON! There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
et: Ma õppisin WATTSONI käe all! Nii kergelt ma küll ei kaota!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat
en: Unplugged and turned off…
et: Juhe seinast ja tuli kustu…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been around for a long, long time.
et: WATTSON, meie SAALI JUHT, on siin olnud juba väga-väga kaua.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle
en: He was battling even before your daddy was born, that tough coot.
et: See vana sitke mees võitles juba enne, kui su isa sündis.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro
en: This GYM's got puzzles! Isn't it fun?
et: Selles SAALIS on mõistatused! Kas pole lõbus?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenDefeat
en: It's no fun to lose…
et: Kaotada pole sugugi lõbus…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle
en: WATTSON says he likes setting up little traps with switches.
et: WATTSON ütleb, et talle meeldib lülititega väikeseid lõkse sättida.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro
en: With my charm and my POKéMON's moves, you'll be shocked!
et: Minu võlu ja mu POKéMONide võtted panevad su lausa võpatama!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat
en: I'm shocked by your power!
et: Sinu jõud lõi mind pahviks!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded by WATTSON.
et: Olen kuulnud, et MAUVILLE LINNA rajas WATTSON.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle
en: He was a TRAINER long before we became TRAINERS. He must know all sorts of things!
et: Ta oli TRAINER ammu enne, kui meie TRAINERITEKS saime. Küll tema teab igasuguseid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro
en: I love shiny things!
et: Mulle meeldivad läikivad asjad!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloDefeat
en: Oh… My eyes are frazzled…
et: Oh… Mul on silmad läbi…

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle
en: MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny forehead. It makes me happy!
et: MAUVILLE SAALI WATTSONIL on läikiv laup. See teeb mind rõõmsaks!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: I've given up on my plans to convert the city, I have.
et: Oma plaanidest linn ümber teha olen ma loobunud, jah.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: And so, I put my time into making door traps in my GYM.
et: Ja nii panengi ma oma aja SAALI uksepüüniste ehitamisse.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Oh? Now, what are you doing here?
et: Ohoo? Ja mis sina siin teed?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: What's that? You say you've gotten past all my rigged doors?
et: Mis asja? Sa ütled, et said kõigist mu kavaldatud ustest läbi?

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Wahahahah! Now, that is amusing!
et: Vahahahaa! Vaat see on alles lõbus!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro
en: Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
et: Siis annan mina, WATTSON, MAUVILLE SAALI JUHT, sulle korraliku laengu!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: Wahahahah! Fine, I lost!
et: Vahahahaa! Hüva, ma kaotasin!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat
en: You ended up giving me a thrill! Take this BADGE!
et: Sa pakkusid mulle tõelist põnevust! Võta see MÄRK!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadge

et: {PLAYER} sai WATTSONILT märgi DYNAMO BADGE.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can use ROCK SMASH out of battle.
et: Märgiga DYNAMO BADGE saavad POKéMONid kasutada ROCK SMASH ka väljaspool lahingut.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: And, it will make your POKéMON a little bit faster, too.
et: Ja see teeb su POKéMONid ka veidi kiiremaks.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadgeTakeThis
en: Hmm… You should take this, too!
et: Hmm… Võta ka see!

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.
et: Seal TM34 sees on SHOCK WAVE.

label: MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave
en: It's a trustworthy move that never misses! You can count on it!
et: See on kindel võte, mis kunagi mööda ei lähe! Sellele võib loota!

en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy!
et: GRETA: Hei! Tervist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureChallenger
en: …Wait, are you the challenger?
et: …Oota, kas sina oledki väljakutsuja?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IsThatRight
en: Is that right? Hmm… Hmhm…
et: Ah nii või? Hmm… Hmhm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: I don't know how to say it, but… To put it bluntly, you look pretty weak. Are you sure you're up for me?
et: Ma ei tea, kuidas seda öelda, aga… Otse öeldes näed sa üsna nõrk välja. Kas oled kindel, et saad minuga hakkama?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_YouLookWeakTakeThingsEasy
en: Well, all right! We'll take things easy to start with!
et: No hüva! Alustame siis rahulikult!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IgniteMyPassionForBattle
en: Okay! Let's see you ignite my passion for battle!
et: Olgu! Vaatame, kas sa suudad mu võitlusiha lõkkele puhuda!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: GRETA: Ow, wait a second! You are tough after all!
et: GRETA: Oih, oota natuke! Sa oledki kõva tegija!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaYoureToughAfterAll
en: I like you! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: Sa meeldid mulle! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedGutsSymbol
en: The Guts Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: FRONTIER PASSile pressiti Guts-sümbol!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GoingToBeFunNextTime
en: It's going to be fun the next time! I'm looking forward to it!
et: Järgmine kord tuleb alles lõbus! Ma juba ootan seda!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: GRETA: Hey! Howdy! You finally won your way up to me!
et: GRETA: Hei! Tervist! Võitlesid end lõpuks minuni välja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaLookingForwardToSeeingAgain
en: I was getting worried waiting for you! I was really looking forward to seeing you again!
et: Ma juba hakkasin sind oodates muretsema! Ootasin tõesti pikisilmi, et sind jälle näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_SoAreYouReady
en: … … … So, are you ready?
et: … … … Niisiis, kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_WontAllowHalfheartedEffort
en: I won't allow a halfhearted effort! Be ready for a thrashing!
et: Poolikut pingutust ma ei salli! Valmistu keretäieks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_LetsGetThisStarted
en: Come on, REFEREE! Let's get this started!
et: Tule, KOHTUNIK! Alustame!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GretaBlownAway
en: GRETA: Gaaah! Blown away! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS!
et: GRETA: Aaah! Mind pühiti minema! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_GutsSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Guts Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Guts-sümbol hakkas kuldselt särama!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: Arrrgh! This is so infuriating!
et: Arrrgh! See ajab mind nii marru!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaBattleRoom_Text_IfWeBattleAgainWontLose
en: If we ever battle again, I won't lose! Don't you forget it! Bye-bye!
et: Kui me veel kunagi võitleme, mina küll ei kaota! Ära seda unusta! Tšau-tšau!

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC… He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…
et: Mu vanem vend on FOSSIL MANIAC… Tore sell, kes armastab FOSSIILE…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: He loves digging holes, too… He dug this hole by himself…
et: Talle meeldib ka auke kaevata… Selle augu kaevas ta ise…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThisToDigLikeMyBrother
en: You can have this, so you can DIG holes just like my big brother…
et: Võta see endale — siis saad võttega DIG auke kaevata just nagu mu vanem vend…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigReturnsYouToEntrance
en: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a cave, you're returned to the entrance…
et: Kui kasutad koopas võtet DIG, viiakse sind tagasi sissepääsu juurde…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFillDisplayCase
en: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the display case…
et: Vitriin on täis veidra kujuga kive…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
en: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA… HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND… STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…
et: KIHISTUTE KOOSTIS… KUIDAS VIHM MAAD KUJUNDAB… KIVID, PINNAS JA KALJUD…

label: Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_CrammedWithBooks
en: It's crammed with books.
et: See on raamatuid täis topitud.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ThankYouVisitWithPoints
en: Thank you very much.
et: Suur tänu.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ThankYouVisitWithPoints
en: Please visit us when you have saved up Battle Points.
et: Tule meile külla, kui oled Battle Pointe kokku kogunud.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WishIHadAllDolls
en: Oh, they're so nice! I wish I had them! Cute cushions! Big plush DOLLS! Little plush DOLLS! I wish I had them all!
et: Oi, need on nii ilusad! Tahaks endale! Nunnud padjad! Suured plüüsnukud! Väikesed plüüsnukud! Tahaks neid kõiki!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
en: Leave it to your mommy!
et: Jäta see oma emme hooleks!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GetYouAnythingYouWant
en: If it's anything you want, I'll go through anything to get it, honey!
et: Kui sa midagi tahad, teen ma kõik, et see kätte saada, kullake!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
en: If I can get hold of the items here, my POKéMON will get tougher.
et: Kui saan siinsed esemed kätte, muutuvad mu POKéMONid sitkemaks.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ItemsWillGetMonTougher
en: You bet they will! No question about it!
et: Just nii! Selles pole kahtlustki!

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: Hah? What are you gawking at?
et: Hah? Mida sa jõllitad?

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: I don't like you staring at my plush doll like that.
et: Mulle ei meeldi, et sa mu plüüsnukku niimoodi vahid.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_GoGetYourOwnDoll
en: If you want it, go get one yourself! Isn't that right, SMOOCHUM?
et: Kui tahad, hangi endale ise! Kas pole nii, SMOOCHUM?

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MoreBattlePointsForRecord
en: If you stretch your record at any of the BATTLE facilities, they start giving you more and more Battle Points.
et: Kui parandad mõnes BATTLE-rajatises oma rekordit, hakatakse sulle üha rohkem Battle Pointe andma.

en: Raises the stat ATTACK of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_CalciumDesc
en: Raises the stat SP. ATK of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi ER. RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_IronDesc
en: Raises the stat DEFENSE of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ZincDesc
en: Raises the stat SP. DEF of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi ER. KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_CarbosDesc
en: Raises the stat SPEED of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi KIIRUST.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_HPUpDesc
en: Raises the HP of one POKéMON.
et: Tõstab ühe POKéMONi elupunkte.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_LeftoversDesc
en: A hold item that gradually restores HP in battle.
et: Hoitav ese, mis taastab lahingus tasapisi elupunkte.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_WhiteHerbDesc
en: A hold item that restores any lowered stat.
et: Hoitav ese, mis taastab kõik langetatud näitajad.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_QuickClawDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally allows the first strike.
et: Hoitav ese, mis lubab vahel esimesena lüüa.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_MentalHerbDesc
en: A hold item that snaps POKéMON out of infatuation.
et: Hoitav ese, mis raputab POKéMONi armumisest välja.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_BrightpowderDesc
en: A hold item that casts a glare to reduce accuracy.
et: Hoitav ese, mis pimestab vastast ja vähendab tema täpsust.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ChoiceBandDesc
en: Raises a move's power, but permits only that move.
et: Tõstab ühe võtte jõudu, kuid lubab kasutada vaid seda.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_KingsRockDesc
en: A hold item that may cause flinching when the foe is hit.
et: Hoitav ese, mis võib vastast tabades panna ta võpatama.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_FocusBandDesc
en: A hold item that occasionally prevents fainting.
et: Hoitav ese, mis vahel hoiab ära minestamise.

label: BattleFrontier_ExchangeServiceCorner_Text_ScopeLensDesc
en: A hold item that raises the critical-hit rate.
et: Hoitav ese, mis tõstab kriitiliste tabamuste määra.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Jou, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a master of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: FORTREE SAALI JUHT WINONA on LENDAV-tüüpi POKéMONide meister.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting at the back of this GYM, behind the rotating doors.
et: Ta ootab selle SAALI tagaosas, pöörlevate uste taga.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: She's waiting for new challengers who are trying to take wing!
et: Ta ootab uusi väljakutsujaid, kes tahavad lendu tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Okay, go for it!
et: Olgu, anna minna!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: You did it! You've achieved liftoff!
et: Said hakkama! Tõusid lendu!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro
en: Behold the elegant battle style of BIRD POKéMON!
et: Vaata LINNU-POKéMONide elegantset võitlusstiili!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat
en: You… You're strong…
et: Sa… Sa oled tugev…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep up with unexpected turns of events.
et: TRAINER peab olema nutikas, et ootamatute pööretega sammu pidada.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle
en: Do you have the smarts to get to our LEADER?
et: Kas sul on nutti meie JUHINI jõuda?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire to join this GYM.
et: LINNU-POKéMONide austajad ihkavad selle SAALIGA liituda.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro
en: As a member of the FORTREE GYM, I'm not allowed to lose!
et: FORTREE SAALI liikmena ei tohi ma kaotada!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoDefeat
en: It was too much of a load for me to bear…
et: See oli mulle liiga suur koorem kanda…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: The world is huge, and there are countless tough TRAINERS.
et: Maailm on suur ja tugevaid TRAINEReid on lugematul hulgal.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle
en: I'm going to keep training and make myself even stronger.
et: Ma treenin edasi ja teen end veelgi tugevamaks.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM LEADER, to deal with you!
et: Pole vaja, et meie SAALI JUHT WINONA sinuga tegeleks!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro
en: I'm plenty good enough for you!
et: Minust piisab sinu jaoks küll ja küll!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintDefeat
en: WINONA, I… I lost!
et: WINONA, ma… ma kaotasin!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: WINONA is cute and she's strong. She's the ultimate LEADER!
et: WINONA on nunnu ja tugev. Ta on parim JUHT üldse!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle
en: Blush…
et: Punastan…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro
en: WINONA taught me personally! You can't beat me easily!
et: WINONA on mind isiklikult õpetanud! Nii kergelt sa mind ei võida!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Sain lüüa…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle
en: Thanks to WINONA, the people of FORTREE can live without fear.
et: Tänu WINONALE saavad FORTREE inimesed elada ilma hirmuta.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
