en: When WINONA takes to battle, her face shines with beautiful determination…
et: Kui WINONA lahingusse astub, särab ta nägu kaunist sihikindlusest…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro
en: I'm not letting you witness that lovely sight!
et: Seda kaunist vaatepilti ma sul näha ei lase!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat
en: Urk! I couldn't stop you.
et: Ürk! Ma ei suutnud sind peatada.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle
en: You'd better watch it! Don't get distracted staring at WINONA or you'll go crashing down in a heap!
et: Ole parem ettevaatlik! Ära jää WINONAT vahtima, muidu oled äkki ise pikali!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You'd better know that there are all sorts of FLYING-type POKéMON.
et: Tasub teada, et LENDAV-tüüpi POKéMONe on igasuguseid.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro
en: You do know that, right?
et: Sa ju tead seda, eks?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat
en: You seem to know your stuff!
et: Paistab, et sa tunned oma asja!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle
en: Sure, you beat me all right. But you'd better watch it! Our LEADER WINONA's POKéMON are all business.
et: Muidugi, sa võitsid mu ausalt ära. Aga ole valvel! Meie JUHI WINONA POKéMONid ei tee nalja.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the FORTREE POKéMON GYM.
et: Mina olen WINONA. Olen FORTREE POKéMON SAALI JUHT.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: I have become one with BIRD POKéMON and have soared the skies…
et: Olen saanud LINNU-POKéMONidega üheks ja tõusnud koos nendega taevasse…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: However grueling the battle, we have triumphed with grace…
et: Ükskõik kui ränk on lahing, oleme alati graatsiliselt võidutsenud…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro
en: Witness the elegant choreography of BIRD POKéMON and I!
et: Vaata minu ja LINNU-POKéMONide elegantset koreograafiat!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: Never before have I seen a TRAINER command POKéMON with more grace than I…
et: Ma pole kunagi näinud TRAINERit, kes juhiks POKéMONe suurema graatsiaga kui mina…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat
en: In recognition of your prowess, I present to you this GYM BADGE.
et: Sinu osavuse tunnustuseks annan sulle selle SAALIMÄRGI.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE from WINONA.
et: {PLAYER} sai WINONALT märgi FEATHER BADGE.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up to LV 70, even those received through trades, will obey your every command.
et: Märgiga FEATHER BADGE kuuletuvad sulle kõik POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 70, ka need, kelle oled kauplemisega saanud.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: You will also be able to use the HM move FLY outside of battle.
et: Väljaspool lahingut saad nüüd kasutada ka HM-võtet FLY.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadgeTakeThis
en: And this… This is a gift from me.
et: Ja see… See on kingitus minult.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.
et: TM40 sisaldab võtet AERIAL ACE.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAerialAce
en: Its speed… No POKéMON should be able to avoid it.
et: Selle kiirus… Ükski POKéMON ei peaks suutma sellest kõrvale hoida.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona
en: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT WINONA registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle
en: Though I fell to you, I will remain devoted to BIRD POKéMON.
et: Kuigi ma sulle kaotasin, jään LINNU-POKéMONidele truuks.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM
et: FORTREE LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: WINONA SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse iial maa külgetõmbest.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Aga täiuslikkuse poole püüeldes on meilgi jõudu lendu tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Valitseva MEISTRINA oled sa tõusnud päris tippu.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, luba mul näha sinu jõudu täies lennus!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat
en: I failed to reach your height again…
et: Ma ei küündinud jälle sinu kõrgusele…

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: WINONA: Even though I have lost, the wings of my heart remain unbroken.
et: WINONA: Kuigi ma kaotasin, on mu südame tiivad endiselt terved.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I can rise and soar again and yet again.
et: Ma tõusen ja lendan ikka ja jälle uuesti.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch
en: I am convinced of it!
et: Ma olen selles kindel!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: WINONA: We humans can never escape gravity's pull on the ground.
et: WINONA: Meie, inimesed, ei pääse iial maa külgetõmbest.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: But by striving for excellence, we have the power to soar!
et: Aga täiuslikkuse poole püüeldes on meilgi jõudu lendu tõusta!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: You have scaled the pinnacle as the reigning CHAMPION.
et: Valitseva MEISTRINA oled sa tõusnud päris tippu.

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please, allow me to see your power at full flight!
et: Palun, luba mul näha sinu jõudu täies lennus!

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh, no… Do you have but one POKéMON with you?
et: Oh ei… Kas sul on kaasas ainult üks POKéMON?

label: FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Please return with two POKéMON at the very least.
et: Palun tule tagasi vähemalt kahe POKéMONiga.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThisIsExhibitHall
en: This is our special exhibit hall.
et: See on meie eriline näitusesaal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: As you can plainly see, there is not a single painting on exhibit.
et: Nagu näed, pole siin väljas ainustki maali.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of so-called classical art.
et: Siia ei taha ma panna nn klassikalise kunsti teoseid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Such classical works you can see on our ground floor.
et: Selliseid klassikalisi töid näed meie alumisel korrusel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: I wish to exhibit work that is far different from the classics.
et: Mina tahan näidata midagi hoopis muud kui klassikat.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Art, after all, is not restricted to old, famous works!
et: Kunst ei piirdu ju vanade kuulsate teostega!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with…
et: Selle näitusesaali tahan täita…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ExplainExhibitHall
en: Modern and vibrant artworks of POKéMON seemingly ready to spring forth into glorious life!
et: …nüüdisaegsete ja elavate POKéMONi-piltidega, mis näivad kohe hiilgavalt ellu ärkavat!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: I beg your pardon. I didn't intend to monopolize the conversation.
et: Palun vabandust. Ma ei tahtnud kogu juttu enda kätte haarata.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: Now, as you are young, and yet obviously well traveled…
et: Aga nüüd — sa oled noor, kuid ilmselgelt palju rännanud…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: You must encounter lively POKéMON and works of art depicting them.
et: Küllap kohtad sa elavaid POKéMONe ja näed ka neid kujutavaid kunstiteoseid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PleaseObtainPaintingsForExhibit
en: If you were to come across such a painting, may we ask you to obtain the artist's permission to exhibit it here?
et: Kui peaksid sellise maali otsa sattuma, kas küsiksid kunstnikult loa seda siin eksponeerida?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_WishToFillExhibit
en: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with modern and vibrant paintings of POKéMON.
et: Tahan selle näitusesaali täita nüüdisaegsete ja elavate POKéMONi-maalidega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thanks to you, we've added a new painting to our collection!
et: Tänu sinule lisandus meie kogusse uus maal!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: I've heard it depicts your POKéMON. Truly magnificent!
et: Kuulsin, et see kujutab sinu POKéMONi. Tõeliselt suurepärane!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThanksAddedNewPainting
en: Thank you so very, very much!
et: Suur, suur tänu sulle!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYouPlayer
en: Ah! It's you! {PLAYER}!
et: Ah! Sina ju! {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Isn't this marvelous? This collection of paintings!
et: Kas pole imeline? See maalide kogu!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Each one of them flawless! None better than another!
et: Iga viimane kui üks on laitmatu! Ükski pole teisest parem!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: These paintings have attracted more guests to our ART MUSEUM.
et: Need maalid on toonud meie ART MUSEUMisse rohkem külalisi.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_PaintingsAttractedMoreGuests
en: Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}. This is my dream come true!
et: Ma tänan sind südamest, {PLAYER}. See on mu unistuse täitumine!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_TokenOfGratitude
en: This is merely a token of my gratitude.
et: See on vaid väike tänutäht.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_KeepThisForYou
en: I will keep this for you until we meet again.
et: Ma hoian seda sinu jaoks alles, kuni me taas kohtume.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}!
et: Ah, nii tore sind näha, {PLAYER}!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: It's an honor to have you visit us on your busy journeys.
et: Meil on au, et sa oma kiirel rännakul meie juurde põikad.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_HonorToHaveYouVisit
en: Please, relax and do enjoy your visit with us.
et: Võta rahulikult ja naudi meie juures käiku.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPinkPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with pink-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam roosade kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsYellowPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with yellow-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam kollaste kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsBluePictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with blue-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam siniste kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsRedPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with red-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam punaste kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsGreenPictureFrame
en: It's a picture frame with green-colored adornments.
et: See on pildiraam roheliste kaunistustega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsPaintingOfPokemon
en: It's a painting of POKéMON.
et: See on maal POKéMONidest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I've been away awhile, so the new paintings up here surprised me.
et: Olin tükk aega ära, nii et need uued maalid siin üleval üllatasid mind.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsSurprisedMe
en: I wish someone would paint my POKéMON this pretty.
et: Tahaks ka, et keegi maaliks mu POKéMONi nii ilusaks.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: Well… So this is where they show the topical POKéMON paintings.
et: Noh… Nii et siin näidataksegi päevakajalisi POKéMONi-maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewPaintingsRatherAmusing
en: I see, these new paintings are indeed rather amusing.
et: Tõepoolest, need uued maalid on üsna lõbusad.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Wow, is that right? These paintings are of your POKéMON.
et: Ohoo, on või? Need maalid on sinu POKéMONidest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ThesePaintingsOfYourPokemon
en: Isn't that just the ultimate joy for a TRAINER?
et: Kas pole see TRAINERile ülim rõõm?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: What a TRAINER needs…
et: Mida TRAINER vajab…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Knowledge… Strategy… Luck… Guts… Spirit… Bravery… And ability…
et: Teadmisi… Strateegiat… Õnne… Julgust… Vaimu… Vaprust… Ja võimekust…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Well, I'm all set in every way! I'll be unstoppable at every building!
et: Noh, mina olen igas mõttes valmis! Ükski hoone mind ei peata!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainerNeeds
en: Huh? POKéMON? What's that?
et: Hä? POKéMON? Mis asi see on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: Do you know about the FRONTIER BRAINS?
et: Kas tead, kes on FRONTIER BRAINS?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFrontierBrains
en: That's what SCOTT calls the seven special TRAINERS that run the seven facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Nii kutsub SCOTT seitset erilist TRAINERit, kes juhivad BATTLE FRONTIERi seitset rajatist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl told me that I have a lot of talent for battling!
et: BATTLE TOWERis ütles üks vanem tüdruk mulle, et mul on võitlemiseks palju annet!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I like POKéMON CONTESTS more!
et: Mulle meeldivad POKéMON VÕISTLUSED rohkem!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: But I'm no good at CONTESTS!
et: Aga VÕISTLUSTEL ma hea ei ole!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveTalentForBattling
en: I guess having talent and liking something aren't the same.
et: Vist ei ole anne ja meeldimine üks ja sama asi.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Uh… Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.
et: Äh… Ah jaa, mina olen MOVE DELETER.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: I can make POKéMON forget their moves.
et: Ma oskan panna POKéMONid võtteid unustama.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICanMakeMonForgetMove
en: Would you like me to do that?
et: Kas sooviksid, et ma seda teeksin?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMonShouldForget
en: Which POKéMON should forget a move?
et: Milline POKéMON peaks võtte unustama?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_WhichMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Which move should be forgotten?
et: Milline võte tuleks unustada?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move so it can't be forgotten…
et: {STR_VAR_1} oskab ainult ühte võtet, nii et seda ei saa unustada…

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonsMoveShouldBeForgotten
en: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? That move should be forgotten?
et: Hm! {STR_VAR_1} võte {STR_VAR_2}? Kas just see tuleks unustada?

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: It worked to perfection!
et: See toimis laitmatult!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonHasForgottenMove
en: {STR_VAR_1} has forgotten {STR_VAR_2} completely.
et: {STR_VAR_1} on võtte {STR_VAR_2} täielikult unustanud.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ComeAgain
en: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
et: Tule jälle, kui on võtteid, mis vajavad unustamist.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggCantForgetMoves
en: What? No EGG should know any moves.
et: Mis? Ükski MUNA ei tohiks ühtki võtet osata.

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Hm!
et: Hm!

label: LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_CantForgetSurf
en: Your {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing to forget SURF.
et: Sinu {STR_VAR_1} ei näi olevat nõus võtet SURF unustama.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out and cycle as fast as you'd like.
et: CYCLING ROAD on koht, kus saad anda kõik ja kihutada nii kiiresti kui tahad.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_GoAllOutOnCyclingRoad
en: It feels great to go that fast, but try not to crash into anyone!
et: Nii kiiresti kihutada on suurepärane tunne, aga ära sõida kellelegi otsa!

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING ROAD. It's too dangerous.
et: Vabandust, CYCLING ROAD ei ole jalgsi käimiseks. Liiga ohtlik.

label: Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance_Text_TooDangerousToWalk
en: Please come back with a BIKE.
et: Tule palun tagasi siis, kui sul on BIKE.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieHoldItRightThere
en: ARCHIE: Hold it right there.
et: ARCHIE: Seis! Jää sinnapaika.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasYou
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu… So it was you, after all.
et: ARCHIE: Fufufu… Nii et see olidki sina.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: ARCHIE: Behold!
et: ARCHIE: Ennäe!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: See how beautiful it is, the sleeping form of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!
et: Vaata, kui kaunis on muistse POKéMONi KYOGRE magav kuju!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKyogre
en: I have waited so long for this day to come…
et: Ma olen seda päeva nii kaua oodanud…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've managed to chase me here.
et: ARCHIE: Mind hämmastab, et sa suutsid mind siiani jälitada.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: But that's all over now.
et: Aga nüüd on sellel lõpp.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustDisappear
en: For the realization of my dream, you must disappear now!
et: Minu unistuse nimel pead sa nüüd kaduma!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat
en: What?! I lost to a mere child like you?!
et: Mida?! Ma kaotasin mingile lapsele nagu sina?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: ARCHIE: Fufufu…
et: ARCHIE: Fufufu…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: I commend you. I must recognize that you are truly gifted.
et: Tunnustan sind. Pean möönma, et sa oled tõeliselt andekas.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: But! I have this in my possession!
et: Aga! See siin on minu käes!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThisRedOrb
en: With this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE…
et: Kui mul on see RED ORB, saan ma KYOGRE…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesByItself
en: The RED ORB suddenly began shining by itself!
et: RED ORB hakkas järsku iseenesest helendama!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: ARCHIE: What?!
et: ARCHIE: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: I didn't do anything. Why did the RED ORB…
et: Ma ei teinud midagi. Miks küll RED ORB…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDidKyogreGo
en: Where did KYOGRE go?
et: Kuhu KYOGRE kadus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessageFromOutside
en: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our members outside…
et: ARCHIE: Hm? Sõnum meie meestelt väljas…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?
et: ARCHIE: Jah, mis on?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hm… It's raining heavily?
et: Hm… Sajab kõvasti?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Good… That should have happened. That is why we awakened KYOGRE, to realize TEAM AQUA's vision of expanding the sea.
et: Hästi… Nii pidigi minema. Just selleks me KYOGRE äratasimegi — et täita TEAM AQUA unistus merede laiendamisest.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: It's raining far harder than we envisioned? You're in danger?
et: Sajab palju kõvemini, kui me ette nägime? Te olete ohus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: That can't be… That's just not possible…
et: See ei saa olla… See lihtsalt pole võimalik…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRainingTooHard
en: Hold your position and monitor the situation!
et: Püsige paigal ja jälgige olukorda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: ARCHIE: There's something wrong…
et: ARCHIE: Midagi on valesti…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: The RED ORB is supposed to awaken and control KYOGRE…
et: RED ORB peaks KYOGRE äratama ja teda juhtima…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: But… Why? Why did KYOGRE disappear?
et: Aga… Miks? Miks KYOGRE kadus?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKyogreDisappear
en: Why?!
et: Miks?!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: MAXIE: What have you wrought?
et: MAXIE: Mis sa küll korda saatsid?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: ARCHIE… You've finally awoken KYOGRE, haven't you?
et: ARCHIE… Sa siis äratasidki KYOGRE, eks ole?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: What will happen to the world if this downpour continues for all eternity?
et: Mis saab maailmast, kui see paduvihm igavesti kestab?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveYouWrought
en: The world's landmass will drown in the deepening sea…
et: Maailma maismaa upub aina süvenevasse merre…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: ARCHIE: W-what?! Don't get all high and mighty with me!
et: ARCHIE: Mi-mida?! Ära hakka mulle siin targutama!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: Wasn't it you, TEAM MAGMA, that infuriated GROUDON?
et: Kas polnud see mitte sina, TEAM MAGMA, kes ajas GROUDONi raevu?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: So long as I have this RED ORB, I should be able to control KYOGRE…
et: Niikaua kui see RED ORB on minu käes, peaks KYOGRE minu võimuses olema…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetAllHighAndMighty
en: I should be able to control it…
et: Ma peaksin suutma teda juhtida…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: MAXIE: We don't have the time to argue about it here!
et: MAXIE: Meil pole aega siin selle üle vaielda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: Get outside and see for yourself!
et: Mine välja ja vaata ise!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHaveTimeToArgue
en: See if what you've wrought is the world that we desired!
et: Vaata, kas see, mille sa korda saatsid, ongi see maailm, mida me soovisime!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPlayer
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have to get out of here, too!
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, kuule, sinagi pead siit välja saama!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: My papa told me.
et: Mu ISA rääkis mulle.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: He says this tunnel is full of timid POKéMON.
et: Ta ütleb, et see tunnel on arglikke POKéMONe täis.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: They get all scared of loud noise and make a big uproar.
et: Nad ehmuvad valjust mürast ja tõstavad kohutava kära.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: So they had to stop the big tunnel project.
et: Nii et suur tunneliprojekt tuli pooleli jätta.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel
en: But there's one man. He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!
et: Aga üks mees on ikka alles! Ta üritab tunnelit üksinda edasi kaevata!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: There was a man who dug a tunnel for a lady he loved.
et: Elas kord mees, kes kaevas tunneli naise pärast, keda ta armastas.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove
en: I don't really get it, but hey!
et: Ma päris ei saa aru, aga no mis siis!

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash is never blown in this direction.
et: Tuuled puhuvad nii, et vulkaanituhka siiapoole kunagi ei kanna.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere
en: The air is clean and delicious here. Living here should do wonders for even frail and sickly people.
et: Siinne õhk on puhas ja mõnus. Siin elamine peaks imet tegema ka nõrkadele ja põdurale.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding a hot winning streak.
et: Mul ja mu POKéMONidel on käimas kuum võiduseeria.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut
en: So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT debut in this town.
et: Nii et otsustasin teha oma debüüdi siinses BATTLE TENTis.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: Did you see the cave next to the POKéMON MART?
et: Kas nägid koobast POKéPOE kõrval?

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: There's a guy in there who's trying to bust up boulders so he can bust out through to the other side.
et: Seal sees on üks tüüp, kes üritab rahne lõhkuda, et teisele poole läbi murda.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThroughCave
en: It'd be great if we could go through… It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.
et: Oleks vahva, kui sealt läbi pääseks… Siis oleks RUSTBOROSSE lihtne minna.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: That cave next to the POKéMON MART is now a tunnel to the other side.
et: See koobas POKéPOE kõrval on nüüd tunnel teisele poole.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroNow
en: It's great--it's easy to go shop for new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.
et: Suurepärane — nüüd on lihtne käia RUSTBOROS uusi DEVONi tooteid ostmas.

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: VERDANTURF TOWN
et: VERDANTURF LINN

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign
en: “The windswept highlands with the sweet fragrance of grass.”
et: „Tuulised kõrgendikud, kus õhus hõljub rohu magus lõhn.”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_WandasHouse
en: WANDA'S HOUSE
et: WANDA MAJA

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”
et: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURFI PAIK „Lahingud, mis pakuvad silmailu!”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL „Ühendab RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURFI”

label: VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: „Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud.”

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: That PC in the corner there is for any POKéMON TRAINER to use.
et: Seda ARVUTIT seal nurgas võib iga POKéMON TRAINER kasutada.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TrainersCanUsePC
en: Naturally, that means you're welcome to use it, too.
et: Loomulikult võid ka sina seda kasutada.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: POKéMON CENTERS are great!
et: POKéKESKUSED on suurepärased!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonCentersAreGreat
en: You can use their services as much as you like, and it's all for free. You never have to worry!
et: Nende teenuseid võid kasutada nii palju kui tahad ja kõik on tasuta. Muretsema ei pea kunagi!

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisele korrusele ehitati hiljuti POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WirelessClubNotAvailable
en: But they say they're still making adjustments.
et: Aga räägitakse, et seal käib veel häälestamine.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on the second floor was built recently.
et: Teisele korrusele ehitati hiljuti POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.

label: OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedInWirelessClub
en: I traded POKéMON right away.
et: Ma käisin kohe POKéMONe vahetamas.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Mina olen MR. STONE, DEVON CORPORATIONi PRESIDENT.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I'd just got word about you!
et: Ma just kuulsin sinust!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: You saved our staff not just once, but twice!
et: Sa päästsid meie töötaja mitte üks, vaid koguni kaks korda!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I have a favor to ask of an amazing person like you.
et: Mul on sinusugusele imelisele inimesele üks palve.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I understand that you're delivering a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.
et: Ma saan aru, et sa viid paki SLATEPORTI SHIPYARDisse.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: Well, on the way, could you stop off in DEWFORD TOWN?
et: Kas sa saaksid teel DEWFORD LINNAS peatuda?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIHaveFavor
en: I was hoping that you'd deliver a LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
et: Lootsin, et viid DEWFORDIS olevale STEVENILE ühe KIRJA.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: MR. STONE: Now, you should know that I am a great PRESIDENT.
et: MR. STONE: Pead teadma, et mina olen suurepärane PRESIDENT.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: So, I'd never be so cheap as to ask a favor for nothing in return.
et: Nii et ma pole kunagi nii ihne, et paluksin teenet ilma midagi vastu andmata.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWantYouToHaveThis
en: That's why I want you to have this!
et: Just seepärast saad sa selle!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ReceivedPokenav
en: {PLAYER} received a POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER} sai POKéNAVi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: MR. STONE: That device…
et: MR. STONE: See seade…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV for short.
et: See on POKéMON NAVIGATOR ehk lühidalt POKéNAV.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It's an indispensable tool for any TRAINER on an adventure.
et: Seiklusel on see igale TRAINERILE asendamatu abivahend.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: It has a map of the HOENN region.
et: Sellel on HOENNI piirkonna kaart.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: You can check the locations of DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!
et: Sealt leiad hõlpsasti DEWFORDI ja SLATEPORTI asukoha!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: By the way, I've heard that sinister criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe-have been making trouble far and wide.
et: Muide, olen kuulnud, et mingid pahad tegelased — vist MAGMA ja AQUA — teevad kõikjal pahandust.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneExplainPokenavRestUp
en: I think it would be best if you rested up before you go on your way.
et: Minu arvates oleks kõige targem enne teele asumist korralikult puhata.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGoWithCautionAndCare
en: MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN}, go with caution and care!
et: MR. STONE: Nonii, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ole teel ettevaatlik ja hoia end!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingOnYou
en: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!
et: MR. STONE: Ma loodan sinu peale!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER? Thank you kindly!
et: MR. STONE: Sa viisid mu KIRJA kohale? Suur tänu sulle!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouForDeliveringLetter
en: This is my way of thanking you. It should help you, a TRAINER.
et: Sedasi tänan sind mina. Sellest peaks TRAINERILE kasu olema.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that EXP. SHARE will be given some of the EXP Points from battle.
et: MR. STONE: POKéMON, kes kannab eset EXP. SHARE, saab lahingust osa EXP punktidest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: It will get EXP Points even if it didn't actually battle.
et: Ta saab EXP punkte ka siis, kui ta ise ei võidelnud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainExpShare
en: I would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful for raising weak POKéMON.
et: Ütleksin, et EXP. SHARE on nõrkade POKéMONide kasvatamiseks üsna kasulik.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed myself in work.
et: MR. STONE: Olen noorest peast saati üleni töösse uppunud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: Consequently, I'm not familiar with trends and that sort of thing.
et: Seetõttu ei tunne ma moevoolusid ega muud sellist.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamiliarWithTrends
en: But do young people all want to be TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?
et: Aga kas kõik noored tahavad tõesti saada POKéMON LIIGA TRAINERITEKS?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: This is the DEVON CORPORATION's third floor.
et: See on DEVON CORPORATIONi kolmas korrus.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on this floor.
et: Meie PRESIDENDI KABINET on sellel korrusel.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm grateful for what you've done.
et: Igatahes — ma ei oskagi öelda, kui tänulik ma sulle selle eest olen.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Um… By the way, that parcel you got back for us…
et: Öö… Muide, see pakk, mille sa meile tagasi tõid…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Could I get you to deliver that to the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?
et: Kas sa viiksid selle SLATEPORTI SHIPYARDisse?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: It would be awful if those robbers tried to take it again.
et: Oleks jube, kui need röövlid üritaksid seda jälle näpata.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count on you to do that for me?
et: Öö… Hehehe, no kas ma võin selles sinu peale loota?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rdFloorWaitHere
en: Oh, that's right. Could you wait here a second?
et: Ah jaa. Kas ootaksid siin hetke?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Our PRESIDENT would like to have a word with you.
et: Meie PRESIDENT sooviks sinuga paar sõna vahetada.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithPresidentComeWithMe
en: Please come with me.
et: Palun tule minuga kaasa.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_PleaseGoAhead
en: Please, go ahead.
et: Palun, astu edasi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCaptSternShipyard
en: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, you should go see CAPT. STERN.
et: Kui satud SLATEPORTI SHIPYARDisse, mine kindlasti CAPT. STERNI juurde.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAndTimerHugelyPopular
en: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL and TIMER BALL, have become hugely popular among TRAINERS.
et: DEVONi uued tooted REPEAT PALL ja TIMER PALL on TRAINERITE seas ülipopulaarseks saanud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocksDisplay
en: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
et: See on PRESIDENDI kokku pandud haruldaste kivide kogu.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: This place is full of cute DOLLS.
et: See koht on nunnusid NUKKE täis.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_PlaceFullOfCuteDolls
en: I should buy some for me, instead of just for my children.
et: Ma peaksin mõned ka endale ostma, mitte ainult lastele.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_GettingDollInsteadOfPokemon
en: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON, so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.
et: Ma pole veel piisavalt suur, et POKéMONe kasvatada, nii et võtan selle asemel nunnu NUKU.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: They sell many cute MATS here.
et: Siin müüakse palju nunnusid MATTE.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_SellManyCuteMatsHere
en: I wonder which one I should get? Maybe I'll buy them all…
et: Huvitav, millise ma peaksin võtma? Võib-olla ostan need kõik…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_ClosedRooftopForWeather
en: I think they closed the rooftop because the weather is wild today.
et: Vist pandi katusekorrus kinni, sest ilm on täna hull.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands FIGHTING-type POKéMON.
et: DEWFORDI SAALI JUHT BRAWLY juhib KAKLUS-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Going against him with NORMAL-type POKéMON is asking for trouble.
et: Tema vastu TAVA-tüüpi POKéMONidega minna tähendab kindlat pahandust.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious smack down on NORMAL POKéMON, so be careful!
et: KAKLUS-POKéMONid annavad TAVA-POKéMONidele tõsise keretäie, nii et ole ettevaatlik!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: What's worse, the GYM is as dark as the ocean floor.
et: Mis veelgi hullem — SAAL on pime nagu ookeanipõhi.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: But it will get brighter after defeating the TRAINERS in your way.
et: Aga kui alistad teele jäävad TRAINERID, läheb seal heledamaks.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, okay, go for it!
et: Hei, olgu, anna minna!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!
et: Ohoo! Siin läks liiga heledaks!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Your future is bright, too!
et: Ka sinu tulevik on helge!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro
en: Might is right! Come on!
et: Jõud teeb õiguse! Tule aga!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoDefeat
en: Not enough power…
et: Jõudu jäi väheks…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle
en: Your skill overcame my strength! Your technique is commendable!
et: Sinu osavus võitis minu jõu! Tehnika on sul kiiduväärt!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: There's no need for BRAWLY to be involved!
et: Pole vaja, et BRAWLY peaks sinuga tegelema!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro
en: I'll crush you!
et: Ma purustan su!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat
en: But… How? How could I lose so easily?
et: Aga… Kuidas? Kuidas ma nii kergesti kaotada sain?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: I'm not going to waste this loss. I'll use it to motivate me to train!
et: Ma ei lase sel kaotusel raisku minna. See annab mulle indu treenida!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: One day I'll become a GYM LEADER…
et: Ühel päeval saan ma SAALI JUHIKS…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle
en: No, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!
et: Ei, ma saan POKéMON LIIGA MEISTRIKS!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro
en: Don't you dare brush me off! It's not my fault if you cry!
et: Ära söanda minust mööda vaadata! Pole minu süü, kui sa nutma hakkad!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat
en: Waaaaaaah! I lost!
et: Uääääh! Ma kaotasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: I battle in the dark to make my heart stronger.
et: Ma võitlen pimedas, et oma süda tugevamaks teha.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle
en: But because it's so dark, I can never see BRAWLY's face…
et: Aga kuna on nii pime, ei näe ma kunagi BRAWLY nägu…

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro
en: Ufufu… Are you stumbling around in the dark?
et: Ufufu… Kas sa koperdad pimeduses ringi?

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat
en: Oh, you… I don't want to know you!
et: Oh, sina… Ma ei taha sind tundagi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle
en: You deserve to stay lost and end up back at the entrance again!
et: Sa väärid seda, et ära eksid ja jälle sissepääsu juures välja jõuad!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro
en: I'll show you the gumption of a sailing man!
et: Ma näitan sulle meremehe indu!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat
en: How'd this happen? It's not like me to lose this way!
et: Kuidas see juhtus? Nii kaotada pole üldse minu moodi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle
en: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing our GYM LEADER.
et: Oh jaa! Sa oled väärt, et meie SAALI JUHTI näha.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro
en: If you mean to pass, it has to be through me!
et: Kui tahad edasi, siis ainult minust üle!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat
en: Grrrrr! Vastly overpowered!
et: Grrrrr! Sa oled lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle
en: You win! Go after that BADGE!
et: Sa võitsid! Mine nüüd selle MÄRGI järele!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I'm BRAWLY! DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!
et: Mina olen BRAWLY! DEWFORDI SAALI JUHT!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: I've been churned in the rough waves of these parts, and I've grown tough in the pitch-black cave!
et: Mind on siinsed karmid lained läbi loksutanud ja pilkases koopas olen ma karastunud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro
en: So you wanted to challenge me? Let me see what you're made of!
et: Nii et sa tahtsid mind välja kutsuda? Näita, millest sa tehtud oled!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected!
et: Ohoo, vau! Sa tegid palju suurema laksu, kui ma ootasin!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: You swamped me!
et: Sa uhtusid mu minema!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat
en: Okay, you've got me. Take this GYM BADGE!
et: Olgu, sa said mu kätte. Võta see SAALIMÄRK!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE from BRAWLY.
et: {PLAYER} sai BRAWLYLT märgi KNUCKLE BADGE.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON up to Level 30, even those you get in trades, obey without question.
et: Märgiga KNUCKLE BADGE kuuletuvad sulle vastuvaidlematult kõik POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 30, ka need, kelle oled kauplemisega saanud.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: And, you'll be able to use the HM move FLASH outside of battle.
et: Ja väljaspool lahingut saad kasutada HM-võtet FLASH.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTakeThis
en: If you'd like, use this TECHNICAL MACHINE, too.
et: Kui soovid, kasuta ka seda TEHNILIST MASINAT.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: That TM08 contains BULK UP.
et: See TM08 sisaldab võtet BULK UP.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp
en: It's a move that raises both ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
et: See võte tõstab nii RÜNNAKU kui ka KAITSE näitajat.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly
en: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT BRAWLY registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle
en: I can see your talent becoming a giant wave to cause a storm of astonishment among TRAINERS one day!
et: Ma näen, kuidas sinu anne kasvab ühel päeval hiidlaineks, mis paneb TRAINERID hämmastusest ahhetama!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD LINNA POKéMON SAAL

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: DEWFORD LINNA POKéMON SAAL

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: BRAWLY SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib taanduda, aga kaldale naaseb ta alati.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusugune andekuse hiidlaine… Ma teadsin, et sa tuled tagasi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch
en: Show me how much higher you've gone!
et: Näita mulle, kui palju kõrgemale oled jõudnud!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchDefeat
en: Wow! Swamped again!
et: Ohoo! Jälle uhuti mind minema!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch
en: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. You can't see the bottom. It's just like the sea of HOENN!
et: BRAWLY: Võitlemine on avar ja sügav. Põhja sa ei näe. Päris nagu HOENNi meri!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
et: BRAWLY: Laine võib taanduda, aga kaldale naaseb ta alati.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
et: Sinusugune andekuse hiidlaine… Ma teadsin, et sa tuled tagasi!

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh? You only have one POKéMON that can battle.
et: Oh? Sul on ainult üks POKéMON, kes suudab võidelda.

label: DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back with at least two POKéMON.
et: Vabandust, aga tule palun tagasi vähemalt kahe POKéMONiga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}. Do you know it? It's quite cute and rather nice.
et: Mu POKéMON on {STR_VAR_2}. Kas tunned teda? Ta on üsna nunnu ja päris tore.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: This little one, I could trade with pride!
et: Selle väikese võin uhkusega vahetusse panna!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLikeToTrade
en: Would you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}?
et: Kas vahetaksid oma {STR_VAR_1} minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh, it's adorable! Thank you! I promise I'll be good to it!
et: Oi, kui armas! Aitäh! Ma luban, et hoian teda hästi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBeGoodToIt
en: Oh! I hope you'll be good to my {STR_VAR_2}, too!
et: Oh! Loodan, et sinagi oled mu {STR_VAR_2} vastu hea!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeForAnythingButMon
en: Oh, I'm sorry! I don't intend to trade for anything but a {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Oh, vabandust! Ma tahan vahetada ainult {STR_VAR_1} vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFineToo
en: Oh, you won't? Well, that's fine, too. Please come visit us again.
et: Ah, sa ei taha? No eks siis ole. Tule meid jälle vaatama.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuchCuterThanImagined
en: Giggle! A SKITTY is so much cuter than I had imagined. I'm delighted!
et: Hihii! SKITTY on palju nunnum, kui ma ette kujutasin. Ma olen vaimustuses!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: For 70 years I have raised POKéMON! I am the man they revere as the legendary top POKéMON BREEDER!
et: 70 aastat olen POKéMONe kasvatanud! Mina olen see mees, keda austatakse legendaarse tipp-POKéMON BREEDERina!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: If you ever become as seasoned as me, you'll see the abilities of POKéMON at a glance.
et: Kui saad kunagi sama kogenuks kui mina, näed POKéMONide võimeid ühe pilguga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: You're a TRAINER. Doesn't it interest you to know your own POKéMON's abilities?
et: Sa oled TRAINER. Kas sind ei huvita, mis võimed su enda POKéMONidel on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_PokemonBreederIntro
en: Here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Noh! Vaatame su POKéMONi üle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_AverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as being of average ability.
et: Üldiselt ütleksin, et see on keskmiste võimetega.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BetterThanAverageAbility
en: This one, overall, I would describe as having better-than-average ability.
et: Üldiselt ütleksin, et see on keskmisest paremate võimetega.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_ImpressiveAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is quite impressive in ability!
et: Üldiselt ütleksin, et selle võimed on üsna muljetavaldavad!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: …Hmm…
et: …Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_OutstandingAbility
en: This one, overall, I would say is wonderfully outstanding in ability!
et: Üldiselt ütleksin, et selle võimed on imeliselt silmapaistvad!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectHP
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its HP…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest ELUPUNKTID…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest RÜNNAK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest KAITSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpAtk
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL ATTACK…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest ERIRÜNNAK…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpDef
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPECIAL DEFENSE…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest ERIKAITSE…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_BestAspectSpeed
en: Incidentally, the best aspect of it, I would say, is its SPEED…
et: Muuseas, selle parim külg on minu meelest KIIRUS…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatRelativelyGood
en: That stat is relatively good. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on üsna hea. …Hm… Nii ma seda hindan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatImpressive
en: That stat is quite impressive. …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on päris muljetavaldav. …Hm… Nii ma seda hindan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatOutstanding
en: That stat is outstanding! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See näitaja on silmapaistev! …Hm… Nii ma seda hindan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_StatFlawless
en: It's flawless! A thing of perfection! …Hm… That's how I call it.
et: See on veatu! Puhas täiuslikkus! …Hm… Nii ma seda hindan.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: What? You have no time for my advice?
et: Mis? Sul pole aega minu nõuannet kuulata?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_NoTimeForMyAdvice
en: You should always be eager to learn from the experiences of your elders!
et: Vanemate inimeste kogemustest tuleb alati innukalt õppida!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: Yes, what is it now?
et: Jah, mis nüüd on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_HaveBusinessNeedsTending
en: I have business that needs tending! Save it for next time!
et: Mul on asjatoimetusi! Jäta see järgmiseks korraks!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Ah, youngster! Do your POKéMON's abilities intrigue you?
et: Ah, noorsand! Kas sind huvitavad su POKéMONide võimed?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_LetsLookAtYourPokemon
en: Here, here! Let's have a look at your POKéMON!
et: Tule, tule! Vaatame su POKéMONi üle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: An expert I am, but even I can't tell anything about an unhatched POKéMON!
et: Ekspert ma olen küll, aga koorumata POKéMONi kohta ei oska isegi mina midagi öelda!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_EvenICantTell
en: Show me a POKéMON! A POKéMON is what I need to see!
et: Näita mulle POKéMONi! POKéMONi ma pean nägema!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_SaidMyMonIsOutstanding
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! I'm glad I raised it carefully!
et: Ta ütles, et mu POKéMON on suurepärane! Hea, et ma teda hoolikalt kasvatasin!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge1_Text_DidntDoAnythingSpecialRaisingIt
en: He said my POKéMON is outstanding! But I didn't do anything special raising it…
et: Ta ütles, et mu POKéMON on suurepärane! Aga ma ei teinud teda kasvatades midagi erilist…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't know what it's good for.
et: Sain selle STEVENILT, aga ma ei tea, milleks see hea on.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGaveMe
en: I think it's called KING'S ROCK. Do you want it?
et: Vist on selle nimi KING'S ROCK. Kas tahad seda?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: Why would you want it? You're weird.
et: Miks sa seda üldse tahad? Imelik tüüp oled.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt
en: You can keep it, but keep it a secret from STEVEN.
et: Võid selle endale jätta, aga hoia seda STEVENI eest saladuses.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere
en: STEVEN's house is right over there!
et: STEVENI maja on kohe seal!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock
en: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you supposed to do with some weird rock?
et: Jah, sinagi arvad nii! Mida sa ühe veidra kiviga peale hakkad?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild WAILMER.
et: MOSSDEEPI ümbruses näeb metsikuid WAILMEReid.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: It's called, uh… What was it now…
et: Seda nimetatakse, äh… Mis see nüüd oligi…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAI, WAI, WAI…
et: WAI, WAI, WAI…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching
en: WAILMER watching!
et: WAILMERi vaatlus!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare KOSMOSEKESKUS on saatnud üles hiiglaslikke rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLetter
en: There's been some kind of an uproar over a letter they received recently.
et: Hiljuti saadud kirja pärast on seal olnud mingi möll.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRockets
en: The island's SPACE CENTER has been launching huge rockets.
et: Saare KOSMOSEKESKUS on saatnud üles hiiglaslikke rakette.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I heard from a SAILOR buddy that TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.
et: Üks sõber, kes on SAILOR, rääkis mulle, et TEAM AQUA on LILYCOVE LINNAS pesa teinud.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: I also heard that someone came along and wiped the floor with them!
et: Kuulsin ka, et keegi tuli ja pühkis nendega põrandat!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted by that TEAM MAGMA.
et: Aga siinne MOSSDEEP on nüüd selle TEAM MAGMA sihtmärk.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagma
en: If you want to know what they're up to, go visit the SPACE CENTER.
et: Kui tahad teada, mida nad plaanivad, mine vaata KOSMOSEKESKUST.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously more important to me.
et: Ma olen SAILOR, nii et meri on mulle muidugi tähtsam.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand
en: But you know? When I get back on land after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
et: Aga tead? Kui ma pärast pikka merereisi maale jõuan, tunnen tõesti kergendust!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: Wouldn't it be nice?
et: Kas poleks tore?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFlowers
en: If the whole world was covered in plants and flowers like this island?
et: Kui kogu maailm oleks taimi ja lilli täis nagu see saar?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: All life needs the sea to live, even though it makes its home on the land.
et: Kogu elu vajab elamiseks merd, kuigi ta on oma kodu rajanud maismaale.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Life, having run its course, becomes soil and returns to the land.
et: Kui elu on oma ringi läbi teinud, saab sellest muld ja see naaseb maa rüppe.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: And the sea is always connected to the land.
et: Ja meri on alati maismaaga ühenduses.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive
en: Yes, like the very shoreline here.
et: Jah, just nagu see rannajoon siin.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: A voyage on a ship is fine.
et: Laevareis on ju tore.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: But crossing the sea with POKéMON using SURF…
et: Aga kui ületad mere POKéMONi seljas SURFiga…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating
en: Now that's an exhilarating trip! Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
et: Vaat see on alles vahva reis! Kas pole nii, nooruke?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: This rock has a special meaning to the people at the SPACE CENTER.
et: Sellel kivil on SPACE CENTERI inimestele eriline tähendus.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: They put it here as their wish for their rockets to fly safely.
et: Nad tõid selle siia sooviga, et nende raketid ohutult lendaksid.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: When you make a wish, what do you use? Do you wish upon a star?
et: Kui sina midagi väga soovid, mida sa selleks kasutad? Kas soovid tähe peale?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock
en: I use a wish tag to make it happen. That's what I do.
et: Mina kasutan soovisilti, et see täituks. Nii ma teen.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ItsAWhiteRock
en: It's a white rock.
et: See on valge kivi.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
en: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM LEADERS: LIZA & TATE
et: MOSSDEEP LINN POKéMON SAALI SAALI JUHID: LIZA & TATE

label: MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The mystic combination!”
et: „Müstiline kooslus!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_CitySign
en: MOSSDEEP CITY “Our slogan: Cherish POKéMON!”
et: MOSSDEEP LINN „Meie moto: hoia POKéMONe!”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign
en: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER “The closest place to space.”
et: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER „Kosmosele lähim paik.”

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? I'm doing great!
et: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kuidas läheb? Mul läheb suurepäraselt!

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is pretty strong, so I decided to come take a look-see for myself.
et: Kuulsin, et MOSSDEEPI SAALI JUHT on päris tugev, nii et tulin ise vaatama.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: But there's something wrong about this town.
et: Aga selle linnaga on midagi valesti.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: People are going on about a warning letter and the SPACE CENTER…
et: Rahvas aina räägib hoiatuskirjast ja SPACE CENTERIST…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWithTown
en: I don't think it concerns me in any way, though.
et: Mind see küll kuidagi ei puuduta, arvan ma.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Ahh… It feels great letting the waves wash over my feet…
et: Ahh… Nii hea on lasta lainetel jalgu loputada…

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: Speaking of the waves, you know that island city SOOTOPOLIS?
et: Lainetest rääkides — kas tead seda saarelinna SOOTOPOLIS?

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: I think the GYM there had a new LEADER come in.
et: Ma arvan, et sealsesse SAALI tuli uus JUHT.

label: MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader
en: People tell me the new LEADER once mentored WALLACE.
et: Räägitakse, et uus JUHT õpetas kunagi WALLACET.

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: Something's happening, and I don't like it!
et: Midagi toimub ja mulle see ei meeldi!

label: FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmosHome
en: I've seen shady characters wandering in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…
et: Olen näinud kahtlaseid tegelasi PROF. COZMO majast sisse-välja käimas…

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: This region's been known for meteors since the olden days.
et: See kant on juba ammustest aegadest meteooride poolest kuulus.

label: FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors
en: They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out by a falling meteorite long ago.
et: Räägitakse, et METEOR FALLSI uuristas ammu välja alla kukkunud meteoriit.

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: See! Take a look! This is my precious AZURILL!
et: Vaata! Vaata ometi! See on minu kallis AZURILL!

label: FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill
en: It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!
et: Ta on sile ja libe ja pealegi pehme!

label: FallarborTown_Text_Azurill
en: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.
et: AZURILL: Rooreelooo.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: Have you already challenged FLANNERY, the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?
et: Kas oled juba välja kutsunud LAVARIDGE SAALI JUHI FLANNERY?

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: The girl's grandfather was famous. He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the POKéMON LEAGUE at one point.
et: Tüdruku vanaisa oli kuulus mees. Ta kuulus omal ajal POKéMON LIIGA ELIITNELIKKU.

label: FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlannery
en: It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY become a great TRAINER in her own right.
et: Mind ei üllataks, kui FLANNERYST saaks omaette suurepärane TRAINER.

label: FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE “May the Greatest Teams Gather!”
et: BATTLE TENT FALLARBORI PAIK „Kogunegu siia suurimad tiimid!”

label: FallarborTown_Text_TownSign
en: FALLARBOR TOWN “A farm community with small gardens.”
et: FALLARBOR LINN „Väikeste aedadega talukogukond.”

label: FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign
en: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE “New moves taught to POKéMON.”
et: MOVE TUTORI MAJA „POKéMONidele õpetatakse uusi võtteid.”

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.
et: Tere tulemast LILYCOVE MUSEUMisse.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WelcomeToLilycoveMuseum
en: Please take the time to enjoy our collection of fantastic artwork featuring POKéMON.
et: Võta aega ja naudi meie suurepärast POKéMONe kujutavat kunstikogu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of fine arts.
et: Ma olen selle kaunite kunstide MUUSEUMI KURAATOR.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: It's heartening to see someone so young as you in our MUSEUM.
et: Rõõm on näha meie MUUSEUMIS nii noort külastajat nagu sina.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCuratorHaveYouViewedOurPaintings
en: Have you viewed our collection of paintings already?
et: Kas oled meie maalikogu juba vaadanud?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotDisturbYouTakeYourTime
en: Ah, then let me not disturb you. Please, do take your time.
et: Ah, siis ma ei sega. Vaata täiesti rahulikult ringi!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Oh? I do believe that you seem to be a POKéMON TRAINER.
et: Oh? Sina oled vist POKéMON TRAINER, kui ma õigesti arvan.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HaveYouAnInterestInPaintings
en: Have you an interest in paintings, too?
et: Kas sindki huvitavad maalid?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I see…
et: Ah nii…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HonoredYoudVisitInSpiteOfThat
en: I'm honored that you would visit us in spite of that.
et: Mul on au, et sa sellest hoolimata meile sisse astusid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Ah, excellent! You do like paintings!
et: Ah, suurepärane! Sulle meeldivad maalid!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ExcellentCanYouComeWithMe
en: Then, may I ask you to come with me?
et: Kas tuleksid siis palun minuga kaasa?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_VeryOldPainting
en: It's a very old painting. The paint is peeling here and there.
et: See on väga vana maal. Värv koorub siin-seal.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddLandscapeFantasticScenery
en: It's an odd landscape with bizarre and fantastic scenery.
et: Imelik maastikumaal — kummaline ja fantastiline vaade.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBeautifulWoman
en: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling woman with a POKéMON on her lap.
et: See on maal kaunist naeratavast naisest, kellel POKéMON süles.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON from long ago.
et: See on maal ammuse aja legendaarsest POKéMONist.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfLegendaryPokemon
en: The artist painted this from imagination.
et: Kunstnik maalis selle kujutluse järgi.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON swaying in a breeze.
et: See on maal tuules õõtsuvatest ROHU-POKéMONidest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfGrassPokemon
en: They appear to be enjoying the wind's gentle caress.
et: Nad näivad nautivat tuule õrna paitust.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: It's a delicious-looking painting of BERRIES.
et: See on isuäratav maal marjadest.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_PaintingOfBerries
en: This painting could make you hungry!
et: See maal võib su näljaseks teha!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.
et: See on kuulsa skulptuuri koopia.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPokemonSculptureReplica
en: It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.
et: See kujutab iidset LINNU-POKéMONi.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It's a big POKé BALL carved from a black stone.
et: See on suur mustast kivist raiutud POKé PALL.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigPokeBallCarvedFromStone
en: It was apparently used in festivals in the olden days.
et: Seda kasutati ilmselt vanasti pidustustel.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_StoneTabletWithAncientText
en: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed with POKéMON and dense text in the small characters of an ancient, unreadable language.
et: See on suur kivitahvel, millele on raiutud POKéMONid ja tihe tekst iidse loetamatu keele väikeste märkidega.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_WorksOfMagnificence
en: Hmmm… What works of great magnificence…
et: Hmmm… Millised suurepärased teosed…

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: Battling with POKéMON is fun, I'll grant you that.
et: POKéMONidega võitlemine on lõbus, seda ma tunnistan.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MustntForgetLoveForFineArts
en: But one mustn't forget our love for the fine arts.
et: Aga ei tohi unustada meie armastust kaunite kunstide vastu.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could see many fantastic paintings.
et: See ART MUSEUM… Noh, siin saab näha palju fantastilisi maale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: And the CURATOR is a wonderful person.
et: Ja KURAATOR on imeline inimene.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisMuseumIsInspiration
en: Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM is an inspiration.
et: Minusugustele kunstnikele on see MUUSEUM tõeline inspiratsioon.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisLadyIsPretty
en: This lady is pretty! She's like Mommy!
et: See daam on kena! Ta on nagu emme!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ThisPokemonIsAdorable
en: This POKéMON is adorable! Just like our little boy!
et: See POKéMON on armas! Just nagu meie väike poiss!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got in some new paintings.
et: Kuulsin, et siia ART MUSEUMisse jõudsid uued maalid.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: So, naturally I hurried over.
et: Nii et muidugi tormasin kohe kohale.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_HeardMuseumGotNewPaintings
en: Are the new paintings up on the second floor?
et: Kas uued maalid on teisel korrusel?

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: Lately, the CURATOR has been unusually cheerful.
et: Viimasel ajal on KURAATOR olnud ebatavaliselt rõõmus.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_CuratorHasBeenCheerful
en: I bet something good happened for him. Definitely.
et: Vean kihla, et temaga juhtus midagi head. Kindlasti.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I aim to see many great paintings here and learn from them.
et: Tahan siin näha palju suurepäraseid maale ja neist õppida.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimToSeeGreatPaintings
en: I have this dream of one day having my artwork exhibited here.
et: Mul on unistus, et ühel päeval on mu kunstiteosed siin väljas.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite tourist destination.
et: ART MUSEUMist on saanud turistide lemmikpaik.

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: It's great for LILYCOVE… No, great for the HOENN region!
et: Suurepärane asi kogu LILYCOVE jaoks… Ei, kogu HOENNi piirkonna jaoks!

label: LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_MuseumTouristDestination
en: This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER procured all the paintings upstairs.
et: Nii olen ma kuulnud — kõik ülakorruse maalid hankis üksainus TRAINER.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to SLATEPORT for some shopping.
et: Kui mul oleks JALGRATAS, oleks kerge SLATEPORTI ostlema sõita.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAtSlateport
en: I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…
et: Ma saaksin osta HARBOR MAILi SLATEPORTI POKéPOEST…

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMailForCoinCase
en: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL? Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?
et: Oh! Sul on HARBOR MAIL? Kas vahetad selle eseme COIN CASE vastu?

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoinCase
en: Oh, I'm so happy! Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!
et: Oi, kui tore! Hüva, ma annan sulle vastu eseme COIN CASE!

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGameCorner
en: That COIN CASE can be used at the GAME CORNER.
et: Seda eset COIN CASE saab kasutada GAME CORNERis.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: Oh, that's disappointing.
et: Oh, kahju küll.

label: MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappointing
en: A COIN CASE is needed for the GAME CORNER.
et: GAME CORNERi jaoks on vaja eset COIN CASE.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is the RANKING HALL.
et: See on RANKING HALL.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainRankingHall
en: This is where we recognize the immortal TRAINERS who left great records in BATTLE FRONTIER events.
et: Siin austame surematuid TRAINEREID, kes on BATTLE FRONTIERi katsetel püstitanud suuri rekordeid.

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePikeFactoryRecords
en: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE, and BATTLE FACTORY Records
et: BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE ja BATTLE FACTORY rekordid

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceArenaPyramidRecords
en: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA, and BATTLE PYRAMID Records
et: BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA ja BATTLE PYRAMID rekordid

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNameOnThisList
en: Hi, is your name on this list?
et: Tere, kas su nimi on selles nimekirjas?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThatsSuper
en: Wow, that's super! I'll have to try harder, too!
et: Ohoo, see on äge! Ma pean ka kõvemini pingutama!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: Oh, is that right?
et: Oh, on või?

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHarderIfYouSawFriendsName
en: If you saw your friend's name up here, I bet it would make you work harder!
et: Kui sa näeksid siin oma sõbra nime, paneks see sind kindlasti kõvemini pingutama!

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Hmm… My name's not up there…
et: Hmm… Mu nime seal pole…

label: BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesNotUpThere
en: Well, it's only natural since I haven't taken any challenges yet.
et: Noh, see on loomulik, kuna ma pole veel ühtki väljakutset vastu võtnud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDomeSign
en: This is the BATTLE DOME! Your path to the invincible superstar!
et: See on BATTLE DOME! Su tee võitmatuks supertäheks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFactorySign
en: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! Seek out the toughest POKéMON!
et: See on BATTLE FACTORY! Otsi üles sitkeimad POKéMONid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePikeSign
en: This is the BATTLE PIKE! Choose one of three paths!
et: See on BATTLE PIKE! Vali üks kolmest teest!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER.
et: See on BATTLE TOWER.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBattleTower
en: TRAINERS bring their best-raised POKéMON for elimination-style matches.
et: TRAINERID toovad siia oma kõige hoolikamalt kasvatatud POKéMONid väljalangemismatšidele.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas tulid praami peale? Kas tohin näha su PILETIT?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER} ei leidnud PILETIT…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHaveTicketToBoard
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Praamile astumiseks peab sul olema PILET.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} näitas PILETIT.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Suurepärane! Rohkem polegi vaja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu sooviksid sõita?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SlateportItIs
en: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!
et: Siis SLATEPORT LINNA!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: Siis LILYCOVE LINNA!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWithUsAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Sõida meiega mõni teine kord!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astu praamile ja oota väljasõitu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis sõita sooviksid?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutOfAllMyFriends
en: I'm the best out of all my friends. But here… I've been useless!
et: Oma sõprade seas olen ma parim. Aga siin… siin pole minust mingit kasu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER, but I can't find it even though I have a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma tahan BATTLE TOWERisse minna, aga ma ei leia seda üles, kuigi mul on BATTLE FRONTIERi kaart.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFindBattleTower
en: This place is just too big!
et: See koht on lihtsalt liiga suur!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: I wanted to take a challenge as soon as I arrived here.
et: Tahtsin kohe pärast saabumist väljakutse vastu võtta.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasickOnWayHere
en: But on the way, I got seasick… Urrrrp…
et: Aga teel jäin merehaigeks… Urrrrp…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: It's not as if just anyone can come here, you know?
et: Pole ju nii, et igaüks võib siia tulla, tead?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: Only those TRAINERS who've been recognized as tough are brought here.
et: Siia tuuakse ainult need TRAINERID, keda peetakse tõeliselt kõvadeks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToughTrainersBroughtHere
en: That's why many TRAINERS don't even know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Sellepärast ei teagi paljud TRAINERID BATTLE FRONTIERist midagi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Hey, bro…
et: Hei, vend…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCanChallengeWithNoMons
en: Are you sure we can make challenges even if we don't have any POKéMON?
et: Oled sa kindel, et saame väljakutseid võtta, isegi kui meil pole POKéMONe?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: Uh… I'm sure it'll be okay.
et: Äh… Küll kõik läheb hästi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: I think…
et: Vist…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySaidIllLendYouMons
en: But remember that big scary guy? He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”
et: Aga kas mäletad seda suurt hirmsat tüüpi? Ta ütles: „Ma laenan sulle POKéMONe!”

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. You can rent strong POKéMON there.
et: See on BATTLE FACTORY. Seal saad rentida tugevaid POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRaisingThoseRentalMons
en: But it makes me wonder. Who's raising those rental POKéMON?
et: Aga see paneb mõtlema. Kes neid renditud POKéMONe kasvatab?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE PIKE because of SEVIPER…
et: Ma kardan SEVIPERI pärast BATTLE PIKE hoonesse minna…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOfPikeBecauseSeviper
en: B-but I came all the way here, so I will try to conquer everything! …Shudder…
et: Aga… aga ma tulin nii kaugele, nii et üritan kõik ära võita! …Judin…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlayRockPaperScissors
en: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! One, two, three!
et: Mängime kivi, paberit, kääre! Üks, kaks, kolm!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTakePikeChallenge
en: Yay! I won! I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
et: Jess! Ma võitsin! Ma lähen BATTLE PIKE väljakutsele!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: Oh, no… I lost.
et: Oh ei… Ma kaotasin.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllPutOffPikeChallenge
en: I guess I'm not very lucky today. I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge until tomorrow.
et: Vist pole mul täna eriti õnne. Ma lükkan oma BATTLE PIKE väljakutse homseni edasi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: I believe I'm the only person here who, for some unknown reason, would choose fishing over battling.
et: Vist olen siin ainus, kes millegipärast eelistab võitlemisele kalapüüki.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFishingOverBattling
en: Huh? You can't catch anything here? That's disappointing…
et: Ää? Siit ei saa midagi kätte? Kahju küll…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBattlingUntilIGetSymbol
en: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no matter what, until I get a Symbol.
