et: Täna võitlen ma nii kaua, kuni Sümboli kätte saan — ükskõik mis juhtub.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: Oh? You're off to challenge the BATTLE DOME?
et: Oh? Sa lähed BATTLE DOME väljakutsele?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOffToChallengeDome
en: I'll wish you the best of luck. Let us both win our way up and meet in challenges.
et: Soovin sulle edu! Võitleme mõlemad end tippu ja kohtume seal.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHereGrandpa
en: Grandpa, over here! The BATTLE DOME is here! Go get 'em, Grandpa!
et: Vanaisa, siiapoole! BATTLE DOME on siin! Näita neile, vanaisa!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!
et: Ah, nii et see siin ongi BATTLE DOME? GENTLEMEN mind küll ei võida!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetGentlemenBeatMe
en: But where is the entrance?
et: Aga kus on sissepääs?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: There used to be nothing here not all that long ago.
et: Veel hiljuti polnud siin mitte midagi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingHereNotLongAgo
en: But, now look at this place! Amazing! I'll bring my mother out to see this.
et: Aga vaata nüüd seda kohta! Hämmastav! Ma toon oma ema seda vaatama.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: Ma jõudsin lõpuks BATTLE FRONTIERisse!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyArrivedAtFrontier
en: I'm sure to grab attention with my looks and ability!
et: Ma püüan kindlasti oma välimuse ja võimekusega tähelepanu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Mäts, mäts…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: It looks like this square's filled with tough people.
et: Näib, et see väljak on täis sitkeid inimesi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFilledWithToughPeople
en: Munch, munch…
et: Mäts, mäts…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: A while back, I met this older girl at the BATTLE PIKE.
et: Mõni aeg tagasi kohtasin BATTLE PIKE juures üht vanemat tüdrukut.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She had these eyes that were scary in a real ornery way.
et: Tal olid sellised silmad — tigedad ja hirmuäratavad.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: She got all furious: “Will you quit eating!” Then she whaled on me.
et: Ta läks marru: „Kas sa lõpetad söömise!” Siis andis ta mulle keretäie.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: It was a hair-raising kind of scary experience, sure enough.
et: See oli tõesti judinaid tekitav hirmus kogemus.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlderGirlAtPike
en: Crunch, munch…
et: Krõmps, mõmps…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? That's nothing!
et: Ää? Kuula ennast! See pole ju midagi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTimeOurEyesMet
en: Why, the last time I cheered for him, our eyes met and sparks flew!
et: Ohoo, viimati kui ma teda ergutasin, kohtusid meie pilgud ja sädemed lendasid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: Whaaaaaat?! Pfft!
et: Miiis?! Ptüi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: That only happened because I happened to be sitting next to you!
et: See juhtus ainult sellepärast, et ma juhtusin su kõrval istuma!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceLookedBecauseOfMyCheering
en: The DOME ACE only looked our way because my cheering was so loud!
et: DOME ACE vaatas meie poole ainult sellepärast, et mu ergutamine oli nii vali!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: Oh, shush! Keep that racket down!
et: Oi, ole vait! Ära tee nii kõva kära!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: You fair-weather fans should stick to cheering for some GYM LEADER!
et: Teie, juhufännid, võiksite pigem mõnda SAALI JUHTI ergutada!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceIsMine
en: The DOME ACE is mine! The only idol for me!
et: DOME ACE on minu! Ainus iidol minu jaoks!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Those people squabbling over there…
et: Need inimesed, kes seal nääklevad…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: It's hard to believe, but they once were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.
et: Raske uskuda, aga kunagi olid nad TRAINERID, ja veel head.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They used to be incredibly tough, and they were famous, too.
et: Nad olid uskumatult kõvad ja pealegi kuulsad.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: But they were obliterated by this certain TRAINER at a tournament.
et: Aga ühel turniiril tegi neile üks kindel TRAINER puhta töö.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: They were so thoroughly whipped, they became smitten by the TRAINER.
et: Nad said nii korraliku keretäie, et armusid sellesse TRAINERISSE.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOverThereUsedToBeTrainers
en: Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. They go cheer for their idol at the BATTLE DOME every day now.
et: Nüüd on nad lihtsalt selle TRAINERI fännid. Iga päev käivad nad BATTLE DOME juures oma iidolit ergutamas.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: I heard a rumor that someone saw a POKéMON with an unusually long tail somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Kuulsin kuulujuttu, et keegi nägi kuskil BATTLE FRONTIERis ebatavaliselt pika sabaga POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…
et: Küll ta on armas. Ma olen selles kindel…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithLongTailInFrontier
en: Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven to find the delightful creature!
et: Oh, väljakutsed võivad oodata. Ma lihtsalt pean selle armsa olendi üles leidma!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: PP UP is great!
et: PP UP on suurepärane!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat
en: It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, of a POKéMON move.
et: See tõstab POKéMONi võtte jõupunkte ehk PP.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: What… What is happening?
et: Mis… Mis toimub?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside
en: I really want to know, but it's too scary to go outside.
et: Ma tõesti tahan teada, aga on liiga hirmus välja minna.

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Do you know FULL RESTORE?
et: Kas sa tead, mis on FULL RESTORE?

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: Full restoration of HP! Eradication of all status problems!
et: HP täielik taastamine! Kõigi olekumurede kaotamine!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItemOfDreams
en: It's truly an item of your dreams!
et: See on tõesti su unistuste ese!

label: SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_DidSomethingAwaken
en: This weather… Did something awaken?
et: See ilm… Kas midagi ärkas?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, like, I couldn't find myself any POKéMON that were, like, for me.
et: Nii et, nagu, ma ei leidnud endale ühtki POKéMONi, kes oleks, nagu, minu jaoks.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: So, I figured, like, hey, I should file a complaint to the guy there?
et: Nii et ma mõtlesin, nagu, hei, ma peaksin sellele tüübile seal kaebuse esitama?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja ta ei kuulanud mind ära, nagu, hei! Nii et, nagu, täielik jama, sõber!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_CouldntFindMonForMe
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Hei, nagu, sina! Pane suu kinni, tead? Lihtsalt, tead, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See on, nagu, TM41, tead? Hei, see on TORMENT, kas sa kuuled?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu, see ei lase teisel tüübil sama võtet kaks korda järjest kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Hei, kuule nüüd, nagu, ma ei piina sind ju!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: I don't really like BUG POKéMON, but maybe I'll try using some for a change of pace.
et: Mulle ei meeldi eriti PUTUKA-POKéMONid, aga vahelduseks proovin ehk mõnda kasutada.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTryUsingBugMons
en: Who knows, I might even get to like them!
et: Kes teab, äkki nad hakkavadki mulle meeldima!

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_BattleEvenWithoutToughMons
en: You can battle all you want here even if you don't have any tough POKéMON.
et: Sa võid siin võidelda nii palju kui tahad, isegi kui sul pole ühtki kõva POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceIfMoreSelection
en: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of a selection?
et: Kas poleks tore, kui neil oleks rohkem valikut?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Well, well, what have we here? A most energetic customer!
et: Noh-noh, mis meil siin on? Ülimalt energiline klient!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting
en: Me? You may call me RYDEL. I'm the owner of this cycle shop.
et: Mina? Kutsu mind lihtsalt RYDEL. Ma olen selle jalgrattapoe omanik.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES… They're awfully filthy.
et: RYDEL: Su RUNNING SHOES… Need on kohutavalt räpased.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFromFarAway
en: Did you come from far away?
et: Kas tulid kaugelt?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: RYDEL: Is that right?
et: RYDEL: On või?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontNeedBike
en: Then, I guess you have no need for any of my BIKES.
et: Siis vist pole sul mu JALGRATTAID vaja.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …
et: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … …

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: You're saying that you came all this way from LITTLEROOT?
et: Sa tulid kogu selle tee LITTLEROOTIST?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: My goodness! That's ridiculously far!
et: Heldeke! See on naeruväärselt kaugel!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: If you had one of my BIKES, you could go anywhere easily while feeling the gentle caress of the wind!
et: Kui sul oleks üks mu JALGRATTAID, saaksid kergesti kõikjale minna, tundes tuule õrna paitust!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'll tell you what! I'll give you a BIKE!
et: Tead mis! Ma kingin sulle JALGRATTA!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Oh, wait a second!
et: Oh, oota hetk!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I forgot to tell you that there are two kinds of BIKES!
et: Ma unustasin sulle öelda, et on kaks liiki JALGRATTAID!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: They are the MACH BIKE and the ACRO BIKE!
et: Need on MACH BIKE ja ACRO BIKE!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want to feel the wind with their bodies!
et: MACH BIKE on neile ratturitele, kes tahavad tuult kogu kehaga tunda!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: And an ACRO BIKE is for those who prefer technical rides!
et: Ja ACRO BIKE on neile, kes eelistavad tehnilisi sõite!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: I'm a real sweetheart, so you can have whichever one you like!
et: Ma olen tõeline kullapai, nii et vali julgelt see, mis sulle rohkem meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesChooseWhichOne
en: Which one will you choose?
et: Kumma sa valid?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseMachBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis ratta MACH BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ChoseAcroBike
en: {PLAYER} chose the ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} valis ratta ACRO BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch BIKES, just come see me!
et: RYDEL: Kui tahad JALGRATAST vahetada, astu lihtsalt minu juurest läbi!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about switching BIKES?
et: RYDEL: Oh? Kas mõtlesid JALGRATTAID vahetada?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBikes
en: RYDEL: Okay, no problem! I'll switch BIKES for you!
et: RYDEL: Olgu, pole probleemi! Ma vahetan sulle JALGRATTA!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMachForAcro
en: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged for an ACRO BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} sai MACH BIKE asemel uue ratta ACRO BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcroForMach
en: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged for a MACH BIKE.
et: {PLAYER} sai ACRO BIKE asemel uue ratta MACH BIKE.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeIt
en: RYDEL: Good, good! I'm happy that you like it!
et: RYDEL: Tubli, tubli! Mul on hea meel, et see sulle meeldib!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh? What happened to that BIKE I gave you?
et: Oh? Mis sai sellest JALGRATTAST, mille ma sulle andsin?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.
et: Ah, saan aru, sa panid selle ARVUTISSE hoiule.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: Well, take it out of PC storage, and I'll be happy to exchange it!
et: Võta see ARVUTIST välja, siis vahetan hea meelega!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsInPC
en: May the wind always be at your back on your adventure!
et: Olgu tuul su seiklusel alati selja taga!

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: I'm learning about BIKES while I work here.
et: Siin töötades õpin ma JALGRATASTE kohta kõvasti juurde.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreInBack
en: If you need advice on how to ride your BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in the back.
et: Kui vajad nõu, kuidas oma JALGRATTAGA sõita, on tagaruumis paar käsiraamatut.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.
et: See on MACH BIKE käsiraamat.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovid lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: A BIKE moves in the direction that the + Control Pad is pressed.
et: JALGRATAS liigub suunas, kuhu + Juhtnuppu vajutatakse.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: It will speed up once it gets rolling.
et: See kiireneb, kui veerema hakkab.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: To stop, release the + Control Pad. The BIKE will slow to a stop.
et: Peatumiseks vabasta + Juhtnupp. JALGRATAS aeglustub ja peatub.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't stop very quickly.
et: MACH BIKE on kiire, aga ei suuda väga kiiresti peatuda.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: It gets a little tricky to get around a corner.
et: Nurga taha keeramine on veidi trikiline.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Release the + Control Pad a little before the corner and slow down.
et: Vabasta + Juhtnupp veidi enne nurka ja aeglusta.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMachBike
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: There are small sandy slopes throughout the HOENN region.
et: Kogu HOENNi piirkonnas leidub väikeseid liivanõlvu.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: The loose, crumbly sand makes it impossible to climb normally.
et: Lahtise pudeneva liiva tõttu on võimatu tavapäraselt üles ronida.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can zip up a sandy slope.
et: Aga kui sul on MACH BIKE, saad liivase nõlva üles kihutada.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.
et: See on ACRO BIKE käsiraamat.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookWhichPage
en: Which page do you want to read?
et: Millist lehekülge soovid lugeda?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Press the B Button while riding, and the front wheel lifts up.
et: Vajuta sõites B-nuppu ja esiratas kerkib üles.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: You can zip around with the front wheel up using the + Control Pad.
et: + Juhtnupuga saad esiratas üleval ringi kihutada.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: This technique is called a wheelie.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse tagarattasõiduks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Keeping the B Button pressed, your BIKE can hop on the spot.
et: Hoides B-nuppu all, saab su JALGRATAS paigal hüpelda.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: This technique is called a bunny hop.
et: Seda tehnikat nimetatakse jäneshüppeks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: You can ride while hopping, too.
et: Saad sõita ka hüpeldes.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the B Button and the + Control Pad at the same time to jump.
et: Vajuta korraga B-nuppu ja + Juhtnuppu, et hüpata.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press the + Control Pad to the side to jump sideways.
et: Vajuta + Juhtnuppu küljele, et teha külghüpe.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Press it backwards to make the BIKE change directions while jumping.
et: Vajuta seda tahapoole, et JALGRATAS hüpates suunda muudaks.

label: MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps
en: Want to read a different page?
et: Kas soovid lugeda teist lehekülge?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER.
et: Praegu mind vaadates ei ütleks, aga kunagi olin ma üks kõva TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you!
et: Ma olin siinkandi kõige kõvem BEAUTY — kuulus nimi, ma ütlen sulle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: What is it now? You don't believe me.
et: Mis nüüd on? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented!
et: Ma pole nagu see suurustaja naine seal. Mina olen tegelikult andekas!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves.
et: Lase mul sulle tõestada. Ma oskan õpetada su POKéMONile erilisi ja seejuures nunnusid võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga mu tunnid pole tasuta. Kuidas oleks, kui maksaksid õpetatud võtete eest paari Battle Pointiga?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Buhahaha!
et: Buhahaha!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWelcomeBack
en: Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?
et: Kas tulid tagasi õppima erilisi ja nunnusid POKéMON-võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove
en: Fine, fine, look here! Which move should I teach?
et: Hüva, hüva, vaata siia! Millist võtet peaksin õpetama?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXBattlePoints
en: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?
et: Võte {STR_VAR_1}, jah? See maksab {STR_VAR_2} Battle Pointi, olgu?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToWhichMon
en: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON I should teach the move to.
et: Hüva, hüva, nüüd vali POKéMON, kellele võte õpetada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEnoughPoints
en: What the… You haven't got enough Battle Points!
et: Mida… Sul pole piisavalt Battle Pointe!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattlePoints
en: Do you see how skilled I am now? I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!
et: Kas näed nüüd, kui osav ma olen? Ma võtan su Battle Pointid, aitäh!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: What's that? You don't want to…
et: Mis? Sa ei taha või…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantTo
en: If you want to see how skilled I am, you come see me anytime!
et: Kui tahad näha, kui osav ma olen, tule julgelt millal tahes tagasi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER.
et: Ma tean, et praegu on raske uskuda, aga ma olin kunagi üks fantastiline TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!
et: Ma olin siinkandi kõige võitmatum SWIMMER — seda teadsid kõik, ma ütlen sulle!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: What's wrong? You don't believe me.
et: Mis viga? Sa ei usu mind.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced!
et: Ma pole nagu see totakas naine seal. Mina olen tegelikult kogenud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves.
et: Ma suudan sulle tõestada. Ma oskan õpetada su POKéMONile karme ja seejuures ilusaid võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIntro
en: But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
et: Aga mu tunnid pole tasuta. Kuidas oleks, kui maksaksid õpetatud võtete eest paari Battle Pointiga?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Ihihihi!
et: Ihihihi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWelcomeBack
en: Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?
et: Kas tulid õppima karme ja ilusaid POKéMON-võtteid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along.
et: Kuulates, kuidas need daamid teineteist sõimavad, arvad sa ilmselt, et nad ei saa omavahel läbi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesDontGetAlong
en: But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?
et: Aga kui see nii oleks, ei istuks nad ju siin koos, ega?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful.
et: Kui ma olin veel pisike YOUNGSTER, olid need daamid tugevad ja kaunid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: They were idols among us TRAINERS.
et: Nad olid meie TRAINERITE iidolid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities.
et: Isegi praegu pole aeg nende oskusi nüristanud.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished.
et: Tegelikult on nende POKéMONi võtted muutunud veelgi lihvitumaks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this…
et: Aga… millegipärast ei suuda ma seda mõtet peast saada…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereStrongAndBeautiful
en: Time is so cruel…
et: Aeg on nii julm…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDesc
en: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.
et: Taastab kuni poole kasutaja maksimaalsetest elupunktidest.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossDesc
en: Inflicts damage identical to the user's level.
et: Teeb kahju, mis võrdub kasutaja tasemega.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDesc
en: Recovers half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
et: Taastab poole magavale vaenlasele tehtud kahjust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDesc
en: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.
et: Tugev rusikalöök uskumatu jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc
en: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.
et: Äärmiselt võimas jalalöök tugeva jõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc
en: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
et: Kogu kehaga rammimine, mis võib halvata.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDesc
en: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.
et: Loobitakse suuri rahne. Võib panna võpatama.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc
en: Retaliates any physical hit with double the power.
et: Vastab füüsilisele löögile topeltjõuga.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveDesc
en: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe.
et: Nõrk elektrilöök, mis halvab vaenlase.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceDesc
en: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.
et: Võitlustants, mis tõstab järsult RÜNNAKUT.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlDesc
en: Curls up to conceal weak spots and raise DEFENSE.
et: Keerdub kerra, et varjata nõrku kohti ja tõsta KAITSET.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc
en: A loud attack that can be used only while asleep.
et: Vali rünnak, mida saab kasutada vaid magades.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc
en: Hurls mud in the foe's face to reduce its accuracy.
et: Viskab vaenlasele muda näkku ja vähendab ta täpsust.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc
en: Sprays starshaped rays that never miss.
et: Pihustab tähekujulisi kiiri, mis kunagi mööda ei lähe.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc
en: A chilling attack that lowers the foe's SPEED.
et: Külmutav rünnak, mis langetab vaenlase KIIRUST.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc
en: Endures any attack for 1 turn, leaving 1HP.
et: Peab 1 käigu iga rünnakule vastu, jättes alles 1 elupunkti.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc
en: Copies the foe's effect(s) and gives to the user.
et: Kopeerib vaenlase mõjud ja annab kasutajale.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc
en: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.
et: Jäine rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast külmutada.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunchDesc
en: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.
et: Elektriline rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast halvata.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDesc
en: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.
et: Tuline rusikalöök, mis võib vaenlast põletada.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: Huh? My POKéMON is cute? Sure, I knew that.
et: Ää? Mu POKéMON on armas? Muidugi, seda ma tean küll.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: But if you really want, I'm willing to trade it to you.
et: Aga kui sa väga tahad, olen nõus ta sinuga ära vahetama.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWant
en: I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.
et: Kui tahad, annan sulle oma {STR_VAR_2} ja saan vastu sinu {STR_VAR_1}.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToMyPokemon
en: Eheheh… Please be good to my POKéMON.
et: Ehehee… Palun ole mu POKéMONi vastu hea.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeMonToMe
en: Huh? That doesn't look anything like a {STR_VAR_1} to me.
et: Ää? Minu meelest ei näe see üldse {STR_VAR_1} moodi välja.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToThatsOkay
en: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay. But my POKéMON is cute, you know…
et: Oh, kui sa ei taha, siis pole midagi. Aga mu POKéMON on ikka armas, tead küll…

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBeCute
en: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise it with care and kindness.
et: Iga POKéMON võib olla armas, kui kasvatad teda hoole ja lahkusega.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: In all sorts of places, there are all sorts of POKéMON and people.
et: Igasugustes kohtades on igasuguseid POKéMONe ja inimesi.

label: RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlaces
en: I find that fascinating, so I go to all sorts of places.
et: See paelub mind, nii et ma rändan igale poole.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We don't need a kid around! Go on home already!
et: Mis lapsed siia asja! Mine parem koju!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I want to go home…
et: Ma tahan koju…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: I want to get a promotion so I can boss around the GRUNTS…
et: Ma tahan edutamist, et saaksin REAMEESTELE käske jagada…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: That submarine… It's tiny inside. I'm sore all over!
et: See allveelaev… See on seest tilluke. Mul on üleni valus!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Losing makes me sore!
et: Kaotamine teeb mind pahaseks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: That submarine we jacked, man, it's brutal as a ride. It's way too tight in there!
et: See allveelaev, mille me pihta panime, on sõidu poolest jõhker, mees. Seal sees on lihtsalt liiga kitsas!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: You're the first TRAINER I've seen who deploys POKéMON so masterfully.
et: Sa oled esimene TRAINER, keda ma näinud olen, kes oma POKéMONe nii meisterlikult juhib.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: But, I should tell you--my son is stronger than you.
et: Aga ma pean sulle ütlema – mu poeg on sinust tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySonIsStrongerThanYou
en: He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge, I'll have you know.
et: Tema käis isegi POKéMON LIIGA väljakutsel, tead.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: We use this MACHO BRACE to more effectively strengthen our POKéMON in training.
et: Me kasutame eset MACHO BRACE, et oma POKéMONe treeningus tõhusamalt tugevdada.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_LikeYouToHaveMachoBrace
en: Since you've beaten all of us here, I don't know if you need it, but we would like you to have our MACHO BRACE.
et: Sa võitsid meid siin kõiki, nii et vaevalt sa seda vajad, aga võta meie MACHO BRACE ikkagi endale.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_PassionateAboutBattles
en: When it comes to POKéMON battles, we tend to be pretty passionate.
et: POKéMON-lahingute osas oleme meie peres päris kirglikud.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.
et: Emme on issist tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: I'm stronger than Mommy.
et: Mina olen emmest tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: And Grandma's stronger than me!
et: Ja vanaema on minust tugevam!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_StrongerFamilyMembers
en: But my big brother is even stronger than Grandma.
et: Aga mu suur vend on vanaemastki tugevam.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: There's no question that you're strong.
et: Pole kahtlust, et sa oled tugev.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: But if you were to battle my grandson, you'd end up crying in frustration.
et: Aga kui sa võitleksid mu pojapojaga, jääksid sa lõpuks pettumusest nutma.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He's much stronger than any TRAINER our family knows.
et: Ta on palju tugevam kui ükski TRAINER, keda meie pere teab.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: He must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Praeguseks on ta vist juba POKéMON LIIGA MEISTRI vastu väljas.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrong
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Oma pojapoega tundes võib ta juba MEISTER olla!

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: My grandson must be challenging the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.
et: Mu pojapoeg on praeguseks vist juba POKéMON LIIGA MEISTRI vastu väljas.

label: Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_GrandsonStrongShort
en: Knowing my grandson, he could be the CHAMPION already!
et: Oma pojapoega tundes võib ta juba MEISTER olla!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}? I've heard tales of your exploits.
et: Ah, nii et sina oled {PLAYER}{KUN}? Ma olen kuulnud lugusid su vägitegudest.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: My name is WALLACE.
et: Mu nimi on WALLACE.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: I was once the GYM LEADER of SOOTOPOLIS, but something came up.
et: Ma olin kunagi SOOTOPOLISE SAALI JUHT, aga midagi tuli ette.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: So now, I've entrusted my mentor JUAN with the GYM's operation.
et: Nii et nüüd olen usaldanud SAALI juhtimise oma mentorile JUANILE.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: GROUDON and KYOGRE, the two POKéMON wreaking havoc here, are considered to be super-ancient POKéMON.
et: GROUDONi ja KYOGRET, kaht POKéMONi, kes siin laastavad, peetakse super-iidseteks POKéMONideks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But there aren't just two superancient POKéMON.
et: Aga super-iidseid POKéMONe pole ainult kaks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: There is one more somewhere.
et: Kuskil on veel üks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: Somewhere, there is a superancient POKéMON named RAYQUAZA.
et: Kuskil on super-iidne POKéMON nimega RAYQUAZA.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: It's said that it was RAYQUAZA that becalmed the two combatants in the distant past.
et: Öeldakse, et just RAYQUAZA rahustas kaugminevikus kaks võitlejat.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory
en: But even I have no clue as to RAYQUAZA's whereabouts…
et: Aga isegi mul pole aimu, kus RAYQUAZA asub…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, do you perhaps know where RAYQUAZA is now?
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa ehk tead, kus RAYQUAZA praegu on?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza
en: If you do, please tell me.
et: Kui tead, palun ütle mulle.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN?
et: WALLACE: CAVE OF ORIGIN?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: But that's right here! I need you to do better than that!
et: Aga see ongi siinsamas! Mõtle nüüd paremini!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOrigin
en: Please, I need you to think about where RAYQUAZA might be right now.
et: Palun mõtle järele, kus RAYQUAZA praegu olla võiks.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?
et: WALLACE: MT. PYRE?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: But when I met the old lady there earlier, she made no mention of it.
et: Aga kui ma varem sealse vanaprouaga kohtusin, ei maininud ta seda.

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: I very much doubt that the old lady would try to hide something from me…
et: Ma väga kahtlen, et vanaproua üritaks minu eest midagi varjata…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentionThat
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this more carefully for me?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas mõtleksid minu pärast veel korra hoolega järele?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? Hmm… That's a problem…
et: WALLACE: Ää? Sa ei mäleta? Hmm… See on halb lugu…

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSomehow
en: Can't you remember somehow?
et: Kas sa ei suuda kuidagi meenutada?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR?
et: WALLACE: SKY PILLAR?

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: That's it! It must be the SKY PILLAR!
et: See ongi! See peab olema SKY PILLAR!

label: CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, there's not a moment to lose! We'll head to the SKY PILLAR right away!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, pole hetkegi kaotada! Me suundume kohe SKY PILLARisse!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: The rich atmosphere of the mountain has elevated my psychic power!
et: Mäe rikkalik atmosfäär on tõstnud mu psüühilist väge!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro
en: A mere child like you… You dream of winning?
et: Sinusugune tavaline laps… Sina unistad võidust?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamDefeat
en: I drown in self-pity…
et: Ma uppun enesehaletsusse…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle
en: My psychic powers have surely grown several times, but…
et: Mu psüühilised jõud on kindlasti mitu korda kasvanud, aga…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro
en: This is no place for children, least of all you!
et: See pole koht lastele ja kõige vähem sinule!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaDefeat
en: I lost that cleanly…
et: Ma kaotasin ausalt…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: This means my training is still not enough…
et: See tähendab, et mu treening pole veel piisav…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: I've got to keep working toward the summit…
et: Ma pean tipu poole edasi rühkima…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle
en: Go, me!
et: Edasi, mina!

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleIntro
en: Why have you come here?
et: Miks sa siia tulid?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat
en: That was amazing! You're a very special TRAINER.
et: See oli hämmastav! Sa oled väga eriline TRAINER.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMONid, keda enam pole selles maailmas. POKéMONid, kes on nüüd sinuga.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja POKéMONid, keda kohtad tulevikus…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle
en: They are all to be equally cherished. Please remember that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb ühtviisi kalliks pidada. Palun pea seda meeles.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: I would like to see your POKéMON when they grow up some more…
et: Ma tahaksin näha su POKéMONe, kui nad veidi rohkem kasvavad…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister
en: Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.
et: Palun, mul on vaja näha su POKéNAVi.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Oh, it's you…
et: Oh, see oled sina…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro
en: Have you come to show me your grown POKéMON?
et: Kas tulid mulle oma sirgunud POKéMONe näitama?

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat
en: How amazing! You are a special person.
et: Kui hämmastav! Sa oled eriline inimene.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: POKéMON no longer of this world. POKéMON that are with you now.
et: POKéMONid, keda enam pole selles maailmas. POKéMONid, kes on nüüd sinuga.

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: And the POKéMON that you will meet in the future…
et: Ja POKéMONid, keda kohtad tulevikus…

label: MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch
en: They are all to be equally cherished. I see that you've remembered that.
et: Neid kõiki tuleb ühtviisi kalliks pidada. Ma näen, et oled seda meeles pidanud.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMON hide in tall grass like this, don't they?
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}… POKéMONid peidavad end sellises kõrges rohus, kas pole?

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: Please watch me and see if I can catch one properly.
et: Palun vaata, kas ma suudan ühe korralikult kinni püüda.

label: Route102_Text_WatchMeCatchPokemon
en: …Whoa!
et: …Ohoo!

label: Route102_Text_WallyIDidIt
en: WALLY: I did it… It's my… My POKéMON!
et: WALLY: Ma tegin seda… See on minu… Minu POKéMON!

label: Route102_Text_LetsGoBack
en: {PLAYER}, thank you! Let's go back to the GYM!
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh! Lähme tagasi SAALI!

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right into tall grass.
et: Ma… pole eriti pikka kasvu, nii et kõrges rohus kaon ma lihtsalt ära.

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: The grass goes up my nose and… Fwafwafwafwafwa…
et: Rohi läheb mulle ninna ja… Fvafvafvafvafva…

label: Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall
en: Fwatchoo!
et: Fvatšuu!

label: Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon
en: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of POKéMON!
et: Ma kavatsen püüda terve hunniku POKéMONe!

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignOldale
en: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
et: ROUTE 102 {RIGHT_ARROW} OLDALE LINN

label: Route102_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
en: ROUTE 102 {LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY
et: ROUTE 102 {LEFT_ARROW} PETALBURG LINN

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: DAD: Oh, {PLAYER}?
et: ISA: Oh, {PLAYER}?

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: … … … … … … Where are you now? It sounds windy wherever you are.
et: … … … … … … Kus sa praegu oled? Kuulda on, et seal on tuuline.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: I just heard from DEVON's MR. STONE about your POKéNAV, so I decided to give you a call.
et: Kuulsin just DEVONI MR. STONE käest su POKéNAVIST, nii et otsustasin sulle helistada.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: It sounds like you're doing fine, so that's fine with me.
et: Tundub, et sul läheb hästi — mulle sellest piisab.

label: Route104_Text_DadPokenavCall
en: You take care now.
et: Hoia ennast!

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav
en: Registered DAD NORMAN in the POKéNAV.
et: ISA NORMAN registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
en: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL is crucial.
et: Iga POKéMON-matši jaoks on X SPECIAL ülioluline.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_XSpecialIsCrucial
en: It jacks up the power of some moves even though it's only for one battle.
et: See kruvib mõne võtte jõu lakke, kuigi ainult üheks lahinguks.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
en: They don't seem to sell any winning strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT…
et: Näib, et nad ei müü BATTLE TENTI jaoks mingeid võidustrateegia juhendeid…

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuidesForBattleTent
en: It seems one must rely on one's own wits after all…
et: Näib, et lõpuks tuleb loota oma nutikusele…

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
en: The NEST BALL works better on weakened POKéMON.
et: NEST PALL toimib paremini nõrgestatud POKéMONide peal.

label: VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnWeakenedPokemon
en: VERDANTURF is the only place you can buy it.
et: VERDANTURF on ainuke koht, kust seda osta saab.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.
et: WALLACE olevat kuulu järgi kogu HOENNI piirkonna kõvim TRAINER.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER who taught WALLACE.
et: Selle linna SAALI juhib TRAINER, kes WALLACET õpetas.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.
et: Aga ELIITNELIK… Nad olevat veel tugevamad kui WALLACE õpetaja.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WallaceToughestInHoenn
en: How strong could they be?
et: Kui tugevad nad küll olla võivad?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
en: Everyone in town has taken refuge and won't come out of their homes.
et: Kõik linnas on varjule läinud ega tule oma kodudest välja.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryoneTakenRefuge
en: Even I would rather not venture outside.
et: Isegi mina ei riskiks praegu õue minna.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
en: Whenever, wherever, and whatever happens, I will always be friends with POKéMON.
et: Millal iganes, kus iganes ja mis iganes juhtub, ma jään alati POKéMONidega sõbraks.

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AlwaysBeFriendsWithPokemon
en: Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!
et: Sest POKéMONidega olla on lõbus!

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
en: Aren't POKéMON our friends?
et: Kas POKéMONid pole meie sõbrad?

label: SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ArentPokemonOurFriends
en: Why are they going wild this way?
et: Miks nad nõnda metsikult käituvad?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro
en: I don't have a bone to pick with you. I'm just following orders!
et: Mul pole sinuga kana kitkuda. Ma lihtsalt täidan käske!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Defeat
en: I may have lost, but…
et: Ma võisin kaotada, aga…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
en: We dug up something beyond belief! And, we got the BLUE ORB!
et: Me kaevasime välja midagi uskumatut! Ja me saime BLUE ORBi!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattle
en: All that's left is for our leader to… Fufufu… Fwahahaha!
et: Nüüd on jäänud veel ainult see, et meie juht… Fufufu… Fvahahaha!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've joined TEAM AQUA instead…
et: Ma ei talu kuumust. Võib-olla oleksin pidanud hoopis TEAM AQUAGA liituma…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat
en: Yeah, I really may not be right for TEAM MAGMA…
et: Jah, ma tõesti ei pruugi TEAM MAGMALE sobida…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: Don't you get lonely for the sea being in a place like this?
et: Kas sellises kohas ei hakka merest puudust tundma?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: You can hear tremors here sometimes.
et: Siin võib vahel tunda värinaid.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Could it be the volcano rattling? Or is it GROU…
et: Kas see on vulkaan, mis müriseb? Või hoopis GROU…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Whoops! No, no, never mind!
et: Uups! Ei, ei, pole midagi!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat
en: You're a fiery battler. Just like a volcano!
et: Sa oled tuline võitleja. Just nagu vulkaan!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: You just happened to win this time, but that doesn't matter.
et: Sa lihtsalt juhtusid seekord võitma, aga see pole tähtis.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: TEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be reached!
et: TEAM MAGMA eesmärk saab kohe täidetud!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: One of our guys was freaking out that he lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…
et: Üks meie tüüpidest oli endast väljas, et kaotas oma MAGMA EMBLEMi…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: Wait a minute! Was it you who found it?
et: Oota hetk! Kas see olid sina, kes selle leidis?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Defeat
en: I'm having trouble believing this…
et: Mul on raske seda uskuda…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
en: I'm getting this feeling that our plan is going to end in failure…
et: Mul tekib tunne, et meie plaan lõppeb läbikukkumisega…

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
en: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!
et: FORTREE puumajad on suurepärased!

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGreat
en: I think it's the number one town for living together with POKéMON.
et: Ma arvan, et see on POKéMONidega koos elamiseks number üks linn.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
en: POKéMON and people have adapted to nature for survival.
et: POKéMONid ja inimesed on ellujäämiseks loodusega kohanenud.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature
en: There's no need to make nature conform to the way we want to live.
et: Pole mingit vajadust painutada loodust oma elu järgi.

label: FortreeCity_House5_Text_Zigzagoon
en: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!
et: ZIGZAGOON: Bufuu!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: I understand everything our leader says. But you know what?
et: Ma mõistan kõike, mida meie juht ütleb. Aga tead mis?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: Doing stuff like digging up a superancient POKéMON and ripping off someone's METEORITE…
et: Kaevame välja super-iidse POKéMONi, näppame kelleltki eseme METEORITE…

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro
en: I think we're going a little too far. What do you think?
et: Ma arvan, et me läheme veidi liiga kaugele. Mida sina arvad?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat
en: Yeah, I think we are doing something wrong somehow.
et: Jah, ma arvan, et me teeme kuidagi midagi valesti.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
en: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.
et: Tead, sulle kaotamine tegi mu meele selgeks.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattle
en: The next time I see our leader, I'm going to ask him about what we do.
et: Järgmine kord, kui ma oma juhti näen, küsin ma temalt, mida me õieti teeme.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature.
et: Mu POKéMONil on TORMAKAS loomus.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: It has higher SPEED compared to my other POKéMON.
et: Tema KIIRUS on mu teiste POKéMONide omast suurem.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithStatGains
en: Maybe their nature has something to do with the stat gains of POKéMON.
et: Ehk on nende loomusel midagi pistmist POKéMONide näitajate kasvuga.

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
en: You're a TRAINER, aren't you?
et: Sa oled TRAINER, kas pole?

label: SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBattleTent
en: Since you came to SLATEPORT CITY, you must be going to the BATTLE TENT.
et: Kui sa juba SLATEPORT LINNA tulid, siis kindlasti lähed BATTLE TENTI.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
en: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM.
et: Tere tulemast OCEANIC MUSEUMisse.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldYouLikeToEnter
en: The entrance fee is ¥50. Would you like to enter?
et: Sissepääsutasu on ¥50. Kas sooviksid siseneda?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: Please enjoy yourself.
et: Palun tunne end hästi.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to have enough money.
et: Oh? Vabandust, aga näib, et sul pole piisavalt raha.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
en: Oh? You're with that group that went in earlier?
et: Oh? Kas sa kuulud sellesse gruppi, kes enne sisse läks?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CatchUpWithYourGroup
en: You're the only one who's late. You'd better go catch up to them!
et: Sina oled ainus, kes hiljaks jäi. Kiirusta neile järele!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_AquaExistForGoodOfAll
en: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good of all!
et: Meie, TEAM AQUA, tegutseme kõigi hüvanguks!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
en: We were told to assemble here, so we did, but…
et: Meil kästi siia koguneda ja me tulimegi, aga…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurBossIsntHere
en: Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.
et: Meie BOSSI, kogu asja hinge, pole kohal.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WouldStuffHereMakeMeRich
en: If I ripped off the stuff here, would it make me rich?
et: Kui ma siinsed asjad pihta paneksin, kas saaksin rikkaks?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanLearnForNefariousDeeds
en: What I learn here, I can put to use on nefarious deeds…
et: Mida ma siin õpin, selle võin panna tööle kurjade tegude heaks…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RustboroBungled
en: If our goons didn't bungle things in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!
et: Kui meie mehed poleks RUSTBORO LINNAS asja untsu ajanud, poleks me praegu siin!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DidntHaveMoney
en: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long time getting by the receptionist.
et: Mul polnud ¥50, nii et läks tükk aega, enne kui registratuurist mööda sain.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_LearnAboutSeaForBattling
en: I want to learn about the sea and use that knowledge for battling.
et: Ma tahan merest rohkem teada saada ja neid teadmisi lahingus kasutada.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
en: I get all giddy and gooey when I see the sea!
et: Kui ma merd näen, läheb mul pea ringi ja süda pehmeks!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_SternIsRoleModel
en: For me, CAPT. STERN is the number one role model!
et: Minu jaoks on CAPT. STERN eeskuju number üks!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
en: The sea is vast without end, and infinitely deep…
et: Meri on lõputult avar ja põhjatult sügav…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_MustBePokemonWeDontKnow
en: There must be many POKéMON that we don't know about.
et: Seal peab olema veel palju POKéMONe, keda me üldse ei tunne.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
en: I want a sea POKéMON.
et: Ma tahan mere-POKéMONi.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WantSeaPokemon
en: I think it would feel cool and nice to hug.
et: Arvan, et teda oleks jahe ja mõnus kallistada.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Aiyeeeh! What are you doing here?
et: Aiiih! Mida sina siin teed?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member you thumped before, remember? Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL?
et: Mina? Ma olen see TEAM AQUA liige, keda sa RUSTURF TUNNELIS kolkisid, mäletad?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_RememberMeTakeThis
en: Here, take this! You have to forgive me!
et: Säh, võta see! Sa pead mulle andestama!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
en: That TM, it suits you more than it does me.
et: See TM sobib sulle rohkem kui mulle.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_HopeINeverSeeYouAgain
en: Hope I never see you again! Wahahaha!
et: Loodetavasti ei näe ma sind enam kunagi! Vahahahaa!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouHaveToTakeThis
en: Awww, come on! You have to take this and let me go!
et: Ohh, no kuule! Võta see ära ja lase mind minema!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
en: A blue fluid is spiraling inside a glass vessel.
et: Klaasnõus keerleb sinine vedelik spiraalis.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WhirlpoolExperiment
en: “This is an experiment to create a WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”
et: „See on katse tekitada tuule abil kunstlik VEEKEERIS.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
en: A red ball is bobbing up and down inside a glass vessel.
et: Klaasnõu sees hüpleb üles-alla punane kuul.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_WaterfallExperiment
en: “This is an experiment simulating a WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”
et: „See on katse, kus kuuli üleslükkejõud jäljendab KOSKE.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: It's a sample of soil from the ocean floor.
et: See on mullaproov ookeani põhjast.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: “Over many years, the remains of life-forms settle at the bottom of the sea, making sedimentary layers.
et: „Aastate jooksul settivad elusolendite jäänused merepõhja ja moodustavad settekihte.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanSoilDisplay
en: “By analyzing these layers, the ancient past is revealed.”
et: „Neid kihte uurides avaneb pilk muistsesse minevikku.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: It's a sample of beach sand.
et: See on rannaliiva proov.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: “Stones from mountains are washed down by rivers where they are chipped and ground down.
et: „Jõed uhuvad mägedest pärit kivid alla ning kulutavad ja jahvatavad neid teel.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_BeachSandDisplay
en: “They are reduced to grains and end up as sand on beaches.”
et: „Nad pudenevad teradeks ja jõuavad lõpuks liivana randa.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 1 Why is seawater blue?
et: „OOKEANI MINIFAKT 1 Miks on merevesi sinine?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “Light is composed of many colors.
et: „Valgus koosneb paljudest värvidest.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “When light passes through water, most kinds of light lose color.
et: „Vees liikudes kaotab enamik valgusliike oma värvi.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact1
en: “However, blue light retains its color, making the sea appear blue.”
et: „Sinine valgus aga säilitab oma värvi ja seetõttu paistab meri sinine.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 2 Why is the sea salty?
et: „OOKEANI MINIFAKT 2 Miks on meri soolane?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “Seawater contains dissolved salt in the form of sodium and chlorine ions.
et: „Merevesi sisaldab lahustunud soola naatriumi- ja klooriioonidena.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “These ions leech out of rocks and are carried out to sea by rain.
et: „Need ioonid leostuvad kivimitest ja vihm kannab need merre.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact2
en: “The concentration of dissolved salt makes the sea salty.”
et: „Just lahustunud sool teebki mere soolaseks.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 3 Which is bigger? The sea or land?
et: „OOKEANI MINIFAKT 3 Kumb on suurem? Meri või maismaa?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “The sea covers about 70% of the planet, and the rest is land.
et: „Meri katab umbes 70% planeedist, ülejäänu on maismaa.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OceanicMinifact3
en: “The sea is therefore more than twice the size of land.”
et: „Nii on meri maismaast rohkem kui kaks korda suurem.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it.
et: See on fossiil, millel on lainelised vaod.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured by the tide.
et: „Ookeanipõhja mulda uhub loodete vool.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “The flowing seawater marks the soil with small ridges and valleys.
et: „Voolav merevesi jätab pinnasesse väikesed vaod ja harjad.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_FossilDisplay
en: “If this soil becomes fossilized, it is called a ripple mark.”
et: „Kui selline pinnas kivistub, nimetatakse seda lainejäljeks.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
en: A strange machine is rotating under a glass dome.
et: Klaaskupli all pöörleb üks veider masin.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_DepthMeasuringMachine
en: Maybe it's for measuring the depth of something…
et: Ehk mõõdab see millegi sügavust…

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
en: People… POKéMON…
et: Inimesed… POKéMONid…

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArousedByNature
en: Their hidden powers are aroused by living in natural environments…
et: Looduse keskel elamine äratab neis peidus oleva jõu…

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: Let this old woman see if your hidden power has awoken…
et: Las see vanaeit vaatab, kas sinu peidetud jõud on ärganud…

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: I hold a coin in my hand.
et: Ma hoian käes münti.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand
en: Now, tell me, have I palmed it in the right hand? Or in the left?
et: Ütle nüüd, kummas käes ma seda peidan? Paremas või vasakus?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: Oh! Yes, correct!
et: Oh! Jah, õige!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: We shall try again.
et: Proovime veel kord.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand
en: In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?
et: Kummas käes on münt? Paremas või vasakus?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: Oh! Yes, correct!
et: Oh! Jah, õige!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: We shall try again.
et: Proovime veel kord.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainWhichHand2
en: In which hand have I palmed the coin? The right or left?
et: Kummas käes on münt? Paremas või vasakus?

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
en: Oh! Splendid! Your hidden power has awoken!
et: Oh! Suurepärane! Su peidetud jõud on ärganud!

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerHasAwoken
en: Here, take this and awaken the hidden power of your POKéMON.
et: Säh, võta see ja ärata oma POKéMONi peidetud jõud.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainHiddenPower
en: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes with the POKéMON.
et: HIDDEN POWER on võte, mis on igal POKéMONil isesugune.

label: FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong
en: No, too bad. You guessed wrong.
et: Ei, kahju küll. Arvasid valesti.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
en: This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS.
et: See on TRAINER HILL, kus saad pidada paarislahinguid paljude TRAINERITEGA.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingReady
en: Unfortunately, we're still getting things ready. Please come back later!
et: Kahjuks käivad meil veel ettevalmistused. Tule palun hiljem tagasi!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
en: Welcome!
et: Tere tulemast!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrainerHill
en: This is the TRAINER HILL where you may enjoy tag battles with many TRAINERS!
et: See on TRAINER HILL, kus saad pidada paarislahinguid paljude TRAINERITEGA!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
en: Is this your first visit here?
et: Kas oled siin esimest korda?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBeforeEnter
en: Before you enter, please save your game.
et: Enne sisenemist salvesta palun oma mäng.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
en: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are…
et: Vaatame… Praegu on siin TRAINEREID…

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFloorX
en: Up to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Kuni {STR_VAR_1}. korruseni.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
en: Let's see… The TRAINERS here now are…
et: Vaatame… Praegu on siin TRAINEREID…

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEveryRoom
en: There appear to be TRAINERS gathered in every room.
et: Näib, et TRAINEREID on kogunenud igasse ruumi.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChallengeTrainers
en: Would you like to challenge the waiting TRAINERS?
et: Kas soovid ootavatele TRAINERITELE väljakutse esitada?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: I will time your progress. Best of luck!
et: Ma võtan su aja. Palju edu!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: On your marks…
et: Kohtadele…

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: Get set…
et: Valmis olla…

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGetSetGo
en: Go!
et: Läks!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_PleaseVisitUsAgain
en: Please do visit us again!
et: Tule meile kindlasti jälle külla!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: That was too bad.
et: Kahju küll.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: I think you put in a tremendous effort in your battling.
et: Minu meelest andsid sa lahingutes endast kõik.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendousEffort
en: Please come back and try again!
et: Tule tagasi ja proovi uuesti!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest
en: I hope you give it your best.
et: Loodan, et annad endast parima.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: When the TRAINERS switch places, the movement can be hectic.
et: Kui TRAINERID kohti vahetavad, läheb siin päris sagimiseks.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: To avoid the stampede, we moved the reception counter here.
et: Tunglemise vältimiseks kolisime vastuvõtuleti siia.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReceptionHereForSwitch
en: I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
et: Vabandame ebamugavuste pärast.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing!
et: Aitäh mängimast!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct an event called the Time Attack.
et: Siin TRAINER HILLis korraldame üritust nimega Ajarünnak.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: It is a race that measures how long you take to reach our owner on the rooftop from this counter.
et: See on võidujooks: mõõdame, kui kaua sul kulub siit letist katusel ootava omanikuni.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: The fastest times are posted on the Time Board--try competing with your friends.
et: Kiireimad ajad pannakse Ajatahvlile — proovi sõpradega võistelda!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainerHill
en: In TRAINER battles along the way, neither Exp. Points nor money will be awarded.
et: Teel peetavate TRAINERI-lahingute eest ei anta kogemuspunkte ega raha.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
en: Oh, I'm sorry, but you appear to have only one POKéMON with you.
et: Oh, vabandust, aga sul näib kaasas olevat vaid üks POKéMON.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_NeedAtLeastTwoPokemon
en: You will need at least two POKéMON to enter this event.
et: Sellele üritusele pääsemiseks on vaja vähemalt kahte POKéMONi.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Hm! Hm!
et: Hm! Hm!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You finally came! Yes, you have arrived!
et: Sa tulid lõpuks! Jah, sa oled kohal!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Wait! Don't say it! I know why you came all the way here by yourself!
et: Oot! Ära ütle! Ma tean, miks sa kogu selle tee omapäi siia tulid!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You wanted to see me, the owner of the TRAINER HILL, because…
et: Sa tahtsid näha mind, TRAINER HILLi omanikku, sest…

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: You want to form a tag team with me! Wa-hoo!
et: Sa tahad minuga paari lüüa! Uuhuu!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: …Uh? That's not it?
et: …Ää? Ei ole või?

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouFinallyCameBravo
en: Anyway, I watched you on your way up. Marvelous battling! Bravo, indeed!
et: Igatahes, ma jälgisin sind üles tulles. Imeline võitlus! Braavo, tõesti!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_HaveTheMostMarvelousGift
en: For a marvelous someone like you, I have the most marvelous gift!
et: Sinusuguse imelise inimese jaoks on mul kõige imelisem kingitus!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_FullUpBeBackLaterForThis
en: Oh, no, full up with things! You'll be back later for this!
et: Oo ei, kott on asju täis! Tule sellele hiljem järele!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: Oh, hold on here! Did you possibly get here marvelously quickly?
et: Oh, oota korraks! Kas sa jõudsid siia imeliselt kiiresti?

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: How splendid! You needn't have hurried so to see me!
et: Kui suurepärane! Poleks pidanud minu pärast nii kiirustama!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_GotHereMarvelouslyQuickly
en: That is so delightful. I'll have the Time Board at the reception updated!
et: See on nii tore! Lasen vastuvõtus Ajatahvli ära uuendada!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_YouWerentVeryQuick
en: But, oh… You weren't very quick getting here.
et: Aga oh… Väga kiiresti sa siia küll ei jõudnud.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Perhaps it would please me more if you arrived zippier next time.
et: Järgmine kord võiksid nobedamini kohal olla — see rõõmustaks mind rohkem.

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Then, I should be pleased to form a tag team with you!
et: Siis lööksin sinuga hea meelega paari!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_ArriveZippierNextTime
en: Until we meet again, amigo!
et: Kohtumiseni, amigo!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
en: I had the TRAINER HILL built for but one reason and one only!
et: Ma lasin TRAINER HILLi ehitada vaid ühel ainsal põhjusel!

label: TrainerHill_Roof_Text_BuiltTrainerHillToFindPartner
en: To find the most suitable partner with whom I may form a tag team!
et: Et leida kõige sobivam kaaslane, kellega paari lüüa!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ChallengeTime
en: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sec.
et: {STR_VAR_1} min. {STR_VAR_2}.{STR_VAR_3} sek.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
en: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS and POKéMON combos are ahead?
et: Kes teab, millised TRAINERID ja POKéMONid meid ees ootavad?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrainersAreAhead
en: All I know is that I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!
et: Üht ma tean: ma löön kõrvale igaühe, kes mulle ette jääb!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this TRAINER HILL from all over.
et: Kuulsin, et siia TRAINER HILLi tuleb kõvasid TRAINEREID kõikjalt.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I can't wait to test the waters!
et: Ma ei jõua ära oodata, et oma jõudu proovile panna!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTestTheWaters
en: I'll knock aside anyone that stands in my way!
et: Ma löön kõrvale igaühe, kes mulle ette jääb!

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
en: Do you see the Time Board over there?
et: Kas näed seal Ajatahvlit?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingToReachTimeBoardTop
en: My friends and I are trying to see who can reach the top in the least time.
et: Mina ja mu sõbrad võistleme, kes jõuab kõige kiiremini tippu.

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
en: Do you know when they're opening this place up?
et: Kas sa tead, millal see koht avatakse?

label: TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenTheyOpen
en: I'm waiting here to be the first challenger ever!
et: Ma ootan siin, et olla kõige esimene väljakutsuja!

label: TrainerHill_Elevator_Text_ReturnToReception
en: Would you like to return to the reception counter?
et: Kas soovid vastuvõtuleti juurde tagasi minna?

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
en: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up. Would you like to be on it?
et: KÖISRAUDTEE on valmis üles sõitma. Kas tahad peale astuda?

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way.
et: Astu palun siiapoole.

label: Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
en: Please ride with us another time.
et: Sõida meiega mõni teine kord.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
en: First, we will hold your POKéMON for safekeeping.
et: Kõigepealt võtame su POKéMONid hoiule.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_HoldMonsChooseFromSelection
en: You may then choose from our selection of POKéMON.
et: Seejärel võid valida meie POKéMONide seast.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LetUsRestoreMons
en: Thank you for competing! Let us restore your POKéMON!
et: Aitäh võistlemast! Lase meil su POKéMONid terveks ravida!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
en: The 2nd match is next! Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 2. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
en: The 3rd match is next! Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 3. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
en: The 4th match is next! Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 4. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
en: The 5th match is next! Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 5. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
en: The 6th match is next! Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena 6. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
en: Finally, the 7th match is next! Are you ready?
et: Ja lõpuks 7. matš! Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja lõpetada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Battle Swap challenge?
et: Kas soovid Battle Swap väljakutsest loobuda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_InvestigatedUpcomingOpponent
en: I've conducted a little investigation about your upcoming opponent.
et: Ma uurisin su järgmise vastase kohta veidi järele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInNormalType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the NORMAL type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav TAVA-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFireType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FIRE type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav TULE-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInWaterType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the WATER type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav VEE-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInElectricType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ELECTRIC type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav ELEKTRI-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGrassType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GRASS type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav ROHU-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInIceType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ICE type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav JÄÄ-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFightingType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FIGHTING type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav KAKLUS-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInPoisonType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the POISON type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav MÜRGI-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGroundType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GROUND type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav MAA-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInFlyingType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the FLYING type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav LENDAVAT tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInPsychicType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the PSYCHIC type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav VAIMSET tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInBugType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the BUG type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav PUTUKA-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInRockType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the ROCK type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav KIVI-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInGhostType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the GHOST type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav KUMMITUSE-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInDragonType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the DRAGON type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav DRAAKONI-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInDarkType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the DARK type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav PIMEDUSE-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerSkilledInSteelType
en: The TRAINER is apparently skilled in the handling of the STEEL type.
et: Paistab, et see TRAINER on osav TERAS-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_TrainerHasNoClearFavorite
en: The TRAINER appears to have no clear favorites when it comes to type.
et: Paistab, et sellel TRAINERil pole ühtki kindlat lemmiktüüpi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleSlowAndSteady
en: The favorite battle style appears to be slow and steady.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat aeglane ja kindel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleEndurance
en: The favorite battle style appears to be one of endurance.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat vastupidavuse peale mängimine.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleHighRisk
en: The favorite battle style appears to be high risk, high return.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat suur risk, suur tulu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleDependsOnFlow
en: The favorite battle style appears to depend on the battle's flow.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab sõltuvat lahingu kulust.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleTotalPreparation
en: The favorite battle style appears to be one based on total preparation.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat põhjalik ettevalmistus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleWeakenFoe
en: The favorite battle style appears to be weakening the foe to start.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat vastase esmalt nõrgestamine.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleFlexible
en: The favorite battle style appears to be flexibly adaptable to the situation.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat paindlik kohanemine olukorraga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleImpossibleToPredict
en: The favorite battle style appears to be impossible to predict.
et: Tema lemmikstiili on võimatu ette aimata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_StyleUnrestrained
en: The favorite battle style appears to be free-spirited and unrestrained.
et: Tema lemmikstiil paistab olevat vaba ja ohjeldamatu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_LikeToSwapMon
en: Before starting the battle, would you like to swap a POKéMON?
et: Kas soovid enne lahingu algust POKéMONi vahetada?
