label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_YourSwapIsComplete
en: Thank you! Your POKéMON swap is complete.
et: Aitäh! POKéMONi vahetus on tehtud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
en: Right this way, please!
et: Palun siiapoole!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
en: I am saving your data. Please wait.
et: Salvestan su andmed. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLatestBattle
en: Would you like to record your latest battle on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase lahingu FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_WaitFewMoments
en: Excuse me! Excuse me, please! May I get you to wait a few moments?
et: Vabandust! Vabandust, palun! Kas ootaksid hetke?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_UnderstoodSirWillDo
en: …Uh-huh? What?! …Whoa! Understood, sir! Will do!
et: …Ähää? Mida?! …Ohoo! Selge, härra! Teen ära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: Oh, my… Sorry to keep you waiting!
et: Oh heldeke… Vabandust, et ootama pidid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: I have a message from this facility's boss, the FACTORY HEAD.
et: Selle rajatise boss FACTORY HEAD saatis sulle sõnumi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_MessageFromHeadComeRightNow
en: He says, “We're going to do it! Come here right now!”
et: Ta ütleb: „Me teeme selle ära! Tule kohe siia!”

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_PreparedToFaceHead
en: The FACTORY HEAD is demanding you. Are you prepared to face him?
et: FACTORY HEAD nõuab sind enda ette. Kas oled valmis talle vastu astuma?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryPreBattleRoom_Text_CantTellAnythingAboutHead
en: I'm terribly sorry, but I can't tell you anything about the FACTORY HEAD.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju, aga FACTORY HEADi kohta ma sulle midagi öelda ei tohi.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: SCOTT: Well, hi, hi! {PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: SCOTT: No tere, tere! {PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Something's come up, so I have to disembark, but am I glad to see you!
et: Mul tuli midagi ette ja pean maha minema, aga küll on hea meel sind näha!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Congratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION!
et: Palju õnne, LIIGA MEISTER!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: There's a place I'd like to invite someone like you.
et: On üks koht, kuhu tahaksin sinusuguse kutsuda.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: It's the… BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: See on… BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: What's the place like? You'll understand when you see it!
et: Milline koht see on? Saad aru, kui oma silmaga näed!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: I've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN about this.
et: Ma olen sellest laeva KAPTENIGA rääkinud.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: The next time you take a ferry, you should be able to sail to the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Järgmine kord praamile astudes peaksid saama sõita BATTLE FRONTIERisse.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontierInvite
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you at the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: Olgu, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma ootan sind BATTLE FRONTIERis!

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: This ferry is built to plow through fast-running currents.
et: See praam on ehitatud kiiretest hoovustest läbi murdma.

label: SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: We hope you enjoy your voyage with us. Feel free to explore the ship.
et: Loodame, et reis meiega meeldib. Uuri julgelt laeva ringi.

label: SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage
en: We hope you enjoy your voyage on our ferry.
et: Loodame, et reis meie praamil meeldib sulle.

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport
en: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.
et: Oleme maabunud SLATEPORT LINNAS. Aitäh, et meiega sõitsid.

label: SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInLilycove
en: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY. Thank you for sailing with us.
et: Oleme maabunud LILYCOVE LINNAS. Aitäh, et meiega sõitsid.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: It'll be some time before we make land, I reckon.
et: Läheb vist veel tükk aega, enne kui maale jõuame.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: You can rest up in your cabin if you'd like. Your cabin's No. 2.
et: Kui tahad, võid oma kajutis puhata. Sinu kajut on number 2.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2
en: The bed in there is soft and plushy. I can attest to how comfy it is!
et: Seal on pehme ja kohev voodi. Võin kinnitada, kui mugav see on!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_WeveArrived
en: We've arrived!
et: Oleme kohal!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins
en: Go visit other cabins. TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will be itching to battle.
et: Käi teistes kajutites. Laevasõidust tüdinud TRAINERID kibelevad lahingut lööma.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_EnjoyYourCruise
en: Enjoy your cruise!
et: Naudi reisi!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyondPorthole
en: The horizon spreads beyond the porthole.
et: Illuminaatori taga laiub silmapiir.

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MR. BRINEY: Tere tulemast pardale, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: They made me honorary captain of the S.S. TIDAL!
et: Minust tehti laeva S.S. TIDAL aukapten!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!
et: Nüüd võid mind kutsuda: CAPTAIN BRINEY!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: You know, I retired once before, but when I saw this majestic ship…
et: Tead, ma olin juba kord pensionil, aga kui ma seda uhket laeva nägin…

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard
en: Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping soul as a sailor!
et: Ütleme nii, et see äratas minus magava meremehehinge!

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Peeko
en: PEEKO: Pihyo pihyohyo…
et: PEEKO: Pihüo pihüohüo…

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin1
en: Cabin 1
et: Kajut 1

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin2
en: Cabin 2
et: Kajut 2

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin3
en: Cabin 3
et: Kajut 3

label: SSTidalCorridor_Text_Cabin4
en: Cabin 4
et: Kajut 4

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: If it doesn't like a certain move, a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it.
et: Kui mõni võte POKéMONile ei meeldi, kasutab ta seda vastumeelselt.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: It doesn't matter how strong it is, either.
et: Ja pole tähtis, kui tugev see võte on.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE nature probably won't enjoy hurting its opponents.
et: Näiteks GENTLE loomusega POKéMONile ilmselt ei meeldi vastastele haiget teha.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MonsReluctantToUseDislikedMoves
en: If it can't seem to live up to its potential, it's probably failing at using a disliked move against its will.
et: Kui ta ei suuda oma võimeid välja mängida, on ta ilmselt sunnitud kasutama võtet, mis talle ei meeldi.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
en: My big sister is gentle usually. But when she gets angry, she's really, really scary!
et: Mu suur õde on tavaliselt tasane. Aga kui ta vihastab, on ta tõesti kohutavalt hirmus!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_GentleMonsScaryIfAngry
en: I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary if it gets angry!
et: Vean kihla, et tasane POKéMON on vihasena ka hirmus!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: My feelings toward my POKéMON… The attraction runs deep…
et: Mu tunded oma POKéMONide vastu… Kiindumus on sügav…

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: Oh, hi, you didn't see that, did you? Well, it doesn't matter.
et: Oi, tere! Sa ei näinud seda ju? Noh, pole tähtis.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionRunsDeep
en: How would you like this TM for your POKéMON?
et: Kas võtaksid selle TM oma POKéMONile?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
en: My feelings toward my POKéMON… I'm sure the attraction is mutual!
et: Mu tunded oma POKéMONide vastu… Olen kindel, et kiindumus on vastastikune!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_AttractionMutual
en: They battle exactly the way I want them to!
et: Nad võitlevad täpselt nii, nagu ma tahan!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
en: What kind of moves have you taught your POKéMON?
et: Milliseid võtteid oled oma POKéMONidele õpetanud?

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_TaughtWhatKindsOfMoves
en: I think you would give yourself an advantage if they knew how to heal or protect themselves.
et: Arvan, et saaksid eelise, kui nad oskaksid end ravida või kaitsta.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I thought I might see you here.
et: SCOTT: Tere-tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mõtlesin, et võin sind siit leida.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: A BATTLE TENT's a place where you can meet tough TRAINERS.
et: BATTLE TENT on koht, kus kohtad kõvasid TRAINEREID.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: It doesn't matter what the rules are, or how battles are waged, either.
et: Ja pole tähtis, millised on reeglid või kuidas lahinguid peetakse.

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottCanMeetToughTrainers
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do the best you can!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma ootan, et annaksid endast parima!

label: VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_ScottVisitRegularly
en: SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes of seeing tough TRAINERS in action in whatever the situation.
et: SCOTT: Käin siin tihti, lootuses näha kõvasid TRAINEREID tegutsemas, olgu olukord milline tahes.

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
en: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of cleaning this huge place!
et: Arrrgh! Mul on kõrini ja olen koerväsinud selle tohutu koha küürimisest!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro
en: Let's have a quick battle!
et: Lööme kiire lahingu!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipDefeat
en: Little bro, I lost!
et: Väikevend, ma kaotasin!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
en: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!
et: Me oleme KORISTUSVENNAD!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle
en: The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!
et: Vanem kallab pesuainet ja noorem küürib!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro
en: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. There's plenty of room. It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.
et: See on laeva trümmi põhi. Ruumi on küllaga. POKéMON-lahinguks sobib hästi.

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardDefeat
en: Big bro, I lost!
et: Vanem vend, ma kaotasin!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
en: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!
et: Me oleme KORISTUSVENNAD!

label: SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle
en: The old one dumps the detergent, and the young one does the scrubbing!
et: Vanem kallab pesuainet ja noorem küürib!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: Which CONTEST are you entering? Want a piece of advice?
et: Millisele VÕISTLUSELE sa lähed? Tahad nõu?

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: In any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE CONTEST, I don't think they judge you only on cuteness in the first round.
et: Võta näiteks ARMAS VÕISTLUS: minu arust ei hinnata esimeses voorus ainult armsust.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_WhichContestYouEntering
en: You need to work out ways for raising POKéMON better.
et: Pead välja mõtlema, kuidas POKéMONe paremini kasvatada.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.
et: Ma kasvatasin oma POKéMONi armsaks.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I found out you can put POKéMON in a CONTEST for cuteness!
et: Sain teada, et POKéMONiga saab minna armsuse VÕISTLUSELE!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeCute
en: I'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with loving care…
et: Mul on nii hea meel, et kasvatasin oma POKéMONi armastuse ja hoolega…

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: My POKéMON rules!
et: Mu POKéMON on lihtsalt võimas!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: It's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute, and smart. It's complete!
et: Ta on lahe, kõva ja ilus, armas ning tark. Täiuslik!

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_MyMonRules
en: I may as well go for wins in every single CONTEST.
et: Võin sama hästi minna igalt VÕISTLUSELT võitu püüdma.

label: VerdanturfTown_ContestHall_Text_NormalRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS NORMAL RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON KONKURSSIDE NORMAALSE RANGI LAVA!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE. But you can call me MR. SEA!
et: Mina olen SEASHORE HOUSE omanik. Aga kutsu mind lihtsalt MR. SEA!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: What I love above all is to see hot POKéMON battles.
et: Üle kõige armastan ma vaadata tuliseid POKéMON-lahinguid.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: Let me see that your heart burns hot!
et: Näita mulle, et su süda põleb tulikuumalt!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHouseIntro
en: If you can defeat all the TRAINERS here, I'll reward your efforts.
et: Kui suudad kõik siinsed TRAINERID alistada, tasun su vaeva eest.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
en: Show me some hot matches!
et: Näita mulle tuliseid lahinguid!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHotMatches
en: I run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for that reason alone!
et: SEASHORE HOUSE ongi mul ainuüksi selle jaoks!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: You're scorching hot! Those battles blazed! I'm more than just satisfied!
et: Sa oled kõrvetavalt kuum! Need lahingud lõõmasid! Ma olen rohkem kui rahul!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: As thanks for showing me your hot streak, I want you to take these.
et: Tänuks selle tulise esituse eest tahan, et sa need vastu võtaksid.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSodaPopBottles
en: It's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!
et: Terve pool tosinat pudelit SODA POPi!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull
en: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full. I'll hang on to these for you.
et: Oi, aga kuule, su KOTT on puupüsti täis. Ma hoian need sulle alles.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
en: Want to buy some SODA POP? POKéMON love it!
et: Tahad SODA POPi osta? POKéMONid jumaldavad seda!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySodaPop
en: Just ¥300 a bottle! Buy some!
et: Vaid ¥300 pudel! Osta mõni!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_HereYouGo
en: Here you go!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have the money.
et: Sul pole raha.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: No? That's too bad.
et: Ei? Kahju küll.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro
en: If you're looking for a battle in the SEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no hotter TRAINER than me, matey!
et: Otsid lahingut? Siin SEASHORE HOUSE majas minust tulisemat TRAINERit ei ole, semu!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeated
en: That was a hot battle! I can accept that loss, matey!
et: See oli tuline lahing! Selle kaotusega ma lepin, semu!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBattle
en: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy hot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!
et: Alati kui ma SLATEPORT LINNAS olen, naudin tuliseid lahinguid ja jääkülma SODA POPi!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
en: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.
et: Igavad lahingud pole vaeva väärt.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro
en: Fiery hot battles are what toughen up TRAINERS and POKéMON!
et: Just tulikuumad lahingud karastavad TRAINEREID ja POKéMONe!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaDefeated
en: That's hot!
et: See on kuum!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostBattle
en: Whew, I'm all thirsty. Maybe I'll have a SODA POP.
et: Uhh, mul on kõva janu. Võtan vist ühe SODA POPi.

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro
en: I'm going to show you how great my POKéMON are, but don't cry!
et: Ma näitan sulle, kui vägevad mu POKéMONid on — ainult ära nuta!

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonDefeated
en: …I lost, but I won't cry…
et: …Ma kaotasin, aga ma ei nuta…

label: Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBattle
en: If one of my POKéMON knew the move for carrying me across water on its back, I could get rid of this inner tube.
et: Kui mõni mu POKéMONidest oskaks võtet, millega mind seljas üle vee viia, saaksin sellest ujurõngast lahti.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyInOldDays
en: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just a teeny, tiny company.
et: Ammustel aegadel oli DEVON lihtsalt tilluke firmakene.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
en: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.
et: Mu issi töötab CORPORATIONis.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
en: My daddy made this! But I can't use it, so you can have it.
et: Mu issi tegi selle! Aga mina seda kasutada ei oska, nii et võta sina.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
en: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.
et: Mu issi töötab CORPORATIONis.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
en: When I grow up, I'm going to work for DEVON, too.
et: Kui ma suureks saan, hakkan minagi DEVONi heaks töötama.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY uses FIRE-type POKéMON.
et: LAVARIDGE SAALI JUHT FLANNERY kasutab TULE-tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger and hotter than a volcano.
et: Tema kirg POKéMONide vastu põleb tulisemalt kui vulkaan.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Don't get too close to her--you'll burn! Hose her down with water and then go for it!
et: Ära mine talle liiga lähedale — kõrvetad end ära! Kasta ta veega üle ja siis anna minna!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!
et: Jou! See oli kõrvetavalt kuum lahing!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro
en: Owowowowow! Yikes, it's hot!
et: Ai-ai-ai-ai-ai! Oi, on alles kuum!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat
en: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…
et: Higi jooksis silma ja ma ei näe midagi…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
en: Being buried in hot sand promotes circulation.
et: Kuuma liiva sisse matmine soodustab vereringet.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle
en: It's effective for healing pain in your joints.
et: See aitab hästi liigesevalu vastu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro
en: I'm trying to relieve my stress. Don't come along and stress me out!
et: Ma üritan siin stressi maandada. Ära tule mind uuesti närvi ajama!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat
en: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!
et: Loodan, et FLANNERY kõrvetab sind korralikult läbi!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
en: Haaah… Whew…
et: Haaah… Uhh…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle
en: If you spend too much time buried in hot sand, it tuckers you out…
et: Kui liiga kaua kuuma liiva sees lesida, võtab see su jõuetuks…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
en: You must be getting tired by now. You'd like to rest in the hot sand, wouldn't you?
et: Sa oled vist juba väsinud. Tahaksid kuumas liivas puhata, eks ole?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganIntro
en: But you should know that maintaining your willpower is an important ability for all TRAINERS.
et: Aga tea, et tahtejõu hoidmine on igale TRAINERile tähtis oskus.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganDefeat
en: Play with fire, and be burned…
et: Kes tulega mängib, see kõrvetab end ära…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
en: Your skill is real… But our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.
et: Sul on tõesti oskust… Aga meie JUHT FLANNERY on tugev.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_KeeganPostBattle
en: If you don't watch yourself, you'll be burned seriously.
et: Kui ettevaatlik ei ole, saad tõsiselt kõrvetada.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro
en: Can your POKéMON withstand 392-degree heat?
et: Kas su POKéMONid taluvad 392-kraadist kuumust?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldDefeat
en: It didn't burn hotly enough…
et: Ei põlenud piisavalt kuumalt…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
en: The temperature of magma is 392 degrees.
et: Magma temperatuur on 392 kraadi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBattle
en: Your POKéMON beat me, so they should easily survive in magma.
et: Su POKéMONid alistasid mind, nii et magmas jäävad nad kindlasti ellu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro
en: Um… Okay, I'll battle with you.
et: Öö… Olgu, ma võitlen sinuga.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleDefeat
en: Oh, but you're too strong.
et: Oh, aga sa oled liiga tugev.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBattle
en: I'm going to be a pretty and strong TRAINER just like FLANNERY.
et: Minust saab ilus ja tugev TRAINER, just nagu FLANNERY.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceIntro
en: Come on, get with it! Let's go before my feelings cool!
et: Ole mees, hakkame pihta! Läki, enne kui mu tuhin jahtub!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JaceDefeat
en: It's so hot, and yet my heart is clutched by ice…
et: Nii kuum on, aga ometi pigistab jää mu südant…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JacePostBattle
en: The way the battling spirit burns within you, you may stand a chance against our LEADER.
et: Nii nagu sinus võitlusvaim põleb, võib sul meie JUHI vastu lootust olla.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffIntro
en: See how the flames blaze wildly? They flare in anticipation of my win!
et: Näed, kuidas leegid metsikult lõõmavad? Nad ootavad juba mu võitu!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffDefeat
en: Something didn't go right.
et: Midagi läks valesti.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
en: Well, so what? I say so what? I can walk on hot coals barefoot!
et: No ja mis siis? Mis siis, ma küsin! Ma kõnnin paljajalu tuliste süte peal!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_JeffPostBattle
en: …Don't even think about trying it!
et: …Ära sina isegi proovi!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliIntro
en: As much as I love mountains, I especially love volcanoes.
et: Ma armastan mägesid, aga vulkaane veel eriti.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliDefeat
en: Well, it seems to me I lost without ever being in control.
et: Noh, mulle tundub, et ma kaotasin, ilma et oleksin kordagi ohje hoidnud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
en: I stay here because I became a fan of FLANNERY's power.
et: Ma olen siin sellepärast, et FLANNERY jõud võlus mu ära.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_B1F_Text_EliPostBattle
en: Hehehehe.
et: Hehehehe.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Welcome… No, wait.
et: Tere tulemast… Ei, oota.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've made it here!
et: Vilets TRAINER, tore näha, et sa siia välja jõudsid!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: I have been entrusted with the… No, wait.
et: Mulle on usaldatud… Ei, oota.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM LEADER here!
et: Mina olen FLANNERY ja siinne SAALI JUHT!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: Uh… Dare not underestimate me, though I have been LEADER only a short time!
et: Öö… Ära julge mind alahinnata, kuigi olen JUHT olnud alles lühikest aega!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro
en: With skills inherited from my grandfather, I shall, uh…demonstrate the hot moves we have honed on this land!
et: Vanaisalt päritud oskustega ma, öö… näitan sulle kuumi võtteid, mida oleme siinsel maal lihvinud!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: Oh… I guess I was trying too hard…
et: Oh… Vist ma pingutasin liiga…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I… I've only recently become a GYM LEADER.
et: Ma… ma sain SAALI JUHIKS alles hiljuti.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I tried too hard to be someone I'm not.
et: Ma püüdsin liiga kõvasti olla keegi, kes ma ei ole.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: I have to do things my natural way. If I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.
et: Ma pean tegema asju omal loomulikul moel. Muidu lähevad mu POKéMONid segadusse.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat
en: Thanks for teaching me that. For that, you deserve this.
et: Aitäh õpetuse eest. Sa oled selle ausalt ära teeninud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE from FLANNERY.
et: {PLAYER} sai FLANNERY käest märgi HEAT BADGE.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON up to Level 50, even those you get in trades from other people, will obey you completely.
et: Kui sul on HEAT BADGE, kuulavad sind täielikult kõik POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 50 — ka need, kelle oled teistelt vahetuse teel saanud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: And, it lets POKéMON use the HM move STRENGTH outside of battle.
et: Ja see lubab POKéMONidel kasutada HM-võtet STRENGTH ka väljaspool lahingut.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBadgeTakeThis
en: This is a token of my appreciation. Don't be shy about taking it!
et: See on minu tänu märgiks. Ära häbene, võta aga vastu!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.
et: Selles TM50 on võte OVERHEAT.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: That move inflicts serious damage on the opponent.
et: See võte teeb vastasele tõsist kahju.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverheat
en: But it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK of the POKéMON using it. It might not be suitable for longer battles.
et: Aga see langetab järsult ka kasutaja ER. RÜNNAKUT. Pikemaks lahinguks see päris ei sobi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlannery
en: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT FLANNERY registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
en: Your power reminds me of someone…
et: Su jõud tuletab mulle kedagi meelde…

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBattle
en: Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
et: Oh! Ma tean! Sa võitled nagu NORMAN, PETALBURG LINNA SAALI JUHT.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: LAVARIDGE LINNA POKéMON SAAL

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM
et: LAVARIDGE LINNA POKéMON SAAL

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: FLANNERY SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me.
et: FLANNERY: Üks kaotatud lahing ei löö mind norgu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM!
et: Ma armastan POKéMONe. Ma armastan võidelda. Ja… ma armastan seda SAALI!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRematch
en: Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!
et: Vahetame järgmises lahingus ülikuumi võtteid!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchDefeat
en: Whew! On the verge of eruption!
et: Uhh! Oleksin äärepealt purskama hakanud!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: FLANNERY: I lost the match, but I'm completely satisfied.
et: FLANNERY: Kaotasin küll, aga olen täiesti rahul.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: It's not often I get to enjoy a battle this heated.
et: Nii kuuma lahingut ei satu ma tihti nautima.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRematch
en: Let's have another one like this again sometime!
et: Teeme kunagi veel ühe sellise!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going to deflate me.
et: FLANNERY: Üks kaotatud lahing ei löö mind norgu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I love POKéMON. I love to battle. And… I love this GYM!
et: Ma armastan POKéMONe. Ma armastan võidelda. Ja… ma armastan seda SAALI!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Let's exchange superhot moves in another battle!
et: Vahetame järgmises lahingus ülikuumi võtteid!

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON that can battle?
et: Oi, oota. Kas sul on ainult üks POKéMON, kes võidelda saab?

label: LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I hate to say this, but when you come see me, bring at least two POKéMON.
et: Vabandust, aga kui tuled mulle külla, võta kaasa vähemalt kaks POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth
en: Welcome… You must be commended for your luck…
et: Tere tulemast… Sinu õnne võib ainult kiita…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreToFullHealth
en: Your POKéMON shall be restored to full health…
et: Su POKéMONid saavad täiesti terveks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge
en: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Naudi oma Battle Choice väljakutset lõpuni…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon
en: Ah, you're a lucky one. I'm in somewhat-good spirits now.
et: Ah, sul on vedanud. Mul on praegu üsna hea tuju.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreOneMon
en: I will restore one of your POKéMON to full health.
et: Ma teen ühe su POKéMONi täiesti terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell
en: The best of luck to you. Farewell.
et: Soovin sulle edu. Hüvasti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons
en: Excuse me…
et: Vabandust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_CareForBattleWillRestoreMons
en: Would you care for a battle? I'll restore your POKéMON if you win.
et: Kas sooviksid lahingut? Kui võidad, teen su POKéMONid terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowShallWe
en: Very well… Now, shall we?
et: Hästi… Kas alustame siis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HowUnsportingOfYou
en: I see… How unsporting of you…
et: Ah nii… Kui ebasportlik sinust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised
en: Magnificent…
et: Suurepärane…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreMonsAsPromised
en: As promised, I shall restore your POKéMON to full health.
et: Nagu lubatud, teen su POKéMONid täiesti terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BestOfLuckFarewell2
en: The best of luck to you. Farewell.
et: Soovin sulle edu. Hüvasti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut
en: Oh, my!
et: Oh, heldeke!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WatchOut
en: Watch out!
et: Ettevaatust!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaStop
en: Now, now! KIRLIA, stop that!
et: Nonoh! KIRLIA, jäta järele!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsStop
en: Now, now! DUSCLOPS, stop that!
et: Nonoh! DUSCLOPS, jäta järele!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedToxic
en: KIRLIA used TOXIC!
et: KIRLIA kasutas TOXIC!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedHypnosis
en: KIRLIA used HYPNOSIS!
et: KIRLIA kasutas HYPNOSIS!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedThunderWave
en: KIRLIA used THUNDER WAVE!
et: KIRLIA kasutas THUNDER WAVE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_KirliaUsedWillOWisp
en: KIRLIA used WILL-O-WISP!
et: KIRLIA kasutas WILL-O-WISP!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedWillOWisp
en: DUSCLOPS used WILL-O-WISP!
et: DUSCLOPS kasutas WILL-O-WISP!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_DusclopsUsedIceBeam
en: DUSCLOPS used ICE BEAM!
et: DUSCLOPS kasutas ICE BEAM!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ThatsEnough
en: Look here! That's quite enough!
et: Kuule! Aitab juba!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia
en: I must apologize to you…
et: Ma pean sinu ees vabandama…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForKirlia
en: My KIRLIA has a TIMID nature…
et: Mu KIRLIA on TIMID loomuga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops
en: I must apologize to you…
et: Ma pean sinu ees vabandama…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeForDusclops
en: My DUSCLOPS has a TIMID nature…
et: Mu DUSCLOPS on TIMID loomuga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled
en: It attacks without warning if it is startled by another person…
et: Ta ründab hoiatamata, kui keegi ta ehmatab…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AttacksWhenStartled
en: Are you and your POKéMON all right?
et: Kas sinul ja su POKéMONidel on kõik korras?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ApologizeHopeMonsAreFine
en: I do apologize for what happened… I do hope your POKéMON are fine.
et: Vabandan juhtunu pärast… Loodan väga, et su POKéMONid on terved.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer
en: Welcome…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_BattleSomewhatToughTrainer
en: Here, we will have you battle a somewhat-tough TRAINER…
et: Siin paneme sind vastamisi üsna tugeva TRAINERiga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth
en: How wonderful…
et: Kui imeline…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_RestoreToFullHealth
en: To honor your victory, your POKéMON shall be restored to full health…
et: Sinu võidu auks saavad su POKéMONid täiesti terveks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_EnjoyRestOfChallenge2
en: I urge you to enjoy the rest of your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Naudi oma Battle Choice väljakutset lõpuni…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: I am LUCY… I am the law here… For I am the PIKE QUEEN…
et: Mina olen LUCY… Siin olen mina seadus… Sest mina olen PIKE QUEEN…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: You already know it, but to advance, you must defeat me…
et: Sa tead seda isegi, aga edasi pääsed alles siis, kui mind alistad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ImThePikeQueen
en: …I'm not one for idle chatter. Hurry. Come on…
et: …Tühi lobisemine pole minu asi. Kiirusta. Anna tulla…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_HopeYouDidntUseUpLuck
en: Your luck… I hope you didn't use it all up here…
et: Su õnn… Loodan, et sa ei kulutanud seda kõike siin ära…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyShowMeFrontierPass
en: LUCY: … … … … … … Show me your FRONTIER PASS…
et: LUCY: … … … … … … Näita mulle oma FRONTIER PASSi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ReceivedLuckSymbol
en: The Luck Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: FRONTIER PASSile pressiti Luck-sümbol!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_AllThereIsDisappear
en: …That's all there is… Disappear already…
et: …Rohkem pole midagi… Kao juba…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: LUCY: …You again…
et: LUCY: …Sina jälle…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: …I've trampled flowers and braved storms to get to where I am…
et: …Olen tallanud lilli ja trotsinud torme, et jõuda sinna, kus ma praegu olen…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: I don't feel any compulsion to keep losing to the same opponent…
et: Mul pole mingit tahtmist ühele ja samale vastasele aina kaotada…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyYouAgain
en: … … … … … … Fine… I'll do it…
et: … … … … … … Hüva… Olgu, teeme ära…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_NowComeOn
en: Now! Come on!
et: Nüüd! Anna tulla!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LucyFrontierPass
en: …FRONTIER PASS…
et: …FRONTIER PASS…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_LuckSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Luck Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Luck-sümbol lõi kuldselt särama!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_IWontForget
en: …You, I won't forget… …Ever…
et: …Sind ma ei unusta… …Iial…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: I welcome you…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: Giggle… You seem to be bereft of luck…
et: Kihi-kihi… Sul näib õnnest puudu jäävat…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomNoHeal
en: If only you hadn't chosen this room, your POKéMON could have been healed…
et: Kui sa poleks just seda ruumi valinud, oleksid su POKéMONid terveks saanud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne
en: I welcome you…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealOne
en: Since you have chosen this room, I will restore one POKéMON to full health…
et: Kuna valisid selle ruumi, teen ühe POKéMONi täiesti terveks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo
en: I welcome you…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ChoseRoomHealTwo
en: Since you have chosen this room, I will restore two POKéMON to full health…
et: Kuna valisid selle ruumi, teen kaks POKéMONi täiesti terveks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: I welcome you…
et: Tere tulemast…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: Giggle… You should thank your lucky stars…
et: Kihi-kihi… Tänada võid oma õnnetähte…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreAllMons
en: Since you have chosen this room, all your POKéMON will be restored…
et: Kuna valisid selle ruumi, saavad kõik su POKéMONid terveks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_ShallFetchOurMaster
en: I shall go fetch our master…
et: Ma lähen kutsun meie emanda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons
en: Ah, you're a lucky one! I'm in good spirits now.
et: Ah, sul on vedanud! Mul on praegu hea tuju.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomNormal_Text_WillRestoreTwoMons
en: I will restore two of your POKéMON to full health!
et: Ma teen kaks su POKéMONi täiesti terveks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: JUAN
et: SOOTOPOLIS LINN POKéMON SAALI JUHT: JUAN

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The GYM LEADER with the beauty of pure water!”
et: „SAALI JUHT, kes on kaunis kui puhas vesi!”

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY
et: SOOTOPOLIS LINN

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The mystical city where history slumbers.”
et: „Müstiline linn, kus ajalugu uinub.”

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoorIsClosed
en: The door is closed.
et: Uks on kinni.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
en: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and down stairs all the time…
et: Sukeldumine meres. Pidev treppidest üles-alla käimine…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingHere
en: If you live in this town, you end up getting physically fit.
et: Kui selles linnas elad, lähed paratamatult heasse vormi.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared in the middle of the city!
et: Need hiiglaslikud POKéMONid ilmusid järsku keset linna!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: And, I've never seen them before!
et: Ja ma pole neid kunagi varem näinud!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: Why are they smashing into each other like that?
et: Miks nad küll niimoodi üksteise vastu tormavad?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenlyAppeared
en: Why can't they be friends, those POKéMON?
et: Miks nad ei või sõbrad olla, need POKéMONid?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokemon
en: What? What? What? What is that green POKéMON?!
et: Mida? Mida? Mida? Mis roheline POKéMON see selline on?!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
en: GROUDON and KYOGRE… Where did they go?
et: GROUDON ja KYOGRE… Kuhu nad läksid?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesGo
en: Will they cause droughts or downpours somewhere else?
et: Kas nad tekitavad kuskil mujal põuda või paduvihma?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
en: I just get this sense somehow that the two POKéMON aren't angry.
et: Mul on kuidagi selline tunne, et need kaks POKéMONi pole vihased.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry
en: I think… They probably can't control their own power…
et: Ma arvan… Nad lihtsalt ei suuda oma jõudu ohjata…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRampage
en: That flying POKéMON came down from the sky and stopped the rampaging POKéMON…
et: See lendav POKéMON laskus taevast alla ja peatas märatsevad POKéMONid…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
en: I… I've never been out of this city.
et: Ma… Ma pole kunagi siit linnast välja saanud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLike
en: I wonder what the world is like on the other side of this round sky?
et: Huvitav, milline on maailm selle ümmarguse taeva teisel pool?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThisIsWicked
en: Wow! This is wicked!
et: Ohoo! See on ikka vägev!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThatWasWicked
en: Wow! That was wicked!
et: Ohoo! See oli ikka vägev!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon
en: Go for it, red POKéMON! Don't back off, blue POKéMON!
et: Anna minna, punane POKéMON! Ära tagane, sinine POKéMON!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames
en: Hi, do you know the names of those POKéMON fighting over there?
et: Kuule, kas sa tead nende POKéMONide nimesid, kes seal võitlevad?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
en: I was wondering which one would win, the red one or the blue one, but, oh no, it's the green one that settles things!
et: Mõtlesin veel, kumb võidab, kas punane või sinine — aga ei, hoopis roheline teeb asjale lõpu!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThings
en: Talk about a huge turn of events!
et: See on alles pööre!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON.
et: Vana legend räägib, et maa ja mere kujundas hiiglaslik lahing POKéMONide vahel.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Well, I'm seeing that happen with my very own eyes!
et: Ja nüüd näen ma seda oma silmaga!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!
et: Ohhoo! Poleks iial arvanud, et saan millegi nii suure tunnistajaks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: There's an ancient legend that claims the land and sea were shaped by a colossal battle between POKéMON.
et: Vana legend räägib, et maa ja mere kujundas hiiglaslik lahing POKéMONide vahel.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Well, I saw that happen with my very own eyes!
et: Ja mina nägin seda oma silmaga!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes
en: Whoa! I never expected to be witness to something this huge!
et: Ohhoo! Poleks iial arvanud, et saan millegi nii suure tunnistajaks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
en: A big POKéMON is fighting with another big POKéMON!
et: Üks suur POKéMON kakleb teise suure POKéMONiga!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting
en: Please, someone make them stop!
et: Palun, keegi peataks nad ära!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky
en: A pretty POKéMON came down from the sky…
et: Üks ilus POKéMON laskus taevast alla…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrecked
en: Oh, no! SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!
et: Oi ei! SOOTOPOLIS LINN läheb puruks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisDidntGetWrecked
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY didn't get wrecked!
et: SOOTOPOLIS LINN jäi ikkagi terveks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
en: Hm! You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS? You're no ordinary tourist.
et: Hm! Sa oled tulnud kogu selle tee SOOTOPOLIS LINNA? Tavaline turist sa küll pole.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist
en: But I suppose that doesn't make you an extraordinary tourist, either.
et: Aga vist ei tee see sinust ka mingit erilist turisti.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm
en: The city has regained its calm…
et: Linna on rahu tagasi tulnud…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: Who might you be?
et: Kes sina selline oled?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.
et: See on CAVE OF ORIGIN.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.
et: Öeldakse, et POKéMONide hinged, kes MT. PYRE juures rahu leidsid, ärkavad siin uuesti ellu.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLeave
en: Please leave.
et: Palun lahku.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: A person with a strong will and superior talent…
et: Tugeva tahte ja erakordse andega inimene…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: A TRAINER who has knowledge and experience of many kinds of POKéMON…
et: TRAINER, kes tunneb paljusid POKéMONe ja kellel on kogemust…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerToCave
en: If such a person were to appear, I was instructed by WALLACE to lead that TRAINER to this CAVE.
et: WALLACE käskis mul sellise inimese ilmudes see TRAINER siia KOOPASSE juhatada.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
en: Oh, my…
et: Oh, heldeke…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash
en: The clash between the two awakened POKéMON was quelled by the awakening of a third POKéMON…
et: Kahe ärganud POKéMONi heitluse vaigistas kolmanda POKéMONi ärkamine…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
en: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…
et: See on CAVE OF ORIGIN…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsToo
en: With the passing of the crisis, the cave, too, shall sleep…
et: Kriisi möödudes jääb ka koobas magama…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in the crater of a volcano.
et: SOOTOPOLISE linn kerkis vulkaani kraatrisse.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: If you look up at the sky, the lip of the crater is also visible. So, all you see is the sky in a circle.
et: Kui taeva poole vaatad, paistab ka kraatri serv. Nii et näed vaid ringikujulist taevatükki.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautiful
en: But that's what makes the sky above SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.
et: Aga just seepärast ongi taevas SOOTOPOLISE kohal kõige ilusam.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight
en: When two POKéMON that gigantic are fighting that savagely, there's not much that we can do.
et: Kui kaks nii hiiglaslikku POKéMONi nii metsikult võitlevad, pole meil eriti midagi teha.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokemonFlewDown
en: When that third POKéMON flew down, I feared the worst.
et: Kui see kolmas POKéMON alla lendas, kartsin ma halvimat.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
en: A circle of a night sky framed by the crater of a volcano…
et: Öötaeva ring, mida raamib vulkaani kraater…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScenery
en: And in that ring, stars flicker and blink as if they were alive… It's my favorite scenery.
et: Ja selles ringis vilguvad ja pilguvad tähed, justkui oleksid nad elus… See on mu lemmikvaade.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: The weather was clear this morning, but…
et: Täna hommikul oli ilm selge, aga…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, rain started falling in sheets, and there was thunder and lightning, too.
et: Järsku kogunesid tumedad pilved, vihma hakkas kallama nagu oavarrest ning müristas ja lõi välku.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: The weather just went completely wild!
et: Ilm läks lihtsalt täiesti hulluks!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild
en: Is all of this because of those POKéMON?
et: Kas kõik see on nende POKéMONide pärast?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: Oh?
et: Oh?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: It was you who brought that flying POKéMON here?
et: Kas see olid sina, kes selle lendava POKéMONi siia tõi?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon
en: Well, aren't you amazing!
et: Oi, oled sa alles vapustav!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: MAXIE: G… GROUDON… Please! Stop what you're doing!
et: MAXIE: G… GROUDON… Palun! Jäta järele!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: I know the extent of your power now!
et: Nüüd ma tean, kui võimas sa oled!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop
en: If you keep going, all HOENN, not just SOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!
et: Kui sa jätkad, ei hävi mitte ainult SOOTOPOLIS, vaid kogu HOENN!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…
et: MAXIE: Nii et ürgvanad POKéMONid polnud ainult GROUDON ja KYOGRE…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: After all our fruitless scheming and frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's simple action puts everything right again as if nothing had happened…
et: Pärast kõiki meie viljatuid sepitsusi ja meeleheitlikke pingutusi seab ühe POKéMONi lihtne tegu kõik taas korda, nagu poleks midagi juhtunudki…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming
en: Fu… Fuhahaha…
et: Fu… Fuhahaha…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
en: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?! Look over here! It's the RED ORB! Calm down! KYOGRE!
et: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! Mis lahti?! Vaata siiapoole! See on RED ORB! Rahune maha! KYOGRE!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown
en: It's no good! It's not responding at all!
et: See ei aita! Ta ei reageeri üldse!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: ARCHIE: KYOGRE and GROUDON both flew off to who knows where.
et: ARCHIE: KYOGRE ja GROUDON lendasid mõlemad kes teab kuhu.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: The weather in HOENN has returned to its normal state…
et: HOENNI ilm on jälle tavapärane…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: Haha… Hahaha…
et: Haha… Hahaha…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToPokemon
en: Maybe what we were trying to do was something small, even meaningless, to POKéMON…
et: Võib-olla oli kõik see, mida me teha üritasime, POKéMONide jaoks tühine, isegi mõttetu…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting… GROUDON… And KYOGRE…
et: STEVEN: Need võitlevad POKéMONid… GROUDON… Ja KYOGRE…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: The two super-ancient POKéMON were awakened from a long sleep…
et: Kaks ürgvana POKéMONi äratati pikast unest…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: And now they are smashing each other with their uncontrollable energy…
et: Ja nüüd peksavad nad teineteist oma ohjeldamatu jõuga…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: …{PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: …{PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: You being here now I'll take to mean that you're prepared to become involved in this crisis.
et: See, et sa praegu siin oled, tähendab mulle, et oled valmis sellesse kriisi sekkuma.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: Well, then, there's someone that I'd like you to meet.
et: Noh, siis on üks inimene, kellega ma tahaksin sind kokku viia.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisComeWithMe
en: Come with me, please.
et: Tule minuga kaasa, palun.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: STEVEN: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: STEVEN: Kuula, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make you think POKéMON are to be feared?
et: Kas GROUDONI ja KYOGRE nähes tundub sulle, et POKéMONe tuleb karta?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: But that's not true. POKéMON are really more…
et: Aga see pole tõsi. POKéMONid on tegelikult hoopis…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFearPokemon
en: …Why am I asking you this? You already know.
et: …Miks ma seda sinult küsin? Sa juba tead.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: STEVEN: Okay, here we are!
et: STEVEN: Nii, kohal me olemegi!

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: Inside here you'll find someone named WALLACE.
et: Siit seest leiad mehe nimega WALLACE.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWallace
en: I think you have what's needed to help him…
et: Usun, et sul on kõik, mida on vaja teda aidata…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHelpHim
en: STEVEN: I think you have what's needed to help him…
et: STEVEN: Usun, et sul on kõik, mida on vaja teda aidata…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
en: STEVEN: The SKY PILLAR…
et: STEVEN: SKY PILLAR…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar
en: I've never been there. I wonder where it could be?
et: Ma pole seal kunagi käinud. Huvitav, kus see küll olla võiks?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
en: STEVEN: So that's RAYQUAZA…
et: STEVEN: Nii et see ongi RAYQUAZA…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza
en: It's incredible how the two rampaging POKéMON would flee from it in fear…
et: Uskumatu, et kaks märatsevat POKéMONi tema eest hirmuga põgenesid…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
en: STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and ARCHIE have gone away somewhere.
et: STEVEN: Näib, et nii MAXIE kui ARCHIE on kuhugi ära läinud.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft
en: Perhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to return those ORBS…
et: Ehk läksid nad MT. PYRE juurde neid ORBe tagastama…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: WALLACE: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR yet?
et: Kas sa pole veel SKY PILLARi tippu roninud?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPillar
en: I'm sure that you can make it to the top of the SKY PILLAR…
et: Olen kindel, et sa jõuad SKY PILLARi tippu…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: The leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA, I don't think they meant harm.
et: Ma ei usu, et TEAM MAGMA ja AQUA juhid kurja mõtlesid.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHarm
en: It wouldn't hurt to hear what they have to say for themselves.
et: Ei teeks paha kuulda, mida neil enda õigustuseks öelda on.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}… My eyes didn't deceive me.
et: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Mu silmad ei petnud mind.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: Thanks to your help, SOOTOPOLIS… No, all of HOENN was saved.
et: Tänu sinule sai päästetud SOOTOPOLIS… Ei, kogu HOENN.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: On behalf of the people, I thank you.
et: Tänan sind kogu rahva nimel.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAcceptThis
en: This is a gift from me. Please accept it.
et: See on kink minult. Palun võta see vastu.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
en: That HIDDEN MACHINE contains WATERFALL.
et: See HIDDEN MACHINE sisaldab võtet WATERFALL.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
en: If you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON that has learned that HM move can force its way up waterfalls.
et: Kui sul on RAIN BADGE, suudab selle HM-võtte õppinud POKéMON kosest üles ronida.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
en: And where does one get the RAIN BADGE? You know, don't you?
et: Ja kust RAIN BADGE kätte saab? Sa ju tead, kas pole?

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
en: That's right! You have to beat the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.
et: Just nii! Sa pead alistama SOOTOPOLISE SAALI JUHI.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoToGym
en: When you're all set to go, step through that door.
et: Kui oled valmis minema, astu sellest uksest läbi.

label: SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor
en: WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be dazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly elegant battle style.
et: WALLACE: Olen kindel, et mu mentori hingematvalt elegantne võitlusstiil pimestab sind.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
en: What, what, what?
et: Mis, mis, mis?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
en: Only TEAM MAGMA members are supposed to be in here!
et: Siin peaksid olema ainult TEAM MAGMA liikmed!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
en: But you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's uniform…
et: Aga sul pole TEAM MAGMA vormi seljas…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro
en: You rouse my suspicion! Battle with me!
et: Sa tundud mulle kahtlane! Võitle minuga!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat
en: Aiyiyi… My pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…
et: Ai-jai-jai… Mu uhkus TEAM MAGMA liikmena…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattle
en: If you suffer from chills, you should join TEAM MAGMA.
et: Kui sa külmavärinate käes kannatad, peaksid TEAM MAGMAGA liituma.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Hold it right there!
et: Seisa, kus oled!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: You don't really expect me to keep my trap shut and let you waltz by me?
et: Sa ju ei oota, et ma suu kinni pean ja lasen sul minust mööda valssida?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Ooh wow! I concede!
et: Ohoo! Ma tunnistan kaotust!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Maybe it would've been better if I did just let you go unchallenged…
et: Võib-olla oleks parem olnud, kui ma poleks sind üldse välja kutsunud…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Ahah! An intruder!
et: Ahah! Sissetungija!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Graaah!
et: Graaah!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: I've already lost.
et: Ma olen juba kaotanud.

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: Do I really need to keep running around in a circle?
et: Kas ma pean tõesti edasi ringiratast jooksma?

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Oh, oh! An intruder!
et: Oh, oh! Sissetungija!

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Mutter…
et: Pomiseb…

label: MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…
et: Tegelikult pole ma võitlemises mingi ekspert…

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
en: That seaside cottage is where MR. BRINEY lives.
et: Selles rannaäärses suvilas elabki MR. BRINEY.

label: Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottage
en: He was once a mighty sailor who never feared the sea, however stormy.
et: Ta oli kunagi vägev meremees, kes ei kartnud merd, ükskõik kui tormine see ka oli.

label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
en: The sea, huh?
et: Meri, mis?

label: Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea
en: I wonder what it's like at the bottom of the sea?
et: Huvitav, kuidas seal merepõhjas küll on?

label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
en: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL, weaken the wild POKéMON first.
et: Kui kavatsed POKé PALLI visata, nõrgesta metsik POKéMON kõigepealt ära.

label: Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon
en: It will be easier to catch if it's been poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.
et: Teda on kergem püüda, kui ta on mürgitatud, põleb või magab.

label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
en: You're a thief if you try to steal someone else's POKéMON.
et: Sa oled varas, kui üritad kellegi teise POKéMONi varastada.

label: Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon
en: You should throw POKé BALLS only at wild POKéMON.
et: POKé PALLI tohib visata ainult metsikute POKéMONide pihta.

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
en: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.
et: Oh, ei, ma pole TRAINER.

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
en: But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes, it's a challenge to battle.
et: Aga tõsi ta on: kui TRAINERID pilgud ristavad, tähendab see väljakutset lahingule.

label: Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer
en: If you don't want to battle, stay out of their sight.
et: Kui sa ei taha võidelda, ära jää neile silma.

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
en: I like filling my mouth with seeds, then spitting them out fast!
et: Mulle meeldib suu seemneid täis toppida ja need siis kähku välja sülitada!

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
en: You can have this, so you try it out!
et: Võta see endale ja proovi ise järele!

label: Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsTakeThis
en: Use it on a POKéMON, and it will learn a move for firing seeds rapidly.
et: Kasuta seda POKéMONi peal ja ta õpib võtte, millega seemneid kiirelt tulistada.

label: Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse
en: A word of advice!
et: Üks nõuanne!

label: Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse
en: A TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only for one-time use.
et: TM ehk TECHNICAL MACHINE kõlbab ainult ühekordseks kasutamiseks.

label: Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse
en: Once you use it, it's gone. Think twice before using it!
et: Kui oled selle korra kasutanud, ongi see läinud. Mõtle enne kasutamist kaks korda!

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
en: This FLOWER SHOP started selling saplings recently.
et: See LILLEPOOD hakkas hiljuti taimeistikuid müüma.

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
en: It made me so happy, I went overboard shopping.
et: See tegi mind nii õnnelikuks, et läksin ostlemisega üle piiri.

label: Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt
en: I don't need this WHITE HERB anymore. Would you take it, please?
et: Mul pole seda WHITE HERBi enam vaja. Kas võtaksid selle endale?

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
en: This FLOWER SHOP started selling saplings recently.
et: See LILLEPOOD hakkas hiljuti taimeistikuid müüma.

label: Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings
en: It made me so happy, I went overboard shopping. Where should I put them?
et: See tegi mind nii õnnelikuks, et läksin ostlemisega üle piiri. Kuhu ma need küll panen?

label: Route104_Text_MrBrineysCottage
en: MR. BRINEY'S COTTAGE
et: HR. BRINEY SUVILA

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignPetalburg
en: ROUTE 1O4 {RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG CITY
et: ROUTE 1O4 {RIGHT_ARROW} PETALBURG LINN

label: Route104_Text_RouteSignRustboro
en: ROUTE 1O4 {UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
et: ROUTE 1O4 {UP_ARROW} RUSTBORO LINN

label: Route104_Text_PrettyPetalFlowShop
en: PRETTY PETAL FLOWER SHOP
et: PRETTY PETAL LILLEPOOD

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
en: In the HOENN region there are pairs of TRAINERS who challenge others for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: HOENNI piirkonnas on TRAINERITE paare, kes kutsuvad teisi 2-vastu-2 POKéMON-lahingusse, mida nimetatakse TOPELTLAHINGUKS.

label: Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles
en: In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must send out two POKéMON, the one at the left of the list and the top one. Watch how POKéMON are lined up.
et: TOPELTLAHINGUS peab TRAINER välja saatma kaks POKéMONi: nimekirjas vasakpoolse ja ülemise. Jälgi, kuidas POKéMONid on ritta seatud.

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
en: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
en: DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with the MATCH CALL system, huh?
et: DEVON uuendas su POKéNAVi MATCH CALL-süsteemiga, mis?

label: Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister
en: We should register each other so we can get in contact anytime.
et: Me peaksime teineteist registreerima, et saaksime igal ajal ühendust võtta.

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredMay
en: {PLAYER} registered MAY in the POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER} registreeris MAY POKéNAVi.

label: Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex
en: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how's your POKéDEX coming along?
et: MAY: Oh, muide, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kuidas su POKéDEXi täitmine edeneb?

label: Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle
en: Mine's looking pretty decent. So… How about a little battle?
et: Minul läheb päris kenasti. Noh… Kuidas oleks väikese lahinguga?

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
en: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?
et: MAY: Oh, mis viga?

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
en: Haven't you caught or raised your POKéMON very much?
et: Kas sa pole oma POKéMONe eriti püüdnud ega kasvatanud?

label: Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon
en: That's not very good for a TRAINER!
et: See pole TRAINERI jaoks kuigi hea!

label: Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?
et: MAY: Nii, mis sa arvad? Kuidas oleks siin väike lahing?

label: Route104_Text_MayIntro
en: MAY: You just became a TRAINER, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
et: MAY: Sa alles said TRAINERiks, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Mina küll ei kaota!

label: Route104_Text_MayDefeat
en: Yikes! You're better than I expected!
et: Oih! Sa oled parem, kui ma arvasin!

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
en: MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty good with the way you handle POKéMON.
et: MAY: Näha on, et oskad POKéMONidega päris hästi ümber käia.

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
en: But instead of only making them battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.
et: Aga selle asemel, et neid ainult võitlema panna, võiksid olla nagu MR. BRINEY.

label: Route104_Text_MayPostBattle
en: It's important to become friends with POKéMON, too.
et: Tähtis on ka POKéMONidega sõbraks saada.

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
en: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!
et: BRENDAN: Oh, hei, {PLAYER}!

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
en: Cool, you had DEVON install the MATCH CALL system on your POKéNAV!
et: Lahe, sa lasksid DEVONil oma POKéNAVi MATCH CALL-süsteemi paigaldada!

label: Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister
en: Let's register each other in our POKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.
et: Registreerime teineteise oma POKéNAVidesse, et saaksime ühendust hoida.

label: Route104_Text_RegisteredBrendan
en: {PLAYER} registered BRENDAN in the POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER} registreeris BRENDANI POKéNAVi.

label: Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? Have you filled in any pages yet?
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, kuidas su POKéDEXiga on? Kas oled juba mõne lehe täis saanud?

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
en: Me, I'm doing great!
et: Minul läheb suurepäraselt!

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattle
en: Want to check out how good I am with a battle?
et: Tahad lahingus järele proovida, kui hea ma olen?

label: Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence
en: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have any confidence in your POKéMON?
et: BRENDAN: Mis viga? Kas sa ei usu oma POKéMONidesse?

label: Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: BRENDAN: What's up? Want to have a battle with me?
et: BRENDAN: Mis lahti? Tahad minuga lahingu pidada?

label: Route104_Text_BrendanIntro
en: BRENDAN: I know you just became a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!
et: BRENDAN: Ma tean, et sa alles said TRAINERiks, aga armu ma ei anna!

label: Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: Hmm… You're pretty good.
et: Hmm… Sa oled päris hea.

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
en: BRENDAN: You've gotten pretty decent at handling POKéMON.
et: BRENDAN: Sa oskad POKéMONidega juba päris hästi ümber käia.

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
en: But, you know, you shouldn't just be making POKéMON battle.
et: Aga tead, sa ei peaks POKéMONe ainult võitlema panema.

label: Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle
en: Like MR. BRINEY, it's important to become friends with your POKéMON.
et: Nagu MR. BRINEY: tähtis on oma POKéMONidega sõbraks saada.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
en: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship?
et: Kuidas palun? Sa otsid laeva?

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailable
en: I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…
et: Vabandust, praamiteenus pole hetkel saadaval…

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas oled praami pärast siin? Kas tohin näha su PILETIT?

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: PILETIT pole {PLAYER} käes…

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Praamile astumiseks peab sul olema PILET.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas PILETIT.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Suurepärane! Rohkem polegi vaja!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FlashTicketWhereTo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu sa minna sooviksid?

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Sõida meiega mõni teine kord!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SlateportItIs
en: SLATEPORT CITY it is, then!
et: Siis SLATEPORT LINNA!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
en: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!
et: Siis BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astu praamile ja oota väljasõitu.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna sooviksid?

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
en: Until they finish making the ferry, we sailors have nothing to do…
et: Kuni nad praami valmis teevad, pole meil, madrustel, midagi teha…

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnavailable
en: I wish they'd get a move on, the folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.
et: Võtaksid nad seal SLATEPORTI LAEVATEHASES ometi hoogu juurde!

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
en: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in operation.
et: Praam S.S. TIDAL on lõpuks käigus.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
en: The folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT must've worked extra hard.
et: SLATEPORTI LAEVATEHASE rahvas pidi eriti kõvasti tööd tegema.

label: LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvailable
en: Well, it's my turn to get busy now!
et: Noh, nüüd on minu kord tööd rabada!

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
en: Listen, kid, are you working on a POKéDEX?
et: Kuule, noor sõber, kas sa täidad POKéDEXi?

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSafariZone
en: Hmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE. That's my suggestion.
et: Hmm… Mine SAFARI ZONE piirkonda. Selline on mu soovitus.

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
en: Have you done anything at the RECORD CORNER?
et: Kas oled RECORD CORNERis midagi teinud?

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
en: It's pretty neat. It mixes and matches the records of TRAINERS.
et: See on päris nutikas. See segab ja sobitab TRAINERite andmeid omavahel.

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerIsNeat
en: I don't know quite how it works, but it's cool. It's exciting, even!
et: Ma ei tea päris täpselt, kuidas see töötab, aga lahe on! Lausa põnev!

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
en: Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV! And it's just like mine!
et: Ohoo, sul on POKéNAV! Ja täpselt samasugune nagu minul!

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
en: Do you know about POKéNAV's MATCH CALL system?
et: Kas tead POKéNAVi MATCH CALL-süsteemist?

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
en: Access it, and you can chat with registered TRAINERS anytime.
et: Ava see ja saad registreeritud TRAINERitega igal ajal vestelda.

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
en: It also shows you which TRAINERS want a rematch with you.
et: See näitab sulle ka, millised TRAINERid tahavad sinuga uuesti võidelda.

label: FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouKnowAboutPokenav
en: It's really nifty! Those DEVON guys sure know what they're doing!
et: See on tõesti nutikas! Need DEVONi tüübid teavad küll, mida teevad!

label: Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon
en: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found on ROUTE 103 include…
et: MAY: Vaatame… ROUTE 103 peal elavad sellised POKéMONid…

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: …Oh, I see, my dad gave you a POKéMON as a gift.
et: …Ahaa, mu isa kinkis sulle POKéMONi.

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: Since we're here, let's have a quick battle!
et: Kuna me kord juba siin oleme, peame kiire lahingu!

label: Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: I'll give you a taste of what being a TRAINER is like.
et: Näitan sulle, mis tunne on olla TRAINER.

label: Route103_Text_MayDefeated
en: Wow! That's great! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're pretty good!
et: Ohoo! See on suurepärane! {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa oled päris hea!

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
en: MAY: I think I know why my dad has an eye out for you now.
et: MAY: Ma vist tean, miks mu isa nüüd sinul silma peal hoiab.

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
en: I mean, you just got that POKéMON, but it already likes you.
et: Sa ju alles said selle POKéMONi, aga sa juba meeldid talle.

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
en: You might be able to befriend any kind of POKéMON easily.
et: Sa saad vist iga POKéMONiga kergesti sõbraks.

label: Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack
en: Well, it's time to head back to the LAB.
et: Noh, aeg on LABORISSE tagasi minna.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon
en: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and that one that live on ROUTE 103…
et: BRENDAN: Nii, ROUTE 103 peal elavad siis see ja too…

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!
et: Hei, see on {PLAYER}!

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: …Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.
et: …Oh, jah, isa andis sulle POKéMONi.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: Since we're here, how about a little battle?
et: Kuna me kord juba siin oleme, kuidas oleks väikese lahinguga?

label: Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: I'll teach you what being a TRAINER's about!
et: Ma õpetan sulle, mida tähendab TRAINERiks olla!

label: Route103_Text_BrendanDefeated
en: Huh, {PLAYER}, you're not too shabby.
et: Huh, {PLAYER}, sa pole sugugi kehv.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
en: BRENDAN: I think I get it. I think I know why my dad has his eye out for you now.
et: BRENDAN: Ma vist saan aru. Ma vist tean, miks mu isa nüüd sinul silma peal hoiab.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
en: Look, your POKéMON already likes you, even though you just got it.
et: Vaata, sa juba meeldid oma POKéMONile, kuigi said ta alles äsja.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
en: {PLAYER}, I get the feeling that you could befriend any POKéMON with ease.
et: {PLAYER}, mul on tunne, et sa suudaksid iga POKéMONiga hõlpsalt sõbraks saada.

label: Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack
en: We should head back to the LAB.
et: Me peaksime LABORISSE tagasi minema.

label: Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion
en: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired… I should have brought a POTION…
et: Mu POKéMON on surmväsinud… Oleksin pidanud POTIONi kaasa võtma…

label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
en: If you cross the sea from here, it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.
et: Kui ületad siit mere, on see otsetee OLDALE LINNA.

label: Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale
en: Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?
et: Fufufu, see on kasulik, kas pole?

label: Route103_Text_RouteSign
en: ROUTE 103 {DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE TOWN
et: ROUTE 103 {DOWN_ARROW} OLDALE LINN

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
en: Want a tip for battling?
et: Tahad võitlemise kohta nõuannet?

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
en: I'd say it's raising different kinds of POKéMON in a balanced manner.
et: Ma ütleksin nii: kasvata eri liiki POKéMONe tasakaalus.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
en: It's no good to make just one POKéMON strong.
et: Ainult ühe POKéMONi tugevaks treenimisest pole kasu.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RaiseDifferentTypesOfPokemon
en: If it has a type disadvantage, it might not stand a chance.
et: Kui vastase tüüp on talle ebasoodne, ei pruugi tal mingit lootust olla.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
en: I trade POKéMON with my friends.
et: Ma vahetan oma sõpradega POKéMONe.

label: SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedMonWithFriend
en: If a traded POKéMON is holding an item, it makes me twice as happy!
et: Kui vahetatud POKéMONil on ese kaasas, on rõõm kahekordne!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
en: Yippee!
et: Jippii!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveMePokeblockCase
en: The lady at the reception counter gave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!
et: Vastuvõtuleti proua kinkis mulle {POKEBLOCK}ide karbi!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
en: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there.
et: Tee {POKEBLOCK}e ja pane need sinna.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeblocksDifferentBerries
en: When you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone has to put in a different BERRY.
et: Kui teete {POKEBLOCK}i, peab igaüks panema sisse eri marja.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
en: I did a painting of your POKéMON to commemorate its victory…
et: Maalisin su POKéMONist pildi, et ta võitu jäädvustada…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokemonSpurredMeToPaint
en: Well, your POKéMON's appeals were so fantastic, it spurred me into painting better than I usually do. Look, see?
et: Noh, su POKéMONi etteasted olid nii fantastilised, et maalisin tavapärasest palju paremini. Vaata ise!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
en: What do you think? I'm confident in what I've done, but do you like it?
et: Mida arvad? Olen oma tööga rahul, aga kas sulle meeldib?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
en: A work of this caliber, it wouldn't look out of place in an art museum.
et: Selline töö ei jääks kunstimuuseumiski kohatuks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
en: Huh? An art museum really is looking for paintings?
et: Mis? Kunstimuuseum otsib tõesti maale?
