label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITakePaintingToMuseum
en: Do you think I should take this there?
et: Kas arvad, et peaksin selle sinna viima?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
en: What, really? Then, sure, I will take this painting there right now.
et: Mis, tõesti? Siis ma muidugi viin selle maali kohe sinna.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
en: I'll give it a proper title, too.
et: Ma annan sellele ka korraliku pealkirja.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
en: I hope they'll like it and consider exhibiting this.
et: Loodan, et see neile meeldib ja nad kaaluvad selle väljapanekut.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePaintingToMuseum
en: Please check if they did accept this. Thank you!
et: Palun kontrolli, kas nad selle vastu võtsid. Aitäh!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
en: Oh, that's right!
et: Ah, tõsi ju!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMementoOfPainting
en: As a memento of me painting your POKéMON, please take this.
et: Võta see mälestuseks sellest, et ma su POKéMONi maalisin.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ReceivedARibbon
en: {PLAYER} received a RIBBON.
et: {PLAYER} sai RIBBONi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PutTheRibbonOnMon
en: {PLAYER} put the RIBBON on {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} kinnitas RIBBONi POKéMONile {STR_VAR_1}.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_OkaySeeYou
en: Okay, see you!
et: Olgu, näeme!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
en: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take this home with me…
et: Oh… Siis vist võtan selle lihtsalt endaga koju…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeButIdLikeToTakeToMuseum
en: But, you know, I would like to take this to the art museum… Okay?
et: Aga tead, ma sooviksin selle kunstimuuseumi viia… Olgu?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
en: Oh, fine, that's the way it is. I will hang this in my own house.
et: Oh, hüva, olgu nii. Riputan selle siis omaenda koju seinale.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThatsTheWayItIs
en: I'll just have to try harder next time. Well, be seeing you.
et: Pean lihtsalt järgmine kord kõvemini pingutama. Noh, näeme.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
en: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS, here I come.
et: Ohhoo… MEISTRIJÄRGU VÕISTLUSED, ma tulen.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRankHereICome
en: The world will know that my dearest POKéMON is the cutest being in all existence. The time has come! Uheheheh.
et: Maailm saab teada, et mu kallis POKéMON on kõige nunnum olend kogu ilmas. Aeg on käes! Uheheheh.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
en: You can see a whole variety of POKéMON here.
et: Siin näeb igasuguseid POKéMONe.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVarietyOfPokemonHere
en: That's why I make this place a regular part of my daily stroll.
et: Seepärast põikan ma oma igapäevasel jalutuskäigul alati siia sisse.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
en: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is a feast for these eyes!
et: Ohoo, VÕISTLUSELE tulek on silmadele lausa pidu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFeastForEyes
en: Would you look at all the POKéMON that just scream to be painted?
et: Vaata ometi kõiki neid POKéMONe, keda lihtsalt peab maalima!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
en: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like extreme, man!
et: KÕVA VÕISTLUS on ikka päris ekstreemne, mees!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughContestIsExtreme
en: Those muscular appeals… Cascading sweat… I swoon!
et: Need lihaselised etteasted… Voolav higi… Ma minestan ära!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
en: Day in and day out, I lavished my care on this POKéMON.
et: Päevast päeva olen selle POKéMONi eest hoolega hoolitsenud.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedCareOnMon
en: Its condition is peaking. Today, victory is mine!
et: Ta on parimas vormis. Täna on võit minu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
en: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and Big Sister. They turned out great!
et: Ma tegin {POKEBLOCK}e koos emme, issi ja vanema õega. Need tulid suurepärased!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeblocksWithFamily
en: I bet you can make smoother, better {POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.
et: Kui teid on rohkem, tulevad {POKEBLOCK}id kindlasti siledamad ja paremad.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
en: Yes? If you're looking for STERN, that would be me.
et: Jah? Kui otsid STERNI, siis see olen mina.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
en: Ah! Those must be the parts I ordered from MR. STONE of DEVON.
et: Ah! Need on vist osad, mille ma DEVONI MR. STONE käest tellisin.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ThankYouForTheParts
en: Thank you! That's great! We can prepare for our expedition now.
et: Aitäh! See on suurepärane! Me saame nüüd oma ekspeditsiooniks valmistuda.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WellTakeThoseParts
en: Hehehe, hold it! We'll take those parts!
et: Hehehe, pea kinni! Me võtame need osad!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternWhoAreYou
en: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what? Who are you people?
et: CAPT. STERN: M-mida? Kes teie olete?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
en: We're TEAM AQUA!
et: Me oleme TEAM AQUA!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WereTeamAqua
en: Our BOSS wants those parts! Shut your yap and fork them over!
et: Meie BOSS tahab neid osi! Pane suu kinni ja anna need siia!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Awaaaah! A kid beat me!
et: Awaaaah! Mind võitis üks laps!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_BossGoingToBeFurious
en: Oh, man, what a disaster… The BOSS is going to be furious…
et: Oi ei, milline katastroof… BOSS läheb marru…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetMeTakeCareOfThis
en: Humph, sniveling wimp! Let me take care of this!
et: Hmpf, virisev nõrguke! Lase mul sellega tegeleda!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: What?! I lost, too!
et: Mida?! Minagi kaotasin!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
en: Now what? If we don't get the parts, we're in for it!
et: Mis nüüd? Kui me neid osi kätte ei saa, on meil kõva jama!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_MeddlingKid
en: Arrgh, I didn't count on being meddled with by some meddling kid!
et: Arrgh, ma ei osanud arvata, et mingi pealetükkiv jõmpsikas vahele segab!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_CameToSeeWhatsTakingSoLong
en: I came to see what was taking so long to snatch some parts, and you simps are held up by a mere child?
et: Tulin vaatama, miks paari osa näppamine nii kaua võtab, ja teid, lollpäid, peab kinni mingi lapsuke?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: We are TEAM AQUA, and we love the sea!
et: Me oleme TEAM AQUA ja me armastame merd!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: And I am TEAM AQUA's leader, ARCHIE!
et: Ja mina olen TEAM AQUA juht, ARCHIE!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: What makes you interfere with us?
et: Miks sa meie asjadesse sekkud?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: …No! You can't be! You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?
et: …Ei! Ei või olla! Sa ju ei ole TEAM MAGMA liige?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: Wait, that can't be right. You're not dressed for the part.
et: Oota, miski ei klapi. Sul pole ju õiget mundrit seljas.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: POKéMON, people… All life depends on the sea.
et: POKéMONid, inimesed… Kogu elu sõltub merest.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: So, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to the expansion of the sea.
et: Seepärast on TEAM AQUA pühendunud mere laiendamisele.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: Don't you agree? What we are doing is a magnificent undertaking.
et: Kas sa pole nõus? Meie ettevõtmine on ju suurejooneline!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: Ah, fine… You're still too young to understand our noble objective.
et: Ah, hea küll… Sa oled ikka liiga noor, et meie üllast eesmärki mõista.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: But, I warn you, don't even consider interfering with our plans again.
et: Aga ma hoiatan: ära isegi mõtle veel kord meie plaanidesse sekkuda.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: The consequences will cost you dearly!
et: Tagajärjed maksavad sulle kallilt kätte!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_ArchieWarning
en: And don't you forget it!
et: Ja ära seda unusta!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
en: CAPT. STERN: You're… Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: CAPT. STERN: Sa oled… Ah, olgu, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
en: Anyway, that was a tense situation! Thank you for saving us!
et: Igatahes, see oli pingeline olukord! Aitäh, et meid päästsid!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternThankYouForSavingUs
en: Oh, yes, I almost forgot that you even brought the parts from DEVON!
et: Oh jaa, peaaegu unustasin — sa tõid ju ka DEVONI osad kohale!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
en: CAPT. STERN: Whoops! There's no time to lose!
et: CAPT. STERN: Uups! Pole aega raisata!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
en: We have to set out on our ocean-floor expedition really soon.
et: Peame juba päris pea merepõhja ekspeditsioonile asuma.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
en: Thanks again, but now I've got to go!
et: Aitäh veel kord, aga nüüd pean ma minema!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SternIveGotToGo
en: Feel free to wander around and check out our facilities, though.
et: Aga uitle julgesti ringi ja vaata meie maja rahulikult üle.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
en: I saw a model of a ship here.
et: Ma nägin siin laeva mudelit.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_RemindsMeOfAbandonedShip
en: It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP near DEWFORD TOWN…
et: See meenutas mulle ABANDONED SHIPi DEWFORD LINNA lähedal…

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DontRunInMuseum
en: Don't you dare run around inside the MUSEUM!
et: Ära julge MUUSEUMIS ringi joosta!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WantToRideSubmarine
en: Wow, the submarine's awesome! I want to go for a ride!
et: Vau, allveelaev on äge! Ma tahaks sellega sõitma minna!

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
en: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the label says.
et: „VEEKVALITEEDI NÄIDIS 1,” ütleb silt.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample1
en: The sea is all connected, but the water seems to differ by region.
et: Meri on kõikjal üks ja seesama, aga vesi näib piirkonniti erinevat.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
en: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the label says.
et: „VEEKVALITEEDI NÄIDIS 2,” ütleb silt.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_WaterQualitySample2
en: Does the saltiness of seawater differ by region, too?
et: Kas merevee soolasus erineb samuti piirkonniti?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
en: A rubber ball is expanding and shrinking.
et: Kummipall paisub ja tõmbub kokku.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
en: “In the sea, the weight of water itself exerts pressure.
et: „Meres avaldab vee enda raskus survet.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
en: “In shallow water, the pressure is not very heavy.
et: „Madalas vees pole surve eriti suur.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_PressureExperiment
en: “However, in extremely deep water, the pressure can reach even tens of thousands of tons on a small area.”
et: „Ent väga sügavas vees võib surve väikesel alal ulatuda isegi kümnete tuhandete tonnideni.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
en: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION”
et: „HOENNI PIIRKONNA MUDEL”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
en: It's a miniature diorama of the HOENN region.
et: See on HOENNI piirkonna miniatuurne dioraama.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_HoennModel
en: Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?
et: Kus on sellel LITTLEROOT LINN?

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
en: It's a display on the flow of seawater.
et: See on väljapanek merevee liikumisest.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_DeepSeawaterDisplay
en: “Near the bottom of the sea, water flows due to differences in such factors as temperature and salinity.”
et: „Merepõhja lähedal paneb vee liikuma temperatuuri ja soolsuse erinevus.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
en: It's a display on the flow of seawater.
et: See on väljapanek merevee liikumisest.

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SurfaceSeawaterDisplay
en: “Toward the surface, seawater flows as currents driven by the winds.”
et: „Pinna lähedal liigub merevesi hoovustena, mida ajavad tuuled.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
en: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL
et: „PRAAM S.S. TIDAL

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTidalReplica
en: “A scale replica of the ship under construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”
et: „Mõõtkavas koopia laevast, mida STERNI laevatehases praegu ehitatakse.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
en: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1
et: „SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SubmarineReplica
en: “A replica of the high-performance ocean floor exploration submarine.”
et: „Koopia võimsast allveelaevast, millega uuritakse merepõhja.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
en: “SUBMERSIBLE POD
et: „VEEALUNE KAPSEL

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SumbersibleReplica
en: “A replica of a compact, unmanned pod for seafloor exploration.”
et: „Koopia väikesest mehitamata kapslist, millega uuritakse merepõhja.”

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
en: “S.S. ANNE
et: „S.S. ANNE

label: SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAnneReplica
en: “A replica of the luxury liner that circles the globe.”
et: „Koopia luksuslaevast, mis sõidab ümber maakera.”

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Ahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: I'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR. I did my training on MT. PYRE.
et: Mina olen PHOEBE ELIITNELIKUST. Ma treenisin end MT. PYRE mäel.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: While I trained, I gained the ability to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.
et: Treenides omandasin võime suhelda KUMMITUS-tüüpi POKéMONidega.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Yes, the bond I developed with POKéMON is extremely tight.
et: Jah, minu side POKéMONidega on ülimalt tugev.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: So, come on, just try and see if you can even inflict damage on my POKéMON!
et: Nii et anna tulla, proovi ja vaata, kas suudad mu POKéMONidele üldse kahju teha!

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Oh, darn. I've gone and lost.
et: Oh, pagan. Võtsin ja kaotasin.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: There's a definite bond between you and your POKéMON, too.
et: Ka sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel on kindel side.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: I didn't recognize it, so it's only natural that I lost.
et: Ma ei märganud seda, nii et pole ime, et kaotasin.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Yup, I'd like to see how far your bond will carry you.
et: Jah, ma sooviksin näha, kui kaugele su side sind kannab.

label: EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Go ahead, move on to the next room.
et: Mine aga edasi järgmisse ruumi.

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
en: The DEVON CORPORATION… We all just shorten it to DEVON.
et: DEVON CORPORATION… Me kõik lihtsalt lühendame selle DEVONIKS.

label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
en: That company makes all sorts of convenient products.
et: See firma valmistab igasuguseid mugavaid tooteid.

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
en: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?
et: Hm? Kahtlase olemisega mees?

label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
en: Come to think of it, yes, a shadylooking guy went around the corner.
et: Kui järele mõelda, siis jah, üks kahtlase väljanägemisega sell läks nurga taha.

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
en: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM challenge?
et: Kas oled POKéMON SAALI väljakutse vastu võtnud?

label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
en: When you get that shiny GYM BADGE in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to realize what is required of them.
et: Kui läikiv SAALIMÄRK on käes, siis vist hakkab TRAINER mõistma, mida temalt oodatakse.

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
en: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!
et: Hei, see on ju RUSTBORO SAALIMÄRK!

label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
en: Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES, RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.
et: Minu meelest on kõigist POKéMON SAALIMÄRKIDEST RUSTBORO oma kõige ägedam.

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
en: Oh? Who might you be? You're a new face around these parts.
et: Oh? Kes sina olla võiksid? Sa oled siin kandis uus nägu.

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere
en: Have you just transferred into the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?
et: Kas sa astusid just POKéMON TRAINERI KOOLI?

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
en: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…
et: Ma esitasin SAALI JUHILE väljakutse, aga…

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
en: It's not going to be easy winning with my FIRE-type POKéMON…
et: Mu TULE-tüüpi POKéMONidega ei saa võit kerge olema…

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithFire
en: FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up well against ROCK-type POKéMON…
et: TULE-tüüpi POKéMONid ei saa KIVI-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu hästi hakkama…

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
en: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a cottage by the sea.
et: Vana madrus MR. BRINEY elab mereäärses majakeses.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
en: He goes for walks in the tunnel every so often.
et: Ta käib aeg-ajalt tunnelis jalutamas.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
en: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a cottage by the sea.
et: Vana madrus MR. BRINEY elab mereäärses majakeses.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
en: He said he was going shopping in SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.
et: Ta ütles, et läheb SLATEPORTI ostlema oma lemmiku PEEKO jaoks.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
en: That old sea dog, he must really love that PEEKO.
et: Vana merekaru, ta armastab seda PEEKOT tõesti väga.

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
en: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.
et: Ohoo, sinulgi on POKéMONid kaasas.

label: RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon
en: When I get bigger, I'm going to go places with POKéMON, too.
et: Kui ma suuremaks saan, lähen minagi POKéMONidega maailma rändama.

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
en: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!
et: POKéMON TRAINERI KOOL!

label: RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoToSchool
en: If I go to this school, will I be able to catch rare POKéMON easily?
et: Kui ma siia kooli lähen, kas siis oskan kergesti haruldasi POKéMONe püüda?

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
en: If a POKéMON gains experience in battles, it can sometimes change in the way it looks.
et: Kui POKéMON kogub lahingutes kogemust, võib ta vahel hoopis teistsuguse välimuse saada.

label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
en: A POKéMON changes shape? If one did that, I would be shocked!
et: POKéMON muudab kuju? Kui mõni seda teeks, saaksin ma šoki!

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
en: A POKéMON you get in a trade from someone grows fast.
et: POKéMON, kelle saad kelleltki vahetuse teel, kasvab kiiresti.

label: RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast
en: But if you don't have certain GYM BADGES, it may not obey you…
et: Aga kui sul pole teatud SAALIMÄRKE, ei pruugi ta sulle kuuletuda…

label: RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay
en: Get out! Out of the way!
et: Mine ära! Eest ära!

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
en: Wait! Pleeeaaase!
et: Oota! Paluuun!

label: RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods
en: Don't take my GOODS!
et: Ära võta mu KAUPA!

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
en: Oh, it's you!
et: Oh, see oled sina!

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
en: You're that fantastic TRAINER who helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!
et: Sa oled see tubli TRAINER, kes mind PETALBURG WOODSis aitas!

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
en: Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA! I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!
et: Aita mind! TEAM AQUA röövis mind paljaks! Ma pean DEVON GOODSi tagasi saama!

label: RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed
en: If I don't… I'm going to be in serious trouble.
et: Kui ei saa… jään tõsiselt hätta.

label: RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffTowardsTunnel
en: That shady character, I think he took off towards the tunnel over there.
et: See kahtlane tegelane… Ma arvan, et ta pani sealtkandi tunneli poole minema.

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
en: Oh! How did it go? The DEVON GOODS?
et: Oh! Kuidas läks? Kas DEVON GOODS on käes?

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
en: You did! You got them back!
et: Said ikka! Said selle tagasi!

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
en: You really are a great TRAINER!
et: Sa oled tõesti suurepärane TRAINER!

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou
en: I know! As my thanks, I'll give you another GREAT BALL!
et: Ma tean! Tänuks annan ma sulle veel ühe SUPER PALLI!

label: RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems
en: You're loaded with items. I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
et: Su kotis pole enam ruumi. Ma ei saa sulle seda SUPER PALLI anda.

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: Excuse me, please! Please come with me!
et: Vabandust, palun! Palun tule minuga kaasa!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
en: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
en: You had a MATCH CALL feature put on your POKéNAV!
et: Sa lasksid oma POKéNAVi MATCH CALL funktsiooni paigaldada!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister
en: Let's register each other so we can contact one another anytime!
et: Paneme teineteise kirja, siis saame igal ajal ühendust võtta!

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredMay
en: Registered MAY in the POKéNAV.
et: MAY registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.
et: MAY: Oh, muide, PETALBURG WOODSis jäi mulle vastu MR. BRINEY.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: I guess he's on his way home to his cottage by the sea.
et: Ma arvan, et ta on teel koju oma mereäärsesse majakesse.

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: How's your POKéDEX coming along, {PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!
et: Kuidas su POKéDEXI täitmine edeneb, {PLAYER}{KUN}? Minu oma on juba päris kena!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: So… How about a little battle?
et: Nii et… Kuidas oleks väikese lahinguga?

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
en: MAY: Oh, what's the matter?
et: MAY: Oh, mis viga?

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
en: Haven't you caught or raised your POKéMON very much?
et: Kas sa pole oma POKéMONe eriti püüdnud ega kasvatanud?

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough
en: That's not very good for a TRAINER!
et: See pole TRAINERI jaoks kuigi hea!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle
en: MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?
et: MAY: Nii, mis sa arvad? Kuidas oleks siinsamas väikese lahinguga?

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose
en: MAY: You just became a TRAINER, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
et: MAY: Sa alles said TRAINERiks, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Ma ei kavatse kaotada!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat
en: Yikes! You're better than I expected!
et: Oih! Sa oled parem, kui ma ootasin!

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
en: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who I just passed…
et: MAY: Oh, muide, see MR. BRINEY, kes mulle just vastu jäi…

label: RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you might not know this, but MR. BRINEY was once a revered seafarer.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa kolisid alles siia, nii et sa ei pruugi teada — MR. BRINEY oli kunagi lugupeetud meresõitja.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
en: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!
et: BRENDAN: Oh, hei, {PLAYER}!

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
en: You had a MATCH CALL feature put on your POKéNAV! Cool!
et: Sa lasksid oma POKéNAVi MATCH CALL funktsiooni paigaldada! Lahe!

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister
en: Let's register each other so we can get in touch anytime!
et: Paneme teineteise kirja, siis saame igal ajal ühendust võtta!

label: RustboroCity_Text_RegisteredBrendan
en: Registered BRENDAN in the POKéNAV.
et: BRENDAN registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.
et: BRENDAN: Muide, {PLAYER}, PETALBURG WOODSis jäi mulle vastu MR. BRINEY.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: I bet he was on his way home to his cottage by the sea.
et: Küllap ta oli teel koju oma mereäärsesse majakesse.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? Have you filled in any pages yet?
et: {PLAYER}, kuidas su POKéDEXIGA on? Kas oled juba mõne lehekülje täis saanud?

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: Mine rules.
et: Minu oma on võimas.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWantToBattle
en: Want to have a battle to test how far you've progressed?
et: Tahad lahingut, et näha, kui kaugele sa jõudnud oled?

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInPokemon
en: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have any confidence in your POKéMON?
et: BRENDAN: Mis viga? Kas sa ei usu oma POKéMONidesse?

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle
en: BRENDAN: What's up? Want to have a battle with me?
et: BRENDAN: Mis lahti? Tahad minuga lahingu pidada?

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy
en: BRENDAN: I know you just became a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!
et: BRENDAN: Ma tean, et sa alles said TRAINERiks, aga ma ei hakka sind säästma!

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: Hmm… You're pretty good.
et: Hmm… Sa oled päris hea.

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
en: BRENDAN: By the way, you know MR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?
et: BRENDAN: Muide, kas sa tead, kes on MR. BRINEY? See sell, kes mulle just vastu jäi?

label: RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint
en: I bet you didn't know this, since you just moved here, {PLAYER}, but MR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.
et: Küllap sa ei teadnud seda, sest sa alles kolisid siia, {PLAYER}, aga MR. BRINEY oli kunagi kuulus meremees.

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
en: “Timesaving tunnel nearing completion!”
et: „Ajasäästev tunnel valmimas!”

label: RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletion
en: …Is what it says on the sign, but there's also a big “X” splashed across it in red paint…
et: …seisab sildil, aga üle selle on punase värviga tõmmatud suur „X”…

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
en: DEVON CORPORATION
et: DEVON CORPORATION

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign
en: “For all your living needs, we make it all.”
et: „Me valmistame kõike, mida eluks vaja läheb.”

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
en: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: ROXANNE
et: RUSTBORO LINN POKéMON SAALI JUHT: ROXANNE

label: RustboroCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The ROCK-loving honors student!”
et: „KIVE armastav priimus!”

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
en: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE
et: DEVON CORP. HARUKONTOR

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeSign
en: “Access limited to DEVON employees and authorized personnel.”
et: „Sisse pääsevad ainult DEVONI töötajad ja volitatud isikud.”

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
en: RUSTBORO CITY
et: RUSTBORO LINN

label: RustboroCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The city probing the integration of nature and science.”
et: „Linn, mis uurib looduse ja teaduse ühendamist.”

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
en: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL
et: POKéMON TRAINERI KOOL

label: RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign
en: “We'll teach you anything about POKéMON!”
et: „Me õpetame sulle POKéMONide kohta kõike!”

label: RustboroCity_Text_CuttersHouse
en: CUTTER'S HOUSE
et: LÕIKAJA MAJA

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
en: I've been developing an added feature for the POKéNAV…
et: Ma olen arendanud POKéNAVi lisafunktsiooni…

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
en: And it turned out great!
et: Ja see kukkus suurepäraselt välja!

label: RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFeature
en: {PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV? The one our PRESIDENT gave you?
et: {PLAYER}, kas tohin näha seda POKéNAVi? Seda, mille meie PRESIDENT sulle andis?

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
en: There you go, {PLAYER}!
et: Palun, {PLAYER}!

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
en: I added a new feature named MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.
et: Ma lisasin su POKéNAVi uue funktsiooni nimega MATCH CALL.

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
en: Using the MATCH CALL feature, you can chat with people who have been registered in your POKéNAV.
et: MATCH CALL funktsiooni kasutades saad vestelda inimestega, kes on su POKéNAVi registreeritud.

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
en: {PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should be registered in your POKéNAV.
et: {PLAYER}, meie PRESIDENT STONE peaks olema su POKéNAVi registreeritud.

label: RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCallMrStone
en: Test it out. Please give our PRESIDENT a call.
et: Proovi seda. Palun helista meie PRESIDENDILE.

label: RustboroCity_Text_PleaseSelectPokenav
en: Please select the POKéNAV.
et: Palun vali POKéNAV.

label: RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork
en: Okay, I'd better get back to work. Please take care, {PLAYER}!
et: Olgu, ma lähen parem töö juurde tagasi. Hoia end, {PLAYER}!

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
en: Did you know this?
et: Kas teadsid seda?

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
en: You can have a 2-on-2 battle even if you're not with another TRAINER.
et: Sa võid pidada 2-vastu-2 lahingu isegi siis, kui sul pole teist TRAINERIT kaaslaseks.

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
en: If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS when you have two or more POKéMON, they'll both challenge you.
et: Kui sul on kaks või rohkem POKéMONi ja sa jääd korraga kahele TRAINERILE silma, astuvad mõlemad sulle vastu.

label: RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle
en: Don't you think it'd be cool if you could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?
et: Kas sa ei arva, et oleks lahe, kui suudaksid kaks TRAINERit üksinda võita?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
en: What did I do to deserve this guard posting?
et: Millega ma küll selle valvekorra ära teenisin?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro
en: My left ear is burning up!
et: Mu vasak kõrv põleb!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Defeat
en: I'm getting heat exhaustion…
et: Ma saan kuumarabanduse…

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle
en: Do you think it's odd that we're wearing hoods in this magma-filled volcano?
et: Kas sulle tundub veider, et me magmat täis vulkaanis kapuutse kanname?

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
en: We joined so we can help our leader achieve his fantastic vision.
et: Me liitusime selleks, et aidata oma juhil tema suurepärane unistus teoks teha.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
en: I don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA or if you're just some kid passing by.
et: Mind ei huvita, kas sa kuulud TEAM AQUASSE või oled lihtsalt mööda juhtunud jõmpsikas.

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro
en: No one interferes with us and gets away with it!
et: Keegi ei sega meie asju ja pääse sellest puhtalt!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat
en: Oh, no! You're not to be trusted at all!
et: Oh ei! Sind ei saa üldse usaldada!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
en: Listen to me. TEAM MAGMA is right!
et: Kuula mind. TEAM MAGMAL on õigus!

label: MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattle
en: Don't listen to TEAM AQUA. Don't believe their lies!
et: Ära kuula TEAM AQUAT. Ära usu nende valesid!

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
en: We do all right in the preliminary round, but we can never win the appeals…
et: Eelvoorus saame hakkama, aga etteastetes ei võida me kunagi…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_DoAllRightInPreliminary
en: Maybe it means I have to watch what other contestants are doing…
et: Võib-olla tähendab see, et pean jälgima, mida teised osalejad teevad…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
en: See! My POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!
et: Vaata! Mu POKéMON võitis kõik need RIBBONid!

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_MonAllTheseRibbons
en: Have your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS? You can check them on your POKéNAV.
et: Kas su POKéMONid on mõne RIBBONi välja teeninud? Saad neid POKéNAVist vaadata.

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
en: I can't beat GYM LEADERS…
et: Ma ei suuda SAALI JUHTE võita…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
en: I can't win any CONTESTS…
et: Ma ei suuda ühtki VÕISTLUST võita…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_CantWinEverywhere
en: I've been here, there, and everywhere, and it's all for naught…
et: Olen käinud siin ja seal ja igal pool, aga kõik on tühja läinud…

label: FallarborTown_ContestHall_Text_SuperRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS SUPER RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON VÕISTLUSTE SUPER RANGI ETAPP!

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersLiveHere
en: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in this building.
et: Selles majas elavad DEVON CORPORATIONI töötajad.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!
et: SKITTY: Güaaah!

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
en: While speaking about POKéDEXES, I remembered something.
et: POKéDEXidest rääkides meenus mulle midagi.

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
en: I met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when I was searching for rare stones.
et: Kui ma haruldasi kive otsisin, kohtasin üht TRAINERIT nimega STEVEN.

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
en: Hoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON with him.
et: Ohhoo, tal olid kaasas lausa hämmastavad POKéMONid.

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
en: They weren't just rare, they were trained to terrifying extremes!
et: Nad polnud ainult haruldased — nad olid treenitud hirmuäratavalt tugevaks!

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmazingPokemon
en: He might even be stronger than the GYM LEADER in this town…
et: Ta võib olla isegi tugevam kui selle linna SAALI JUHT…

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
en: What's that thing you have there?
et: Mis asi sul seal on?

label: FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex
en: Oh, it's called a POKéDEX? It's really awesome!
et: Oh, seda kutsutakse POKéDEXiks? See on tõesti vägev!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got here ahead of us!
et: Ei! Need TEAM MAGMA sulid jõudsid meist ette!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We can't fall behind!
et: Me ei tohi maha jääda!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: I thought you were one of the MAGMAS who happened to come back…
et: Ma arvasin, et sa oled üks neist MAGMA meestest, kes juhtus tagasi tulema…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Yeah, so you are strong… But there're a lot of us!
et: Jah, nii et sa oled tugev… Aga meid on palju!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Hah! Too bad for you!
et: Hah! Sul veab küll halvasti!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: If you came earlier, you only would've had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.
et: Kui oleksid varem tulnud, oleksid pidanud võitlema vaid nõrga TEAM MAGMAGA.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: But since you arrived now, you have to take on us toughies!
et: Aga et sa tulid alles nüüd, pead jõudu katsuma meie, kõvade poistega!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Urgh… I should've let you take on TEAM MAGMA first…
et: Urgh… Ma oleksin pidanud laskma sul kõigepealt TEAM MAGMAGA jõudu katsuda…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: You don't know anything! So why are you messing with us?
et: Sa ei tea midagi! Nii et miks sa meiega jamad?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: You… We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.
et: Sina… Me nägime sind MT. CHIMNEY otsas.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: You don't belong to either TEAM, so why would you be here?
et: Sa ei kuulu kummassegi jõuku, mis sa siis siin teed?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: If you're going to mess with anyone, let it be TEAM MAGMA…
et: Kui juba kellegagi jamada, siis olgu see TEAM MAGMA…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Heh, it doesn't matter! We bought ourselves some time!
et: Heh, pole tähtis! Me võitsime endale veidi aega!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: The BOSS should have snatched what he was after!
et: Küllap BOSS on selle juba näpanud, mida ta tahtis!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Oh, I know! You tried to join TEAM MAGMA, but they wouldn't have you!
et: Oh, ma tean! Sa üritasid TEAM MAGMAGA liituda, aga nad ei võtnud sind!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Well, don't think that we'll let you join our TEAM AQUA!
et: Noh, ära arva, et me laseme sul meie TEAM AQUAGA liituda!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: If you want to join TEAM AQUA that badly, we can consider it…
et: Kui sa nii väga tahad TEAM AQUAGA liituda, võime seda kaaluda…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: We have a great combination going with us members and our leader.
et: Meie ja meie juht — see on suurepärane kooslus.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
en: ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead of us, but we also got what we wanted.
et: ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA MAXIE jõudis meist ette, aga meiegi saime, mida tahtsime.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
en: The RED ORB preserved at MT. PYRE… I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!
et: MT. PYRE tipus hoitud RED ORB… Mina, ARCHIE, olen selle nüüd endale saanud!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
en: Fufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate objective to fruition!
et: Fufufu… Nüüd saame oma lõpliku eesmärgi ellu viia!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLetsGo
en: Okay, TEAM! We're pulling out!
et: Olgu, TEAM! Me tõmbume tagasi!

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: Oh, no… This cannot happen…
et: Oh, ei… See ei tohi juhtuda…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: Not only the BLUE ORB, but even the RED ORB has been taken…
et: Mitte üksnes BLUE ORB, vaid isegi RED ORB on ära võetud…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never be separated. They belong together.
et: BLUE ORB ja RED ORB ei tohi kunagi lahus olla. Nad kuuluvad kokku.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: What are those men trying to do with the two ORBS?
et: Mida need mehed küll nende kahe ORBIGA teha kavatsevad?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: Oh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came and took the BLUE ORB first?
et: Oh, jah. Kas TEAM MAGMA oligi see, kes tuli ja võttis BLUE ORBI esimesena?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: Well, in their haste, they left this behind.
et: Noh, kiirustades jätsid nad selle siia maha.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: I couldn't imagine what exactly it could be.
et: Ma ei osanud ette kujutada, mis see täpselt olla võiks.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLeftThis
en: I would like you to have it. Perhaps it will be useful in some way.
et: Võta sina see endale. Ehk on sellest kuidagi kasu.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
en: The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by those sinister men…
et: BLUE ORB ja RED ORB, mille need kurjad mehed võtsid…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken
en: They must never be apart… I fear something terrible will happen…
et: Nad ei tohi kunagi lahus olla… Ma kardan, et midagi kohutavat juhtub…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: Oh, my goodness…
et: Oh, heldeke…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE have been awakened?
et: Sa ütled, et nii GROUDON kui KYOGRE on äratatud?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: It is said that the BLUE ORB and the RED ORB quelled the rage of the two POKéMON…
et: Öeldakse, et BLUE ORB ja RED ORB vaigistasid nende kahe POKéMONi raevu…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: It is also said that the true owner of the ORBS still exists.
et: Samuti öeldakse, et ORBIDE tõeline omanik on ikka veel olemas.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: However, no one knows who, or what exactly, the ORBS belong to.
et: Ometi ei tea keegi, kellele või millele täpselt ORBID kuuluvad.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened
en: It could be a human, or perhaps a POKéMON, but no one knows.
et: Ehk on see inimene, ehk hoopis POKéMON — keegi ei tea.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
en: The two men who took the ORBS came back to return them on their own.
et: Need kaks meest, kes ORBID võtsid, tulid ise tagasi, et need tagastada.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOrbs
en: Those men… Perhaps they are not so evil after all…
et: Need mehed… Ehk polegi nad nii kurjad, kui arvasin…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
en: The embodiments of the land, sea, and the sky…
et: Maismaa, mere ja taeva kehastused…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
en: That is said to be the identities of the super-ancient POKéMON…
et: Räägitakse, et just sellised ongi ürgvanad POKéMONid…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
en: In the same way that we humans and POKéMON have life, our world, too, is alive…
et: Nii nagu meis, inimestes, ja POKéMONides on elu, on ka meie maailm elus…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTaughtUs
en: The super-ancient POKéMON have taught us that…
et: Just seda on ürgvanad POKéMONid meile õpetanud…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
en: MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits of POKéMON that have passed on…
et: MT. PYRE on paik, kus me rahustame lahkunud POKéMONide hingi…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
en: This is a high place where one can see all of HOENN…
et: See on kõrge koht, kust näeb kogu HOENNI…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
en: The disembodied spirits of POKéMON must find solace here…
et: POKéMONide kehatud hinged leiavad siit küllap rahu…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
en: Is it coincidence that you are here…
et: Kas on juhus, et sa siin oled…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale
en: Will you hear out my tale? A tale long told in the HOENN region?
et: Kas kuulaksid mu loo ära? Loo, mida on HOENNI piirkonnas kaua räägitud?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: It happened long, long ago…
et: See juhtus kaua, kaua aega tagasi…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The world was wracked by a ferocious clash between the POKéMON of the land and the POKéMON of the sea…
et: Maailma raputas äge kokkupõrge maismaa POKéMONi ja mere POKéMONi vahel…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The POKéMON of the land raised mountains and created continents…
et: Maismaa POKéMON kergitas mägesid ja lõi mandreid…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The POKéMON of the sea raised huge waves and carved out oceans…
et: Mere POKéMON tõstis tohutuid laineid ja uuristas ookeane…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: Their fierce duel raged without end.
et: Nende äge heitlus möllas lõputult.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The world was engulfed in massive infernos and vicious storms.
et: Maailma neelasid hiiglaslikud tulemered ja marutormid.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought an end to the calamity.
et: BLUE ORB ja RED ORB tegid katastroofile lõpu.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: Light poured from the two ORBS and becalmed the enraged adversaries.
et: Mõlemast ORBist voogas valgust, mis rahustas raevunud vastased.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale
en: The pair, made docile, dove deep into the sea where eventually they disappeared…
et: Taltunud paar sukeldus sügavale merre ja kadus sinna lõpuks…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine
en: I see… Well, that, too, is fine…
et: Ahsoo… Noh, eks seegi ole hea…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_MaxieSilence
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}…
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
en: It is my role to pass on the legends of HOENN to future generations.
et: Minu ülesanne on anda HOENNI legendid edasi tulevastele põlvedele.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
en: And the crisis that just ended in SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…
et: Ja kriis, mis just SOOTOPOLISES lõppes, kirjutas ühe legendi ümber…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoenn
en: Have you the time to hear the new legend of HOENN?
et: Kas sul on aega kuulata HOENNI uut legendi?

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: It happened long, long ago…
et: See juhtus kaua, kaua aega tagasi…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: The world was wracked by a ferocious clash between the POKéMON of the land and the POKéMON of the sea…
et: Maailma raputas äge kokkupõrge maismaa POKéMONi ja mere POKéMONi vahel…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: The POKéMON of the land raised mountains and created continents…
et: Maismaa POKéMON kergitas mägesid ja lõi mandreid…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: The POKéMON of the sea raised huge waves and carved out oceans…
et: Mere POKéMON tõstis tohutuid laineid ja uuristas ookeane…

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: Their fierce duel raged without end.
et: Nende äge heitlus möllas lõputult.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: The world was engulfed in massive fires and vicious storms.
et: Maailma neelasid hiiglaslikud tulekahjud ja marutormid.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: It was then that the POKéMON of the sky descended from a storm.
et: Just siis laskus taeva POKéMON tormist alla.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: The POKéMON, shining a vivid green, becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.
et: See POKéMON, kirka rohelisena helendades, rahustas kaks raevunud POKéMONi.

label: MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale
en: Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON flew off into the wild blue yonder…
et: Siis, kui ta kohus oli täidetud, lendas roheline POKéMON kaugesse sinisesse avarusse…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: DAD: Hm?
et: ISA: Hm?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}! So you're all finished moving in?
et: Näe, kes siin on — {PLAYER}! Kas kolimine on juba tehtud?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: I'm surprised that you managed to get here by yourself.
et: Üllatav, et sa omal jõul siia jõudsid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: Oh, I see. You're with your POKéMON.
et: Ahaa, selge. Sul on oma POKéMON kaasas.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: Hm… Then I guess you're going to become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.
et: Hm… Küllap saab sinust siis minusugune TRAINER, {PLAYER}.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithYourPokemon
en: That's great news! I'll be looking forward to it!
et: Suurepärane uudis! Ootan seda huviga!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokemon
en: Um… I… I'd like to get a POKéMON, please…
et: Ee… Ma… Ma tahaksin endale POKéMONi, palun…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRight
en: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right. You're WALLY, right?
et: ISA: Hm? Sa oled… Ee… Ah jaa. Sa oled WALLY, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
en: WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.
et: WALLY: Ma lähen elama oma sugulaste juurde VERDANTURF LINNA.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
en: I thought I would be lonely by myself, so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.
et: Mõtlesin, et mul hakkab üksinda igav, ja tahtsin POKéMONi kaasa võtta.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaughtAPokemon
en: But I've never caught a POKéMON before. I don't know how…
et: Aga ma pole kunagi varem POKéMONi püüdnud. Ma ei tea, kuidas…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHmISee
en: DAD: Hm. I see.
et: ISA: Hm. Selge.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
en: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that, right?
et: ISA: {PLAYER}, sa kuulsid seda, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWally
en: Go with WALLY and make sure that he safely catches a POKéMON.
et: Mine temaga kaasa ja hoolitse, et ta POKéMONi ohutult kätte saaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
en: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.
et: WALLY, näe, ma laenan sulle oma POKéMONi.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigzagoon
en: WALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!
et: WALLY sai ZIGZAGOONi!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
en: WALLY: Oh, wow! A POKéMON!
et: WALLY: Oi, ohoo! POKéMON!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
en: DAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too. Go for it!
et: ISA: Hm. Ma annan sulle ka POKé PALLI. Anna minna!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndDadGivesPokeBall
en: WALLY received a POKé BALL!
et: WALLY sai POKé PALLI!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyOhWowThankYou
en: WALLY: Oh, wow! Thank you!
et: WALLY: Oi, ohoo! Aitäh!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyComeWithMe
en: {PLAYER}… Would you really come with me?
et: {PLAYER}… Kas sa tõesti tuleksid minuga kaasa?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut
en: DAD: So, did it work out?
et: ISA: Noh, kas läks korda?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did. Here's your POKéMON back.
et: WALLY: Aitäh, jah, läks küll. Siin on su POKéMON tagasi.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: {PLAYER}, thank you for coming along with me.
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh, et minuga kaasa tulid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: You two are why I was able to catch my POKéMON.
et: Just tänu teile kahele sain ma oma POKéMONi kätte.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: I promise I'll take really good care of it.
et: Luban, et hoolitsen tema eest väga hästi.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: Oh! My mom's waiting for me, so I have to go!
et: Oh! Mu ema ootab mind, nii et ma pean minema!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye
en: Bye, {PLAYER}!
et: Nägemist, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: DAD: Now…
et: ISA: Nii…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: {PLAYER}, if you want to become a strong TRAINER, here's my advice.
et: {PLAYER}, kui tahad tugevaks TRAINERiks saada, siis kuula mu nõu.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: Head for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this town.
et: Suundu siit linnast edasi RUSTBORO LINNA.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: There, you should challenge the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE.
et: Seal peaksid välja kutsuma SAALI JUHI ROXANNE.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: After her, go on to other POKéMON GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.
et: Pärast teda mine teistesse POKéMON SAALIDESSE ja alista nende JUHID.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: Collect BADGES from them, understood?
et: Kogu neilt MÄRKE, selge?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: Of course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too. We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}.
et: Muidugi olen minagi SAALI JUHT. Ükskord me veel võitleme, {PLAYER}.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadges
en: But that's only after you become stronger.
et: Aga alles siis, kui oled tugevamaks saanud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
en: DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?
et: ISA: Hm? Kas sa ei lähegi RUSTBORO LINNA POKéMON SAALI?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
en: There's no challenge for me to battle a greenhorn TRAINER.
et: Kogenematu TRAINERIGA võitlemine ei paku mulle mingit väljakutset.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
en: {PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me when you become a lot stronger.
et: {PLAYER}, kutsu mind välja siis, kui oled palju tugevamaks saanud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustboro
en: I'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?
et: Ma astun sinuga vastamisi, {PLAYER}, kui näitad mulle nelja SAALIMÄRKI, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
en: DAD: I see… So, you've beaten the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.
et: ISA: Ahsoo… Nii et sa alistasid RUSTBORO LINNA SAALI JUHI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
en: But there are many more TRAINERS who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}.
et: Aga on veel palju TRAINEReid, kes on sinust tugevamad, {PLAYER}.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
en: Across the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.
et: Üle mere DEWFORD LINNAS on SAALI JUHT nimega BRAWLY.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford
en: You should go challenge him.
et: Mine kutsu ta välja.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
en: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten stronger.
et: ISA: Hm… {PLAYER}, sa oled tugevamaks saanud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStronger
en: I can tell by the number of BADGES that you've earned.
et: Näen seda MÄRKIDE arvu järgi, mille oled välja teeninud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: DAD: Hm… So, you did get four GYM BADGES.
et: ISA: Hm… Nii et sa said tõesti neli SAALIMÄRKI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: Fine, as I promised, we will have a POKéMON battle.
et: Hea küll, nagu lubasin, peame POKéMON-lahingu.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: {PLAYER}…
et: {PLAYER}…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: I'm so happy that I can have a real battle with my own child.
et: Olen nii rõõmus, et saan pidada päris lahingu omaenda lapsega.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: But, a battle is a battle!
et: Aga lahing on lahing!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: I will do everything in my power as a GYM LEADER to win.
et: SAALI JUHINA teen ma võidu nimel kõik, mis suudan.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro
en: {PLAYER}, you'd better give it your best shot, too!
et: {PLAYER}, anna sinagi endast parim!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
en: I… I can't…
et: Ma… Ma ei suuda…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
en: I can't believe it. {PLAYER}…
et: Ma ei suuda seda uskuda. {PLAYER}…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
en: I lost to {PLAYER}?
et: Kas ma tõesti kaotasin sulle, {PLAYER}?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat
en: But, rules are rules! Here, take this.
et: Aga reeglid on reeglid! Näe, võta see.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE from DAD!
et: {PLAYER} sai ISALT MÄRGI BALANCE BADGE!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE of all your POKéMON will increase.
et: ISA: Selle MÄRGIGA suureneb kõigi su POKéMONide KAITSE.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: POKéMON that know the HM move SURF will be able to travel over water.
et: POKéMONid, kes oskavad HM-võtet SURF, saavad vee peal liikuda.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBadgeTakeThis
en: This is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm sure you can use it correctly.
et: See on mu kink sulle. {PLAYER}, ma olen kindel, et oskad seda õigesti kasutada.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.
et: ISA: TM42 sisaldab võtet FACADE.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: It doubles the power of moves if the POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed, or burned.
et: See kahekordistab võtete jõu, kui POKéMON on mürgitatud, halvatud või põleb.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFacade
en: It might be able to turn a bad situation into an advantage.
et: See võib halva olukorra hoopis eeliseks pöörata.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
en: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't express how upset I am…
et: ISA: SAALI JUHINA ei suuda ma väljendada, kui pettunud ma olen…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad
en: But as a father, it makes me both happy and a little sad. It's odd…
et: Aga isana teeb see mind nii õnnelikuks kui ka veidi kurvaks. See on veider…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ah, siin sa oledki, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: Please come with me. I have something I want you to have.
et: Palun tule minuga kaasa. Mul on midagi, mida ma tahan sulle anda.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
en: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you?
et: NORMAN, sa ei pane pahaks, ega ju?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer
en: Let me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for a minute or two.
et: Laenaksin su {PLAYER}{KUN} minutiks-paariks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit your mother every so often.
et: ISA: {PLAYER}, käi vahetevahel ka ema vaatamas.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: I'm going to stay here and redouble my training.
et: Mina jään siia ja hakkan kaks korda kõvemini treenima.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTraining
en: It would bother me as a TRAINER to not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!
et: TRAINERINA ei annaks mulle rahu, kui ma seda kaotust sulle kätte ei maksaks, {PLAYER}!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going?
et: ISA: {PLAYER}, kuidas läheb?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: The world of POKéMON is deep.
et: POKéMONide maailm on sügav.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrainingIsEnough
en: I honestly think that no amount of training would ever be enough.
et: Ausalt öeldes tundub mulle, et treeningust ei ole kunagi küllalt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Hei, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The doors in this GYM open when you beat the awaiting TRAINERS.
et: Selle SAALI uksed avanevad siis, kui alistad seal ootavad TRAINERID.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Whoops! The doors in this room are already open, so don't attack me!
et: Uups! Selle ruumi uksed on juba lahti, nii et ära ründa mind!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM use all kinds of items.
et: PETALBURG SAALI TRAINERID kasutavad igasuguseid esemeid.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The door at the left leads to the SPEED ROOM.
et: Vasakpoolne uks viib KIIRUSE RUUMI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The door at the right leads to the ACCURACY ROOM.
et: Parempoolne uks viib TÄPSUSE RUUMI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The room's name will be on the door, so choose carefully.
et: Ruumi nimi on ukse peal, nii et vali hoolikalt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Once you've chosen the door… Well, hey, go for it!
et: Kui oled ukse valinud… Noh, hei, anna minna!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even your own father!
et: {PLAYER}! Ohoo! Sa oled võitnud isegi omaenda isa!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Like, whoa! What a stunning turn of events!
et: Ohhoo! Milline vapustav sündmuste pööre!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
en: The ability to attack before the opponent…
et: Võime rünnata enne vastast…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro
en: Just that alone puts me at a great advantage, don't you agree?
et: Juba ainuüksi see annab mulle suure eelise, kas pole nii?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallDefeat
en: That was a magnificent battle!
et: See oli suurepärane lahing!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: Go on to the next room where a new challenge awaits you.
et: Mine edasi järgmisse ruumi, kus sind ootab uus väljakutse.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: At the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.
et: Vasakul on SEGADUSE RUUM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle
en: The right door leads to the DEFENSE ROOM.
et: Parempoolne uks viib KAITSE RUUMI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
en: Whomever you beat, and whomever you may lose to, you never shirk from training yourself and your POKéMON.
et: Keda sa ka ei alistaks ja kellele sa ka ei kaotaks — enda ja oma POKéMONide treenimisest sa kunagi kõrvale ei hiili.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge
en: That's what I think being a GYM LEADER is all about.
et: Just seda tähendab minu arust SAALI JUHT olla.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
en: This is the CONFUSION ROOM.
et: See on SEGADUSE RUUM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro
en: Let me see how well bonded you are with your POKéMON!
et: Vaatame, kui tugev side sul oma POKéMONidega on!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat
en: I couldn't confuse your team enough… You share a strong bond together.
et: Ma ei suutnud su meeskonda piisavalt segadusse ajada… Teil on omavahel tugev side.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle
en: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM. Can you withstand brute force?
et: Järgmine ruum on JÕU RUUM. Kas suudad toorele jõule vastu pidada?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge
en: After you beat our LEADER, the training has become a lot tougher.
et: Pärast seda, kui sa meie JUHI alistasid, on treening palju karmimaks muutunud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: Just when you think you're going to win, your opponent restores HP…
et: Just siis, kui arvad, et võidad, taastab vastane oma HP…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: Can you just imagine how awful that must feel?
et: Kas kujutad ette, kui õudne tunne see on?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro
en: I'll show you exactly how awful it feels!
et: Ma näitan sulle täpselt, kui õudne see tunne on!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat
en: I couldn't restore HP enough… What ATTACK power…
et: Ma ei suutnud küllalt HP taastada… Milline RÜNNAKU jõud…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: I should have expected no less from our LEADER's kid.
et: Meie JUHI lapselt polnudki vähemat oodata.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: No, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are earned only through effort.
et: Ei, oota! TRAINERI oskused tulevad ainult vaevaga.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: I lost because my own efforts weren't enough.
et: Ma kaotasin, sest mu enda pingutused ei olnud piisavad.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle
en: Go on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.
et: Mine edasi! ÜHE-LÖÖGI KO RUUM on järgmine.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge
en: I'm going to keep training at GYMS. One day, I'll become a LEADER.
et: Ma jätkan SAALIDES treenimist. Ühel päeval saan JUHIKS.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
en: I'm not going to take it easy just because you're our LEADER's kid.
et: Ma ei kavatse leebe olla lihtsalt sellepärast, et sa meie JUHI laps oled.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro
en: I'll show you how horrid it is for a POKéMON to take a critical hit!
et: Ma näitan sulle, kui õudne on POKéMONil kriitiline tabamus vastu võtta!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat
en: Your power… You're the real deal.
et: Su jõud… Sinus on ikka asja.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: Your father really is strong. He's a TRAINER worth my respect.
et: Su isa on tõesti tugev. Ta on TRAINER, kes väärib mu austust.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: And, I sense the same glow coming from you as your father.
et: Ja ma aiman sinust sama sära, mis su isast.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle
en: I hope that you'll stage a terrific battle with your father!
et: Ma loodan, et sa pead oma isaga suurepärase lahingu!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge
en: Since your dad became the LEADER, the TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have become a lot tougher.
et: Sellest ajast, kui su isa JUHIKS sai, on PETALBURG LINNA TRAINERID palju karmimaks muutunud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
en: Giggle… This is the ACCURACY ROOM.
et: Hihii… See on TÄPSUSE RUUM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro
en: It's pretty nasty when every attack lands without fail.
et: On päris vastik, kui iga rünnak tabab eksimatult.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat
en: You were a cut above me…
et: Sa olid minust astme võrra üle…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: There are some even stronger TRAINERS waiting for you.
et: Sind ootavad veel tugevamad TRAINERID.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: The left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and the right is the RECOVERY ROOM.
et: Vasakul on KAITSE RUUM ja paremal TAASTUMISE RUUM.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle
en: Your POKéMON's ATTACK power will be on trial either way.
et: Kummalgi juhul pannakse su POKéMONide RÜNNAKU jõud proovile.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
en: Do you know what we're trying to achieve as TRAINERS?
et: Kas tead, mida me TRAINERITENA saavutada üritame?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge
en: We're striving to become soul mates with our POKéMON.
et: Me püüdleme selle poole, et saada oma POKéMONidega hingesugulasteks.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro
en: The higher the DEFENSE, the more reckless I can be in attack.
et: Mida kõrgem KAITSE, seda julgemalt võin rünnata.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaDefeat
en: Our defenses weren't enough…
et: Meie kaitse polnud piisav…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: I think you've taught me a valuable lesson here.
et: Sa andsid mulle siin väärtusliku õppetunni.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: Now, go on! The left door goes to the STRENGTH ROOM.
et: Aga nüüd mine edasi! Vasak uks viib JÕU RUUMI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: The right door opens to the ONE-HIT KO ROOM.
et: Parem uks avaneb ÜHE-LÖÖGI KO RUUMI.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle
en: Both of them have TRAINERS who are skilled at offense.
et: Mõlemas on TRAINERID, kes on rünnakus osavad.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge
en: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?
et: Tere! Kas oled proovinud SURFi kasutada?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
en: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out and beat you.
et: Meie SAALI JUHT käskis meil endast kõik anda ja sind alistada.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro
en: Even if you happen to be the LEADER's kid!
et: Isegi kui sa oledki JUHI laps!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyDefeat
en: But… I went all out!
et: Aga… Ma andsin endast kõik!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
en: The way you use your POKéMON… It's like your father's style.
et: See, kuidas sa oma POKéMONe juhid… Päris oma isa käekiri.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle
en: Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your father, is waiting!
et: Mine edasi! SAALI JUHT, su isa, ootab!

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON stronger.
et: Muidugi on hea oma POKéMONe tugevamaks teha.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: But what decides the winner?
et: Aga mis otsustab võitja?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge
en: Why, it's the feelings TRAINERS have for their POKéMON.
et: Eks ikka tunded, mis TRAINERITEL oma POKéMONide vastu on.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked
en: This door appears to be locked right now…
et: Näib, et see uks on praegu lukus…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
en: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „KIIRUSE RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked2
en: This door appears to be locked right now…
et: Näib, et see uks on praegu lukus…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
en: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „TÄPSUSE RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
en: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „SEGADUSE RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
en: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „KAITSE RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
en: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „TAASTUMISE RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
en: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „JÕU RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
en: “ONE-HIT KO ROOM,” the sign says.
et: „ÜHE-LÖÖGI KO RUUM,” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
en: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM
et: „SAALI JUHI RUUM

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
en: “See for yourself what POKéMON await you!” the sign says.
et: „Vaata ise, millised POKéMONid sind ootavad!” ütleb silt.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRoom
en: Do you want to go through?
et: Kas tahad läbi minna?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
et: PETALBURG LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
et: PETALBURG LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: NORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: NORMANI SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… I had a feeling that you would come.
et: ISA: {PLAYER}… Mul oli tunne, et sa tuled.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: I would never refuse to accept a challenge from you.
et: Ma ei keelduks kunagi sinu väljakutset vastu võtmast.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: You do understand, don't you?
et: Sa saad ju aru, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that we are a parent and child.
et: SAALIS pole tähtis, et me oleme vanem ja laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPreRematch
en: …No, because we are parent and child, we owe it to each other to do the best we can. Isn't that right, {PLAYER}?
et: …Ei, just seepärast, et oleme isa ja laps, võlgneme teineteisele oma parima. Kas pole nii, {PLAYER}?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefeat
en: Uh… Haha… Maybe that was going too hard…
et: Ee… Hahaa… Vist läks veidi liiga kõvaks…

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… What is your dream?
et: ISA: {PLAYER}… Mis on sinu unistus?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanPostRematch
en: My dream… Hahaha… It has already come true, actually.
et: Minu unistus… Hahaha… See on tegelikult juba täitunud.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: DAD: {PLAYER}… I had a feeling that you would come.
et: ISA: {PLAYER}… Mul oli tunne, et sa tuled.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I would never refuse to accept a challenge from you.
et: Ma ei keelduks kunagi sinu väljakutset vastu võtmast.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: You do understand, don't you?
et: Sa saad ju aru, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that we are a parent and child.
et: SAALIS pole tähtis, et me oleme vanem ja laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Hm? Wait a second, {PLAYER}.
et: Hm? Oota hetk, {PLAYER}.

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Do you only have one POKéMON that is capable of battle?
et: Kas sul ongi vaid üks võitlusvõimeline POKéMON?

label: PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Sorry, but you'll have to come back with at least two POKéMON.
et: Vabandust, aga sa pead tagasi tulema vähemalt kahe POKéMONiga.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
en: By being together with POKéMON, people make more and more friends.
et: POKéMONidega koos olles saavad inimesed üha rohkem sõpru.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldCloserTogether
en: And that brings the world closer together. I think it's wonderful!
et: Ja nii saab maailm üha lähedasemaks. Minu arust on see imeline!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_GoBirdPokemon
en: There! Go, BIRD POKéMON!
et: Nii! Lenda, LINNU-POKéMON!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRunErrand
en: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run an errand for me.
et: Hehee, mu WINGULL käis mul asja ajamas.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: Good! Welcome back, WINGULL!
et: Tubli! Tere tulemast tagasi, WINGULL!

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: Huh? What is this? What is it holding?
et: Ää? Mis see on? Mida ta hoiab?

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: A MENTAL HERB? It must have picked it up somewhere.
et: MENTAL HERB? Küllap korjas ta selle kuskilt üles.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTakeMentalHerb
en: But I'm not a TRAINER, so you can have it.
et: Aga mina pole TRAINER, nii et võta see endale.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayThanksToWingull
en: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends who live far away.
et: Mu WINGULL on mulle toonud sõpru, kes elavad kaugel.

label: FortreeCity_House4_Text_Wingull
en: WINGULL: Pihyoh!
et: WINGULL: Pihjoh!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ammu pole näinud!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: Oh? While I visited the hot springs, you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.
et: Oh? Sel ajal kui mina kuumaveeallikates käisin, said sina LAVARIDGE SAALIMÄRGI.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: You must have collected good POKéMON… No, I believe you raised some.
et: Küllap oled head POKéMONid kokku korjanud… Ei, ma usun, et sa oled nad ise üles kasvatanud.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: I guess it would be okay for you to have this.
et: Vist võin selle sulle anda.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll have no trouble getting through the desert near ROUTE 111.
et: MAY: GO-GOGGLES peas pääsed sa ROUTE 111 kõrbest hõlpsasti läbi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: But, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}… Challenging GYMS…
et: Aga ohoo, {PLAYER}{KUN}… Sa käidki SAALE alistamas…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: You're trying hard because you don't want to lose to me, I bet!
et: Vean kihla, et sa pingutad nii kõvasti sellepärast, et ei taha mulle kaotada!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge your dad in PETALBURG GYM.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma arvan, et peaksin su isa PETALBURG SAALIS välja kutsuma.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: See you again!
et: Näeme veel!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while. How's it going?
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hei, ammu pole näinud. Kuidas läheb?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: Hmm… That's a decent collection of BADGES.
et: Hmm… Päris korralik MÄRKIDE kogu sul.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTakeThis
en: All right, then. You may as well have this.
et: Hüva siis. Võta see endale.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're planning on going into that desert near ROUTE 111.
et: BRENDAN: Hoia neid kaasas, kui plaanid minna sinna kõrbe ROUTE 111 lähedal.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: There should be some POKéMON that are exclusively desert-dwellers. You might look around for those.
et: Seal peaks olema POKéMONe, kes elavad ainult kõrbes. Sa võiksid neid otsida.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: As for me… I'm considering challenging NORMAN, the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
et: Mis minusse puutub… Mõtlen välja kutsuda PETALBURG SAALI JUHI NORMAN.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: Unlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like he really is tough.
et: Erinevalt sinust, {PLAYER}, tundub su isa tõesti kõva mees olevat.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGogglesChallengeDad
en: See you around!
et: Näeme veel!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I have here an EGG.
et: Mul on siin MUNA.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in hot sand by the hot springs. But that doesn't seem to be enough…
et: Ma lootsin selle koorutada, kattes seda kuumaveeallikate juures kuuma liivaga. Aga sellest ei näi piisavat…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: I've heard it would be best if it were kept together with POKéMON and carried about.
et: Ma olen kuulnud, et parim oleks, kui seda hoitaks koos POKéMONidega ja kantaks kaasas.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: You are a TRAINER, yes? And your POKéMON radiate vitality.
et: Sa oled TRAINER, jah? Ja su POKéMONid kiirgavad elujõudu.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt
en: So, what say you? Will you take this EGG to hatch?
et: Niisiis, mis sa ütled? Kas võtad selle MUNA koorutada?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWithEgg
en: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with this here EGG!
et: Tubli! Loodan, et kõnnid selle MUNAGA palju!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_ReceivedTheEgg
