en: {PLAYER} received the EGG.
et: {PLAYER} sai MUNA.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg
en: Oh? You've too many POKéMON. There's no room for this EGG…
et: Oh? Sul on liiga palju POKéMONe. Selle MUNA jaoks pole ruumi…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
en: As you wish, then…
et: Olgu siis, nagu soovid…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen
en: If you have a change of heart about hatching this EGG, I will be here.
et: Kui peaksid MUNA koorutamise osas ümber mõtlema, olen ma siinsamas.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
en: Every so often, an EGG will be found at the POKéMON DAY CARE.
et: Aeg-ajalt leitakse POKéMON DAY CARE juurest MUNA.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundAtDayCare
en: Or at least that's how the rumor goes.
et: Vähemalt nii räägitakse.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: We draw as much hot water as we need, and yet the hot springs never run dry.
et: Me võtame nii palju kuuma vett, kui vajame, ja ometi ei kuiva kuumaveeallikad kunagi.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: Isn't it magical?
et: Kas pole maagiline?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry
en: These hot springs appear near active volcanoes. Veins of water under the ground are heated by magma to well up as hot springs.
et: Kuumaveeallikad tekivad tegutsevate vulkaanide lähedusse. Magma soojendab maa all olevaid veesooni ja vesi pulbitseb kuuma allikana üles.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: Being buried in this hot sand is… Sigh…
et: Kuuma liiva sisse maetud olla on… Ohhh…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: So warm and heavenly…
et: Nii soe ja mõnus…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: Eh? Gyaah! Ouch!
et: Ee? Gjaah! Ai!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside
en: A POKéMON nipped my backside!
et: POKéMON näpistas mu tagumikku!

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
en: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?
et: Oh, sulle meeldivad kuumaveeallikad, mis?

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings
en: That's surprising for one as young as you.
et: Nii noore inimese kohta on see üllatav.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
en: I bathe in the hot springs every day.
et: Ma käin iga päev kuumaveeallikates.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEveryDay
en: I want to become a beautiful and strong GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.
et: Tahan saada sama kauniks ja tugevaks SAALI JUHIKS nagu FLANNERY.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
en: If people put POKéMON in hot springs, it might be seriously strange.
et: Kui POKéMONe kuumaveeallikasse panna, võiks juhtuda midagi päris imelikku.

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings
en: Why, it might be an electric bath, or a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…
et: Ohoo, see võib olla elektrivann või mullivann või isegi laavavann…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims
en: They're claiming that these hot springs are good for calming nervous tension, relieving aching muscles, solving romantic problems, and attracting money…
et: Räägitakse, et need kuumaveeallikad rahustavad närve, leevendavad lihasevalu, lahendavad armuhädasid ja meelitavad ligi raha…

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN
et: LAVARIDGE LINN

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign
en: “POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS An excellent place for relaxing!”
et: „POKéKESKUSE KUUMAVEEALLIKAD — suurepärane koht lõõgastumiseks!”

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign
en: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: FLANNERY “One with a fiery passion that burns!”
et: LAVARIDGE LINNA POKéMON SAAL SAALI JUHT: FLANNERY „Tema sees põleb tuline kirg!”

label: LavaridgeTown_Text_HerbShopSign
en: POKéMON HERB SHOP “Bitter taste--better cure!”
et: POKéMON HERB SHOP „Mõru maitse — parem ravi!”

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieIntro
en: What's so funny about having my inner tube aboard the ship?
et: Mis siis nii naljakat on, et mul on laeva peal ujumisrõngas kaasas?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieDefeat
en: Whoa, you overwhelmed me!
et: Ohoo, sa lihtsalt purustasid mu!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharliePostBattle
en: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS while hanging on to an inner tube!
et: Pole sugugi lihtne POKé PALLI visata, kui pead ujumisrõngast kinni hoidma!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFunHere
en: Isn't it fun here? I get excited just being here!
et: Kas pole siin tore? Ainuüksi siinolemine ajab mu elevile!

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: There are items that temporarily elevate the stats of POKéMON.
et: On esemeid, mis ajutiselt tõstavad POKéMONide näitajaid.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: The ones I know you use in battle are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…
et: Mina tean neist kahte, mida lahingus kasutatakse — X ATTACK ja X DEFEND…

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporarilyElevateStats
en: I do believe that there are others like them.
et: Usun, et neid on veel teisigi.

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
en: Use a certain move, or use an item instead…
et: Kas kasutada mõnda võtet või hoopis eset…

label: MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermineBattle
en: The TRAINER's decisions determine how battles turn out, I think.
et: Minu arust otsustavad just TRAINERI valikud selle, kuidas lahing lõpeb.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: No one believes me, but I saw this gigantic POKéMON in the sky.
et: Keegi ei usu mind, aga ma nägin taevas üht hiiglaslikku POKéMONi.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: It seemed to squirm as it flew toward ROUTE 131.
et: See justkui vingerdas, kui ROUTE 131 poole lendas.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: By the way… Sniff… Um… You, uh…smell singed.
et: Muuseas… Nuhh-nuhh… Öö… Sa, äh… lõhnad kõrbehaisu järele.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky
en: Were you at a volcano or something?
et: Kas sa olid vulkaani juures või midagi?

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
en: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but something's blocking the way.
et: Ma tahan POKéMON SAALI minna, aga miski tõkestab teed.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym
en: After all the bother I went through training on ROUTE 120…
et: Ja seda pärast kõike seda vaeva, mis ma ROUTE 120 peal treenides nägin…

label: FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona
en: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.
et: Mul on kaasas POKéMON, kes on mu uhkus ja rõõm. Seekord ma alistan WINONA.

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
en: The ground absorbs rainwater, and trees grow by drinking that water…
et: Maapind imab endasse vihmavett ja puud kasvavad seda vett juues…

label: FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRainwater
en: Our FORTREE CITY exists because there's both water and soil.
et: Meie FORTREE LINN on olemas ainult tänu sellele, et siin on nii vett kui pinnast.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: The CITY consists of homes built on trees.
et: LINN koosneb puude otsa ehitatud kodudest.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: Perhaps because of that lifestyle, everyone is healthy and lively.
et: Võib-olla just selle eluviisi tõttu on kõik terved ja elurõõmsad.

label: FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLively
en: Why, even myself--I feel as if I've grown thirty years younger.
et: Ohoo, isegi mina — tunnen end, nagu oleksin kolmkümmend aastat nooremaks saanud.

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
en: Living on top of trees is okay.
et: Puude otsas elamine on igati okei.

label: FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWindow
en: But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in through windows. It can be really startling.
et: Aga vahel lendavad PUTUKA-POKéMONid aknast sisse. See ehmatab korralikult!

label: FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTraded
en: There are POKéMON that evolve when you trade them! That's what I heard.
et: On POKéMONe, kes arenevad siis, kui neid vahetada! Nii ma olen kuulnud.

label: FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Miski nähtamatu on ees.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Miski nähtamatu on ees.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope
en: Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
et: Kas kasutada eset DEVON SCOPE?

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas eset DEVON SCOPE.

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFled
en: The startled POKéMON fled!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON põgenes!

label: FortreeCity_Text_CitySign
en: FORTREE CITY “The treetop city that frolics with nature.”
et: FORTREE LINN „Puulatvade linn, kus hullatakse koos loodusega.”

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
en: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: WINONA
et: FORTREE LINN POKéMON SAALI SAALI JUHT: WINONA

label: FortreeCity_Text_GymSign
en: “The bird user taking flight into the world.”
et: „Lindude kasutaja, kes tõuseb lendu suurde maailma.”

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro
en: Teacher… Please watch over my progress!
et: Õpetaja… Vaata palun, kui kaugele ma olen jõudnud!

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiDefeat
en: Teacher… Please forgive me!
et: Õpetaja… Palun andesta mulle!

label: MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiPostBattle
en: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests here, will never find true peace…
et: Kuni ma pole paremaks saanud, ei leia siin puhkav õpetaja iial tõelist rahu…

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome! Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.
et: SCOTT: Noh, tere ja tere tulemast! Hehee… Vabandust kitsikuse pärast.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Igatahes, {PLAYER}{KUN}, luba mul sind ametlikult BATTLE FRONTIERisse tervitada.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: This is my dream come true. It took me years and years, but I've finally given shape to my dream.
et: See on mu unistuse täitumine. Selleks kulus aastaid ja aastaid, aga lõpuks sai mu unistus kuju.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: On reflection, it was a terribly long journey…
et: Tagasi vaadates oli see kohutavalt pikk teekond…

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: I left home alone on a quest to find strong TRAINERS.
et: Ma lahkusin üksinda kodunt, et otsida tugevaid TRAINEReid.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchEffortItTookToMakeReal
en: No one can imagine how much effort or time it took to make this real.
et: Keegi ei kujuta ette, kui palju vaeva ja aega kulus, et see kõik teoks teha.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: But that's all in the past. No point dwelling on that!
et: Aga see kõik on minevik. Pole mõtet sellel peatuda!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: All I want for you is to enjoy battling to your heart's content here.
et: Ma soovin sulle vaid ühte: naudi siin lahinguid südame põhjani!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThisAsMementoOfOurPathsCrossing
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this as a memento for all the time our paths crossed on our journeys.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, võta see mälestuseks kõigist kordadest, mil meie teed rännakutel ristusid.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
en: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_1} Battle Pointi.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: SCOTT: You can check your Battle Points on your FRONTIER PASS.
et: SCOTT: Oma Battle Pointe saad vaadata FRONTIER PASSilt.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: The more success you have here at the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle Points you will collect.
et: Mida rohkem edu sul siin BATTLE FRONTIERis on, seda rohkem Battle Pointe kogud.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainBattlePoints
en: Use your Battle Points the way you see fit, like trading them for items.
et: Kasuta oma Battle Pointe nii, nagu õigeks pead, näiteks vaheta neid esemete vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingGreatThings
en: I'm expecting great things from you!
et: Ma ootan sinult suuri tegusid!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual. They all lead lives of their own.
et: SCOTT: Iga TRAINER on isiksus. Nad kõik elavad oma elu.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: But when they're in a battle, it doesn't matter who they are.
et: Aga kui nad on lahingus, pole tähtis, kes nad on.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: They're all the same!
et: Nad on kõik ühesugused!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: I love the purity of battle, where everyone is equal.
et: Ma armastan lahingu puhtust — seal on kõik võrdsed.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSeekingTrainers
en: That's why I go everywhere seeking TRAINERS who are serious about battling, and invite them here.
et: Sellepärast rändangi ma kõikjal ringi, otsin TRAINEReid, kes võtavad lahinguid tõsiselt, ja kutsun nad siia.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: SCOTT: Have you met any of the FRONTIER BRAINS?
et: SCOTT: Kas oled mõnda FRONTIER BRAINi juba kohanud?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: Better yet, have you obtained any symbols from them?
et: Veel parem — kas oled neilt mõne sümboli saanud?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.
et: FRONTIER BRAINS valisin ma ise välja — nad on kõige kõvemad TRAINERID, keda leida on.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouMetFrontierBrain
en: But I'm sure that seeing how tough you are will startle even them!
et: Aga olen kindel, et sinu kõvadust nähes ehmuvad isegi nemad!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: SCOTT: You don't just train for battle, right?
et: SCOTT: Sa ei treeni ainult lahinguks, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: I think I remember you working on a POKéDEX as well.
et: Ma mäletan, et tegelesid ka POKéDEXiga.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: Well, guess what?
et: Noh, ja tead mis?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindWildMonsInFrontier
en: You may run into wild POKéMON in the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere… Fufufu!
et: Sa võid BATTLE FRONTIERis kuskil metsikute POKéMONide otsa sattuda… Fufufu!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in the BATTLE FRONTIER?
et: SCOTT: Kuidas sul BATTLE FRONTIERis meeldib?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: …Wait a second… Oh!
et: …Oota hetk… Oh!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: Your FRONTIER PASS! You've collected the full set of silver symbols!
et: Su FRONTIER PASS! Sul on koos terve hõbesümbolite komplekt!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: That's more than impressive! You are tough, just as I suspected!
et: See on enam kui muljetavaldav! Sa oledki kõva, just nagu ma aimasin!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: Normally, I wouldn't do something like this, but this is a special time!
et: Tavaliselt ma midagi sellist ei teeks, aga see on eriline hetk!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllSilverSymbols
en: I want you to have this. I'm sure you can put it to proper use.
et: Võta see endale. Olen kindel, et oskad sellega midagi õiget peale hakata.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: SCOTT: Loodan, et sul on BATTLE FRONTIERis mõnus.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: …Wait a second… Oh, my disbelieving eyes!
et: …Oota hetk… Oh, ma ei usu oma silmi!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: Your FRONTIER PASS! You've gathered up the full set of gold symbols!
et: Su FRONTIER PASS! Sul on koos terve kuldsümbolite komplekt!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: That's more than stupendous! You're incredible, just as I suspected!
et: See on enam kui vapustav! Sa oledki uskumatu, just nagu ma aimasin!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: {PLAYER}, you've got to accept this!
et: {PLAYER}, sa pead selle vastu võtma!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCollectedAllGoldSymbols
en: I think you will be able to appreciate the value of my gift!
et: Usun, et sina oskad mu kingitust õigesti hinnata!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
en: I must say I have the gift of knowing a good TRAINER when I see one.
et: Pean ütlema, et mul on hea nina — hea TRAINERI tunnen ma ära esimese pilguga.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIBroughtYouHere
en: I'm so glad I had the foresight to bring you here!
et: Kui hea, et mul jätkus taipu sind siia tuua!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPocketStuffed
en: Your BERRY POCKET seems to be stuffed.
et: Su MARJADE tasku näib olevat puupüsti täis.

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
en: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you! How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?
et: SCOTT: Oh, ma kuulsin sinust! Kuidas sa BATTLE TOWERis võimust võtsid! Alistasid järjest üle 50 TRAINERI?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50TrainersInARow
en: That's fantastic! I want you to have this!
et: See on fantastiline! Võta see endale!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
en: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you! How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER! You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?
et: SCOTT: Oh sa heldeke! Ma kuulsin sinust! Kuidas sa BATTLE TOWERI puruks tegid! Alistasid järjest üle 100 TRAINERI?

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100TrainersInARow
en: That's ridiculously spectacular! You've got to have this!
et: See on lausa naeruväärselt vapustav! Võta see endale!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExpectingToHearEvenGreaterThings
en: I'll be expecting to hear even greater things about you now!
et: Nüüd ootan ma sinust veelgi suuremaid tegusid kuulda!

label: BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBackForThisLater
en: Oops, well, if you have too much stuff, come back for this later.
et: Uups, kui sul on kotid juba täis, tule selle järele hiljem tagasi.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh… I never should have let myself be conned into telling TEAM MAGMA where you can find METEORITES…
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh… Ma poleks tohtinud end ära rääkida lasta ja TEAM MAGMALE öelda, kust METEORIITE leida…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MeteoriteWillNeverBeMineNow
en: That METEORITE from METEOR FALLS… It's never going to be mine now…
et: See METEOR FALLSi METEORIIT… Nüüd ei saa see enam kunagi minu omaks…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Oh! Hah?
et: Oh! Häh?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: That item…
et: See ese…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Could it be?
et: Kas see võib tõesti olla…?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Is it the METEORITE that TEAM MAGMA took from METEOR FALLS?
et: Kas see on METEORIIT, mille TEAM MAGMA METEOR FALLSist võttis?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: Please, may I have it?
et: Palun, kas ma tohin selle endale saada?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMeteoriteMayIHaveIt
en: I'm not asking for it for free. How about in exchange for this TM?
et: Ma ei palu seda niisama. Vahetame — mina annan sulle vastu selle TM!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseUseThisTM
en: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents my feeling of gratitude. Please use it!
et: PROF. COZMO: See TM on minu tänu märk. Palun võta see kasutusse!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it. This is really, really great!
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh, ma ei suuda uskuda. See on tõesti, tõesti suurepärane!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoingToHelpMyResearch
en: This is really going to help my research!
et: See aitab mu uurimistööd tõesti edasi!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWithDisappointment
en: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but… I'm crushed with disappointment…
et: PROF. COZMO: Oh, aga… Ma olen pettumusest murtud…

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
en: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that METEORITE?
et: PROF. COZMO: Palun, kas ma tohin selle METEORIIDI saada?

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveMeteorite
en: I'm not asking for it for free. How about in exchange for this TM?
et: Ma ei palu seda niisama. Vahetame — mina annan sulle vastu selle TM!

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWentToMeteorFalls
en: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS on ROUTE 114 with some people from TEAM MAGMA.
et: PROF. COZMO läks koos mõne TEAM MAGMA mehega METEOR FALLSi, mis on ROUTE 114 peal.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorryForCozmo
en: Poor PROF. COZMO… He's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.
et: Vaene PROF. COZMO… Ta on nii masenduses… Mul on temast kahju.

label: FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSoHappy
en: Look at PROF. COZMO… He's so happy! I think it's cute.
et: Vaata ainult PROF. COZMOT… Ta on nii õnnelik! Minu meelest on see armas.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: I want to see GROUDON, too, but they won't let me see even its tail…
et: Ma tahan ka GROUDONi näha, aga nad ei lase mul isegi ta saba näha…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: It's got me feeling really frustrated.
et: See ajab mind tõsiselt närvi.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro
en: Oh, no! I blabbed about GROUDON!
et: Oi ei! Ma lobisesin GROUDONI kohta välja!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat
en: I guess it's impossible to win if one doesn't have a calm mind…
et: Vist ei saagi võita, kui meel pole rahulik…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle
en: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?
et: Huvitav, kas GROUDONil üldse sabagi on?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro
en: Fuhahaha! Soon! Very soon! Our grand objective will be achieved!
et: Fuhahaha! Varsti! Väga varsti! Meie suur eesmärk saab täidetud!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat
en: Grrr… I've come so far, but now this?
et: Grrr… Ma olen nii kaugele jõudnud, aga nüüd see?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle
en: MAXIE, sir! An intruder is headed your way!
et: MAXIE, härra! Sissetungija on teel teie poole!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro
en: You're not finished yet! You're not getting by me easily!
et: Veel pole läbi! Minust sa nii kergelt mööda ei pääse!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat
en: Was I that easy to knock down?
et: Kas mind oligi nii kerge maha võtta?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle
en: C-come on, one more match…
et: N-noh, veel üks lahing…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: Hehehe! You made it this far, so I'll tell you!
et: Hehehe! Sa jõudsid nii kaugele — olgu, ma ütlen sulle!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: That's right! Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!
et: Just nii! Eespool magab GROUDON!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: MAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds ago!
et: MAXIE läks GROUDONI juurde just sekundi eest!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro
en: It's going to awaken real soon! Hehe! Hehehe!
et: Ta ärkab iga hetk! Hehe! Hehehe!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Taken down again… Hehe…
et: Jälle maha löödud… Hehe…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: …And while you wasted time with me, MAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…
et: …Ja sel ajal, kui sa minuga aega raiskasid, on MAXIE GROUDONI juba äratanud…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: MAXIE: GROUDON…
et: MAXIE: GROUDON…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: Nothing could awaken you from your sleep bathed in magma…
et: Miski ei suutnud sind äratada su magmasse mattunud unest…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: This BLUE ORB is what you sought. Wasn't it?
et: Just seda BLUE ORBi sa otsisidki. Kas pole nii?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: I have brought you the BLUE ORB. Let its shine awaken you!
et: Ma tõin sulle BLUE ORBi. Äratagu selle sära sind!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon
en: And show me… Show me the full extent of your power!
et: Ja näita mulle… Näita mulle kogu oma väge!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: MAXIE: GROUDON! What's wrong?
et: MAXIE: GROUDON! Mis viga?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: Wasn't the BLUE ORB the key?
et: Kas BLUE ORB polnud siis võti?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWrong
en: GROUDON! Where have you gone…
et: GROUDON! Kuhu sa küll kadusid…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?
et: MAXIE: Oh, nii et see olid sina?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: I've seen you poking around uninvited here and there…
et: Ma olen näinud sind kutsumata siin-seal ringi nuuskimas…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou
en: I get it now! You must have pulled a cheap stunt!
et: Nüüd saan aru! Sina pidid mingi odava trikiga hakkama saama!

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: What makes you so adept at handling POKéMON?
et: Kust sa oled õppinud POKéMONidega nii osavalt ümber käima?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: MAXIE: There has to be some reason why GROUDON fled…
et: MAXIE: Peab olema mingi põhjus, miks GROUDON põgenes…

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: That's what you're trying to say, aren't you?
et: Seda sa tahadki öelda, eks ju?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: Humph… You think I didn't know that?
et: Hmph… Sa arvad, et ma seda ei teadnud?

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: With GROUDON gone, there is no longer any need for this blasted volcano.
et: Nüüd, kui GROUDON on läinud, pole seda neetud vulkaani enam vaja.

label: MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGroudon
en: I am going after GROUDON, so this is where we part!
et: Ma lähen GROUDONILE järele — siin lähevad meie teed lahku!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
en: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my friend's has a JOLLY nature.
et: Mu POKéMONil on SÜÜTU loomus ja mu sõbra omal RÕÕMSAMEELNE loomus.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokemonHavePersonalities
en: It's fascinating how POKéMON have personalities!
et: Põnev, et POKéMONidel on igaühel oma iseloom!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
en: Just like people, there are male and female POKéMON.
et: Nagu inimesigi, on POKéMONe nii isaseid kui emaseid.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleAndFemalePokemon
en: But no one seems to have any idea how they're different.
et: Aga näib, et kellelgi pole aimu, kuidas nad erinevad.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
en: The man next door gave me an HM!
et: Naabrimees andis mulle ühe HMi!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCutNextDoor
en: I used it to teach my POKéMON how to CUT down skinny trees.
et: Õpetasin sellega oma POKéMONile, kuidas CUT abil peenikesi puid maha raiuda.

label: Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre
en: Okay! We're to move out to MT. PYRE!
et: Olgu! Me liigume MT. PYRE poole!

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
en: Ahead looms MT. PYRE…
et: Ees kõrgub MT. PYRE…

label: Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre
en: It is a natural monument to the spirits of departed POKéMON…
et: See on looduslik mälestusmärk lahkunud POKéMONide vaimudele…

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
en: MT. PYRE PIER
et: MT. PYRE KAI

label: Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign
en: …The sign is old and worn out. The words are barely legible…
et: …Silt on vana ja kulunud. Sõnad on vaevu loetavad…

label: Route121_Text_SafariZoneSign
en: “Filled with rare POKéMON!” SAFARI ZONE
et: „Täis haruldasi POKéMONe!” SAFARI ZONE

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_ShipDesignMoreLikeBuilding
en: Designing a large ship is more like making a big building than putting together a transportation vehicle.
et: Suure laeva kavandamine on pigem nagu suure maja ehitamine kui sõiduki kokkupanek.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
en: Don't you think it's strange that a ship made of heavy iron floats?
et: Kas pole imelik, et raskest rauast laev vee peal püsib?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_FloatsBecauseBuoyancy
en: It floats because of a principle called buoyancy.
et: See püsib pinnal tänu üleslükkejõule.

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Where were you? I was looking for you!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kus sa olid? Ma otsisin sind!

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: How much stronger have you gotten? Let me check for you!
et: Kui palju tugevamaks sa oled saanud? Las ma vaatan järele!

label: Route119_Text_MayIntro
en: Ready with your POKéMON? Of course you are! Go!
et: Valmis oma POKéMONiga? Muidugi oled! Anna minna!

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
en: Achah! {PLAYER}{KUN}, you're strong!
et: Ahhah! {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa oled tugev!

label: Route119_Text_MayDefeat
en: I was worried that you might be struggling with your training.
et: Ma muretsesin, et sa võid oma treeninguga jännis olla.

label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
en: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to worry about! Keep it up!
et: MAY: Aga mul polnud absoluutselt millegi pärast muretseda! Jätka samas vaimus!

label: Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou
en: And, here! I have a present for you.
et: Ja vaata — mul on sulle kingitus!

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will instantly carry you to any town you've already visited.
et: MAY: Kasuta võtet FLY ja su POKéMON viib sind silmapilkselt igasse linna, kus oled juba käinud.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: But, to use FLY, you have to get the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY. That's important, so don't forget.
et: Aga FLY kasutamiseks pead saama FORTREE LINNAST SAALIMÄRGI. See on tähtis, ära unusta.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: You should FLY home and visit LITTLEROOT for a change.
et: Võiksid vahelduseks koju lennata ja LITTLEROOTIS ära käia.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: I bet your mom's worried about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Su ema muretseb kindlasti su pärast, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: Route119_Text_MayExplainFly
en: Well, let's meet again somewhere!
et: Noh, kohtume kuskil jälle!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where you've been looking for POKéMON?
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Nii et siin oledki sa POKéMONe otsinud?

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: Let me see how good you got. I'll test you!
et: Vaatame, kui heaks sa oled saanud. Ma panen su proovile!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIntro
en: Now! It's a battle, so battle!
et: Nii! Lahing on lahing — hakkame pihta!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat
en: Hmm… You've gotten pretty darn decent.
et: Hmm… Sa oled päris kõvasti paremaks saanud.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
en: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough to search for POKéMON anywhere.
et: BRENDAN: Ma ütleksin, et sa oled piisavalt hea, et kõikjal POKéMONe otsida.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis
en: Here, I'll give you this. Try it out.
et: Võta, ma annan selle sulle. Proovi järele!

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON instantly carries you to any town you've already visited.
et: BRENDAN: Kasuta võtet FLY ja su POKéMON viib sind silmapilkselt igasse linna, kus oled juba käinud.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: But you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE to do that.
et: Aga selleks on sul vaja FORTREE SAALIMÄRKI.

label: Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly
en: Anyway, I have to move along.
et: Igatahes, ma pean edasi liikuma.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: SCOTT: Hahahah! Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: SCOTT: Hahahaa! Vaat nii, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I just passed by a TRAINER riding a BIKE.
et: Möödusin just ühest TRAINERIST, kes sõitis JALGRATTAGA.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you? It was pretty obvious that you did.
et: Sina ju alistasid selle TRAINERI, eks? See oli päris selgesti näha.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: The kid looked really upset with a face all red from anger.
et: Tal oli nägu vihast punane ja tuju täiesti must.

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I sure seem to run into you often. Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?
et: Ma kohtan sind tõesti tihti. Kas suundud järgmisena FORTREE SAALI?

label: Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou
en: I expect that you'll do well at the GYM. Well, I'll be seeing you!
et: Usun, et SAALIS läheb sul hästi. Noh, näeme veel!

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: SCOTT: Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}, it's me!
et: SCOTT: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, see olen mina!

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Just as I thought, you won at the FORTREE GYM.
et: Nagu arvata võis — sa võitsid FORTREE SAALIS.

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Your strength… Perhaps you really are the TRAINER that I've been searching for.
et: Su tugevus… Ehk oledki sina tõesti see TRAINER, keda ma olen otsinud.

label: Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym
en: Remember, you have a fan in me. I'll be cheering from the sidelines. Keep up the great work!
et: Pea meeles: minus on sul üks fänn. Ma elan kõrvalt kaasa. Jätka samas vaimus!

label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
en: We're standing lookout here.
et: Me seisame siin valves.

label: Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitute
en: Hey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER INSTITUTE. It's not safe.
et: Hei, sina! Hoia WEATHER INSTITUTE majast eemale. Siin pole ohutu.

label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
en: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring.
et: Valvekord on üllatavalt igav.

label: Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute
en: Hey, you! Please don't go near the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: Hei, sina! Ära mine palun WEATHER INSTITUTE majale lähedale.

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: I thought you FLY by catching a whole flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then hanging on to them somehow.
et: Ma arvasin, et lendamiseks tuleb püüda terve parv LINNU-POKéMONe ja siis kuidagi nende küljes rippuda.

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: But it turns out there's an HM move called FLY!
et: Aga selgub, et on olemas HM-võte nimega FLY!

label: Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMons
en: I wish I'd known about that a long time ago…
et: Oleksin ma seda ammu teadnud…

label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
en: Tch… It's a no-go…
et: Tsc… Ei tule välja…

label: Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires
en: The tall grass snares BIKE tires. There's no way you can cycle here.
et: Kõrge rohi püüab JALGRATTA rehvid kinni. Siin ei saa kuidagi rattaga sõita.

label: Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase
en: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER on a big pile of grass and make a SECRET BASE?
et: Kas su POKéMON oskab suure rohupuhma peal kasutada SECRET POWER ja teha SALABAASI?

label: Route119_Text_RouteSignFortree
en: ROUTE 119 {RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY
et: ROUTE 119 {RIGHT_ARROW} FORTREE LINN

label: Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute
en: WEATHER INSTITUTE
et: WEATHER INSTITUTE

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: Up to sixteen decorations and furniture items can be placed in a SECRET BASE.
et: SALABAASI saab paigutada kuni kuusteist kaunistust ja mööblieset.

label: Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration
en: Pick your favorite items and create your very own SECRET BASE exactly the way you want.
et: Vali oma lemmikesemed ja loo oma isiklik SALABAAS just nii, nagu tahad.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: As you can see, there's not much here, but this is my home.
et: Nagu näed, pole siin palju, aga see on mu kodu.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: Thank you for all that you've done.
et: Aitäh kõige eest, mida oled teinud.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: This is my token of appreciation. It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.
et: See on minu tänu märk. See on HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarnedHMDive
en: No need to be shy--you've earned this HM.
et: Pole vaja häbeneda — sa oled selle HM ausalt ära teeninud.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you should notice dark patches of water.
et: STEVEN: Kui kasutad SURFi, peaksid märkama tumedaid veelaike.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: Use DIVE if you come to deep water like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.
et: Kasuta DIVE, kui satud sellisesse sügavasse vette. Vajud merepõhja.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: When you want to come back up, use DIVE again.
et: Kui tahad tagasi üles tulla, kasuta uuesti DIVE.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDive
en: In some places, it won't be possible for you to surface, though.
et: Mõnes kohas pole sul siiski võimalik pinnale tõusta.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
en: STEVEN: Apparently, there's an underwater cavern between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.
et: STEVEN: Näib, et MOSSDEEPI ja SOOTOPOLISE vahel on veealune koobas.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_UnderwateCavernBetweenMossdeepSootopolis
en: You know, the one that CAPT. STERN found in his submarine.
et: Tead küll, see, mille CAPT. STERN oma allveelaevaga leidis.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL.
et: {PLAYER} uuris POKé PALLI.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: It contained the POKéMON BELDUM.
et: Selle sees oli POKéMON BELDUM.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallContainingBeldum
en: Take the POKé BALL?
et: Kas võtta POKé PALL?

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ObtainedBeldum
en: {PLAYER} obtained a BELDUM.
et: {PLAYER} sai BELDUMi.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceForAnotherMon
en: There is no space for another POKéMON.
et: Veel ühe POKéMONi jaoks pole ruumi.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeBallWhereItWas
en: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where it was.
et: {PLAYER} jättis POKé PALLI sinnapaika.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: It's a letter.
et: See on kiri.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: To {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: Kallis {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I've decided to do a little soulsearching and train on the road.
et: Otsustasin veidi endasse vaadata ja rännates treenida.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I don't plan to return home for some time.
et: Niipea ma koju naasta ei kavatse.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I have a favor to ask of you.
et: Mul on sulle üks palve.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I want you to take the POKé BALL on the desk.
et: Tahan, et võtaksid laualt selle POKé PALLI.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite POKéMON.
et: Selle sees on BELDUM, mu lemmik-POKéMON.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: I'm counting on you.
et: Ma loodan sinu peale.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: May our paths cross someday.
et: Ehk ristuvad meie teed kunagi.

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFromSteven
en: STEVEN STONE
et: STEVEN STONE

label: MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_CollectionOfRareRocks
en: It's a collection of rare rocks and stones assembled by STEVEN.
et: See on STEVENi kogutud haruldaste kivide ja kivimite kogu.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: Listen up, and I'll tell you something good.
et: Kuula, ma räägin sulle midagi head.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: There's supposed to be an ancient ruin in the sea around here.
et: Siinkandis meres olevat muistsed varemed.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasuresWaitingInSea
en: There could be treasures just waiting to be discovered down there.
et: Seal all võib olla aardeid, mis lihtsalt ootavad avastamist.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
en: Ancient treasures…
et: Muistsed aarded…

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwaterWithPokemon
en: It would be nice if they existed, but even if they didn't, it would be so beautiful to take an underwater stroll with my POKéMON.
et: Oleks tore, kui need olemas oleksid, aga isegi kui ei ole, oleks ikka nii ilus teha oma POKéMONidega veealune jalutuskäik.

label: SootopolisCity_House4_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Marurii.
et: AZUMARILL: Marurii.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo! How's it going, CHAMPIONbound {PLAYER}?
et: Jou! Kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is a master of WATER-type POKéMON.
et: SOOTOPOLISE SAALI JUHT JUAN on VEE-tüüpi POKéMONide meister.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor will hamper your progress…
et: Ja JUANI juurde jõudmist takistab jäine põrand…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the advice that I have for you.
et: Kuule, vabandust, aga rohkem nõu mul sulle ei ole.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The rest of the way, you have to go for it yourself!
et: Ülejäänud tee pead sa ise läbima!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who was supposedly the best in all HOENN!
et: Ohoo! Sa alistasid isegi JUANI, kes olevat kogu HOENNI parim!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.
et: Olgu! Vaata oma TRAINER CARDi.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!
et: Kui oled kõik MÄRGID kätte saanud, oled valmis POKéMON LIIGA väljakutseks!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Let me ask you. Did you know? Ah, I should not be so coy.
et: Lubad, ma küsin? Kas sa teadsid? Ah, ma ei peaks nii salatsema.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: It was I who taught WALLACE everything there is to know about POKéMON.
et: Just mina õpetasin WALLACELE kõike, mida POKéMONide kohta teada on.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Once, I had given up my position as the GYM LEADER.
et: Kunagi loobusin ma SAALI JUHI kohast.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE with the GYM.
et: Enda asemel usaldasin SAALI WALLACE kätte.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: However, a compelling reason arose for me to make a comeback.
et: Ent tekkis kaalukas põhjus, et ma naaseksin.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Ah, but enough chatter. Let us begin our match, shall we?
et: Ah, aga aitab lobisemisest. Alustagem siis meie matši, eks?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: Please, you shall bear witness to our artistry.
et: Palun — sinust saab meie kunsti tunnistaja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro
en: A grand illusion of water sculpted by POKéMON and myself!
et: Suurejooneline veeillusioon, mille on voolinud POKéMONid ja mina!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Ahahaha, excellent! Very well, you are the winner.
et: Ahahahaa, suurepärane! Väga hea, sina oled võitja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: From you, I sense the brilliant shine of skill that will overcome all.
et: Ma tunnen sinus oskuse hiilgavat sära, mis saab kõigest jagu.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: However, compared with me or even WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.
et: Ent minu või isegi WALLACEGA võrreldes napib sul elegantsi.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Perhaps I should make you a loan of my outfit?
et: Ehk peaksin sulle oma riietuse laenama?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Hahaha, I merely jest!
et: Hahaha, ma ainult naljatan!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat
en: Rather than my clothes, I shall reward you with this, the RAIN BADGE!
et: Riiete asemel premeerin sind hoopis sellega — see on RAIN BADGE!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE from JUAN.
et: {PLAYER} sai JUANILT märgi RAIN BADGE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you the full obedience of all your POKéMON to your every command.
et: Kui sul on RAIN BADGE, kuulavad kõik su POKéMONid iga su käsku.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: The RAIN BADGE also allows the use of the HM move WATERFALL to scale walls of cascading water.
et: RAIN BADGE lubab kasutada ka HM-võtet WATERFALL, et ronida mööda langevat vett üles.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBadgeTakeThis
en: And, so that you never forget the battle we shared, take this…
et: Ja et sa meie lahingut iial ei unustaks, võta see…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
en: The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you contains WATER PULSE.
et: TEHNILINE MASIN, mille ma sulle andsin, sisaldab võtet WATER PULSE.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterPulse
en: In use, it will occasionally confuse the target with ultrasonic waves.
et: Kasutamisel ajab see vahel sihtmärgi ultrahelilainetega segadusse.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJuan
en: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHT JUAN registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: The TRAINERS who have gathered all the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make way to the ultimate destination.
et: TRAINERID, kes on kogunud kõik HOENNI SAALIMÄRGID, peaksid suunduma ülima sihtkoha poole.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: POKéMON LIIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: Travel to the easternmost reaches of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.
et: Rända HOENNI kõige idapoolsemasse serva, EVER GRANDE saarele.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattle
en: There, you shall find the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Seal sa leiadki POKéMON LIIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
en: There remains but one BADGE to obtain in HOENN.
et: HOENNIS on saamata veel vaid üks MÄRK.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeBadge
en: If you wish to challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE, you must obtain the last BADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.
et: Kui soovid POKéMON LIIGAT proovile panna, pead viimase MÄRGI FORTREE SAALIST kätte saama.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatue
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
et: SOOTOPOLIS LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
et: SOOTOPOLIS LINN POKéMON SAAL

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCertified
en: JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
et: JUANI SERTIFITSEERITUD TRAINERID: {PLAYER}

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity…
et: JUAN: Ah, SAALI oli naasnud tavapärane rahu…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again!
et: Aga meie noor taifuun on naasnud, et meid taas proovile panna!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: Well, my friend, most certainly!
et: Aga muidugi, mu sõber!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematch
en: I shall be delighted to dance with you as often as you wish!
et: Mul on rõõm sinuga tantsida nii tihti, kui vaid soovid!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDefeat
en: Ahahaha, you are the winner! You have defeated me again!
et: Ahahahaa, sina oled võitja! Sa alistasid mu taas!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: JUAN: If I told you to become my apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.
et: JUAN: Kui ma paluksin sul hakata mu õpilaseks, sa kindlasti keelduksid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: I would like to make a gift of my coat to you.
et: Ma kingiksin sulle hea meelega oma mantli.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: But again, you will refuse. I imagine that to be so.
et: Aga ka sellest sa keeldud. Küllap on nii.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRematch
en: And that, my friend, is a certain sign of nobility!
et: Ja see, mu sõber, on kindel õilsuse märk!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its usual state of serenity…
et: JUAN: Ah, SAALI oli naasnud tavapärane rahu…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: But our young typhoon has returned to put us to the test again!
et: Aga meie noor taifuun on naasnud, et meid taas proovile panna!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Well, my friend, most certainly! I shall be delighted to dance with you…
et: Aga muidugi, mu sõber! Mul on rõõm sinuga tantsida…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: Ah, no, no, no. You have with you but one POKéMON.
et: Ah, ei, ei, ei. Sul on kaasas vaid üks POKéMON.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNeedTwoMons
en: I wish that you would return with two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.
et: Palun tule tagasi kahe, võib-olla enamagi POKéMONiga.

label: Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivities
en: TEAM AQUA's activities… We can't talk about them yet.
et: TEAM AQUA tegemised… Neist me veel rääkida ei tohi.

label: Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus
en: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and kick up a ruckus!
et: Ma tahan SLATEPORTI minna ja kära teha!

label: Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua
en: This is my first job after joining TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.
et: See on mu esimene töö pärast TEAM AQUAGA liitumist. Veidi hirmus on küll.

label: Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles
en: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring smiles to people's faces!
et: TEAM AQUA teod peaksid inimeste nägudele naeratuse tooma!

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!
et: MAY: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}, pole ammu näinud!

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: While I was searching for other POKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.
et: Teisi POKéMONe otsides on mu omad tugevamaks muutunud.

label: Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle
en: So… How about a little battle?
et: Nii et… Kuidas oleks väikese lahinguga?

label: Route110_Text_MayDefeated
en: Yikes! You're better than I expected!
et: Ohhoo! Sa oled parem, kui ma arvasin!

label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy training, too, haven't you?
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sinagi oled usinasti treeninud, eks?

label: Route110_Text_MayTakeThis
en: I think you deserve a reward! This is from me!
et: Ma arvan, et sa väärid tasu! See on minult!

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.
et: MAY: See on ITEMFINDER.

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: Try it out. If there is an item that's not visible, it emits a sound.
et: Proovi järele. Kui läheduses on nähtamatu ese, teeb see häält.

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's meet again!
et: Olgu, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kohtume jälle!

label: Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder
en: I know it's a little silly coming from me, but I think you should train a lot harder for the next time.
et: Ma tean, et minu suust kõlab see veidi rumalalt, aga järgmiseks korraks võiksid sa palju kõvemini treenida.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}. So this is where you were. How's it going?
et: BRENDAN: Hei, {PLAYER}. Nii et siin sa olidki. Kuidas läheb?

label: Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle
en: Have you been raising your POKéMON? I'll check for you.
et: Kas oled oma POKéMONe kasvatanud? Ma vaatan järele.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated
en: Hmm… You're pretty good.
et: Hmm… Sa oled päris hea.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
en: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained without me noticing…
et: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, sa oled treeninud, ilma et ma oleks märganudki…

label: Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis
en: Good enough! Here, take this.
et: Küllalt hea! Säh, võta see.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.
et: BRENDAN: See on ITEMFINDER.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: Use it to root around for items that aren't visible.
et: Sellega saab otsida esemeid, mida silmaga ei näe.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: If it senses something, it emits a sound.
et: Kui see midagi tajub, teeb see häält.

label: Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder
en: Anyway, I'm off to look for new POKéMON.
et: Igatahes, ma lähen uusi POKéMONe otsima.

label: Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed
en: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
et: Kas poleks suurepärane sõita JALGRATTAGA täiskiirusel JALGRATTATEEL?

label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
en: How do you like the way my ravencolored hair streams behind me?
et: Mis sa arvad, kuidas mu kaarnamustad juuksed taga lehvivad?

label: Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe
en: I grew my hair out just for that.
et: Just selleks ma juuksed pikaks kasvatasingi.

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!
et: Oh, hei, sa said selle JALGRATTA RYDELILT!

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: Oh, it's glaringly obvious. It says right on your bike…
et: Oh, see on ju silmnähtav. Su rattal on kohe kirjas…

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL… That name's everywhere.
et: RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL… See nimi on kõikjal.

label: Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel
en: You should ride it around all over the place--it's good advertising!
et: Sa peaksid sellega igal pool ringi sõitma – see on hea reklaam!

label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
en: The two roads, one above, one below…
et: Need kaks teed, üks üleval, teine all…

label: Route110_Text_TwoRoads
en: A road each for people and POKéMON. Perhaps that is right and fair.
et: Üks tee inimestele, teine POKéMONidele. Ehk ongi see õige ja õiglane.

label: Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad
en: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take a leisurely walk on the low road.
et: Mul pole JALGRATAST, nii et ma teen rahuliku jalutuskäigu alumisel teel.

label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
en: Learning techniques will make BIKE riding even more fun.
et: Tehnikate õppimine teeb JALGRATTAGA sõitmise veel lõbusamaks.

label: Route110_Text_BikeTechniques
en: There are some places that you can reach only by using a BIKE technique.
et: On mõned kohad, kuhu pääseb ainult JALGRATTA-tehnikat kasutades.

label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
en: Which should I choose?
et: Kumma ma peaksin valima?

label: Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose
en: Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road and look for POKéMON?
et: Kihutan JALGRATTATEED mööda otse MAUVILLE poole või lähen alumist teed ja otsin POKéMONe?

label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
en: Number of collisions: … … {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Kokkupõrgete arv: … … {STR_VAR_1}!

label: Route110_Text_CyclingChallengeResultSummary
en: Total time: … … {STR_VAR_2}!
et: Koguaeg: … … {STR_VAR_2}!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
en: Bravo! Splendid showing!
et: Braavo! Suurepärane etteaste!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest
en: Your love of cycling comes from deep within your heart. You've shaken me to my very soul!
et: Su armastus rattasõidu vastu tuleb sügavalt südamest. Sa raputasid mind hingepõhjani!

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
en: Your technique is remarkable.
et: Su tehnika on tähelepanuväärne.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood
en: I suggest you speed up a bit while still avoiding collisions.
et: Soovitan veidi kiirendada, aga kokkupõrkeid ikka vältida.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
en: I would consider you a work in progress.
et: Ütleksin, et sinus on veel arenemisruumi.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk
en: Still, I hope you don't forget the sheer pleasure of cycling.
et: Ometi loodan, et sa ei unusta rattasõidu puhast naudingut.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
en: My word… Your cycling skills border on terrifying.
et: Oh sa… Su rattasõiduoskus on lausa hirmuäratav.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad
en: Most certainly, you need much more practice riding.
et: Sa pead kindlasti palju rohkem sõitu harjutama.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: …I am aghast…
et: …Ma olen jahmunud…

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: You're perhaps not cut out for this unfortunate cycling business.
et: Rattasõit pole vist paraku sinu jaoks.

label: Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst
en: You ought to give serious thought to returning that BIKE to RYDEL.
et: Sa peaksid tõsiselt kaaluma selle JALGRATTA RYDELILE tagasi viimist.

label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
en: This is CYCLING ROAD.
et: See on JALGRATTATEE.

label: Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions
en: If you were to ride from MAUVILLE to SLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would be rated for the number of collisions and your total time.
et: Kui sõidaksid rattaga MACH BIKE MAUVILLEST SLATEPORTI, hinnataks su kokkupõrgete arvu ja koguaega.

label: Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher
en: Regardless of the results, I count on seeing more challenges from you. Always aim higher!
et: Tulemustest hoolimata loodan sinult veel väljakutseid näha. Siht alati kõrgemale!

label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
en: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding MACH BIKES are rated for their number of collisions and their total times.
et: Sellel JALGRATTATEEL hinnatakse neid, kes sõidavad rattaga MACH BIKE: arvesse lähevad kokkupõrgete arv ja koguaeg.

label: Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify
en: ACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating. They are easy to turn, so it's not fair.
et: Rattad ACRO BIKE hindamisele ei kvalifitseeru. Nendega on liiga kerge pöörata, see poleks aus.

label: Route110_Text_SlateportCitySign
en: ROUTE 110 {DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT CITY
et: ROUTE 110 {DOWN_ARROW} SLATEPORT LINN

label: Route110_Text_CyclingRoadSign
en: SEASIDE CYCLING ROAD
et: MEREÄÄRNE JALGRATTATEE

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: “TEAM AQUA was here!”
et: „TEAM AQUA oli siin!”

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: Someone painted that onto this sign, but then someone else painted over it.
et: Keegi kritseldas selle siia sildile, aga siis värvis keegi teine selle üle.

label: Route110_Text_AquaWasHere
en: “TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it says now.
et: Nüüd on seal kirjas „TEAM MAGMA valitseb!”

label: Route110_Text_Route103Sign
en: ROUTE 110 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103
et: ROUTE 110 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 103

label: Route110_Text_SeasideParkingSign
en: SEASIDE PARKING
et: MEREÄÄRNE PARKLA

label: Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign
en: ROUTE 110 {UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 110 {UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE LINN

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: The foe can be made helpless by paralyzing it or causing it to sleep.
et: Vastase saab abituks teha, kui ta halvata või magama panna.

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep
en: It is an important technique for POKéMON battles.
et: POKéMON-lahingutes on see tähtis taktika.

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems
en: The items in the BAG can be reorganized by pressing SELECT.
et: KOTIS olevaid esemeid saab ümber korraldada SELECTi vajutades.

label: Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign
en: “Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW} to reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”
et: „Kolm sammu {RIGHT_ARROW} ja kaks sammu {UP_ARROW} ning jõuadki imelisse majja TRICK HOUSE.”

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…
et: PARIM REKORD SENIAJANI…

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: No. of collisions: {STR_VAR_1}
et: Kokkupõrgete arv: {STR_VAR_1}

label: Route110_Text_BestRecord
en: Elapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}
et: Kulunud aeg: {STR_VAR_2}

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE…
et: PARIM REKORD SENIAJANI…

label: Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord
en: No one seems to have taken the challenge. There is no record…
et: Näib, et keegi pole väljakutset vastu võtnud. Rekordit pole…

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Imagine seeing you here!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kes oleks arvanud, et sind siit kohtan!

label: Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere
en: And where might my {RIVAL} be?
et: Ja kus mu {RIVAL} olla võiks?

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, I see! You two are running separately. Well, that's fine.
et: Ahsoo! Te reisite siis eraldi. No see on ju hea.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV had the MATCH CALL system installed.
et: Ah jaa, ma kuulsin, et sinu POKéNAVi on paigaldatud MATCH CALL süsteem.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: Well, then, I should register you in my POKéNAV as well.
et: Noh, siis peaksin ka mina sind oma POKéNAVi registreerima.

label: Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall
en: That way, even when we're apart, I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.
et: Nii saan ma su POKéDEXi igal ajal hinnata, isegi kui oleme eri paigus.

label: Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav
en: Registered PROF. BIRCH in the POKéNAV.
et: PROF. BIRCH registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}. … … … … … …
et: Palun vaata mu {RIVAL} järele. … … … … … …

label: Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival
en: Well, I had better get going. See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Noh, ma pean minema hakkama. Näeme jälle, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerSign
en: This is the BATTLE TOWER! Keep the win streak as the toughest TRAINER!
et: See on BATTLE TOWER! Hoia võiduseeriat ja ole kõige kõvem TRAINER!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePalaceSign
en: This is the BATTLE PALACE! Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!
et: See on BATTLE PALACE! Hoia POKéMON-lahingutel silm peal!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleArenaSign
en: This is the BATTLE ARENA! Let the toughest teams gather!
et: See on BATTLE ARENA! Kogunegu kõige kõvemad meeskonnad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePyramidSign
en: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID! Advance through the Battle Quest!
et: See on BATTLE PYRAMID! Liigu Battle Questil edasi!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingHallSign
en: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL Set your sights on new records!
et: BATTLE FRONTIERi RANKING HALL — sea sihiks uued rekordid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ExchangeCornerSign
en: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER Exchange your Battle Points!
et: BATTLE POINTide VAHETUSTEENUSE NURK — vaheta oma Battle Pointid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: Wow! It's huge!
et: Ohoo! See on hiiglaslik!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTowerFeelsSpecial
en: The BATTLE TOWER feels special. It's different from the others.
et: BATTLE TOWER tundub eriline. See erineb teistest.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: My grand ambition is to conquer both the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Mu suur unistus on alistada nii BATTLE FRONTIER kui ka POKéMON LIIGA.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: And if my dream comes true…
et: Ja kui mu unistus täitub…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerLeagueAndFrontier
en: I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door if she will be friends with me!
et: Ma… ma küsin naabritüdrukult MIMILT, kas ta tahaks minuga sõber olla!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! I just can't make it to the top!
et: BATTLE PYRAMID on liiga karm! Ma lihtsalt ei jõua tippu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidTooHarsh
en: Since I'm out of options, maybe I can climb the outside…
et: Muud ei jää üle — ehk saan mööda välisseina üles ronida…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: I thrive in darkness… Yes… What is worthy of me? None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…
et: Ma õitsen pimeduses… Jah… Mis on minu vääriline? Ei miski muu kui BATTLE PYRAMID…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveInDarkness
en: What say you to wandering in darkness and in utter and total desperation?
et: Mis sa kostad ekslemisest pimeduses ja põhjatus meeleheites?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I didn't sleep for a week, but then I put together the ultimate team!
et: Ma ei maganud terve nädala, aga siis panin kokku ülima meeskonna!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutTogetherUltimateTeam
en: I can't see myself losing, no joke. We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Ma ei kujuta ettegi, et kaotaksin — ausõna. Me tormame BATTLE ARENASSE!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: Did SCOTT bring you here, too? What is it with that guy?
et: Kas SCOTT tõi sinugi siia? Mis sellel tüübil viga on?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: It sounds like he really does know how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…
et: Tundub, et ta tõesti oskab andekaid TRAINEReid ära tunda, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScottBringYouHere
en: I've never seen him battling in person ever.
et: Ma pole teda kunagi ise võitlemas näinud.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: ZIGG! I believe in you, little buddy!
et: ZIGG! Ma usun sinusse, väike sõber!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveInYouBuddy
en: I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite tasty treats you like if you win!
et: Kui võidad, teen oma väikesele ZIGGile just sellist maiust, nagu sa tahad!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ZigzagoonLooksVacant
en: ZIGZAGOON looks vacant…
et: ZIGZAGOONil on täiesti tühi pilk…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: People call me a busybody, but I can't help it.
et: Inimesed kutsuvad mind sekeldajaks, aga ma ei saa sinna midagi parata.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: Your hat's on crooked! Oh, no, trash on the ground! Oops, it's almost dinnertime!
et: Su müts on viltu! Oh ei, prügi maas! Uups, peagi on õhtusöögiaeg!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCallMeBusybody
en: I don't know if I can stand to just watch at the BATTLE PALACE…
et: Ma ei tea, kas suudan BATTLE PALACE saalis lihtsalt pealt vaadata…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: I may not look that impressive now, but I once beat a GYM LEADER.
et: Ma ei pruugi praegu eriti muljetavaldav välja näha, aga ma alistasin kunagi SAALI JUHI.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeatGymLeader
en: Who knows, maybe I should give it another shot at glory.
et: Kes teab, võib-olla peaksin veel korra hiilguse poole püüdlema.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for the way I battle, too.
et: Ma olen JALGRATTAL kiire ja sama kiire olen ka lahingus.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBikeAndBattles
en: I win matches in the blink of an eye!
et: Ma võidan matše silmapilkselt!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterThanDaddyAtPokemon
en: I'm better than my daddy at POKéMON.
et: Ma olen POKéMONides parem kui mu issi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: Go on, my baby sweetie! Go rack up some wins for Daddy!
et: Anna minna, mu kullapai! Mine korja issi jaoks võite!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUpSomeWinsForDaddy
en: You're just like your mother, so you'll be dominating!
et: Sa oled täpselt nagu su ema, nii et sa oled võitmatu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: It wasn't easy getting here, but I'd heard about this knockout pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Siia jõudmine polnud lihtne, aga ma olin kuulnud, et BATTLE ARENAS on üks pööraselt kena tüdruk.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: Instead of her, do you know what I found?
et: Kas tead, mida ma tema asemel leidsin?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPrettyGirlAtBattleArena
en: A whole teeming mob of sweaty, stinky, and primitive martial artists!
et: Terve kihava kamba higiseid, haisvaid ja toorevõitu võitluskunstnikke!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: I sometimes see this really importantlooking old man going in there.
et: Vahel näen, kuidas üks väga tähtsa olekuga vanahärra sinna sisse läheb.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_SometimesImportantOldManInThere
en: He has these really awesome POKéMON. He seems really nice, though.
et: Tal on hullult vägevad POKéMONid. Aga ta tundub päris kena mees.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Do you know it? The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?
et: Kas tead seda? BATTLE PYRAMIDi legendi?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: When there comes a confident TRAINER reaching for the golden pinnacle, there shall appear a man among men.
et: Kui tuleb enesekindel TRAINER, kes küünitab kuldse tipu poole, astub välja mees meeste seast.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: Don't know that legend? Well, of course not! I just made it up!
et: Ei tea seda legendi? Noh, muidugi mitte! Ma just mõtlesin selle välja!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOfBattlePyramid
en: What's it supposed to mean? That, my friend, I can't say!
et: Mida see peaks tähendama? Seda, mu sõber, ma öelda ei oska!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: Man! Oh man! I've never lost once before!
et: Ei või olla! Lihtsalt ei või olla! Ma pole varem kordagi kaotanud!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: But I got wiped out with no saving grace at all!
et: Aga mind pühiti platsilt minema, ilma igasuguse armuta!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWipedOut
en: And then I'm told I don't have any talent?! Man!
et: Ja siis öeldakse mulle veel, et mul pole mingit annet?! Ei või olla!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: This guy ran into a horribly tough TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE TOWER challenge.
et: See tüüp sattus BATTLE TOWERi väljakutsel ülikõva TRAINERi otsa.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: Now look at him…
et: Nüüd vaata teda…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTrainerInBattleTower
en: You need to be cautious if you ever decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.
et: Sa pead olema ettevaatlik, kui kunagi otsustad BATTLE TOWERisse minna.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: Yes! I've finally got enough Battle Points!
et: Jah! Mul on lõpuks piisavalt Battle Pointe!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBattlePointsForDoll
en: I guess I'll trade for another giant plush DOLL!
et: Vahetan vist jälle ühe hiigelsuure pehme NUKU vastu!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: Oh, yeah, okay! So this is the RANKING HALL!
et: Oh, jaa, olgu! Nii et see on RANKING HALL!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHaveNameRecordedHere
en: I'd like to go down in history as a super champ and have my name recorded here for posterity.
et: Ma sooviksin ajalukku minna kui supermeister ja lasta oma nimi siia järeltulevatele põlvedele jäädvustada.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAnythingWithYou
en: With you by my side, I can do anything.
et: Sinuga mu kõrval suudan ma kõike.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!
et: Ohh, kullake, sa oled nii imeline!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!
et: Ohh, ma ei suuda enam oodata!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM right this instant!
et: Lähme otsekohe MULTI BATTLE ROOMI!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, the power of our love will overcome everyone we meet.
et: Kui me BATTLE SALONIS kokku saame, võidab meie armastuse jõud kõik, keda kohtame.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfOurLoveWillOvercome
en: Why, before us, darling, everything will topple like dominoes!
et: Kullake, meie ees langeb kõik nagu doominokivid!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively for tough TRAINERS.
et: BATTLE FRONTIER pole ainult kõvade TRAINERite jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: Many people with special abilities have been invited, it seems.
et: Näib, et kutsutud on palju erivõimetega inimesi.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: That man SCOTT…
et: See mees SCOTT…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FrontierNotExclusivelyForToughTrainers
en: He may have built this place to serve a bigger objective…
et: Võib-olla ehitas ta selle koha mingil suuremal eesmärgil…

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you good eyesight?
et: Vabandust, nooruke. Kas sul on hea nägemine?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeHereSeemsToWiggle
en: There is an odd tree past here, and to my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
et: Siit edasi on veider puu ja mu väsinud silmadele näib, et see vingerdab.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: Excuse me, young one. Have you a good memory?
et: Vabandust, nooruke. Kas sul on hea mälu?

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOddTreePastHere
en: I have this feeling there once was an odd tree past here.
et: Mul on tunne, et kunagi oli siit edasi veider puu.

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: I… I saw it!
et: Ma… ma nägin seda!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON with a long tail up ahead!
et: Seal eespool oli üks kleepuv pika sabaga POKéMON!

label: BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMonWithLongTail
en: It was hiding under a boulder, and it kept staring at me!
et: See peitis end rahnu all ja jõllitas mind pidevalt!

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.
et: Ma jätsin oma POKéMONi PÄEVAHOIDU.

label: Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove
en: When I got it back, it had a new move that I didn't teach it. I was really, really surprised.
et: Kui ma ta tagasi sain, oskas ta uut võtet, mida ma talle ei õpetanud. Ma olin tõesti-tõesti üllatunud.

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: What do you think? Aren't these flowers pretty?
et: Mis sa arvad? Kas need lilled pole ilusad?

label: Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty
en: I planted them all!
et: Ma istutasin nad kõik ise!

label: Route117_Text_AirIsTastyHere
en: The air is tasty here!
et: Õhk on siin maitsev!

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignVerdanturf
en: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF TOWN
et: ROUTE 117 {LEFT_ARROW} VERDANTURF LINN

label: Route117_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 117 {RIGHT_ARROW} MAUVILLE LINN

label: Route117_Text_DayCareSign
en: POKéMON DAY CARE “Let us raise your POKéMON.”
et: POKéMON DAY CARE „Kasvatame teie POKéMONi teie eest.”

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?
et: Sa oled POKéMON TRAINER, eks ju?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. Even more than his student WALLACE!
et: SOOTOPOLISE JUANIL on palju fänne. Isegi rohkem kui tema õpilasel WALLACE!

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFansDoYou
en: Do you have any?
et: Kas sul endal on fänne?

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePrettyStrong
en: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.
et: Ohoo, siis sa oled vist päris tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Oh, dear… That's a little lonesome.
et: Oi heldeke… See on ju natuke kurb.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWorkingHarder
en: Try working a little harder to get a fan following.
et: Pinguta natuke rohkem, küll siis fännid tulevad!

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: Dedicated fans come over from even outside of HOENN.
et: Pühendunud fännid tulevad kohale isegi väljastpoolt HOENNI.

label: SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClubWasWild
en: It was really wild when I went to the TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.
et: Kui ma käisin LILYCOVES TRAINER FAN CLUBIS, oli seal alles möll!

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: ARCHIE: What happened… What is this wretched scene…
et: ARCHIE: Mis juhtus… Mis õnnetu vaatepilt see on…

label: Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened
en: Did I…make a horrible mistake?
et: Kas ma… tegin kohutava vea?

label: Route128_Text_ArchieIOnlyWanted
en: I… I only wanted…
et: Ma… Ma tahtsin ju ainult…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: MAXIE: Do you understand now, ARCHIE?
et: MAXIE: Kas sa nüüd mõistad, ARCHIE?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: Do you finally see how disastrous your dream turned out to be?
