et: Kas sa lõpuks näed, kui hukatuslikuks su unistus osutus?

label: Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow
en: We have to hurry! We have to do something before the situation goes completely out of control!
et: Peame kiirustama! Peame midagi ette võtma, enne kui olukord täiesti käest läheb!

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything.
et: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, ära ütle midagi.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: I know that I have no right to be critical of ARCHIE…
et: Ma tean, et mul pole õigust ARCHIET arvustada…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But the way things are now, I doubt that we humans will be capable of doing anything about it.
et: Aga praeguses olukorras kahtlen, kas meie, inimesed, suudame siin üldse midagi ära teha.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: But neither can we stand by and just watch helplessly.
et: Aga me ei saa ka käed rüpes kõrvalt abitult pealt vaadata.

label: Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToArchieAndMe
en: The responsibility for putting an end to this falls to ARCHIE and me…
et: Sellele kõigele lõpu tegemine on ARCHIE ja minu vastutada…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: MAXIE: This defies belief…
et: MAXIE: See on lihtsalt uskumatu…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Those super-ancient POKéMON…
et: Need ürgvanad POKéMONid…

label: Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief
en: Their power is unbelievable. They've upset the balance of nature…
et: Nende jõud on uskumatu. Nad on looduse tasakaalu rikkunud…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWhatIsHappening
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! What is happening?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Mis toimub?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This is terrible…
et: See on kohutav…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: After the scorching heat wave ended, this deluge began.
et: Pärast kõrvetavat kuumalainet algas see uputus.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… No, the whole world will drown.
et: Kui see ei lakka, upub kogu HOENN… Ei, kogu maailm.

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: This huge rain cloud is spreading from above SOOTOPOLIS…
et: See tohutu vihmapilv levib SOOTOPOLISE kohalt…

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: What in the world is taking place there?
et: Mis seal küll toimuda võib?

label: Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown
en: There's no point arguing here… SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…
et: Pole mõtet siin vaielda… Ehk leiame vastused SOOTOPOLISEST…

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}… I don't know what you intend to do, but don't do anything reckless.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}… Ma ei tea, mida sa plaanid, aga ära tee midagi rumalat.

label: Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis
en: Okay. I'm going to SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Olgu. Mina lähen SOOTOPOLISESSE.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey!
et: EMA: {PLAYER}, me olemegi kohal, kullake!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It must be tiring riding with our things in the moving truck.
et: Kolimisautos koos kogu kraamiga sõita oli kindlasti väsitav.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.
et: Nii, see ongi LITTLEROOT LINN.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: How do you like it? This is our new home!
et: Kuidas meeldib? Siin on meie uus kodu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be an easy place to live, don't you think?
et: Veidi vanamoodne, aga elamiseks tundub mõnus koht, eks?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInside
en: And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! Let's go inside.
et: Ja sina saad oma toa, {PLAYER}! Läki sisse.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WaitPlayer
en: MOM: Wait, {PLAYER}!
et: EMA: Oota, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
et: EMA: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Kas sa tutvustasid end PROF. BIRCHILE?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!
et: Oi! Küll on armas POKéMON! Said selle PROF. BIRCHILT. Kui tore!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: You're your father's child, all right. You look good together with POKéMON!
et: Sa oled ikka täiesti oma isa laps. POKéMONiga koos näed sa hea välja!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: Here, honey! If you're going out on an adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.
et: Võta, kullake! Kui lähed seiklema, pane jalga need RUNNING SHOES.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoes
en: They'll put a zip in your step!
et: Need panevad su sammu vilkaks!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunningShoes
en: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.
et: {PLAYER} pani jalga RUNNING SHOES.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with instructions.
et: EMA: {PLAYER}, nende jalatsitega tuli kaasa juhend.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Press the B Button while wearing these RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!
et: „Kui RUNNING SHOES on jalas, vajuta B-nuppu ja jooksed eriti kiiresti!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes
en: “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race in the great outdoors!”
et: „Pane RUNNING SHOES jalga ja kihuta mööda vaba loodust!”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: To think that you have your very own POKéMON now… Your father will be overjoyed.
et: Mõelda vaid, sul on nüüd päris oma POKéMON… Isa jääb ülirõõmsaks.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: …But please be careful. If anything happens, you can come home.
et: …Aga palun ole ettevaatlik. Kui midagi juhtub, tule ikka koju.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHappens
en: Go on, go get them, honey!
et: Anna minna, näita neile, kullake!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: If you use a PC, you can store items and POKéMON.
et: ARVUTIS saad hoiustada nii esemeid kui ka POKéMONe.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems
en: The power of science is staggering!
et: Teaduse jõud on lausa jahmatav!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB studying, then he'll suddenly go out in the wild to do more research…
et: PROF. BIRCH istub päevad läbi LABORIS uurimistöö kallal ja siis kaob äkki loodusesse edasi uurima…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab
en: When does PROF. BIRCH spend time at home?
et: Millal PROF. BIRCH siis üldse kodus on?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: Um, um, um!
et: Öö, öö, öö!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemonWillJumpOut
en: If you go outside and go in the grass, wild POKéMON will jump out!
et: Kui lähed välja rohu sisse, hüppavad metsikud POKéMONid välja!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHavePokemon
en: It's dangerous if you don't have your own POKéMON.
et: See on ohtlik, kui sul endal POKéMONi pole.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Um, hi!
et: Öö, tere!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: There are scary POKéMON outside! I can hear their cries!
et: Väljas on hirmsaid POKéMONe! Ma kuulen nende kisa!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: I want to go see what's going on, but I don't have any POKéMON…
et: Ma tahan minna vaatama, mis toimub, aga mul pole ühtki POKéMONi…

label: LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHappening
en: Can you go see what's happening for me?
et: Kas sa läheksid minu eest vaatama, mis seal toimub?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch
en: You saved PROF. BIRCH! I'm so glad!
et: Sa päästsid PROF. BIRCHI! Ma olen nii rõõmus!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPokemon
en: Are you going to catch POKéMON? Good luck!
et: Kas lähed POKéMONe püüdma? Edu!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign
en: LITTLEROOT TOWN “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”
et: LITTLEROOT LINN „Linn, mida ei värvi ükski toon.”

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsLab
en: PROF. BIRCH'S POKéMON LAB
et: PROF. BIRCHI POKéMON LABOR

label: LittlerootTown_Text_PlayersHouse
en: {PLAYER}'s HOUSE
et: {PLAYER} MAJA

label: LittlerootTown_Text_ProfBirchsHouse
en: PROF. BIRCH'S HOUSE
et: PROF. BIRCHI MAJA

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! That was good work out there!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Vaat kus lugu, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa said seal kenasti hakkama!

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I knew there was something special about you when I first saw you, but I never expected this.
et: Juba esimesel kohtumisel aimasin, et sinus on midagi erilist, aga sellist asja ma küll oodata ei osanud.

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX I gave you?
et: Ahjaa. Kas see POKéDEX, mille ma sulle andsin, on veel alles?

label: LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShowYouAtLab
en: I have something to show you. Let's go to my LAB.
et: Mul on sulle midagi näidata. Läki mu LABORISSE.

label: gText_LinkStandby3
en: Link standby…
et: Ühenduse ootel…

label: gText_YourPartnerHasRetired
en: Your partner has retired.
et: Su partner loobus.

label: gText_YourPartnerHasRetired
en: Your BATTLE ROOM challenge will be canceled.
et: Su BATTLE ROOMi väljakutse tühistatakse.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: Where has our WALLY gone?
et: Kuhu meie WALLY küll jäi?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally
en: We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN very soon…
et: Peame ju üsna pea VERDANTURF LINNA teele asuma…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Hiya! Are you maybe… A rookie TRAINER?
et: Tere! Kas sa oled äkki… algaja TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS do when they reach a new town?
et: Kas tead, mida POKéMON TRAINERID teevad, kui nad uude linna jõuavad?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer
en: They first check what kind of GYM is in the town.
et: Kõigepealt uurivad nad välja, milline SAAL selles linnas on.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym
en: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.
et: Näed? See ongi PETALBURG LINNA SAAL.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign
en: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it whenever you're looking for a GYM.
et: See on SAALI silt. Kui SAALI otsid, vaata just selle sildi järgi.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: My face is reflected in the water.
et: Mu nägu peegeldub vees.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: It's a shining grin full of hope…
et: Lootust täis särav naeratus…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: Or it could be a look of somber silence struggling with fear…
et: Või on see hoopis sünge vaikiv pilk, mis hirmuga heitleb…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection
en: What do you see reflected in your face?
et: Mida sina oma näos peegeldumas näed?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: Let's say you have six POKéMON. If you catch another one…
et: Oletame, et sul on kuus POKéMONi. Kui püüad veel ühe…

label: PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation
en: It is automatically sent to a STORAGE BOX over a PC connection.
et: See saadetakse ARVUTI kaudu automaatselt BOXi.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign
en: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: NORMAN “A man in pursuit of power!”
et: PETALBURG LINNA POKéMON SAALI JUHT: NORMAN „Mees, kes ihkab jõudu!”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign
en: PETALBURG CITY “Where people mingle with nature.”
et: PETALBURG LINN „Kus inimesed elavad loodusega käsikäes.”

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WallyHouseSign
en: WALLY'S HOUSE
et: WALLY MAJA

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Excuse me!
et: Vabandust!

label: PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer
en: Let me guess, from the way you're dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?
et: Las ma arvan… Riietuse järgi otsustades oled sa POKéMON TRAINER?

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: Well, maybe not. Your clothes aren't all that dirty.
et: Noh, vahest siiski mitte. Su riided pole kuigi mustad.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot
en: You're either a rookie TRAINER, or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.
et: Sa oled kas algaja TRAINER või siis lihtsalt tavaline laps.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm roaming the land in search of talented TRAINERS.
et: Ma rändan mööda maad ja otsin andekaid TRAINEREID.

label: PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedTrainers
en: I'm sorry to have taken your time.
et: Vabandust, et su aega võtsin.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: Merchandise you buy here is sent to your own PC.
et: Kaup, mille siit ostad, saadetakse su enda ARVUTISSE.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_MerchandiseSentToPC
en: That's fantastic! I wish they could also deliver me home like that.
et: Lausa imeline! Kui nad ka minu saaksid niimoodi koju toimetada…

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm putting my cute DOLLS on it.
et: Ma ostan ilusa laua ja panen sellele oma nunnud NUKUD.

label: FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDeskForDolls
en: If I don't, when I decorate my SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get dirty or poked with splinters.
et: Muidu lähevad mu NUKUD SALABAASI kaunistades mustaks või saavad pindusid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro
en: I'll show you the sublime techniques I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
et: Näitan sulle neid ülevaid oskusi, mille olen meie JUHILT JUANILT õppinud!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaDefeat
en: Please forgive me, JUAN…
et: Palun andesta mulle, JUAN…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBattle
en: Watch what happens if you crack all the floor tiles.
et: Vaata, mis juhtub, kui sa kõik põrandaplaadid mõranema paned.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: You came all the way here, but you won't get to see JUAN.
et: Sa tulid küll terve selle tee, aga JUANI sa nägema ei pääse.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro
en: Not if you lose to me, you won't!
et: Ei saa, kui sa mulle kaotad!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat
en: You're strong! I was fooled by your cute looks!
et: Sa oled tugev! Su armas välimus pettis mind ära!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBattle
en: You might be good enough to avoid being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.
et: Võib-olla oled piisavalt tubli, et JUAN sind ühe hoobiga minema ei pühiks.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The sight of JUAN conducting a battle…
et: Vaatepilt, kuidas JUAN lahingut juhib…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro
en: The very beauty of it compelled me to become a TRAINER.
et: Juba selle ilu pani mind TRAINERIKS hakkama.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat
en: You battled with more beauty than I could muster…
et: Sinu võitlus oli ilusam, kui mina iial suudan…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: The grace you bring to battle is fabulous.
et: Sinu graatsia lahingus on lausa vapustav.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBattle
en: Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found POKéMON.
et: Oh… Kui hea, et ma POKéMONid leidsin.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro
en: I should teach you how harsh battles can be.
et: Ma õpetan sulle, kui karmid lahingud olla võivad.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieDefeat
en: Oh. You're strong.
et: Oh. Sa oled tugev.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: I'll tell you something good.
et: Räägin sulle ühe hea asja.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBattle
en: If you want to reach JUAN, you need to walk on each floor tile once.
et: Kui tahad JUANI juurde jõuda, pead igal põrandaplaadil täpselt korra käima.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level in the HOENN region…
et: HOENNI piirkonna kõige kõrgema tasemega POKéMON SAAL…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro
en: That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.
et: See ongi SOOTOPOLISE SAAL.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefeat
en: What a high level you are!
et: Küll sina oled kõrgel tasemel!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostBattle
en: Rather than being satisfied by being in a strong GYM, I imagine training in other places will make you stronger. But above all, it looks more fun.
et: Tugevas SAALIS istudes on lihtne rahule jääda, aga mujal treenides saab vist tugevamaks. Ja mis peamine — see tundub ka lõbusam.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: I train my POKéMON together with JUAN.
et: Ma treenin oma POKéMONe koos JUANIGA.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro
en: Don't think I'm a pushover.
et: Ära arva, et minust on kerge jagu saada.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaDefeat
en: I was beaten…
et: Sain lüüa…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBattle
en: I think you have potential. Why don't you stay and train with us?
et: Minu meelest on sul annet. Miks sa ei jää meiega koos treenima?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A graceful glide across the ice while crossing no lines…
et: Graatsiline liug üle jää, ühtki joont ületamata…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro
en: A TRAINER putting on that performance would be elegantly beautiful!
et: TRAINER, kes sellise etteaste teeb, oleks lausa elegantselt ilus!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyDefeat
en: Well, excuse me?!
et: Noh, vabandust väga?!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostBattle
en: This is really obvious, but how strong you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do with how young or old you are.
et: See on ju ilmselge, aga TRAINERI tugevusel pole vanusega mingit pistmist.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro
en: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
et: Kui ma olen oma POKéMONidega, lendab aeg mööda, enne kui jõuad öelda „Uups!”

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyDefeat
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostBattle
en: I wish I could forget about lost causes before I can manage an “Oops!”
et: Kui ma suudaksin ka lootusetud asjad unustada, enne kui jõuan „Uups!” öelda…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro
en: I can battle with really rare POKéMON if you'd like.
et: Kui soovid, võin lahingusse saata tõeliselt haruldased POKéMONid.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat
en: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look at my POKéMON?
et: Oi, no vaat! Kas said mu POKéMONi ilusti ära vaadata?

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: I came to this GYM because JUAN praised me for my darling POKéMON.
et: Tulin sellesse SAALI sellepärast, et JUAN kiitis mu armsaid POKéMONe.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBattle
en: Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago when I was younger…
et: Oh, oleksin ma vaid JUANIGA kohtunud juba aastaid tagasi, kui olin noorem…

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro
en: Giggle… Your grim look is so charming.
et: Kihi… Su sünge ilme on nii võluv.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefeat
en: Oh, dear. I went much too easy on you.
et: Oi heldeke. Ma olin sinuga palju liiga leebe.

label: SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostBattle
en: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, I'm sure. Giggle…
et: JUANILE sa küll sõrmegi külge panna ei suudaks. Kihi…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: POKéMON are partners to people. They aren't our tools.
et: POKéMONid on inimeste partnerid. Nad pole meie tööriistad.

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartnersNotTools
en: Unfortunately, there are some people who fail to understand that…
et: Kahjuks leidub inimesi, kes sellest aru ei saa…

label: LilycoveCity_House1_Text_Kecleon
en: KECLEON: Ruroro?
et: KECLEON: Ruroro?

label: SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff
en: The awakened RAYQUAZA flew off…
et: Ärganud RAYQUAZA lendas minema…

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp
en: When POKéMON battle, they eventually level up and become stronger.
et: Lahingutes POKéMONide tase tõuseb ja nad muutuvad tugevamaks.

label: OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWithStrongPokemon
en: If the POKéMON with you become stronger, you'll be able to go farther away from here.
et: Kui su POKéMONid tugevamaks muutuvad, saad siit kaugemale minna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: Where the battling spirit of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE võitlusvaim!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE ARENA!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE ARENASSE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattleArena
en: I am your guide to the Set KO Tourney!
et: Olen sinu teejuht Set KO turniiril!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WishToTakeChallenge
en: Now, do you wish to take the BATTLE ARENA challenge?
et: Noh, kas soovid BATTLE ARENA väljakutse vastu võtta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame su väljakutset mõnel teisel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake the Set KO Tourney.
et: BATTLE ARENAS peetakse Set KO turniiri.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: All participants enter with a team of three POKéMON.
et: Kõik osalejad astuvad võistlusse kolme POKéMONiga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: The three POKéMON must be lined up in the order in which they are to appear.
et: Need kolm POKéMONi tuleb seada just sellesse järjekorda, milles nad lahingusse astuvad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: During battle, the POKéMON will appear one at a time in the preset order.
et: Lahingu ajal ilmuvad POKéMONid ükshaaval etteantud järjekorras.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must remain out until the match is decided.
et: Kui POKéMON on lahingusse astunud, peab ta seal püsima, kuni matš on otsustatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If a match remains undecided in three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui matš jääb kolme käiguga otsustamata, läheb see hindamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you wish to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui soovid väljakutse pooleli jätta, salvesta palun mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will not be able to continue with your challenge.
et: Kui sa ei salvesta, ei saa sa väljakutsega hiljem jätkata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainChallenge
en: If you pull off the feat of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui suudad alistada seitse TRAINERIT järjest, kingime sulle Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OkayToSave
en: Before showing you to the BATTLE ARENA, you must save. Is that okay?
et: Enne kui sind BATTLE ARENASSE juhatan, pead salvestama. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The BATTLE ARENA offers two levels of challenge, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice?
et: BATTLE ARENA pakub kaht raskusastet: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumma valid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very well, now select your three POKéMON, please.
et: Suurepärane! Palun vali nüüd oma kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Sul pole sisenemiseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Osalemiseks pead kaasa võtma kolm eri liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad kanda ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled ettevalmistused teinud, tule palun tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for entry.
et: Sul pole sisenemiseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To qualify, you must bring three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Osalemiseks pead kaasa võtma kolm eri liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: The three different POKéMON must all be Level 50 or lower.
et: Kõik kolm POKéMONi peavad olema tasemel 50 või madalamal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not hold the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi nad kanda ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: When you have made your preparations, please do return.
et: Kui oled ettevalmistused teinud, tule palun tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_GuideYouToArena
en: I shall now guide you to the BATTLE ARENA.
et: Ma juhatan sind nüüd BATTLE ARENASSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: My dear challenger!
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You did not save the game before shutting down, did you?
et: Sa ei salvestanud mängu enne sulgemist, ega ju?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: It is unfortunate, but that has resulted in your disqualification from your challenge.
et: Kahju küll, aga seetõttu oled sa väljakutselt kõrvaldatud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeShuttingDown
en: You may, of course, start with a fresh challenge.
et: Muidugi võid alustada uue väljakutsega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnSevenWins
en: We congratulate you for your splendid string of wins over seven TRAINERS!
et: Õnnitleme sind suurepärase seitsme järjestikuse võidu puhul!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordAchievement
en: Your achievement will be recorded. Please wait while I save the game.
et: Sinu saavutus salvestatakse. Palun oota, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PresentYouWithPrize
en: In commemoration of your 7-win streak, we present you with this prize.
et: Seitsme järjestikuse võidu puhul kingime sulle selle auhinna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinna {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: Oh? Your BAG seems to be full.
et: Oh? Su KOTT näib olevat täis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BagFullReturnForPrize
en: I urge you to clear space and return for your prize.
et: Tee palun kotis ruumi ja tule oma auhinnale järele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Thank you so much for participating!
et: Suur tänu, et osalesid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ThankYouWaitWhileSave
en: Please wait while I save the game.
et: Palun oota, kuni ma mängu salvestan.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_AwaitAnotherChallenge2
en: We await your challenge on another occasion!
et: Ootame su väljakutset mõnel teisel korral!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: We have been looking forward to your arrival.
et: Oleme sinu tulekut juba oodanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LookingForwardToArrivalSaveGame
en: Before I show you to the BATTLE ARENA, I must save the game. Please wait.
et: Enne kui sind BATTLE ARENASSE juhatan, pean mängu salvestama. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Shall I record your last BATTLE ARENA match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase BATTLE ARENA lahingu FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I lost on the REFEREE's decision…
et: Ma kaotasin KOHTUNIKU otsusega…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_BadIdeaToNotAttack
en: I don't think it was a good idea to only use defensive moves and not attack…
et: Vist polnud hea mõte ainult kaitsta ja üldse mitte rünnata…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: I won in judging!
et: Ma võitsin hindamisel!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_LandingHitsWorked
en: Landing hits consistently on the opponent's POKéMON worked!
et: Vastase POKéMONile järjekindel pihta saamine tasus end ära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: Our match was declared a draw.
et: Meie matš kuulutati viigiks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_MatchWasDeclaredDraw
en: When we ran out of time, both my POKéMON and the opponent's had about the same amount of HP left.
et: Kui aeg otsa sai, oli nii minu kui vastase POKéMONil umbes sama palju HP alles.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: In the BATTLE ARENA, the order of POKéMON is totally important.
et: BATTLE ARENAS on POKéMONide järjekord ülimalt oluline.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: For example, if your first POKéMON has certain type disadvantages, try making your second POKéMON one with moves that are super effective against the first one.
et: Näiteks kui su esimesel POKéMONil on mõni tüübinõrkus, vali teiseks selline POKéMON, kelle võtted on esimese vastu ülitõhusad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_OrderOfMonsImportant
en: I think that will be a good way of making an effective team.
et: Minu meelest on see hea viis tõhus meeskond kokku panna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Set KO Tourney's rules are listed.
et: Siin on kirjas Set KO turniiri reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist peatükki soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The Set KO Tourney has special rules, unlike standard battles.
et: Set KO turniiril kehtivad tavalahingutest erinevad erireeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: First, one battle lasts only three turns.
et: Esiteks, üks lahing kestab vaid kolm käiku.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: If the outcome is not decided after three turns, it goes to judging.
et: Kui kolme käiguga tulemus ei selgu, läheb see hindamisele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: The REFEREE will choose the winner based on how the POKéMON battled.
et: KOHTUNIK valib võitja selle põhjal, kuidas POKéMONid võitlesid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBattleRules
en: Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out until its battle's outcome is decided.
et: Samuti ei saa POKéMONi välja vahetada enne, kui tema lahingu tulemus on selgunud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The first judging factor is “Mind.” This factor evaluates how aggressive the battlers were.
et: Esimene hindamistegur on „Vaim”. See tegur hindab, kui agressiivsed võitlejad olid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainMindRules
en: The judging is based on how often the TRAINERS ordered the use of offensive moves.
et: Arvesse läheb see, kui tihti TRAINERID ründevõtteid kasutada käskisid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The second judging factor is “Skill.” This factor evaluates how effectively POKéMON moves were used.
et: Teine hindamistegur on „Oskus”. See tegur hindab, kui tõhusalt POKéMONi võtteid kasutati.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move worked successfully, the Skill rating goes up.
et: Kui võte õnnestus, tõuseb Oskuse hinnang.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If a move failed, the Skill rating is lowered.
et: Kui võte ebaõnnestus, langeb Oskuse hinnang.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If it was an offensive move, the Skill rating goes up if the move was “super effective” and goes down if it was “not very effective.”
et: Kui see oli ründevõte, tõuseb Oskuse hinnang siis, kui võte oli „ülitõhus”, ja langeb siis, kui see „polnud eriti tõhus”.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: The Skill rating will not go up for moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.
et: Selliste võtete nagu PROTECT ja DETECT puhul Oskuse hinnang ei tõuse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainSkillRules
en: If the opponent used PROTECT or DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to hit with a move, its Skill rating will not go down.
et: Kui vastane kasutas PROTECT või DETECT ja su POKéMON ei suutnud võttega pihta saada, siis tema Oskuse hinnang ei lange.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The third judging factor is “Body.” This factor is based on how much HP remained at the end of a battle.
et: Kolmas hindamistegur on „Keha”. See põhineb sellel, kui palju HP lahingu lõpus alles jäi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_ExplainBodyRules
en: The rating takes into account how much HP a POKéMON had at the start of battle, and what remained at the end.
et: Hinne arvestab, kui palju HP oli POKéMONil lahingu alguses ja kui palju lõpuks alles jäi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: A victory snatched from the ARENA TYCOON, and a seven-TRAINER sweep!
et: Võit ARENA TYCOONI üle ja kõik seitse TRAINERIT alistatud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_CongratsOnDefeatingTycoon
en: We congratulate you on your most splendid challenge!
et: Õnnitleme sind suurepäraselt läbitud väljakutse puhul!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_PleaseAcceptBattlePoints
en: My dear challenger, in recognition of your indefatigable spirit, please accept these Battle Point(s).
et: Mu kallis väljakutsuja, sinu väsimatu võitlusvaimu tunnustuseks palun võta vastu need Battle Pointid.

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringVictoryRoad
en: ENTERING VICTORY ROAD
et: SISENED VICTORY ROADILE

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_EnteringPokemonLeague
en: ENTERING POKéMON LEAGUE CENTER GATE
et: SISENED POKéMON LEAGUE'i KESKUSEVÄRAVASSE

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: EVER GRANDE CITY
et: EVER GRANDE LINN

label: EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The paradise of flowers, the sea, and POKéMON.”
et: „Lillede, mere ja POKéMONide paradiis.”

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: MT. PYRE…
et: MT. PYRE…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAboutMtPyreOrbs
en: At its peak are two orbs placed side by side. Did you know?
et: Selle tipus on kaks orbi kõrvuti. Kas teadsid?

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: Yes, two orbs side by side…
et: Jah, kaks orbi kõrvuti…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSideBySide
en: The sight of them together… It is somehow soothing…
et: Kui nad on koos… see on kuidagi rahustav vaatepilt…

label: SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitAndSee
en: Is that so? Perhaps you ought to visit and see…
et: Ah nii? Ehk peaksid ise kohale minema ja vaatama…

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Ohhh, what am I to do?
et: Ohhh, mida ma nüüd küll teen?

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when we were jumped by an odd thug…
et: Olime jalutuskäigul, PEEKO ja mina, kui üks veider kaabakas meile kallale kargas…

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: The scoundrel made off with my darling PEEKO!
et: See lurjus viis mu armsa PEEKO minema!

label: Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko
en: Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!
et: Rrrrooooaaar! PEEKO!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn… Roar!

label: Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel
en: I want to dig that tunnel!
et: Ma tahan seda tunnelit kaevata!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: Nnn… Roar! What's going on?
et: Nnn… Roar! Mis toimub?

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I was digging the tunnel without any tools when some goon ordered me out!
et: Kaevasin tunnelit ilma tööriistadeta, kui mingi lontrus käskis mul välja minna!

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That tunnel's filled with POKéMON that react badly to loud noises. They could cause an uproar.
et: Tunnel on täis POKéMONe, kes ei salli valju müra. Nad võivad möllama hakata.

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: That's why we stopped using heavy equipment for tunneling…
et: Just seepärast me loobusimegi kaevamisel rasketest masinatest…

label: Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrderedMeOut
en: I'm worried that the goon will do something stupid and startle the POKéMON into an uproar.
et: Kardan, et see lontrus teeb midagi rumalat ja ajab POKéMONid möllama.

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: Nnn… Roar!
et: Nnn… Roar!

label: Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunnel
en: That goofy goon hightailed it out of the tunnel! I can go back to digging!
et: See tobe lontrus pistis tunnelist plehku! Nüüd saan jälle kaevama hakata!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Oh! It's you!
et: Oh! See oled sina!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: You're that person who not only helped me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got back my stolen package and then even graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!
et: Sina oled ju see, kes mind PETALBURG WOODSis aitas, mu varastatud paki tagasi tõi ja selle siis veel lahkelt SLATEPORTI viis!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: CAPT. STERN informed us that the package arrived, too!
et: CAPT. STERN teatas meile, et pakk on kohale jõudnud!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: I thank you very, very much!
et: Ma tänan sind väga-väga palju!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would shower you with gratitude and hail you as a hero!
et: Oleksin ma vihmapilv, kallaksin sulle tänu kaela ja kuulutaksin sind kangelaseks!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: For you, the most wonderful TRAINER, I bear good news!
et: Sulle, kõige imelisemale TRAINERILE, on mul häid uudiseid!

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: Recently, our company developed a new kind of POKé BALL.
et: Hiljuti töötas meie firma välja uut sorti POKé PALLI.

label: Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation, this is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!
et: Tänutäheks — see on meie kingitus imelisele TRAINERILE!

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Our new POKé BALL will be available at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.
et: Meie uus POKé PALL tuleb müügile RUSTBORO POKéPOES.

label: Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart
en: Please do try it out! Thank you and bye-bye!
et: Palun proovi seda kindlasti! Aitäh ja head aega!

label: Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked
en: Your BAG is jam-packed. I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.
et: Su KOTT on puupüsti täis. Ma ei saa sulle seda REPEAT PALLI anda.

label: Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation
en: As a token of our appreciation for your delivering our package, I have a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our most wonderful TRAINER!
et: Tänutäheks paki kohaletoimetamise eest on mul meie kõige imelisemale TRAINERILE kinkida uut sorti POKé PALL!

label: Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses
en: I dropped my glasses… Can you help me find them?
et: Ma pillasin oma prillid maha… Kas aitad mul neid leida?

label: Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses
en: Those glasses! May I see them for a second?
et: Need prillid! Kas tohin neid hetkeks näha?

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm… Need on BLACKGLASSES. Mina otsin hoopis midagi muud…

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTheyArentHere
en: Maybe my glasses aren't around here…
et: Ehk pole mu prillid siin kandis…

label: Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere
en: Hmm… I can't find my glasses anywhere… Maybe they're not around here…
et: Hmm… Ma ei leia oma prille kusagilt… Ehk pole nad siin kandis…

label: Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor
en: Hmm… These are BLACKGLASSES. They're not what I'm looking for…
et: Hmm… Need on BLACKGLASSES. Mina otsin hoopis midagi muud…

label: Route116_Text_RouteSignRustboro
en: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO CITY
et: ROUTE 116 {LEFT_ARROW} RUSTBORO LINN

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: RUSTURF TUNNEL “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF
et: RUSTURF TUNNEL „Ühendab RUSTBORO ja VERDANTURFI”

label: Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign
en: “The tunnel project has been canceled.”
et: „Tunneliprojekt on tühistatud.”

label: Route116_Text_TunnelersRestHouse
en: TUNNELER'S REST HOUSE
et: TUNNELIKAEVAJA PUHKEMAJA

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: If you want to stop a POKéMON from evolving, press the B Button while it is trying to evolve. The startled POKéMON will stop.
et: Kui tahad POKéMONi arenemist takistada, vajuta arenemise ajal B-nuppu. Ehmunud POKéMON peatub.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolution
en: This is called an evolution cancel.
et: Seda nimetatakse arenemise katkestamiseks.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Your BAG has several POCKETS.
et: Su KOTIL on mitu TASKUT.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: Items you obtain are automatically placed in the appropriate POCKETS.
et: Esemed, mille sa saad, lähevad automaatselt õigesse TASKUSSE.

label: Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets
en: No TRAINER can afford to be without a BAG of their own.
et: Ükski TRAINER ei tule toime ilma oma KOTITA.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Umm… If this goes here, and that goes over there…
et: Ömm… Kui see läheb siia ja too sinna…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Then where does this thing go? And what about that doohickey?
et: Kuhu siis see asi käib? Ja kuhu see vidin?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CantMakeHeadsOrTails
en: Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails of this!
et: Aaargh! Ma ei saa sellest sotti!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Hm? Hi, I'm DOCK.
et: Hm? Tere, ma olen DOCK.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN commissioned me to design a ferry.
et: CAPT. STERN tellis minult praami kavandi.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Oh! That there… Are they DEVON GOODS?
et: Oh! See seal… Kas see on DEVON GOODS?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: But, hmm… This won't do…
et: Aga, hmm… See ei sobi…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: CAPT. STERN went off somewhere. He said he had some work to do.
et: CAPT. STERN läks kuhugi ära. Ütles, et tal on tööd teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_MeetDockDeliverToStern
en: Could I get you to go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that to him?
et: Kas sa läheksid CAPT. STERNI otsima ja annaksid selle talle üle?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have gone off to?
et: DOCK: Kuhu CAPT. STERN küll ära läks?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldYouFindStern
en: Could you go find CAPT. STERN and deliver that parcel to him?
et: Kas läheksid CAPT. STERNI otsima ja annaksid selle paki talle üle?

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art.
et: DOCK: Laevaehitus on kunst.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: A lot of things can't be figured out just by calculating.
et: Paljusid asju ei saa pelgalt arvutamisega välja nuputada.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_CouldUseAdviceFromVeteran
en: I really could use advice from a veteran who knows the seas…
et: Mul kuluks tõesti ära mõne vana merekaru nõuanne…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to lend us his help.
et: DOCK: Tere! MR. BRINEY tuli meile appi!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_BrineyJoinedUs
en: Thanks to the veteran sailor, the ferry is steadily coming together.
et: Tänu kogenud meremehele saab praam tasapisi valmis.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!
et: DOCK: Praam on lõpuks valmis!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel of technology!
et: Uus S.S. TIDAL on tõeline tehnikaime!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: But, I get the feeling that we can make something even better.
et: Aga mul on tunne, et me suudame teha midagi veelgi paremat.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_FerryIsReady
en: You know, there's never an end to technology's march.
et: Tead, tehnika areng ei jää kunagi seisma.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! It's been too long!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ammu pole näinud!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's been feeling frisky!
et: Jaa, sinuga kohtumisest saati tunneb see vana merekaru end nagu noor mees!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: So I've decided to help DOCK make a ferry.
et: Nii et ma otsustasin aidata DOCKIL praami teha.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: Aye, after all, a ferry would be able to carry a lot of people.
et: Jaa, praam suudaks ju korraga hulga rahvast vedada.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: But, you know, that DOCK is really something special.
et: Aga tead, see DOCK on tõesti omamoodi mees.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_DecidedToHelpDock
en: With his knack for technology and my experience, I'm sure that we can build one great ship, aye!
et: Tema tehnikanina ja minu kogemus — küll me ehitame ühe vägeva laeva, jaa!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: The seasons, the weather, where the moon sits in the sky…
et: Aastaajad, ilm, kuu asend taevas…

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: These and other conditions make the sea change its expression.
et: Need ja muud asjaolud muudavad mere ilmet.

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_SeaIsLikeLivingThing
en: That's right! The sea is like a living thing!
et: Just nii! Meri on nagu elusolend!

label: SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_GetSeasickEasily
en: I get seasick real easily. So I get to help out here instead.
et: Mina jään ülikergesti merehaigeks. Nii et aitan selle asemel siin kaldal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Hey! I remember your face!
et: Hei! Ma mäletan su nägu!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: If you're here, it must mean that you're about to mess with us again!
et: Kui sa siin oled, kavatsed sa meile kindlasti jälle jalgu jääda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune tatt — kas sa tõesti arvad, et saad TEAM AQUAGA hakkama?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ütleksin, et sa oled umbes triljon aastat liiga vara platsis!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Sa sobid ideaalselt TEAM MAGMA seltskonda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: TEAM MAGMAST rääkides — kuulu järgi nähti neid MOSSDEEPI lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeep
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See lontruste kamp ei sobi mere äärde küll mitte!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: A punk like you, do you really think you can take on TEAM AQUA?
et: Sinusugune tatt — kas sa tõesti arvad, et saad TEAM AQUAGA hakkama?

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: I'd say you're too early by about a trillion years!
et: Ütleksin, et sa oled umbes triljon aastat liiga vara platsis!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: You're a perfect fit for the likes of TEAM MAGMA!
et: Sa sobid ideaalselt TEAM MAGMA seltskonda!

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they were spotted near MOSSDEEP.
et: TEAM MAGMAST rääkides — kuulu järgi nähti neid MOSSDEEPI lähedal.

label: SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNearMossdeepShort
en: That bunch of goons, they sure don't look good near the sea!
et: See lontruste kamp ei sobi mere äärde küll mitte!

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.
et: Tere! Sa oled vist rändaja?

label: Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily
en: How's this? What do you say to taking on our family of four in a series of POKéMON battles?
et: Kuidas oleks? Mis sa kostad, kui astud meie neljaliikmelise perega järjest POKéMON-lahingusse?

label: Route111_Text_IsThatSo
en: Is that so? Drop in, if you change your mind!
et: Ah nii? Astu sisse, kui meelt muudad!

label: Route111_Text_VictorIntro
en: That's the spirit! I like you!
et: Näe, see on õige vaim! Sa meeldid mulle!

label: Route111_Text_VictorDefeat
en: Aiyah! You're a lot tougher than I expected!
et: Aiah! Sa oled palju kõvem, kui ma ootasin!

label: Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle
en: Hey, all! I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
et: Hei, kõik! Ma leidsin päris tugeva TRAINERI!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?
et: Oh, heldeke! Küll sa oled noor!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: You must be quite the TRAINER to beat my husband, though.
et: Aga kui sa mu mehe alistasid, pead sa üsna tubli TRAINER olema.

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro
en: It's my turn to battle now!
et: Nüüd on minu kord võidelda!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat
en: Oh, gosh! I can't get over how strong you are!
et: Oh, heldeke! Ma ei jõua ära imestada, kui tugev sa oled!

label: Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle
en: There's a strong TRAINER here! This one's really strong!
et: Siin on üks tugev TRAINER! Tõeliselt tugev!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!
et: Sa oled emmest tugevam? Ohoo!

label: Route111_Text_ViviIntro
en: But I'm strong, too! Really! Honestly!
et: Aga minagi olen tugev! Tõesti! Ausõna!

label: Route111_Text_ViviDefeat
en: Huh? Did I just lose?
et: Huh? Kas ma just kaotasin?

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: This stinks…
et: See on nii ebaõiglane…

label: Route111_Text_ViviPostBattle
en: …Snivel… Grandma!
et: …Nuuks… Vanaema!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: How dare you make my granddaughter cry!
et: Kuidas sa julged mu lapselast nutma panna!

label: Route111_Text_VickyIntro
en: For that, I'm going to smack you! Prepare to lose!
et: Selle eest ma virutan sulle! Valmistu kaotama!

label: Route111_Text_VickyDefeat
en: Kwah! You are strong… My granddaughter was right…
et: Kvaah! Sa oled tugev… Lapselapsel oli õigus…

label: Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle
en: If you're not in any hurry, visit with us awhile.
et: Kui sul kiiret pole, jää meile veidi külla.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: If you don't raise your POKéMON some more, it could be tough to keep winning up through the ranks.
et: Kui sa oma POKéMONe veel ei treeni, võib edasi ülespoole võitlemine raskeks minna.

label: Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRanks
en: I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's ELITE FOUR are far stronger than any GYM LEADER.
et: Olen kuulnud, et POKéMON LIIGA ELIITNELIK on palju tugevam kui ükski SAALI JUHT.

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe
en: I challenged the WINSTRATE family, but four matches in a row is tough going… They destroyed me.
et: Astusin perekonna WINSTRATE vastu, aga neli lahingut järjest on ränk töö… Nad tegid mu pihuks ja põrmuks.

label: Route111_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 111 {DOWN_ARROW} MAUVILLE LINN

label: Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign
en: “Our family's hearts beat as one!” THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE
et: „Meie pere südamed löövad kui üks!” SIIN ELAB PEREKOND WINSTRATE

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign112
en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112
et: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 112

label: Route111_Text_RouteSign113
en: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113
et: ROUTE 111 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 113

label: Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign
en: OLD LADY'S REST STOP “Come in and rest your tired bones.”
et: VANAPROUA PUHKEPEATUS „Tule sisse ja anna oma väsinud kontidele puhkust.”

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: One of the indicators of a POKéMON's powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for “SPECIAL ATTACK.”
et: Üks POKéMONi tugevuse näitajaid on ER. RÜNNAK. See tähendab „ERILINE RÜNNAK”.

label: Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef
en: Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL DEFENSE.”
et: Samamoodi tähendab ER. KAITSE „ERILINE KAITSE.”

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: There should be a tower made of sand around here somewhere.
et: Siin kandis peaks kuskil olema liivast torn.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: But for some reason, it can be seen sometimes, and sometimes not.
et: Aga millegipärast on seda vahel näha ja vahel mitte.

label: Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundHere
en: That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.
et: Just seepärast ma nimetangi seda nimega MIRAGE TOWER.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I see it! The tower of sand!
et: Ma näen seda! Liivatorn!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: The sand tower they called a mirage is clearly visible!
et: Liivatorn, mida nad miraažiks nimetasid, on selgelt näha!

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: But it looks so fragile… It could crumble away anytime…
et: Aga see näeb nii habras välja… Võib iga hetk kokku variseda…

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible
en: I want to go inside it, but I can't get my courage up for it…
et: Tahaks sinna sisse minna, aga julgust ei jätku…

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Whoa… That was shocking.
et: Ohoo… See oli vapustav.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: Sand rained down in chunks all of a sudden.
et: Järsku sadas liiva kamakate kaupa alla.

label: Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedDown
en: What was it like inside? Were there sandy ghosts and such?
et: Milline seal sees oli? Kas seal oli liivaseid tonte või midagi sellist?

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand hasn't been seen.
et: Pärast meie juttu pole liivatorni enam näha olnud.

label: Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSince
en: Perhaps it really was the MIRAGE TOWER…
et: Ehk oligi see tõesti MIRAGE TOWER…

label: Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared
en: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: CLAW FOSSIL kadus liiva sisse…

label: Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared
en: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into the sand…
et: ROOT FOSSIL kadus liiva sisse…

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: Oh, no!
et: Oh, ei!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to ROUTE 111!
et: Mu onu MAUVILLES käskis mul ROCK SMASH kaasa võtta, kui ma ROUTE 111 peale lähen!

label: Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeRockSmash
en: My uncle? He lives across from the bike shop in MAUVILLE.
et: Mu onu? Ta elab MAUVILLES rattapoe vastas.

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL SISSEPÄÄS

label: Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign
en: “Scale the heights, you hot-blooded TRAINERS!”
et: „Vallutage kõrgused, te tulised TRAINERID!”

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: There appears to be some connection between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.
et: Näib, et SOOTOPOLISE ja MT. PYRE vahel on mingi seos.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtPyreConnection
en: My friends and I did some research on it at the lab where I used to work.
et: Mina ja mu sõbrad tegime selle kohta veidi uurimistööd laboris, kus ma kunagi töötasin.

label: SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedToStudySea
en: My big brother used to study the sea.
et: Mu vanem vend uuris kunagi merd.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: Even if a POKéMON is weak now, it will grow stronger.
et: Isegi kui POKéMON on praegu nõrk, saab ta tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStronger
en: The most important thing is love! Love for your POKéMON!
et: Kõige tähtsam on armastus! Armastus su POKéMONi vastu!

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful
en: Do you use REPEL? It keeps POKéMON away, so it's useful when you're in a hurry.
et: Kas kasutad REPELi? See hoiab POKéMONe eemal, nii et see on kasulik, kui sul on kiire.

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: Do you have any ANTIDOTES with you?
et: Kas sul on kaasas mõni ANTIDOTE?

label: PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidotesWithYou
en: If you walk around with a poisoned POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints. Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
et: Kui käid ringi mürgitatud POKéMONiga, kaotab ta HP kuni minestamiseni. Võta kindlasti ANTIDOTE kaasa.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanIntro
en: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS always bring our POKéMON. How about a quick battle?
et: Kui me merele läheme, võtame meie, SAILORID, alati POKéMONid kaasa. Kuidas oleks kiire lahinguga?

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanDefeat
en: Whoops, I'm sunk!
et: Uups, ma läksin põhja!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: The ship's bottom has sunk into the depths.
et: Laeva põhi on vajunud sügavustesse.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanPostBattle
en: If a POKéMON knew how to go underwater, we might make some progress…
et: Kui mõni POKéMON oskaks vee alla sukelduda, saaksime ehk edasi…

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_YayItsAShip
en: Yay! It's a ship!
et: Jess! See on laev!

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: “STORAGE” is painted on the door.
et: Uksele on maalitud „LADU”.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the STORAGE KEY.
et: {PLAYER} pistis võtme STORAGE KEY lukku ja keeras.

label: AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_InsertedStorageKey
en: The inserted KEY stuck fast, but the door opened.
et: VÕTI jäi lukku kinni, kuid uks avanes.

label: AbandonedShip_Text_TheDoorIsOpen
en: The door is open.
et: Uks on lahti.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: STEVEN: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: STEVEN: Tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It's me, STEVEN! We met in the cave near DEWFORD.
et: See olen mina, STEVEN! Kohtusime koopas DEWFORDI lähedal.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Have you met many kinds of POKéMON since I last saw you?
et: Kas oled pärast meie viimast kohtumist palju eri liiki POKéMONe kohanud?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: There are many, many kinds of POKéMON in this wide world of ours.
et: Meie avaras maailmas on väga-väga palju eri liiki POKéMONe.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: If you wanted to raise only your favorites, that's fine.
et: Kui tahad kasvatada ainult oma lemmikuid, on see täiesti korras.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Perhaps you find it more fun to raise all sorts of POKéMON.
et: Ehk on sinu meelest lõbusam kasvatada kõikvõimalikke POKéMONe.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: As a TRAINER of POKéMON, what do you think?
et: Sina oled POKéMONide TRAINER — mida sina arvad?

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: Of course, it's not any of my business.
et: Muidugi pole see üldse minu asi.

label: Route118_Text_StevenQuestions
en: It would be nice if we were to meet again somewhere.
et: Oleks tore, kui me kunagi kuskil jälle kohtuksime.

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Hmm! A GOOD ROD is really good!
et: Hmm! GOOD ROD on tõesti hea!

label: Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood
en: Wouldn't you agree?
et: Kas sa ei arva samamoodi?

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! We're of identical minds!
et: Hmm! Me oleme ühte meelt!

label: Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis
en: Hmm! Take this GOOD ROD!
et: Hmm! Võta see GOOD ROD!

label: Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing
en: Wherever there's water, try your luck at fishing.
et: Kus iganes on vett, proovi kalaõnne.

label: Route118_Text_DontYouLikeToFish
en: Don't you like to fish?
et: Kas sulle ei meeldi kala püüda?

label: Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod
en: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON with your GOOD ROD.
et: Proovi oma GOOD ROD abil püüda kõikvõimalikke POKéMONe.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: Even if there isn't a boat, you can cross rivers and the sea if you have a POKéMON that knows SURF.
et: Isegi kui paati pole, saad jõgesid ja merd ületada, kui sul on POKéMON, kes oskab SURFi.

label: Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf
en: POKéMON can be counted on to do so much!
et: POKéMONid oskavad nii palju — neile võib alati loota!

label: Route118_Text_RouteSignMauville
en: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY
et: ROUTE 118 {LEFT_ARROW} MAUVILLE LINN

label: Route118_Text_RouteSign119
en: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119
et: ROUTE 118 {UP_ARROW} ROUTE 119

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted on the hull.
et: Laeva kerele on maalitud „SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1”.

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: This is the submarine TEAM AQUA stole in SLATEPORT!
et: See on allveelaev, mille TEAM AQUA SLATEPORTIS varastas!

label: Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplorer1
en: TEAM AQUA must have gone ashore here.
et: TEAM AQUA on kindlasti siit kaldale läinud.

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!
et: Mina olen see SUKELDUV AARDEKÜTT!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_Greeting
en: I'm the awesome dude who makes deep-sea dives to gather treasures resting at the bottom.
et: Ma olen see äge sell, kes sukeldub süvamerre ja korjab merepõhjast aardeid!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_HaveYouSeenAnyShards
en: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of tools made in ancient times?
et: Ütle, kas sa oled näinud muistsetest tööriistadest jäänud KILDE?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: You haven't got any treasures for me…
et: Sul pole minu jaoks ühtegi aaret…

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YouHaventGotAnyShards
en: If you see any SHARDS, like the RED SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!
et: Kui näed kuskil KILDU, näiteks eset nimega RED SHARD, pead selle minuga vahetama!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, hey! That… That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!
et: Ohoo, oota! See… See on KILD! Just selliseid ma otsingi!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ThatsAShardIllTradeYou
en: Oh, man, you've got to trade that with me! I'll give you something good!
et: Oi, sõber, see tuleb minuga ära vahetada! Annan sulle midagi head!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_WhatDoYouWantToTrade
en: What do you want to trade?
et: Mida sa tahad vahetada?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_YoullTradeShardForStone
en: You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
et: Vahetad siis oma {STR_VAR_1} minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ItsADeal
en: It's a done deal! Use that wisely!
et: Asi klaar! Kasuta seda targalt!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_TradeSomethingElse
en: Do you want to trade something else?
et: Kas tahad midagi muud vahetada?

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_BagFull
en: Whoops, your BAG's full. Get rid of some items, friend!
et: Uups, su KOTT on täis. Viska mõni ese välja, sõber!

label: Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text_ComeBackIfYouChangeMind
en: No? That's a downer. Well, if you change your mind, come back.
et: Ei? Kahju küll. No kui ümber mõtled, tule tagasi.

en: {CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item {CLEAR_TO 15}RED SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 123}FIRE STONE{CLEAR_TO 200}

et: {CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item {CLEAR_TO 6}YELLOW SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 115}THUNDERSTONE{CLEAR_TO 200}

et: {CLEAR_TO 10}Wanted item{CLEAR_TO 124}Trade item {CLEAR_TO 8}GREEN SHARD{CLEAR_TO 89}{LEFT_ARROW}{RIGHT_ARROW}{CLEAR_TO 123}LEAF STONE

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. It's been a while.
et: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, tere. Ammu pole näinud.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: There's something here that you can't see, right?
et: Siin on midagi, mida sa ei näe, eks?

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: Now, if I were to use this device on the invisible obstacle…
et: Kui ma nüüd kasutaksin seda seadet nähtamatu takistuse peal…

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: No, no. Rather than describing it, I should just show you. That would be more fun.
et: Ei-ei. Selle asemel, et seletada, on parem lihtsalt näidata. Nii on ka põnevam.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGreeting
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas su POKéMONid on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: STEVEN: No?
et: STEVEN: Ei?

label: Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere
en: I'll wait here, so you can get ready.
et: Ootan siin, valmistu rahulikult.

label: Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for battle?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas su POKéMONid on lahinguks valmis?

label: Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true power as a TRAINER!
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näita, milleks sa TRAINERina päriselt võimeline oled!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: STEVEN kasutas eset DEVON SCOPE.

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope
en: The startled POKéMON attacked!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON ründas!

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: STEVEN: I see… Your battle style is intriguing.
et: STEVEN: Ahaa… Sinu võitlusstiil on põnev.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Your POKéMON have obviously grown since I first met you in DEWFORD.
et: Sinu POKéMONid on pärast meie esimest kohtumist DEWFORDIS selgelt tugevamaks saanud.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: I'd like you to have this DEVON SCOPE.
et: Võta see DEVON SCOPE endale.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope
en: Who knows, there may be other concealed POKéMON.
et: Kes teab — ehk peidab end veel mõni POKéMON.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS who strive together.
et: Mulle meeldib näha POKéMONe ja TRAINEREID, kes koos pingutavad.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: I think you're doing great.
et: Minu meelest läheb sul suurepäraselt.

label: Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye
en: Well, let's meet again somewhere.
et: Noh, kohtume kuskil jälle.

label: Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Ees on midagi nähtamatut.

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
en: Something unseeable is in the way.
et: Ees on midagi nähtamatut.

label: Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope
en: Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
et: Kas kasutada eset DEVON SCOPE?

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
en: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas eset DEVON SCOPE.

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
en: An invisible POKéMON became completely visible!
et: Nähtamatu POKéMON muutus täiesti nähtavaks!

label: Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked
en: The startled POKéMON attacked!
et: Ehmunud POKéMON ründas!

en: ROUTE 120 {LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY
et: ROUTE 120 {LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE LINN

label: Route120_Text_RouteSign121
en: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 121 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 120

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: The generator is radiating heat that can be felt even at a distance.
et: Generaator kiirgab kuumust, mida tunneb isegi eemalt.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiatingHeat
en: It looks like it should be turned off as soon as possible.
et: Paistab, et see tuleks võimalikult ruttu välja lülitada.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorQuietedDown
en: The generator quieted down.
et: Generaator jäi vaikseks.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch.
et: {PLAYER} astus lülitile.

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: Click…
et: Klõps…

label: NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchGeneratorStopped
en: The generator appears to have stopped…
et: Näib, et generaator on seiskunud…

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: You're… Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?
et: Sina oled… Ahaa, sina oledki vist {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: Thank you for playing with WALLY a little while ago.
et: Aitäh, et sa hiljuti WALLY seltsis aega veetsid.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: He's been frail and sickly ever since he was a baby.
et: Ta on juba maast madalast nõrk ja põdur olnud.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: We've sent him to stay with my relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.
et: Me saatsime ta mõneks ajaks minu sugulaste juurde VERDANTURF LINNA.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: The air is a lot cleaner there than it is here.
et: Õhk on seal palju puhtam kui siin.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: What's that? Where's WALLY? He's already left, our WALLY.
et: Mis? Kus on WALLY? Meie WALLY on juba ära läinud.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksForPlayingWithWally
en: I wonder where he could have gotten by now?
et: Huvitav, kuhu ta praeguseks jõudnud on?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHowWallyIsDoing
en: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?
et: Huvitav, kuidas meie WALLY seal hakkama saab?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for dragging you here this way.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Vabanda, et me su niimoodi siia tirisime.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: But our WALLY's become very healthy since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.
et: Aga meie WALLY on pärast VERDANTURF LINNA kolimist väga terveks saanud.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: We owe it all to you!
et: Ja see kõik on sinu teene!

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: When WALLY left town, you helped him catch a POKéMON, right?
et: Kui WALLY linnast lahkus, aitasid sa tal POKéMONi püüda, eks?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: I think that made WALLY really happy.
et: Ma arvan, et WALLY oli selle üle väga õnnelik.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Actually, not just WALLY. It made me, his father, happy too.
et: Ja mitte ainult WALLY. Ka mina, tema isa, olin väga rõõmus.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: Happy that he's gained such a great friend as you.
et: Rõõmus selle üle, et ta on leidnud nii toreda sõbra nagu sina.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExcuseUs
en: This isn't a bribe or anything, but I'd really like you to have this.
et: See pole mingi altkäemaks, aga võta see palun vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAllSortsOfPlaces
en: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be able to go to all sorts of places.
et: Kui su POKéMON oskab SURFi, pääsed kõikvõimalikesse paikadesse.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsComingHomeSoon
en: WALLY's coming home soon. I'm looking forward to that.
et: WALLY tuleb varsti koju. Ootan seda päeva pikisilmi.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE CITY?
et: Oh? Sina ja WALLY saite EVER GRANDE LINNAS kokku?

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly.
et: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ära räägi rumalusi.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWallyInEverGrandeCity
en: He may have gotten healthy, but he can't go somewhere far away like that all by himself.
et: Terveks ta ju sai, aga nii kaugele ta üksipäini ei lähe.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: WALLY was really happy when he told us that he caught a POKéMON.
et: WALLY oli tõesti õnnelik, kui ta meile rääkis, et püüdis POKéMONi.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasReallyHappy
en: It's been ages since I've seen him smile like that.
et: Ma polnud teda ammu-ammu niimoodi naeratamas näinud.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I want you to keep this a secret from my husband…
et: Ära räägi seda palun mu mehele…

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN without telling anyone.
et: Aga meie WALLY lahkus VERDANTURF LINNAST kellelegi ütlemata.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: You know, WALLY is frail, but he's surprisingly strong-willed.
et: Tead, WALLY on küll nõrguke, aga üllatavalt kange tahtega.

label: PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeftWithoutTelling
en: I'm sure that he'll come back safe and sound one day!
et: Olen kindel, et ta tuleb ühel päeval elusa ja tervena tagasi!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: WALLACE: Tere tulemast, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: That incident in SOOTOPOLIS CITY… That was superb work, putting an end to that crisis all by yourself.
et: See juhtum SOOTOPOLIS LINNAS… Suurepärane töö — sa lõpetasid selle kriisi omal jõul.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Oops!
et: Uups!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: It wouldn't be fair to say that you alone ended the crisis.
et: Poleks aus öelda, et sina üksi kriisi lõpetasid.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: You overcame that difficult situation by working as one with your POKéMON.
et: Sa tulid sellest raskest olukorrast välja, sest tegutsesid koos oma POKéMONidega nagu üks.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: We TRAINERS raise POKéMON by giving them items and by teaching them new techniques for battle.
et: Meie, TRAINERid, kasvatame POKéMONe: anname neile esemeid ja õpetame neile uusi võtteid.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: But we ourselves also learn many things from POKéMON.
et: Aga ka meie ise õpime POKéMONidelt palju.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: And this is where your achievements are put to the test against what others like you have achieved.
et: Ja just siin pannakse sinu saavutused proovile teiste sinusuguste omade vastu.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Now!
et: Nüüd!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Who can most elegantly dance with their POKéMON in HOENN?
et: Kes suudab HOENNis oma POKéMONidega kõige elegantsemalt tantsida?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Show me right here and now!
et: Näita mulle siin ja praegu!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…
et: Mina, MEISTER, olen lüüa saanud…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: That was wonderful work. You were elegant, infuriatingly so. And yet it was utterly glorious!
et: See oli imeline. Sa olid elegantne — lausa ärritavalt elegantne. Ja ometi oli see täiesti hiilgav!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Kudos to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Au sulle, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat
en: You are a truly noble POKéMON TRAINER!
et: Sa oled tõeliselt üllas POKéMON TRAINER!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: WALLACE: The POKéMON you sent into battle…
et: WALLACE: POKéMONid, keda sa lahingusse saatsid…

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: At times they danced like a spring breeze, and at times they struck like lightning.
et: Vahel tantsisid nad nagu kevadtuul ja vahel lõid nad nagu välk.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: It was with light, yet surefooted, elegance that you led your POKéMON.
et: Sa juhtisid oma POKéMONe kerge, kuid kindla elegantsiga.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Even I felt bedazzled by your masterful performance!
et: Isegi mina jäin sinu meisterlikust esitusest pimestatuks!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You now stand at the glorious peak of the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Sa seisad nüüd POKéMON LIIGA hiilgaval tipul.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: I now proclaim you to be the new HOENN region…
et: Ma kuulutan sind nüüd HOENNi piirkonna uueks…
