et: Kas ma ei öelnud, et sa ei pea {PLAYER}{KUN} pärast muretsema?

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.
et: … … … … … … … … {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa tegid selle lõpuks ära.

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex
en: When I heard that you defeated your own father at the PETALBURG GYM, I thought perhaps you had a chance…
et: Kui ma kuulsin, et sa alistasid PETALBURG SAALIS oma isa, mõtlesin, et võib-olla sul on lootust…

et: Ah, jah!

label: EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchArriveRatePokedex

en: My husband is waiting at home. What would make a good gift for him?
et: Mu abikaasa ootab kodus. Mis oleks talle hea kingitus?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_StockUpOnItems

et: Lähen varsti pikale reisile. Pean esemeid varuma.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound {PLAYER}?
et: Jou, kuidas läheb, MEISTRIKS pürgiv {PLAYER}?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: The GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.
et: Siinsed SAALI JUHID kasutavad VAIMSET tüüpi POKéMONe.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you go up against them with FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, they'll inflict horrible damage!
et: Kui lähed neile vastu KAKLUS- või MÜRGI-tüüpi POKéMONidega, teevad nad sulle kohutavat kahju!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: Plus, they'll come at you with outstanding combination attacks.
et: Pealegi ründavad nad sind suurepäraste kombinatsioonidega.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice
en: If you want to win, you'll need to show them how tight you are with your POKéMON. Go for it!
et: Kui tahad võita, pead neile näitama, kui tugev on side sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel. Anna minna!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory
en: Wow, you're astounding! You're one great TRAINER!
et: Vau, sa oled hämmastav! Sinust on saanud suurepärane TRAINER!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro
en: Battles hinge on the strength of your spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!
et: Lahingud sõltuvad su vaimujõust! Nõrga vaimuga ei võida kunagi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat
en: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!
et: Ma kaotasin! Pean oma vaimu taas karastama!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle
en: The indecisive lose. That's my warning to you.
et: Kõhklejad kaotavad. See on mu hoiatus sulle.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro
en: Let me see your talent!
et: Näita mulle oma annet!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat
en: You possess spectacular talent!
et: Sul on suurepärane anne!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: If there are prodigies in the world, then our GYM LEADERS are them!
et: Kui maailmas on imelapsi, siis on need meie SAALI JUHID!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle
en: However, you may be even more talented than them…
et: Kuid sina võid olla neist veelgi andekam…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé BALL telekinetically!
et: Fufufufu… Vaata, kuidas ma POKé PALLI telekineetiliselt hõljutan!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Wrooooooooaaaar! … … … … … … …
et: Vroooooooaaar! … … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro
en: Sometimes, I'm out of sync…
et: Vahel ma lihtsalt pole vormis…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat
en: My POKéMON battling skills are out of sync, too!
et: Ka mu oskused POKéMON-lahingutes pole vormis!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift psychically. But this dust bunny…
et: POKé PALL oli liiga raske, et seda vaimujõuga tõsta. Aga see tolmupall…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: Whoooooooooooooooh! … … … … … …
et: Vuuuuuuuuuuuh! … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle
en: No, I'm not cheating! I didn't blow on it! Honestly!
et: Ei, ma ei peta! Ma ei puhunud sellele! Ausõna!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: When you lose to me, don't be too hard on yourself.
et: Kui mulle kaotad, ära ole enda vastu liiga karm.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro
en: It's not that you're weak--I'm just too strong!
et: Asi pole selles, et sa nõrk oled – ma olen lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahDefeat
en: You're just too strong!
et: Sa oled lihtsalt liiga tugev!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: I'm not going to get down on myself for losing. I just need to train harder.
et: Ma ei hakka kaotuse pärast norutama. Pean lihtsalt kõvemini treenima.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle
en: Positive thinking--that's my strong point!
et: Positiivne mõtlemine – see on minu tugev külg!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: I see it… I see your future…
et: Ma näen seda… Ma näen su tulevikku…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro
en: If you can beat me, I will tell you your future!
et: Kui suudad mind võita, siis räägin sulle su tulevikust!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaDefeat
en: I surrender!
et: Ma alistun!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: You will wage a terrifically intense battle with our GYM LEADERS…
et: Sa pead meie SAALI JUHTIDEGA ülimalt ägeda lahingu…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle
en: The result… You won't hear it from me!
et: Tulemus… Seda sa minult ei kuule!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: The roads you have traveled… What you have experienced…
et: Teed, mida mööda oled rännanud… Kõik, mida oled kogenud…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro
en: Come at me with everything you've learned!
et: Tule mulle vastu kõigega, mida oled õppinud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat
en: You've traveled a path of greatness!
et: Sa oled läbinud suursuguse teekonna!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: A bright future awaits those who have worked diligently.
et: Helge tulevik ootab neid, kes on usinasti tööd teinud.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: For those who lazed idly, there is only despair at the end.
et: Neid, kes jõude logelesid, ootab lõpus vaid meeleheide.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle
en: What goes around comes around…
et: Kuidas külvad, nõnda lõikad…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro
en: Even at the risk of life, I will win this battle!
et: Isegi elu hinnaga võidan ma selle lahingu!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat
en: What you do… It horrifies me…
et: Mida sa teed… See paneb mind õudusest värisema…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: How dare you beat me…
et: Kuidas sa julged mind võita…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle
en: It won't be my fault if something horrible befalls you…
et: See pole minu süü, kui sinuga midagi kohutavat juhtub…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: Hohoho.
et: Hohoho.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro
en: You need me to show you how tenacious the PSYCHIC type can be.
et: Pean sulle näitama, kui sitke võib VAIMNE tüüp olla.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat
en: Oh! My, my! Your battle style is fantastic!
et: Oh! Vaat kus lugu! Su võitlusstiil on fantastiline!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle
en: I… I don't let defeat rattle m-me, however b-badly.
et: Ma… Ma ei lase kaotusel end h-häirida, ükskõik kui r-ränk see on.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro
en: Let me show you a perfectly awful, horrifying time!
et: Las ma pakun sulle täiesti jubedat ja õudust täis elamust!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat
en: N-nooooo!
et: E-eiiii!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle
en: Your vitality is contagious! Get away from me quickly!
et: Su elujõud on nakkav! Kao ruttu minust eemale!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro
en: I may be past my prime, but I suggest you not patronize me.
et: Ma võin oma parimatest aastatest möödas olla, aga soovitan sul mind mitte alahinnata.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordDefeat
en: Ah, you overflow with the power of youth!
et: Ah, sa pakatad nooruse jõust!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle
en: It seems that I could not overcome your youthful energy.
et: Näib, et ma ei saanud su nooruslikust energiast jagu.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro
en: You're not getting through to the end! Not if I can help it!
et: Sa ei jõua lõpuni välja! Mitte siis, kui minust sõltub!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyDefeat
en: How could you be so ludicrously strong?
et: Kuidas sa saad nii naeruväärselt tugev olla?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: Humph! You may be strong, but you're not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!
et: Hmpf! Sa võid tugev olla, aga VAIMSE tüübi jaoks sa ei sobi!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle
en: The way you battle is somehow brutal!
et: Su võitlusviis on kuidagi jõhker!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro
en: Wroooar! Have a taste of my super POKéMON hard-battling power!
et: Vrooar! Maitse mu vägevat POKéMON-lahingujõudu!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat
en: Oh! Done in!
et: Oh! Ma sain lüüa!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle
en: All right! I think I'll develop a special invincible POKéMON power next.
et: Hea küll! Vist arendan järgmisena välja erilise võitmatu POKéMON-väe.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised?
et: TATE: Hehehe… Kas olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: LIZA: Fufufu… Were you surprised?
et: LIZA: Fufufu… Kas olid üllatunud?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS? LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
et: TATE: Et SAALI JUHTE on kaks? LIZA: Et SAALI JUHTE on kaks?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We're twins! LIZA: We're twins!
et: TATE: Me oleme kaksikud! LIZA: Me oleme kaksikud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: We don't need to talk because… LIZA: We can each determine what…
et: TATE: Meil pole vaja rääkida, sest… LIZA: Me mõlemad taipame, mida…

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: The other is thinking… LIZA: All in our minds!
et: TATE: teine mõtleb… LIZA: Kõik toimub meie mõtetes!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro
en: TATE: This combination of ours… LIZA: Can you beat it?
et: TATE: Meie koostööd… LIZA: kas suudad selle murda?

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: What?! Our combination… LIZA: Was shattered!
et: TATE: Mida?! Meie koostöö… LIZA: sai purustatud!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat
en: TATE: It can't be helped. You've won… LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
et: TATE: Pole midagi teha. Sa võitsid… LIZA: Nii et tunnustuseks võta see.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge
en: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE from TATE and LIZA.
et: {PLAYER} sai TATE ja LIZA käest märgi MIND BADGE.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.
et: TATE: MIND BADGE võimendab POKéMONide ER. RÜNNAKUT ja ER. KAITSET.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: LIZA: It also lets you use the HM move DIVE outside of battle.
et: LIZA: Lisaks saad HM-võtet DIVE kasutada ka väljaspool lahingut.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTakeThis
en: TATE: You should also take this, too.
et: TATE: Võta ka see!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: That TM04 contains… LIZA: CALM MIND!
et: TATE: See TM04 sisaldab… LIZA: võtet CALM MIND!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: It raises SP. ATK and… LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!
et: TATE: See tõstab ER. RÜNNAKUT ja… LIZA: See tõstab ER. KAITSET!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCalmMind
en: TATE: It's a move that's perfect… LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!
et: TATE: See on võte, mis sobib ideaalselt… LIZA: VAIMSE tüübi POKéMONidele!

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndLiza
en: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA in the POKéNAV.
et: SAALI JUHID TATE & LIZA registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBattle
en: TATE: Looks like the bond between you and your POKéMON is far stronger than the bond that we share as twins.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIntro
en: I keep coming back to this same place!

et: Mul on niigi raske, ja siis pead sina mind veel ära võitma? Pole aus!

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
en: I'm having a hard time deciding if I should make my SKITTY evolve or not.
et: Mul on raske otsustada, kas arendada oma SKITTY edasi või mitte.

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve

et: Mul on vaja vaid kasutada eset MOON STONE, aga otsustada on nii raske…

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
en: If I make it evolve, it will become much stronger.
et: Kui ma lasen tal areneda, muutub ta palju tugevamaks.

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEvolve
en: But it will look so different, too.
et: Aga ta näeb siis ka hoopis teistsugune välja.

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Miyao?
et: SKITTY: Mijao?

label: FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound
en: This NUGGET I found here… I suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing as how it has no other use.
et: See NUGGET, mille ma siit leidsin… Vist tuleb see maha müüa, muud kasu sellest niikuinii pole.

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon
en: People were saying they saw a POKéMON flying high above HOENN.
et: Inimesed rääkisid, et nägid POKéMONi kõrgel HOENNI kohal lendamas.

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHighFlyingPokemon

et: Kas ta lendab kogu aeg ringi? Kas tal pole vaja kuskil puhata?

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon
en: A sky POKéMON! A sky POKéMON!
et: Taeva-POKéMON! Taeva-POKéMON!

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_WhereDidYouComeFrom
en: Where did you come from?
et: Kust sina tulid?

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
en: Yes? YES TOWN?
et: Jah? JAH-LINN?

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown
en: I've never heard of a place like that.
et: Ma pole kunagi sellisest kohast kuulnud.

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
en: No? That doesn't make any sense. You have to come from somewhere.
et: Ei? Sel pole mingit mõtet. Kuskilt sa ju pead tulema.

label: PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToComeFromSomewhere
en: Oh! Wait! You're not going to say you were born at the bottom of the sea?
et: Oh! Oota! Sa ei kavatse ju öelda, et sündisid merepõhjas?

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreeting
en: When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER.
et: Kui ma noor olin, rändasin POKéMON TRAINERina mööda maailma.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreeting
en: Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.
et: Nüüd, kui olen vanaks kondiks jäänud, on mu ainus lõbu vaadata noori TRAINEReid võitlemas.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked

et: Uks näib olevat lukus.

et: Mul on külas TRAINER nimega {STR_VAR_1}.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisitingTrainer
en: Would you like to challenge {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas sooviksid {STR_VAR_1} vastu välja astuda?

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle
en: You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…
et: Sa ei võitlegi? Kahju, et ma ei saa sind võitlemas näha…

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
en: Oh, good, good!
et: Oo, tore, tore!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
en: But my house isn't all that sturdy.
et: Aga mu maja pole eriti vastupidav.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3
en: Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?
et: Kas ma tohiksin paluda, et peaksite 3 vastu 3 matši?

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgress
en: Before you two battle, you should save your progress.
et: Enne võitlust peaksite te mõlemad mängu salvestama.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoodMatch
en: I hope to see a good match!
et: Loodan näha head matši!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie
en: So, it became a standoff.
et: Nii, viigiks jäigi.

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie
en: It was a brilliant match in which neither side conceded a step!
et: See oli hiilgav matš, kus kumbki pool sammugi järele ei andnud!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon
en: That was superlative!
et: See oli suurepärane!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon
en: Why, it was like seeing myself in my youth again!
et: Ohoo, oli, nagu näeksin iseennast noorena!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost

et: Ah, kahju küll!

label: RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost

et: Aga see oli hea matš. Loodan, et järgmine kord võidad.

label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLivingOnIsland
en: There's a lot to be said for living on a small island like this in harmony with POKéMON and the family.
et: Elu sellisel väikesel saarel, POKéMONide ja perega kooskõlas — sel on omad võlud.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard
en: You get to be popular if you have strong POKéMON, right? So, I've been training hard.
et: Tugevate POKéMONidega saab ju populaarseks, eks? Nii et ma olen kõvasti treeninud.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: Yo, there! Your POKéMON doing okay?
et: Jou! Kas su POKéMONidel on kõik korras?

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass
en: If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, you should stay out of tall grass.
et: Kui su POKéMONid on nõrgad ja tahad lahinguid vältida, peaksid kõrgest rohust eemale hoidma.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: Sometimes, there are things on the ground even if you can't see them.
et: Vahel on maapinnal asju, isegi kui sa neid ei näe.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanation
en: That's why I always check where I'm walking.
et: Just seepärast vaatan ma alati, kuhu astun.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: Oh, neat! That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!
et: Oh, tore! See on MÄRK RUSTBORO SAALIST!

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem
en: You must be a TRAINER. You should try using this item.
et: Sa oled vist TRAINER. Proovi seda eset kasutada.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: It's a MIRACLE SEED. If a POKéMON holds that item, its GRASS-type moves become stronger.
et: See on MIRACLE SEED. Kui POKéMON hoiab seda eset, muutuvad ta ROHU-tüüpi võtted tugevamaks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanation
en: Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are other convenient items for POKéMON to hold.
et: Peale MIRACLE SEEDi on vist teisigi kasulikke esemeid, mida POKéMON kanda saab.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: Any POKéMON that appears even once in a battle is awarded EXP Points.
et: Iga POKéMON, kes lahingus kas või korraks välja tuleb, saab kogemuspunkte.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the left of the team list.
et: Nõrga POKéMONi kasvatamiseks pane ta nimekirjas kõige ette.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperience
en: As soon as a battle starts, switch it out. It will earn EXP Points without being exposed to any harm.
et: Niipea kui lahing algab, vaheta ta välja. Nii teenib ta kogemuspunkte, ilma et midagi juhtuks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: TRAINER TIPS
et: TRAINERI NÕUANDED

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON have Power Points (PP) that are used to make moves during battle.
et: Lisaks elupunktidele (HP) on POKéMONidel jõupunktid (PP), mida kulub lahingus võtete kasutamiseks.

label: PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP
en: If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
et: Kui POKéMONil saab PP otsa, tuleb ta POKéKESKUSESSE viia.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeRoomFinal_Text_CongratsThisWayPlease
en: Congratulations… Now, this way, please…
et: Palju õnne… Ja nüüd palun siiapoole…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_DoorIsClosed
en: The door is closed.
et: Uks on kinni.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry!
et: WALLACE: Oh, heldeke, mul on kohutavalt kahju!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: In my haste, I didn't notice that I'd left you behind!
et: Kiirustades ma ei märganudki, et su maha jätsin!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: I've opened the locked door of the SKY PILLAR.
et: Ma avasin SKY PILLARi lukustatud ukse.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPillar
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, asugem teele!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: WALLACE: It's an earthquake!
et: WALLACE: Maavärin!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMomentToWaste
en: There's not a moment to waste! We've got to hurry!
et: Pole hetkegi raisata! Me peame kiirustama!

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingWorse
en: WALLACE: Hmm… The situation is getting worse…
et: WALLACE: Hmm… Olukord läheb aina hullemaks…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: WALLACE: This isn't good…
et: WALLACE: Halvad lood…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: The weather distortion is spreading even here…
et: Ilmastikuhäire levib isegi siia…

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: RAYQUAZA should be farther up from here.
et: RAYQUAZA peaks olema siit kõrgemal.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: I'm worried about SOOTOPOLIS. I've got to go back.
et: Ma muretsen SOOTOPOLISE pärast. Ma pean tagasi minema.

label: SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSootopolis
en: Everything is in your hands now. Don't fail us!
et: Kõik on nüüd sinu kätes. Ära vea meid alt!

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: NORMAN became our town's new GYM LEADER.
et: NORMAN sai meie linna uueks SAALI JUHIKS.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGymLeader
en: I think he called his family over from somewhere far away.
et: Ma arvan, et ta kutsus oma pere kuskilt kaugelt siia.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, he was way too strong.
et: Ma võitlesin kord NORMANIGA — ohoo, ta oli lihtsalt liiga tugev.

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: How would I put it?
et: Kuidas seda nüüd öeldagi?

label: PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanOnce
en: I just got the feeling that he lives for POKéMON.
et: Mul lihtsalt tekkis tunne, et ta elab POKéMONide nimel.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WelcomeToDeptStore
en: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.
et: Tere tulemast kaubamajja LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBuyAllSortsOfThings
en: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT STORE, I always end up buying all sorts of things because it's so fun.
et: Iga kord, kui satun siia DEPARTMENT STORE kaubamajja, ostan igasugust kraami — siin on lihtsalt nii lõbus.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_MomBuyingMeFurniture
en: Today, my mom is going to buy me some nice furniture.
et: Täna ostab ema mulle ilusat mööblit.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_BuyingSomethingForAzumarill
en: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL as a reward for winning a CONTEST.
et: Ostan oma POKéMONile AZUMARILL midagi tasuks VÕISTLUSE võitmise eest.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Azumarill
en: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!
et: AZUMARILL: Maririroo!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER LOTTERY CORNER
et: 1. KORRUS: TEENINDUSLETT LOTERII NURK

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 2F: TRAINER'S ZONE
et: 2. KORRUS: TRAINERI TSOON

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 3F: BATTLE COLLECTION
et: 3. KORRUS: LAHINGUKOGU

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 4F: TM CORNER
et: 4. KORRUS: TM NURK

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: 5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR
et: 5. KORRUS: POKé NUKU KORRUS

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_FloorNamesSign
en: ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA
et: KATUS: KATUSEPLATS

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: Wireless Communication is a lot of fun, isn't it?
et: Juhtmevaba side on päris lõbus, eks?

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it lets you do things that weren't possible before.
et: Minu meelest saab sellega teha asju, mis varem polnud võimalikud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: For instance, you can now trade with people you couldn't before.
et: Näiteks saad nüüd kaubelda inimestega, kellega varem ei saanud.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_WirelessCommIsFun
en: I think it's going to be exciting!
et: Minu meelest tuleb sellest põnev!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_SpreadWordAboutWirelessComm
en: I want to spread the word about how fun Wireless Communication can be.
et: Tahan kõigile rääkida, kui lõbus juhtmevaba side olla võib.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… When I get engrossed in research, things end up this way…
et: Vabandust, et siin nii segamini on… Kui ma uurimistöösse süvenen, läheb alati nii…

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingClutteredKeepThis
en: This is embarrassing… Please keep this a secret in exchange for this.
et: Nii piinlik… Palun hoia seda saladuses — võta see vastutasuks.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: May I offer advice about my POKéMON Storage System?
et: Kas tohin anda nõu oma POKéMONide hoiusüsteemi kohta?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYourBoxes
en: You should organize your BOXES so you can tell which POKéMON are in them.
et: Korralda oma BOXid nii, et näeksid, millised POKéMONid neis on.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: It's LANETTE's research notes. There's information about BOXES.
et: Need on LANETTE uurimismärkmed. Siin on juttu BOXidest.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.
et: Kujundada BOXid nii, et igasse mahub 30 POKéMONi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Each TRAINER should be able to store 420 POKéMON on the PC system.
et: Iga TRAINER peaks saama arvutisüsteemi hoiule panna 420 POKéMONi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage1
en: Keep reading?
et: Loed edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: A marking system should be added to make POKéMON easier to organize.
et: Tuleks lisada tähistussüsteem, et POKéMONe oleks lihtsam korrastada.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: The name and wallpaper design of each BOX will be made changeable to please the stored POKéMON.
et: Iga BOXi nimi ja tapeet tuleb teha muudetavaks, et see hoiul olevatele POKéMONidele meeldiks.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage2
en: Keep reading?
et: Loed edasi?

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: When storing a POKéMON, it should be sent to the BOX inspected last.
et: POKéMONi hoiule pannes tuleks ta saata viimati vaadatud BOXi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: If that BOX is full, the received POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.
et: Kui see BOX on täis, läheb saadud POKéMON järgmisse BOXi.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNotesPage3
en: In other words, when a BOX is examined, it is automatically selected as the BOX to which POKéMON are sent.
et: Teisisõnu: kui mõnda BOXi vaadata, valitakse see kohe BOXiks, kuhu POKéMONid saadetakse.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ClosedTheNotebook
en: {PLAYER} closed the notebook.
et: {PLAYER} pani märkmiku kinni.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: There's an e-mail from someone on the PC.
et: ARVUTIS on kelleltki e-kiri.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Your Storage System offers more convenience than mine.
et: „Sinu hoiusüsteem on palju mugavam kui minu oma.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It has a lot of user-friendly features that make it fun and useful, too.
et: „Sellel on hulk kasutajasõbralikke lahendusi, mis teevad selle ühtaegu lõbusaks ja kasulikuks.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “It makes me proud that I played a part in its development.
et: „Olen uhke, et sain selle arendamisele kaasa aidata.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “Here's hoping that you'll continue research in Storage Systems.
et: „Loodan, et jätkad hoiusüsteemide uurimist.

label: Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBill
en: “From BILL … … … … … … … …”
et: „Saatja: BILL … … … … … … … …”

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToFindBases
en: My little brother says he likes to go find people's SECRET BASES.
et: Mu väike vend ütleb, et talle meeldib inimeste SALABAASE üles otsida.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToVisitBasesAndBattle
en: My little brother says he likes to visit people's SECRET BASES and have POKéMON battles.
et: Mu väike vend ütleb, et talle meeldib inimeste SALABAASE külastada ja seal POKéMON-lahinguid pidada.

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBaseNearX
en: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas see olid sina, kes tegi SALABAASI {STR_VAR_1} lähedale?

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase
en: You should make a SECRET BASE somewhere. I'll go find it!
et: Tee kuhugi ka endale SALABAAS. Küll ma selle üles leian!

label: MossdeepCity_House4_Text_Skitty
en: SKITTY: Miyaan?
et: SKITTY: Miyaan?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Want a tasty little bit of advice for CONTESTS?
et: Tahad üht maitsvat nõuannet VÕISTLUSTE kohta?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Using a certain move after another certain kind of move sometimes gets you extra attention.
et: Kui kasutada üht võtet kohe teatud kindla võtte järel, tõmbab see vahel lisatähelepanu.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: If you know what you're doing, you can score big in appeal.
et: Kui tead, mida teed, võid säraga korralikult punkte lõigata.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_AdviceForContests
en: Of course, your opponents might try disrupting your POKéMON's showing.
et: Muidugi võivad vastased üritada su POKéMONi esitust segada.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: My papa, he's a CONTEST JUDGE.
et: Mu papa on VÕISTLUSE KOHTUNIK.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyPapaIsContestJudge
en: I wonder what I should be when I grow up, a JUDGE or a GYM LEADER?
et: Huvitav, kelleks ma suureks saades hakkan — KOHTUNIKUKS või SAALI JUHIKS?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, man, I'm like majorly cheesed, you know. Like, you know, I just wanted to know why my POKéMON never won, you know, like, hey?
et: Kuule, mees, ma olen nagu täitsa vihane, tead. Nagu, tead, ma tahtsin lihtsalt teada, miks mu POKéMON kunagi ei võida, tead, nagu, kuule?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: So, like, I gave the JUDGE my two cents, you know, they're free.
et: Nii et ma ütlesin KOHTUNIKULE oma arvamuse välja, nagu, tead, see on tasuta.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! So, like, total bummer, man!
et: Ja tema ei kuulanud mind äragi, nagu, kuule! Täielik jama, mees!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ImLikeMajorlyCheesed
en: Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? Just, you know, take this!
et: Kuule, sina seal! Pea suu, tead? Lihtsalt, nagu, võta see!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: That's, like, TM41, you know? Hey, it's TORMENT, you hearing me?
et: See on, nagu, TM41, tead? Kuule, see on TORMENT, kuuled sa?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Like, it won't let the other guy use the same move twice in a row, see?
et: Nagu, see ei lase teisel tüübil sama võtet kaks korda järjest kasutada, näed?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ExplainTorment
en: Hey, now, you listen here, like, I'm not laying a torment on you!
et: Kuule nüüd, sa kuula siia, nagu, ma ei pane sulle mingit piina peale!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: MC: Oh, my, my! Now isn't that a dandy of a POKéMON?
et: MC: Oh, heldeke! Kas pole see alles tore POKéMON?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: Please! Do step right up and take part in our splendid CONTESTS!
et: Palun, astu aga ligi ja võta osa meie suurepärastest VÕISTLUSTEST!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MCStepUpTakePartInContest
en: You'll do well! I'm sure of it! My eyes have never failed me!
et: Sul läheb hästi! Ma olen selles kindel! Mu silmad pole mind kunagi alt vedanud!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: JUDGE: Well, hello there! I see that you're a TRAINER!
et: KOHTUNIK: Ohoo, tervist! Sa oled ju TRAINER!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Then, it just wouldn't do for you to miss a POKéMON CONTEST!
et: Siis ei tohiks sa POKéMON VÕISTLUSEST kindlasti ilma jääda!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWouldntDoToMissContest
en: Get a CONTEST PASS in VERDANTURF CITY and enter anytime!
et: Hangi VERDANTURF LINNAST CONTEST PASS ja tule võistlema, millal tahad!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_ItsAppealTime
en: It's appeal time! What should I lead with?
et: Sära aeg käes! Millega ma küll alustan?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: They didn't pay much attention to my POKéMON's appeal…
et: Nad ei pööranud mu POKéMONi särale eriti tähelepanu…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_DidntPayAttentionToAppeal
en: Humph, that JUDGE, he doesn't know a good thing when he sees it.
et: Hmpf, see KOHTUNIK ei tunne head asja ära, kui see tal nina all on.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Oh, hi! You must be a serious fan to get this close to the action.
et: Oo, tere! Sa oled vist tõsine fänn, kui nii tegevusele lähedale trügid.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: I'll reward your enthusiasm with this sage advice.
et: Su innukuse eest annan sulle ühe targa nõu.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: If a move goes over really well, the audience will get excited.
et: Kui võte tõesti hästi peale läheb, läheb publik elevile.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: The POKéMON that makes its appeal right when everyone's excited…
et: POKéMON, kes esitab oma sära just siis, kui kõik on elevil…

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_RewardWithSageAdvice
en: Well, you'd think something good has to happen!
et: Noh, siis peakski ju midagi head juhtuma!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I can't do this! I'm more freaked out than my POKéMON.
et: Ma ei suuda! Mul on rohkem hirm kui mu POKéMONil.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MoreFreakedOutThanMon
en: I'm shivering and my heart is racing!
et: Ma värisen ja mu süda peksleb!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: A battle and a CONTEST aren't the same, but they are alike, too.
et: Lahing ja VÕISTLUS pole sama asi, aga sarnast on neis palju.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_BattleAndContestAlike
en: You need to work hard and believe in the POKéMON you've raised.
et: Sa pead kõvasti pingutama ja uskuma POKéMONidesse, keda oled kasvatanud.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: That POKéMON looks like it's on top of its game, huh?
et: See POKéMON on täiesti hoos, mis?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MonLooksOnTopOfGame
en: A POKéMON that does good in the secondary judging seems to be more relaxed when it's doing appeals.
et: POKéMON, kes teises hindamisvoorus hästi läbi lööb, tundub särades palju rahulikum.

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Will you look at that sorry sight?
et: Vaata ometi, milline hale vaatepilt!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonBetterThanThatLot
en: Heh, my POKéMON's absolutely better than that lot!
et: Heh, mu POKéMON on kindlasti sellest kambast parem!

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_GetUrgeToMoveWithMon
en: Don't you get the urge to move with POKéMON if they're putting on an energetic appeal?
et: Kas sul ei tule tahtmist POKéMONidega kaasa liikuda, kui nad nii hoogsalt säravad?

label: SlateportCity_ContestHall_Text_HyperRankStage
en: POKéMON CONTESTS HYPER RANK STAGE!
et: POKéMON KONKURSSIDE HYPER RANGI LAVA!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound1
en: Your 1st-round match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su 1. vooru matš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForRound2
en: Your 2nd-round match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su 2. vooru matš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSemifinals
en: Your semifinal match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su poolfinaalmatš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForFinals
en: Your final match is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmisena su finaalmatš. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ChooseTwoMons
en: Please choose the two POKéMON that are to appear in battle.
et: Palun vali kaks POKéMONi, kes lahingusse lähevad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RightThisWay
en: Right this way, please.
et: Palun siiapoole.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
en: Thank you for competing!
et: Aitäh võistlemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth

et: Teen su POKéMONid täiesti terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_Round1Complete

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2
en: Congratulations for getting through the 1st round.
et: Palju õnne, sa said 1. voorust läbi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForRound2
en: The 2nd round is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmine on 2. voor. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals
en: Congratulations for advancing to the semifinals.
et: Palju õnne, sa jõudsid poolfinaali!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForSemifinals
en: The best four teams meet in this round. Are you ready?
et: Selles voorus kohtuvad neli parimat meeskonda. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: Congratulations for advancing to the final match.
et: Palju õnne, sa jõudsid finaali!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_CongratsReadyForFinals
en: You're one win from the championship. Are you ready?
et: Sa oled meistritiitlist ühe võidu kaugusel. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_PlayersNextOpponentIsTrainer
en: {PLAYER}'s next opponent is this TRAINER.
et: {PLAYER} järgmine vastane on see TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound1
en: The tournament is in the 1st round.
et: Turniir on 1. voorus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInRound2
en: The tournament is in the 2nd round.
et: Turniir on 2. voorus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInSemifinals
en: The tournament is in the semifinals.
et: Turniir on poolfinaalis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_TourneyInFinals
en: The tournament is up to the final.
et: Turniir on jõudnud finaali.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja sulgeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RetireYourChallenge
en: Would you like to retire from your Battle Tournament challenge?
et: Kas soovid oma Battle Tournament väljakutsest loobuda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_SavingDataPleaseWait
en: I am saving your data. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan su andmeid. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Should I record your last match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas panen su viimase matši FRONTIER PASSile kirja?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver

et: Palju õnne, sa jõudsid finaali!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver
en: For the final match, you will challenge the DOME ACE TUCKER.
et: Finaalmatšis on su vastaseks DOME ACE TUCKER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilver
en: Are you ready?
et: Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold
en: Congratulations for advancing to the final match.
et: Palju õnne, sa jõudsid finaali!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold
en: For the final match, you will challenge the DOME ACE TUCKER.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGold

et: Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerSilverShort
en: Your final battle against TUCKER is next. Are you ready?
