label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomePreBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForTuckerGoldShort
en: Your final battle against TUCKER is next. Are you ready?
et: Järgmine on su finaallahing TUCKERI vastu. Kas oled valmis?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, hello. You are?
et: Oh, tere. Ja sina oled…?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}. I can see that you're a TRAINER.
et: Selge, su nimi on {PLAYER}{KUN}. Näen, et sa oled TRAINER.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: So that means you use the POKéMON Storage System I developed.
et: See tähendab, et kasutad POKéMONide hoiusüsteemi, mille mina välja töötasin.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: How I arrived at that conclusion is a simple deductive process.
et: Kuidas ma selleni jõudsin? Lihtne loogiline järeldus.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: You spoke to me because you wanted to access something on this PC.
et: Sa tulid minuga rääkima, sest tahtsid selles ARVUTIS millelegi ligi pääseda.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.
et: Oh, vabandust. Ma olen LANETTE.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's great you're using the Storage System.
et: Ausalt öeldes on mul hea meel sinuga kohtuda — tore, et hoiusüsteemi kasutad.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LanetteGreeting
en: If you could, please visit me at home. My house is on ROUTE 114.
et: Kui saad, tule mulle koju külla. Mu maja on ROUTE 114 peal.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: I wonder what POKéMON looked like long, long ago?
et: Huvitav, millised POKéMONid ammu-ammu aega tagasi välja nägid?

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FossilManiacEdgeOfTown
en: Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge of town will know.
et: Võib-olla teab seda FOSSIL MANIAC linna servas.

label: FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlantHardyTrees
en: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant seedlings of hardy trees that thrive even in volcanic ash.
et: FALLARBORI põldudel istutame vastupidavate puude taimi, mis kasvavad isegi vulkaanituhas.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and ANTIDOTES.
et: Ostan endale paar eset: PARLYZ HEAL ja ANTIDOTE.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCaseOfShroomish
en: Just in case I run into SHROOMISH in PETALBURG WOODS.
et: Igaks juhuks, kui satun PETALBURG WOODSis SHROOMISHi otsa.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: My POKéMON evolved. It has a lot of HP now.
et: Mu POKéMON arenes. Tal on nüüd palju HP.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPotionsInstead
en: I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it instead of ordinary POTIONS.
et: Peaksin talle tavaliste POTIONite asemel ostma SUPER POTIONeid.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in case I get lost in a cave.
et: Võtan kaasa ESCAPE ROPE, juhuks kui koopas ära eksin.

label: RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRopeJustInCase
en: I just need to use it to get back to the entrance.
et: Kasutan seda lihtsalt ära ja olengi sissepääsu juures tagasi.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: This is a perfect place to go exploring! It's exciting here!
et: See on ideaalne koht uurimiseks! Siin on nii põnev!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPlaceToGoExploring
en: I bet there're amazing treasures on board.
et: Vean kihla, et pardal on vingeid aardeid.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before.
et: See POKéMON võitis siin varem ILU VÕISTLUSE.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!
et: Ja tead mis? Täna panin ta TARGA VÕISTLUSE võitma!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSmartnessContest
en: My abilities scare even me…
et: Mu võimed hirmutavad isegi mind…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work.
et: Olen mitmel VÕISTLUSEL käinud, nii et hakkan taipama, kuidas asjad käivad.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals.
et: LAHEDAL VÕISTLUSEL lähevad etendusena peale lahedad võtted.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBunchOfContests
en: But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.
et: Aga nutikad ja nunnud võtted seal näiteks ei lähe peale.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Sel noormehel, kes varem võitis, oli terve hunnik eri {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonEarlierHadPokeblocks
en: Can you win if you had that many of those things?
et: Kas võit tulebki siis, kui neid asju nii palju on?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!
et: Ohoo, milline hiiglaslik koht!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPlaceHumongous
en: The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.
et: See pinge õhus… Päris teine asi kui mõni kolka VÕISTLUSSAAL.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their TRAINERS, are you ready?!
et: MC: Nii, NUTIKAD POKéMONid ja nende TRAINERid, kas olete valmis?!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBestSmartAppeal
en: Give it your best showing! Let's appeal!
et: Anna endast parim! Etendame!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?
et: KOHTUNIK: Kas naudid seda VÕISTLUST?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjoyingThisContest
en: Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!
et: Tule tagasi kolme sõbraga ja te kõik võite VÕISTLUSELE astuda!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST.
et: Ai-jai-jai-jai… Ma sattusin valele VÕISTLUSELE.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST…
et: Panin selle kõva POKéMONi TARGALE VÕISTLUSELE…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWrongContest
en: Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.
et: Anna tulla, hämmasta neid nutika ROCK SMASHiga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart.
et: Olen aastaid ja kogu oma tarkust kulutanud, et kasvatada see POKéMON nutikaks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON.
et: Teda ei alista kergesti mõne noore jõnglase POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonToBeSmart
en: My dear wife, are you seeing this?
et: Mu kallis naine, kas sa näed seda?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: There it is!
et: Sealt see tuleb!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPullsSmartMoveNext
en: If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!
et: Kui mu POKéMON teeb järgmisena nutika võtte, jõuab publiku elevus haripunkti!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: Oh, dear, no!
et: Oh, heldeke, ei!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over!
et: Mu armsa ZUBATI LEECH LIFE on nii nunnu, et ma kasutasin seda ikka ja jälle!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontAppreciateCuteLeechLife
en: But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!
et: Aga need õelad inimesed ei oska seda üldse hinnata!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_YoureBeautifulGrandpa
en: Kiyaaah! You're beautiful, Grandpa!
et: Kijaaah! Sa oled kaunis, vanaisa!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals.
et: Isegi kui TRAINERid toovad välja sama liiki POKéMONi, kasutavad nad etendusteks kõik eri võtteid.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToUseDifferentMoves
en: It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.
et: Täpselt nagu lahingutes — igaühel oma stiil.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSmarterThanTrainers
en: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.
et: Minu meelest näevad POKéMONid nutikamad välja kui nende TRAINERid. Tunduvalt.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS.
et: Mis seal ikka — TARGAD VÕISTLUSED on ja jäävad mu lemmikuks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveSmartnessContests
en: That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.
et: See intellektuaalne roheline värv… See on nii… Nii… Lahe.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnteringBeautyContest
en: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!
et: MC: Kas sinagi astud ILU VÕISTLUSELE? Edu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty!
et: KOHTUNIK: Ah, iga POKéMON siin on laitmatu ilu eeskuju!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokemonPristineBeauty
en: Why, I almost forgot to score them!
et: Ohoo, ma peaaegu unustasin neid hinnata!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it.
et: Nii kaunis POKéMON… Teist sellist lihtsalt pole.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBeGluedToMyBeauty
en: Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.
et: Kõigi pilgud jäävad mu ilu külge kinni.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: Waaaah!
et: Ojoooo!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: I brushed and groomed my POKéMON carefully for this CONTEST…
et: Ma harjasin ja sugesin oma POKéMONi selle VÕISTLUSE jaoks hoolega…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: But I overdid it… My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…
et: Aga ma pingutasin üle… Mu POKéMONi karv läks üleni sassi…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGrooming
en: What should I do?
et: Mida ma nüüd teen?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it.
et: See AURORA BEAM on nii pimestav, et KOHTUNIK ei suuda seda näha.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontSeeAuroraBeam
en: Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!
et: Oi, oota korra… Siis pole sellest ju mingit kasu!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger.
et: See kaunis POKéMON näeb välja täpselt nagu mina nooruses.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking.
et: Kui ma seda ütlesin, pritsis mu mees suutäie kohvi välja.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLooksLikeYoungerMe
en: Did I say something funny?
et: Kas ma ütlesin midagi naljakat?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyContestMakesMeHappy
en: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.
et: Tead, kui ma ILU VÕISTLUSE võidan, teeb see mind muidugi rõõmsaks. Rohkem kui tavaliselt igatahes.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Wahahahah!
et: Vahahahaa!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAllThosePrettyPokemon
en: Will you take a gander at all those pretty POKéMON! I just love this sort of glitz!
et: Vaata ometi neid kauneid POKéMONe! Mulle lihtsalt meeldib selline sära!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You can't always win on just beauty alone.
et: Ainuüksi iluga alati ei võida.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnBeautyAlone
en: You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.
et: Pead oma POKéMONi sugema, kuni ta on kena ja läikiv nagu minu oma.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: MC: Uh-oh! Hello! We're in the middle of a CONTEST!
et: MC: Oih! Tere! Meil on VÕISTLUS parajasti käimas!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddleOfContest
en: Please enter at our registration counter and come out, okay?
et: Registreeru palun meie letis ja tule siis siia lavale, eks?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals!
et: KOHTUNIK: Oi, millised võluvad ja nunnud etendused!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmingCuteAppeals
en: Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!
et: Oh, heldeke! Milline täiuslikult armas WATER SPORT etendus!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillWasDistracted
en: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was distracted by another POKéMON.
et: Oh ei… Mu armsa AZURILLI tähelepanu juhtis teine POKéMON kõrvale.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBattleButContest
en: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, but put it in a CONTEST and look out!
et: Mu POKéMON pole kunagi lahingus võitnud, aga pane ta VÕISTLUSELE ja siis hoia alt!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance.
et: Mu POKéMONi PETAL DANCE on puhas elegants.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDanceIsMarvel
en: I won't let anyone disturb its performance.
et: Ma ei lase kellelgi tema etendust rikkuda.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.
et: Kõigi POKéMONid on väga nunnud.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: However, if my POKéMON were to make a cute appeal…
et: Kuid kui mu POKéMON teeks nunnu etenduse…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppealSoMuchCuter
en: I'm sure that it would be so much cuter than the others.
et: Olen kindel, et ta oleks teistest palju nunnum.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsInContest
en: My child is in this CONTEST.
et: Mu laps on sellel VÕISTLUSEL.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear
en: Come on, dear. Go for it! Your POKéMON is the best!
et: Läheb lahti, kullake. Anna minna! Su POKéMON on kõige parem!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
en: I think that girl over there is the cutest of the lot.
et: Minu meelest on see tüdruk seal kõige nunnum.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlThereIsCutest
en: What's that? They're judging POKéMON by their looks?
et: Mis? Siin hinnataksegi POKéMONide välimust?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
en: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, they make we want to get my own!
et: Ohh, kõiki neid nunnusid POKéMONe nähes tahan ma endale ka ühe saada!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMonOfMyOwn
en: I'm going to go catch some!
et: Lähen ja püüan endale mõne!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyContestStage
en: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!
et: BEAUTY VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END LUMMATA KAUNITEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContestStage
en: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!
et: CUTENESS VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END VÕLUDA NUNNUDEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartContestStage
en: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!
et: SMARTNESS VÕISTLUSE LAVA — LASE END MULJETADA NUTIKATEST POKéMONIDEST!

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
en: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.
et: Karbile on trükitud POKéMONi logo.

label: InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo
en: It's a POKéMON brand moving and delivery service.
et: See on POKéMONi kaubamärgiga kolimis- ja veoteenus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom1
en: You are currently in the 1st room…
et: Sa oled praegu 1. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom3
en: You are currently in the 3rd room…
et: Sa oled praegu 3. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom5
en: You are currently in the 5th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 5. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom7
en: You are currently in the 7th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 7. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom9
en: You are currently in the 9th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 9. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom11
en: You are currently in the 11th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 11. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_CurrentlyInRoom13
en: You are currently in the 13th room…
et: Sa oled praegu 13. ruumis…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_ContinueWithChallenge
en: Will you continue with your challenge?
et: Kas jätkad oma väljakutset?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SaveChallengeAndQuit
en: Would you like to save your challenge and quit the game for now?
et: Kas soovid oma väljakutse salvestada ja mängu esialgu sulgeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_RetireFromChallenge
en: Do you wish to retire from your Battle Choice challenge?
et: Kas soovid loobuda oma Battle Choice väljakutsest?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AwaitingReturnSaveBeforeResume
en: We've been awaiting your return…
et: Oleme sind tagasi oodanud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AwaitingReturnSaveBeforeResume
en: Before resuming your Battle Choice challenge, let me save the game…
et: Enne kui Battle Choice väljakutsega jätkad, luba mul mäng salvestada…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PleaseEnjoyChallenge
en: Please do enjoy your Battle Choice challenge…
et: Palun naudi oma Battle Choice väljakutset…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SavingYourData
en: I am saving your data… A little time, please…
et: Ma salvestan su andmeid… Pisut kannatust, palun…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePike_Text_PathBlockedNoTurningBack
en: The path is blocked! And there is no turning back…
et: Tee on suletud! Ja tagasiteed pole…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_FindingItDifficultToChoose
en: I beg your pardon, but…
et: Palun vabandust, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_FindingItDifficultToChoose
en: Are you perhaps finding it difficult to choose your path?
et: Kas sul on ehk raske teed valida?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_ApologizeForImpertinence
en: I see… I apologize for my impertinence…
et: Selge… Vabandan oma jultumust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutRightPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path on the right…
et: Ah, las ma vaatan… Parempoolse teega on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutCenterPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path in the center…
et: Ah, las ma vaatan… Keskmise teega on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_SomethingAboutLeftPath
en: Ah, let me see… There is something about the path on the left…
et: Ah, las ma vaatan… Vasakpoolse teega on midagi…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_AromaOfPokemon
en: It seems to have the distinct aroma of POKéMON wafting around it…
et: Selle kohal hõljub selgelt POKéMONide lõhn…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_PresenceOfPeople
en: Is it… A TRAINER? I sense the presence of people…
et: Kas see on… TRAINER? Ma tajun inimeste kohalolu…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_HeardWhispering
en: I seem to have heard something… It may have been whispering…
et: Ma justkui kuulsin midagi… See võis olla sosin…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_WaveOfNostaliga
en: For some odd reason, I felt a wave of nostalgia coming from it…
et: Millegipärast tuli sealt imelik nostalgialaine…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: I am sorry to say…
et: Mul on kahju öelda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: A terrifying event, yes, a horrible one, is about to befall you…
et: Sind on tabamas õudne, jah, lausa kohutav sündmus…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_TerrifyingEvent
en: I urge you to pay the utmost care and prepare for the worst…
et: Palun ole ülimalt ettevaatlik ja valmistu halvimaks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeThreePathRoom_Text_DreadfulPresence
en: From every path I sense a dreadful presence…
et: Igalt teelt tajun ma õudset kohalolu…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_BlackboardListsStatusChanges
en: The blackboard lists status changes that may affect POKéMON in battle.
et: Tahvlile on kirjutatud olekumuutused, mis võivad POKéMONe lahingus tabada.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhichTopic
en: Which topic do you want to read?
et: Millist teemat tahad lugeda?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will steadily lose HP.
et: Kui POKéMON on mürgitatud, kaotab ta pidevalt HP.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: The effects of poison remain after a battle.
et: Mürgi mõju püsib pärast lahingut.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: A poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop while it is traveling.
et: Mürgitatud POKéMONi HP langeb, kui ta ringi rändab.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainPoison
en: Heal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.
et: Mürgitust ravib ANTIDOTE.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed, its SPEED drops.
et: Kui POKéMON halvatakse, langeb ta KIIRUS.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: It may also not be able to move while it is in battle.
et: Vahel ei saa ta lahingus üldse liikuda.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainParalysis
en: Paralysis remains after battle. Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.
et: Halvatus püsib ka pärast lahingut. Ravi see PARLYZ HEALiga.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be unable to attack.
et: Kui POKéMON uinub, ei suuda ta rünnata.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: A POKéMON may wake up on its own, but if a battle ends while it is sleeping, it will stay asleep.
et: POKéMON võib ka ise ärgata, aga kui lahing lõpeb tema magades, jääbki ta magama.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainSleep
en: Wake it up using an AWAKENING.
et: Ärata ta üles esemega AWAKENING.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
en: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it steadily reduces the victim's HP.
et: Põletus vähendab RÜNNAKU jõudu ja närib pidevalt ohvri HP.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainBurn
en: A burn lingers after battle. Cure a burn using a BURN HEAL.
et: Põletus püsib ka pärast lahingut. Ravi seda BURN HEALiga.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
en: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes completely helpless.
et: Kui POKéMON on külmunud, muutub ta täiesti abituks.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainFreeze
en: It will remain frozen after battle. Thaw it out using an ICE HEAL.
et: Ta jääb ka pärast lahingut külmunuks. Sulata ta üles ICE HEALiga.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
en: Students who don't study get a little taste of my QUICK CLAW.
et: Õpilased, kes ei õpi, saavad minu QUICK CLAW maiku tunda.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
en: Whether or not you are a good student will be evident from the way you use this item.
et: Kuidas sa seda eset kasutad, sellest paistabki, kas oled hea õpilane.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will occasionally speed up and get to move before its opponent.
et: POKéMON, kelle käes on QUICK CLAW, saab vahel hoo sisse ja liigub vastasest ette.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: There are many other items that are meant to be held by POKéMON.
et: Selliseid esemeid, mida POKéMONid kanda saavad, on veel palju.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
en: Just those alone will give you many topics to study!
et: Juba ainuüksi neist jagub sulle õppimist küllaga!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingRightNow
en: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend right now.
et: Ma vahetan praegu oma sõbraga POKéMONe.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWantedSeedot
en: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and I'm finally getting one!
et: Olen alati tahtnud SEEDOTi ja lõpuks ma saangi selle!

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemontCantUseManMadeItems
en: POKéMON can hold items, but they don't know what to do with man-made items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
et: POKéMONid saavad esemeid kanda, aga nad ei tea, mida peale hakata inimeste tehtud asjadega nagu POTION ja ANTIDOTE.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: You know how some POKéMON moves can confuse a POKéMON?
et: Tead ju, et mõned võtted ajavad POKéMONi segadusse?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: A confused POKéMON will sometimes attack itself without meaning to.
et: Segaduses POKéMON võib vahel iseennast tahtmatult rünnata.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ConfusedPokemonAttacksItself
en: But once it leaves battle, it will return to normal.
et: Aga kui lahing läbi saab, läheb ta jälle korda.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal itself…
et: POKéMON, kelle käes on mari, ravib end ise…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: There are many kinds of items that POKéMON can hold…
et: Esemeid, mida POKéMON kanda saab, on igasuguseid…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonHealItselfWithBerry
en: Boy, it sure is hard taking notes down…
et: Ohh, märkmete tegemine on ikka raske küll…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: It's this student's notebook…
et: See on selle õpilase märkmik…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: POKéMON are to be caught using POKé BALLS.
et: POKéMONe püütakse POKé PALLIDEGA.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: Up to six POKéMON can accompany a TRAINER.
et: TRAINERIL võib kaasas olla kuni kuus POKéMONi.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: A TRAINER is someone who catches POKéMON, raises them, and battles with them.
et: TRAINER on see, kes püüab POKéMONe, kasvatab neid ja võitleb nendega.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsNotes
en: A TRAINER's mission is to defeat the strong TRAINERS who await challengers in POKéMON GYMS.
et: TRAINERI ülesanne on alistada tugevad TRAINERID, kes ootavad väljakutsujaid POKéMON SAALIDES.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: Hello? Didn't we meet before? I think back in PETALBURG CITY.
et: Tere! Kas me pole varem kohtunud? Vist seal PETALBURG LINNAS.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: Let me introduce myself. My name's SCOTT.
et: Las ma tutvustan end. Mu nimi on SCOTT.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding TRAINERS.
et: Ma rändan mööda maailma ringi ja otsin silmapaistvaid TRAINEREID.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: More specifically, I'm looking for POKéMON battle experts.
et: Täpsemalt otsin POKéMON-lahingute asjatundjaid.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: So, what brings you to this SCHOOL? Are you a TRAINER, too?
et: Aga mis sind siia KOOLI toob? Kas sinagi oled TRAINER?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: The first thing you should do is to have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.
et: Kõigepealt õpeta mõnele oma POKéMONile CUT selgeks.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyCut
en: If I remember correctly, someone in this town has CUT.
et: Kui õigesti mäletan, on CUT kellelgi siin linnas olemas.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
en: SCOTT: Hmm…
et: SCOTT: Hmm…

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentTalentLevelUnknown
en: The talent levels of the students here are unknown. The potential's there.
et: Siinsete õpilaste tase on veel teadmata. Aga potentsiaali on.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
en: SCOTT: Oh, what's that?
et: SCOTT: Oh, mis see on?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
en: It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it? That's pretty impressive, I'd say.
et: See on ju STONE BADGE, eks? Päris muljetavaldav, ütleksin ma.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
en: But, you know, I would've loved to see you in battle.
et: Aga, tead, ma oleksin sind hea meelega lahingus näinud.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottStoneBadge
en: It's hard to tell what you're like as a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
et: LIIGA MÄRGI järgi on raske öelda, milline TRAINER sa oled.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: Hello? Didn't we meet before? I think back in PETALBURG CITY.
et: Tere! Kas me pole varem kohtunud? Vist seal PETALBURG LINNAS.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: Let me introduce myself. My name's SCOTT.
et: Las ma tutvustan end. Mu nimi on SCOTT.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: I've been traveling everywhere in search of outstanding TRAINERS.
et: Ma rändan mööda maailma ringi ja otsin silmapaistvaid TRAINEREID.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: More specifically, I'm looking for POKéMON battle experts.
et: Täpsemalt otsin POKéMON-lahingute asjatundjaid.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: Oh, what's that? It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
et: Oh, mis see on? See on ju STONE BADGE, eks?

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: That's pretty impressive, I'd say, for a starting TRAINER like yourself.
et: Sinusuguse algaja TRAINERI kohta päris muljetavaldav, ütleksin ma.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: But, you know, I would've loved to see you in battle.
et: Aga, tead, ma oleksin sind hea meelega lahingus näinud.

label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMetAlreadyStoneBadge
en: It's hard to tell what you're like as a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
et: LIIGA MÄRGI järgi on raske öelda, milline TRAINER sa oled.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
en: Howdy! When it comes to news about the BATTLE FRONTIER, I'm no. 1.
et: Tervist! BATTLE FRONTIERi uudiste asjus olen ma number üks!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
en: You can think of me as the FRONTIER MANIAC.
et: Võid mind julgelt kutsuda nimega FRONTIER MANIAC.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
en: Just checking, but you are a TRAINER, isn't that right?
et: Igaks juhuks küsin: sa oled ju TRAINER, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FrontierManiacIntro
en: I'll happily share the hottest news I gathered about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Ma jagan hea meelega kõige kuumemaid uudiseid, mis BATTLE FRONTIERi kohta kogusin.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SwingByForTheLatestWord
en: Howdy! Did you swing by to grill me about the latest word? Oh, all right!
et: Tervist! Kas põikasid sisse, et mind viimaste uudiste pärast pinnida? Oh, hüva!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight
en: Well? Well? Well?
et: Noh? Noh? Noh?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MyInformationsBeenUsefulRight
en: I'm sure my information's been seriously useful to you, right?
et: Küllap mu info oli sulle kõvasti kasuks, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest
en: Let's see now…
et: Vaatame nüüd…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FacilityIsHottest
en: It sounds like the {STR_VAR_1} is the hottest place going.
et: Tundub, et {STR_VAR_1} on kõige kuumem paik.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest
en: Let's see now…
et: Vaatame nüüd…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest
en: It sounds like BATTLE TOWER {STR_VAR_1} is the hottest.
et: Tundub, et BATTLE TOWER {STR_VAR_1} on kõige kuumem.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenIsThere
en: It's this mysterious TRAINER called the SALON MAIDEN that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib salapärane TRAINER nimega SALON MAIDEN.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
en: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN?
et: Kas oled SALON MAIDENIGA võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
en: When she's measuring up her opponent, she apparently uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta vastast kaalub, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenSilverMons
en: A PSYCHIC-type PSI POKéMON, a FIRE-type VOLCANO POKéMON, and a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.
et: VAIMSE-tüüpi PSI POKéMON, TULE-tüüpi VOLCANO POKéMON ja TAVA-tüüpi SLEEPING POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons
en: Have you battled the SALON MAIDEN when she's serious?
et: Kas oled SALON MAIDENIGA võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons
en: When she's battling flat out, she apparently uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta täie hooga võitleb, kasutab ta ilmselt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_SalonMaidenGoldMons
en: A DRAGON & PSYCHIC EON POKéMON, an ELECTRIC-type THUNDER POKéMON, and a NORMAL-type SLEEPING POKéMON.
et: DRAAKONI- ja VAIMSE-tüüpi EON POKéMON, ELEKTRI-tüüpi THUNDER POKéMON ning TAVA-tüüpi SLEEPING POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceIsThere
en: It's this flamboyant TRAINER called the DOME ACE that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib uhkeldav TRAINER nimega DOME ACE.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons
en: Have you battled the DOME ACE?
et: Kas oled DOME ACE vastu võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons
en: When he's treating the opponent lightly, he uses these three POKéMON:
et: Kui ta vastast kergelt võtab, kasutab ta neid kolme POKéMONi:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceSilverMons
en: A DRAGON & FLYING DRAGON POKéMON, a WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON, and a FIRE & FLYING FLAME POKéMON.
et: DRAAKONI- ja LENDAVA tüüpi DRAGON POKéMON, VEE- ja MAA-tüüpi MUD FISH POKéMON ning TULE- ja LENDAVA tüüpi FLAME POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons
en: Have you battled the DOME ACE when he's serious?
et: Kas oled DOME ACE vastu võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons
en: When he's demonstrating his strategy, he uses these three POKéMON:
et: Kui ta oma strateegiat välja mängib, kasutab ta neid kolme POKéMONi:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DomeAceGoldMons
en: A DRAGON & FLYING EON POKéMON, a WATER & GROUND MUD FISH POKéMON, and a STEEL- & PSYCHIC-type IRON LEG POKéMON.
et: DRAAKONI- ja LENDAVA tüüpi EON POKéMON, VEE- ja MAA-tüüpi MUD FISH POKéMON ning TERAS- ja VAIMSE-tüüpi IRON LEG POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadIsThere
en: It's this freaky TRAINER called the FACTORY HEAD that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib veider TRAINER nimega FACTORY HEAD.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons
en: Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD already?
et: Kas oled FACTORY HEADiga juba võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons
en: Let me think… When he goes to battle, he just gets three rental POKéMON.
et: Las ma mõtlen… Lahingusse minnes võtab ta lihtsalt kolm renditud POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadSilverMons
en: He battles under pretty much the same conditions as you.
et: Ta võitleb üsna samades tingimustes kui sina.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons
en: Have you battled the FACTORY HEAD when he's serious?
et: Kas oled FACTORY HEADiga võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons
en: When he goes seriously to battle, he still gets three rental POKéMON.
et: Ka tõsiselt lahingusse minnes võtab ta kolm renditud POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_FactoryHeadGoldMons
en: He battles under virtually the same conditions as you.
et: Ta võitleb praktiliselt samades tingimustes kui sina.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

et: Seda paika juhib hirmuäratav TRAINER nimega PIKE QUEEN.

en: Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN before?
et: Kas oled varem PIKE QUEENIGA võidelnud?

et: Heas tujus olles kasutab ta räägitavasti neid kolme POKéMONi:

et: MÜRGI-tüüpi FANG SNAKE POKéMON, PUTUKA- ja KIVI-tüüpi MOLD POKéMON ning VEE-tüüpi TENDER POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenGoldMons
en: Have you battled the PIKE QUEEN when she's serious?
et: Kas oled PIKE QUEENIGA võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenGoldMons
en: When she's seriously annoyed, they say she uses these three POKéMON:
et: Tõsiselt tigedaks saades kasutab ta räägitavasti neid kolme POKéMONi:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PikeQueenGoldMons
en: A POISON-type FANG SNAKE POKéMON, a STEEL & GROUND IRON SNAKE POKéMON, and a WATER- & FLYING-type ATROCIOUS POKéMON.
et: MÜRGI-tüüpi FANG SNAKE POKéMON, TERAS- ja MAA-tüüpi IRON SNAKE POKéMON ning VEE- ja LENDAVA tüüpi ATROCIOUS POKéMON.

en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonIsThere
en: It's this cute TRAINER called the ARENA TYCOON that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib nunnu TRAINER nimega ARENA TYCOON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonSilverMons
en: Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON before?
et: Kas oled varem ARENA TYCOONI vastu võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonSilverMons
en: When she's assessing the foe's ability, she supposedly uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta vastase oskusi kaalub, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonSilverMons
en: A BUG & FIGHTING SINGLE HORN POKéMON, a DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON, and a BUG & GHOST SHED POKéMON.
et: PUTUKA- ja KAKLUS-tüüpi SINGLE HORN POKéMON, PIMEDUSE-tüüpi MOONLIGHT POKéMON ning PUTUKA- ja KUMMITUSE-tüüpi SHED POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonGoldMons
en: Have you battled the ARENA TYCOON when she's serious?
et: Kas oled ARENA TYCOONI vastu võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonGoldMons
en: When she battles for keeps, she supposedly uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta päris tõsiselt võitleb, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ArenaTycoonGoldMons
en: A DARK-type MOONLIGHT POKéMON, a GHOST & POISON SHADOW POKéMON and a GRASS- & FIGHTING-type MUSHROOM POKéMON.
et: PIMEDUSE-tüüpi MOONLIGHT POKéMON, KUMMITUSE- ja MÜRGI-tüüpi SHADOW POKéMON ning ROHU- ja KAKLUS-tüüpi MUSHROOM POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenIsThere
en: It's this sinister TRAINER called the PALACE MAVEN that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib kurjakuulutav TRAINER nimega PALACE MAVEN.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenSilverMons
en: Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN before?
et: Kas oled varem PALACE MAVENIGA võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenSilverMons
en: When he's testing the opponent's spirit, he's said to use these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta vastase vaimu proovile paneb, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenSilverMons
en: A POISON & FLYING-type BAT POKéMON, a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON, and a WATER- & ICE-type TRANSPORT POKéMON.
et: MÜRGI- ja LENDAVA tüüpi BAT POKéMON, TAVA-tüüpi LAZY POKéMON ning VEE- ja JÄÄ-tüüpi TRANSPORT POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons
en: Have you battled the PALACE MAVEN when he's serious?
et: Kas oled PALACE MAVENIGA võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons
en: When he throws his entire might into battle, he's said to use these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta kogu oma jõu lahingusse paneb, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PalaceMavenGoldMons
en: A FIRE-type LEGENDARY POKéMON, a NORMAL-type LAZY POKéMON, and a WATER-type AURORA POKéMON.
et: TULE-tüüpi LEGENDARY POKéMON, TAVA-tüüpi LAZY POKéMON ja VEE-tüüpi AURORA POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingIsThere
en: Bet you didn't know this!
et: Vean kihla, et sa seda ei teadnud!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingIsThere
en: One of those top TRAINERS that SCOTT calls the FRONTIER BRAINS is there.
et: Seal on üks neist tipp-TRAINERitest, keda SCOTT kutsub FRONTIER BRAINSiks.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingIsThere
en: It's this fiery-hot TRAINER called the PYRAMID KING that runs the place.
et: Seda paika juhib tulikuum TRAINER nimega PYRAMID KING.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingSilverMons
en: Have you battled the PYRAMID KING before?
et: Kas oled varem PYRAMID KINGiga võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingSilverMons
en: When he's checking the foe's power, he apparently uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta vastase jõudu kompab, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingSilverMons
en: A ROCK-type ROCK PEAK POKéMON, an ICE-type ICEBERG POKéMON, and a STEEL-type IRON POKéMON.
et: KIVI-tüüpi ROCK PEAK POKéMON, JÄÄ-tüüpi ICEBERG POKéMON ja TERAS-tüüpi IRON POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingGoldMons
en: Have you battled the PYRAMID KING when he's serious?
et: Kas oled PYRAMID KINGiga võidelnud siis, kui ta tõsiselt võtab?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingGoldMons
en: When he's pumped with hot power, he apparently uses these POKéMON:
et: Kui ta on tulist jõudu täis, kasutab ta väidetavalt neid POKéMONe:

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_PyramidKingGoldMons
en: An ICE & FLYING FREEZE POKéMON, an ELECTRIC & FLYING ELECTRIC POKéMON, and a FIRE- & FLYING-type FLAME POKéMON.
et: JÄÄ- ja LENDAVA tüüpi FREEZE POKéMON, ELEKTRI- ja LENDAVA tüüpi ELECTRIC POKéMON ning TULE- ja LENDAVA tüüpi FLAME POKéMON.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
en: Sure, there are several places where you can enter DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Muidugi on mitu kohta, kus saab TOPELTLAHINGUISSE astuda.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
en: But the DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS of the BATTLE TOWER are, like, basic!
et: Aga BATTLE TOWERi DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMid on ju kõige põhilisem koht!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice1
en: They're where you should learn about how DOUBLE BATTLES are played here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Seal peaksid õppima, kuidas TOPELTLAHINGUID siin BATTLE FRONTIERis mängitakse.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2
en: Watch yourself in the battles here.
et: Ole siinsetes lahingutes valvas.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice2
en: I hear there are TRAINERS that have strategies they developed just for DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Ma kuulsin, et on TRAINEReid, kellel on just TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks väljatöötatud strateegiad.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_DoubleBattleAdvice3
en: Once you're confident and comfortable with DOUBLE BATTLES here, you should think about challenging other places offering DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Kui siinsed TOPELTLAHINGUD on sul käpas, võiksid mõelda ka teistele paikadele, kus TOPELTLAHINGUID peetakse.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MultiBattleAdvice
en: All sorts of TRAINERS gather in the BATTLE SALON.
et: BATTLE SALONI koguneb igasuguseid TRAINEReid.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_MultiBattleAdvice
en: Just think--you may run into your friends or followers! You should look carefully!
et: Mõtle vaid — võid kohata oma sõpru või austajaid! Vaata hoolega ringi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice
en: If you're with a friend, head for the LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM.
et: Kui oled sõbraga, suundu LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOMI.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_LinkMultiBattleAdvice
en: If you play with a strong friend, you can expect to see tough foes!
et: Kui mängid tugeva sõbraga, tulevad vastu ka kõvad vastased!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_NewsGatheringPower
en: What amazing news-gathering power! My mentor's like none other!
et: Milline uudistenina! Minu õpetajale pole võrdset!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowersOfObservation
en: What amazing powers of observation! My mentor's like none other!
et: Milline vaatlusteravus! Minu õpetajale pole võrdset!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_AmazingPowerOfPersuasion
en: What amazing power of persuasion! My mentor's like none other!
et: Milline veenmisjõud! Minu õpetajale pole võrdset!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_ThisPlaceIsScaringMe
en: …What is this place? It's scaring me…
et: …Mis koht see on? See hirmutab mind…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItToMe
en: Aak! You've made it to me? Hmmm… You're sharp!
et: Aak! Sa jõudsid minuni välja? Hmmm… Sul on nutti!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPlantTrees
en: It took me all night to plant all those trees…
et: Mul kulus terve öö kõigi nende puude istutamiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPlantTrees
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four, five, six places!
et: Suursugususes jääd mulle alla vaid ühe, kahe, kolme, nelja, viie, kuue koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
en: It took me all night to make the maze…
et: Mul kulus terve öö labürindi tegemiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMaze
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four, five places!
et: Suursugususes jääd mulle alla vaid ühe, kahe, kolme, nelja, viie koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
en: It took me all night to prepare the wall panels…
et: Mul kulus terve öö seinapaneelide ettevalmistamiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPreparePanels
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three, four places!
et: Suursugususes jääd mulle alla vaid ühe, kahe, kolme, nelja koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
en: It took me all night to shove in those boulders…
et: Mul kulus terve öö, et need rahnud paika lükata…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToShoveBoulders
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two, three places!
et: Suursugususes jääd mulle alla vaid ühe, kahe, kolme koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
en: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS and another to think up the quiz…
et: Mul kulus terve öö MECHADOLLIDE tegemiseks ja veel üks viktoriini väljamõtlemiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMakeMechadolls
en: You're almost my equal in greatness by one, two places!
et: Suursugususes jääd mulle alla vaid ühe, kahe koha võrra!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: It took me all night to install the doors…
et: Mul kulus terve öö uste paigaldamiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToInstallDoors
en: You're almost my equal in greatness!
et: Suursugususes oled sa mulle peaaegu võrdne!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: It took me all night setting up arrows…
et: Mul kulus terve öö noolte üles seadmiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSettingUpArrows
en: You're my equal in greatness!
et: Suursugususes oled sa mulle võrdne!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: It took me all night polishing floors…
et: Mul kulus terve öö põrandate poleerimiseks…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPolishingFloors
en: You're above me in greatness! Possibly…
et: Sa oled minust suursugusem! Võib-olla…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Wh-what should I do? My fountain of ideas for tricks has run dry…
et: M-mida ma nüüd teen? Mu trikiideede allikas on kuivaks jäänud…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfIdeasRunDry
en: Perhaps it is time I toured the country on a quest to devise new tricks…
et: Ehk on aeg mul mööda maad ringi rännata ja uusi trikke välja mõelda…

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: I hate to admit defeat, but you have bested me!
et: Vastumeelt on kaotust tunnistada, aga sa oled minust üle!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Still, you must have been reeled in by my charisma for you to visit me again and again. Yes, you must have!
et: Sellegipoolest pidi mu karisma sind ligi tõmbama, et sa mind ikka ja jälle külastad. Jah, kindlasti pidi!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: But that has nothing to do with my losing!
et: Aga sel pole midagi pistmist minu kaotamisega!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: In recognition of the friendship between you, the driven, and the genius that is myself, I demand that you take this keepsake!
et: Meie sõpruse auks — sinu, sihikindla, ja minu, geeniuse, vahel — nõuan, et võtaksid selle mälestuseseme!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePreferWhichTent
en: Actually there are two-a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT. Which do you prefer?
et: Tegelikult on neid kaks — RED TENT ja BLUE TENT. Kumba eelistad?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: What? No room in your PC? What am I to make of that?
et: Mida? Su ARVUTIS pole ruumi? Mida ma sellest arvama pean?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I wish I could say that, but I am much too kind and caring, so come back later!
et: Tahaks nii öelda, aga ma olen liiga lahke ja hooliv, nii et tule hiljem tagasi!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I am leaving on a journey of discovery. A quest in search of new tricks.
et: Ma asun avastusretkele. Uusi trikke otsima.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: I wish that you will one day visit and entertain me again.
et: Loodan, et tuled ühel päeval jälle mind lõbustama.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJourney
en: And now, farewell!
et: Ja nüüd, hüvasti!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarnedThisReward
en: Fine! You have earned this reward!
et: Hea küll! Sa oled selle tasu ära teeninud!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: What? Have you no room for this? What manner of items do you carry?
et: Mida? Kas sul pole selle jaoks ruumi? Missuguseid esemeid sa kannad?

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThis
en: But fine, since you've reached me, your reward will be with me till later.
et: Aga olgu, kuna sa minuni jõudsid, hoian su tasu seni enda käes.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Scrub that smug smirk from your face! It's much too early to think you've won!
et: Pühi see ennasttäis irve näolt! Liiga vara on arvata, et oled võitnud!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will. You may mock me only when you're done.
et: Ma mõtlen välja uued trikid, mis su ummikusse ajavad! Pilgata võid mind alles siis, kui need läbitud on.

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTricksToStumpYou
en: Come back for the next exciting installment!
et: Tule tagasi järgmise põneva osa peale!

label: Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnoringMe
en: Now, now! You're ignoring me now? Now that, I consider heartbreaking!
et: No kuule! Sa eirad mind nüüd? Seda küll pean ma südantlõhestavaks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Who are you? Where did you come in from?
et: Kes sa oled? Kust sina sisse tulid?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Lost it…
et: Kaotasin…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I can't find the way out!
et: Ma ei leia väljapääsu!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: I'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!
et: Ma ei karda. Ära saa minust valesti aru!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Who are you? Where do you think you're going?
et: Kes sa oled? Kuhu sa õige lähed?

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: I failed to win!
et: Võitu ei tulnud!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: My partner forgot the map in that submarine!
et: Mu partner unustas kaardi sellesse allveelaeva!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How's that for being useless?
et: Kui kasutu veel olla saab?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: Urrrrppp…
et: Urrrrpp…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: I'm getting queasy just being aboard this ship…
et: Mul hakkab juba sellel laeval olemisest paha…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQueasy
en: It's not even moving, but…
et: See ei liigu ju isegi, aga…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: How did you manage to get here without a submarine? What an impressive child!
et: Kuidas sa ilma allveelaevata siia said? Milline muljetavaldav laps!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: But… It won't do to have you meddling about here.
et: Aga… Ei lähe, et sa siin vahele segad.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: And, I do want payback for what happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE…
et: Ja ma tahan kätte maksta selle eest, mis juhtus WEATHER INSTITUTE juures…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro
en: I'm going to give you a little taste of pain! Resign yourself to it!
et: Ma lasen sul pisut valu maitsta! Lepi sellega!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ouch!
et: Ai!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: Ahahahaha! You're so darn strong.
et: Ahahahaa! Sa oled ikka kuradi tugev.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: It's terribly disappointing that you're not a TEAM AQUA member.
et: On kohutavalt kahju, et sa pole TEAM AQUA liige.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: You could have enjoyed the fabulous world our BOSS has promised as one of us…
et: Sa oleksid võinud ühena meist nautida seda vapustavat maailma, mille meie BOSS on lubanud…

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: For our dream to become real, we need the power of POKéMON.
et: Et meie unistus täituks, vajame POKéMONide jõudu.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: But meddlers like you use the power of POKéMON to mess with us even at a place like this!
et: Aga sinusugused tüütud jändajad kasutavad POKéMONide jõudu, et meiega jamada isegi sellises paigas!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Life just doesn't work the way we need it to!
et: Elu lihtsalt ei lähe nii, nagu meil vaja oleks!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Gwah!
et: Gvah!

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: You know, we don't dare question the motives of our leader.
et: Tead, me ei julge oma juhi ajendeid kahtluse alla seada.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: But here you are, just some punk, going up against our BOSS.
et: Aga siin sa oled — mingi nolk, kes meie BOSSIGA jõudu katsub.

label: SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Maybe… You must be something…
et: Võib-olla… Sinus peab midagi olema…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!
et: Rakett stardib kohe-kohe!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_SuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Rakett startis ohutult! See on edukas start nr. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…
et: Ma tean, et asjad on praegu veidi segamini, aga…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButRocketLaunchImminent
en: The rocket's launch is imminent!
et: Rakett stardib kohe-kohe!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: I know that things are a little haywire right now, but…
et: Ma tean, et asjad on praegu veidi segamini, aga…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HaywireButSuccessfulLaunchNumber
en: The rocket launched safely! That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
et: Rakett startis ohutult! See on edukas start nr. {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: A rocket launch demands perfection. Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.
et: Raketistart nõuab täiuslikkust. Lubatud pole isegi 1% viga.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing is useless if 1% happens to be no good.
et: Isegi kui 99% on korras, on kogu asi läbi, kui see 1% alt veab.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketLaunchDemandsPerfection
en: Despite that, we never stop trying. Why? It's a dream that never ends.
et: Sellest hoolimata me ei lakka kunagi püüdmast. Miks? See on unistus, mis ei lõpe kunagi.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights set on our SPACE CENTER.
et: Need MAGMA sulid on võtnud sihikule meie KOSMOSEKESKUSE.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHaveSightsOnSpaceCenter
en: But we can't allow anything that minor to interfere with our rocket launch!
et: Aga me ei saa lubada millelgi nii tühisel meie raketistarti segada!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: I was taking a stroll down the beach when I found this.
et: Jalutasin rannas ja leidsin selle.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundThisYouCanHaveIt
en: It's not anything I need, so you can have it.
et: Mul pole seda vaja, nii et võta endale.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFamousForMeteorShowers
en: The HOENN region has been famous for its meteor showers for a long time.
et: HOENNI piirkond on juba ammu oma meteoorisadude poolest kuulus.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal the rocket fuel.
et: TEAM MAGMAL ei tohi lasta raketikütust varastada.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCantStealFuelTakeThis
en: Oh, by the way, you can have this stone I found on the beach.
et: Ah jaa, võta see kivi, mille ma rannast leidsin.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStrollOnBeachWithMagma
en: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess strolls on the beach aren't safe.
et: Kui TEAM MAGMA siin ringi luusib, pole rannas jalutamine vist ohutu.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPokemonComeFromSpace
en: Some people claim that POKéMON came from space. Could it be true?
et: Mõned inimesed väidavad, et POKéMONid tulid kosmosest. Kas see saab tõsi olla?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: TEAM AQUA should take care of TEAM MAGMA!
et: TEAM AQUA peaks TEAM MAGMAGA tegelema!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaShouldBeatMagma
en: But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will become bold and brazen, won't they?
et: Aga kui nad seda teeksid, muutuks TEAM AQUA julgeks ja häbematuks, kas pole?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…
et: Hiiglaslik metallitükk murrab läbi taeva ja lendab kosmosesse…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketsBoggleMyMind
en: It boggles my mind!
et: See ajab mul pea päris segi!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: A giant chunk of metal bursts through the skies and flies into space…
et: Hiiglaslik metallitükk murrab läbi taeva ja lendab kosmosesse…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil that dream of mine!
et: Aga TEAM MAGMA tahab mu unistuse ära rikkuda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWantsToSpoilMyDream
en: I'm not having any of that!
et: Seda ma küll ei luba!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that proclamation already?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas sa oled seda kuulutust juba lugenud?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket fuel on this island.
et: TEAM MAGMA tuleb siia saarele raketikütuse järele.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I don't know what they'd need it for, but they can't be allowed to take it.
et: Ma ei tea, milleks neile seda vaja on, aga me ei tohi lasta neil seda kätte saada.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: I'll keep an eye on things for a while longer.
et: Ma hoian siin veel veidi aega silma peal.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenMagmaCantBeAllowedToTakeFuel
en: In the meantime, why don't you go check out the town?
et: Käi sina vahepeal linnas ringi vaatamas!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: As promised, we've come for the rocket fuel!
et: Nagu lubatud, tulime raketikütusele järele!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: Ran out of fuel…
et: Kütus sai otsa…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Don't think you're on a roll just because you've beaten me!
et: Ära arva, et sa nüüd hoos oled, lihtsalt sellepärast, et mu ära võitsid!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: We gave you fair warning! There's nothing sneaky about us!
et: Me hoiatasime sind ausalt ette! Meis pole midagi salakavalat!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: Grrr… We should've used sneaky treachery…
et: Grrr… Oleksime pidanud ikka salakavalalt tegutsema…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: Okay, I get it already! The next time, we'll come unannounced.
et: Olgu, sain juba aru! Järgmine kord tuleme ette teatamata.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has in storage--that's what we're after.
et: Raketikütus, mida KOSMOSEKESKUS laos hoiab – just see meid huvitabki.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: We mean to take every last bit of it!
et: Me kavatseme selle viimse tilgani ära viia!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Please, can you spare some fuel? Even a chintzy cup will do!
et: Palun, kas sa ei annaks natuke kütust? Isegi üks kehvake tassitäis kõlbaks!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: What are we going to do with the rocket fuel?
et: Mida me selle raketikütusega üldse peale hakkame?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: How would I know? Ask our leader upstairs!
et: Kust mina tean? Küsi ülakorruselt meie juhi käest!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Our leader said no one, but no one, gets past me!
et: Meie juht ütles, et keegi, aga mitte keegi ei pääse minust mööda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Ack! Ack! Aaack!
et: Ah! Ah! Aaah!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Please, tell our leader that I never abandoned my post. That I stayed to the bitter end…
et: Palun ütle meie juhile, et ma ei jätnud oma posti hetkekski maha. Et ma pidasin kibeda lõpuni vastu…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: This is… An intent-to-steal notice?
et: See on… varastamiskavatsuse teade?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “To the staff of the SPACE CENTER: How are you? We are doing fine.
et: „KOSMOSEKESKUSE töötajatele! Kuidas teil läheb? Meil läheb hästi.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “We will soon visit you to take your rocket fuel.
et: „Tuleme teile varsti külla, et teie raketikütus ära viia.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Please don't try to stop us. We will take the fuel no matter what.
et: „Palun ärge püüdke meid takistada. Me võtame kütuse niikuinii.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIntentToStealNotice
en: “Let there be more land! TEAM MAGMA”
et: „Olgu rohkem maismaad! TEAM MAGMA”
