en: That's silly! An EGG is asleep! I can't talk to it!
et: Oi kui rumal! MUNA ju magab! Temaga ei saa rääkida!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSheUnderstandsPokemon
en: How charming! That little lady claims she can understand POKéMON!
et: Kui armas! See pisike preili väidab, et saab POKéMONidest aru!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSomethingProfound
en: I have this feeling that the little girl is saying something profound.
et: Mul on tunne, et see väike tüdruk räägib midagi sügavamõttelist.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
en: I know something!
et: Ma tean midagi!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtRedHouseALot
en: That little girl plays at the red house a lot!
et: See väike tüdruk mängib tihti punase maja juures!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
en: For my own POKéMON, I give them perfectly suited nicknames!
et: Oma POKéMONidele panen ma alati täpselt sobivad hüüdnimed!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlySuitedNicknames
en: It's my expression of, uh… originality, yes, that's it!
et: See on minu… öö… originaalsus, jah, just nimelt!

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
en: But giving the name PEKACHU to a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.
et: Aga panna PIKACHU nimeks PEKACHU? Tundub üsna mõttetu.

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
en: I suppose it is good to use a name that's easy to understand, but…
et: Küllap on hea, kui nimi on kergesti mõistetav, aga…

label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
en: PEKACHU: Peka!
et: PEKACHU: Peka!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
en: That man over there, he says weird things!
et: See mees seal räägib igasugu veidraid asju!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOverThereSaysWeirdThings
en: He's funny in a weird way. I doubt I'll forget about him!
et: Ta on omamoodi naljakas. Vaevalt et ma teda unustan!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
en: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER, the data for what's hot in DEWFORD got updated.
et: Kui ma RECORD CORNERIS käisin, uuenesid andmed selle kohta, mis DEWFORDIS moes on.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDataUpdatedFromRecordCorner
en: Now that bit of data is the same as my friend's!
et: Nüüd on see andmekild sama mis mu sõbral!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
en: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in the POKéMON CENTER.
et: POKéKESKUSE ülakorrusel avati RECORD CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RecordCornerSoundsFun
en: I don't know what it's about, but it sounds fun. I'll go check it out!
et: Ma ei tea, millega seal tegeldakse, aga kõlab lõbusalt. Lähen vaatan järele!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Where the hearts of TRAINERS are put to the test.
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE südamed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.
et: Tere tulemast! See on BATTLE PALACE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I accept challenges to the SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: Ma võtan vastu väljakutseid SINGLE BATTLE HALLIDESSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeSingleBattleChallenge
en: Do you wish to take the SINGLE BATTLE HALL challenge?
et: Kas soovid vastu võtta SINGLE BATTLE HALLI väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: In the BATTLE PALACE, there are several auditoriums for SINGLE BATTLES that are named SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: BATTLE PALACE hoones on üksiklahingute jaoks mitu saali — need on SINGLE BATTLE HALLID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The SINGLE BATTLES are conducted in the usual way, except with one crucial rule that must be obeyed.
et: Üksiklahinguid peetakse tavapärasel moel, ainult ühte tähtsat reeglit tuleb järgida.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are permitted only to switch their POKéMON in and out.
et: TRAINERID tohivad ainult oma POKéMONe välja ja tagasi kutsuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to command their POKéMON.
et: Muus osas on TRAINERITEL keelatud oma POKéMONe käsutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: The POKéMON are to behave according to their nature and battle on their own.
et: POKéMONid peavad käituma oma loomuse järgi ja võitlema omal käel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.
et: Sa pead oma POKéMONe usaldama ja neil silma peal hoidma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui suudad seitse TRAINERIT järjest alistada, kingime sulle Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must save the game.
et: Kui tahad väljakutse pooleli jätta, pead mängu salvestama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainSingleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReturnWhenFortified
en: When you have fortified your heart and POKéMON, you must return.
et: Kui oled oma südame ja POKéMONid tugevamaks teinud, tule tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhichChallenge
en: There are two BATTLE HALLS, Level 50 and Open Level. Which is your choice of a challenge?
et: Saale on kaks: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumma väljakutse valid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for the challenge.
et: Sul pole väljakutseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: To enter, you must provide three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Osalemiseks pead kaasa võtma kolm eri liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: These POKéMON must all be of Level 50 or lower.
et: Kõik need POKéMONid peavad olema tasemel 50 või madalamal.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: They also must not be holding the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi neil olla kaasas ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: Come back when you have made your preparations.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled ettevalmistused teinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: You do not have the three POKéMON required for the challenge.
et: Sul pole väljakutseks nõutavat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: To enter, you must provide three different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Osalemiseks pead kaasa võtma kolm eri liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: They also must not be holding the same kinds of items.
et: Samuti ei tohi neil olla kaasas ühesuguseid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: EGGS{STR_VAR_1} ineligible.
et: MUNAD{STR_VAR_1} ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: Come back when you have made your preparations.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled ettevalmistused teinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NowSelectThreeMons
en: Good. Now, you must select your three POKéMON.
et: Hästi. Nüüd vali oma kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge2
en: I must save before I show you to the BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?
et: Pean enne salvestama, kui su BATTLE HALLI juhatan. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FollowMe
en: Good. Now, follow me.
et: Hästi. Järgne nüüd mulle.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
en: I feel privileged for having seen your POKéMON's exploits.
et: Mul oli au su POKéMONide vägitegusid näha.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ResultsWillBeRecorded
en: The results will be recorded. I must ask you to briefly wait.
et: Tulemused pannakse kirja. Palun sul hetkeks oodata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: To achieve a 7-win streak…
et: Seitse võitu järjest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FirmTrueBondsFor7WinStreak
en: The bonds that bind your heart with your POKéMON seem firm and true.
et: Side sinu südame ja su POKéMONide vahel näib tugev ja tõeline.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FeatWillBeRecorded
en: Your feat will be recorded. I must ask you to briefly wait.
et: Su saavutus pannakse kirja. Palun sul hetkeks oodata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_BattlePointsFor7WinStreak
en: For the feat of your 7-win streak, we present you with Battle Point(s).
et: Seitsme järjestikuse võidu eest kingime sulle Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
en: You seem to have no space for our prize.
et: Paistab, et sul pole meie auhinna jaoks ruumi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NoSpaceForPrize
en: You should return when you have organized your BAG.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled oma KOTI korda teinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WeHaveBeenWaiting
en: We have been waiting for you…
et: Me oleme sind oodanud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MustSaveBeforeChallenge
en: I must save before I show you to the BATTLE HALL. Is that okay?
et: Pean enne salvestama, kui su BATTLE HALLI juhatan. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: You failed to save before you ended your challenge the last time.
et: Sa ei salvestanud eelmisel korral enne väljakutse lõpetamist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_FailedToSaveBeforeEndingChallenge
en: As a result, your challenge has been disqualified. It is most unfortunate.
et: Seetõttu on su väljakutse diskvalifitseeritud. Äärmiselt kahetsusväärne.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReceivedPrize
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinnaks {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: For a hardy fellow like me, hardy POKéMON are the best.
et: Minusuguse karastunud mehe jaoks on parimad just karastunud POKéMONid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Offense is the best defense! A relentless attack is the ultimate!
et: Rünnak on parim kaitse! Halastamatu pealetung on kõige ülem!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: But that's not what I wanted to chat about.
et: Aga ma ei tahtnud tegelikult sellest rääkida.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Every so often a really cute lady swings by here.
et: Aeg-ajalt põikab siia sisse üks päris nunnu neiu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: She says that she can tell what POKéMON are thinking.
et: Ta ütleb, et saab aru, mida POKéMONid mõtlevad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: I don't know about that part, but she is really cute.
et: Selle kohta ma ei oska öelda, aga nunnu on ta küll.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LadyCanTellWhatMonsThink
en: Huh? Why are you looking at me like that?
et: Ää? Miks sa mind niimoodi vaatad?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: It appears that the nature of POKéMON and the moves that they have been taught are the keys to battle here.
et: Paistab, et siinse lahingu võti on POKéMONi loomus ja talle õpetatud võtted.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: To be more precise, it's how well the moves match the nature of the POKéMON.
et: Täpsemalt öeldes see, kui hästi võtted POKéMONi loomusega kokku sobivad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_NatureAndMovesKeyHere
en: If your POKéMON is in trouble and unable to live up to its potential, you may need to examine how well its moves match its nature.
et: Kui su POKéMON on hädas ega suuda oma võimeid välja mängida, tasub üle vaadata, kas ta võtted sobivad ta loomusega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: My POKéMON is usually very docile.
et: Minu POKéMON on tavaliselt väga tasane.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: But when it's in a BATTLE HALL, it sometimes seems to become transformed into something wicked!
et: Aga BATTLE HALLIS muutub ta vahel nagu hoopis teiseks — päris tigedaks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_MonDocileButTransforms
en: It becomes totally intimidating. It's shocking, even.
et: Ta muutub lausa hirmuäratavaks. See on isegi jahmatav.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I wonder what sort of nature a POKéMON would have if it favored enfeebling its opponents and chipping away slowly.
et: Huvitav, milline loomus on POKéMONil, kellele meeldib vastast nõrgestada ja teda tasapisi murendada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: I'd be surprised if it was a LAX nature.
et: Oleksin üllatunud, kui selleks osutuks LAX-loomus.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WhatNatureFavorsChippingAway
en: But, nah, that can't be right.
et: Aga ei, vaevalt see nii on.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: Where the hearts of TRAINERS are put to the test.
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE südamed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: I welcome you to the BATTLE PALACE.
et: Tere tulemast! See on BATTLE PALACE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: I accept challenges to the DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: Ma võtan vastu väljakutseid DOUBLE BATTLE HALLIDESSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_TakeDoubleBattleChallenge
en: Do you wish to take the DOUBLE BATTLE HALL challenge?
et: Kas soovid vastu võtta DOUBLE BATTLE HALLI väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: In the BATTLE PALACE, there are several auditoriums for DOUBLE BATTLES that are named DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: BATTLE PALACE hoones on topeltlahingute jaoks mitu saali — need on DOUBLE BATTLE HALLID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: The DOUBLE BATTLES are conducted in the usual way, except with one crucial rule that must be obeyed.
et: Topeltlahinguid peetakse tavapärasel moel, ainult ühte tähtsat reeglit tuleb järgida.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are permitted only to switch their POKéMON in and out.
et: TRAINERID tohivad ainult oma POKéMONe välja ja tagasi kutsuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to command their POKéMON.
et: Muus osas on TRAINERITEL keelatud oma POKéMONe käsutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: The POKéMON are to behave according to their nature and battle on their own.
et: POKéMONid peavad käituma oma loomuse järgi ja võitlema omal käel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: You must put your trust in your POKéMON and watch over them.
et: Sa pead oma POKéMONe usaldama ja neil silma peal hoidma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you achieve the honor of beating seven TRAINERS in succession, we will present you with Battle Points.
et: Kui suudad seitse TRAINERIT järjest alistada, kingime sulle Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad väljakutse pooleli jätta, siis palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainDoubleBattleChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ToDefeatMavenAnd7Trainers
en: To defeat the PALACE MAVEN and seven TRAINERS in a row…
et: Alistada PALACE MAVEN ja seitse TRAINERIT järjest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_PresentYouWithBattlePoints
en: In honor of the bond you share with your POKéMON, we present you with these Battle Point(s).
et: Sinu ja su POKéMONide vahelise sideme auks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_LikeToRecordMatch
en: Would you like to record your latest BATTLE PALACE match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase BATTLE PALACE matši FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The BATTLE HALL rules are listed.
et: Siin on kirjas BATTLE HALLI reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist peatükki soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Here, POKéMON are required to think and battle by themselves.
et: Siin peavad POKéMONid ise mõtlema ja ise võitlema.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesBasics
en: Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live with people behave differently depending on their nature.
et: Erinevalt metsikutest käituvad inimeste juures elavad POKéMONid oma loomuse järgi isemoodi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may prefer to attack no matter what.
et: Mõni POKéMON tahab oma loomuse tõttu iga hinna eest rünnata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Another POKéMON may prefer to protect itself from any harm.
et: Teine hoiab ennast pigem igasuguse kahju eest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Yet another may enjoy vexing or confounding its foes.
et: Kolmandale meeldib vastast ärritada ja segadusse ajada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: Due to its nature, a POKéMON will have favorite moves that it is good at using.
et: Loomuse tõttu on igal POKéMONil lemmikvõtted, mida ta hästi valdab.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesNature
en: It may also dislike certain moves that it has trouble using.
et: Ja on ka võtteid, mida ta ei salli ja mille kasutamine tal hästi ei õnnestu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are offensive moves that inflict direct damage on the foe.
et: On ründevõtteid, mis teevad vastasele otsest kahju.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are defensive moves that are used to prepare for enemy attacks or used to heal HP and so on.
et: On kaitsevõtteid, millega valmistutakse vastase rünnakuks, taastatakse HP ja nii edasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: There are also other somewhat-odd moves that may enfeeble the foes with stat problems including poison and paralysis.
et: On ka veidravõitu võtteid, mis nõrgestavad vastast seisundihädadega — näiteks mürgitavad või halvavad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesMoves
en: POKéMON will consider using moves in these three categories.
et: POKéMON kaalub võtteid kõigist kolmest rühmast.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: When not under command by its TRAINER, a POKéMON may be unable to effectively use certain moves.
et: Ilma TRAINERI käsuta ei pruugi POKéMON mõnda võtet tõhusalt kasutada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: A POKéMON is not good at using any move that it dislikes.
et: Võte, mida POKéMON ei salli, tal hästi välja ei tule.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesUnderpowered
en: If a POKéMON only knows moves that do not match its nature, it will often be unable to live up to its potential.
et: Kui POKéMON oskab ainult võtteid, mis ta loomusega ei sobi, jäävad ta võimed sageli välja mängimata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may start using moves that don't match its nature when it is in trouble.
et: Mõni POKéMON hakkab hädas olles oma loomuse tõttu kasutama võtteid, mis talle tegelikult ei sobi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_ExplainRulesWhenInDanger
en: If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly in a pinch, watch it carefully.
et: Kui POKéMON hakkab kitsikuses veidralt käituma, jälgi teda hoolega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE nutikus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: Welcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!
et: Tere tulemast! Siin on BATTLE FACTORY!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForSingleBattle
en: I am your guide to the Battle Swap Single Tournament.
et: Mina olen sinu teejuht Battle Swap üksikturniiril.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeSinglesChallenge
en: Would you like to take the Battle Swap Single challenge?
et: Kas soovid vastu võtta Battle Swap üksikväljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: The Battle Swap Single Tournament is a SINGLE BATTLE competition using only rental POKéMON.
et: Battle Swap üksikturniir on üksiklahingu võistlus, kus kasutatakse ainult renditud POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: First, you will be loaned three POKéMON specifically for this event.
et: Kõigepealt laenatakse sulle just selleks võistluseks kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: Using the supplied rental POKéMON, you must conduct a SINGLE BATTLE.
et: Nende renditud POKéMONidega pead pidama üksiklahingu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you win, you are permitted to trade one of your rental POKéMON.
et: Kui võidad, tohid ühe oma renditud POKéMONi ära vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: Repeat this cycle of battling and trading--if you win seven times in a row, you will earn Battle Points.
et: Korda seda ringi — võitle ja vaheta; kui võidad seitse korda järjest, teenid Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad väljakutse pooleli jätta, siis palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSinglesChallenge
en: If you don't save, you will be disqualified from your challenge.
et: Kui sa ei salvesta, sind diskvalifitseeritakse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_LookForwardToNextVisit
en: We look forward to your next visit.
et: Ootame sind jälle külla!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: Which level do you wish to challenge? Level 50 or Open Level?
et: Millisel tasemel soovid võistelda? Tase 50 või Avatud tase?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_OkayToSaveBeforeChallenge
en: Before you begin your challenge, I need to save the game. Is that okay?
et: Enne väljakutse algust pean mängu salvestama. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WillHoldMonsForSafekeeping
en: Okay, I will hold your POKéMON for safekeeping while you compete.
et: Hästi, võistluse ajaks võtan su POKéMONid hoiule.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way.
et: Palun astu siiapoole.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: Thank you for participating!
et: Aitäh osalemast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: I will return your POKéMON in exchange for our rental POKéMON.
et: Vahetan meie renditud POKéMONid sinu omade vastu tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMonsSaveResults
en: I must also save the event results. Please wait.
et: Pean ka võistluse tulemused salvestama. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReturnMons
en: I will return your POKéMON in exchange for our rental POKéMON.
et: Vahetan meie renditud POKéMONid sinu omade vastu tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsSevenWins
en: Congratulations! You've won seven straight Battle Swap matches!
et: Palju õnne! Seitse Battle Swapi matši järjest võidetud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePointsForStreak
en: In recognition of your 7-win streak, we award you these Battle Point(s).
et: Seitsme järjestikuse võidu tunnustuseks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Oh, oh, oh!
et: Oh, oh, oh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Your Battle Points are maxed.
et: Su Battle Pointid on maksimumis.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_MaxBattlePoints
en: Please come back after using some Battle Points.
et: Tule tagasi, kui oled mõne Battle Pointi ära kulutanud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
en: We've been waiting for you!
et: Me ootasime sind juba!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WaitingForYouToResume
en: Before we resume your challenge, I must save the game.
et: Enne väljakutse jätkamist pean mängu salvestama.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: I'm sorry to say this, but you didn't save before you quit playing last time.
et: Kahju küll, aga sa ei salvestanud eelmisel korral enne mängu lõpetamist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_DidntSaveBeforeQuitting
en: As a result, you have been disqualified from your challenge.
et: Seetõttu oled sa väljakutselt diskvalifitseeritud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WellReturnMons
en: We'll return your personal POKéMON.
et: Anname sulle su enda POKéMONid tagasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReceivedPrizeItem
en: {PLAYER} received the prize {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} sai auhinnaks {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: Where the intelligence of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE nutikus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: Welcome to the BATTLE FACTORY!
et: Tere tulemast! Siin on BATTLE FACTORY!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_WelcomeForDoubleBattle
en: I am your guide to the Battle Swap Double Tournament.
et: Mina olen sinu teejuht Battle Swap topeltturniiril.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_TakeDoublesChallenge
en: Would you like to take the Battle Swap Double challenge?
et: Kas soovid vastu võtta Battle Swap topeltväljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: The Battle Swap Double Tournament is a DOUBLE BATTLE competition using only rental POKéMON.
et: Battle Swap topeltturniir on topeltlahingu võistlus, kus kasutatakse ainult renditud POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: First, you will be loaned three POKéMON specifically for this event.
et: Kõigepealt laenatakse sulle just selleks võistluseks kolm POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: Using the supplied rental POKéMON, you must conduct a DOUBLE BATTLE.
et: Nende renditud POKéMONidega pead pidama topeltlahingu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: If you win, you are permitted to trade one of your rental POKéMON.
et: Kui võidad, tohid ühe oma renditud POKéMONi ära vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: Repeat this cycle of battling and trading--if you win seven times in a row, you will earn Battle Points.
et: Korda seda ringi — võitle ja vaheta; kui võidad seitse korda järjest, teenid Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad väljakutse pooleli jätta, siis palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainDoublesChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CongratsForDefeatingHead
en: Congratulations for defeating the FACTORY HEAD and winning seven matches in a row!
et: Palju õnne! Alistasid FACTORY HEADI ja võitsid seitse matši järjest!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_AwardBattlePoints
en: In recognition of your wealth of knowledge and keen intelligence, we award you these Battle Point(s).
et: Sinu rikkalike teadmiste ja terase mõistuse tunnustuseks kingime sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExchangeMonsAndSave
en: Let me exchange your POKéMON for our rental POKéMON.
et: Vahetan nüüd meie renditud POKéMONid sinu omade vastu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExchangeMonsAndSave
en: I need to save the battle data, so please wait.
et: Pean lahinguandmed salvestama, palun oota hetk.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Would you like to record your last BATTLE FACTORY match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase BATTLE FACTORY matši FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: Hi! You, there!
et: Hei! Sina seal!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: Are you thinking that the events here are easy since you don't need to have a raised team of POKéMON?
et: Arvad vahest, et siin on lihtne, kuna omi treenitud POKéMONe polegi vaja?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: I wouldn't be too sure about winning that easily.
et: Ma ei oleks nii kindel, et võit nii kergelt tuleb.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedKnowledgeOfMonsMoves
en: If you don't have thorough knowledge about POKéMON and their moves, it will be tough to keep winning.
et: Kui sa POKéMONe ja nende võtteid põhjalikult ei tunne, on raske järjest võita.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
en: I swapped for a weak POKéMON… I thought it was a good kind to have…
et: Vahetasin endale nõrga POKéMONi… Arvasin, et see on hea liik…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_SwappedForWeakMon
en: They wiped the floor with us…
et: Nad pühkisid meiega põrandat…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons
en: Things haven't been going my way at all.
et: Mul pole viimasel ajal üldse hästi läinud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_NeedToCheckOpponentsMons
en: You need to check your opponent's POKéMON during battle to see if they're any good.
et: Lahingu ajal tasub vastase POKéMONid üle vaadata, et näha, kas neist on asja.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
en: You know how the staff here give you a few hints about your next opponent?
et: Tead ju, et siinsed töötajad annavad su järgmise vastase kohta paar vihjet?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_CantFigureOutStaffHints
en: Well, I'm a full-grown man, but I have trouble figuring out their hints.
et: No ma olen täiskasvanud mees, aga neist vihjetest ei saa ma ikka aru.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried
en: Like, I'm really tough, but I get bored really easily, so I just kept swapping and battling over and over.
et: Ma olen küll kõva käsi, aga mul läheb ruttu igavaks, nii et vahetasin ja võitlesin aina edasi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RentalMonsAreVaried
en: So anyway, when I kept entering Battle Swap events, I noticed they varied the rental POKéMON.
et: Igatahes, kui ma Battle Swapil ikka ja jälle käisin, panin tähele, et renditavad POKéMONid on iga kord isesugused.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Swap rules are listed.
et: Siin on kirjas Battle Swapi reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist peatükki soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: In a Battle Swap event, you may use only three POKéMON.
et: Battle Swapi võistlusel tohid kasutada ainult kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainBasicRules
en: Whether you are renting or swapping, your team may not have two or more of the same POKéMON.
et: Ükskõik kas rendid või vahetad — meeskonnas ei tohi olla kahte ühesugust POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap POKéMON only with the TRAINER you have just defeated.
et: POKéMONe tohid vahetada ainult selle TRAINERIGA, kelle just alistasid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapPartnerRules
en: You may swap for only those POKéMON used by the beaten TRAINER.
et: Vahetada saad ainult nende POKéMONide vastu, keda alistatud TRAINER kasutas.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: After every battle you win, you may swap for one of your defeated opponent's POKéMON.
et: Iga võidetud lahingu järel võid ühe alistatud vastase POKéMONi endale vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNumberRules
en: You will not be able to swap POKéMON with the seventh TRAINER in the event.
et: Võistluse seitsmenda TRAINERIGA enam vahetada ei saa.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
en: There are two key points to be aware of when swapping POKéMON.
et: POKéMONide vahetamisel tuleb meeles pidada kahte olulist asja.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
en: First, when swapping, you can't check the stats of the POKéMON you are about to receive.
et: Esiteks: vahetades ei näe sa selle POKéMONi näitajaid, kelle sa endale saad.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
en: Second, the POKéMON on your team are lined up in sequence, depending on the order in which you rented them.
et: Teiseks: sinu meeskonnas seisavad POKéMONid selles järjekorras, nagu sa nad rentisid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainSwapNotesRules
en: This sequence remains unchanged even when swaps are made.
et: See järjekord ei muutu ka pärast vahetusi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryLobby_Text_ExplainOpenLvRules
en: In the Open Level, the rental POKéMON and the opposing TRAINERS' POKéMON are all Level 100.
et: Avatud tasemel on kõik POKéMONid — nii renditud kui ka vastaste omad — tasemel 100.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
en: My name is STEVEN.
et: Mu nimi on STEVEN.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
en: I'm interested in rare stones, so I travel here and there.
et: Mind huvitavad haruldased kivid, seepärast rändan siia-sinna.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLetterForMe
en: Oh? A LETTER for me?
et: Oh? KIRI mulle?

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
en: STEVEN: Okay, thank you.
et: STEVEN: Olgu, aitäh.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
en: You went through all this trouble to deliver that. I need to thank you.
et: Nägid selle toomisega kõvasti vaeva. Pean sind tänama.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
en: Let me see… I'll give you this TM.
et: Las ma vaatan… Ma annan sulle selle TM-võtte.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTakeThis
en: It contains my favorite move, STEEL WING.
et: Selles on mu lemmikvõte STEEL WING.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
en: STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite capable.
et: STEVEN: Su POKéMONid tunduvad üsna tublid.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
en: If you keep training, you could even become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON LEAGUE one day. That's what I think.
et: Kui treenimist jätkad, võid ühel päeval saada isegi POKéMON LIIGA MEISTRIKS. Nii ma arvan.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecomeChampionLetsRegister
en: I know, since we've gotten to know each other, let's register one another in our POKéNAVS.
et: Tead mis, kuna oleme nüüd tuttavaks saanud, paneme teineteise oma POKéNAVIDESSE kirja.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_RegisteredSteven
en: Registered STEVEN in the POKéNAV.
et: STEVEN registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHurryAlong
en: Now, I've got to hurry along.
et: Nii, mul on nüüd kiire.

label: GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull
en: Oh, your BAG is full… That's too bad, then.
et: Oh, su KOTT on täis… Kahju küll.

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: Welcome, challenger! I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.
et: Tere tulemast, väljakutsuja! Mina olen SIDNEY ELIITNELIKUST.

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: I like that look you're giving me. I guess you'll give me a good match. That's good! Looking real good!
et: Mulle meeldib su pilk. Vist tuleb meil korralik matš. Hea! Väga hea!

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpeech
en: All right! You and me, let's enjoy a battle that can only be staged here in the POKéMON LEAGUE!
et: Hüva! Löömegi lahingu, mille saab pidada ainult siin, POKéMON LIIGAS!

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat
en: Well, how do you like that? I lost! Eh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.
et: Näed sa! Ma kaotasin! Ah, lõbus oli, pole hullu.

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: Well, listen to what this loser has to say.
et: Kuula nüüd, mis sellel kaotajal öelda on.

label: EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBattleSpeech
en: You've got what it takes to go far. Now, go on to the next room and enjoy your next battle!
et: Sinus on mõõtu, et kaugele jõuda. Mine nüüd järgmisse tuppa ja naudi järgmist lahingut!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetMeRestoreYourMons
en: Excellent… Let me restore your POKéMON.
et: Suurepärane… Ma teen su POKéMONid terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor2ndOpponent
en: The 2nd opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 2. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor3rdOpponent
en: The 3rd opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 3. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor4thOpponent
en: The 4th opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 4. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor5thOpponent
en: The 5th opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 5. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor6thOpponent
en: The 6th opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 6. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_PreparedFor7thOpponent
en: The 7th opponent is next. Are you prepared?
et: Järgmisena tuleb 7. vastane. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja lõpetada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_WishToQuitChallenge
en: Do you wish to quit your challenge?
et: Kas soovid väljakutse pooleli jätta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SavingData
en: Saving the data. Have patience…
et: Salvestan andmeid. Pisut kannatust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_RecordLastMatch
en: Do you wish to record your latest match on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas soovid oma viimase matši FRONTIER PASSile salvestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ChallengingPalaceMaven
en: And now…
et: Ja nüüd…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ChallengingPalaceMaven
en: By winning consistently, you have earned the privilege of challenging our master, the PALACE MAVEN…
et: Järjepidevate võitudega oled välja teeninud õiguse kutsuda välja meie meister PALACE MAVEN…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForPalaceMaven
en: I shall send for the PALACE MAVEN. Are you ready?
et: Kutsun PALACE MAVENI kohale. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_AnnounceArrivalOfSpenser
en: Let great fanfare announce the arrival of the PALACE MAVEN, SPENSER!
et: Kõlagu fanfaarid — saabub PALACE MAVEN SPENSER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
en: SPENSER: My physical being is with POKéMON always!
et: SPENSER: Minu ihu on alati POKéMONide juures!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
en: My heart beats as one with POKéMON always!
et: Minu süda tuksub alati ühes taktis POKéMONidega!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
en: Young one of a TRAINER! Do you believe in your POKéMON?
et: Noor TRAINER! Kas sa usud oma POKéMONidesse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
en: Can you believe them through and through?
et: Kas usud neid läbi ja lõhki?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserFirstIntro
en: If your bonds of trust are frail, you will never beat my brethren!
et: Kui usaldusside on nõrk, ei võida sa iial minu vendi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ProveYourBondWithMons
en: The bond you share with your POKéMON! Prove it to me here!
et: Sinu side oma POKéMONidega! Tõesta seda mulle siinsamas!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
en: SPENSER: Gwahahah!
et: SPENSER: Gvahahaa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
en: Hah, you never fell for my bluster! Sorry for trying that stunt!
et: Hah, sa ei läinud mu kõmisemise õnge! Vabandust selle vembu eest!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserPostSilverBattle
en: Here! Bring me the thing!
et: Hei! Tooge mulle see asi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeFrontierPass
en: My, my, if only you could maintain that facade of distinguished authority…
et: Oh heldust, kui te vaid suudaksite seda väärikat hoiakut lõpuni kanda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeFrontierPass
en: Here! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS!
et: Nii! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedSpiritsSymbol
en: The Spirits Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Spirits-sümbol pressiti FRONTIER PASSile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
en: SPENSER: Your POKéMON's eyes are truly clear and unclouded.
et: SPENSER: Sinu POKéMONide pilk on tõesti selge ja puhas.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserAwaitNextTime
en: I will eagerly await the next opportunity to see you.
et: Ootan pikisilmi järgmist kohtumist.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
en: SPENSER: Gwahahah! You've battled your way up again?
et: SPENSER: Gvahahaa! Oled end taas siia välja võidelnud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
en: You must have developed a truly formidable bond with your POKéMON.
et: Side sinu ja su POKéMONide vahel peab olema tõeliselt vägev.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
en: So be it!
et: Olgu nii!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
en: This time, I won't bluster or hold back. This time, there's no fooling around.
et: Seekord ma ei kõmise ega hoia end tagasi. Seekord ei ole nalja.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserThisTimeWontHoldBack
en: Ready now? Prepare to lose!
et: Valmis? Valmistu kaotuseks!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_Kaaah
en: … … …Kaaah!
et: … … …Kaaah!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
en: SPENSER: Well, that was some display! Even fully unleashed, my brethren could not overpower you.
et: SPENSER: Vaat see oli alles vaatemäng! Isegi täiel jõul ei suutnud mu vennad sind murda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
en: Your team spirit is truly admirable!
et: Sinu meeskonnavaim on tõeliselt imetlusväärne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserYourTeamIsAdmirable
en: Here! Bring me that thing, will you?
et: Hei! Tooge mulle see asi, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
en: My, my, if only you could maintain a certain level of decorum…
et: Oh heldust, kui te vaid natukenegi väärikust hoiaksite…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_HurryWithFrontierPass
en: Gaaah, here! Hurry with that FRONTIER PASS, you!
et: Ahh, nii! Kärmemini selle FRONTIER PASSiga!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpiritsSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Spirits Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Spirits-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
en: SPENSER: Gwahahah!
et: SPENSER: Gvahahaa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceBattleRoom_Text_SpenserComeSeeMeAgain
en: Come see me time and again! My brethren and I will be waiting!
et: Tule mind ikka ja jälle vaatama! Mina ja mu vennad ootame!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RestoreMonsToFullHealth
en: We will restore your POKéMON to full health.
et: Me teeme su POKéMONid täiesti terveks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. {STR_VAR_1}. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr {STR_VAR_1}. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor2ndOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 2. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 2. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor3rdOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 3. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 3. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor4thOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 4. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 4. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor5thOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 5. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 5. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor6thOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 6. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 6. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyFor7thOpponent
en: You will be facing opponent no. 7. Are you ready?
et: Vastu astub vastane nr 7. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordYourBattle
en: Record your battle on your FRONTIER PASS?
et: Kas salvestada lahing FRONTIER PASSile?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_BattleRecordedOnPass
en: {PLAYER}'s battle was recorded on the FRONTIER PASS.
et: {PLAYER} lahing salvestati FRONTIER PASSile.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SaveAndQuitGame
en: Would you like to save and quit the game?
et: Kas soovid mängu salvestada ja lõpetada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SavingPleaseWait
en: Saving your battle data. Please wait.
et: Salvestan su lahinguandmeid. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_CancelYourChallenge
en: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE ROOM challenge?
et: Kas soovid BATTLE ROOMI väljakutse katkestada?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_RecordCouldntBeSaved
en: There was an error of some sort. Your record could not be saved.
et: Tekkis mingi viga. Su tulemust ei õnnestunud salvestada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
en: Excuse me, but…
et: Vabandust, aga…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
en: Our leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on her way here in hopes of battling you.
et: Meie juht SALON MAIDEN on teel siia — ta loodab sinuga lahingut pidada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_SalonMaidenOnHerWay
en: She should be arriving very shortly.
et: Ta peaks kohe-kohe kohale jõudma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReadyForSalonMaiden
en: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN. Are you prepared?
et: Vastu astub SALON MAIDEN. Kas oled valmis?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
en: Greetings… My name is ANABEL.
et: Tervist… Minu nimi on ANABEL.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
en: I am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…
et: Mina olen SALON MAIDEN ja minu hoole all on BATTLE TOWER…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
en: I have heard several rumors about you…
et: Ma olen sinu kohta mõndagi kuulnud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
en: In all honesty, what I have heard does not seem attractive in any way…
et: Ausalt öeldes ei kõla kuuldu kuidagi ahvatlevalt…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_GreetingsImAnabel
en: The reason I've come to see you… Well, there is but one reason…
et: Miks ma sind vaatama tulin… Noh, põhjus on ainult üks…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetMeSeeYourTalent
en: Let me see your talent in its entirety…
et: Näita mulle kogu oma annet…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
en: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…
et: ANABEL: Fufufu, kenasti tehtud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelTalentShallBeRecognized
en: Your FRONTIER PASS, please… Your talent shall be recognized.
et: Sinu FRONTIER PASS, palun… Sinu anne saab tunnustuse.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedAbilitySymbol
en: The Ability Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Ability-sümbol pressiti FRONTIER PASSile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
en: You have confidence in your POKéMON battling talent, don't you?
et: Sa usud oma osavusse POKéMON-lahingutes, kas pole?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
en: I urge you to keep battling and keep on winning.
et: Soovitan sul edasi võidelda ja edasi võita.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_UntilNextTime
en: I will be waiting for you. Until the next time we meet…
et: Ma ootan sind. Kuni järgmise kohtumiseni…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
en: ANABEL: You really did come back to see me…
et: ANABEL: Sa tulidki tõesti mind jälle vaatama…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
en: You've won straight matches to see me… I won't have to hold back against you…
et: Sa võitsid kõik matšid järjest, et minuni jõuda… Sinu vastu ei pea ma end tagasi hoidma…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
en: It's been too long now…
et: Sellest on liiga kaua möödas…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelYouCameBack
en: Too long since I've been able to battle without thinking about anything…
et: Liiga kaua pole ma saanud võidelda nii, et ei pea millelegi mõtlema…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_LetsBeginShallWe
en: Let's begin, shall we?
et: Alustame siis, eks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AnabelCongratsYourPassPlease
en: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations… Your FRONTIER PASS, please…
et: ANABEL: Fufu, palju õnne… Sinu FRONTIER PASS, palun…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_AbilitySymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Ability Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Ability-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
en: That was fun…
et: See oli lõbus…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
en: I have never had a POKéMON battle so enjoyable before…
et: Nii nauditavat POKéMON-lahingut pole mul varem olnud…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Text_WishICouldBattleYouAgain
en: I wish I could battle with you again…
et: Tahaksin sinuga veel kord võidelda…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInterviewsAiring
en: I wonder if they'll be airing interviews with tough TRAINERS today?
et: Huvitav, kas täna näidatakse kõvade TRAINERITE intervjuusid?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRestaurantHere
en: If I opened a restaurant here, it'd make money for sure.
et: Kui ma siia restorani avaksin, teeniks see kindla peale raha.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
en: Whew…
et: Puhh…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
en: I need to take a breather after some intense battles…
et: Pärast paari ägedat lahingut on vaja hinge tõmmata…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreatherAfterBattles
en: But even now, I never take a break from plotting strategy and combos.
et: Aga isegi praegu ei tee ma pausi strateegiate ja kombinatsioonide nuputamisest.

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
en: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.
et: TRAINERI KOOL on suurepärane.

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolExcellent
en: If you study there, you could even become a GYM LEADER.
et: Kui seal õpid, võid isegi SAALI JUHIKS saada.

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
en: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows a lot about POKéMON.
et: SAALI JUHT ROXANNE teab POKéMONide kohta tõesti palju.

label: RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALot
en: She's really strong, too!
et: Ja tugev on ta ka!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
en: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm taking a look around.
et: Selliseid laevu näeb harva, seepärast vaatangi ringi.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookAround
en: Hmhm… There appear to be other cabins…
et: Hmhm… Paistab, et kajuteid on veel…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro
en: What on earth would compel you to come here? You must be curious!
et: Mis sind küll siia tõi? Küll sa oled uudishimulik!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat
en: Not just curious, but also strong…
et: Mitte ainult uudishimulik, vaid ka tugev…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
en: The man next door…
et: See mees kõrvaltoas…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBattle
en: He says he's just sightseeing, but I don't know about that.
et: Ta ütleb, et lihtsalt vaatab ringi, aga mine tea.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegister
en: You're such a tough TRAINER! Let me register you as a memento!
et: Oled ikka kõva TRAINER! Las ma panen su mälestuseks kirja!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchIntro
en: What on earth would compel you to come back? You must really be curious!
et: Mis sind küll tagasi tõi? Küll sa oled ikka uudishimulik!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematchDefeat
en: Aren't you too strong?
et: Oled sa liiga tugev või?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRematch
en: I'm sure that man's up to something! He just acts so suspiciously!
et: Olen kindel, et see mees hauab midagi! Ta käitub nii kahtlaselt!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusIntro
en: Waaah! I've been found! …Huh?
et: Ojoo! Mind leiti üles! …Ää?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusDefeat
en: Oh, you're not my mom.
et: Oi, sa polegi mu ema.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPostBattle
en: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran. Keep it a secret where I am!
et: Ma sain emaga pahandust ja jooksin ära. Ära ütle kellelegi, kus ma olen!

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
en: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS…
et: MT. CHIMNEY JAGGED PASS…

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
en: Now this is what I've always wanted in a mountain.
et: Just sellist mäge olen ma alati tahtnud.

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro
en: This jagged bumpiness… It rocks my soul!
et: See sakiline konarlikkus… See paneb hinge värisema!

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricDefeat
en: Losing left me bitter!
et: Kaotus jättis mulle mõru maigu!

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
en: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…
et: Jah, POKéMONides ma kaotasin…

label: JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle
en: But, when it comes to the love of the mountains, I have you beat!
et: Aga mägede armastuses olen ma sinust üle!

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro
en: This place isn't your casual hike. It's not suited for a picnic.
et: See pole mingi tavaline jalutuskäik. Piknikuks siin kohta pole.

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat
en: Ohhh, no! The ground is too bumpy…
et: Ohhh ei! Maapind on liiga konarlik…

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle
en: Some people cleverly ride their bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.
et: Mõni sõidab osavalt jalgrattaga sellest kohutavalt konarlikust rajast üles.

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister
en: Will you ever be back in this area? If you do return, I'd like a rematch.
et: Kas sa tuled siia kanti veel? Kui tuled, tahaksin revanši.

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro
en: Picnics are fun wherever you go. Just like POKéMON!
et: Piknik on igal pool tore. Täpselt nagu POKéMONid!

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat
en: I only lost because the ground is too bumpy!
et: Ma kaotasin ainult sellepärast, et maa on nii konarlik!

label: JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch
en: I'll forget about losing and just enjoy this bumpy hike.
et: Unustan kaotuse ära ja naudin lihtsalt seda konarlikku matka.

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro
en: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on. It's a good place for training.
et: JAGGED PASSil on raske kõndida. Hea koht treenimiseks.

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat
en: It was all over while we were still trying to find a good footing…
et: Kõik oli läbi, kui me alles jalgealust otsisime…

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle
en: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to jump ledges.
et: Kui mul oleks ACRO BIKE, saaksin astangutest üle hüpata.

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister
en: When I get more used to this bumpiness, I'll be sure to win!
et: Kui ma nende konarustega rohkem harjun, siis ma kindlasti võidan!

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister
en: Can you register me in your POKéNAV?
et: Kas paned mu oma POKéNAVi kirja?

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro
en: I got used to this bumpiness. I sing while I climb now.
et: Ma olen nende konarustega harjunud. Nüüd ma isegi laulan ronides.

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat
en: It's still not easy to battle on this bumpy ground…
et: Sellisel konarlikul maal pole ikka veel kerge võidelda…

label: JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch
en: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL in MAUVILLE CITY…
et: Peaksin MAUVILLE LINNAS RYDELI käest endale ACRO BIKE muretsema…

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
en: Wah! What are you doing here?
et: Vah! Mida sina siin teed?

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
en: What am I doing in a place like this?
et: Mida mina sellises kohas teen?

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro
en: What business is it of yours?
et: Mis see sinu asi on?

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat
en: Urrrgh…
et: Urrrgh…

label: JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat
en: I should've ducked into our HIDEOUT right away…
et: Oleksin pidanud kohe oma PEIDIKUSSE pugema…

label: JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant
en: Okay, oh-kay! I admit it--you're strong!
et: Olgu, ol-gu! Tunnistan — sa oled tugev!

label: JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant
en: Don't worry about me. Go wherever you want!
et: Ära minust hooli. Mine kuhu tahad!

label: JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponseToEmblem
en: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response to the MAGMA EMBLEM!
et: Oi! See rahn hakkas MAGMA EMBLEMi peale värisema!

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro
en: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot down the mountain in one go!
et: Aiii! Ühe hooga mäest alla kihutada on kohutavalt hirmus!

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat
en: I feel like I'm falling apart…
et: Tunne, nagu laguneksin koost…

label: JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle
en: My bicycle bounced around so much, my rear end's sore…
et: Ratas hüppas nii palju, et tagumik on päris valus…

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro
en: I climb this hill every day. I have confidence in my strength!
et: Ma ronin siit mäest iga päev üles. Oma jõus ma ei kahtle!

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnDefeat
en: Hmm… What went wrong?
et: Hmm… Mis viltu läks?

label: JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle
en: What is that odd rock protrusion a little up the hill from here?
et: Mis veider kaljueend see natuke ülalpool on?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_CantYouSeeWereBusyHere
en: …What's that you want?
et: …Mida sa tahad?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_CantYouSeeWereBusyHere
en: Can't you see we're kind of busy here? Can't your business wait till later?
et: Kas sa ei näe, et meil on siin tegemist? Kas su asi ei kannata oodata?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: …Huh? You look to me like a tough TRAINER.
et: …Ää? Sa näed välja nagu kõva TRAINER.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: Heheh… Listen, I have this proposition.
et: Hehee… Kuula, mul oleks sulle üks pakkumine.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: We have a little group going here, and we play a little game with what goes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Meil on siin väike seltskond ja me mängime väikest mängu selle peale, mis BATTLE FRONTIERIS toimub.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: The rules are really simple.
et: Reeglid on üpris lihtsad.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: First, we pick one of the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Kõigepealt valime ühe BATTLE FRONTIERI rajatise.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: Then, we each pick a different TRAINER who's taking that facility's challenge, and bet with our Battle Points.
et: Siis valib igaüks endale ühe seal võistleva TRAINERI ja paneb oma Battle Pointid mängu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: The guy who bet on the TRAINER with the best record takes all the Battle Points in the pool.
et: Kelle TRAINER teeb parima tulemuse, see võtab kogu panga endale.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookToughExplainGambling
en: Sounds simple, huh? So, anyway…
et: Lihtne, eks? Nii et…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerSingle
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be challenging the BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb ette võtta BATTLE TOWERI SINGLE BATTLE ROOMID.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerSingle
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerDouble
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be challenging the BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb ette võtta BATTLE TOWERI DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMID.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerDouble
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerMulti
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be challenging the BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb ette võtta BATTLE TOWERI MULTI BATTLE ROOMID.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleTowerMulti
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleDomeSingle
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE DOME's SINGLE BATTLE Tourney.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb astuda BATTLE DOME SINGLE BATTLE turniirile.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleDomeSingle
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE DOME's DOUBLE BATTLE Tourney.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb astuda BATTLE DOME DOUBLE BATTLE turniirile.

en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleFactorySingle
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE FACTORY's Battle Swap Single Tourney.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb astuda BATTLE FACTORY Battle Swap üksikturniirile.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleFactorySingle
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleFactoryDouble
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE FACTORY's Battle Swap Double Tourney.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb astuda BATTLE FACTORY Battle Swap topeltturniirile.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleFactoryDouble
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePalaceSingle
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be challenging the BATTLE PALACE's SINGLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb ette võtta BATTLE PALACE SINGLE BATTLE HALLID.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePalaceSingle
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePalaceDouble
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be challenging the BATTLE PALACE's DOUBLE BATTLE HALLS.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb ette võtta BATTLE PALACE DOUBLE BATTLE HALLID.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePalaceDouble
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleArena
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE ARENA's Set KO Tourney.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERIT, kes kavatseb astuda BATTLE ARENA Set KO turniirile.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattleArena
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERIT, kellel oleks võitja hõngu.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePike
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE PIKE's Battle Choice.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERit, kes kavatseb osaleda BATTLE PIKE väljakutses Battle Choice.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePike
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERit, kes näeks välja nagu võitja.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePyramid
en: What I'm looking for is a TRAINER who's going to be entering the BATTLE PYRAMID's Battle Quest.
et: Ma otsin TRAINERit, kes kavatseb osaleda BATTLE PYRAMID väljakutses Battle Quest.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ChallengeBattlePyramid
en: But so far, I haven't seen a TRAINER that has that winning quality.
et: Aga seni pole ma näinud ühtegi TRAINERit, kes näeks välja nagu võitja.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowAboutEnteringEventForMe
en: I'll see to it that you benefit, too. So how about it? How about entering that event for me?
et: Hoolitsen selle eest, et sinagi kasu saad. No kuidas oleks? Kas läheksid minu eest sellele üritusele?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_SpotMeSomeBattlePoints
en: All right, that's perfect. So, uh… How about spotting me some of your Battle Points?
et: Hästi, see sobib suurepäraselt. Ja, öö… kas laenaksid mulle natuke oma Battle Pointe?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_SpotMeSomeBattlePoints
en: Trust me, I'll show you my gratitude afterward.
et: Usu mind, pärast ma tasun sulle kindlasti!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowMuchCanYouSpot
en: Great, great! So, how much can you spot me?
et: Tore, tore! Noh, kui palju sa mulle laenata saad?

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveEnoughPoints
en: Oh, no, no, no! You don't have enough Battle Points!
et: Oi ei, ei, ei! Sul pole piisavalt Battle Pointe!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveEnoughPoints
en: I wish you wouldn't monkey around and waste everyone's time!
et: Ära aja siin lolli ja raiska kõigi aega!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThanksOffYouGo
en: Heheh! Thanks much! So, off you go!
et: Hehee! Suur tänu! Nõnda, mine nüüd!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerSingle
en: Get to the BATTLE TOWER's SINGLE BATTLE ROOMS pronto!
et: Mine kohe BATTLE TOWERi ÜKSIKLAHINGU RUUMIDESSE!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerSingle
en: It's a must-win situation! Don't blow your chance! Both of our futures depend on you!
et: Seal tuleb tingimata võita! Ära lase võimalust käest! Meie mõlema tulevik sõltub sinust!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_GetToBattleTowerDouble
en: Get to the BATTLE TOWER's DOUBLE BATTLE ROOMS pronto!
et: Mine kohe BATTLE TOWERi TOPELTLAHINGU RUUMIDESSE!
