label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints
en: Oh, it's you… Nice try…
et: Oh, sina… Kena katse…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints
en: I hate to break it to you, but I can't return your Battle Points…
et: Mul on kahju seda öelda, aga ma ei saa sulle Battle Pointe tagasi anda…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantReturnPoints
en: I guess we'll have to let it motivate us to try harder next time!
et: Las see olla meile ajendiks, et järgmine kord veel kõvemini pingutada!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints
en: Oh, yes! Hello there, champ!
et: Oh, jaa! Tervist, meister!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints
en: I knew you could! I knew you would! We're both big winners!
et: Ma teadsin, et sa suudad! Teadsin, et sa teed ära! Me mõlemad oleme suured võitjad!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHeresYourPoints
en: I'll return your Battle Points and, of course, a little extra from me!
et: Annan su Battle Pointid tagasi ja muidugi veel pisut pealekauba!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ObtainedBattlePoints
en: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Points.
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_1} Battle Pointi.

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThinkOfMeForAnotherChallenge
en: If you're up for another challenge, please do think of me!
et: Kui tahad jälle väljakutset vastu võtta, siis pea mind meeles!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NotInterested
en: Not interested?! You shouldn't be so afraid to take a chance!
et: Ei huvita või?! Ära karda riskida!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_Oh
en: Oh…
et: Oh…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_BackedWrongTrainer
en: I backed the wrong TRAINER again!
et: Ma panin jälle valele TRAINERile!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_BackedWrongTrainer
en: Maybe I should be battling normally like everyone else…
et: Võib-olla peaksin lihtsalt ise võitlema, nagu kõik teised…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled
en: That TRAINER…
et: See TRAINER…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodButRattled
en: He's good, but he gets rattled too easily to survive the BATTLE DOME…
et: Ta on hea, aga läheb liiga kergesti närvi, et BATTLE DOME katsumust üle elada…

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWhenISeeOne
en: Giggle! I know a winner when I see one!
et: Hihii! Ma tunnen võitja kohe ära!

label: BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTakingChallenges
en: Those TRAINERS… What are they doing? They should be taking challenges.
et: Need TRAINERid… Mida nad õige teevad? Nad peaksid väljakutseid vastu võtma.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
en: Hey, you. It gets awfully dark ahead. It'll be tough trying to explore.
et: Kuule, sina! Edasi läheb hirmus pimedaks. Seal on raske ringi uidata.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
en: That guy who came by earlier… STEVEN, I think it was.
et: See mees, kes enne siit läbi läks… STEVEN, kui ma õigesti mäletan.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
en: He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought to be all right, but…
et: Tema oskas kasutada FLASH, nii et temaga peaks kõik korras olema, aga…

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
en: Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those that we meet is our motto.
et: Noh, meil HIKERitel on selline moto: aita kõiki, keda teel kohtad.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYouGo
en: Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.
et: Säh, võta see endale!

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
en: Teach that hidden move FLASH to a POKéMON and use it.
et: Õpeta see peidetud võte FLASH mõnele POKéMONile ja kasuta seda.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
en: It lights up even the inky darkness of caves.
et: See valgustab ära isegi koobaste pilkase pimeduse.

label: GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash
en: But, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.
et: Aga selle kasutamiseks on sul vaja SAALIMÄRKI DEWFORD LINNA POKéMON SAALIST.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
en: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather, and its winds are stable.
et: MOSSDEEP LINNAS on enamasti päikesepaisteline ilm ja tuuled püsivad ühtlased.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MossdeepIdealForRockets
en: It's an ideal location for launching rockets.
et: See on ideaalne asukoht rakettide startimiseks.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWouldMagmaStealRocketFuel
en: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal our rocket fuel in the first place?
et: Miks üldse tahaks TEAM MAGMA meie raketikütust varastada?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
en: If only I was a little younger, I would have liked being an astronaut…
et: Kui ma vaid oleksin pisut noorem, oleksin hea meelega astronaudiks hakanud…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WouldveLikedToBeAstronaut
en: No… It's not too late! I can and will try!
et: Ei… Pole veel hilja! Ma suudan ja ma proovin!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
en: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel, I won't be able to go to space!
et: Kui TEAM MAGMA raketikütuse ära viib, ei pääse ma iial kosmosesse!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCantGetAwayWithThis
en: They can't be allowed to get away with such an outrage!
et: Sellist jultumust ei tohi neile andeks anda!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrdinaryPeopleCouldGoIntoSpace
en: I wish ordinary people could go into space one day…
et: Küll oleks tore, kui ka tavalised inimesed kunagi kosmosesse pääseksid…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMagmaWantToGoToSpace
en: TEAM MAGMA… Do they want to go to space, too?
et: TEAM MAGMA… Kas nemadki tahavad kosmosesse minna?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
en: What's wrong with you?
et: Mis sul viga on?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOutnumberedTakeUsOn
en: You're outnumbered three to one, but you still want to take us on?
et: Meid on kolm ühe vastu, aga sa tahad ikka jõudu katsuda?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAnswer
en: Good answer! That's what a smart person'll do!
et: Hea vastus! Nii teebki tark inimene!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: A reckless go-getter, are you? Okay, I'll go first!
et: Uljas pealehakkaja, mis? Olgu, mina alustan!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: I lost! But!
et: Ma kaotasin! Aga!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: It's too soon to be relieved! I'm up next!
et: Liiga vara on kergendust tunda! Nüüd tulen mina!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
en: I lost, too! But!
et: Minagi kaotasin! Aga!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: I bet you want to take a break. But I'm not about to let you do that!
et: Küllap tahaksid hinge tõmmata. Aga seda ma sul teha ei lase!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
en: We should've taken a break… That's what we should've done…
et: Me oleksime pidanud puhkama… Just seda me oleksime pidanud tegema…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: Three of us here, and look at the sorry mess we got ourselves into.
et: Meid oli siin kolm — ja vaata nüüd, kui haledalt me sisse kukkusime.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: We three losing like this… We look worse than usual by triple!
et: Kõik kolm kaotasime… Nüüd näeme kolm korda hullemad välja kui tavaliselt!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Are we being useful to our leader at all?
et: Kas meist on meie juhile üldse mingit kasu?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
en: We come all the way here to get some fuel, and we're interfered with again!
et: Tulime terve selle maa taha kütust hankima ja jälle jäädakse meile jalgu!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTakeCareOfYou
en: If you're going to mess with us too, we'll take care of you at the same time!
et: Kui sinagi kavatsed meile tüli teha, siis saad kohe ühtlasi ka ise!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDontInterfere
en: MAXIE: Clear out of the way! Don't you dare interfere!
et: MAXIE: Eest ära! Ära julge vahele segada!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenWhyStealRocketFuel
en: STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…
et: STEVEN: TEAM MAGMA…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenWhyStealRocketFuel
en: What's the point of stealing rocket fuel?
et: Mis mõte on raketikütust varastada?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
en: MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so curious, you deserve an explanation.
et: MAXIE: Fufufu… Kuna sa nii uudishimulik oled, väärid sa selgitust.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
en: We're going to jettison the entire load into MT. CHIMNEY!
et: Me paiskame kogu lasti MT. CHIMNEY kraatrisse!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
en: With GROUDON gone, we have no need for that slag heap of a mountain!
et: Nüüd, kui GROUDON on läinud, pole meil seda räbuhunnikust mäge enam vaja!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
en: So we'll use the fuel's power to make the volcano erupt!
et: Nii et me paneme kütuse jõul vulkaani purskama!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUseFuelToEruptVolcano
en: It will be savage!
et: See tuleb metsik vaatepilt!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
en: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! You're going to help me?
et: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kas sa aitad mind?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenAreYouReadyToBattle
en: Let's go into battle together! Are you ready?
et: Lähme koos lahingusse! Oled valmis?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenHurryGetReadyQuickly
en: STEVEN: Then, hurry! Get ready quickly!
et: STEVEN: Siis kiirusta! Tee end ruttu valmis!

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWantToExpandLand
en: All I want… I just want to expand the land mass…
et: Ma tahan ainult… Ma tahan ainult maismaad suuremaks teha…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: I'm with our leader…
et: Mina olen oma juhi poolt…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
en: MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano erupt…
et: MAXIE: Me ei suutnud vulkaani purskama panna…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
en: We failed to control GROUDON after we had awoken it…
et: Me äratasime GROUDONi üles, aga ei suutnud teda ohjata…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
en: Is our goal to expand the land misguided?
et: Kas meie eesmärk maismaad laiendada on ekslik?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
en: If… If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong… … … … … … …
et: Kui… Kui meie, TEAM MAGMA, eksime… … … … … … …

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeFailedIsAquaAlsoMisguided
en: Then might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand the sea also be equally misguided?
et: Kas siis on ka TEAM AQUA eesmärk merd laiendada sama ekslik?

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
en: MAXIE: All right… We will give up on the fuel…
et: MAXIE: Hea küll… Me loobume kütusest…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWeWillGiveUp
en: There appear to be more important matters that I must examine…
et: Näib, et on tähtsamaid asju, mille üle pean järele mõtlema…

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
en: STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense. {PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.
et: STEVEN: Ohoo, see oli alles pingeline. {PLAYER}{KUN}, aitäh sulle.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
en: I have something to give you as thanks for your support.
et: Mul on sulle abi eest midagi tänuks anda.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
en: Please come see me at home after this.
et: Tule pärast mulle koju külla.

label: MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenThankYouComeSeeMeAtHome
en: Oh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY. I live right here on this island.
et: Ah jaa, ma ei ela RUSTBORO LINNAS. Ma elan siinsamas sellel saarel.

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarReadyGetOn
en: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down. Would you like to be on it?
et: KÖISRAUDTEE on valmis alla sõitma. Kas soovid peale tulla?

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_StepThisWay
en: Please step this way.
et: Palun astu siiapoole.

label: MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnotherTime
en: Please ride with us another time.
et: Tule mõni teine kord jälle meiega sõitma!

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItemsBestForTougheningPokemon
en: For quickly toughening up POKéMON, items are the best.
et: POKéMONide kiireks karastamiseks on esemed parimad.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_ItemsBestForTougheningPokemon
en: PROTEIN boosts ATTACK, and CALCIUM raises SP. ATK.
et: PROTEIN tõstab RÜNNAKUT ja CALCIUM tõstab ER. RÜNNAKUT.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_WantMoreEndurance
en: I want my POKéMON to have more endurance.
et: Tahaks, et mu POKéMON peaks rohkem vastu.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_WantMoreEndurance
en: I'm trying to decide whether to raise DEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.
et: Ma ei oska otsustada, kas tõsta KAITSET IRONiga või ER. KAITSET ZINCiga.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_GaveCarbosToSpeedUpMon
en: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON, and its SPEED went up.
et: Andsin oma POKéMONile eseme CARBOS ja tema KIIRUS tõusis.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
en: Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?
et: Ähh? PROF. BIRCH?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
en: The PROF's away on fieldwork. Ergo, he isn't here.
et: PROF on välitöödel. Järelikult teda siin ei ole.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
en: Oh, let me explain what fieldwork is.
et: Oot, ma seletan, mis asi on välitöö.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
en: It is to study things in the natural environment, like fields and mountains, instead of a laboratory.
et: See tähendab, et asju uuritakse labori asemel looduses, näiteks väljadel ja mägedes.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchAwayOnFieldwork
en: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work. He's the type of person who would rather go outside and experience things than read about them here.
et: PROF pole mingi lauataguse töö mees. Ta läheb pigem ise välja ja kogeb kõike, selle asemel et siin neist lugeda.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchIsntOneForDeskWork
en: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work. He's the type of person who would rather go outside and experience things than read about them here.
et: PROF pole mingi lauataguse töö mees. Ta läheb pigem ise välja ja kogeb kõike, selle asemel et siin neist lugeda.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
en: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats and distribution of POKéMON.
et: PROF. BIRCH uurib POKéMONide elupaiku ja levikut.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchEnjoysRivalsHelpToo
en: The PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too. There's a lot of love there.
et: PROFile meeldib, kui {RIVAL} teda aitab. Nende vahel on palju armastust.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: PROF. BIRCH: So, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Niisiis, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: I've heard so much about you from your father.
et: Su isa on mulle sinust nii palju rääkinud.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: I've heard that you don't have your own POKéMON yet.
et: Kuulsin, et sul pole veel oma POKéMONi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: But the way you battled earlier, you pulled it off with aplomb!
et: Aga see, kuidas sa äsja võitlesid — sa said sellega suurepäraselt hakkama!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: I guess you have your father's blood in your veins after all!
et: Küllap on sul ikkagi isa veri soontes!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: Oh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me, I'd like you to have the POKéMON you used earlier.
et: Ahjaa! Tänuks päästmise eest jäägu see POKéMON, keda sa enne kasutasid, sinule.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_LikeYouToHavePokemon
en: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_1}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_WhyNotGiveNicknameToMon
en: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not give a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?
et: PROF. BIRCH: Kui juba, siis anna sellele POKéMONile {STR_VAR_1} kohe ka hüüdnimi!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
en: PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON and gain experience, I think you'll make an extremely good TRAINER.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Kui POKéMONidega tegeled ja kogemusi kogud, saab sinust minu arvates väga hea TRAINER.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
en: My kid, {RIVAL}, is also studying POKéMON while helping me out.
et: Ka minu laps {RIVAL} uurib POKéMONe ja aitab mind samal ajal.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MightBeGoodIdeaToGoSeeRival
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't you think it might be a good idea to go see {RIVAL}?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, äkki oleks hea mõte minna {RIVAL} juurde?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
en: PROF. BIRCH: Great! {RIVAL} should be happy, too.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Tore! Küllap on ka {RIVAL} rõõmus.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GetRivalToTeachYou
en: Get {RIVAL} to teach you what it means to be a TRAINER.
et: Palu, et {RIVAL} õpetaks sulle, mida tähendab olla TRAINER.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontBeThatWay
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way. You should go meet my kid.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, ära ole nii. Mine ikka minu lapsega kohtuma.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
en: PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}? Gone home, I think.
et: PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}? Vist läks koju.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
en: Or maybe that kid's scrabbling around in tall grass again somewhere…
et: Või siis tuhnib see laps jälle kuskil kõrges rohus…

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BirchRivalGoneHome
en: If you or your POKéMON get tired, you should get some rest at home.
et: Kui sina või su POKéMONid ära väsite, minge kodus puhkama.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
en: I heard you beat {RIVAL} on your first try. That's excellent!
et: Kuulsin, et alistasid {RIVAL} juba esimesel katsel. Suurepärane!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
en: {RIVAL}'s been helping with my research for a long time.
et: {RIVAL} on mind uurimistöös juba kaua aidanud.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
en: {RIVAL} has an extensive history as a TRAINER already.
et: {RIVAL} on TRAINERina juba päris pika staažiga.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeardYouBeatRivalTakePokedex
en: Here, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I ordered this for my research, but I think you should have this POKéDEX.
et: Võta, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Tellisin selle POKéDEXi oma uurimistöö jaoks, aga arvan, et sina vajad seda rohkem.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedPokedex
en: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX!
et: {PLAYER} sai POKéDEXi!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
en: PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech tool that automatically makes a record of any POKéMON you meet or catch.
et: PROF. BIRCH: POKéDEX on nutikas seade, mis paneb automaatselt kirja iga POKéMONi, keda sa kohtad või püüad.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
en: My kid, {RIVAL}, goes everywhere with it.
et: Minu laps {RIVAL} käib sellega kõikjal kaasas.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ExplainPokedex
en: Whenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON and records its data in the POKéDEX, why, {RIVAL} looks for me while I'm out doing fieldwork, and shows me.
et: Iga kord, kui mu laps mõne haruldase POKéMONi püüab ja andmed POKéDEXi salvestab, otsib {RIVAL} mu välitöödelt üles ja näitab uhkusega ette.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
en: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON await you!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Sind ootavad lugematud POKéMONid!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CountlessPokemonAwait
en: Argh, I'm getting the itch to get out and do fieldwork again!
et: Ah, mul hakkavad jalad jälle välitööde järele sügelema!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
en: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}! You got a POKéDEX, too!
et: MAY: Ohoo, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sinagi said POKéDEXi!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayGotPokedexTooTakeThese
en: That's great! Just like me! I've got something for you, too!
et: Vahva! Nagu minulgi! Mul on sulle ka midagi!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
en: MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of POKéMON!
et: MAY: Kui POKéMONe palju koguda, on hirmus lõbus!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
en: I'm going to look all over the place because I want different POKéMON.
et: Mina kavatsen igalt poolt otsida, sest tahan igasuguseid POKéMONe.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCutePokemonWithPokeBalls
en: If I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch them with POKé BALLS!
et: Kui leian mõne nunnu POKéMONi, püüan ta POKé PALLIDEGA kinni!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OhYourBagsFull
en: Oh? Your BAG's full.
et: Oh? Su KOTT on täis.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
en: MAY: I wonder where I should go look for POKéMON next?
et: MAY: Huvitav, kust ma järgmisena POKéMONe otsima peaksin?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
en: BRENDAN: Huh… So you got a POKéDEX, too.
et: BRENDAN: Häh… Nii et sinagi said POKéDEXi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanGotPokedexTooTakeThese
en: Well then, here. I'll give you these.
et: No siis säh — need on sulle.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
en: BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to have a whole bunch of POKéMON.
et: BRENDAN: Tead ju, et terve hunnik POKéMONe on palju lõbusam.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
en: I'm going to explore all over the place to find different POKéMON.
et: Mina kavatsen kõik kohad läbi uurida, et leida igasuguseid POKéMONe.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CatchCoolPokemonWithPokeBalls
en: If I find any cool POKéMON, you bet I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.
et: Kui leian mõne ägeda POKéMONi, siis kindel see, et püüan ta POKé PALLIDEGA kinni.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_HeyYourBagsFull
en: Hey, your BAG's full.
et: Kuule, su KOTT on täis.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
en: BRENDAN: Where should I look for POKéMON next…
et: BRENDAN: Kust ma järgmisena POKéMONe otsiks…

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_SeriousLookingMachine
en: It's a serious-looking machine. The PROF must use this for research.
et: Tõsise väljanägemisega masin. Küllap PROF kasutab seda uurimistööks.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PCUsedForResearch
en: It's a PC used for research. Better not mess around with it.
et: See on uurimistöö ARVUTI. Parem sellega mitte jamada.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CrammedWithBooksOnPokemon
en: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.
et: See on POKéMONide raamatuid puupüsti täis.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BookTooHardToRead
en: It's a book that's too hard to read.
et: Raamat, mis on lugemiseks liiga keeruline.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: PROF. BIRCH: Now…
et: PROF. BIRCH: Niisiis…

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: {PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two of you help me study POKéMON.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN} ja {RIVAL}, te mõlemad olete mind POKéMONide uurimisel aidanud.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: Thanks to your help, new facts are coming to light.
et: Tänu teie abile on hakanud ilmsiks tulema uued teadmised.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: It appears that in the HOENN region, there are also POKéMON from other regions.
et: Näib, et HOENNi piirkonnas elab ka POKéMONe teistest piirkondadest.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: It goes to show how rich and varied the natural environments of HOENN happen to be.
et: See näitab, kui rikkalik ja mitmekesine HOENNi loodus tegelikult on.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: That's why I think it's necessary for me to upgrade your POKéDEX to the NATIONAL Mode.
et: Seepärast arvan, et su POKéDEX tuleks uuendada NATIONAL-režiimile.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OtherRegionsUpgradeToNational
en: Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.
et: Nii, näidake oma POKéDEXe siia.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
en: MAY: Eheheh!
et: MAY: Ehehe!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
en: It's so cool that even my POKéDEX is getting updated!
et: Nii lahe, et isegi minu POKéDEX uuendatakse!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayUpgradeSoCool
en: It's because you went out and caught so many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Ja seda kõike sellepärast, et sina nii palju POKéMONe püüdsid, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
en: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN and checked out POKéMON.
et: BRENDAN: Mina käisin kogu HOENNi läbi ja uurisin POKéMONe.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
en: You can thank me for getting the NATIONAL Mode POKéDEX.
et: Nii et NATIONAL-režiimi POKéDEXi eest võid mind tänada.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanYouCanThankMe
en: Yep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!
et: Jaa, sul on vedanud, {PLAYER}!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_OkayAllDone
en: PROF. BIRCH: Okay, all done!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Nii, valmis sai!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PokedexUpgradedToNational
en: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded to the NATIONAL Mode!
et: {PLAYER} POKéDEX uuendati NATIONAL-režiimile!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
en: PROF. BIRCH: But listen. You've become the CHAMPION, but your POKéMON journey isn't over.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Aga kuula. Sinust on saanud MEISTER, aga su teekond POKéMONide maailmas pole veel läbi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
en: There is no end to the road that is POKéMON.
et: POKéMONide teel pole lõppu.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting2
en: Somewhere, there is a grassy patch that's waiting for you!
et: Kuskil ootab sind uus rohulapp!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
en: MAY: I think I'll take a short break from fieldwork.
et: MAY: Vist teen välitöödest väikese pausi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayTakeBreakFromFieldwork
en: I think I'll help the PROF here for a while.
et: Küllap aitan mõnda aega siin PROFi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
en: BRENDAN: For the time being, I'm taking a break from fieldwork.
et: BRENDAN: Esialgu teen ma välitöödest pausi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanTakeBreakFromFieldwork
en: I'll be helping out the PROF here for a while.
et: Ma aitan mõnda aega siin PROFi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Let's have a look at your POKéDEX.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Vaatame su POKéDEXi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: Yes, there's no doubt about it.
et: Jah, selles pole kahtlust.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: You really have completed the HOENN region's POKéDEX.
et: Sa oled tõesti HOENNi piirkonna POKéDEXi täis saanud.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: That's more than just impressive.
et: See on enam kui muljetavaldav.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: I have a gift for you.
et: Mul on sulle kingitus.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: Consider it my show of appreciation for the fantastic work you've done.
et: Olgu see minu tänu selle suurepärase töö eest, mille oled ära teinud.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: My gift is a rare POKéMON only found in another region!
et: Minu kingitus on haruldane POKéMON, keda leiab ainult ühest teisest piirkonnast!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CompletedDexChoosePokemon
en: You can have any one of these three POKéMON!
et: Võid valida ükskõik millise neist kolmest POKéMONist!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
en: PROF. BIRCH: These are rare POKéMON only found in another region!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Need on haruldased POKéMONid, keda leiab ainult ühest teisest piirkonnast!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_CanHaveAnyOneOfRarePokemon
en: You can have any one of these three POKéMON!
et: Võid valida ükskõik millise neist kolmest POKéMONist!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
en: PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON CYNDAQUIL caught your eye!
et: PROF. BIRCH: TULE-POKéMON CYNDAQUIL püüdis su pilku!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
en: You're as sharp as ever!
et: Sa oled terane nagu ikka!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeCyndaquil
en: So the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?
et: Niisiis, sinu valik on CYNDAQUIL?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
en: PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON TOTODILE is your choice!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Sinu valik on VEE-POKéMON TOTODILE!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
en: You know how to pick a good one.
et: Sa oskad küll head valida.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeTotodile
en: So, you'll take the TOTODILE?
et: Niisiis, sa võtad TOTODILE?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
en: PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON CHIKORITA is your choice!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Sinu valik on ROHU-POKéMON CHIKORITA!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
en: You sure know what you're doing.
et: Sa tead küll, mida teed.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_YoullTakeChikorita
en: So, you'll take the CHIKORITA?
et: Niisiis, sa võtad CHIKORITA?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_TakeYourTimeAllInvaluable
en: PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before you decide.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Võta aega, enne kui otsustad.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_TakeYourTimeAllInvaluable
en: They're all invaluable POKéMON.
et: Nad kõik on hindamatud POKéMONid.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_PickedFinePokemon
en: PROF. BIRCH: I see! You picked a fine POKéMON!
et: PROF. BIRCH: Vaat kus tubli! Valisid suurepärase POKéMONi!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ReceivedJohtoStarter
en: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1} from PROF. BIRCH!
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_1}, mille kinkis PROF. BIRCH!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_NicknameJohtoStarter
en: Want to give a nickname to the {STR_VAR_1} you received?
et: Kas tahad oma uuele POKéMONile {STR_VAR_1} hüüdnime anda?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
en: PROF. BIRCH: Listen, {PLAYER}{KUN}. You've completed the HOENN POKéDEX, but your POKéMON journey isn't over.
et: PROF. BIRCH: Kuula, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Sa oled HOENNi POKéDEXi täis saanud, aga su teekond POKéMONide maailmas pole veel läbi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
en: There is no end to the road that is POKéMON.
et: POKéMONide teel pole lõppu.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_GrassyPatchWaiting
en: Somewhere, there is a grassy patch that's waiting for you!
et: Kuskil ootab sind uus rohulapp!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BetterLeaveOthersAlone
en: You received the promised POKéMON. Better leave the others alone.
et: Lubatud POKéMONi sa juba said. Jäta teised parem rahule.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForPokemon
en: Oh, you don't have any room for this POKéMON.
et: Oh, sul pole selle POKéMONi jaoks ruumi.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this… What are you going to do?
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mis sa nüüd edasi teed?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
en: Are you going to keep battling and sharpening your skills?
et: Kas jätkad võitlemist ja lihvid oma oskusi?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
en: Or are you going to try filling the NATIONAL POKéDEX?
et: Või üritad NATIONAL POKéDEXi täis saada?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayWhatNextImStayingHere
en: I'm staying here to help the PROF.
et: Mina jään siia PROFi aitama.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanPreferCollectingSlowly
en: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting POKéMON, I prefer slowly and steadily raising the one I chose.
et: BRENDAN: POKéMONide kogumise asemel meeldib mulle pigem tasapisi ja kindlalt kasvatada seda üht, kelle ma valisin.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_MayHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
en: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Have you gone to that place, the BATTLE FRONTIER?
et: MAY: Oo, tere, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Kas oled juba käinud selles kohas nimega BATTLE FRONTIER?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_BrendanHaveYouGoneToBattleFrontier
en: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}! Have you gone out to that place, the BATTLE FRONTIER?
et: BRENDAN: Hei, {PLAYER}! Kas oled juba käinud selles kohas nimega BATTLE FRONTIER?

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}! It's me, SCOTT.
et: SCOTT: Tere-tere, {PLAYER}! Mina siin, SCOTT.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: I'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now. It feels great to be on the sea!
et: Olen praegu laeva S.S. TIDAL pardal. Merel on ikka vahva tunne!

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: By the way…
et: Muide…

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: There's this place that I'd like to invite you to for a visit.
et: On üks koht, kuhu tahaksin sind külla kutsuda.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: If you're interested, board a ferry at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.
et: Kui huvi on, astu praamile kas SLATEPORT või LILYCOVE sadamas.

label: LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_ScottAboardSSTidalCall
en: I'll fill you in on the details when we meet. I'll be waiting!
et: Üksikasjad räägin sulle kohtumisel. Ma ootan sind!

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
en: Did you know that you can link battle at the COLOSSEUM here?
et: Kas teadsid, et siin COLOSSEUMIS saab pidada ühenduslahinguid?

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
en: They put up your record on the wall for everyone to see.
et: Sinu tulemus pannakse seinale kõigile vaatamiseks.

label: MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Youngster
en: It's embarrassing if you lose more often than you win…
et: Piinlik on küll, kui kaotad rohkem kui võidad…

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
en: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, is the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Kaugel, sügaval EVER GRANDE LINNAS, asub POKéMON LIIGA.

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGatherAtPokemonLeague
en: The TRAINERS who gather there are all frighteningly well skilled.
et: Sinna kogunevad TRAINERID on kõik hirmuäratavalt osavad.

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
en: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the rules say that you have to battle the ELITE FOUR all in a row.
et: POKéMON LIIGA reeglid ütlevad vist, et ELIITNELIKUGA tuleb võidelda kõigiga järjest.

label: VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFourInARow
en: If you lose to any of them, you have to begin your challenge again from the first one.
et: Kui sa kellelegi neist kaotad, pead kõike esimesest peale otsast alustama.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
en: WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm not feeling down anymore.
et: WALLY: Ma kaotasin sulle, {PLAYER}, aga ma ei ole enam kurb.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech
en: Because I have a new purpose in life. Together with my RALTS, I'm going to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become a great TRAINER.
et: Sest mul on nüüd elus uus siht. Koos oma RALTSIGA hakkan POKéMON SAALIDELE väljakutseid esitama ja saan suureks TRAINERIKS.

label: VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_StrongerSpeech

en: You still haven't realized your potential.
et: Sa pole oma võimeid veel välja arendanud.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
en: It is true that you are tremendously powerful.
et: On tõsi, et sa oled tohutult võimas.

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
en: But! I can tell…
et: Aga! Mina näen…

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
en: That strength cannot be considered true strength yet!
et: Seda jõudu ei saa veel tõeliseks jõuks pidada!

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
en: True strength is…! … …
et: Tõeline jõud on…! … …

label: LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_YourePowerfulButNotTrueStrength
en: Actually, I have no idea, either.
et: Tegelikult pole minulgi aimu.

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggInHotSprings
en: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot springs. This is what she told me.
et: Mu naine soojendab kuumaveeallikas MUNA. Nii ta mulle vähemalt rääkis.

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggInHotSprings
en: She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE. And they discovered that EGG!
et: Ta jättis kaks POKéMONi hoiukoju DAY CARE. Ja sealt see MUNA leitigi!

label: LavaridgeTown_House_Text_Zigzagoon
en: ZIGZAGOON: Pshoo!
et: ZIGZAGOON: Pšoo!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: Woohoo!
et: Uuhuu!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: I hear people call me the ROCK SMASH GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.
et: Kuulen, et mind kutsutakse ROCK SMASH TÜÜBIKS, aga minu meelest on see kuidagi alandav.

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: I think I deserve a bit more respect, like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.
et: Minu arust väärin veidi rohkem lugupidamist — näiteks ROCK SMASH MEISTER.

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: Woohoo!
et: Uuhuu!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: Anyways, your POKéMON look pretty strong.
et: Igatahes, su POKéMONid näevad päris tugevad välja.

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDudeTakeThis
en: I like that! Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!
et: See mulle meeldib! Säh, võta see PEIDETUD MASIN!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
en: That HM contains ROCK SMASH.
et: See HM sisaldab võtet ROCK SMASH.

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
en: If you come across large boulders that block your path…
et: Kui satud suurte rahnude otsa, mis su teed tõkestavad…

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
en: Well, use that HM move and smash them right out of your way!
et: Noh, kasuta seda HM-võtet ja löö need lihtsalt teelt puruks!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmash
en: Yes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say! Woohoo!
et: Just nii! Kivid puruks ja teelt ära, ütlen mina! Uuhuu!

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
en: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON could come flying out of hiding.
et: Ah jaa — kui kivi puruks lööd, võib mõni POKéMON peidust välja lennata.

label: MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfSmashedRock
en: Woohoo!
et: Uuhuu!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
en: Wrooooaaar! I need it! I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}! I'll do anything for it!
et: Vrooooaaar! Ma vajan seda! Mul on vaja endale üht {STR_VAR_1}! Teen selle nimel kõike!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
en: …Uh… Did you hear that? My shout from the bottom of my heart?
et: …Öö… Kas sa kuulsid? See oli hüüd mu südamepõhjast!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWontYou
en: Having heard that, you will trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, won't you?
et: Nüüd, kui sa seda kuulsid — vahetad ju oma {STR_VAR_1} minu {STR_VAR_2} vastu, eks?

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
en: Oh, yeah, right on!
et: Oh, jaa, just nii!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare
en: {STR_VAR_1}, welcome! {STR_VAR_2}, you take care!
et: {STR_VAR_1}, tere tulemast! {STR_VAR_2}, hoia end!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon
en: Uh, no, I don't think so. That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Öö, ei, vist mitte. See pole ju {STR_VAR_1}.

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe
en: No? You won't trade me? Even after I bared my heart to you?
et: Ei või? Sa ei vaheta? Isegi pärast seda, kui ma sulle oma hinge avasin?

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
en: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super strong from this moment on!
et: Sellest hetkest alates teen ma VOLBEATi ülitugevaks!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbeatStrong
en: I hope you do the same with PLUSLE!
et: Loodan, et teed sama PLUSLEGA!

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
en: Trading POKéMON with others…
et: POKéMONide vahetamine teistega…

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesWithOthers
en: It's as if you're trading your own memories with other people.
et: See on nagu vahetaksid teistega oma mälestusi.

label: FortreeCity_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
en: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?
et: ZIGZAGOON: Gumomoh?

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko
en: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass! Wait up, PEEKO!
et: MR. BRINEY: Pea kinni, tüdruk! Oota, PEEKO!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}! You saved my darling PEEKO! We owe so much to you!
et: Hm? Sina oled {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa päästsid mu armsa PEEKO! Me võlgneme sulle palju!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: What's that? You want to sail with me?
et: Mis sa ütled? Tahad minuga merele minna?

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: Hmhm…
et: Hmhm…

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: You have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD and a package for SLATEPORT, then?
et: Sul on siis KIRI DEWFORDI ja pakk SLATEPORTI?

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: Quite the busy life you must lead!
et: Küllap on sul kibekiire elu!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: But, certainly, what you're asking is no problem at all.
et: Aga muidugi — see, mida sa palud, pole mingi probleem.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsSailToDewford
en: You've come to the right man! We'll set sail for DEWFORD.
et: Sa tulid õige mehe juurde! Purjetame DEWFORDI.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!
et: MR. BRINEY: Olgu siis DEWFORD!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForDewford
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankur üles! PEEKO, me asume teele, mu kallis!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
en: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? Your deliveries can wait?
et: MR. BRINEY: Ah nii? Saadetised võivad siis oodata?

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeliverySail
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail!
et: Anna aga teada, kui tahad merele minna!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Ma tean täpselt, mida sa öelda tahad!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
en: You're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD and a package to SLATEPORT.
et: Sa pead viima KIRJA DEWFORDI ja paki SLATEPORTI.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
en: What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job!
et: See, mida sa minult palud, pole mingi mure — mina olen just õige mees!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeDeliveriesSailToDewford
en: First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.
et: Kõigepealt purjetame DEWFORDI.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! I know exactly what you want to say!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Ma tean täpselt, mida sa öelda tahad!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
en: You're to deliver a package to CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.
et: Sa pead viima paki CAPT. STERNILE SLATEPORTIS.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
en: What you need me to do is no problem at all--I'm the man for the job!
et: See, mida sa minult palud, pole mingi mure — mina olen just õige mees!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliverPackageSailToDewford
en: First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.
et: Kõigepealt purjetame DEWFORDI.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Sinu jaoks lähen ma merele igal ajal!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: Now, my friend, where are we bound?
et: Noh, sõber, kuhu me suuna võtame?

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
en: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? Well, PEEKO owes her life to you.
et: MR. BRINEY: Ah nii? Noh, PEEKO võlgneb sulle oma elu.

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWheneverYouWantToSail
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail!
et: Anna aga teada, kui tahad merele minna!

label: Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_Peeko
en: PEEKO: Pii piihyoro!
et: PEEKO: Pii piihüoro!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: The INSTITUTE created a type of POKéMON that has something to do with the weather. We're here to take them!
et: INSTITUUT tegi POKéMONi, kel on ilmaga midagi pistmist. Meie tulime ta endale võtma!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?
et: Meie plaani rikub ära üks laps?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: If the POKéMON they made here can control the weather freely, then we of TEAM AQUA definitely need it!
et: Kui siin loodud POKéMON suudab ilma oma tahtmist mööda juhtida, siis vajab teda kindlasti just TEAM AQUA!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: We're TEAM AQUA! We appear wherever anything rare is found!
et: Meie oleme TEAM AQUA! Me ilmume igale poole, kust leitakse midagi haruldast!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: You got me!
et: Sa said mu kätte!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: You don't have any idea what we of TEAM AQUA are working towards! You stay out of our way!
et: Sul pole aimugi, mille nimel TEAM AQUA töötab! Hoia meie teelt eemale!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Don't tell me you're looking for that weather POKéMON, too?
et: Ära ütle, et sinagi jahid seda ilma-POKéMONi?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: That's a no-no! We were here to get it first!
et: Ei tule kõne allagi! Meie jõudsime siia esimesena!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?
et: Oh, vaata nüüd mu POKéMONi…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: Humph, so what? What we want…
et: Hmpf, mis siis? See, mida me tahame…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: What we really want isn't here… Ihihihihi…
et: See, mida me tegelikult tahame, pole siin… Ihihihihii…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
en: Ahahahaha!
et: Ahahahaa!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
en: You're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's affairs?
et: Sa kavatsed TEAM AQUA asjadesse sekkuda?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
en: You're either absolutely fearless, simply ignorant, or both!
et: Sa oled kas täiesti kartmatu või lihtsalt rumal — või mõlemat korraga!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyIntro
en: You're so cute, you're disgusting! I'll put you down, kiddy!
et: Sa oled nii nunnu, et ajab lausa iiveldama! Ma teen sulle tuule alla, titeke!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyDefeat
en: Ahahahaha! You're disgustingly strong!
et: Ahahahaa! Sa oled vastikult tugev!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA blunder about, but now there's you!
et: Niigi on paha, et TEAM MAGMA jalus vussib, aga nüüd oled veel sina!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ShellyPostBattle
en: What makes you want to sniff around in our business, anyway?
et: Mis sind õieti sunnib meie asjades nuuskima?

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
en: We have a situation here!
et: Meil on siin probleem!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
en: A TEAM MAGMA mob just passed the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: TEAM MAGMA jõuk möödus just WEATHER INSTITUTE hoonest.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMagmaJustPassedBy
en: They appear to be headed for MT. PYRE!
et: Näib, et nad suunduvad MT. PYRE poole!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
en: We can't waste any more time here! We have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!
et: Siin ei tohi enam aega raisata! Ka meie peame kähku MT. PYRE juurde!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHaveToHurryToMtPyre
en: Ahahahaha! TEAM MAGMA, just you wait!
et: Ahahahaa! TEAM MAGMA, oodake te!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
en: Thanks! Thanks to you, we're safe!
et: Aitäh! Tänu sinule oleme me pääsenud!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ThanksPleaseTakePokemon
en: It might be an odd way of thanking you, but take this POKéMON.
et: See on ehk veider tänuavaldus, aga võta see POKéMON endale.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoomForPokemon
en: Hm? You don't seem to have any room for this POKéMON.
et: Hm? Näib, et sul pole selle POKéMONi jaoks ruumi.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PlayerReceivedCastform
en: {PLAYER} received CASTFORM!
et: {PLAYER} sai CASTFORMi!

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
en: That POKéMON changes shape according to the weather conditions.
et: See POKéMON muudab olenevalt ilmast oma kuju.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_PokemonChangesWithWeather
en: There're plenty of them in the INSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.
et: Neid on INSTITUUDIS küllaga — võta aga julgelt.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_ChangingWeatherRidiculous
en: I've been researching rain for many years, but it's ridiculous to think that humans can freely change the weather.
et: Ma olen palju aastaid vihma uurinud, aga on naeruväärne arvata, et inimesed saavad vabalt ilma muuta.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_GroudonWeather
en: I track weather patterns over the HOENN region.
et: Ma jälgin HOENNI piirkonna ilmastikumustreid.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_GroudonWeather
en: Presently, a drought has been recorded in {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Praegu on {STR_VAR_1} kandis registreeritud põud.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_GroudonWeather
en: Could that mean, somewhere near {STR_VAR_1}…
et: Kas see võiks tähendada, et kuskil {STR_VAR_1} lähedal…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_KyogreWeather
en: I track weather patterns over the HOENN region.
et: Ma jälgin HOENNI piirkonna ilmastikumustreid.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_KyogreWeather
en: Presently, heavy rainfall has been recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Praegu on {STR_VAR_1} kohal registreeritud tugev vihmasadu.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_KyogreWeather
en: Could that mean, somewhere near {STR_VAR_1}…
et: Kas see võiks tähendada, et kuskil {STR_VAR_1} lähedal…

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbnormalWeather
en: Abnormal weather conditions are no longer being reported.
et: Ebatavalistest ilmaoludest enam ei teatata.

label: Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbnormalWeather
en: The occasional rainfall is a blessing, really.
et: Aeg-ajalt sadav vihm on tegelikult õnnistus.

label: SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYouNeed
en: I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and sell you what you need!
et: Mina olen ENERGY GURU! Annan endast kõik ja müün sulle, mida vaja!

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhYourPokemon
en: Oh? Your {STR_VAR_1}…
et: Oh? Su {STR_VAR_1}…

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffortRibbon
en: Went for it stupendously!
et: Ta on pingutanud lausa vapustavalt!

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffortRibbon
en: As its reward, please give it this EFFORT RIBBON.
et: Tasuks palun anna talle see EFFORT RIBBON.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ReceivedEffortRibbon
en: {PLAYER} received the EFFORT RIBBON.
et: {PLAYER} sai EFFORT RIBBONi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_PutEffortRibbonOnMon
en: {PLAYER} put the EFFORT RIBBON on {STR_VAR_1}.
et: {PLAYER} kinnitas POKéMONile {STR_VAR_1} EFFORT RIBBONi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder
en: You have to go for it a little harder.
et: Sa pead veidi kõvemini pingutama.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder
en: If you do, I'll give your POKéMON something nice.
et: Kui pingutad, annan su POKéMONile midagi toredat.

label: SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGoodOnIt
en: Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT RIBBON looks good on it!
et: Oh! Su {STR_VAR_1}, see EFFORT RIBBON sobib talle hästi!

label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
en: The light of the lighthouse reaches dozens of miles away.
et: Majaka valgus ulatub kümnete miilide kaugusele.

label: SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseStartlesPokemon
en: I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON in the sea.
et: Huvitav, kas see ei ehmata meres elavaid POKéMONe.

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
en: Ooh, look at this!
et: Ohoo, vaata seda!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
en: The seaweed you can get around these parts is fresh and full of life.
et: Merevetikad, mida siin kandis saab, on värsked ja täis elu.

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife
en: Why, it looks like it can even rear up and attack!
et: Näib, nagu võiksid need isegi püsti tõusta ja rünnata!

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
en: Where the water is clean, the fruits of bountiful harvest gather.
et: Kus vesi on puhas, sinna kogunevad rikkaliku saagi viljad.

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
en: And where people gather, a market soon starts.
et: Ja kuhu inimesed kogunevad, sinna tekib peagi turg.

label: SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows
en: That is how a town is born and grows.
et: Nõnda sünnib ja kasvab linn.

label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
en: Shopping where you can breathe the scent of the ocean…
et: Ostlemine, hingates sisse mere lõhna…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPlace
en: SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!
et: SLATEPORT on nii imeline paik!

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
en: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on the floor, they'll get dirty.
et: Kui paned põrandale NUKUD või PADJAD, saavad need mustaks.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontGetDirty
en: I'm going to buy some BRICKS so my DOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty when I leave them out.
et: Ostan endale TELLISEID, et mu NUKUD ja PADJAD väljas olles mustaks ei läheks.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
en: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in the BATTLE TENT, too!
et: Vrooar! Minagi kavatsen BATTLE TENTIS võistelda!

label: SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattleTent
en: But before that, I need to catch some POKéMON!
et: Aga enne seda pean mõned POKéMONid püüdma!

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
en: Whew… I'm just bushed…
et: Puhh… Olen täiesti läbi…

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
en: I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY. But, boy, this city's huge.
et: Tulin jalgsi MAUVILLE LINNAST. Aga küll on see linn ikka tohutu!

label: SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauville
en: If I'd known this, I would've ridden my BIKE here.
et: Oleksin ma seda teadnud, oleksin JALGRATTAGA sõitnud.

label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
en: STERN, the fellow who built the MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader of an undersea exploration team.
et: STERN, see mees, kes MUUSEUMI ehitas, on ühtlasi veealuse uurimisrühma juht.

label: SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptStern
en: So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.
et: Nii et kõik kutsuvad teda lihtsalt CAPT. STERN.

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverThere
en: What is that over there? That long line…
et: Mis see seal on? See pikk järjekord…

label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
en: When I was a child, I visited the MUSEUM often.
et: Lapsena käisin ma tihti MUUSEUMIS.

label: SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften
en: I used to dream about the mysteries of the sea after seeing the exhibits.
et: Pärast eksponaatide vaatamist unistasin ma alati mere saladustest.

label: SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing
en: Hey, there! Quit pushing! This is the line, can't you see?
et: Hei, sina seal! Lõpeta trügimine! See on järjekord, kas sa ei näe?

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy
en: TEAM AQUA has a policy of assembling and dispersing at the operation site.
et: TEAM AQUA põhimõte on koguneda ja laiali minna otse operatsioonipaigas.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
en: Our BOSS is brilliant.
et: Meie BOSS on geniaalne.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant
en: What would he want to do with a MUSEUM now?
et: Mida ta küll MUUSEUMIGA peale hakata tahab?

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
en: What's the new scheme, I wonder?
et: Huvitav, mis see uus plaan on?

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder
en: Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so I'd better not screw things up…
et: Meie BOSS on hirmus, kui ta vihane on, nii et ma parem ei aja asju untsu…

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll
en: If there's something we need in the MUSEUM, we should take it all!
et: Kui MUUSEUMIS on midagi, mida me vajame, peaksime selle kõik võtma!

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn
en: Hey, you there! Don't butt in!
et: Hei, sina seal! Ära trügi vahele!

label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
en: A long line, huh?
et: Pikk järjekord, mis?

label: SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineForGames
en: It reminds me of the times I lined up to buy smash-hit games…
et: See tuletab mulle meelde aegu, mil ma seisin järjekorras hittmänge ostmas…

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp
en: Why are we even lining up and paying? We should just march in!
et: Miks me üldse järjekorras seisame ja maksame? Me peaksime lihtsalt sisse marssima!

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhatDoYouWant
en: What? What do you want?
et: Mida? Mida sa tahad?

label: SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou
en: You want to read this sign? I'll read it for you!
et: Sa tahad seda silti lugeda? Ma loen selle sulle ette!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
en: Let's see…
et: Vaatame…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
en: Um… I think it says something like “the life in the sea is endless.”
et: Öö… Ma arvan, et seal on kirjas midagi nagu „elu meres on lõputu.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaIsEndless
en: Yup, I'm pretty sure that's what it says.
et: Jah, ma olen üsna kindel, et just nii seal kirjas on.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
en: Grumble…
et: Nurin…

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
en: I should've brought my Game Boy Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line…
et: Oleksin pidanud oma Game Boy Advance kaasa võtma, et järjekorras igav ei hakkaks…

label: SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGameBoy
en: Grumble…
et: Nurin…

label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
en: When this operation's over, I'll take you to a hot spring spa!
et: Kui see operatsioon läbi saab, viin ma su kuumaallika spaasse!

label: SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperation
en: That's what our leader said. I can't wait!
et: Nii ütles meie juht. Ma ei jõua ära oodata!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
en: The sea is just so vast…
et: Meri on lihtsalt nii avar…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet
en: Could the sea have been made by the tears shed by POKéMON?
et: Kas meri võib olla tekkinud POKéMONide valatud pisaratest?

label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
en: Do you know what they do with old ships that become too creaky to sail?
et: Kas tead, mida tehakse vanade laevadega, mis muutuvad purjetamiseks liiga krigisevaks?

label: SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats
en: They sink them in the sea so they become habitats for POKéMON.
et: Need uputatakse merre, et neist saaks POKéMONide elupaigad.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch
en: Whenever I visit here, I get carried away and buy too much.
et: Alati kui ma siia külla tulen, lasen end kaasa haarata ja ostan liiga palju.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou
en: If you want to change your POKéMON's nickname, you'll have to get the NAME RATER to help you.
et: Kui tahad oma POKéMONi hüüdnime muuta, pead NAME RATERI appi kutsuma.

label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
en: Any POKéMON you get in a trade, you can't change its nickname.
et: Vahetuse teel saadud POKéMONi hüüdnime ei saa muuta.

label: SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonName
en: The original TRAINER's love for that POKéMON is in the nickname.
et: Algse TRAINERI armastus selle POKéMONi vastu peitub hüüdnimes.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
en: Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built in SLATEPORT.
et: Hiljuti ehitati SLATEPORTI BATTLE TENT.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
en: GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's awesome in its own way.
et: SAALID on lõbusad, aga BATTLE TENT on omal moel äge.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecently
en: You should go find tough POKéMON for the BATTLE TENT!
et: Sa peaksid minema BATTLE TENTI jaoks kõvasid POKéMONe otsima!

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
en: I was hoping that it was a famous star so I could get an autograph.
et: Lootsin, et seal on mõni kuulus staar ja saan autogrammi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingInterviewed
en: But who's that being interviewed? Isn't that CAPT. STERN?
et: Aga keda seal intervjueeritakse? Kas see pole mitte CAPT. STERN?

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
en: That lady interviewer is so cool and pretty.
et: See naisreporter on nii lahe ja ilus.

label: SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool
en: When I grow up, I'm going to be an international journalist!
et: Kui ma suureks saan, hakkan rahvusvaheliseks ajakirjanikuks!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
en: CAPT. STERN says they discovered something at the bottom of the sea.
et: CAPT. STERN ütleb, et nad avastasid merepõhjast midagi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSomething
en: I wonder what it is? What could it be?
et: Huvitav, mis see on? Mis see küll võiks olla?

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
en: What's going on here?
et: Mis siin toimub?

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBigFish
en: Did the good CAPTAIN come back with a big fish from the ocean floor?
et: Kas hea KAPTEN tuli ookeanipõhjast suure kalaga tagasi?

label: SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV
en: Hey! Are you watching? Am I on TV?
et: Hei! Kas sa vaatad? Kas ma olen telekas?

label: SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity
en: A TV interview! Here! The CAPTAIN's a celebrity!
et: TV-intervjuu! Siin! KAPTEN on kuulsus!

label: SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera
en: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile for the camera!
et: TY: Olgu, CAPT. STERN, suur naeratus kaamerasse!

label: SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperience
en: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most invaluable experience…
et: GABBY: Ah nii, ah nii. Teil on olnud tõeliselt hindamatu kogemus…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExploration
en: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to move ahead with our exploration.
et: CAPT. STERN: Jah, tõepoolest. Kavatseme oma uurimistööd jätkata.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
en: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN! Thank you for taking the time from your busy schedule to talk to us.
et: GABBY: Suurepärane, CAPT. STERN! Aitäh, et leidsite oma tiheda graafiku kõrvalt meie jaoks aega.

label: SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksForInterview
en: We hope we can interview you again with news of more discoveries!
et: Loodame, et saame teid uute avastuste puhul taas intervjueerida!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
en: CAPT. STERN: Whew…
et: CAPT. STERN: Puhh…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstInterview
en: That was my first time to be filmed for TV. That was nerve-wracking.
et: See oli esimene kord, kui mind telesse filmiti. Päris närvesööv oli.

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
en: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! You're looking great!
et: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa näed suurepärane välja!

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
en: We made a huge discovery on our last seafloor exploration.
et: Me tegime oma viimasel merepõhja uurimisel suure avastuse.

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
en: We found an underwater cavern on ROUTE 128.
et: Leidsime ROUTE 128 kandist veealuse koopa.

label: SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscovery
en: We think it's the habitat of a POKéMON that's said to have been long extinct.
et: Arvame, et seal elab POKéMON, keda on ammu väljasurnuks peetud.

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
en: Fufufu… CAPT. STERN, I presume.
et: Fufufu… CAPT. STERN, kui ma ei eksi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
en: We of TEAM AQUA will assume control of your submarine!
et: Meie, TEAM AQUA, võtame su allveelaeva enda kontrolli alla!

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
en: Your objections are meaningless! We expect your total cooperation!
et: Su vastuväited on mõttetud! Me ootame sinult täielikku koostööd!

label: SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControlOfSubmarine
en: Fufufu… Just watch and learn what TEAM AQUA has planned!
et: Fufufu… Vaata ja õpi, mida TEAM AQUA on plaaninud!

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
en: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?
et: CAPT. STERN: Mis see kõik siis oli?

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
en: It sounded like someone using a megaphone…
et: See kõlas nagu keegi kasutaks megafoni…

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat
en: Where did it come from?
et: Kust see tuli?

label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
en: It's from the HARBOR!
et: See on SADAMAST!

label: SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTakeSub
en: The submarine! They're trying to take it!
et: Allveelaev! Nad tahavad selle ära viia!

label: SlateportCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please, come with me!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Palun tule minuga kaasa!

label: SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign
en: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE “Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”
et: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORTI PAIK „Leia see! Ülim POKéMON!”

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
en: STERN'S SHIPYARD
et: STERNI LAEVATEHAS

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedSign
en: “Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing in all currents.”
et: „Otsitakse: madrust, kes suudab purjetada kõigis vooludes.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
en: STERN'S SHIPYARD
et: STERNI LAEVATEHAS

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCompletion
en: “The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears completion for serving the ports of SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”
et: „Praam S.S. TIDAL saab peagi valmis ja hakkab teenindama SLATEPORTI ning LILYCOVE sadamat.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
en: STERN'S SHIPYARD
et: STERNI LAEVATEHAS

label: SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryComplete
en: “Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE ferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the HARBOR.”
et: „SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE praamile S.S. TIDAL saab pardale SADAMAS.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign
en: POKéMON FAN CLUB “Calling all fans of POKéMON!”
et: POKéMON FAN CLUB „Kõik POKéMONide fännid, tulge kohale!”

label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
en: “The endless sea sustains all life.”
et: „Lõputu meri toidab kogu elu.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign
en: OCEANIC MUSEUM
et: OOKEANIMUUSEUM

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
en: SLATEPORT CITY
et: SLATEPORT LINN

label: SlateportCity_Text_CitySign
en: “The port where people and POKéMON cross paths.”
et: „Sadam, kus inimeste ja POKéMONide teed ristuvad.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign
en: SLATEPORT MARKET “Unique items found nowhere else!”
et: SLATEPORTI TURG „Ainulaadsed esemed, mida mujalt ei leia!”

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
en: SLATEPORT HARBOR
et: SLATEPORTI SADAM

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
en: “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under construction in the SHIPYARD.
et: „Praam S.S. TIDAL on LAEVATEHASES ehitusjärgus.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConstruction
en: “Service is scheduled to begin shortly.”
et: „Teenindus algab peagi.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
en: SLATEPORT HARBOR
et: SLATEPORTI SADAM

label: SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign
en: “Enjoy a delightful cruise on the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”
et: „Naudi meeldivat kruiisi praamil S.S. TIDAL.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_NameRatersHouseSign
en: NAME RATER'S HOUSE “POKéMON nicknames rated.”
et: NAME RATERi MAJA „Siin hinnatakse POKéMONide hüüdnimesid.”

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals itself by chewing on BERRIES.
et: Kui metsik POKéMON saab viga, ravib ta end marju närides.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: Did you know that?
et: Kas teadsid seda?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: Somebody saw that and got the idea of making medicine from BERRIES.
et: Keegi nägi seda ja tuli mõttele teha marjadest ravimit.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: Did you know that?
et: Kas teadsid seda?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: To turn BERRIES into medicine, they must be crushed into powder.
et: Et marjadest ravimit teha, tuleb need pulbriks purustada.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: Did you know that?
et: Kas teadsid seda?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: You seem to have an interest in BERRIES!
et: Näib, et sind huvitavad marjad!

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries
en: I've got something good for someone like you.
et: Mul on sinusuguse jaoks midagi head.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
en: I recently had machines installed at POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.
et: Lasksin hiljuti POKéKESKUSTESSE paigaldada masinad marjade purustamiseks.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
en: The BERRY CRUSH machines are at the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.
et: BERRY CRUSH masinad on ülemisel korrusel DIRECT CORNERIS.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
en: Could you make BERRY POWDER for me using those machines?
et: Kas saaksid teha mulle nende masinatega BERRY POWDERit?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder
en: I can make you all sorts of medicine if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.
et: Ma saan sulle teha igasuguseid ravimeid, kui tood mulle palju BERRY POWDERit.

label: SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPowder
en: Have you brought me some BERRY POWDER?
et: Kas oled mulle veidi BERRY POWDERit toonud?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt
en: What would you like to exchange it with?
et: Mille vastu sa selle vahetada sooviksid?

label: SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderForItem
en: Okay, you want to exchange your BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Olgu, sa tahad oma BERRY POWDERit vahetada ühe {STR_VAR_1} vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPowder
en: Oh, dear. You don't have enough BERRY POWDER.
et: Oh, heldeke. Sul pole piisavalt BERRY POWDERit.

label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
en: This is fine BERRY POWDER. It will make excellent medicine.
et: See on hea BERRY POWDER. Sellest saab suurepärast ravimit.

label: SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeSomethingElse
en: Would you like to trade more of your BERRY POWDER for something else?
et: Kas sooviksid oma BERRY POWDERit veel millegi muu vastu vahetada?

label: SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringItToMe
en: Okay! When you get some more BERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!
et: Olgu! Kui saad veel BERRY POWDERit, too see mulle, palun!

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
en: Come back if you'd like to trade your BERRY POWDER for some medicine.
et: Tule tagasi, kui sooviksid oma BERRY POWDERit ravimi vastu vahetada.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
en: I'm always running a bazaar here.
et: Ma pean siin kogu aeg basaari.

label: SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryPowder
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
en: SCOTT: Huh? I'm sure I met you somewhere before.
et: SCOTT: Huh? Oleme kindlasti kuskil varem kohtunud.

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
en: Have I introduced myself to you? If not, my name's SCOTT.
et: Kas ma olen end sulle tutvustanud? Kui mitte, siis mu nimi on SCOTT.

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
en: I just saw TEAM AQUA run away from here like they were stung.
et: Nägin just, kuidas TEAM AQUA siit nagu nõelatult minema jooksis.

label: SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway
en: Let me guess--you drove them away?
et: Las ma arvan – sina ajasid nad minema?

label: SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer
en: SCOTT: Hmm… Maybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…
et: SCOTT: Hmm… Võib-olla, just nimelt võib-olla, on see TRAINER…

label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
en: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going to become a good friend.
et: SCOTT: Hea küll! Ma arvan, et sinust saab hea sõber.

label: SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther
en: So, let's register each other in our POKéNAVS.
et: Nii et registreerime teineteise oma POKéNAVIDESSE.

label: SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott
en: Registered this SCOTT person in the POKéNAV.
et: SCOTT registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
en: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along with you, but I do want to keep an eye on the talents of other people, too.
et: SCOTT: Kõige meelsamini lööksin sinuga kaasa, aga tahan ka teiste andekate tegemistel silma peal hoida.

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
en: So, I'll be off to roam other towns a bit more.
et: Nii et ma lähen veel veidi teistes linnades rändama.

label: SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSeeingYou
en: Be seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Näeme veel, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
en: SCOTT: Oh, hey! If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: SCOTT: Oo, tere! Kas see pole mitte {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, las ma arvan – sa kavatsed BATTLE TENTI väljakutse vastu võtta?

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
en: Yeah! That's a good idea! That's a really great idea!
et: Jah! See on hea mõte! See on tõesti suurepärane mõte!

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
en: After all, a tough TRAINER is the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!
et: Lõppude lõpuks sobib kõva TRAINER ideaalselt BATTLE TENTI!

label: SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChallenge
en: Give it your best effort!
et: Anna endast parim!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike
en: Where the luck of TRAINERS is put to the test…
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERite õnn…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike
en: Welcome to the BATTLE PIKE…
et: Tere tulemast! Siin on BATTLE PIKE…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePike
en: I am your guide to the BATTLE PIKE…
et: Mina olen su teejuht siin BATTLE PIKE radadel…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_TakeChallenge
en: Would you like to take the Battle Choice challenge?
et: Kas soovid Battle Choice väljakutse vastu võtta?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: Here we conduct an event we call the Battle Choice.
et: Siin korraldame üritust nimega Battle Choice.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: The Battle Choice rules are very simple…
et: Battle Choice reeglid on väga lihtsad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: Choose one of three paths and make your way to the goal room at the end of the BATTLE PIKE. It's that simple.
et: Vali üks kolmest teest ja jõua BATTLE PIKE lõpus asuvasse sihtruumi. Nii lihtne see ongi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: However, what happens on the chosen path depends entirely on the luck of the challenger…
et: Kuid see, mis valitud teel juhtub, sõltub täielikult väljakutsuja õnnest…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: If you reach the goal, you will be rewarded with Battle Points.
et: Kui jõuad sihile, saad tasuks Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please have a word with our staff in the big rooms on the way.
et: Kui soovid väljakutse katkestada, räägi palun teel olevates suurtes ruumides meie töötajatega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePike
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_LookForwardToSeeingYou
en: We look forward to seeing you on another occasion…
et: Ootame sind mõnel teisel korral…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_WhichChallengeMode
en: You have the choice of two courses, Level 50 and Open Level. Which will you challenge?
et: Sul on valida kahe raja vahel: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumma valid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePikeLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50
en: I beg your pardon, but…
et: Palun vabandust, aga…
