en: {STR_VAR_1} match!
et: {STR_VAR_1} matš!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTrainer
en: {PLAYER} versus {STR_VAR_2}!
et: {PLAYER} vs {STR_VAR_2}!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTrainer
en: Let the battle begin!
et: Algagu lahing!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsWinner
en: {PLAYER} is the winner! Congratulations!
et: {PLAYER} on võitja! Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TrainerIsWinner
en: {STR_VAR_2} is the winner! Congratulations!
et: {STR_VAR_2} on võitja! Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ
en: {PLAYER} is the Level 50 Battle Tournament Champion!
et: {PLAYER} on taseme 50 lahinguturniiri meister!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp
en: {PLAYER} is the Open Level Battle Tournament Champion!
et: {PLAYER} on avatud taseme lahinguturniiri meister!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereeDecisionPleaseWait
en: What an unbelievable finish! We have a double knockout!
et: Milline uskumatu lõpp! Meil on topeltnokaut!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereeDecisionPleaseWait
en: In this event, the Battle Tournament rules call for a REFEREE'S decision.
et: Sellel üritusel nõuavad lahinguturniiri reeglid KOHTUNIKU otsust.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereeDecisionPleaseWait
en: Please wait while the judging is under way.
et: Palun oota, kuni hindamine käib.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTrainer
en: The REFEREES have reached a decision!
et: KOHTUNIKUD on otsuseni jõudnud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTrainer
en: The winner is… Oh, my goodness! The winner is {STR_VAR_1}! Congratulations!
et: Võitja on… Oh, heldeke! Võitja on {STR_VAR_1}! Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerPlayer
en: The REFEREES have reached a decision!
et: KOHTUNIKUD on otsuseni jõudnud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerPlayer
en: The winner is… Oh, my goodness! The winner is {PLAYER}! Congratulations!
et: Võitja on… Oh, heldeke! Võitja on {PLAYER}! Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_BrightNewHope
en: The bright new hope!
et: Särav uus lootus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RisingStar
en: The rising star!
et: Tõusev täht!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillTheyRaceToChampionship
en: Will this TRAINER race to the championship?
et: Kas see TRAINER kihutab meistritiitlini?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAchieveChampionFirstTry
en: Can the feat of a championship on the first try be achieved?
et: Kas meistritiitel tuleb kohe esimese katsega?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanLossBeAvenged
en: Can the loss of the last match be avenged?
et: Kas eelmise matši kaotus saab kätte makstud?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_OnFireForChampionship
en: The TRAINER is on fire for the first championship try!
et: See TRAINER põleb soovist esimest korda meistritiitel võita!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinHereAdvancesToFinal
en: A win here means this TRAINER advances to the final!
et: Võit siin tähendab, et see TRAINER jõuab finaali!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillLongHeldDreamComeTrue
en: Will the long-held dream of a championship finally come true?
et: Kas kaua hellitatud meistritiitli unistus lõpuks täitub?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TheInvincibleChampion
en: The invincible champion!
et: Võitmatu meister!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanAnyoneHopeToBeatTrainer
en: Can anyone hope to beat this TRAINER?
et: Kas kellelgi on lootust seda TRAINERIT võita?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_DoBattlesExistSolelyForTrainer
en: Do battles exist solely for this TRAINER?
et: Kas lahingud ongi loodud ainult selle TRAINERI jaoks?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CurrentChampAimingToRetainTitle
en: The current champion aiming to retain the title!
et: Valitsev meister, kes tuli tiitlit kaitsma!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerChampHasReturned
en: The former champion has returned!
et: Endine meister on naasnud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FormerToughnessReturned
en: The former toughness has returned!
et: Vana sitkus on tagasi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillDoExpectedAdvanceToFinals
en: Will this TRAINER do as expected and advance to the finals?
et: Kas see TRAINER täidab ootused ja jõuab finaali?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WillFormerChampRegainGlory
en: Will the former champ regain lost glory?
et: Kas endine meister taastab kaotatud hiilguse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_FeelGlowOfTrueMaster
en: Feel the glow of a true master!
et: Tunneta tõelise meistri sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForDomeAceTucker
en: And now… The TRAINER standing in {PLAYER}'s record-setting path…
et: Ja nüüd… TRAINER, kes seisab {PLAYER} rekordijahi teel ees…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_MakeWayForDomeAceTucker
en: Yes! The one and only! The BATTLE DOME COMMISSIONER! Our very own DOME ACE! Make way for TUCKER!
et: Jah! Ainus ja kordumatu! BATTLE DOME KOMISSAR! Meie enda DOME ACE! Tehke teed TUCKERILE!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SpectatorTuckerChant
en: Spectators: TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER!
et: Pealtvaatajad: TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER! TUCKER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: TUCKER: Ahahah!
et: TUCKER: Ahahaa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: Do you hear it? This crowd! They're all itching to see our match!
et: Kas sa kuuled? See rahvahulk! Nad kõik ihkavad meie matši näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: Ahahah!
et: Ahahaa!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: I bet you're twitching all over from the tension of getting to battle me!
et: Vean kihla, et sa väriled üleni põnevusest, et saad minuga võidelda!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: But don't you worry about a thing!
et: Aga ära muretse millegi pärast!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerSilverIntro
en: I'm the no. 1 star of the BATTLE DOME! I, TUCKER the DOME ACE, will bathe you in my brilliant glow!
et: Mina olen BATTLE DOME number 1 täht! Mina, DOME ACE TUCKER, uputan sind oma pimestavasse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LetsSeeYourStrategy
en: Your strategy! Let's see it!
et: Sinu strateegia! Lase näha!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_IncredibleVictorIsPlayer
en: Unbelievable! It's incredible! The victor is {PLAYER}!
et: Uskumatu! See on hämmastav! Võitja on {PLAYER}!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsTucker
en: The winner is TUCKER! The DOME ACE has prevailed!
et: Võitja on TUCKER! DOME ACE jäi peale!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WinnerIsTucker
en: Congratulations, TUCKER!
et: Palju õnne, TUCKER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_SeeYourFrontierPass
en: TUCKER: Rules are rules! Let me see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: TUCKER: Reeglid on reeglid! Näita mulle oma FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedTacticsSymbol
en: The Tactics Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: Tactics-sümbol pressiti FRONTIER PASSile!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_WontUnderestimateYouNextTime
en: I sorely underestimated you. I won't make the same mistake next time…
et: Ma alahindasin sind rängalt. Järgmine kord ma sama viga ei tee…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_CanWinStreakBeStretched
en: Can the win streak be stretched? The confidence is there!
et: Kas võiduseeriat saab pikendada? Enesekindlust jagub!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LegendHasReturnedDomeAceTucker
en: Ladies and gentlemen! Boys, girls, and POKéMON!
et: Daamid ja härrad! Poisid, tüdrukud ja POKéMONid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LegendHasReturnedDomeAceTucker
en: Finally! Finally, the legend has returned!
et: Lõpuks! Lõpuks on legend naasnud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LegendHasReturnedDomeAceTucker
en: Yes, the name of that legend! Our very own DOME ACE! It's none other than TUCKER!
et: Jah, selle legendi nimi! Meie enda DOME ACE! See pole keegi muu kui TUCKER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro
en: TUCKER: Ah… The pummeling roar of the crowd… Their furnace-like heat of excitement… This is a wonderful place…
et: TUCKER: Ah… Rahvahulga müristav möire… Nende ahjukuum elevus… See on imeline paik…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro
en: To the crowd, I am the DOME ACE… I represent their hopes and dreams… I must never fade from their sight…
et: Rahvale olen mina DOME ACE… Ma esindan nende lootusi ja unistusi… Ma ei tohi kunagi nende silmist kaduda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TuckerGoldIntro
en: I must burn! Brighter and more brilliant! I must light all that gather here!
et: Ma pean lõõmama! Eredamalt ja hiilgavamalt! Ma pean valgustama kõiki, kes siia kogunevad!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_UnleashAllPowerIPossess
en: I will unleash all the power that I possess! Right here and now!
et: Ma päästan valla kogu oma jõu! Siin ja praegu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed
en: TUCKER: You're genuinely fantastic!
et: TUCKER: Sa oled tõeliselt fantastiline!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed
en: Never before! I haven't ever lost in the times I've had to unleash my power.
et: Mitte kunagi varem! Ma pole kordagi kaotanud, kui olen pidanud oma jõu valla päästma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_NeverLostWhenPowerUnleashed
en: Yes, quite fantastic! Your FRONTIER PASS, please?
et: Jah, üsna fantastiline! Sinu FRONTIER PASS, palun?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_TacticsSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Tactics Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Tactics-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LookForwardToNextEncounter
en: You're strong, but above all, you have a unique charm!
et: Sa oled tugev, aga eelkõige on sul ainulaadne võlu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LookForwardToNextEncounter
en: In you, I see a definite potential for a superstar like me.
et: Sinus näen ma selget potentsiaali saada minusuguseks supertäheks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_LookForwardToNextEncounter
en: I will very much look forward to our next encounter!
et: Ma ootan väga meie järgmist kohtumist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ2
en: {PLAYER} is the Level 50 Battle Tournament Champion!
et: {PLAYER} on taseme 50 lahinguturniiri meister!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLv50Champ2
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp2
en: {PLAYER} is the Open Level Battle Tournament Champion!
et: {PLAYER} on avatud taseme lahinguturniiri meister!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerIsLvOpenChamp2
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTucker
en: The final match!
et: Finaalmatš!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTucker
en: {PLAYER} versus the DOME ACE, TUCKER!
et: {PLAYER} vs DOME ACE TUCKER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_PlayerVersusTucker
en: Let the battle begin!
et: Algagu lahing!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTucker
en: The REFEREES have reached a decision!
et: KOHTUNIKUD on otsuseni jõudnud!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTucker
en: The winner is… Oh, my goodness! The winner is our very own DOME ACE! It's TUCKER!
et: Võitja on… Oh, heldeke! Võitja on meie enda DOME ACE! See on TUCKER!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeBattleRoom_Text_RefereesDecidedWinnerTucker
en: Congratulations! And thank you! Let's hear it for the DOME ACE, TUCKER!
et: Palju õnne! Ja aitäh! Elagu DOME ACE TUCKER!

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
en: REVIVE is fantastic!
et: REVIVE on fantastiline!

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
en: Give it to a fainted POKéMON, and the POKéMON will arise.
et: Anna see minestanud POKéMONile ja ta tõuseb taas jalule.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic
en: But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore the used-up PP of moves.
et: Aga ole ettevaatlik — REVIVE ei taasta võtete ärakulutatud PP punkte.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLongest
en: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.
et: MAX REPEL hoiab kõik nõrgad POKéMONid eemal.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLongest
en: Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts the longest.
et: Kõigist REPEL-pihustitest kestab see kõige kauem.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
en: The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.
et: NET ja DIVE PALL on haruldased POKé PALLID, mida tehakse ainult MOSSDEEPIS.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
en: A NET BALL is effective against BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.
et: NET PALL on tõhus PUTUKA-tüüpi ja VEE-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRare
en: A DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON at the bottom of the sea.
et: DIVE PALL mõjub kõige paremini merepõhjas elavate POKéMONide peal.

label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
en: I love GRASS-type POKéMON!
et: Mulle meeldivad väga ROHU-tüüpi POKéMONid!

label: Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny
en: Do you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?
et: Kas sul on mõni ROHU-tüüpi POKéMON?

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
en: Oh?
et: Oh?

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
en: You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too, don't you?
et: Sinulegi meeldivad ROHU-tüüpi POKéMONid, kas pole?

label: Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThis
en: I'm so happy, you can have this! It's a token of our friendship.
et: Mul on nii hea meel — võta see endale! See olgu meie sõpruse märgiks.

label: Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon
en: I check trees with my GRASS-type POKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.
et: Ma kontrollin puid oma ROHU-tüüpi POKéMONidega. Ma olen nagu puuarst.

label: Route123_Text_RouteSign
en: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118
et: {RIGHT_ARROW} ROUTE 123 {LEFT_ARROW} ROUTE 118

label: Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre
en: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE “Forbidden to the faint of heart.”
et: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE „Keelatud nõrganärvilistele.”

label: Route123_Text_BerryMastersHouse
en: BERRY MASTER'S HOUSE
et: BERRY MASTERI MAJA

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstTimeHereThisWay
en: Is it your first time here? Please step this way!
et: Kas oled esimest korda siin? Palun astu siiapoole!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_WelcomeToBattleFrontier
en: The front lines of POKéMON battling! Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!
et: POKéMON-lahingute eesliin! Tere tulemast BATTLE FRONTIERisse!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: For a first-time visitor, we issue the FRONTIER PASS.
et: Esmakordsele külastajale väljastame FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: It's for use at all the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Seda kasutatakse kõigis BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatistes.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueFrontierPass
en: Here you are!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ObtainedFrontierPass
en: {PLAYER} obtained the FRONTIER PASS.
et: {PLAYER} sai FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_PlacedTrainerCardInFrontierPass
en: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD in the FRONTIER PASS.
et: {PLAYER} asetas TRAINER CARDi FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyBattleFrontier
en: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE FRONTIER has to offer!
et: Loodame, et naudid kõike, mida BATTLE FRONTIER pakkuda oskab!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIsntPlayerYouCame
en: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! You came out here!
et: ???: Ohoo, kas pole mitte {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sa tulid siia välja!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrScottGoodDay
en: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir! Good day to you, sir!
et: TEEJUHT: Oh! MR. SCOTT, härra! Tere päevast teile, härra!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: SCOTT: It's great to see you here, it really is!
et: SCOTT: On tore sind siin näha, tõesti on!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: I hope you'll take your time and explore everywhere.
et: Loodan, et võtad aega ja uurid siin kõik läbi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: Naturally, I hope you'll also experience the pure essence of battling.
et: Loomulikult loodan, et saad tunda ka võitlemise puhast võlu.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottGreatToSeeYouHere
en: I also have my quarters here, so feel free to visit if you have time.
et: Mul on siin ka oma peatuspaik, nii et astu julgelt läbi, kui aega on.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFacilities
en: I'm your guide to the various facilities here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Mina tutvustan sulle BATTLE FRONTIERi eri rajatisi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich2
en: Which would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid rohkem kuulda?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
en: It is the gigantic tower considered to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.
et: See on hiiglaslik torn, mida peetakse BATTLE FRONTIERi sümboliks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleTowerInfo
en: There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI, and LINK MULTI BATTLES.
et: Tornis on neli liiki BATTLE ROOMe: ÜKSIK-, TOPELT-, MULTI- ja LINK MULTI-LAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: The BATTLE DOME is the large building shaped like a huge egg.
et: BATTLE DOME on suur hoone, mis meenutab hiiglaslikku muna.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: Events named Battle Tourneys are held in this facility.
et: Selles rajatises peetakse üritusi nimega lahinguturniirid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleDomeInfo
en: The Battle Tourneys are offered in two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Lahinguturniire pakutakse kahel rajal — ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
en: The BATTLE PALACE is the red building on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE PALACE on punane hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi paremas servas.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePalaceInfo
en: There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Seal on kaht liiki BATTLE SAALE: ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
en: The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like building at the center-right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE ARENA on dojo-laadne hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi keskel paremal pool.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleArenaInfo
en: An event called the Set KO Tourney takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.
et: BATTLE ARENAS toimub üritus nimega Set KO turniir.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: The BATTLE FACTORY is the large building that is the closest to us.
et: BATTLE FACTORY on suur hoone, mis jääb meile kõige lähemale.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: An event called the Battle Swap is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Swap.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattleFactoryInfo
en: The Battle Swap event is offered in two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
et: Üritust Battle Swap pakutakse kahel rajal — ÜKSIK- ja TOPELTLAHINGUTE jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
en: The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped like a POKéMON at the center-left of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE PIKE on POKéMONI-kujuline hoone BATTLE FRONTIERi keskel vasakul pool.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePikeInfo
en: An event called the Battle Choice is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Choice.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
en: The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous pyramid.
et: BATTLE PYRAMID on see tohutu püramiid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePyramidInfo
en: An event called the Battle Quest is conducted there.
et: Seal peetakse üritust nimega Battle Quest.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
en: The RANKING HALL is located near the BATTLE TOWER.
et: RANKING HALL asub BATTLE TOWERi lähedal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RankingHallInfo
en: There, you may see the most fantastic records left by the TRAINERS that took on the many challenges of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Seal võid näha kõige vapustavamaid rekordeid, mille on püstitanud TRAINERID, kes on BATTLE FRONTIERi paljud väljakutsed vastu võtnud.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
en: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near the BATTLE TOWER.
et: EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER on BATTLE TOWERi lähedal.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ExchangeCornerInfo
en: The Battle Points you have earned in the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged for fabulous prizes there.
et: Battle Pointe, mille oled BATTLE FRONTIERis teeninud, saab seal vapustavate auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToRules
en: I'm your guide to the basic rules that are common to all the challenges offered by the facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Mina tutvustan sulle põhireegleid, mis kehtivad kõigil BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatiste väljakutsetel.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhat
en: What would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid rohkem kuulda?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelModeInfo
en: All the challenges at the BATTLE FRONTIER's facilities come in two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.
et: Kõiki BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatiste väljakutseid pakutakse kahel rajal — Tase 50 ja Avatud tase.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON up to and including Level 50.
et: Tase 50 rajale pääsevad POKéMONid kuni tasemeni 50 (kaasa arvatud).

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: Please keep in mind, however, that no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 50.
et: Pane siiski tähele, et ühelgi TRAINERIL, kellega kohtud, pole POKéMONe alla taseme 50.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: This course is the entry level for battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: See rada on BATTLE FRONTIERi lahingute algtase.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level50Info
en: To begin, we hope you will challenge this course.
et: Loodame, et alustad just sellelt rajalt.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: The Open Level course places no limit on the levels of POKéMON entering challenges.
et: Avatud taseme rada ei sea väljakutsele astuvate POKéMONide tasemele mingit piiri.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: The levels of your opponents will be adjusted to match the levels of your POKéMON.
et: Su vastaste tasemed kohandatakse su POKéMONide tasemetega.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLevelInfo
en: However, no TRAINER you face will have any POKéMON below Level 60.
et: Ühelgi TRAINERIL, kellega kohtud, pole aga POKéMONe alla taseme 60.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take on the challenges at all facilities.
et: Peaaegu iga POKéMON võib kõigi rajatiste väljakutsetele astuda.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON, however, are not permitted.
et: MUNAD ja teatud liiki POKéMONid pole aga lubatud.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: The numbers of POKéMON required for challenges will depend on the facility.
et: Väljakutseteks vajalik POKéMONide arv oleneb rajatisest.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEntryInfo
en: At all facilities, however, two or more of the same kind of POKéMON are not permitted.
et: Üheski rajatises ei tohi aga kaasa võtta kahte või enamat sama liiki POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
en: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not be holding the same kind of item.
et: BATTLE FRONTIERi rajatise väljakutsele astudes ei tohi POKéMONid hoida ühesugust eset.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldItemsInfo
en: Please make sure that all POKéMON entering a challenge are holding different items.
et: Palun veendu, et kõik väljakutsele astuvad POKéMONid hoiavad erinevaid esemeid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGuideToFrontierPass
en: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.
et: Mina tutvustan sulle FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnAboutWhich1
en: Which would you like to learn about?
et: Millest sooviksid rohkem kuulda?

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: There are seven facilities at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: BATTLE FRONTIERis on seitse rajatist.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: TRAINERS who gain recognition for their abilities may be rewarded with symbols from each of the facilities.
et: Iga rajatis võib TRAINERIT, kelle võimeid tunnustatakse, premeerida oma sümboliga.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need to defeat other TRAINERS in a row, and may need to win events repeatedly.
et: Sümboli teenimiseks tuleb TRAINERIL alistada teisi TRAINEREID järjest või võita üritusi korduvalt.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_SymbolsInfo
en: It's certainly not easy to win symbols. I wish you the best of luck!
et: Sümboleid pole sugugi kerge võita. Soovin sulle palju edu!

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: It is possible to record one battle on your FRONTIER PASS.
et: FRONTIER PASSile on võimalik salvestada üks lahing.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: You may record a battle you had with a friend or friends.
et: Võid salvestada lahingu, mille pidasid sõbra või sõpradega.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: Or you may record a battle conducted at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding matches at the BATTLE PIKE or the BATTLE PYRAMID.
et: Või võid salvestada BATTLE FRONTIERis peetud lahingu — välja arvatud BATTLE PIKE ja BATTLE PYRAMID matšid.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_RecordedBattleInfo
en: You may choose to record your match at the end of a battle.
et: Lahingu lõpus saad valida, kas matš salvestada.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
en: Battle Points are rewards given to TRAINERS who battled outstandingly at the BATTLE FRONTIER.
et: Battle Pointid on tasu TRAINERITELE, kes on BATTLE FRONTIERis silmapaistvalt võidelnud.

label: BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_BattlePointsInfo
en: You may trade in your Battle Points for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER.
et: Võid oma Battle Pointid EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNERis auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: Route124_Text_HuntersHouse

en: Once you have partnered up, you will be shown to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM.
et: Kui olete paari löönud, juhatatakse teid MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
en: In the MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven tag teams await your challenge.
et: MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMIS ootab su väljakutset seitse paarismeeskonda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
en: If you manage to defeat all seven teams, you will earn Battle Points.
et: Kui suudate kõik seitse meeskonda alistada, teenite Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, please save the game.
et: Kui tahad oma väljakutse katkestada, palun salvesta mäng.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultisChallenge
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectTwoMons
en: Now please select the two POKéMON that are to be entered.
et: Nüüd palun vali kaks POKéMONi, keda üles panna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeLinkMultiBattle
en: Where the talents of TRAINERS are put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERite anded!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeLinkMultiBattle
en: Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE TOWERisse!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_WelcomeLinkMultiBattle
en: I am your guide to the LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Mina juhatan sind LINK MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMIDESSE.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_TakeLinkMultisChallenge
en: Would you like to take the LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge?
et: Kas soovid võtta vastu LINK MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI väljakutse?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: The BATTLE TOWER's MULTI BATTLE ROOMS are facilities for conducting MULTI BATTLES with a friend.
et: BATTLE TOWERi MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMID on mõeldud MULTI-LAHINGUTEKS koos sõbraga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: You must link with your friend using Wireless Adapters or a Game Boy Advance Game Link cable.
et: Pead sõbraga ühenduma juhtmevabade adapterite või Game Boy Advance Game Link kaabli abil.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: You must partner with your friend and enter two different kinds of POKéMON.
et: Pead sõbraga paari lööma ja panema välja kaks POKéMONi, kes on sõbra omadest eri liiki.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: There are many MULTI BATTLE ROOMS in the BATTLE TOWER for team battles.
et: BATTLE TOWERis on palju MULTI-LAHINGU RUUME meeskonnalahinguteks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: In a MULTI BATTLE ROOM, seven tag teams await you and your friend to make a tag-team challenge.
et: MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMIS ootab sind ja su sõpra seitse paarismeeskonda, kellega koos jõudu katsuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: If you manage to defeat all seven teams, you will earn Battle Points.
et: Kui suudate kõik seitse meeskonda alistada, teenite Battle Pointe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: Please beware that unlike other ROOMS, you may not interrupt your challenge.
et: Palun pane tähele, et erinevalt teistest RUUMIDEST ei saa sa oma väljakutset katkestada.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainLinkMultisChallenge
en: Once you start, you must battle seven MULTI BATTLES in a row nonstop.
et: Kui alustad, pead pidama seitse MULTI-LAHINGUT järjest ilma peatumata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_PleaseSelectTwoMons2
en: Now please select the two POKéMON that are to be entered.
et: Nüüd palun vali kaks POKéMONi, keda üles panna.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChoseSameMonAsFriend
en: You have chosen the same kind of POKéMON as your friend.
et: Sa valisid sama liiki POKéMONi kui su sõber.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChoseSameMonAsFriend
en: Please choose two POKéMON different from your friend's, match the level you wish to enter, and register again.
et: Palun vali kaks POKéMONi, kes erinevad su sõbra omadest, lepi sõbraga tase kokku ja registreeru uuesti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_LinkMultiOnlyForTwoPlayers
en: The LINK MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge is only for two linked players.
et: LINK MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI väljakutse on ainult kahele ühendatud mängijale.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendAlsoSelectedMon
en: Your friend has also selected the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Su sõber valis samuti POKéMONi {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendAlsoSelectedMons
en: Your friend has also selected the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}.
et: Su sõber valis samuti POKéMONid {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_2}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendChoseDifferentLvlMode
en: Your friend has chosen a different battle level.
et: Su sõber valis erineva lahingutaseme.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendChoseDifferentLvlModeSameMon
en: Your friend has chosen a different battle level.
et: Su sõber valis erineva lahingutaseme.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendChoseDifferentLvlModeSameMon
en: Your friend has also selected the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Su sõber valis samuti POKéMONi {STR_VAR_1}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendChoseDifferentLvlModeSameMons
en: Your friend has chosen a different battle level.
et: Su sõber valis erineva lahingutaseme.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_FriendChoseDifferentLvlModeSameMons
en: Your friend has also selected the POKéMON {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2}.
et: Su sõber valis samuti POKéMONid {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_2}.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ChooseDifferentMonsMatchLvlMode
en: Please choose two POKéMON different from your friend's, match the level you wish to enter, and register again.
et: Palun vali kaks POKéMONi, kes erinevad su sõbra omadest, lepi sõbraga tase kokku ja registreeru uuesti.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_SaveGameBeforeShowingIn
en: I will save the game before showing you in. Please wait.
et: Ma salvestan mängu, enne kui sind sisse juhatan. Palun oota.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_CongratsDefeatedMaiden
en: Congratulations! You have defeated the SALON MAIDEN and swept seven TRAINERS!
et: Palju õnne! Sa alistasid SALON MAIDENi ja võitsid kõik seitse TRAINERit järjest!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_AwardYouTheseBattlePoints
en: In recognition of your infinite talent, we award you these Battle Point(s).
et: Sinu piiritu ande tunnustuseks anname sulle need Battle Pointid.

label: BattleFrontier_Text_ObtainedXBattlePoints
en: {PLAYER} obtained {STR_VAR_1} Battle Point(s).
et: {PLAYER} sai {STR_VAR_1} Battle Pointi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The BATTLE TOWER rules are listed.
et: Siin on kirjas BATTLE TOWERi reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Mille kohta sa lugeda soovid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where four types of battles are waged-SINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI BATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE.
et: BATTLE TOWER on rajatis, kus peetakse nelja tüüpi lahinguid — ÜKSIKLAHING, TOPELTLAHING, MULTI-LAHING ja LINK MULTI-LAHING.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: For each of these types, there are separate BATTLE ROOMS.
et: Iga tüübi jaoks on omad BATTLE ROOMid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainTowerRules
en: Please speak with a guide offering the type of battle you wish to enter.
et: Räägi teejuhiga, kes pakub just seda lahingut, mida sa soovid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are entering, you will be required to take a certain number of POKéMON.
et: Olenevalt sellest, millisesse BATTLE ROOMi sa astud, on vaja kindlat arvu POKéMONe.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The SINGLE BATTLE mode requires three POKéMON.
et: ÜKSIKLAHINGU režiim nõuab kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: The DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four, and the MULTI modes both require two.
et: TOPELTLAHINGU režiim nõuab nelja ja mõlemad MULTI-režiimid nõuavad kahte.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: The BATTLE SALON is where you must find a partner to form a tag team for the MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge.
et: BATTLE SALONIS tuleb leida partner, kellega moodustada paarismeeskond MULTI-LAHINGU RUUMI jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: Choose the best partner for you by examining other TRAINERS' POKéMON and their moves.
et: Vali endale parim partner, uurides teiste TRAINERite POKéMONe ja nende võtteid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainSalonRules
en: You may choose a new tag partner after winning seven straight matches.
et: Pärast seitset järjestikust võitu võid valida uue paarispartneri.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two friends to mount a challenge together.
et: LINK MULTI-LAHINGU režiimis saavad kaks sõpra koos jõudu katsuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You and your friend must be linked with Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link cable.
et: Sina ja su sõber peate olema ühendatud juhtmevabade adapterite või GBA Game Link kaabli abil.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You must choose two POKéMON at the registration counter.
et: Pead registreerimislaua juures valima kaks POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: These POKéMON must be different from those of your friend.
et: Need POKéMONid peavad erinema su sõbra omadest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_ExplainMultiLinkRules
en: You may not interrupt this challenge in the middle, unlike other modes.
et: Erinevalt teistest režiimidest ei saa seda väljakutset poole pealt katkestada.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: Hm, so they doubled the guests by using POKéMON as attractions?
et: Hm, nii et nad kahekordistasid külaliste arvu, kasutades POKéMONe atraktsioonidena?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute POKéMON our inn's mascot.
et: Hm, noh, ehk peaksin mõne nunnu POKéMONi meie võõrastemaja maskotiks võtma.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_GuestsDoubledByMascot
en: I wonder if that will attract more guests to stay with us?
et: Huvitav, kas see meelitab rohkem külalisi meie juurde jääma?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV!
et: Oi, vabandust, vabandust! Olin telekasse nii süvenenud!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGuestsWithTeamAqua
en: Since that TEAM AQUA came to town, the tourists have been staying away.
et: Sellest ajast, kui see TEAM AQUA linna tuli, hoiavad turistid eemale.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantSeeTheTV
en: Hey, down in front! I can't see the TV!
et: Hei, seal ees! Ma ei näe telekat!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON found someone's lost item?
et: Uskumatu! Kas tõesti leidis POKéMON kellegi kaotatud asja?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: That's something. If we had some smart POKéMON like that…
et: Vaat see on asi. Kui meilgi oleks mõni nii tark POKéMON…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFoundLostItem
en: We could recover anything that our guests mislaid…
et: Siis leiaksime üles kõik, mille külalised kaotavad…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV!
et: Oi, vabandust, vabandust! Olin telekasse nii süvenenud!

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: I heard that someone busted the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT.
et: Ma kuulsin, et keegi lõi TEAM AQUA PEIDIKU laiaks.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: Thanks to that, we just booked a reservation from a big group.
et: Tänu sellele tuli meile just suure seltskonna broneering.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HeardAquaHideoutBusted
en: It was a company called… Uh… GAME something…
et: See oli firma nimega… Öö… GAME midagi…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON caught a burglar?
et: Uskumatu! Maja valvanud POKéMON püüdis varga kinni?

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: That's something. If we had a tough POKéMON as a security guard…
et: Vaat see on asi. Kui meilgi oleks turvameheks mõni kõva POKéMON…

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_HouseSittingMonCaughtBurglar
en: We would be able to provide our guests with greater safety.
et: Siis oleksid meie külalised palju turvalisemad.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Oh, sorry, sorry! I was too involved in watching TV.
et: Oi, vabandust, vabandust! Olin telekasse nii süvenenud.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Oh, yes. A big group of guests arrived a little while ago.
et: Ah jaa. Veidi aega tagasi saabus suur seltskond külalisi.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: They booked in as GAME FREAK, so I guess they must make games.
et: Nad registreerisid end nimega GAME FREAK, järelikult teevad nad vist mänge.

label: LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_BetterGetWorkingOnGuestsDinner
en: Uh-oh, I'd better get working on their dinner!
et: Oih, parem ma asun nende õhtusöögi kallale!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro
en: DAN: While searching for treasures, we discovered a TRAINER!
et: DAN: Aardeid otsides avastasime TRAINERi!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat
en: DAN: We couldn't win even though we worked together…
et: DAN: Isegi koos ei suutnud me võita…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBattle
en: DAN: We can't find any treasures… I wonder if someone got them already?
et: DAN: Me ei leia ühtki aaret… Huvitav, kas keegi sai need juba kätte?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoughMons
en: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
et: DAN: Sul pole isegi kahte POKéMONi. Niimoodi ei maksa loota meist jagu saada.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro
en: KIRA: Oh? We were searching for treasures. But we discovered a TRAINER instead!
et: KIRA: Oh? Me otsisime aardeid. Aga leidsime selle asemel TRAINERi!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraDefeat
en: KIRA: Ooh, so strong!
et: KIRA: Ohoo, nii tugev!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
en: KIRA: Where could the treasures be?
et: KIRA: Kus need aarded küll võiksid olla?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBattle
en: I've already decided what I'm buying when we find the treasures!
et: Ma juba otsustasin, mida ostan, kui me aarded leiame!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnoughMons
en: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
et: KIRA: Oh, sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Peame mõni teine kord võitlema!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegister
en: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry! I'm going to register you for that!
et: KIRA: Oi, sa ajad mu nii vihale! Selle eest ma registreerin su ära!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
en: DAN: We've been searching for treasures all this time.
et: DAN: Me oleme kogu selle aja aardeid otsinud.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchIntro
en: Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. Let us show you, okay?
et: Ka meie POKéMONid on tugevamaks saanud. Lase meil sulle näidata, olgu?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchDefeat
en: DAN: You're strong, as usual!
et: DAN: Sa oled tugev, nagu ikka!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
en: DAN: We can't find any treasures, we lose at POKéMON…
et: DAN: Aardeid ei leia, POKéMON-lahingud kaotame…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRematch
en: I want to go home… But if I say that, she gets all angry with me…
et: Ma tahan koju… Aga kui ma seda ütlen, läheb ta minu peale pahaseks…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchNotEnoughMons
en: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. You can't expect to beat us like that.
et: DAN: Sul pole isegi kahte POKéMONi. Niimoodi ei maksa loota meist jagu saada.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: KIRA: Oh? We meet again!
et: KIRA: Oh? Me kohtume taas!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: Just like us, you still haven't given up searching for treasures, have you?
et: Nagu meiegi, pole sa aardeotsingut veel maha jätnud, ega ju?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchIntro
en: Want to make it so the loser has to give up searching?
et: Kas lepime kokku, et kaotaja peab otsimise maha jätma?

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchDefeat
en: KIRA: Oh, we lost again…
et: KIRA: Oh, kaotasime jälle…

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRematch
en: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise our POKéMON some more and we find the treasures here!
et: KIRA: Me ei lahku enne, kui oleme oma POKéMONid tugevamaks treeninud ja siit aarded leidnud!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematchNotEnoughMons
en: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? We'll have to battle some other time!
et: KIRA: Oh, sul pole kahte POKéMONi? Peame mõni teine kord võitlema!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro
en: I'm not good at swimming, but I am good at battles!
et: Ma pole ujumises hea, aga lahingutes olen!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat
en: Oops. That didn't go very well.
et: Uups. See ei läinud eriti hästi.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBattle
en: Walking around barefoot in this ship is kind of gross.
et: Selles laevas paljajalu ringi kõndida on kuidagi vastik.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonIntro
en: Strength and compassion… Those are a TRAINER's treasures!
et: Jõud ja kaastunne… Need on TRAINERi aarded!

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDefeat
en: Ah, there is something about you that sparkles.
et: Ah, sinus on midagi, mis sätendab.

label: AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPostBattle
en: In a cabin somewhere on board, I saw something sparkle.
et: Nägin kusagil laeva kajutis midagi sätendamas.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut
en: The clerk says they're all sold out. I can't buy any POKé BALLS.
et: Müüja ütleb, et need on kõik välja müüdud. Ma ei saa ühtki POKé PALLI osta.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBalls
en: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS and catch a bunch of POKéMON!
et: Ostan terve hunniku POKé PALLI ja püüan hulga POKéMONe!

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
en: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP and faints, it won't be able to battle.
et: Kui POKéMON saab viga, kaotab HP ja minestab, ei saa ta enam võidelda.

label: OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion
en: To prevent your POKéMON from fainting, restore its HP with a POTION.
et: Et su POKéMON ei minestaks, taasta ta HP esemega POTION.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_DoorIsLocked
en: The door is locked.
et: Uks on lukus.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UseBasementKey
en: Use the BASEMENT KEY?
et: Kas kasutada eset BASEMENT KEY?

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
en: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY.
et: {PLAYER} kasutas eset BASEMENT KEY.

label: NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKey
en: The door opened!
et: Uks avanes!

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one at the left of the list goes out first.
et: Kui POKéMON-lahing algab, läheb esimesena välja see, kes on nimekirjas vasakul.

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: So, when you get more POKéMON in your party, try switching around the order of your POKéMON.
et: Nii et kui saad oma seltskonda rohkem POKéMONe, proovi oma POKéMONide järjekorda muuta.

label: OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOutFirst
en: It could give you an advantage.
et: See võib sulle eelise anda.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonHasAbility
en: Every POKéMON has a special ability that it can use.
et: Igal POKéMONil on eriline võime, mida ta saab kasutada.

label: RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_PokemonStrange
en: POKéMON are such strange creatures.
et: POKéMONid on nii veidrad olendid.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
en: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time, and it gets the job done.
et: SUPER REPEL kestab kaua ja teeb töö ära.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter
en: It's much better than an ordinary REPEL.
et: See on palju parem kui tavaline REPEL.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
en: I always stock up on more items than I'm sure I'll need.
et: Ma varun alati rohkem esemeid, kui arvan vajavat.

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems
en: You never know what might happen. Better to be safe than sorry!
et: Kunagi ei tea, mis võib juhtuda. Parem karta kui kahetseda!

label: FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonGrow
en: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow immediately by one level.
et: RARE CANDY tõstab POKéMONi taset kohe ühe võrra.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
en: That PC-based POKéMON Storage System…
et: See ARVUTIS olev POKéMONide hoiusüsteem…

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCStorageSystem
en: Whoever made it must be some kind of a scientific wizard!
et: Selle looja peab olema mingi teadusvõlur!

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OranBerryRegainedHP
en: When my POKéMON ate an ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!
et: Kui mu POKéMON sõi ORAN BERRY ära, taastus tal HP!

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: There are many types of POKéMON.
et: POKéMONe on palju eri tüüpe.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: All types have their strengths and weaknesses against other types.
et: Kõigil tüüpidel on oma tugevused ja nõrkused teiste tüüpide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManyTypesOfPokemon
en: Depending on the types of POKéMON, a battle could be easy or hard.
et: Sõltuvalt POKéMONide tüüpidest võib lahing olla kerge või raske.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: For example, your TREECKO is a GRASS type.
et: Näiteks su TREECKO on ROHU-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: It's strong against the WATER and GROUND types.
et: Ta on tugev VEE- ja MAA-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TreeckoIsGrassType
en: But, it's weak against FIRE-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk TULE-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: For example, your TORCHIC is a FIRE type.
et: Näiteks su TORCHIC on TULE-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: It's strong against the GRASS and BUG types.
et: Ta on tugev ROHU- ja PUTUKA-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TorchicIsFireType
en: But, it's weak against WATER-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk VEE-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: For example, your MUDKIP is a WATER type.
et: Näiteks su MUDKIP on VEE-tüüpi.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: It's strong against the FIRE type.
et: Ta on tugev TULE-tüübi vastu.

label: PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MudkipIsWaterType
en: But, it's weak against GRASS-type and ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
et: Aga ta on nõrk ROHU-tüüpi ja ELEKTRI-tüüpi POKéMONide vastu.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short distance after the VICTORY ROAD.
et: Pärast VICTORY ROAD on POKéMON LIIGANI jäänud vaid lühike maa.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LeagueAfterVictoryRoad
en: If you've come this far, what choice do you have but to keep going?
et: Kui oled juba nii kaugele jõudnud, mis muud üle jääb, kui edasi minna?

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD…
et: Pikk ja piinarikas VICTORY ROAD…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: It's like reliving the path one has traveled in life…
et: Nagu elaksid uuesti läbi kogu oma senise eluteekonna…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BelieveInYourPokemon
en: Believe in your POKéMON and give it your very best!
et: Usu oma POKéMONi ja anna endast parim!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE!
et: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, sa oled küüntega üles rühkinud, et POKéMON LIIGALE vastu astuda!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: I'm happy for you! You made my cheering worthwhile!
et: Mul on sinu üle hea meel! Ma ei ergutanud sind asjata!

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION…
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kui sinust saaks POKéMON LIIGA MEISTER…

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: I'll get in touch with you then.
et: Ma võtan sinuga siis ühendust.

label: EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ScottHappyForYou
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Go for greatness!
et: Olgu, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Näita, mis sinus on!

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentCollectsRareStones
en: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect rare stones.
et: DEVONI PRESIDENDILE meeldib haruldasi kive koguda.

label: RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSonAlsoCollectsRareStones
en: I think the PRESIDENT's son also collects rare stones.
et: Ma arvan, et PRESIDENDI poeg kogub samuti haruldasi kive.

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
en: Huh? What? What's that?
et: Ää? Mis? Mis see on?

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHaveThis
en: I'm not near awake yet… You can have this…
et: Ma pole veel päriselt ärkvel… Võta see endale…

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
en: Yawn…
et: Uaaah…

label: LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssential
en: Sleep is essential for good health… Sleep and regain health…
et: Uni on hea tervise jaoks hädavajalik… Maga ja taasta tervis…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: Got here already, did you? We underestimated you!
et: Jõudsid juba siia, mis? Me alahindasime sind!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: But this is it!
et: Aga siit sa kaugemale ei saa!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: I'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen so far.
et: Ma olen neist SELLIDEST, keda sa siiani näinud oled, terve pea jagu üle.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro
en: I'm not stalling for time. I'm going to pulverize you!
et: Ma ei viivita. Ma teen su pihuks ja põrmuks!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat
en: Hehehe… So, I lost, too…
et: Hehehe… Nii et minagi kaotasin…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHisPreparations
en: While I was toying with you, our BOSS got through his preparations!
et: Kuni ma sinuga mängisin, sai meie BOSS oma ettevalmistused tehtud!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: Our BOSS has already gone on his way to some cave under the sea!
et: Meie BOSS on juba teel kuskile koopasse mere põhjas!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: If you're going to give chase, you'd better search the big, wide sea beyond LILYCOVE.
et: Kui kavatsed järele minna, otsi läbi see suur lai meri LILYCOVE LINNAST kaugemal.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle
en: But will you find it then? Hehehe!
et: Aga kas sa siis leiad? Hehehe!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro
en: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting! You owe me a battle, too!
et: Vahahaa, mind tüütas ootamine! Sa võlgned mullegi lahingu!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat
en: Tired of waiting… Lost and dazed…
et: Ootamisest väsinud… Kaotanud ja uimane…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle
en: BOSS… Is this good enough?
et: BOSS… Kas sellest piisab?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride and joy!
et: Teleportpaneelid, PEIDIKU uhkus ja rõõm!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: You're clueless about where you are, aren't you?
et: Sul pole aimugi, kus sa oled, ega ju?

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro
en: Fluster and tire out the enemy, then lower the boom! That's our plan!
et: Aja vaenlane segadusse, väsita ära ja anna siis hoop! Selline ongi meie plaan!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat
en: What's wrong with you? You're not tired at all!
et: Mis sul viga on? Sa pole üldse väsinud!

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: That reminds me… I can't remember where I put the MASTER BALL.
et: See tuletab meelde… Ma ei mäleta, kuhu ma MASTER PALLI panin.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle
en: If I fail to guard it, our BOSS will chew me out…
et: Kui ma seda ei valva, saan BOSSILT sõimu…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro
en: When I joined TEAM AQUA, the first thing I had to learn was how these warp panels connected.
et: Kui ma TEAM AQUAGA liitusin, pidin kõigepealt selgeks õppima, kuhu need teleportpaneelid viivad.

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Defeat
en: I was too occupied thinking about the warp panels…
et: Mul oli mõte liialt teleportpaneelide juures…

label: AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle
en: I'll have to learn about how I can battle more effectively…
et: Ma pean õppima, kuidas tõhusamalt võidelda…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThisIsMauvilleGameCorner
en: This is MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.
et: See on MAUVILLE GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
en: Okay, you wanted some COINS for the games?
et: Olgu, sa tahtsid mängude jaoks MÜNTE?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseForCoins
en: But you don't have a COIN CASE for stowing the COINS.
et: Aga sul pole eset COIN CASE, kuhu MÜNDID panna.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
en: Were you looking for COINS?
et: Kas otsisid MÜNTE?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLookingForCoins
en: It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS. Would you like some?
et: 50 MÜNTI maksab ¥1000. Kas soovid?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHereAreYourCoins
en: Thank you very much! Here are your COINS!
et: Suur tänu! Siin on su MÜNDID!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEnoughMoney
en: Um… You don't appear to have enough money…
et: Öö… Sul ei näi olevat piisavalt raha…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
en: Oh? Your COIN CASE is full.
et: Oh? Su COIN CASE on täis.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoinsThen
en: Oh… You don't need COINS, then? Good luck on your adventure!
et: Oh… Sa ei vaja siis MÜNTE? Edu su seiklusel!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
en: Welcome.
et: Tere tulemast.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoinsForPrizes
en: You can exchange your COINS for prizes here.
et: Siin saad oma MÜNDID auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichPrize
en: Which prize would you like?
et: Millist auhinda sooviksid?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsTheTMX
en: So your choice is the {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?
et: Nii et su valik on {STR_VAR_1} {STR_VAR_2}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourHomePC
en: Thank you! We'll send it to your PC at home.
et: Aitäh! Me saadame selle su koju ARVUTISSE.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NotEnoughCoins
en: You don't have enough COINS.
et: Sul pole piisavalt MÜNTE.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPlacingDecor
en: There isn't any room available for placing {STR_VAR_1}.
et: Pole vaba kohta, kuhu {STR_VAR_1} asetada.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: Oh, is that so? You need to save some COINS before coming back here.
et: Oh, on või? Sa pead veidi MÜNTE koguma, enne kui siia tagasi tuled.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SoYourChoiceIsX
en: So your choice is {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Nii et su valik on {STR_VAR_1}?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo
en: Here you go!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAnyMore
en: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.
et: Oh, sa ei saa rohkem kaasas kanda.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
en: I made a mistake and got two of the same DOLLS.
et: Ma eksisin ja sain kaks ühesugust NUKKU.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSameDollWantOne
en: Would you like one of them?
et: Kas sooviksid üht neist?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HereYouGo2
en: Here you go!
et: Palun, siin ta on!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItButNotNow
en: Huh? You want it, but not right now?
et: Ää? Sa tahad seda, aga mitte praegu?

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegative
en: Oh, don't be so negative! You can have this!
et: Oh, ära ole nii tõrges! Võta see endale!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJackpot
en: There's a prize I want, but I can't win the jackpot.
et: Üks auhind meeldiks mulle küll, aga peavõitu ma kätte ei saa.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
en: Hey, kid, if you want to play here, you need a COIN CASE.
et: Hei, põnn, kui tahad siin mängida, on sul vaja eset COIN CASE.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCaseGoNextDoor
en: I think the young lady next door had one. Go see her!
et: Naabritüdrukul vist oli üks. Mine küsi tema käest!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLastSoLongTakeCoins
en: My luck can only last so long. This is too much for me. Here, take some COINS!
et: Ega mu õnn igavesti kesta. See on mulle liiga palju. Võta sina need MÜNDID!

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
en: MAUVILLE has something for everyone.
et: MAUVILLE LINNAS on igaühele midagi.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSomethingForEveryone
en: For me, it's the GAME CORNER.
et: Minu jaoks on see GAME CORNER.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
en: The ROULETTE tables have different rates.
et: ROULETTE-laudadel on erinevad panused.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTablesDifferentRates
en: Check your COINS if you're going to pick a table.
et: Kontrolli oma MÜNTE, kui hakkad lauda valima.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseTrackOfTime
en: It's easy to lose track of time in here. I should get back to work.
et: Siin kaob ajataju kiiresti. Peaksin tööle tagasi minema.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNeededToPlay
en: COINS are needed to play here in the GAME CORNER.
et: Siin GAME CORNERis on mängimiseks vaja MÜNTE.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
en: This ROULETTE thing… It's rather demanding.
et: See ROULETTE-värk… on päris nõudlik mäng.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnlyLuck
en: Win or lose, it's only by luck.
et: Võit või kaotus, see on ainult õnne asi.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsCanBeUsed
en: Up to three COINS can be used to play the SLOTS.
et: SLOTIDE mängimiseks saab kasutada kuni kolme MÜNTI.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
en: It's very difficult to make it stop right on “7.”
et: Väga raske on see just „7” peal seisma panna.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultToStopOn7
en: If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.
et: Kui see peatub REEL TIME boonusmängus „7” peal, saad lisamünte.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: Here's some information for you about the SLOTS.
et: Räägin sulle veidi SLOTIDEST.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: The more lightning bolts you stock, the more REEL TIME chances you get.
et: Mida rohkem välgunooli varud, seda rohkem REEL TIME võimalusi saad.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: In a game with the maximum five REEL TIME chances…
et: Mängus, kus on maksimaalselt viis REEL TIME võimalust…

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: It is possible to receive four regular bonuses, then a big bonus.
et: On võimalik saada neli tavalist boonust ja siis suur boonus.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSlotsInfo
en: That would total 660 COINS, but it's very difficult to get.
et: See teeks kokku 660 MÜNTI, aga seda on väga raske saada.

label: MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWithNoCoinCase
en: You can't play if you don't have a COIN CASE.
et: Ilma esemeta COIN CASE ei saa sa mängida.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
en: Let me see your POKéMON. I'll check to see how much it likes you.
et: Näita mulle oma POKéMONi. Ma vaatan, kui väga sa talle meeldid.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_SeeHowMuchPokemonLikesYou
en: Oh. Your POKéMON…
et: Oh. Su POKéMON…

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_AdoresYou
en: It adores you. It can't possibly love you any more. I even feel happy seeing it.
et: Ta jumaldab sind. Ta ei saakski sind rohkem armastada. Mul on lausa hea meel teda näha.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryHappy
en: It seems to be very happy. It obviously likes you a whole lot.
et: Ta paistab väga õnnelik. Sa ilmselgelt meeldid talle väga.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_LikesYouQuiteALot
en: It likes you quite a lot. It seems to want to be babied a little.
et: Sa meeldid talle päris palju. Näib, et ta tahab, et teda veidi hellitataks.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_GettingUsedToYou
en: It's getting used to you. It seems to believe in you.
et: Ta harjub sinuga. Näib, et ta usub sinusse.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_NotUsedToYou
en: It's not very used to you yet. It neither loves nor hates you.
et: Ta pole veel sinuga eriti harjunud. Ta ei armasta ega vihka sind.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_VeryWary
en: It's very wary. It has scary viciousness in its eyes. It doesn't like you much at all.
et: Ta on väga umbusklik. Silmis on tal hirmuäratav õelus. Sa ei meeldi talle sugugi.

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
en: This is a little hard for me to say…
et: Seda on mul veidi raske öelda…

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_DetestsYou
en: Your POKéMON simply detests you. Doesn't that make you uncomfortable?
et: Su POKéMON lausa põlgab sind. Kas sul endal ei hakka kõhe?

label: VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Text_Pikachu
en: PIKACHU: Pika pika!
et: PIKACHU: Pika pika!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere
en: MOM: See, {PLAYER}? Isn't it nice in here, too?
et: EMA: Näed, {PLAYER}? Kas pole siin ka kena?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: The mover's POKéMON do all the work of moving us in and cleaning up after. This is so convenient!
et: Kolimisfirma POKéMONid teevad kogu töö ära — kolivad meid sisse ja koristavad ka. Nii mugav!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: {PLAYER}, your room is upstairs. Go check it out, dear!
et: {PLAYER}, su tuba on üleval. Mine vaata, kallis!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetClock
en: DAD bought you a new clock to mark our move here. Don't forget to set it!
et: ISA ostis sulle kolimise puhul uue kella. Ära unusta seda õigeks seada!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
en: MOM: Well, {PLAYER}?
et: EMA: Noh, {PLAYER}?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedInRoom
en: Aren't you interested in seeing your very own room?
et: Kas sa ei taha oma päris enda tuba näha?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
en: MOM: {PLAYER}.
et: EMME: {PLAYER}.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock
en: Go set the clock in your room, honey.
et: Mine sea oma toas kell, kullake.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_OhComeQuickly
en: MOM: Oh! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}! Quick! Come quickly!
et: EMA: Oi! {PLAYER}, {PLAYER}! Kiiresti! Tule ruttu!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn
en: MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM! Maybe DAD will be on!
et: EMA: Vaata! See on PETALBURG SAAL! Võib-olla on ISA ekraanil!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
en: MOM: Oh… It's over.
et: EMA: Oh… See on läbi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim
en: I think DAD was on, but we missed him. Too bad.
et: Vist oli ISA ekraanil, aga me jäime temast ilma. Kahju küll.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: Oh, yes. One of DAD's friends lives in town.
et: Oh, jah. Üks ISA sõpradest elab linnas.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: PROF. BIRCH is his name.
et: Tema nimi on PROF. BIRCH.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourselfNextDoor
en: He lives right next door, so you should go over and introduce yourself.
et: Ta elab siinsamas kõrvalmajas, mine tutvusta end talle.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_SeeYouHoney
en: MOM: See you, honey!
et: EMA: Näeme, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch
en: MOM: Did you introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?
et: EMA: Kas sa tutvustasid end PROF. BIRCHILE?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
en: MOM: How are you doing, {PLAYER}? You look a little tired.
et: EMA: Kuidas läheb, {PLAYER}? Sa näed veidi väsinud välja.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShouldRestABit
en: I think you should rest a bit.
et: Ma arvan, et sa peaksid veidi puhkama.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TakeCareHoney
en: MOM: Take care, honey!
et: EMA: Hoia end, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
en: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?
et: EMA: Oh? Kas ISA andis sulle selle MÄRGI?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSomethingFromMom
en: Then here's something from your MOM!
et: Siis on siin midagi EMA käest!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
en: Don't push yourself too hard, dear. You can always come home.
et: Ära pinguta end liiga üle, kallis. Sa võid alati koju tulla.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfTooHard
en: Go for it, honey!
et: Anna minna, kullake!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
en: MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV? Someone from DEVON gave it to you?
et: EMA: Mis see on, kullake? POKéNAV? Keegi DEVONIST andis selle sulle?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav
en: Well, honey, how about registering your mom?
et: Noh, kullake, kuidas oleks, kui registreeriksid oma ema?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RegisteredMom
en: Registered MOM in the POKéNAV.
et: EMA registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth1
en: Fugiiiiih!
et: Fugiiiih!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_Vigoroth2
en: Huggoh, uggo uggo…
et: Huggoh, uggo uggo…

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburgGym
en: INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this report from in front of PETALBURG GYM.
et: INTERVJUEERIJA: …Me tõime teile selle reportaaži PETALBURG SAALI eest.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: There is a movie on TV.
et: Telekas on film.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: Two men are dancing on a big piano keyboard.
et: Kaks meest tantsivad suurel klaveriklahvistikul.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TheresAMovieOnTV
en: Better get going!
et: Parem asun teele!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: It's the instruction booklet for the RUNNING SHOES.
et: See on jalatsite RUNNING SHOES kasutusjuhend.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: “Press the B Button to run while wearing your RUNNING SHOES.
et: „Kui kannad jalas RUNNING SHOES, vajuta jooksmiseks B-nuppu.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_RunningShoesManual
en: “Lace up your RUNNING SHOES and hit the road running!”
et: „Nööri RUNNING SHOES jalga ja lase jooksuga teele!”

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: DAD: Hm?
et: ISA: Hm?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: Hey, it's {PLAYER}!
et: Hei, see on {PLAYER}!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: It's been a while since I saw you, but you look…stronger, somehow.
et: Ammu pole sind näinud, aga sa näed…kuidagi tugevam välja.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: That's the impression I get. But your old man hasn't given up yet!
et: Selline mulje mul on. Aga su vanamees pole veel alla andnud!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_TicketFromBrineyCameForYou
en: Oh, yes, I have something for you. This came to you from someone named MR. BRINEY.
et: Oh, jah, mul on sulle midagi. See tuli sulle kelleltki nimega MR. BRINEY.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
en: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?
et: ISA: Hm, praami PILET?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLilycove
en: If I recall, there are ferry ports in SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.
et: Kui õigesti mäletan, on praamisadamad SLATEPORT LINNAS ja LILYCOVE LINNAS.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
en: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.
et: Parem ma lähen tagasi PETALBURG SAALI.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym
en: MOM, thanks for looking after the house while I'm away.
et: EMA, aitäh, et minu äraolekul maja eest hoolitsed.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: MOM: That DAD of yours…
et: EMA: See sinu ISA…

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: He comes home for the first time in a while, but all he talks about is POKéMON.
et: Tuleb ükskord pika aja pärast koju ja räägib ainult POKéMONidest.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger
en: He should relax and stay a little longer.
et: Ta peaks lõõgastuma ja veidi kauemaks jääma.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStory
en: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?
et: EMA: Kas see on erakorraline uudis?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: We bring you this emergency news flash!
et: Toome teieni erakorralise uudise!

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: In various HOENN locales, there have been reports of a BZZT…colored POKéMON in flight.
et: Mitmel pool HOENNis on nähtud lendamas BZZT…värvi POKéMONi.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: The identity of this POKéMON is currently unknown.
et: Praegu pole teada, milline POKéMON see on.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFlash
en: We now return you to the regular movie program.
et: Nüüd jätkame katkestatud filmiga.

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
en: MOM: {PLAYER}, did you catch that?
et: EMA: {PLAYER}, kas sa kuulsid?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_WhatColorDidTheySay
en: What color did the announcer say that POKéMON was?
et: Mis värvi see POKéMON teadustaja sõnul oli?

label: PlayersHouse_1F_Text_StillUnknownPokemon
en: MOM: Well, isn't that something! There are still unknown POKéMON.
et: EMA: Vaat see on alles asi! Tundmatuid POKéMONe on veel.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HmmYourPokemon
en: Hmm! Your {STR_VAR_1}…
et: Hmm! Su {STR_VAR_1}…

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
en: It likes {STR_VAR_1}S, doesn't it?
et: Talle meeldivad {STR_VAR_1}, kas pole?

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblocks
en: No, I'm positive of it! It definitely likes {STR_VAR_1}S!
et: Ei, ma olen kindel! Talle meeldivad kindlasti {STR_VAR_1}!

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDislikePokeblocks
en: It doesn't appear to like or dislike any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Paistab, et tal pole {POKEBLOCK} suhtes mingeid eelistusi.

label: MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellPokeblockMonLikes
en: My husband can tell what kind of {POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.
et: Mu mees oskab ühe pilguga öelda, millised {POKEBLOCK} POKéMONile meeldivad.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: This area is covered in volcanic ash, huff-puff!
et: See kant on vulkaanituhka täis, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: I'm specially gifted, huff-puff.
et: Ma olen erilise andega, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: I make glass out of volcanic ash and make items, huff-puff.
et: Ma teen vulkaanituhast klaasi ja valmistan esemeid, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAshWithThis
en: Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.
et: Mine kogu sellega tuhka, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: Just take that SOOT SACK and walk through piles of ash, huff-puff.
et: Võta lihtsalt see SOOT SACK ja kõnni läbi tuhahunnikute, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: And it will fill up with the volcanic ash, huff-puff.
et: Ja see täitub vulkaanituhaga, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootSack
en: Once you think you've collected a good amount, come see me, huff-puff.
et: Kui arvad, et oled piisavalt kogunud, tule minu juurde, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeCollectedAshes
en: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff? Let me see, huff-puff.
et: Kas oled tuhka kogunud, ähh-puhh? Näita mulle, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
en: Hmmm… There's not enough ash here, huff-puff. I can't make glass with this, huff-puff.
et: Hmmm… Siin pole piisavalt tuhka, ähh-puhh. Ma ei saa sellest klaasi teha, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshNeedX
en: Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps you'll need to walk for me to make you a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.
et: Vaatame… pead käima veel {STR_VAR_1} sammu, et ma saaksin sulle teha eseme BLUE FLUTE, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
en: Oh! You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!
et: Oh! Sul on palju tuhka, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassItemWoudYouLike
en: I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff! Which one would you like, huff-puff?
et: Ma teen sulle klaaseseme, ähh-puhh! Millist sooviksid, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
et: {STR_VAR_1}, ähh-puhh? Kas see on see, mis sulle sobib, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYouLike
en: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
et: Millist sooviksid, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff!
et: Olgu siis {STR_VAR_1}, ähh-puhh!

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemForYou
en: Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff. Just wait a little while, huff-puff.
et: Olgu! Ma teen selle sulle, ähh-puhh. Oota vaid pisut, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?
et: {STR_VAR_1}, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: There's not enough ash here to make that, though, huff-puff.
et: Siin pole selle tegemiseks piisavalt tuhka, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps you'll need to walk through volcanic ash for me to make that item, huff-puff.
et: Vaatame… pead vulkaanituhas käima veel {STR_VAR_2} sammu, et ma selle eseme teha saaksin, ähh-puhh.
