label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAshToMakeItem
en: Which item would you rather have me make instead, huff-puff?
et: Millise eseme laseksid mul selle asemel teha, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshButDontWantAnything
en: You've collected all that ash, but you don't want anything, huff-puff?
et: Kogusid nii palju tuhka, aga ei taha midagi, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedGlassItem
en: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}. Take it, huff-puff.
et: Ah, ma sain su {STR_VAR_1} valmis. Võta see, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: Oh? You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.
et: Oh? Su KOTIS pole ruumi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian selle alles, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: Oh? You've no room in your PC, huff-puff?
et: Oh? Su ARVUTIS pole ruumi, ähh-puhh?

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back later, huff-puff.
et: Ma hoian selle alles, nii et tule hiljem tagasi, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK with you, huff-puff.
et: Hah? Sul pole eset SOOT SACK kaasas, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYourSootSack
en: You have to keep it with you to collect volcanic ash, huff-puff.
et: Sa pead seda kaasas hoidma, et vulkaanituhka koguda, ähh-puhh.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my boss is talking.
et: On lõbus puhuda klaasflööti, kui mu ülemus räägib.

label: Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGlassFlute
en: Huff-huff! Puff-puff!
et: Ähh-ähh! Puhh-puhh!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.
et: Meri PACIFIDLOGI ja SLATEPORTI vahel on kiire vooluga.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent
en: If you decide to SURF, you could end up swept away somewhere else.
et: Kui otsustad SURFida, võib vool su hoopis mujale kanda.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: See, isn't it neat? These houses are on water!
et: Näed, kas pole tore? Need majad on vee peal!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater
en: I was born here!
et: Ma sündisin siin!

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: The SKY PILLAR?
et: SKY PILLAR?

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: …Oh, you must mean that tall, tall tower a little further out.
et: …Oh, sa pead silmas seda kõrget, kõrget torni veidi eemal.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. It's too scary to get up that high.
et: Minu käest kui küsida, siis mina sinna ei roniks. Nii kõrgele minna on liiga hirmus.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary
en: Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, that suits me fine.
et: Elu siin merepinnal PACIFIDLOGIS sobib mulle hästi.

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: PACIFIDLOG TOWN
et: PACIFIDLOG LINN

label: PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign
en: “Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.”
et: „Kus hommikupäike naeratab vetele.”

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: The thought that I'm getting closer to the POKéMON LEAGUE…
et: Mõte, et POKéMON LIIGA on aina lähemal…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro
en: I'm getting stage fright…
et: Mind tabab lavahirm…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelDefeat
en: I couldn't do a thing…
et: Ma ei suutnud midagi teha…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle
en: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant again… What a letdown…
et: POKéMON LIIGA jäi jälle kaugele… Milline pettumus…

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro
en: To win your way through the POKéMON LEAGUE, you need the trust of your POKéMON.
et: Et POKéMON LIIGAST läbi murda, on sul vaja oma POKéMONide usaldust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat
en: Your relationship is based on solid trust.
et: Teie suhe põhineb kindlal usaldusel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle
en: By being together all the time, trust grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.
et: Kogu aeg koos olles kasvab usaldus POKéMONide ja TRAINERITE vahel.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro
en: This isn't the goal. It's only a place on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: See pole veel eesmärk. See on lihtsalt üks koht teel POKéMON LIIGASSE.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleDefeat
en: That's the way!
et: Just nii!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle
en: You'll do fine, for sure! Your POKéMON are all eager to go!
et: Sul läheb kindlasti hästi! Su POKéMONid on kõik võitlushimulised!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro
en: My POKéMON are cosmically awe inspiring!
et: Mu POKéMONid on kosmiliselt aukartustäratavad!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat
en: I've never met anyone like you before.
et: Ma pole kunagi varem kohanud kedagi sinusugust.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle
en: Even outside of battle, I sense incredible power emanating from you and your POKéMON.
et: Isegi väljaspool lahingut on sinust ja su POKéMONidest tunda uskumatut jõudu.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro
en: Okay, no need to get your back up! Relax, let's take it easy!
et: Olgu, pole vaja karvu turri ajada! Lõdvestu, võtame rahulikult!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleDefeat
en: Whoa! Wonderful!
et: Ohoo! Imeline!

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD.
et: Muidugi, see on VICTORY ROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: But it's not all that different from the path you've taken so far.
et: Aga see ei erine eriti teest, mille oled seni käinud.

label: VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle
en: Try to enjoy things the rest of the way!
et: Naudi ülejäänud teed!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I beg your pardon? You're looking for a ship?
et: Palun? Sa otsid laeva?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUnavailable
en: I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't available at present…
et: Vabandust, praamiteenus pole hetkel saadaval…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTicket
en: Hello, are you here for the ferry? May I see your TICKET?
et: Tere, kas oled praami pärast siin? Kas tohin näha su PILETIT?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: {PLAYER} doesn't have the TICKET…
et: {PLAYER} ei leia PILETIT…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on kohutavalt kahju.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTicket
en: You must have a TICKET to board the ferry.
et: Praamile astumiseks peab sul olema PILET.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: {PLAYER} flashed the TICKET.
et: {PLAYER} vilgutas PILETIT.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: Perfect! That's all you need!
et: Suurepärane! Rohkem polegi vaja!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FlashedTicketWhereTo
en: And where would you like to go?
et: Ja kuhu sa minna sooviksid?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime
en: Please sail with us another time!
et: Tule meiega mõni teine kord merele!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LilycoveItIs
en: LILYCOVE CITY it is, then!
et: Olgu siis LILYCOVE LINN!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_BattleFrontierItIs
en: BATTLE FRONTIER it is, then!
et: Olgu siis BATTLE FRONTIER!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFerry
en: Please board the ferry and wait for departure.
et: Palun astu praamile ja oota väljasõitu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLikeToGo
en: Then, where would you like to go?
et: Kuhu sa siis minna sooviksid?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: A journey to the bottom of the sea… I wonder what it'd be like?
et: Teekond merepõhja… Huvitav, milline see oleks?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUnderwaterSomeday
en: I'd love to go deep underwater like that someday.
et: Ma tahaksin kunagi nõnda sügavale vee alla minna.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: For a ship to sail safely, we need to know about the weather!
et: Et laev ohutult sõidaks, peame ilma teadma!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: Speaking of weather, I heard something from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE.
et: Ilmast rääkides — üks mees WEATHER INSTITUTE uurimisjaamast rääkis mulle midagi.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: He was saying abnormal weather has been reported all over the place!
et: Ta rääkis, et igal pool on nähtud imelikku ilma!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeather
en: You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE and ask around!
et: Mine ise WEATHER INSTITUTE juurde ja päri ringi!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on the ocean floor exploration.
et: Ma tahtsin CAPT. STERNIGA merepõhja uurimisele minna.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: But the sub's too small for me.
et: Aga allveelaev on minu jaoks liiga väike.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallForMe
en: If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be any room for the CAPTAIN…
et: Kui ma end sinna sisse suruksin, poleks KAPTENILE üldse ruumi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs…
et: CAPT. STERN: Need sulid…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTriedToRobAtMuseum
en: They're the same lot who tried to rob the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.
et: Nad on sama kamp, kes üritas MUUSEUMIS varastada eset DEVON GOODS.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: ARCHIE: Oh? Not you again…
et: ARCHIE: Oh? Jälle sina…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: You are tenacious to track us here, that much I will give you.
et: Visa sa oled, et meid siia jälitasid — seda pean tunnistama.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: But now… No one can stop us! No one!
et: Aga nüüd… Keegi ei suuda meid peatada! Mitte keegi!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Or, will you follow us back to our HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY?
et: Või järgned sa meile meie PEIDIKUSSE LILYCOVE LINNAS?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgainHideoutInLilycove
en: Fwahahahaha…
et: Fvahahahaa…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: CAPT. STERN: Why…
et: CAPT. STERN: Miks…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: Why would TEAM AQUA steal my SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?
et: Miks küll TEAM AQUA varastaks mu SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: They can't be after the slumbering POKéMON at the bottom of the sea…
et: Ega nad ometi jahi merepõhjas uinuvat POKéMONi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhyStealMySubmarine
en: But even if I were to chase them, I don't stand a chance against them…
et: Aga isegi kui ma neid taga ajaksin, pole mul nende vastu mingit šanssi…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Okay… So TEAM AQUA left before you could stop them…
et: Olgu… Nii et TEAM AQUA lahkus, enne kui sa neid peatada said…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Oh, no, don't blame yourself. You're not responsible for this.
et: Ei-ei, ära ennast süüdista. Sina ei ole selles süüdi.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible for most people.
et: Allveelaevale järele jõuda… Enamiku jaoks on see võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Sul oleks vaja POKéMONi, kes oskab võtet DIVE…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui läheksid MOSSDEEP LINNA…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNeedDive
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sulle õpetada…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a submarine… It's impossible.
et: CAPT. STERN: Allveelaevale järele jõuda… See on võimatu.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: You would need a POKéMON that knows how to DIVE…
et: Sul oleks vaja POKéMONi, kes oskab võtet DIVE…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: Perhaps if you went out to MOSSDEEP CITY…
et: Ehk kui läheksid MOSSDEEP LINNA…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatchSub
en: A lot of divers live out there, so someone might teach you…
et: Seal elab palju sukeldujaid, nii et keegi võib sulle õpetada…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes. MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD.
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh, jah. MR. BRINEY tuli meie LAEVATEHASESSE.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBeforeWeFinishFerry
en: It won't be long now before we finish making the ferry!
et: Nüüd ei lähe enam kaua, kui praami valmis saame!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: KAPTEN STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We finally finished making the ferry S.S. TIDAL!
et: Saime lõpuks praami S.S. TIDAL valmis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: We couldn't have done it without your friend MR. BRINEY.
et: Ilma sinu sõbrata MR. BRINEY poleks me hakkama saanud.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMakingFerry
en: Please go for a short cruise on it!
et: Tee sellega kindlasti väike merereis!

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have…
et: CAPT. STERN: Oh? {PLAYER}{KUN}, see ese, mis sul on…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: That's a SCANNER! That would sure help us on our explorations.
et: See on ju SCANNER! See tuleks meie uuringutes kindlasti kasuks.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your SCANNER for something?
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, kas vahetaksid oma SCANNERI millegi vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeScanner
en: Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?
et: Näiteks mul on olemas DEEPSEATOOTH ja DEEPSEASCALE — kas üks neist sobiks?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain? It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}…
et: CAPT. STERN: Kas oled kindel? See on sulle kasutu, {PLAYER}{KUN}…

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTradeLetMeKnow
en: Well, okay, then. If you want to trade your SCANNER, let me know.
et: Noh, olgu siis. Kui tahad oma SCANNERit vahetada, anna teada.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaTooth
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEATOOTH?
et: CAPT. STERN: Nii et sa vahetad selle mu DEEPSEATOOTH vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSeaScale
en: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for my DEEPSEASCALE?
et: CAPT. STERN: Nii et sa vahetad selle mu DEEPSEASCALE vastu?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouWant
en: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?
et: CAPT. STERN: Kumba sa tahad?

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerToStern
en: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to CAPT. STERN.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas SCANNERI CAPT. STERNILE.

label: SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpResearch
en: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}! This will help our research a lot!
et: CAPT. STERN: Aitäh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! See aitab meie uurimistööle palju kaasa!

label: DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity
en: DEWFORD is a tiny island community. If something gets trendy here, everyone picks up on it right away.
et: DEWFORD on väike saarekogukond. Kui midagi läheb siin moodi, haaravad kõik sellest kohe kinni.

label: DewfordTown_Text_TownSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN “A tiny island in the blue sea.”
et: DEWFORD LINN „Väike saar sinises meres.”

label: DewfordTown_Text_GymSign
en: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”
et: DEWFORD LINNA POKéMON SAALI JUHT: BRAWLY „Suur laine kakluses!”

label: DewfordTown_Text_HallSign
en: DEWFORD HALL “Everyone's information exchange!”
et: DEWFORD HALL „Kõigi infovahetuspaik!”

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD.
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Jõudsime DEWFORDIS maale.

label: Route104_Text_LandedInDewfordDeliverLetter
en: I suppose you're off to deliver that LETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!
et: Küllap lähed nüüd seda KIRJA ära viima — kellele see nüüd oligi — STEVENILE!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your LETTER?
et: MR. BRINEY: Kas oled oma KIRJA kohale viinud?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg
en: Or were you meaning to sail back to PETALBURG?
et: Või tahtsid tagasi PETALBURGI purjetada?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!
et: MR. BRINEY: Olgu siis PETALBURG!

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail2
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankur üles! PEEKO, me asume teele, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting
en: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver the LETTER. I'll be waiting.
et: MR. BRINEY: Siis mine ja vii KIRI kohale. Ma ootan.

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've hit land in DEWFORD!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Jõudsime DEWFORDIS maale!

label: DewfordTown_Text_BrineyLandedInDewford
en: You just go on and tell me whenever you want to set sail again!
et: Ütle mulle lihtsalt, millal iganes tahad taas purjetama minna!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
et: MR. BRINEY: Ahoi! Sinu jaoks lähen ma merele igal ajal!

label: DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound
en: Now, my friend, where are we bound?
et: Noh, mu sõber, kuhu me nüüd suuna võtame?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, jah?

label: DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankur üles! PEEKO, me asume teele, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?
et: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, jah?

label: DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSail
en: Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
et: Ankur üles! PEEKO, me asume teele, mu kallis!

label: DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedToSetSail
en: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever you need to set sail again!
et: MR. BRINEY: Anna lihtsalt teada, kui tahad jälle merele minna!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish
en: This is a renowned fishing spot. Are you getting the itch to fish?
et: See on kuulus kalapaik. Kas sul kisub ka kala püüdma?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I hear you, and I like what you're saying!
et: Kuulen-kuulen, ja mulle meeldib, mida sa räägid!

label: DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods
en: I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.
et: Ma annan sulle ühe oma ÕNGEDEST.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw in a little fishing advice!
et: Ja kauba peale annan sulle veel pisut kalapüüginõu!

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Kõigepealt keera nägu vee poole, siis kasuta ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.
et: Keskendu… Kui nokib, siis tõmba ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel jääb midagi kohe haaki, aga suurema saagi puhul pead ÕNGE tõmbeid ajastama, et see välja vinnata.

label: DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen
en: Oh, is that so? That's too bad, then.
et: Ah, on või? Noh, siis on kahju küll.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HowsYourFishing
en: Yo! How's your fishing?
et: Jou! Kuidas kalapüük läheb?

label: DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes
en: Is that right! That's great! Haul in some big ones!
et: On või! Vahva! Vinna mõni suur välja!

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself! I'll give you a little fishing advice.
et: Oi, kuule, ära lase pead norgu! Annan sulle veidi kalapüüginõu.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: First, you want to face the water, then use the ROD.
et: Kõigepealt keera nägu vee poole, siis kasuta ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Focus your mind… If you get a bite, pull the ROD.
et: Keskendu… Kui nokib, siis tõmba ÕNGE.

label: DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice
en: Sometimes you can snag something immediately, but with bigger catches, you need to time the pulls on your ROD to haul them in.
et: Vahel jääb midagi kohe haaki, aga suurema saagi puhul pead ÕNGE tõmbeid ajastama, et see välja vinnata.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I like what's hip, happening, and trendy. I'm always checking it out.
et: Mulle meeldib kõik, mis on moes ja lahe. Hoian sellel pidevalt silma peal.

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Listen, have you heard about this new “{STR_VAR_1}”?
et: Kuule, kas oled kuulnud sellest uuest „{STR_VAR_1}”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: That's right! Of course you know!
et: Just nii! Muidugi sa tead!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: I mean, sheesh, “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's the hottest thing in cool!
et: No kuule, „{STR_VAR_1}”… Lahedamat asja lihtsalt pole!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningThingRight
en: Wherever you're from, “{STR_VAR_1}” is the biggest happening thing, right?
et: Kust sa ka pärit poleks, „{STR_VAR_1}” on praegu kõige suurem asi, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Hunh? It's not the hip and happening thing?
et: Häh? See ei olegi kõige moekam asi?

label: DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn
en: Well, hey, you have to tell me, what's new and what's “in”?
et: No kuule, sa pead mulle ütlema, mis on uus ja mis on praegu „moes”.

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Hunh? “{STR_VAR_2}”?
et: Häh? „{STR_VAR_2}”?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: …Uh… Yeah! That's right! Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!
et: …Äh… Jah! Just nii! Jah, ma teadsin seda! Teadsin kogu aeg!

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Of course I know about that! “{STR_VAR_2},” right?
et: Muidugi ma tean sellest! „{STR_VAR_2}”, eks?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Yeah, that's it, it's there! Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}” the coolest, or what?
et: Jah, just see! Kas „{STR_VAR_2}” pole kõige lahedam või mis?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: It's the hippest thing in hip. You think I'd not know about it?
et: Moekamat asja polegi olemas. Sa arvad, et mina seda ei tea?

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: “{STR_VAR_1}”… It's, like, so five minutes ago.
et: „{STR_VAR_1}”… See on nagu eilne uudis.

label: DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat
en: Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is what's vital and in tune with the times!
et: Nüüd on „{STR_VAR_2}” see, mis loeb ja mis käib ajaga kaasas!

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: Hmm… “{STR_VAR_2},” huh?
et: Hmm… „{STR_VAR_2}”, või nii?

label: DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool
en: But personally, I think “{STR_VAR_1}” is what's real in cool.
et: Aga minu meelest on tõeliselt lahe hoopis „{STR_VAR_1}”.

label: DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShareWithMe
en: Well, if you hear of any happening new trends, come share them with me, okay?
et: Kui kuuled mõnest põnevast uuest trendist, siis räägi mulle ka, olgu?

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: Yeah, absolutely right!
et: Jah, just nimelt!

label: DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRightNow
en: “{STR_VAR_1}” is the definition of “in” right now.
et: Praegu ongi „{STR_VAR_1}” kõige moekam asi.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite
en: With this METEORITE, that thing in MT. CHIMNEY will…
et: Selle METEORIIDIGA hakkab see asi MT. CHIMNEY sees…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: Heh?
et: Häh?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFromMagma
en: I don't know who you are, but if you get in the way of TEAM MAGMA, don't expect any mercy!
et: Ma ei tea, kes sa oled, aga kui TEAM MAGMALE ette jääd, ära oota mingit halastust!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: Hold it right there, TEAM MAGMA!
et: Seis, TEAM MAGMA!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereMagma
en: You're badly mistaken if you think you can have your way with the world!
et: Sa eksid rängalt, kui arvad, et võid maailmaga oma tahtmist teha!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Hehehe! Even TEAM AQUA joins us!
et: Hehehe! Isegi TEAM AQUA ilmus kohale!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: But it's too much trouble to deal with you all…
et: Aga teie kõigiga jännata on liiga tüütu…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Heh, it doesn't matter!
et: Heh, pole tähtsust!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: We've got the METEORITE, so off to MT. CHIMNEY we go!
et: METEORIIT on käes, nüüd läheme MT. CHIMNEY juurde!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAqua
en: Hehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM AQUA dingbats!
et: Hehehe! Näeme veel, te TEAM AQUA tainapead!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: ARCHIE: Didn't I see you before? At SLATEPORT's MUSEUM?
et: ARCHIE: Kas ma pole sind varem näinud? SLATEPORTI MUUSEUMIS?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Ah, so your name is {PLAYER}.
et: Ah, nii et su nimi on {PLAYER}.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: At the time, I thought you were one of TEAM MAGMA's goons.
et: Tookord pidasin sind üheks TEAM MAGMA käsilaseks.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: Humph… You're one odd kid.
et: Hmph… Kummaline laps sa oled.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: TEAM MAGMA is a dangerous group of total fanatics.
et: TEAM MAGMA on ohtlik jõuk pöörasi fanaatikuid.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: They engage in destruction, claiming to expand the land mass.
et: Nad purustavad kõike ja väidavad, et laiendavad maismaad.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefore
en: They are the rivals to us, the sea-loving TEAM AQUA!
et: Nad on meie, merd armastava TEAM AQUA rivaalid!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChaseMagma
en: BOSS, we should give chase to TEAM MAGMA…
et: BOSS, me peaksime TEAM MAGMALE järele minema…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: ARCHIE: Yes, yes, we must! We've got to hurry.
et: ARCHIE: Jah, jah, kindlasti! Peame kiirustama.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellingWhatMagmaWillDo
en: There's no telling what TEAM MAGMA will do at MT. CHIMNEY!
et: Kes teab, mida TEAM MAGMA seal MT. CHIMNEY otsas korda saadab!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
en: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, you should keep an eye out for TEAM MAGMA, too.
et: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, hoia sinagi TEAM MAGMAL silma peal.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell
en: Farewell!
et: Hüvasti!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: I… I'm COZMO… I'm a PROFESSOR…
et: Ma… ma olen COZMO… Ma olen PROFESSOR…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: TEAM MAGMA asked me to guide them to METEOR FALLS…
et: TEAM MAGMA palus mul nad METEOR FALLSi juhatada…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But they tricked me. They even took my METEORITE away…
et: Aga nad petsid mind. Nad võtsid isegi mu METEORIIDI ära…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: And then another similar bunch, TEAM AQUA showed up.
et: Ja siis ilmus veel üks samasugune kamp — TEAM AQUA.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: After that… I don't understand any of it.
et: Pärast seda… ma ei saa enam millestki aru.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: But that TEAM MAGMA…
et: Aga see TEAM MAGMA…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo
en: What are they going to do with that METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?
et: Mida nad selle METEORIIDIGA seal MT. CHIMNEY otsas teha kavatsevad?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
en: PROF. COZMO: But that TEAM MAGMA…
et: PROF. COZMO: Aga see TEAM MAGMA…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoingAtMtChimney
en: What are they going to do with that METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?
et: Mida nad selle METEORIIDIGA seal MT. CHIMNEY otsas teha kavatsevad?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeSingleBattle
en: Where the strategies of TRAINERS are put to the test!
et: Kus pannakse proovile TRAINERITE strateegiad!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeSingleBattle
en: Welcome to the BATTLE DOME!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE DOMEsse!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_WelcomeSingleBattle
en: I am your guide to the SINGLE BATTLE Tournament.
