label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103
en: Like father, like child. {RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.
et: Nagu isa, nii laps. {RIVAL} ei suuda vaikselt kodus püsida.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: I think it's wonderful for people to travel with POKéMON.
et: Minu meelest on imeline, kui inimesed rändavad koos POKéMONidega.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: But you should go home every so often to let your mother know you're okay.
et: Aga käi aeg-ajalt kodus ka, et EMA teaks, et sul on kõik hästi.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoOften
en: She might not say it, but I'm sure she worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Ta ei pruugi seda välja öelda, aga küll ta muretseb su pärast, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Who… Who are you?
et: Ää? Kes… kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}. So your move was today.
et: Oh, sa oled {PLAYER}{KUN}. Nii et te kolisitegi täna.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Um… I'm MAY. Glad to meet you!
et: Öö… Ma olen MAY. Rõõm tutvuda!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I have this dream of becoming friends with POKéMON all over the world.
et: Ma… mul on unistus saada sõbraks POKéMONidega üle kogu maailma.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
et: Ma… ma kuulsin sinust, {PLAYER}{KUN}, oma ISA PROF. BIRCHI käest.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was hoping that you would be nice, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa oled tore, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ja et me saame sõpradeks.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, this is silly, isn't it? I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Oh, see on ju rumal, eks? Ma… ma alles kohtusin sinuga, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Eheheh…
et: Ehehe…

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, no! I forgot!
et: Oh ei! Ma unustasin!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was supposed to go help Dad catch some wild POKéMON!
et: Ma pidin minema ISA aitama metsikuid POKéMONe püüdma!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näeme hiljem!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Hey! You…
et: Hei! Sina…

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Who are you?
et: Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you? Moved in next door, right?
et: Oh, sina oled vist {PLAYER}? Kolisid äsja naabrimajja, eks?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I didn't know that you're a girl.
et: Ma ei teadnud, et sa oled tüdruk.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Dad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's kid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.
et: ISA, PROF. BIRCH, ütles, et meie uus naaber on SAALI JUHI laps, nii et arvasin, et oled poiss.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: My name's BRENDAN. So, hi, neighbor!
et: Mina olen BRENDAN. Nii et tere, naaber!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have a POKéMON?
et: Ää? Kuule, {PLAYER}, kas sul POKéMONi polegi?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Do you want me to go catch you one?
et: Kas tahad, et ma sulle ühe püüan?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Aw, darn, I forgot…
et: Ohh, pagan, ma unustasin…

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I'm supposed to go help my dad catch some wild POKéMON.
et: Ma pean minema ISA aitama metsikuid POKéMONe püüdma.

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Some other time, okay?
et: Mõni teine kord, olgu?

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
en: Hi, neighbor!
et: Tere, naaber!

label: RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon
en: Do you already have your own POKéMON?
et: Kas sul on juba oma POKéMON?

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: In the HOENN region, there are three POKéMON that represent the power of rock, ice, and steel.
et: HOENNI piirkonnas on kolm POKéMONi, kes kehastavad kivi, jää ja terase jõudu.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: Each of them is said to hide away deep inside caves.
et: Räägitakse, et igaüks neist peidab end sügaval koopas.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory
en: That's the story I heard when I was just a little kid.
et: See lugu jõudis minuni, kui olin veel päris väike.

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
en: “Six dots open three doors.”
et: „Kuus täppi avavad kolm ust.”

label: PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenThreeDoors
en: Grandpa used to say that, but I don't know what he meant.
et: Vanaisa kordas seda alatasa, aga ma ei tea, mida ta silmas pidas.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas salakoodi uksele.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: “TRICK MASTER is my life.” … … … … … … … …
et: „TRICK MASTER on mu elu.” … … … … … … … …

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: The lock clicked open!
et: Lukk klõpsatas lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIntro
en: When I heard there was a strange house, I had to check it out.
et: Kui kuulsin, et siin on üks veider maja, pidin selle kohe üle vaatama.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaDefeat
en: I've discovered a tough TRAINER!
et: Avastasin kõva TRAINERI!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
en: I'm sure having a good time checking this place out.
et: Mul on seda kohta uurides tõesti tore.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPostBattle
en: It's a challenge I've found worth repeating!
et: See on väljakutse, mida tasub korrata!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyIntro
en: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON to fly over the wall…
et: Ehk saaksin panna oma LINNU-POKéMONi üle müüri lendama…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyDefeat
en: Gwaaah! I blew it!
et: Gvaaah! Ma vussisin ära!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPostBattle
en: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because I was trying to cheat.
et: Ehehehe… Ma vist kaotasin sellepärast, et üritasin sohki teha.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianIntro
en: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating doors…
et: Neist pöörlevatest ustest hakkab mul pea ringi käima…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianDefeat
en: Everything's spinning around and around. I can't take this anymore…
et: Kõik keerleb ja keerleb. Ma ei kannata seda enam välja…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SebastianPostBattle
en: You don't seem to be affected at all. Or do you have your poker face on?
et: Sind ei näi see üldse mõjutavat. Või on sul lihtsalt pokkerinägu ees?

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: The penetrating cold around these parts is an impediment to training.
et: Siinne läbitungiv külm segab treenimist.

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: But with focus, one can overcome!
et: Aga keskendumisega saab sellest jagu!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOvercomeColdWithFocus
en: With this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and withstand the cold!
et: Selle FOCUS BANDiga võta end kokku ja pea külmale vastu!

label: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_EverythingStartsWithFocus
en: Everything starts with focus!
et: Kõik algab keskendumisest!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
en: Hello and welcome to the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Tere ja tere tulemast DEVON CORPORATIONI.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
en: We're proud producers of items and medicine that enhance your life.
et: Me toodame uhkusega esemeid ja ravimeid, mis teevad elu paremaks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
en: One of our research staff stupidly got robbed of an important parcel.
et: Üks meie uurijatest laskis rumalasti tähtsa paki endalt röövida.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
en: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES! They're one of our products!
et: Hei, need RUNNING SHOES! Need on üks meie toodetest!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
en: It makes me happy when I see someone using something we made.
et: Mul on hea meel näha, kui keegi kasutab midagi, mille meie oleme teinud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: That stolen parcel…
et: See varastatud pakk…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: Well, sure it's important, but it's not anything that anyone can use.
et: Noh, tähtis see muidugi on, aga keegi ei oska sellega midagi peale hakata.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
en: In my estimation, that robber must not have been very bright.
et: Minu arvates ei olnud see röövel eriti nutikas.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
en: It sounds like they've recovered the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.
et: Kuulu järgi saadi ärandatud DEVONI KAUP tagasi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
en: I'm sorry, only authorized people are allowed to enter here.
et: Vabandust, siia tohivad siseneda ainult volitatud isikud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
en: It's beyond stupid. How could we get robbed?
et: See on lausa arusaamatult rumal. Kuidas meid küll röövida sai?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
en: Hi, there! You're always welcome here!
et: Tere-tere! Sa oled siin alati oodatud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: Samples of rocks and metal are displayed in the glass case.
et: Klaasvitriinis on väljas kivimi- ja metallinäidised.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: There's a panel with some writing on it…
et: Seal on tahvel, millele on midagi kirjutatud…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “DEVON CORPORATION got its start as a producer of stones from quarries.
et: „DEVON CORPORATION sai alguse ettevõttena, mis murdis karjäärides kivi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “The company also produced iron from filings in the sand.
et: „Firma tootis ka rauda liivas leiduvast raualaastust.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “From that humble start as a producer of raw materials, DEVON developed.
et: „Sellest tagasihoidlikust toormetootja algusest kasvaski DEVON välja.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMetalDisplay
en: “DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide range of industrial products.”
et: „Täna valmistab DEVON laia valikut tööstustooteid.”

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: Prototypes and test products fill the glass display case.
et: Klaasvitriin on täis prototüüpe ja katsetooteid.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: There's a panel with a description…
et: Seal on tahvel kirjeldusega…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: “In addition to industrial products, DEVON now markets sundries and pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.
et: „Lisaks tööstustoodetele turustab DEVON nüüd ka tarbekaupu ja ravimeid, mis muudavad elu paremaks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDisplay
en: “Recently, DEVON has begun marketing tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”
et: „Viimasel ajal on DEVON hakanud POKéMON TRAINERITELE müüma abivahendeid, sealhulgas POKé PALLE ja POKéNAV-süsteeme.”

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
en: Traveling is wonderful!
et: Reisimine on suurepärane!

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWonderful
en: When I was young, I roamed the seas and the mountains!
et: Noorena rändasin ma meredel ja mägedes!

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Sigh…
et: Ohh…

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: I wish I could go on an adventure with some POKéMON…
et: Oh, kui ma saaksin mõne POKéMONiga seiklema minna…

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Crawl through some damp grass… Climb rocky, rugged mountains…
et: Roomata läbi niiske rohu… Ronida kivistele, konarlikele mägedele…

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: Cross the raging seas… Wander about in dark caves…
et: Ületada möllavaid meresid… Uidata pimedates koobastes…

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: And, sometimes, even get a little homesick…
et: Ja vahel isegi veidi koduigatsust tunda…

label: PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure
en: It must be fabulous to travel!
et: Küll reisimine peab olema vahva!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_GetAMoveOn
en: Hey, hey! Get a move on!
et: Hei, hei! Nobedamini!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Hey, my name's NOLAND! I'm basically in charge of this place, which is why I'm the FACTORY HEAD!
et: Hei, mina olen NOLAND! Põhimõtteliselt juhin ma seda kohta — seepärast olengi FACTORY HEAD!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I had a look at your Battle Swap data.
et: Ma vaatasin su Battle Swapi andmeid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: You seem to have the right idea, but you're still square in your head!
et: Mõte tundub sul õige olevat, aga pea on sul ikka veel kandiline!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Listen up, okay? Knowledge isn't only about reading books or doing desk work.
et: Kuula nüüd, olgu? Teadmised ei tule ainult raamatutest ja lauataguse tööga.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: Just doing that sort of thing… It may as well be useless!
et: Ainult sellest… sellest pole suurt kasu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: You have to experience things with your heart and your body, understand?
et: Sa pead asju läbi elama südame ja kehaga, saad aru?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I'll take you on under the same conditions as you.
et: Ma astun sulle vastu täpselt samadel tingimustel.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandImFactoryHead
en: I'll be using rental POKéMON, too!
et: Ka mina kasutan renditud POKéMONe!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ShakeOutKnowledgeBringItOn
en: Shake out every last bit of your knowledge and bring it on!
et: Raputa välja iga viimane raas oma teadmistest ja anna tulla!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NolandLetsSeeFrontierPass
en: NOLAND: Smart going! Let's see your FRONTIER PASS.
et: NOLAND: Tark tegu! Näita oma FRONTIER PASSi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_ReceivedKnowledgeSymbol
en: The Knowledge Symbol was embossed on the FRONTIER PASS!
et: FRONTIER PASSile pressiti Knowledge-sümbol!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: Heh… You're a pretty bright spark…
et: Heh… Sa oled päris terav pea…

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: Next time, I'll come after you hard. No holds barred, understand?
et: Järgmine kord tulen sulle täie jõuga peale. Ilma igasuguse armuta, saad aru?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_NextTimeNoHoldsBarred
en: You keep up your studies!
et: Jätka õppimist!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: NOLAND: Hey, hey! How's it going? You keeping up with your studies?
et: NOLAND: Hei, hei! Kuidas läheb? Kas õpingutega on kõik korras?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: …Oh?
et: …Ohoo?

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: You've taken on a harder look than the last time I saw you.
et: Su ilme on karmim kui viimati, kui sind nägin.

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_HarderLookThanLastTime
en: Now, this should be fun! I'm getting excited, hey!
et: No sellest tuleb lõbus! Mul hakkab juba põnev, hei!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_AllRightBringItOn
en: All right! Bring it on!
et: Hüva! Anna tulla!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
en: NOLAND: What the… You're getting out of my league!
et: NOLAND: Mida… Sa kasvad mul juba üle pea!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_OutOfMyLeagueLetsSeePass
en: Sheesh! Let's see that FRONTIER PASS!
et: Pagan! Näita seda FRONTIER PASSi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_KnowledgeSymbolTookGoldenShine
en: The Knowledge Symbol took on a golden shine!
et: Knowledge-sümbol omandas kuldse sära!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: Pfft, man!
et: Pfff, no kuule!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: That's absolutely the last time I lose to you!
et: See oli küll viimane kord, kui ma sulle kaotan!

label: BattleFrontier_BattleFactoryBattleRoom_Text_LastTimeILoseToYou
en: We have to do this again, hey?
et: Peame seda kindlasti kordama, eks?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm amazed you knew where to find me.
et: STEVEN: Oh, ohoo, {PLAYER}{KUN}. Olen üllatunud, et sa teadsid, kust mind leida.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: Do you, uh…maybe think of me as just a rock maniac?
et: Kas sa, öö… pead mind lihtsalt kivihulluks?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: No, that can't be right.
et: Ei, see ei saa õige olla.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: We battled alongside each other at the SOOTOPOLIS SPACE CENTER.
et: Me võitlesime kõrvuti SOOTOPOLISE KOSMOSEKESKUSES.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: You should have a very good idea about how good I am.
et: Sa tead küllap väga hästi, kui tugev ma olen.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowHowGoodIAmExpectWorst
en: Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount a serious challenge, expect the worst!
et: Olgu, {PLAYER}{KUN}, kui tuled tõsiselt võitlema, siis oota halvimat!

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefeat
en: You… I had no idea you'd become so strong…
et: Sina… Mul polnud aimugi, et sa nii tugevaks oled saanud…

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since our paths first crossed in GRANITE CAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling.
et: STEVEN: Kui järele mõelda, siis juba sellest ajast, kui meie teed DEWFORDIS GRANITE CAVE koopas ristusid, oli mul selline tunne.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: I thought that you would eventually become the CHAMPION.
et: Ma arvasin, et sinust saab lõpuks MEISTER.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: My predictions usually come true.
et: Mu ennustused tavaliselt täituvad.

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: And where will you go from here?
et: Ja kuhu sa nüüd edasi lähed?

label: MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictionCameTrue
en: Fufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.
et: Fufufu, isegi mina ei oskaks sulle seda öelda.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: If you want to know the secret about our HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!
et: Kui tahad meie PEIDIKU saladust teada, pead esmalt minu alistama!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: I can't win at all…
et: Ma ei suuda üldse võita…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Our HIDEOUT's secret?
et: Meie PEIDIKU saladus?

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Well, let's just say… There's a submarine at the far end!
et: Noh, ütleme nii… Kaugemas otsas on allveelaev!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: But, by now… Kekekeke…
et: Aga praeguseks… Kekekeke…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Fuel supply loaded A-OK! In-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!
et: Kütusevaru laetud — korras! Reisisnäkid laetud — korras!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro
en: Nothing left to do but KO a pesky meddler!
et: Jääb veel vaid tüütu vahelesegaja nokauti lüüa!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat
en: I took a serious licking!
et: Ma sain kõva keretäie!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: Humph! This was supposed to happen!
et: Hmph! See pidigi juhtuma!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle
en: My mission was to just hold you up!
et: Minu ülesanne oli sind vaid kinni pidada!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro
en: Yawn… Keeping watch over the HIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.
et: Haigutus… PEIDIKU valvamine on igav. Võtan su ette.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Defeat
en: Yawn… Oh, I lost…
et: Haigutus… Oh, ma kaotasin…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle
en: If you scurry too much, other TEAM AQUA members might get you.
et: Kui liiga palju sibad, saavad teised TEAM AQUA liikmed su kätte.

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Hey! You there!
et: Hei! Sina seal!

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro
en: Which do you think is cooler? TEAM AQUA's uniform or TEAM MAGMA's?
et: Kumb on sinu arvates lahedam? TEAM AQUA vormiriietus või TEAM MAGMA oma?

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat
en: I lost in a cool way…
et: Kaotasin lahedal moel…

label: AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle
en: If you have a cool uniform, you look good even in a loss, don't you think?
et: Lahedas vormis näed sa isegi kaotades hea välja, kas pole?

label: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_BrightShinyTrash
en: It's bright and shiny! But it's just trash…
et: Särab ja läigib! Aga tegelikult on see lihtsalt prügi…

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: The power contained in the METEORITE…
et: METEORIIDIS sisalduv jõud…

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: By amplifying its power with this machine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic activity will instantly intensify…
et: Kui selle jõudu selle masinaga võimendada, tugevneb MT. CHIMNEY vulkaaniline tegevus silmapilkselt…

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolcano
en: Its energy will grow deep inside the crater and… Fufufu…
et: Selle energia kasvab sügaval kraatris ja… Fufufu…

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: MAXIE: Hm? Who are you?
et: MAXIE: Hm? Kes sina oled?

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: I'd heard ARCHIE bemoaning a child who's been meddling in TEAM AQUA's affairs.
et: Kuulsin, kuidas ARCHIE halas lapse üle, kes TEAM AQUA asjadesse sekkub.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: It must be you he meant.
et: Küllap ta mõtles just sind.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Humph! So you're thinking of interfering with us, TEAM MAGMA?
et: Hmpf! Nii et sa kavatsed meile, TEAM MAGMALE, jalgu jääda?

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Now you listen. Long ago, living things used the land to live and grow.
et: Kuula nüüd. Ammu ammu elasid ja kasvasid kõik elusolendid maismaal.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: That is why land is all important! It is the cradle of all!
et: Just seepärast on maismaa kõige tähtsam! See on kõige häll!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: That is why TEAM MAGMA is dedicated to the expansion of the land mass.
et: Just seepärast on TEAM MAGMA pühendunud maismaa laiendamisele.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: It is for further advancement of humankind and POKéMON!
et: See on inimkonna ja POKéMONide edasise arengu nimel!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: And for that, we need the power of what sleeps within this mountain…
et: Ja selleks vajame selle jõudu, mis selle mäe sees magab…

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: Oh! There was no need for you to learn that much.
et: Oh! Sul polnudki vaja nii palju teada saada.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro
en: But, no matter! I'll teach you the consequences of meddling in our grand design!
et: Aga olgu peale! Ma näitan sulle, mis juhtub, kui meie suurejoonelisse plaani sekkuda!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: What?!
et: Mida?!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat
en: I, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!
et: Mina, MAXIE, lasin end üllatada?!

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: MAXIE: But, enough. I will back off this time.
et: MAXIE: Aga aitab. Seekord ma taandun.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: But don't think that this is the last you've seen of TEAM MAGMA.
et: Aga ära arva, et see oli viimane kord, kui TEAM MAGMAT nägid.

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: Fufufu…
et: Fufufu…

label: MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfMagma
en: Even without the METEORITE, if we obtain that ORB… Fufufu…
et: Isegi ilma METEORIIDITA, kui saame selle ORBI kätte… Fufufu…

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: Hehehe!
et: Hehehe!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: So you've come all the way here!
et: Nii et sa oledki siia välja jõudnud!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro
en: But you're too late! I've already delivered the METEORITE from METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!
et: Aga sa jäid hiljaks! Ma toimetasin METEORIIDI METEOR FALLSist juba BOSSILE!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe…

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat
en: Even though I've lost, if our leader awakens that thing…
et: Olgu ma kaotasin, aga kui meie juht selle asja äratab…

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: BOSS, hurry! Give it the METEORITE's energy!
et: BOSS, kiirusta! Anna sellele METEORIIDI energia!

label: MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle
en: Hehehe…
et: Hehehe…

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for everyone's sake.
et: Meie, TEAM MAGMA, töötame kõvasti kõigi heaks.

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Like, if that thing's power made more land, there'd be more places to live.
et: Vaata, kui selle asja jõud tekitaks juurde maismaad, oleks rohkem elupaiku.

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro
en: Everyone'd be happy!
et: Kõik oleksid õnnelikud!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Defeat
en: Hunh? What do you mean I lost?
et: Häh? Kuidas nii, et ma kaotasin?

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone happy.”
et: Meie BOSS ütleb: „See teeb kõik õnnelikuks.”

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle
en: But why does everyone keep getting in our way?
et: Aga miks kõik meile pidevalt jalgu jäävad?

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: If there were more land, I'd be able to get a big house of my own!
et: Kui oleks rohkem maismaad, saaksin endale suure maja!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro
en: I'm going to build it on hardened lava!
et: Ma ehitan selle tardunud laavale!

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat
en: My dream of a big house…
et: Mu unistus suurest majast…

label: MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle
en: A kid like you, you ought to be splashing about in the waves!
et: Sinusugune laps peaks hoopis lainetes plusklema!

label: MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWithPlans
en: That annoying TEAM AQUA… They always mess with our plans!
et: See tüütu TEAM AQUA… Nad ajavad alati meie plaanid sassi!

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPower
en: METEORITES pack amazing power!
et: METEORIITIDES on hämmastav jõud!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
en: You'd better not mess with us!
et: Parem ära jama meiega!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs
en: We're trying to awaken that thing for the benefit of everyone!
et: Me üritame selle asja äratada kõigi heaks!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: We're TEAM MAGMA!
et: Me oleme TEAM MAGMA!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: They're TEAM AQUA!
et: Nemad on TEAM AQUA!

label: MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar
en: It totally annoys me that they'd use a name like ours!
et: Mind ajab täitsa marru, et nad võtsid meie omaga nii sarnase nime!

label: MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire
en: Yeah! Douse them in fire!
et: Jah! Valage nad tulega üle!

label: MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand
en: We're going to keep making more land!
et: Me teeme maismaad aina juurde!

label: MtChimney_Text_Bufoh
en: Bufoh!
et: Bufoo!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}! I should've guessed you'd show up!
et: ARCHIE: Grr, {PLAYER}! Oleksin pidanud arvama, et sina siia ilmud!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: See for yourself what the fanatics of TEAM MAGMA are up to!
et: Vaata ise, mida TEAM MAGMA fanaatikud plaanivad!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: They're trying to inject the stolen METEORITE's power into the volcano!
et: Nad üritavad varastatud METEORIIDI jõudu vulkaani sisse pumbata!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma
en: Doing something like that will cause the volcano's eruption!
et: Sellisest asjast tuleb vulkaanipurse!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: ARCHIE: Grrr…
et: ARCHIE: Grrr…

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: I want to stop that MAXIE, but I can't!
et: Ma tahan selle MAXIE peatada, aga ei saa!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull
en: Not when I have my hands full battling three opponents at once!
et: Mitte siis, kui mul on käed tööd täis kolme vastasega korraga!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! Thank you!
et: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! Aitäh sulle!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: With your help, we thwarted TEAM MAGMA's destructive plan!
et: Sinu abiga nurjasime TEAM MAGMA hävitava plaani!

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: But… You… Whose side are you on?
et: Aga… Sina… Kelle poolel sa õigupoolest oled?

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: Ah, it doesn't matter.
et: Ah, pole tähtis.

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: We will remain vigilant and keep up our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.
et: Me jääme valvsaks ja jätkame TEAM MAGMA jälitamist.

label: MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou
en: {PLAYER}, we shall meet again!
et: {PLAYER}, me kohtume veel!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs
en: Darn… TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us! We can't keep up with them!
et: Neetud… TEAM MAGMAT on rohkem kui meid! Me ei jõua neile järele!

label: MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemon
en: If they expand the land, there'll be less habitats for WATER POKéMON!
et: Kui nad maismaad laiendavad, jääb VEE-POKéMONidele vähem elupaiku!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: We're TEAM AQUA!
et: Me oleme TEAM AQUA!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: They're TEAM MAGMA!
et: Nemad on TEAM MAGMA!

label: MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar
en: It burns me up that they'd use such a confusing name!
et: Mind ajab marru, et nad võtsid nii segadusttekitava nime!

label: MtChimney_Text_Bushaa
en: Bushaa!
et: Bušaa!

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
en: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local specialty.
et: LAVA COOKIED on MT. CHIMNEY kohalik hõrgutis.

label: MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200
en: Try one. It's just ¥200.
et: Proovi üht. Maksab vaid ¥200.

label: MtChimney_Text_ThankYouDear
en: Thank you, dear!
et: Aitäh, kallis!

label: MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney
en: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if you've not got the money.
et: Oh heldeke. Ilma rahata ei saa ju midagi osta.

label: MtChimney_Text_OhFineThen
en: Oh, fine then.
et: Oh, olgu siis pealegi.

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
en: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine…
et: METEORIIT on paigaldatud salapärasele masinale…

label: MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine
en: The machine seems to be storing energy in the METEORITE.
et: Näib, et masin kogub METEORIITI energiat.

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
en: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious machine…
et: METEORIIT on paigaldatud salapärasele masinale…

label: MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite
en: Do you want to remove the METEORITE?
et: Kas tahad METEORIIDI eemaldada?

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite
en: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from the mysterious machine.
et: {PLAYER} eemaldas METEORIIDI salapäraselt masinalt.

label: MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite
en: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where it was.
et: {PLAYER} jättis METEORIIDI sinnapaika.

label: MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse
en: This mysterious machine… It makes no response whatsoever.
et: See salapärane masin… See ei reageeri enam millelegi.

label: MtChimney_Text_RouteSign
en: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE TOWN AHEAD
et: {DOWN_ARROW} JAGGED PATH LAVARIDGE LINN EES

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro
en: I've been to the hot springs and refreshed my tired bones. Right now I'm feeling strong!
et: Käisin kuumaallikatel ja värskendasin väsinud konte. Praegu on mul jõudu küll!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!
et: Oh heldeke. Oled sina alles tükk!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle
en: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call myself an EXPERT now, can I?
et: No mis sa kostad, kaotasin ära. Ei saa ma end nüüd küll EKSPERDIKS nimetada.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
en: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if I were battling my own grandchild.
et: Aitäh, laps. Oli lõbus, justkui võitleksin oma lapselapsega.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister
en: Please, come see me again for a rematch.
et: Tule mulle kindlasti veel revanši pakkuma.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro
en: If you can mesh your heart with those of your POKéMON, why, you should be able to achieve great things.
et: Kui suudad oma südame POKéMONide omadega ühte sulatada, siis saad korda saata suuri asju.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat
en: Oh, my goodness. Now, aren't you something!
et: Oh heldeke. Oled sina alles tükk!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch
en: Perhaps your heart has become one with the hearts of your POKéMON.
et: Vist on su süda POKéMONide südametega üheks saanud.

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro
en: I've got the fire in me, baby. I can't stand it! I have to battle!
et: Mul on tuli sees, kullake! Ma ei pea vastu — pean võitlema!

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat
en: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!
et: Ohoo, see oli kõrvetavalt kuum matš!

label: MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle
en: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms me up, baby!
et: MT. CHIMNEY kuumus soojendab mind, kullake!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro
en: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. I want to make my POKéMON battle!
et: Lõpuks ometi jõudsin MT. CHIMNEY otsa. Tahan oma POKéMONid lahingusse saata!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat
en: The way you battle… It's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!
et: Su võitlusviis… See on nagu MT. CHIMNEY purse!

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
en: Like I said, I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if I only do a little sightseeing…
et: Nagu ma ütlesin, lõpuks ometi jõudsin MT. CHIMNEY otsa. Kahju oleks, kui jääksin ainult ringi vaatama…

label: MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle
en: I want to get in some battles and buy COOKIES as souvenirs.
et: Tahan mõne lahingu maha pidada ja suveniiriks COOKIEsid osta.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro
en: Since I bathed in the hot springs, I've been feeling great! I'm sure I'm going to win!
et: Pärast kuumaallikates käimist on enesetunne suurepärane! Ma kindlasti võidan!

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat
en: Yowch! I'm getting a chill out of the water.
et: Auu! Veest väljas hakkab külm.

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
en: I'll have to take another dip in the hot springs. Want to join me?
et: Pean kuumaallikatesse veel korra minema. Tuled kaasa?

label: MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle
en: Just joking!
et: Ma ainult naljatan!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro
en: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of hot people around for company!
et: Vahva mägi! Ja seltsiks igal pool kuumi inimesi!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat
en: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!
et: Oh, sinagi oled tõeline tulesäde!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle
en: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE HOT SPRING with the locals!
et: Vist tuleb mul kohalikega koos LAVARIDGE KUUMAALLIKASSE minna!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister
en: I like little fireballs like you. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Mulle meeldivad sinusugused väikesed tulekerad. Las ma panen su oma POKéNAVi kirja.

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro
en: I'm happily surrounded by hot people around these parts. I won't lose!
et: Siinkandis on mu ümber lausa kuumad inimesed — see meeldib mulle! Mina ei kaota!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat
en: Gosh, you're still the same firebrand as before!
et: Heldeke, sa oled ikka sama tulesäde nagu ennegi!

label: MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch
en: Actually, it really is hot here. I'm overdressed for these parts.
et: Tegelikult on siin ikka päris palav. Olen siinse koha jaoks liiga soojalt riides.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Tere! {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I bet you're surprised to see me here!
et: Kindlasti üllatab sind, et ma siin olen!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I made it all the way here, and it's all thanks to you!
et: Ma jõudsin siia välja ja seda ainult tänu sinule!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: {PLAYER}, losing to you that time made me stronger!
et: {PLAYER}, tookordne kaotus sulle tegi mind tugevamaks!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: But I'm not going to lose anymore!
et: Aga ma ei kavatse enam kaotada!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: I'm going to win! For the POKéMON who gave me courage and strength!
et: Ma kavatsen võita! Nende POKéMONide nimel, kes andsid mulle julgust ja jõudu!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseAnymore
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu… Ma tulen!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat
en: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
et: Ohoo! {PLAYER}, sa oledki ju tugev!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBattle
en: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, {PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll catch up to you!
et: WALLY: Ma ei suutnud sind täna võita, {PLAYER}, aga ühel päeval jõuan ma sulle järele!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Tere! {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: I've gotten stronger since that last time! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!
et: Ma olen viimasest korrast tugevamaks saanud! Tahtsin seda sulle näidata, {PLAYER}!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu… Ma tulen!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat
en: Wow! {PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
et: Ohoo! {PLAYER}, sa oledki ju tugev!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
en: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time, too… But one of these days, {PLAYER}, I'm going to catch up to you…
et: WALLY: Ma ei suutnud sind seekordki võita… Aga ühel päeval, {PLAYER}, jõuan ma sulle järele…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle
en: And challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!
et: Ja astun POKéMON LIIGA vastu!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro
en: I've made it this far a couple times, but the last stretch is so long…
et: Olen paar korda siia välja jõudnud, aga viimane lõik on nii pikk…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarDefeat
en: My dream ends here again…
et: Mu unistus lõpeb jälle siin…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle
en: You've made it this far. Keep the momentum going and become the CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!
et: Sa oled juba nii kaugele jõudnud. Hoia hoogu ja saa MEISTRIKS! Kui keegi suudab, siis sina!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro
en: I didn't come all this way to lose now. That possibility doesn't exist!
et: Ma ei tulnud kogu seda teed selleks, et nüüd kaotada. Seda võimalust lihtsalt pole!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertDefeat
en: Impossible… I lost?
et: Võimatu… Ma kaotasin?

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
en: I lost here…
et: Ma kaotasin siin…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle
en: That means I lack the qualifications to become the CHAMPION…
et: See tähendab, et minust ei olegi MEISTRIT…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro
en: This seemingly infinite and harsh road lives up to its name of VICTORY.
et: See näiliselt lõputu ja karm tee kannab nime VICTORY täie õigusega.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeDefeat
en: Your battle style is fantastic…
et: Su võitlusstiil on lausa hämmastav…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle
en: You seem to have the potential for becoming the CHAMPION.
et: Näib, et sul on potentsiaali MEISTRIKS saada.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro
en: What is the VICTORY ROAD? I'll tell you if you win!
et: Mis on VICTORY ROAD? Ütlen sulle, kui võidad!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyDefeat
en: Okay! Well done!
et: Olgu! Hästi tehtud!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
en: Getting through here safely--that's the final test for any TRAINER aiming to become the POKéMON CHAMPION.
et: Siit tervelt läbi pääseda – see ongi viimane proovikivi igale TRAINERILE, kes tahab saada POKéMON MEISTRIKS.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle
en: That's why it's called the VICTORY ROAD.
et: Just seepärast kannabki see nime VICTORY ROAD.

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro
en: I have nothing to say to anyone that's come this far. Come on!
et: Mul pole midagi öelda kellelegi, kes nii kaugele on jõudnud. Tule siis!

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnDefeat
en: This is a disgrace…
et: Milline häbi…

label: VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle
en: Humph, go right on ahead. See if I care.
et: Hmpf, mine aga edasi. Mis mul sellest.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro
en: I trained together with my whole family, every one of us! I'm not losing to anyone!
et: Treenisin koos kogu perega, iga viimane kui üks meist! Mina küll kellelegi ei kaota!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat
en: Better than my family?! Is that possible?!
et: Parem kui mu perekond?! Kas see on üldse võimalik?!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
en: I was better than everyone in my family. I've never lost before…
et: Olin parem kui keegi teine mu peres. Ma pole veel kunagi kaotanud…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle
en: I've lost my confidence… Maybe I'll go home…
et: Kaotasin enesekindluse… Äkki lähen koju…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro
en: I'd heard that there was a tough little kid around. Do they mean you?
et: Kuulsin, et siinkandis liigub üks kõva põnn. Kas see oledki sina?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenDefeat
en: The little shrimp is tough!
et: See pisike on ikka kõva küll!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle
en: The rumors I heard, that tough little kid is from PETALBURG CITY.
et: Kuulduste järgi on see kõva põnn pärit PETALBURG LINNAST.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro
en: You must be getting a little tired.
et: Sa oled vist juba veidi väsinud.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat
en: No signs of tiring at all!
et: Väsimusest pole jälgegi!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle
en: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE are long and grueling challenges. Beware of fatigue!
et: VICTORY ROAD ja POKéMON LIIGA on pikad ja kurnavad proovikivid. Hoia end väsimuse eest!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
en: You shouldn't get complacent just because you have a lot of GYM BADGES.
et: Ära muutu liiga enesekindlaks ainult sellepärast, et sul on palju SAALIMÄRKE.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro
en: There's always going to be someone who's better than you!
et: Alati leidub keegi, kes on sinust parem!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieDefeat
en: You're better than me!
et: Sa oled minust parem!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle
en: Gaze on your collected BADGES and remember the TRAINERS you've faced.
et: Vaata oma kogutud MÄRKE ja meenuta TRAINEREID, kellega oled võidelnud.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro
en: I've come this far, but the tension's giving me awful stomach pain…
et: Olen nii kaugele jõudnud, aga pingest on kõht kohutavalt valus…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixDefeat
en: Ooh… It hurts…
et: Ohh… Kuidas valutab…

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
en: I can't help getting all tense knowing that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.
et: Ma ei saa midagi parata – POKéMON LIIGA lähedus ajab mu päris pingesse.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle
en: It's all I can do to feign calm.
et: Suudan vaevu rahulikku nägu teha.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
en: The elite among the elite gather in this cave.
et: Siia koopasse koguneb eliidi eliit.

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro
en: How are you finding it?
et: Kuidas sulle tundub?

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat
en: Not rattled in the least bit!
et: Ei lase end põrmugi häirida!

label: VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle
en: You do have guts! I like that! Keep it going!
et: Sul on ikka julgust! See meeldib mulle! Jätka samas vaimus!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
en: This is where we DRAGON users do our training.
et: Siin treenime meie, DRAAKONI kasutajad.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro
en: The CHAMPION even visits. Now do you see how special it is here?
et: Isegi MEISTER käib siin. Kas näed nüüd, kui eriline see paik on?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat
en: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
et: Urgh! Ma ei oodanud, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
en: The road ahead remains long and harsh.
et: Tee edasi on veel pikk ja karm.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle
en: When will my POKéMON and I become the best?
et: Millal saame mina ja mu POKéMONid parimateks?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister
en: I want to know more about your power. Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
et: Ma tahan su jõust rohkem teada. Lase mul sind oma POKéNAVi registreerida.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
en: Since we met, we have trained hard with our sights on number one.
et: Alates kohtumisest oleme kõvasti treeninud, sihiks number üks.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchIntro
en: Help us see how much stronger we've become!
et: Aita meil näha, kui palju tugevamaks oleme saanud!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDefeat
en: Urgh! I didn't expect you to be so strong!
et: Urgh! Ma ei oodanud, et sa nii tugev oled!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
en: You've obviously kept up your POKéMON training.
et: Sa oled ilmselgelt oma POKéMONide treenimist jätkanud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematch
en: So long as you remain strong, I, too, can become stronger!
et: Niikaua kui sa tugevaks jääd, saan minagi tugevamaks!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro
en: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.
et: JOHN: Me oleme alati kahekesi koos POKéMONidega võidelnud. Meil on endasse usku.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat
en: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.
et: JOHN: Oh, heldeke. Me kaotasime, kallis naine.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
en: JOHN: We've been married for fifty years.
et: JOHN: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle
en: Come to think of it, I've yet to beat my dear wife in a battle.
et: Kui mõelda, pole ma oma kallist naist veel lahingus võitnud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
en: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!
et: JOHN: Vaata aga, milline noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons
en: Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.
et: Kas võitled meiega? Siis pead tulema tagasi suurema hulga POKéMONidega.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister
en: JOHN: Young TRAINER, if the chance arises, will you battle with us again?
et: JOHN: Noor TRAINER, kui juhus tuleb, kas võitleksid meiega jälle?

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
en: JAY: We've been married for fifty years.
et: JAY: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro
en: The bond we share as a couple could never be broken.
et: Meie paari sidet ei suudaks miski katkestada.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat
en: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.
et: JAY: Oh, heldeke. Me kaotasime, mu kallis mees.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
en: JAY: Fifty years of marriage…
et: JAY: Viiskümmend aastat abielu…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle
en: If we ever argued, we always settled it with a POKéMON battle…
et: Kui me kunagi vaidlesime, lahendasime selle alati POKéMON-lahinguga…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
en: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER?
et: JAY: Vaata aga, kui noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons
en: If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.
et: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, pead tulema tagasi suurema hulga POKéMONidega.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro
en: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON together as a twosome. We've confidence in ourselves.
et: JOHN: Me oleme alati kahekesi koos POKéMONidega võidelnud. Meil on endasse usku.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat
en: JOHN: Oh, my. We've lost, dear wife.
et: JOHN: Oh, heldeke. Me kaotasime, kallis naine.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
en: JOHN: Married for fifty years…
et: JOHN: Viiskümmend aastat abielus…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch
en: On reflection, the dear wife and I, we battled day in and day out…
et: Kui järele mõelda, võitlesime kalli naisega päevast päeva…

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
en: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!
et: JOHN: Vaata aga, milline noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEnoughMons
en: Will you battle with us? If so, you'll have to return with more POKéMON.
et: Kas võitled meiega? Siis pead tulema tagasi suurema hulga POKéMONidega.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
en: JAY: We've been married for fifty years.
et: JAY: Oleme olnud abielus viiskümmend aastat.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro
en: We've supported each other all that time. We've made ourselves strong.
et: Oleme kogu selle aja teineteist toetanud. Nii oleme tugevaks saanud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat
en: JAY: Oh, dear. We've lost, my dear husband.
et: JAY: Oh, heldeke. Me kaotasime, mu kallis mees.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
en: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… Many things have happened.
et: JAY: Viiskümmend aastat abielu… Palju on juhtunud.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch
en: I hope that we will continue to make happy memories together.
et: Loodan, et kogume ka edaspidi koos õnnelikke mälestusi.

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
en: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young TRAINER?
et: JAY: Vaata aga, kui noor TRAINER!

label: MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnoughMons
en: If you'd care to battle with us, you'll have to come back with more POKéMON.
et: Kui tahad meiega võidelda, pead tulema tagasi suurema hulga POKéMONidega.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy
en: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that this boy's got more pep, I suppose… But he's become a bit too peppy…
et: ONU: Küllap on POKéMONid poisile indu juurde andnud… Aga nüüd on seda indu juba veidi liiga palju…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?
et: WALLY: Ohh, ONU, palun?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: I want to challenge this GYM and see how much better I've become.
et: Ma tahan selles SAALIS end proovile panna ja näha, kui palju paremaks olen saanud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGym
en: Please? May I, please?
et: Palun? Kas ma tohin, palun?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.
et: ONU: Oota nüüd, WALLY.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: Since you started living with POKéMON, you have grown quite a lot stronger.
et: Sellest ajast, kui sa POKéMONidega koos elama hakkasid, oled sa tublisti tugevamaks saanud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt
en: But don't you think you're pushing it to suddenly challenge a GYM?
et: Aga kas sa ei lähe liiale, kui tahad kohe kogu SAALI vastu astuda?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
en: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.
et: WALLY: Ma ei lähe liiale.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone
en: If I combine forces with RALTS, we can beat anyone!
et: Kui RALTS ja mina jõud ühendame, võidame kelle tahes!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Oh! Tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: I've gotten a lot stronger since we met.
et: Olen meie kohtumisest saati palju tugevamaks saanud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: {PLAYER}, I want you and my UNCLE to understand that.
et: {PLAYER}, ma tahan, et sina ja mu ONU seda mõistaksite.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe
en: {PLAYER}, please, will you have a battle with me?
et: {PLAYER}, palun, kas võitleksid minuga?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowImStrong
en: WALLY: Oh… If you won't battle me, {PLAYER}, my UNCLE won't know that I've become really strong.
et: WALLY: Oh… Kui sa minuga ei võitle, {PLAYER}, ei saa mu ONU teada, et olen tõesti tugevaks saanud.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
en: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it? On WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to battle with him just this once?
et: ONU: {PLAYER}{KUN}, eks ju? Kas ma tohin WALLY eest paluda, et sa temaga kasvõi selle ühe korra võitleksid?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally
en: I don't think he's going to listen to any reason the way he is now.
et: Praeguses tujus ta mõistusehäält niikuinii ei kuula.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPleaseBattleMe
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}, please! Battle with me, please.
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}, palun! Võitle minuga, palun.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
en: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you.
et: WALLY: {PLAYER}, aitäh.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome
en: Okay… Here I come!
et: Olgu… Siis ma tulen!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyDefeat
en: I lost…
et: Ma kaotasin…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdanturf
en: WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to VERDANTURF…
et: WALLY: ONU… Ma lähen VERDANTURF LINNA tagasi…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
en: {PLAYER}, thank you. Being a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?
et: {PLAYER}, aitäh. TRAINERIKS olemine on raske, kas pole?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBattle
en: It's not enough just to have POKéMON and make them battle. That isn't what being a real TRAINER is about.
et: Ei piisa sellest, et sul on POKéMONid ja sa lased neil võidelda. Tõeline TRAINER on midagi enamat.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so down on yourself.
et: ONU: WALLY, pole vaja end nii norgu lasta.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: Why, what's keeping you from becoming stronger and stronger?
et: Mis sind ometi takistab üha tugevamaks saamast?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown
en: Come on, let's go home. Everyone's waiting for you.
et: Tule, läki koju. Kõik ootavad sind.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
en: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me that you must be the TRAINER who kept an eye out for WALLY when he caught his POKéMON.
et: ONU: {PLAYER}{KUN}, mulle tuli just pähe, et sina pead olema see TRAINER, kes WALLYL silma peal hoidis, kui ta oma POKéMONi püüdis.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime
en: Why don't you visit us in VERDANTURF sometime? I'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.
et: Tule meile kunagi VERDANTURF LINNA külla! WALLYL oleks kindlasti hea meel.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: WALLY: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
et: WALLY: Oh, tere, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: I just wanted to tell you that my uncle bought me a POKéNAV!
et: Tahtsin lihtsalt öelda, et mu onu ostis mulle POKéNAVi!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WallyPokenavCall
en: Now I can get in touch with you anytime, {PLAYER}!
et: Nüüd saan ma sinuga igal ajal ühendust võtta, {PLAYER}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RegisteredWally
en: Registered WALLY in the POKéNAV.
et: WALLY registreeriti POKéNAVi.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: SCOTT: Hehe… I was watching that match!
et: SCOTT: Hehee… Ma nägin seda lahingut pealt!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: You're friends with that boy WALLY, aren't you?
et: Sa oled ju selle poisi WALLY sõber, eks?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: But you didn't hold anything back and beat him impressively.
et: Aga sa ei hoidnud end tagasi ja alistasid ta muljetavaldavalt.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: Yeah! That's what a real POKéMON battle is all about!
et: Jah! Selline ongi tõeline POKéMON-lahing!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: I idolize TRAINERS like that!
et: Just selliseid TRAINEREID ma jumaldangi!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack
en: … … … … … … I'll be cheering for you!
et: … … … … … … Ma hoian sulle pöialt!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! You look like you have a lot of zip! That's a good thing, wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Oo, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Sinus on ikka hoogu küll! See on hea asi, vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: Fine! I've decided! I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: Hüva! Otsustatud! Mul on sinult üht teenet vaja, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: MAUVILLE CITY has an underground sector called NEW MAUVILLE.
et: MAUVILLE LINNA all on maa-alune osa nimega NEW MAUVILLE.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and switch off the GENERATOR.
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, ma sooviksin, et sa läheksid sinna ja lülitaksid GENERAATORI välja.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: The GENERATOR has been running a bit haywire. It's getting unsafe.
et: GENERAATOR on veidi peast segi läinud. Asi hakkab ohtlikuks minema.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKey
en: Here, this is the KEY to get into NEW MAUVILLE.
et: Võta, siin on VÕTI. See avab NEW MAUVILLE sissepääsu.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: WATTSON: Don't you worry about it. It won't be a challenge to you.
et: WATTSON: Ära muretse. See pole sulle mingi katsumus.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.
et: NEW MAUVILLE sissepääs jääb ROUTE 110 pealt vaid lühikese SURF-sõidu kaugusele.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge
en: That's it, then, you have my trust! Wahahahaha!
et: Nii on kokku lepitud — ma usaldan sind! Vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: I knew it, {PLAYER}{KUN}! I knew I'd made the right choice asking you!
et: Ma teadsin, {PLAYER}{KUN}! Ma teadsin, et tegin õige valiku, sind paludes!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: This is my thanks--a TM containing THUNDERBOLT!
et: Siin on mu tänu — TM võttega THUNDERBOLT!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeTM
en: Go on, you've earned it!
et: Anna minna, sa oled selle ära teeninud!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
en: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!
et: WATTSON: Vahahahaha!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge
en: It pleases me to no end to see the young step up and take charge!
et: Mulle valmistab lõputut rõõmu näha, kuidas noored astuvad ette ja võtavad ohjad!

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
en: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON battles and stuff…
et: Tead, POKéMON-lahingud ja kõik muu on ju lahe…

label: MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHealth
en: But if your POKéMON gets hurt, you have to nurse it back to health.
et: Aga kui su POKéMON saab viga, pead ta jälle terveks ravima.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
en: The roads of this town stretch north and south, and east and west.
et: Selle linna teed ulatuvad põhja ja lõunasse ning itta ja läände.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeThrough
en: Because of that, we get all sorts of people coming through.
et: Seetõttu käib siit läbi igasuguseid inimesi.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
en: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?
et: Kas oled juba poes RYDEL'S CYCLES käinud?

label: MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous
en: RYDEL, the owner, is a very generous man.
et: Omanik RYDEL on väga helde mees.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBike
en: Even if you're riding a BIKE, wild POKéMON could jump you.
et: Isegi kui sõidad JALGRATTAL, võivad metsikud POKéMONid sulle kallale karata.

label: MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign
en: MAUVILLE CITY “The bright and shiny city of fun!”
et: MAUVILLE LINN „Särav ja läikiv lõbulinn!”

label: MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: Where the courage of TRAINERS is put to the test!
et: Siin pannakse proovile TRAINERITE julgus!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: Welcome to the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: Tere tulemast BATTLE PYRAMIDi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WelcomeToBattlePyramid
en: I am your guide to the Battle Quest.
et: Mina olen sinu teejuht üritusel Battle Quest.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_EmbarkOnChallenge
en: Have you the courage to embark on the Battle Quest challenge?
et: Kas sul jätkub julgust Battle Quest väljakutsele asuda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_AwaitFutureChallenge
en: We await your challenge in the future!
et: Ootame sind tulevikus väljakutsele!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: The Battle Quest is a battling event in which you must explore the PYRAMID and try to reach the top.
et: Battle Quest on lahinguüritus, kus pead PÜRAMIIDI läbi uurima ja püüdma tippu jõuda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: In the PYRAMID are seven floors of mazes, all of them filled with not only skilled TRAINERS but also wild POKéMON.
et: PÜRAMIIDIS on seitse labürindikorrust ja seal ei oota sind mitte ainult osavad TRAINERID, vaid ka metsikud POKéMONid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: You must enter with three POKéMON, none of them holding an item.
et: Sisse pead minema kolme POKéMONiga ja ükski neist ei tohi eset kaasas hoida.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: On your ascent, you will be provided with a BATTLE BAG for items.
et: Ülespoole liikudes antakse sulle esemete jaoks BATTLE BAG.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you fail in your challenge, any item placed in the BATTLE BAG disappears.
et: Kui väljakutse ebaõnnestub, kaovad kõik BATTLE BAGi pandud esemed.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you want to interrupt your challenge, you must select “REST” and save the game.
et: Kui tahad oma väljakutse katkestada, pead valima „PUHKA” ja salvestama mängu.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBattlePyramid
en: If you don't save before interrupting, you will be disqualified.
et: Kui sa enne katkestamist ei salvesta, diskvalifitseeritakse sind.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_WhichLevelMode
en: The PYRAMID offers two courses, Level 50 and Open Level. Which will you enter?
et: PÜRAMIID pakub kahte rada: Tase 50 ja Avatud tase. Kumma valid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_SelectThreeMons
en: Very good. Now, please select the three POKéMON you wish to accompany you.
et: Väga hea. Nüüd palun vali kolm POKéMONi, keda soovid kaasa võtta.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen
en: A slight problem, adventurer!
et: Väike probleem, seikleja!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen

et: Paistab, et sul pole väljakutseks sobivat kolme POKéMONi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLvOpen

et: Pea ka meeles, et võtaksid oma POKéMONidelt kõik esemed ära.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_NotEnoughValidMonsLv50

en: Before you enter the BATTLE PYRAMID, the game must be saved. Is that okay?
et: Enne kui sisened BATTLE PYRAMIDi, tuleb mäng salvestada. Kas sobib?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ShowYouIntoPyramid
en: Very good. I will now show you into the BATTLE PYRAMID.
et: Väga hea. Ma juhatan sind nüüd BATTLE PYRAMIDi.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_StepOnFloorPanel

en: I see flying POKéMON…
et: Ma näen lendavaid POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintFlyingDragon
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…
et: …Ja näen, kuidas su POKéMONid tohutult võimsate võtete käes kannatavad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: I see those that have evolved from the power of stones…
et: Ma näen neid, kes on arenenud kivide jõust…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: I also sense fire, water, and electricity…
et: Ma tajun ka tuld, vett ja elektrit…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintStoneEvolve
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from those three powers…
et: …Ja näen, kuidas su POKéMONid nende kolme jõu käes kannatavad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
en: I see NORMAL-type POKéMON…
et: Ma näen TAVA-tüüpi POKéMONe…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_HintNormal
en: …And, I see your POKéMON suffering from enormously powerful moves…
et: …Ja näen, kuidas su POKéMONid tohutult võimsate võtete käes kannatavad…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
en: Whether you believe my fortunes or not, the choice is yours…
et: Kas usud mu ennustusi või mitte, valik on sinu…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_BelieveMyFortunesOrNot
en: The future can be changed anytime… I wish you safe passage…
et: Tulevikku saab alati muuta… Soovin sulle turvalist teekonda…

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: If you run fast, TRAINERS may notice and come after you for a battle.
et: Kui jooksed kiiresti, võivad TRAINERID seda märgata ja tulla sulle lahingu pärast järele.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_TrainersNoticeRunning
en: So, if you want to avoid TRAINERS, don't catch their eyes, but sneak cautiously and quietly past them.
et: Nii et kui tahad TRAINEREID vältida, ära torka silma, vaid hiili ettevaatlikult ja vaikselt neist mööda.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!
et: Aaaaaarrrrgh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: I had a whole lot of items, but I lost them all when I lost!
et: Mul oli terve hunnik esemeid, aga lüüasaamisega kadusid need kõik!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_LostLotOfItems
en: Awaaaaaaarrrrgh!
et: Aaaaaarrrrgh!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: Welcome back! You've done the unthinkable!
et: Tere tulemast tagasi! Sa tegid mõeldamatu!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_YouveDefeatedPyramidKing
en: You've defeated the PYRAMID KING and conquered the BATTLE PYRAMID!
et: Sa alistasid PYRAMID KINGi ja vallutasid BATTLE PYRAMIDi!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_GiveYouTheseBattlePoints
en: Young explorer! In commendation of your courage, we give you these Battle Point(s)!
et: Noor avastaja! Sinu julguse tunnustuseks anname sulle need Battle Pointid!

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_RulesAreListed
en: The Battle Quest rules are listed.
et: Siia on kirja pandud Battle Questi reeglid.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ReadWhichHeading
en: Which heading do you want to read?
et: Millist pealkirja soovid lugeda?

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: When the PYRAMID is conquered, the wild POKéMON that appear in it are replaced by different kinds.
et: Kui PÜRAMIID on vallutatud, asendatakse selles ilmuvad metsikud POKéMONid teiste liikidega.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMonRules
en: Explore, observe, and learn what kinds of wild POKéMON you may encounter.
et: Uuri, jälgi ja õpi, milliseid metsikuid POKéMONe võid kohata.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: TRAINERS are lying in wait for you inside the PYRAMID.
et: PÜRAMIIDIS varitsevad sind TRAINERID.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: On each floor, there are up to eight TRAINERS.
et: Igal korrusel on kuni kaheksa TRAINERIT.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainTrainerRules
en: When you defeat a TRAINER, you will get a helpful hint for your adventure.
et: Kui alistad TRAINERI, saad oma seikluseks kasuliku vihje.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes in the PYRAMID rearrange themselves every time you enter it.
et: PÜRAMIIDI labürindid muudavad kuju iga kord, kui sa sisse astud.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The mazes are poorly lit. You must advance with caution.
et: Labürindid on halvasti valgustatud. Pead ettevaatlikult edasi liikuma.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainMazeRules
en: The light grows brighter whenever you defeat a wild POKéMON or a TRAINER.
et: Valgus muutub eredamaks iga kord, kui alistad metsiku POKéMONi või TRAINERI.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The BATTLE BAG serves as your BAG while in the PYRAMID.
et: PÜRAMIIDIS on sul KOTI asemel BATTLE BAG.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: There are two separate BATTLE BAGS-one each for the Level 50 and Open Level adventures.
et: BATTLE BAGe on kaks: üks Tase 50 ja teine Avatud taseme seikluse jaoks.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: They each can hold up to 99 pieces of ten kinds of items.
et: Kummassegi mahub kümmet liiki esemeid, igaüht kuni 99 tükki.

label: BattleFrontier_BattlePyramidLobby_Text_ExplainBagRules
en: The contents of the BATTLE BAG are lost if you fail in your quest.
et: BATTLE BAGi sisu läheb kaotsi, kui su retk ebaõnnestub.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: {PLAYER} wrote down the secret code on the door.
et: {PLAYER} kirjutas salakoodi uksele.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: “TRICK MASTER is huggable.” … … … … … … … …
et: „TRICK MASTER on kallistamist väärt.” … … … … … … … …

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSecretCodeLockOpened
en: The lock clicked open!
et: Lukk klõpsatas lahti!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIntro
en: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes like smoke. How does he do it?
et: TRICK MASTER kaob alati nagu suits. Kuidas ta seda teeb?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDefeat
en: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! How do you do it?
et: Aiiih! Sa oled palju liiga tugev! Kuidas sa seda teed?

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPostBattle
en: I wish I could appear and disappear as if I were smoke, too.
et: Tahaks ka ise ilmuda ja kaduda, nagu oleksin suits.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaIntro
en: Going around the same spot… It begets ill fortune…
et: Ikka ja jälle samas kohas ringi käia… See toob õnnetust…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaDefeat
en: Defeated! It's a bad sign…
et: Kaotasin! See on halb enne…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_PatriciaPostBattle
en: I've circled the same spot over ten times now… It's ill fortune…
et: Olen nüüd üle kümne korra samas kohas ringi käinud… See ei tähenda head…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIntro
en: Whoever wins will get through here first. That's the feeling I get.
et: Kes iganes võidab, saab siit esimesena läbi. Selline tunne mul on.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisDefeat
en: Oh! Well, go ahead, then!
et: Oh! Noh, siis mine aga!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPostBattle
en: You're solving all the puzzles in the TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
et: Sa lahendad ära kõik TRICK HOUSE mõistatused. Selline tunne mul on.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaIntro
en: Nufufufu, here at last! Let's get right with it!
et: Nufufufu, lõpuks siin! Asugem kohe asja kallale!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaDefeat
en: You're so casual about winning!
et: Sina võidad nii muretult!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaPostBattle
en: Humph! I'm not upset! Not me!
et: Hmpf! Ma pole pahane! Mina mitte!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIntro
en: I ever so closely watched you coming!
et: Ma jälgisin väga tähelepanelikult, kuidas sa lähened!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDefeat
en: This outcome I didn't see coming…
et: Seda tulemust ma ette ei näinud…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
en: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird place to get acquainted.
et: Noh, igatahes valisime mõlemad tutvumiseks üsna veidra koha.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPostBattle
en: As one weirdo to another, let's do our best!
et: Üks veidrik teisele: anname endast parima!

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettIntro
en: It's awfully cramped in here…
et: Siin on kohutavalt kitsas…

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettDefeat
en: Oh, yes, strong you are.
et: Oh, jah, tugev sa oled.

label: Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettPostBattle
en: I was hoping to switch places with you when I beat you, but…
et: Ma lootsin sinuga kohad vahetada, kui sind võidan, aga…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT? It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Kas tead POKéMONi SEEDOT? SOOTOPOLIS LINNAS ei näe teda peaaegu kunagi.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Anyway, I love big SEEDOT. The bigger the better.
et: Igatahes, mulle meeldib suur SEEDOT. Mida suurem, seda parem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: But my younger brother, he says that LOTAD is bigger.
et: Aga mu noorem vend väidab, et LOTAD on suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: That's silly. SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!
et: Rumal jutt. SEEDOT on ju kindlasti suurem!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigSeedot
en: Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you? P-p-please, show me!
et: Häh? Kas sul on SEEDOT kaasas? P-p-palun, näita mulle!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches! Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli! Oh, heldeke, see on suur!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: It might even beat the big LOTAD my younger brother saw!
et: See võib olla isegi suurem kui see LOTAD, keda mu noorem vend nägi!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_GoshMightBeBiggerThanLotad
en: Thanks for showing me. This is my thanks!
et: Aitäh näitamast. Võta see tänutäheks!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ReceivedPotion1
en: {PLAYER} received a POTION.
et: {PLAYER} sai POTIONi.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BagCrammedFull1
en: Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.
et: Häh? Su KOTT on puupüsti täis.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches, is it?
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli, on või?

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerSeedot
en: Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT than this one.
et: Hmm… Olen näinud suuremat SEEDOT kui see siin.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotSeedot
en: Oh, now this is quite something… But it's not a SEEDOT!
et: Ohoo, see on küll midagi… Aga see pole ju SEEDOT!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
en: You don't have a big SEEDOT? That's too bad…
et: Sul pole suurt SEEDOT? Kahju küll…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigSeedot
en: If you get a big SEEDOT, please come show me.
et: Kui saad suure SEEDOT, tule kindlasti näita!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
en: The biggest SEEDOT in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch giant!
et: Ajaloo suurim SEEDOT! {STR_VAR_2} oma, {STR_VAR_3} tolli pikk hiiglane!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestSeedotInHistory
en: A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD always wanted!
et: SEEDOT, mis on suurem kui ükski LOTAD — just seda ma alati tahtsin!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD? It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.
et: Kas tead POKéMONi LOTAD? SOOTOPOLIS LINNAS näeb teda harva.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: I love, I mean love, big LOTAD!
et: Mulle meeldib suur LOTAD — ei, ma lausa jumaldan teda!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: My big brother says that SEEDOT is bigger.
et: Mu suur vend ütleb, et SEEDOT on suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: But that's wrong! Everyone knows that LOTAD is a lot bigger.
et: Aga see on vale! Kõik teavad, et LOTAD on palju suurem.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_PleaseShowMeBigLotad
en: Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD? P-p-please show me!
et: Häh? Kas sul on LOTAD? P-p-palun näita mulle!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: {STR_VAR_2} inches! Wow, that is big!
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli! Ohoo, see on suur!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: It might be even bigger than the huge SEEDOT my big brother saw.
et: See võib olla isegi suurem kui see tohutu SEEDOT, keda mu suur vend nägi.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_WowMightBeBiggerThanSeedot
en: Thanks for showing me! This is my thanks!
et: Aitäh näitamast! Võta see tänutäheks!

en: {PLAYER} received a POTION.
et: {PLAYER} sai POTIONi.

en: Hunh? Your BAG is crammed full.
et: Häh? Su KOTT on puupüsti täis.
