en: {STR_VAR_2} inches?
et: {STR_VAR_2} tolli?

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_SeenBiggerLotad
en: Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD than this one here.
et: Hmm… Olen näinud suuremat LOTAD kui see siin.

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_ThatsNotLotad
en: Well, isn't this something! But it's no LOTAD!
et: Vaat see on küll midagi! Aga LOTAD see ei ole!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
en: Don't you have a big LOTAD? How disappointing…
et: Kas sul pole suurt LOTAD? Küll on kahju…

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_DontHaveBigLotad
en: If you get a big LOTAD, please come show me!
et: Kui saad suure LOTAD, tule kindlasti näita!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
en: The biggest LOTAD in history! {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}-inch colossus!
et: Ajaloo suurim LOTAD! {STR_VAR_2} oma, {STR_VAR_3} tolli pikk koloss!

label: SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_BiggestLotadInHistory
en: A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT always wanted!
et: LOTAD, mis on suurem kui ükski SEEDOT — just seda ma alati tahtsin!

label: MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman5
en: If I win a whole lot of link battles and show everyone how good I am, I might get a fan following!
et: Kui võidan hulga ühenduslahinguid ja näitan kõigile, kui hea ma olen, võin fänniparve saada!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Gorge your eyes on this!
et: Ahmi seda silmadega!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: It's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the cutting edge of fashion, yeah!
et: See on SILK SCARF. Viimane moekarje, jaa!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Oh, I can see your eyes twinkling! You appreciate my dazzling style!
et: Oo, su silmad lausa säravad! Sa oskad mu pimestavat stiili hinnata!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveSilkScarf
en: Oh, you're a delight! Here you go. I want you to have it!
et: Oo, sa oled tore! Võta, see on sinu!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Oh, you don't have room?
et: Oh, sul pole ruumi?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom
en: Now, listen tight, this SCARF is a musthave! Why, I would sell all my items in order to get it!
et: Kuula nüüd hoolega — see SCARF on lihtsalt hädavajalik! Mina müüksin kasvõi kõik oma esemed maha, et see endale saada!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
en: The SILK SCARF raises the power of NORMAL-type moves.
et: SILK SCARF tõstab TAVA-tüüpi võtete jõudu.

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainSilkScarf
en: It's a marvelous SCARF that will go with almost all POKéMON!
et: See on imeline SCARF, mis sobib peaaegu igale POKéMONile!

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: Wow, you bothered to cross the sea to visit DEWFORD?
et: Ohoo, sa viitsisid üle mere tulla, et DEWFORD LINNA vaadata?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: Did you maybe come here because you heard about BRAWLY?
et: Kas sa tulid ehk siia sellepärast, et oled BRAWLY kohta kuulnud?

label: DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool
en: He's so cool… Everyone idolizes him.
et: Ta on nii lahe… Kõik jumaldavad teda.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: Hmm…
et: Hmm…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: An attacking move… Or a defensive move…
et: Ründevõte… Või kaitsevõte…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_AttackOrDefenseTM
en: It's no easy matter to decide which TM moves should be taught to POKéMON…
et: Pole kerge otsustada, milliseid TM-võtteid POKéMONidele õpetada…

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
en: There are so many different kinds of TM moves.
et: TM-võtteid on nii palju erinevaid.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_FiftyDifferentTMs
en: A catalog I read said there are fifty different kinds.
et: Ühes kataloogis oli kirjas, et neid on viiskümmend eri liiki.

label: LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_PokemonOnlyHaveFourMoves
en: I'd like to get all the different TMs, but a POKéMON learns only four moves.
et: Tahaksin kõik eri TM-võtted endale saada, aga POKéMON suudab õppida vaid neli võtet.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
en: We're developing a device for talking with POKéMON.
et: Me arendame seadet POKéMONidega rääkimiseks.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
en: But we haven't had much success…
et: Aga meil pole eriti edu olnud…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS…
et: Ma arendan uut sorti POKé PALL…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
en: But I haven't made much headway…
et: Aga ma pole eriti edasi jõudnud…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: We finally made new kinds of POKé BALLS!
et: Me saime lõpuks valmis uut sorti POKé PALL!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to catch POKéMON you've caught before.
et: REPEAT PALLIGA on kergem püüda POKéMONe, keda oled juba varem püüdnud.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: The TIMER BALL gets better at catching POKéMON the longer a battle runs.
et: TIMER PALL püüab seda paremini, mida kauem lahing kestab.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Both are proudly developed by the DEVON CORPORATION.
et: Mõlemad on DEVON CORPORATION uhke töö vili.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
en: Please give them a try!
et: Palun proovi neid!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: I made the POKéNAV!
et: Mina tegin POKéNAVi!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
en: As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!
et: Insenerina on mul suur õnn, et sain teha midagi nii suurepärast!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Oh, wow! That's a POKéNAV!
et: Ohoo! See on ju POKéNAV!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: It came about as a result of our PRESIDENT's desire to learn about the feelings of POKéMON.
et: See sündis meie PRESIDENDI soovist saada teada POKéMONide tunnetest.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: Would you like me to describe its features in detail?
et: Kas sooviksid, et ma kirjeldaksin selle funktsioone üksikasjalikult?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
en: No, no. I think you'll find out just by trying the POKéNAV out.
et: Ei, ei. Ma arvan, et sa saad kõik teada juba POKéNAVi proovides.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON…
et: Ma üritan välja töötada seadet, mis näitaks POKéMONide unenägusid piltidena…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga see ei lähe hästi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: I've been trying to develop a device that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…
et: Ma olen üritanud välja töötada seadet, mis äratab POKéMONid fossiilidest ellu…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDeviceToResurrectFossils
en: And, it's working!
et: Ja see toimib!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Wait! That thing you have there… Is that a POKéMON fossil?
et: Oota! See asi, mis sul seal on… Kas see on POKéMONi fossiil?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: Would you like to bring that POKéMON back to life?
et: Kas tahaksid selle POKéMONi ellu äratada?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBringFossilBackToLife
en: I can with my newly developed FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
et: Minu vastvalminud seade FOSSIL REGENERATOR suudab seda teha.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: Oh, is that so?
et: Oh, on või nii?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatSo
en: DEVON's technological expertise is outstanding, I tell you.
et: DEVONI tehnilised oskused on silmapaistvad, usu mind.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Oh, now that's a surprise! You have not one, but two, fossils?
et: Ohoo, milline üllatus! Sul pole mitte üks, vaid koguni kaks fossiili?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Unfortunately, my machine can only regenerate one POKéMON at a time.
et: Kahjuks suudab mu masin korraga elustada ainult ühe POKéMONi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossilsPickOne
en: Would you like to pick one of your fossils for regeneration?
et: Kas valid ühe oma fossiilidest, mille elustame?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: Excellent! Let's do this right away.
et: Suurepärane! Teeme selle kohe ära.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFossilToResearcher
en: {PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} ulatas {STR_VAR_1} DEVONI UURIJALE.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, is incredible.
et: FOSSIL REGENERATOR, mille ma ise valmistasin, on lausa uskumatu.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: But it has one drawback--it takes a long time to work.
et: Aga sel on üks puudus – selle töö võtab kaua aega.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilRegeneratorTakesTime
en: So, uh… How about you go for a stroll and look around for a while?
et: Nii et, öö… Kuidas oleks, kui läheksid jalutama ja vaataksid veidi ringi?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Thanks for waiting!
et: Aitäh ootamast!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: Your fossilized POKéMON has been brought back to life!
et: Sinu fossiilist POKéMON on ellu äratatud!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilizedMonBroughtBackToLife
en: The fossil was an ancient POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, it was!
et: Fossiil oli muistne POKéMON. See oli {STR_VAR_2}!

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ReceivedMonFromResearcher
en: {PLAYER} received {STR_VAR_2} from the DEVON RESEARCHER.
et: {PLAYER} sai DEVONI UURIJALT {STR_VAR_2}.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPokemon
en: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON. You have no room for this one.
et: Oi-oi, sul on liiga palju POKéMONe. Selle jaoks pole sul enam ruumi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV…
et: Ma üritan välja töötada POKéNAVi uut funktsiooni…

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
en: But it's not going well.
et: Aga see ei lähe hästi.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Well, now what shall I work on developing next?
et: Noh, mida ma nüüd järgmisena välja mõtlema peaksin?

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: Our company allows us to make our inspirations into reality.
et: Meie firmas saab oma ideed päriselt teoks teha.

label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
en: One couldn't ask for a better environment as an engineer.
et: Insenerina ei saaks paremat keskkonda soovidagi.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Who… Who are you?
et: Ää? Kes… Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}. So your move was today.
et: Ahaa, sa oledki {PLAYER}{KUN}. Nii et te kolisitegi täna.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Um… I'm MAY. Glad to meet you!
et: Öö… Ma olen MAY. Rõõm kohtuda!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I have this dream of becoming friends with POKéMON all over the world.
et: Ma… ma unistan sellest, et saaksin sõbraks POKéMONidega üle kogu maailma.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I… I heard about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}, from my dad, PROF. BIRCH.
et: Ma… ma kuulsin sinust, {PLAYER}{KUN}, oma isa PROF. BIRCH käest.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was hoping that you would be nice, {PLAYER}{KUN}, and that we could be friends.
et: Ma lootsin, et sa oled tore, {PLAYER}{KUN}, ja et me võiksime sõbrad olla.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, this is silly, isn't it? I… I've just met you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
et: Oi, see on ju rumal jutt. Me… me ju alles kohtusime, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Eheheh…
et: Ehehe…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: Oh, no! I forgot!
et: Oh ei! Ma unustasin!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: I was supposed to go help Dad catch some wild POKéMON!
et: Ma pidin ju isale metsikute POKéMONide püüdmisel appi minema!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou
en: {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll catch you later!
et: {PLAYER}{KUN}, näeme hiljem!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady
en: POKéMON fully restored! Items ready, and…
et: POKéMONid täielikult taastatud! Esemed valmis, ja…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Hey! You…
et: Hei! Sina…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Who are you?
et: Kes sa oled?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Oh, you're {PLAYER}, aren't you? Moved in next door, right?
et: Ahaa, sina oled {PLAYER}, eks? Kolisid siia naabermajja, jah?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I didn't know that you're a girl.
et: Ma ei teadnud, et sa oled tüdruk.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Dad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER's kid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.
et: Isa, PROF. BIRCH, ütles, et meie uus naaber on SAALI JUHI laps, nii et ma eeldasin, et oled poiss.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: My name's BRENDAN. So, hi, neighbor!
et: Mu nimi on BRENDAN. Nii et tere, naaber!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Huh? Hey, {PLAYER}, don't you have a POKéMON?
et: Ää? Hei, {PLAYER}, kas sul pole POKéMONi?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Do you want me to go catch you one?
et: Kas tahad, et ma lähen sulle ühe püüan?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Aw, darn, I forgot…
et: Ohh, pagan, ma unustasin…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: I'm supposed to go help my dad catch some wild POKéMON.
et: Ma pean isale metsikute POKéMONide püüdmisel appi minema.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhoAreYou
en: Some other time, okay?
et: Mõni teine kord, olgu?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady
en: POKéMON fully restored… Items all packed, and…
et: POKéMONid täielikult taastatud… Esemed kõik pakitud, ja…

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
en: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL!
et: See on {RIVAL} POKé PALL!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall
en: Better leave it right where it is.
et: Parem jätta see sinnapaika.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
et: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I was just checking my POKéDEX.
et: Ma lihtsalt kontrollisin oma POKéDEXi.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: There's still a lot of POKéMON that I've seen but haven't caught.
et: On veel palju POKéMONe, keda olen näinud, aga pole püüdnud.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: And there are many others that I think will evolve.
et: Ja on veel palju neid, kes minu arvates alles arenevad.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I wonder where I should go catch some POKéMON next?
et: Huvitav, kuhu peaksin järgmisena POKéMONe püüdma minema?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
en: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch some POKéMON next?
et: MAY: Huvitav, kuhu peaksin järgmisena POKéMONe püüdma minema?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNext
en: Wouldn't it be funny if we ran into each other, {PLAYER}{KUN}?
et: Kas poleks naljakas, kui me üksteise otsa satuksime, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}.
et: BRENDAN: Näe, {PLAYER} ise!

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: I was just checking out my POKéDEX.
et: Ma lihtsalt uurisin oma POKéDEXi.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: There are still many POKéMON that I need to catch, I know, but this is looking pretty good.
et: Tean, et püüdmata POKéMONe on veel palju, aga asi näeb päris kena välja.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingMyPokedex
en: Checking this POKéDEX out gives me the urge to hit the road again.
et: Kui ma seda POKéDEXi vaatan, tekib kohe tahtmine uuesti teele asuda.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
en: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding where I should catch POKéMON next.
et: BRENDAN: Mul on raske otsustada, kus järgmisena POKéMONe püüda.

label: RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIGoNext
en: Hey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out catching POKéMON, I can pitch you a battle if you'd like.
et: Hei, {PLAYER}, kui ma sind POKéMONe püüdmas näen, võin sulle lahingu pakkuda, kui tahad.

label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToMakePokeblocks
en: Oh? Did you want to make some {POKEBLOCK}S with this old-timer?
et: Ohoo? Kas tahtsid selle vanataadiga {POKEBLOCK}e teha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_Excellent
en: Excellent!
et: Suurepärane!

label: BerryBlender_Text_MadeOldTimerSad
en: Oh… You've made this old-timer sad…
et: Oh… Nüüd tegid vanataadi kurvaks…

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks
en: Do you know how to make a {POKEBLOCK}?
et: Kas sa tead, kuidas {POKEBLOCK}i tehakse?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Paneme BERRY BLENDERI käima!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: Okay, a little explanation, then.
et: Hea küll, siis väike selgitus.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: Oh, don't worry, it's quite simple.
et: Oh, ära muretse, see on üsna lihtne.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: When the BLENDER's arrow comes to your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDERI nool jõuab su tähiseni, vajuta lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending
en: That's all you have to do. You'll see how easy it is when you try.
et: Rohkem polegi vaja. Proovid korra ja näed ise, kui lihtne see on.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
en: Oh? You don't have any BERRIES?
et: Ohoo? Sul pole ühtki marja?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries
en: If you don't have any BERRIES, you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Ilma marjadeta ei saa {POKEBLOCK}e teha.

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: Well, that won't do at all now, will it?
et: Noh, nii ei lähe ju kuidagi, eks?

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: If you don't mind leftovers, you can have one of my BERRIES.
et: Kui jäägid sind ei häiri, võid ühe minu marja saada.

label: BerryBlender_Text_CanHaveOneOfMyBerries
en: That way, we could make some {POKEBLOCK}S together using the BERRY BLENDER.
et: Nii saaksime BERRY BLENDERIGA koos {POKEBLOCK}e teha.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
en: If I had some BERRIES left over, I'd gladly give you one…
et: Kui mul oleks marju üle, annaksin sulle hea meelega ühe…

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerriesToSpare
en: But, I don't have any to spare today. We'll have to do this another time.
et: Aga täna pole mul ühtki üle. Peame selle teiseks korraks jätma.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
en: But your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.
et: Aga su {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull
en: You should use some {POKEBLOCK}S before you come see me again.
et: Kasuta mõned {POKEBLOCK}id ära, enne kui uuesti minu juurde tuled.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
en: But you don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Aga sul pole {POKEBLOCK} CASE karpi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase
en: You should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then come see me.
et: Hangi endale {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja tule siis minu juurde.

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsGetBlendingAlready
en: Let's get blending already!
et: Hakkame juba segama!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WhatKindOfPokeblockWillIGet
en: I wonder what kind of {POKEBLOCK} I'll get? This is so exciting!
et: Huvitav, millise {POKEBLOCK}i ma saan? See on nii põnev!

label: BerryBlender_Text_WantToBlendPokeblocksWithUs
en: Hi, there! Did you want to blend some {POKEBLOCK}S with us?
et: Tere-tere! Kas tahtsid meiega koos {POKEBLOCK}e segada?

label: BerryBlender_Text_Okay
en: Okay!
et: Olgu!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: That's too bad…
et: Kui kahju…

label: BerryBlender_Text_ThatsTooBad
en: But we'll always be around whenever you get the urge to blend!
et: Aga me oleme alati siin, kui sul tuju segada tuleb!

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks2
en: Of course, you do know how to blend {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?
et: Sa ju tead, kuidas {POKEBLOCK}e segada, eks?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
en: Let's get started, then!
et: Alustame siis!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender2
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Paneme BERRY BLENDERI käima!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: Okay! Let me explain it to you!
et: Olgu! Las ma selgitan sulle!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: When the spinning BLENDER's arrow reaches your marker, just press the A Button.
et: Kui pöörleva BLENDERI nool jõuab su tähiseni, vajuta lihtsalt A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending2
en: That's all it takes. Pretty easy, don't you think?
et: Rohkem polegi vaja. Päris lihtne, kas pole?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… You don't have any BERRIES.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks… Sul pole ühtki marja.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: You can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S without BERRIES…
et: Ilma marjadeta ei saa {POKEBLOCK}e teha…

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries2
en: We'll always be around whenever you get hold of some BERRIES to blend.
et: Me oleme alati siin, kui sul õnnestub segamiseks marju hankida.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks… Su {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull2
en: You should use some {POKEBLOCK}S and then come back.
et: Kasuta mõned {POKEBLOCK}id ära ja tule siis tagasi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
en: Oh, but wait a second here… You don't have a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Oh, aga oota korraks… Sul pole {POKEBLOCK} CASE karpi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase2
en: You should get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE and then come back.
et: Hangi endale {POKEBLOCK} CASE ja tule siis tagasi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_MakePokeblocksWithOurGroup
en: Oh, hello! Did you want to make some {POKEBLOCK}S with our little group?
et: Oh, tere! Kas tahtsid meie väikese seltskonnaga {POKEBLOCK}e teha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_OhDear
en: Oh, dear!
et: Oh, heldeke!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
en: Oh, dear me…
et: Oh, heldeke…

label: BerryBlender_Text_LeftUsInShock
en: You've left us in shock!
et: Sa lausa jahmatasid meid!

label: BerryBlender_Text_KnowHowToMakePokeblocks3
en: Naturally, you know how to make {POKEBLOCK}S, don't you?
et: Sa ju loomulikult tead, kuidas {POKEBLOCK}e teha?

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
en: Okay, dear! Let's get started!
et: Olgu, kallike! Alustame!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LetsBerryBlender3
en: Let's BERRY BLENDER!
et: Paneme BERRY BLENDERI käima!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: Oh, dear!
et: Oh, heldeke!

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: Then, I'll explain it to you nicely.
et: Küll ma sulle siis kenasti ära seletan.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: When the BLENDER's arrow spins to your marker, press the A Button.
et: Kui BLENDERI nool jõuab keereldes su tähiseni, vajuta A-nuppu.

label: BerryBlender_Text_ExplainBerryBlending3
en: That's all it takes. Isn't it simple?
et: Rohkem polegi vaja. Kas pole lihtne?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: You don't have any BERRIES, do you?
et: Sul pole ühtki marja, ega ju?

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: If you don't have any BERRIES, you can't make any {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Ilma marjadeta ei saa {POKEBLOCK}e teha.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHaveAnyBerries3
en: We'll always be making {POKEBLOCK}S here, so let's make some together when you get a BERRY or two.
et: Me teeme siin alati {POKEBLOCK}e, nii et tule koos tegema, kui sul mõni mari on.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull3
en: Your {POKEBLOCK} CASE is full, it looks like.
et: Näib, et su {POKEBLOCK} CASE on täis.

label: BerryBlender_Text_PokeblockCaseIsFull3
en: You should use some {POKEBLOCK}S up and then come back.
et: Kasuta mõned {POKEBLOCK}id ära ja tule siis tagasi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase3
en: You haven't gotten a {POKEBLOCK} CASE yet, it looks like.
et: Näib, et sul pole veel {POKEBLOCK} CASE karpi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_DontHavePokeblockCase3
en: You need to get a {POKEBLOCK} CASE before you come back.
et: Enne tagasitulekut pead hankima {POKEBLOCK} CASE karbi.

label: BerryBlender_Text_SetNewBlenderRecord
en: Okay! Today's going to be the day that I set a new BLENDER speed record!
et: Olgu! Täna on see päev, mil ma püstitan uue BLENDERI kiirusrekordi!

label: BerryBlender_Text_LookGoodAtBlendingJoinUs
en: Oh, dear! You look as if you're good at blending. Would you like to join us?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: A POKéMON CONTEST involves four TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each in competitive judging.
et: POKéMON VÕISTLUSEL panevad neli TRAINERIT igaüks ühe POKéMONi võistlushindamisele.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: A CONTEST has two stages of judging, primary and secondary.
et: VÕISTLUSEL on kaks hindamisvooru: esimene ja teine.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Primary judging is a popularity poll involving the audience.
et: Esimene voor on publiku seas läbiviidav populaarsushääletus.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Secondary judging features appeals by the POKéMON using their moves.
et: Teises voorus säravad POKéMONid oma võtetega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: Plan appeals carefully to earn the most attention of the JUDGE and excite the audience. Do your best to stand out.
et: Kavanda sära hoolikalt, et püüda KOHTUNIKU tähelepanu ja panna publik elevile. Anna endast parim, et silma paista.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: The primary and secondary scores are added at the end.
et: Lõpuks liidetakse esimese ja teise vooru punktid kokku.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContests
en: The POKéMON garnering the highest score is declared the winner.
et: Võitjaks kuulutatakse kõige rohkem punkte kogunud POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
en: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.
et: VÕISTLUSI on viit liiki.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes
en: COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and TOUGH are the five categories.
et: Need viis kategooriat on LAHE, ILU, ARMAS, TARK ja KÕVA.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestTypes

et: Vali VÕISTLUS, mis sobib POKéMONile, keda kavatsed välja panna.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks

et: POKéMON VÕISTLUSTEL on neli järku.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks

et: Need neli järku on TAVA-, SUPER-, HÜPER- ja MEISTRIJÄRK.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks

et: TAVAJÄRGUS võib osaleda iga POKéMON.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank in the same category.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks
en: In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner can move up to the HYPER Rank, and a HYPER Rank winner can advance to the MASTER Rank in the same category.
et: Samamoodi pääseb SUPERJÄRGU võitja HÜPERJÄRKU ja HÜPERJÄRGU võitja samas kategoorias MEISTRIJÄRKU.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainContestRanks

en: Your POKéMON will be entered in the CONTEST.
et: Su POKéMON pannakse VÕISTLUSELE.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourMonIsEntryNumX
en: Your POKéMON is Entry No. {STR_VAR_2}.
et: Su POKéMON on osaleja nr {STR_VAR_2}.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestBeginShortly
en: The CONTEST will begin shortly.
et: VÕISTLUS algab kohe.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LinkContestReception
en: Welcome! This is the POKéMON CONTEST link reception counter.
et: Tere tulemast! See on POKéMON VÕISTLUSTE ühenduse vastuvõtulett.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LinkContestReception
en: You may enter CONTESTS together with one or more friends.
et: VÕISTLUSTELE võid astuda koos ühe või mitme sõbraga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichTopic2
en: Which topic would you like?
et: Mis teema sind huvitab?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterContest3
en: Would you like to enter a CONTEST?
et: Kas soovid VÕISTLUSELE astuda?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichContest3
en: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?
et: Millisele VÕISTLUSELE soovid astuda?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MonInNoCondition2
en: Your POKéMON appears to be in no condition to take part in a CONTEST…
et: Näib, et su POKéMON pole VÕISTLUSEKS vormis…

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EggCannotTakePart2
en: I'm sorry, but an EGG cannot take part in a POKéMON CONTEST.
et: Vabandust, aga MUNA ei saa POKéMON VÕISTLUSEL osaleda.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_EnterWhichPokemon3
en: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?
et: Millise POKéMONi soovid välja panna?

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDecideLinkLeader
en: Please decide which of you will become the GROUP LEADER.
et: Palun otsustage, kes teist saab GRUPI JUHIKS.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PleaseDecideLinkLeader
en: The other players must then choose “JOIN GROUP.”
et: Teised mängijad peavad seejärel valima „LIITU GRUPIGA”.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayerAt4PCounterUseGMode
en: At least one player has entered using the 4-player reception counter.
et: Vähemalt üks mängija registreerus nelja mängija vastuvõtuleti kaudu.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayerAt4PCounterUseGMode
en: There must be four players connected using a GBA Game Link cable.
et: Neli mängijat peavad olema ühendatud GBA Game Link kaabliga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_PlayerAt4PCounterUseGMode
en: When the four players are ready, select G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE), then register to enter again, please.
et: Kui neli mängijat on valmis, valige G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) ja seejärel registreeruge uuesti.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: This is a CONTEST for two to four players linked using a Wireless Adapter or a GBA Game Link cable.
et: See on VÕISTLUS kahele kuni neljale mängijale, kes on ühendatud Wireless Adapteri või GBA Game Link kaabliga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: Participants are first asked to choose the mode they wish to enter.
et: Kõigepealt palutakse osalejatel valida režiim, milles nad mängida soovivad.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: There are two different modes.
et: Režiime on kaks.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) is for two to four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.
et: E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) on kahele kuni neljale mängijale, kellest igaühel on POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is only for four players, each with a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) on ainult neljale mängijale, kellest igaühel on POKéMON Emerald, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: The players should discuss which mode they want, then choose the same mode.
et: Mängijad peaksid omavahel kokku leppima ja valima siis kõik sama režiimi.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: Once all the players have chosen the same CONTEST in the same mode, the entry registration is complete.
et: Kui kõik mängijad on samas režiimis valinud sama VÕISTLUSE, on registreerimine tehtud.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainLinkContest
en: After that, a CONTEST will start in the usual manner.
et: Seejärel algab VÕISTLUS nagu tavaliselt.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: In E-MODE (EMERALD MODE), a LINK CONTEST can be held with two to four players. Each player must have a POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.
et: Režiimis E-MODE (EMERALD MODE) saab pidada ühendatud VÕISTLUSE kahe kuni nelja mängijaga. Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Emerald Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: The players must be linked with each other using Wireless Adapters or GBA Game Link cables.
et: Mängijad peavad olema omavahel ühendatud Wireless Adapterite või GBA Game Link kaablitega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: If there are fewer than four players, TRAINERS in the hall will join to fill the 4-player CONTEST lineup.
et: Kui mängijaid on vähem kui neli, astuvad saalis olevad TRAINERID appi, et nelja võistlejaga koosseis täis saada.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEMode
en: Please be aware that E-MODE is not available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.
et: Pane tähele, et mängudes POKéMON Ruby ja Sapphire E-MODE ei tööta.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) is specifically for four players who are linked using GBA Game Link cables.
et: G-MODE (GLOBAL MODE) on mõeldud just neljale mängijale, kes on ühendatud GBA Game Link kaablitega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: Each player must have a POKéMON Emerald, Ruby, or Sapphire Game Pak.
et: Igal mängijal peab olema POKéMON Emerald, Ruby või Sapphire Game Pak.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGMode
en: The CONTEST starts after all players choose G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) or enter through the 4-player reception counter (POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire).
et: VÕISTLUS algab siis, kui kõik mängijad on valinud G-MODE (POKéMON Emerald) või registreerunud nelja mängija vastuvõtuleti kaudu (POKéMON Ruby või Sapphire).

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode
en: I'm terribly sorry.
et: Mul on väga kahju.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode
en: G-MODE does not function with Wireless Adapters.
et: G-MODE ei tööta Wireless Adapteritega.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_NoWirelessAdapterInGMode
en: Please select E-MODE or try again using a GBA Game Link cable.
et: Palun vali E-MODE või proovi uuesti GBA Game Link kaabliga.

label: LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WhichContestMode
en: Which CONTEST MODE would you like to enter?
et: Millise VÕISTLUSREŽIIMI sa valid?

label: ContestHall_Text_GettingStartedWireless
en: MC: Hello! We're just getting started with a 4-player linked POKéMON {STR_VAR_2}!
et: MC: Tere! Kohe algab nelja mängija ühendatud POKéMON {STR_VAR_2}!

label: ContestHall_Text_ParticipantsAsFollows
en: The participating TRAINERS and their POKéMON are as follows:
et: Osalevad TRAINERID ja nende POKéMONid on järgmised:

label: ContestHall_Text_WeveSeenContestants
en: MC: We've just seen the four POKéMON contestants.
et: MC: Nägime just kõiki nelja POKéMONi võistlejat.

label: ContestHall_Text_WeveSeenContestants
en: Now it's time for primary judging!
et: Nüüd on aeg esimeseks hindamisvooruks!

label: ContestHall_Text_AudienceWillVote
en: The audience will vote on their favorite POKéMON contestants.
et: Publik hääletab oma lemmik-POKéMONide poolt.

label: ContestHall_Text_LetVotingBegin
en: Without any further ado, let the voting begin!
et: Ilma pikema jututa — hääletus algagu!

label: ContestHall_Text_VotingComplete
en: Voting is now complete!
et: Hääletus on lõppenud!

label: ContestHall_Text_VotingComplete
en: While the votes are being tallied, let's move on to secondary judging!
et: Kuni hääli kokku loetakse, asume teise hindamisvooru juurde!

label: ContestHall_Text_SecondStageOfJudging
en: The second stage of judging is the much-anticipated appeal time!
et: Hindamise teine voor on see kauaoodatud sära aeg!

label: ContestHall_Text_SecondStageOfJudging
en: May the contestants amaze us with superb appeals of dazzling moves!
et: Hämmastagu võistlejad meid pimestavate võtete ja suurepärase säraga!

label: ContestHall_Text_LetsAppeal
en: Let's see a little enthusiasm! Let's appeal!
et: Näidakem veidi hoogu! Nüüd särama!

label: Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseMon
en: I'm the DAY-CARE MAN.
et: Ma olen PÄEVAHOIU MEES.

label: Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseMon
en: I help take care of the precious POKéMON of TRAINERS.
et: Ma aitan hoolitseda TRAINERITE kallite POKéMONide eest.

label: Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaiseMon
en: If you'd like me to raise your POKéMON, have a word with my wife.
et: Kui tahad, et ma su POKéMONi kasvataksin, räägi mu naisega.

label: Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg
en: Ah, it's you!
et: Ah, see oled sina!

label: Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg
en: We were raising your POKéMON, and my goodness, were we surprised!
et: Me kasvatasime su POKéMONi ja issand, kuidas me üllatusime!

label: Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg
en: Your POKéMON had an EGG!
et: Su POKéMONil oli MUNA!

label: Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg
en: We don't know how it got there, but your POKéMON had it.
et: Me ei tea, kust see tuli, aga su POKéMONil see oli.

label: Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg
en: You do want it, yes?
et: Sa ju tahad seda, eks?

label: Route117_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine
en: Ah, it's you! Good to see you. Your {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.
et: Ah, see oled sina! Rõõm näha. Su {STR_VAR_1} tunneb end hästi.

label: Route117_Text_IllKeepIt
en: Well then, I'll keep it. Thanks!
et: No siis jätan ma selle endale. Aitäh!

label: Route117_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt
en: You have no room for it… Come back when you've made room.
et: Sul pole selle jaoks ruumi… Tule tagasi, kui oled ruumi teinud.

label: Route117_Text_ReceivedEgg
en: {PLAYER} received the EGG from the DAY-CARE MAN.
et: {PLAYER} sai PÄEVAHOIU MEHELT MUNA.

label: Route117_Text_TakeGoodCareOfIt
en: Take good care of it.
et: Hoolitse selle eest hästi.

label: Route117_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersMon
en: By the way, about your {STR_VAR_1}, it seemed to be friendly with {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}.
et: Muide, su {STR_VAR_1} näis sõbrunevat {STR_VAR_2} POKéMONiga {STR_VAR_3}.

label: Route117_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersMon
en: I may even have seen it receiving a piece of MAIL.
et: Ma võisin isegi näha, kuidas ta MAILi vastu võttis.

label: Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMon
en: If you want to pick up your POKéMON, have a word with my wife.
et: Kui tahad oma POKéMONi ära tuua, räägi mu naisega.

label: Route117_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine
en: Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and {STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.
et: Ah, see oled sina! Su {STR_VAR_1} ja {STR_VAR_2} tunnevad end hästi.

label: Route117_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt
en: I really will keep it. You do want this, yes?
et: Ma jätan selle tõesti endale. Sa ju tahad seda, eks?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseAMon
en: I'm the DAY-CARE LADY.
et: Ma olen PÄEVAHOIU PROUA.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseAMon
en: We can raise POKéMON for you.
et: Me võime sinu eest POKéMONe kasvatada.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WouldYouLikeUsToRaiseAMon
en: Would you like us to raise one?
et: Kas sooviksid, et üht kasvataksime?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhichMonShouldWeRaise
en: Which POKéMON should we raise for you?
et: Millist POKéMONi me sinu jaoks kasvatama peaksime?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon
en: Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1} for a while.
et: Hea küll, me kasvatame su {STR_VAR_1} mõnda aega.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WellRaiseYourMon
en: Come back for it later.
et: Tule sellele hiljem järele.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WeCanRaiseOneMore
en: We can raise two of your POKéMON. Would you like us to raise one more?
et: Me võime kasvatada kahte su POKéMONi. Kas soovid, et kasvataksime veel üht?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HusbandWasLookingForYou
en: My husband was looking for you.
et: Mu mees otsis sind taga.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_FineThenComeAgain
en: Oh, fine, then. Come again.
et: Oh, hea küll siis. Tule jälle.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have enough money…
et: Sul pole piisavalt raha…

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeOtherOneBackToo
en: Will you take back the other one, too?
et: Kas võtad ka teise tagasi?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeAgain
en: Fine. Come again.
et: Hea küll. Tule jälle.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYou
en: Ah, it's you! Good to see you. Your POKéMON can only be doing good!
et: Ah, see oled sina! Rõõm näha. Su POKéMONil läheb lausa hästi!

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YourMonHasGrownXLevels
en: By level, your {STR_VAR_1} has grown by {STR_VAR_2}.
et: Su {STR_VAR_1} on kasvanud {STR_VAR_2} taseme võrra.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YourTeamIsFull
en: Your POKéMON team is full. Make room, then come see me.
et: Su POKéMONide meeskond on täis. Tee ruumi ja tule siis minu juurde.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeBackWhichMon
en: Which POKéMON will you take back?
et: Millise POKéMONi sa tagasi võtad?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_ItWillCostX
en: If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back, it will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.
et: Kui tahad oma {STR_VAR_1} tagasi, maksab see ¥{STR_VAR_2}.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HeresYourMon
en: Perfect! Here's your POKéMON.
et: Suurepärane! Siin on su POKéMON.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TookBackMon
en: {PLAYER} took back {STR_VAR_1} from the DAY-CARE LADY.
et: {PLAYER} võttis PÄEVAHOIU PROUALT {STR_VAR_1} tagasi.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
en: Oh? But you have just one POKéMON.
et: Oh? Aga sul on ainult üks POKéMON.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouHaveJustOneMon
en: Come back another time.
et: Tule mõni teine kord.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeYourMonBack
en: Will you take your POKéMON back?
et: Kas võtad oma POKéMONi tagasi?

en: If you leave me that POKéMON, what will you battle with?
et: Kui jätad selle POKéMONi mulle, millega sa siis võitled?

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBattleWith
en: Come back another time.
et: Tule mõni teine kord.

et: Huh?

et: Huh? No kuule.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YoullBeLeftWithJustOne
en: If you leave that POKéMON with me, you'll be left with just one.
et: Kui jätad selle POKéMONi minu juurde, jääb sulle vaid üks.

label: Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YoullBeLeftWithJustOne
en: You will be better off if you catch some more, I dare say.
et: Ütlen ausalt — sul oleks parem, kui püüaksid veel mõne.

et: Meri on siin sügav. Kas kasutad võtet DIVE?

label: Text_WantToSurface

label: sText_MysteryGiftAlteringCave
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System.
et: Aitäh, et kasutasid MYSTERY GIFT süsteemi.

label: sText_MysteryGiftAlteringCave
en: There appears to be a rumor about rare POKéMON sightings.
et: Räägitakse kuulujuttu, et kuskil on nähtud haruldasi POKéMONe.

label: sText_MysteryGiftAlteringCave
en: The sightings reportedly came from the ALTERING CAVE on ROUTE 103.
et: Neid olevat nähtud koopas ALTERING CAVE, mis asub ROUTE 103 peal.

label: sText_MysteryGiftAlteringCave
en: Perhaps it would be worthwhile for you to investigate this rumor.
et: Ehk tasuks sul seda kuulujuttu uurida.

label: sText_AuroraTicketForYou
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System.
et: Aitäh, et kasutasid MYSTERY GIFT süsteemi.

label: sText_AuroraTicketForYou
en: You must be {PLAYER}. There is a ticket here for you.
et: Sina oled kindlasti {PLAYER}. Siin on sulle üks pilet.

label: sText_AuroraTicketUseAtPort
en: It appears to be for use at the LILYCOVE CITY port.
et: Paistab, et see on mõeldud kasutamiseks LILYCOVE LINNA sadamas.

label: sText_AuroraTicketUseAtPort
en: Why not give it a try and see what it is about?
et: Miks mitte proovida ja vaadata, millega tegu?

label: sText_AuroraTicketThankYou
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System.
et: Aitäh, et kasutasid MYSTERY GIFT süsteemi.

label: sText_AuroraTicketBagFull
en: Oh, I'm sorry, {PLAYER}. Your BAG's KEY ITEMS POCKET is full.
et: Oh, vabandust, {PLAYER}. Su KOTI TÄHTSATE ESEMETE tasku on täis.

label: sText_AuroraTicketBagFull
en: Please store something on your PC, then come back for this.
et: Pane midagi ARVUTISSE hoiule ja tule siis sellele järele.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System.
et: Aitäh, et kasutasid MYSTERY GIFT süsteemi.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en: Your BATTLE COUNT CARD keeps track of your battle record against TRAINERS with the same CARD.
et: Su BATTLE COUNT CARD peab arvet lahingute üle, mida pead sama kaardiga TRAINERITE vastu.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en: Look for and battle TRAINERS who have the same CARD as you.
et: Otsi üles TRAINERID, kellel on sinuga sama kaart, ja võitle nendega.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en: You may check the overall rankings by reading the NEWS.
et: Üldist edetabelit saad vaadata UUDISTEST.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard
en: Please do give it a try!
et: Palun proovi kindlasti!

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard_WonPrize
en: Thank you for using the MYSTERY GIFT System.
et: Aitäh, et kasutasid MYSTERY GIFT süsteemi.

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard_WonPrize
en: Congratulations!
et: Palju õnne!

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard_WonPrize
en: You have won a prize for winning three battles!
et: Kolme lahingu võitmise eest oled teeninud auhinna!

label: sText_MysteryGiftBattleCountCard_WonPrize

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: Hello there, TRAINER! You've got a wonderful smile, there.
et: Tervist, TRAINER! Sul on imeline naeratus.

label: ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles
en: I have a hobby--collecting the profiles of POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Mul on hobi – koguda POKéMON TRAINERITE profiile.

label: ProfileMan_Text_MayISeeYourProfile
en: So, how about it? May I see your profile?
et: Noh, kuidas oleks? Kas tohin sinu profiili näha?

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You make your own profile by putting together four words or phrases.
et: Oma profiili paned kokku neljast sõnast või väljendist.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Here, I'll show you an example of a profile using four pieces of text.
et: Vaata, ma näitan sulle näidisprofiili neljast tekstitükist.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: You can switch those four pieces with other text pieces any which way you like to make your own profile.
et: Neid nelja tükki võid vahetada teiste vastu just nii, nagu ise soovid, ja nii sünnibki sinu oma profiil.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: There are a lot of text pieces that you can use.
et: Tekstitükke, mida kasutada saad, on palju.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: They are arranged in groups like POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so it is easier to look them up.
et: Need on jaotatud rühmadesse – POKéMONid, eluviisid, hobid –, nii on neid lihtsam üles leida.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: So, first, choose the group of text pieces to display a list of choices.
et: Kõigepealt vali tekstitükkide rühm, siis kuvatakse valikute nimekiri.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Then, pick the choice you want.
et: Seejärel vali see, mida soovid.

label: ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation
en: Repeat for the remaining text choices, and you'll have your very own profile.
et: Korda sama ülejäänud tükkidega ja sul ongi oma isiklik profiil.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LetsSeeItThen
en: Yes! Thank you! So, let's see it, then.
et: Jaa! Aitäh! Lase siis näha.

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile

et: Oi ei, tõesti?

label: ProfileMan_Text_ImagineYouWouldHaveWonderfulProfile

et: Kujutan ette, et sinusugusel on imeline profiil…

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow

label: ProfileMan_Text_NotIntoItRightNow

et: Noh, mulle sobib iga aeg!

et: Jah! Aitäh!

et: Loodan, et see on veel parem kui see, mida sa mulle eelmine kord näitasid.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs

et: Ahsoo, sulle meeldib su profiil just selline, nagu see on.

label: ProfileMan_Text_LikeProfileWayItIs

et: F-fantastiline!

label: ProfileMan_Text_FantasticProfile

et: Sul pole eset COIN CASE.

label: Roulette_Text_CoinCaseIsFull
en: Your COIN CASE is full! Coins can be exchanged for prizes.
et: Su COIN CASE on täis! Münte saab auhindade vastu vahetada.

label: SafariZone_Text_WouldYouLikeToExit
en: Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE right now?
et: Kas soovid SAFARI ZONE alalt kohe lahkuda?

label: SafariZone_Text_TimesUp
en: Ding-dong! Time's up! Your SAFARI Game is over.
et: Ding-dong! Aeg sai täis! Sinu SAFARI Mäng on lõppenud.

label: SafariZone_Text_OutOfBalls
en: You've run out of SAFARI BALLS. Your SAFARI Game is over.
et: Su SAFARI PALLID said otsa. Sinu SAFARI Mäng on lõppenud.

label: SafariZone_Text_PlacePokeblockOnFeeder
en: Would you like to place a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER?
et: Kas paned {POKEBLOCK}i {POKEBLOCK} SÖÖTJALE?

label: SafariZone_Text_PokeblockStillHere
en: The {STR_VAR_1} you left before is still here.
et: {STR_VAR_1}, mille sa enne jätsid, on ikka veel siin.

label: SafariZone_Text_PokeblockWasPlaced
en: The {STR_VAR_1} was placed on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER.
et: {STR_VAR_1} asetati {POKEBLOCK} SÖÖTJALE.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE alale!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Here, you may witness many kinds of POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.
et: Siin näed paljusid POKéMONe, keda mujal HOENNIS harva kohtab.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: And, you'll see them in their wild, untamed state in natural habitats.
et: Ja sa näed neid täiesti metsikuna, nende looduslikus elupaigas.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: What's more, we've thrown open the gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.
et: Ja veel: meie väravad on POKéMON TRAINERITELE pärani lahti.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: You're encouraged to catch POKéMON for keeps!
et: Ja püütud POKéMONid võid kõik endale jätta!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeToSafariZone
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE ala!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WelcomeFirstTime
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! Is it your first time here?
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE alale! Kas oled esimest korda siin?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInAndEnjoy
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE ala!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you start with 30 SAFARI BALLS for catching POKéMON.
et: Kui SAFARI ZONE alale astud, saad POKéMONide püüdmiseks 30 SAFARI PALLI.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: The SAFARI Game is over when you run out of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've walked 500 steps.
et: SAFARI Mäng lõpeb, kui su SAFARI PALLID otsa saavad või kui oled kõndinud 500 sammu.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTimeInfo
en: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tule sisse ja naudi SAFARI ZONE ala!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
et: Tere tulemast SAFARI ZONE alale!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYouLikeToPlay
en: All you can catch for just ¥500! Would you like to play a SAFARI Game?
et: Püüa nii palju, kui jaksad, kõigest ¥500 eest! Kas soovid SAFARI Mängu mängida?

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PlayAnotherTime
en: Okay. Please play another time!
et: Olgu. Tule mõni teine kord mängima!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnoughMoney
en: You don't have enough money. Sorry.
et: Sul pole piisavalt raha. Vabandust.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ThatWillBe500Please
en: That will be ¥500, please.
et: See teeb ¥500, palun.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_HereAreYourSafariBalls
en: Here are your SAFARI BALLS.
et: Siin on su SAFARI PALLID.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Received30SafariBalls
en: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS.
et: {PLAYER} sai 30 SAFARI PALLI.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: We'll let you know when your game is over.
et: Anname teada, kui mäng läbi saab.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseEnjoyYourself
en: So, until then, enjoy yourself, please! Off you go on your wild excursion!
et: Seniks aga naudi täiega! Head metsikut retke sulle!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFull
en: Excuse me! Your PC BOX is full.
et: Vabandust! Sinu ARVUTI BOX on täis.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Excuse me! You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Vabandust! Näib, et sul pole eset {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Your SAFARI Game will be much more fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.
et: Sinu SAFARI Mäng tuleb palju saagikam, kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}e.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: Please come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.
et: Tule palun tagasi, kui sul on {POKEBLOCK} CASE olemas.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeedPokeblockCase
en: You may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.
et: {POKEBLOCK} CASE saab kätte LILYCOVE VÕISTLUSSAALIST.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_StillHaveTimeExit
en: You still have time left. Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE now?
et: Sul on veel aega. Kas soovid SAFARI ZONE alalt juba lahkuda?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_EnjoyTheRestOfYourAdventure
en: Please enjoy the rest of your wild adventure!
et: Naudi oma metsikut seiklust edasi!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Okay.
et: Olgu.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: I'll take back your remaining SAFARI BALLS.
et: Ma võtan su ülejäänud SAFARI PALLID tagasi.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_ExitEarlyThankYouForPlaying
en: Thank you for playing. We hope to see you again.
et: Aitäh mängimast. Loodame sind jälle näha.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: Good luck!
et: Edu!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_GoodLuck
en: If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me, please!
et: Kui midagi vajad, ütle julgelt!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: Did you know?
et: Kas teadsid?

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Boy
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} in that square box, POKéMON gather around.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK}i sellesse nelinurksesse kasti, kogunevad POKéMONid selle juurde.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: I want to keep going deeper, but I forgot to bring a BIKE.
et: Ma tahaksin veel sügavamale minna, aga unustasin JALGRATTA kaasa võtta.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Man
en: Something tells me that rare POKéMON live in the outlying areas.
et: Mul on tunne, et äärealadel elavad haruldased POKéMONid.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Sometimes, when I toss a {POKEBLOCK} at POKéMON, it gets ignored.
et: Vahel, kui ma POKéMONidele {POKEBLOCK}i viskan, ei tee nad sellest väljagi.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_Woman
en: Do POKéMON have likes and dislikes about what they eat?
et: Kas POKéMONidel on toidu osas omad maitse-eelistused?

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: Gasp… Gasp… I…made it out here…but…
et: Ähh… Ähh… Ma…jõudsin siia välja…aga…

label: SafariZone_Northwest_Text_Man
en: I'm exhausted… I don't have the energy to catch POKéMON…
et: Ma olen läbi… Mul pole enam jõudu POKéMONe püüda…

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON you don't see in HOENN.
et: Mul on missioon: leida VEE-POKéMONe, keda mujal HOENNIS ei kohta.

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Fisherman
en: Do you have any idea where the lake is?
et: Kas sul on aimu, kus järv on?

label: SafariZone_North_Text_Man
en: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON here and trade them with my friends!
et: Ma püüan siin hulga haruldasi POKéMONe ja vahetan need sõpradega ära!

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I put a {POKEBLOCK} on the {POKEBLOCK} FEEDER. But it seems to have disappeared.
et: Panin {POKEBLOCK}i {POKEBLOCK} SÖÖTJALE. Aga nüüd näib see kadunud olevat.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_Youngster
en: I guess POKéMON must have eaten it without me noticing.
et: Vist sõid POKéMONid selle ära, ilma et ma oleksin märganud.

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!
et: SAFARI ZONE TRAINERI NÕUANNE!

label: Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_TrainerTip
en: Throw {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make them less likely to flee.
et: Viska metsikutele POKéMONidele {POKEBLOCK}e – siis põgenevad nad harvemini.

label: SafariZone_Southwest_Text_RestHouseSign
en: “Relieve your tired feet.” REST HOUSE
et: „Anna oma väsinud jalgadele puhkust.” PUHKEMAJA

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: I don't have any {POKEBLOCK}S, but I caught a good number of POKéMON.
et: Mul pole ühtki {POKEBLOCK}i, aga ma püüdsin korraliku hulga POKéMONe.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_Youngster
en: You can improve your chances of making a catch by getting closer to them before throwing a SAFARI BALL.
et: Püügišansse saab parandada, kui minna neile enne SAFARI PALLI viskamist lähemale.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: If you use {POKEBLOCK}S, wild POKéMON won't be so quick to run away.
et: Kui kasutad {POKEBLOCK}e, ei põgene metsikud POKéMONid nii kärmelt.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_PsychicM
en: It's not much use to give {POKEBLOCK}S to POKéMON that don't flee easily.
et: Neile POKéMONidele, kes niikuinii kergelt ei põgene, pole {POKEBLOCK}e mõtet anda.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: If you put a {POKEBLOCK} on the FEEDER, POKéMON are attracted to it.
et: Kui paned {POKEBLOCK}i SÖÖTJALE, tõmbab see POKéMONe ligi.

label: SafariZone_RestHouse_Text_FatMan
en: I think POKéMON with the same sort of nature are drawn by a certain {POKEBLOCK}.
et: Ma arvan, et teatud {POKEBLOCK} tõmbab ligi just ühesuguse loomusega POKéMONe.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits1
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See ala on veel ehitusjärgus. Sisse ei saa, vabandust!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: The SAFARI ZONE's expansion project is finished now.
et: SAFARI ZONE laiendus on nüüd valmis.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_ExpansionIsFinished
en: We hope you will enjoy the new area.
et: Loodame, et uus ala sulle meeldib.

label: SafariZone_South_Text_AreaOffLimits2
en: This area is still under construction. It's off-limits, sorry!
et: See ala on veel ehitusjärgus. Sisse ei saa, vabandust!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_LittleGirl
en: Wow! Whee! I haven't seen any of these POKéMON before!
et: Ohoo! Jiihaa! Ma pole ühtegi sellist POKéMONi varem näinud!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: The POKéMON in this area are all new to me.
et: Selle ala POKéMONid on mulle kõik uued.

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_FatMan
en: And I'm allowed to catch these rare POKéMON! Too cool!
et: Ja neid haruldasi POKéMONe tohib veel püüda ka! Ülilahe!

label: SafariZone_Southeast_Text_RichBoy
en: The POKéMON around here seem to be from somewhere other than HOENN.
et: Näib, et siinsed POKéMONid on pärit kuskilt mujalt kui HOENNIST.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I only have a couple SAFARI BALLS left.
et: Mul on jäänud vaid paar SAFARI PALLI.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Boy
en: I'm having a hard time trying to decide what I should catch.
et: Mul on raske otsustada, keda püüda.

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Woman
en: I heard that you can see PIKACHU here. Where might one be?
et: Ma kuulsin, et siin võib näha PIKACHUT. Kus ta küll olla võiks?

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: Oh, boo! I can't seem to catch anything!
et: Oh, häda! Ma ei suuda vist midagi püüda!

label: SafariZone_Northeast_Text_Girl
en: I'll end up wasting the admission price if I don't catch something!
et: Kui ma midagi ei püüa, läheb sissepääsutasu lihtsalt raisku!

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeCanBeClimbed
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.
et: Kui mõned väänid alla langevad, saab sellele puule ronida.

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeUseSecretPower
en: If some vines drop down, this tree can be climbed.
et: Kui mõned väänid alla langevad, saab sellele puule ronida.

label: SecretBase_Text_TreeUseSecretPower
en: Use the SECRET POWER?
et: Kasutada SECRET POWERit?

label: SecretBase_Text_VineDroppedDown
en: A thick vine dropped down!
et: Jäme väänd langes alla!

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpOfGrass
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda rohutuusti saaks liigutada, pääseks ehk sisse.

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpUseSecretPower
en: If this clump of grass can be moved, it might be possible to go inside.
et: Kui seda rohutuusti saaks liigutada, pääseks ehk sisse.

label: SecretBase_Text_ClumpUseSecretPower
en: Use the SECRET POWER?
et: Kasutada SECRET POWERit?

label: SecretBase_Text_DiscoveredSmallEntrance
en: Discovered a small entrance!
et: Avastati väike sissepääs!

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: All decorations and furniture in your SECRET BASE will be returned to your PC.
et: Kõik kaunistused ja mööbel sinu SALABAASIS tagastatakse ARVUTISSE.

label: SecretBase_Text_AllDecorationsWillBeReturned
en: Is that okay?
et: Kas sobib?

label: SecretBase_Text_WantToRegisterSecretBase
en: Do you want to register {STR_VAR_1}'s SECRET BASE?
et: Kas tahad registreerida {STR_VAR_1} SALABAASI?

label: SecretBase_Text_AlreadyRegisteredDelete
en: This data is already registered. Would you like to delete it?
et: Need andmed on juba registreeritud. Kas kustutada need?

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Up to 10 locations can be registered.
et: Registreerida saab kuni 10 asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_TooManyBasesDeleteSome
en: Delete a location if you want to register another location.
et: Kui tahad uue asukoha registreerida, kustuta mõni vana.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistrationCompleted
en: Registration completed.
et: Registreerimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_DataUnregistered
en: Data has been unregistered.
et: Andmed on registrist eemaldatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_BootUpPC
en: {PLAYER} booted up the PC.
et: {PLAYER} käivitas ARVUTI.

label: SecretBase_Text_WhatWouldYouLikeToDo
en: What would you like to do?
et: Mida soovid teha?

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Once registered, a SECRET BASE will not disappear unless the other TRAINER moves it to a different location.
et: Registreeritud SALABAAS ei kao kuhugi, kui teine TRAINER seda mujale ei koli.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: If a SECRET BASE is deleted from the registered list, another one may take its place.
et: Kui SALABAAS registrist kustutada, võib selle koha üle võtta mõni teine.

label: SecretBase_Text_RegistryInfo
en: Up to ten SECRET BASE locations may be registered.
et: Registreerida saab kuni kümme SALABAASI asukohta.

label: SecretBase_Text_BattleTowerShield
en: A shield of {STR_VAR_2} that marks winning {STR_VAR_1} times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.
et: {STR_VAR_2} kilp, mis tähistab {STR_VAR_1} järjestikust võitu BATTLE TOWERis.

label: SecretBase_Text_ToyTV
en: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily mistaken for the real thing.
et: Realistlik mänguteler. Selle võib kergesti pärisasjaga segi ajada.

label: SecretBase_Text_SeedotTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT. It looks ready to roll away on its own…
et: SEEDOTi kujuline mänguteler. Näib, nagu hakkaks kohe ise minema veerema…

label: SecretBase_Text_SkittyTV
en: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY. It looks ready to stroll away…
et: SKITTY kujuline mänguteler. Näib, nagu hakkaks kohe ise minema jalutama…

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: You may only make one SECRET BASE.
et: Sa võid teha ainult ühe SALABAASI.

label: SecretBase_Text_WouldYouLikeToMoveBases
en: Would you like to move from the SECRET BASE near {STR_VAR_1}?
et: Kas kolida ära SALABAASIST, mis on {STR_VAR_1} lähedal?

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Moving completed.
et: Kolimine lõpetatud.

label: SecretBase_Text_MovingCompletedUseSecretPower
en: Would you like to use the SECRET POWER?
et: Kas kasutad SECRET POWERit?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: What's that? What am I doing?
et: Mis? Mida ma teen?

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I'm thinking about making my own room here using a POKéMON move.
et: Ma mõtlen, et teeks siia POKéMONi võttega oma toa.

label: Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourOwn
en: I know! I'll give you this TM. Will you use it to make your own room?
et: Tead mis! Ma annan sulle selle TM-võtte. Kas teed sellega endale oma toa?

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Find a big tree that looks like it might drop some vines.
et: Otsi suur puu, mille küljest võiks väänd alla langeda.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Use SECRET POWER in front of the tree. Some vines should get free and drop down, so you can climb the tree.
et: Kasuta puu ees SECRET POWERit. Mõned väänid peaksid vabanema ja alla langema, nii saad puu otsa ronida.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You'll find a lot of space for putting your favorite things.
et: Sealt leiad hulga ruumi oma lemmikasjade jaoks.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: It'll be your own secret room… A SECRET BASE!
et: See on sinu enda salatuba… SALABAAS!

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: You should make one, too.
et: Tee sinagi endale üks!

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Another thing, you don't always have to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.
et: Ja veel: SALABAASI ei pea tingimata puu sisse tegema.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: Try using SECRET POWER on rock walls that have small indents in them.
et: Proovi SECRET POWERit kaljuseintel, kus on väikesed süvendid.

label: Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower
en: I'm going to look for other places, too. Okay, bye!
et: Ma lähen otsin veel kohti. Olgu, nägemist!

label: Route111_Text_DontWantThis
en: Oh, you don't want this? If you change your mind, tell me, okay?
et: Oh, sa ei taha seda? Kui meelt muudad, ütle mulle, eks?

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: Oh, you don't have any room for this.
et: Oh, sul pole selle jaoks ruumi.

label: Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom
en: I'll hold on to it, so come back for it another time, okay?
et: Ma hoian selle alles, tule mõni teine kord järele, eks?

label: SecretBase_Text_SmallIndentInWall
en: There's a small indent in the wall.
et: Seinas on väike süvend.

label: SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower
en: There's a small indent in the wall.
et: Seinas on väike süvend.

label: SecretBase_Text_IndentUseSecretPower
en: Use the SECRET POWER?
et: Kasutada SECRET POWERit?

label: SecretBase_Text_DiscoveredSmallCavern
en: Discovered a small cavern!
et: Avastati väike koobas!

label: SecretBase_Text_WantToMakeYourSecretBaseHere
en: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?
et: Kas teha oma SALABAAS siia?

label: Text_ThisIsATestSignpostMsg
en: This is a test message. This is a signpost.
et: See on testsõnum. See on teeviit.

label: gText_PokemartSign
en: “Selected items for your convenience!” POKéMON MART
et: “Valitud kaubad teie mugavuseks!” POKéPOOD

label: gText_PokemonCenterSign
en: “Rejuvenate your tired partners!” POKéMON CENTER
et: “Värskenda oma väsinud kaaslasi!” POKéKESKUS

en: {STR_VAR_1} might like this program. … … … … … … … … … … … … … … … …
et: See saade võiks {STR_VAR_1} meele järgi olla.

label: gText_MomOrDadMightLikeThisProgram
en: Better get going!
et: Parem asun teele!

en: Welcome to LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.
et: Tere tulemast kaubamajja LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE.

label: gText_WhichFloorWouldYouLike
en: Which floor would you like?
et: Millisele korrusele soovid?

label: gText_SandstormIsVicious
en: The sandstorm is vicious. It's impossible to keep going.
et: Liivatorm on metsik. Edasi on võimatu liikuda.

label: gText_SelectWithoutRegisteredItem
en: An item in the BAG can be registered to SELECT for easy use.
et: KOTIS oleva eseme saab registreerida SELECTile, et seda mugavalt kasutada.

label: gText_PokemonTrainerSchoolEmail
en: There's an e-mail from POKéMON TRAINER SCHOOL.
et: Saabunud on e-kiri POKéMON TRAINERI KOOLIST.

label: gText_PokemonTrainerSchoolEmail
en: A POKéMON may learn up to four moves.
et: POKéMON võib õppida kuni neli võtet.

label: gText_PokemonTrainerSchoolEmail
en: A TRAINER's expertise is tested on the move sets chosen for POKéMON.
et: TRAINERI vilumus tuleb välja selles, millised võtted ta oma POKéMONidele valib.

label: gText_PlayerHouseBootPC
en: {PLAYER} booted up the PC.
et: {PLAYER} käivitas ARVUTI.

label: gText_PokeblockLinkCanceled
en: The link was canceled.
et: Ühendus katkestati.

label: gText_UnusedNicknameReceivedPokemon
en: Want to give a nickname to the {STR_VAR_2} you received?
et: Kas tahad anda saadud POKéMONile {STR_VAR_2} hüüdnime?

et: Hoiab müstilise jõuga ära seisundihäired.

label: sTM21Desc
en: The less the user likes you, the more powerful this move.
et: Mida vähem kasutaja sind sallib, seda võimsam on see võte.
raw: The less the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

label: sTM22Desc
en: Absorbs sunlight in the 1st turn, then attacks next turn.
et: Imeb 1. käigul päikesevalgust ja ründab järgmisel.
raw: Absorbs sunlight in\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.

label: sTM23Desc
en: Slams the foe with a hard tail. It may lower DEFENSE.
et: Virutab vaenlast kõva sabaga. Võib langetada KAITSET.
raw: Slams the foe with\na hard tail. It may\nlower DEFENSE.

label: sTM24Desc
en: A powerful electric attack that may cause paralysis.
et: Võimas elektrirünnak, mis võib põhjustada halvatuse.
raw: A powerful electric\nattack that may\ncause paralysis.

label: sTM25Desc
en: Strikes the foe with a thunderbolt. It may paralyze.
et: Tabab vaenlast välgunoolega. Võib halvata.
raw: Strikes the foe\nwith a thunderbolt.\nIt may paralyze.

label: sTM26Desc
en: Causes a quake that has no effect on flying foes.
et: Tekitab värina, mis ei mõju lendavatele vaenlastele.
raw: Causes a quake\nthat has no effect\non flying foes.

label: sTM27Desc
en: The more the user likes you, the more powerful this move.
et: Mida rohkem kasutaja sind armastab, seda võimsam see võte.
raw: The more the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

label: sTM28Desc
en: Digs underground the 1st turn, then strikes next turn.
et: Kaevub 1. käigul maa alla ja tabab järgmisel.
raw: Digs underground\nthe 1st turn, then\nstrikes next turn.

label: sTM29Desc
en: A powerful psychic attack that may lower SP. DEF.
et: Võimas vaimne rünnak, mis võib langetada ER. KAITSET.
raw: A powerful psychic\nattack that may\nlower SP. DEF.

label: sTM30Desc
en: Hurls a dark lump at the foe. It may lower SP. DEF.
et: Paiskab vaenlase pihta tumeda kera. Võib langetada ER. KAITSET.
raw: Hurls a dark lump\nat the foe. It may\nlower SP. DEF.

label: sTM31Desc
en: Destroys barriers like LIGHT SCREEN and causes damage.
et: Purustab tõkked, näiteks LIGHT SCREEN, ja teeb kahju.
raw: Destroys barriers\nlike LIGHT SCREEN\nand causes damage.

label: sTM32Desc
en: Creates illusory copies to enhance elusiveness.
et: Loob näivaid koopiaid, et olla raskemini tabatav.

label: sTM33Desc
en: Creates a wall of light that weakens physical attacks.
et: Loob valgusseina, mis nõrgestab füüsilisi rünnakuid.
raw: Creates a wall of\nlight that weakens\nphysical attacks.

label: sTM34Desc
en: Zaps the foe with a jolt of electricity that never misses.
et: Tabab vaenlast elektrilöögiga, mis kunagi mööda ei lähe.
raw: Zaps the foe with a\njolt of electricity\nthat never misses.

label: sTM35Desc
en: Looses a stream of fire that may burn the foe.
et: Vallandab tulejoa, mis võib vaenlast põletada.
raw: Looses a stream of\nfire that may burn\nthe foe.

label: sTM36Desc
en: Hurls sludge at the foe. It may poison the foe.
et: Paiskab vaenlase pihta solki. Võib vaenlast mürgitada.
raw: Hurls sludge at the\nfoe. It may poison\nthe foe.

label: sTM37Desc
en: Causes a sandstorm that hits the foe over several turns.
et: Tekitab liivatormi, mis tabab vaenlast mitu käiku.
raw: Causes a sandstorm\nthat hits the foe\nover several turns.

label: sTM38Desc
en: A powerful fire attack that may burn the foe.
et: Võimas tulerünnak, mis võib vaenlast põletada.
raw: A powerful fire\nattack that may\nburn the foe.

label: sTM39Desc
en: Stops the foe from moving with rocks. May lower SPEED.
et: Takistab kividega vaenlase liikumist. Võib langetada KIIRUST.
raw: Stops the foe from\nmoving with rocks.\nMay lower SPEED.

label: sTM40Desc
en: An extremely fast attack that can't be avoided.
et: Äärmiselt kiire rünnak, mida ei saa vältida.
raw: An extremely fast\nattack that can't\nbe avoided.

label: sTM41Desc
en: Prevents the foe from using the same move in a row.
et: Takistab vaenlasel sama võtet järjest kasutada.
raw: Prevents the foe\nfrom using the same\nmove in a row.

label: sTM42Desc
en: Raises ATTACK when poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
et: Tõstab RÜNNAKUT mürgituse, põletuse või halvatuse korral.

label: sTM43Desc
en: Adds an effect to attack depending on the location.
et: Lisab rünnakule mõju olenevalt asukohast.
raw: Adds an effect to\nattack depending\non the location.

label: sTM44Desc
en: The user sleeps for 2 turns to restore health and status.
et: Kasutaja magab 2 käiku, et taastada tervis ja seisund.
raw: The user sleeps for\n2 turns to restore\nhealth and status.

label: sTM45Desc
en: Makes it tough to attack a foe of the opposite gender.
et: Muudab vastassoost vaenlase ründamise raskeks.
raw: Makes it tough to\nattack a foe of the\nopposite gender.

label: sTM46Desc
en: While attacking, it may steal the foe's held item.
et: Rünnates võib varastada vaenlase eseme.
raw: While attacking,\nit may steal the\nfoe's held item.

label: sTM47Desc
en: Spreads hardedged wings and slams into the foe.
et: Sirutab teravaservalised tiivad laiali ja rammib vaenlast.
raw: Spreads hard-\nedged wings and\nslams into the foe.

label: sTM48Desc
en: Switches abilities with the foe on the turn this is used.
et: Vahetab sellel käigul vaenlasega võimed.
raw: Switches abilities\nwith the foe on the\nturn this is used.

label: sTM49Desc
en: Steals the effects of the move the foe is trying to use.
et: Varastab selle võtte mõju, mida vaenlane üritab kasutada.
raw: Steals the effects\nof the move the foe\nis trying to use.

label: sTM50Desc
en: Enables full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.
et: Võimaldab täisjõulise rünnaku, kuid langetab järsult ER. RÜNNAKUT.
raw: Enables full-power\nattack, but sharply\nlowers SP. ATK.

label: sHM01Desc
en: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws.
et: Ründab vaenlast teravate terade või küüntega.
raw: Attacks the foe\nwith sharp blades\nor claws.

label: sHM02Desc
en: Flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn.
et: Lendab esimesel käigul üles ja ründab järgmisel.
raw: Flies up on the\nfirst turn, then\nattacks next turn.

label: sHM03Desc
en: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe.
et: Tekitab hiiglasliku laine ja paiskab selle vaenlasele kaela.
raw: Creates a huge\nwave, then crashes\nit down on the foe.

label: sHM04Desc
en: Builds enormous power, then slams the foe.
et: Kogub tohutut jõudu ja virutab siis vaenlasele.

label: sHM05Desc
en: Looses a powerful blast of light that reduces accuracy.
et: Vallandab võimsa valgussähvatuse, mis vähendab täpsust.
raw: Looses a powerful\nblast of light that\nreduces accuracy.

label: sHM06Desc
en: A rock-crushingly tough attack that may lower DEFENSE.
et: Kive purustav rünnak, mis võib langetada KAITSET.

label: sHM07Desc
en: Attacks the foe with enough power to climb waterfalls.
et: Ründab vaenlast jõuga, millega saaks koskedest üles.

label: sHM08Desc

label: gDummyPokedexText
en: This is a newly discovered POKéMON. It is currently under investigation. No detailed information is available at this time.
et: See on äsja avastatud POKéMON. Praegu seda uuritakse. Hetkel pole täpsemat teavet saadaval.
raw:
This is a newly discovered POKéMON.
It is currently under investigation.
No detailed information is available
at this time.

label: gBulbasaurPokedexText
en: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright sunlight. There is a seed on its back. By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed grows progressively larger.
et: BULBASAURi võib näha eredas päikesepaistes tukkumas. Tal on seljas seeme. Päikesekiiri neelates kasvab seeme järjest suuremaks.
raw:
BULBASAUR can be seen napping in bright
sunlight. There is a seed on its back.
By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed
grows progressively larger.

label: gIvysaurPokedexText
en: To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into a large flower.
et: Sibula kandmiseks kasvavad IVYSAURi jalad tugevaks. Kui ta lebab rohkem päikese käes, puhkeb pung peagi suureks õieks.
raw:
To support its bulb, IVYSAUR's legs
grow sturdy. If it spends more time lying in
the sunlight, the bud will soon bloom into
a large flower.

label: gVenusaurPokedexText
en: VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
et: Öeldakse, et VENUSAURi õis omandab erksad värvid, kui ta saab rohkelt toitaineid ja päikest. Õie aroom rahustab inimeste tundeid.
raw:
VENUSAUR's flower is said to take on vivid
colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and
sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the
emotions of people.

label: gCharmanderPokedexText
en: The flame that burns at the tip of its tail is an indication of its emotions. The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is happy, and blazes when it is enraged.
et: Saba tipus põlev leek reedab tema tunded. Kui CHARMANDER on rõõmus, võbeleb leek, kui ta on raevunud, lõõmab see täiel jõul.
raw:
The flame that burns at the tip of its
tail is an indication of its emotions.
The flame wavers when CHARMANDER is
happy, and blazes when it is enraged.

label: gCharmeleonPokedexText
en: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.
et: Ta teravad küünised hävitavad vaenlasi halastamatult. Tugevat vastast kohates läheb ta ärevile ja saba leek lõõmab sinakasvalgena.
raw:
Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes.
If it encounters a strong enemy, it
becomes agitated, and the flame on its
tail flares with a bluish white color.

label: gCharizardPokedexText
en: A CHARIZARD flies about in search of strong opponents. It breathes intense flames that can melt any material. However, it will never torch a weaker foe.
et: CHARIZARD lendab ringi tugevaid vastaseid otsides. Ta purskab ägedat leeki, mis sulatab mis tahes materjali. Nõrgemat vaenlast ta aga iial ei kõrveta.
raw:
A CHARIZARD flies about in search of
strong opponents. It breathes intense
flames that can melt any material. However,
