en: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.
et: Ta ei oska veel elektrit hoida. Ehmatades laseb ta jõu kogemata välja. Vanemaks saades õpib ta jõudu paremini hoidma.
raw:
It is still inept at retaining electricity.
When it is startled, it discharges power
accidentally. It gets better at holding
power as it grows older.

label: gCleffaPokedexText
en: On nights with many shooting stars, CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring. They dance until daybreak, when they quench their thirst with the morning dew.
et: Öödel, mil on palju langevaid tähti, võib CLEFFAsid näha ringis tantsimas. Nad tantsivad koiduni, mil nad kustutavad janu hommikukastega.
raw:
On nights with many shooting stars,
CLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.
They dance until daybreak, when they
quench their thirst with the morning dew.

label: gIgglybuffPokedexText
en: Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy. When it sings continuously with all its might, its body steadily turns a deepening pink color.
et: Ta pehme ja painduv keha on väga vetruv. Kui ta laulab pidevalt kõigest väest, muutub ta keha järjest sügavamalt roosaks.
raw:
Its soft and pliable body is very bouncy.
When it sings continuously with all its
might, its body steadily turns a deepening
pink color.

label: gTogepiPokedexText
en: As its energy, it uses the feelings of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and POKéMON. It stores up happy feelings in its shell, then shares them out.
et: Energiaks kasutab ta kaastunnet ja rõõmu, mida inimesed ja POKéMONid õhkavad. Ta kogub õnnelikud tunded oma koore sisse ja jagab neid siis teistega.
raw:
As its energy, it uses the feelings of
compassion and pleasure exuded by
people and POKéMON. It stores up happy
feelings in its shell, then shares them out.

label: gTogeticPokedexText
en: It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When it spots someone who is pure of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its happiness with that person.
et: Öeldakse, et ta on POKéMON, kes toob õnne. Kui ta märkab puhta südamega inimest, ilmub TOGETIC ja jagab selle inimesega oma õnne.
raw:
It is said to be a POKéMON that brings good
fortune. When it spots someone who is pure
of heart, a TOGETIC appears and shares its
happiness with that person.

label: gNatuPokedexText
en: It runs up short trees that grow on the savanna to peck at new shoots. A NATU's eyes look as if they are always observing something.
et: Ta ronib savanni madalatesse puudesse, et uusi võrseid nokkida. NATU silmad näivad alati midagi jälgivat.
raw:
It runs up short trees that grow on the
savanna to peck at new shoots.
A NATU's eyes look as if they are
always observing something.

label: gXatuPokedexText
en: It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing the future. Some people in different lands have long believed that XATU are emissaries from another world.
et: Tal on mõistatuslik võime tulevikku ette näha. Mõned inimesed eri maades on kaua uskunud, et XATUd on saadikud teisest maailmast.
raw:
It has the enigmatic power of foreseeing
the future. Some people in different lands
have long believed that XATU are
emissaries from another world.

label: gMareepPokedexText
en: Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds a static charge. The more energy is charged, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows.
et: Ta kohev vill hõõrdub kokku ja tekitab staatilise laengu. Mida rohkem energiat koguneb, seda eredamalt hõõgub saba tipus olev pirn.
raw:
Its fluffy wool rubs together and builds
a static charge. The more energy is
charged, the more brightly the lightbulb
at the tip of its tail glows.

label: gFlaaffyPokedexText
en: Its fleece quality changes to generate strong static electricity with a small amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its hide are shielded against electricity.
et: Ta villa omadused muutuvad nii, et väikegi villahulk tekitab tugeva staatilise laengu. Ta naha paljad libedad osad on elektri eest kaitstud.
raw:
Its fleece quality changes to generate
strong static electricity with a small
amount of wool. The bare, slick parts of its
hide are shielded against electricity.

label: gAmpharosPokedexText
en: It gives off so much light that it can be seen even from space. People in the old days used its light to send signals back and forth with others far away.
et: Ta kiirgab nii palju valgust, et teda võib näha isegi kosmosest. Vanasti andsid inimesed ta valgusega märku kaugel olevatele inimestele.
raw:
It gives off so much light that it can be
seen even from space. People in the old
days used its light to send signals back
and forth with others far away.

label: gBellossomPokedexText
en: Its flower petals deepen in color through exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather persists, it does a dance that is thought to be a ritual for summoning the sun.
et: Ta õielehed tumenevad päikese käes. Kui pilvine ilm püsib, teeb ta tantsu, mida peetakse rituaaliks päikese esilekutsumiseks.
raw:
Its flower petals deepen in color through
exposure to sunlight. When cloudy weather
persists, it does a dance that is thought
to be a ritual for summoning the sun.

label: gMarillPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with water-repellent fur. Because of the fur, it can swim through water at high speed without being slowed by the water's resistance.
et: Ta keha katab vetthülgav karv. Selle karva tõttu suudab ta ujuda vees suurel kiirusel, ilma et vee takistus teda pidurdaks.
raw:
Its body is covered with water-repellent
fur. Because of the fur, it can swim
through water at high speed without being
slowed by the water's resistance.

label: gAzumarillPokedexText
en: It lives in water virtually all day long. Its body color and pattern act as camouflage that makes it tough for enemies to spot in water.
et: Ta elab praktiliselt terve päeva vees. Ta kehavärv ja muster toimivad maskeeringuna, mis teeb vaenlastel ta vees märkamise raskeks.
raw:
It lives in water virtually all day long.
Its body color and pattern act as
camouflage that makes it tough for
enemies to spot in water.

label: gSudowoodoPokedexText
en: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.
et: Ta jäljendab puud, et vaenlaste rünnakut vältida. Kuid kuna ta esijalad jäävad terve aasta roheliseks, on ta talvel kergesti võltsinguna tuvastatav.
raw:
It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked
by enemies. But since its forelegs
remain green throughout the year, it is
easily identified as a fake in the winter.

label: gPolitoedPokedexText
en: The curled hair on its head proves its status as a king. It is said that the longer and curlier the hair, the more respect it earns from its peers.
et: Ta pea kähar karvatutt on kuningliku seisuse märk. Öeldakse, et mida pikem ja käharam see on, seda rohkem austust ta omasuguste seas pälvib.
raw:
The curled hair on its head proves its
status as a king. It is said that the
longer and curlier the hair, the more
respect it earns from its peers.

label: gHoppipPokedexText
en: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others to prepare against being blown away.
et: See POKéMON triivib ja hõljub tuulega. Kui ta tajub tugeva tuule lähenemist, haagib HOPPIP oma lehed teiste omadega kokku, et neid minema ei puhutaks.
raw:
This POKéMON drifts and floats with the
wind. If it senses the approach of strong
winds, a HOPPIP links leaves with others
to prepare against being blown away.

label: gSkiploomPokedexText
en: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
et: Ta õitseb, kui temperatuur tõuseb üle 18 kraadi. Kuna ta õie õitsemine muutub koos temperatuuriga, kasutatakse teda vahel termomeetrina.
raw:
It blossoms when the temperature rises
above 64 degrees F. Because its flower's
blooming changes with the temperature,
it is sometimes used as a thermometer.

label: gJumpluffPokedexText
en: JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. This POKéMON lands when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
et: JUMPLUFFid ratsutavad soojadel lõunatuultel, et ületada meri ja lennata võõrastesse maadesse. See POKéMON maandub, kui ta hõljudes külma õhku kohtab.
raw:
JUMPLUFF ride warm southern winds to
cross the sea and fly to foreign lands.
This POKéMON lands when it encounters
cold air while it is floating.

label: gAipomPokedexText
en: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have become rather clumsy.
et: Ta saba lõpeb osava käelaadse jätkega. Kuid kuna ta kasutab saba nii palju, on AIPOMi tegelikud käed muutunud üsna kohmakaks.
raw:
Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike
appendage. However, because it uses the
tail so much, AIPOM's real hands have
become rather clumsy.

label: gSunkernPokedexText
en: SUNKERN try to minimize movement to conserve the nutrients they have stored in their bodies for evolution. They will not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.
et: SUNKERNid liiguvad võimalikult vähe, et hoida kokku toitaineid, mille nad on arenguks kehasse kogunud. Nad ei söö, vaid elavad ainult hommikukastest.
raw:
SUNKERN try to minimize movement to
conserve the nutrients they have stored
in their bodies for evolution. They will
not eat, subsisting only on morning dew.

label: gSunfloraPokedexText
en: SUNFLORA convert solar energy into nutrition. They are highly active in the warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as soon as the sun sets.
et: SUNFLORAd muudavad päikeseenergia toiduks. Nad on soojal päeval väga aktiivsed, kuid peatuvad järsult niipea, kui päike loojub.
raw:
SUNFLORA convert solar energy into
nutrition. They are highly active in the
warm daytime but suddenly stop moving as
soon as the sun sets.

label: gYanmaPokedexText
en: It can see 360 degrees without moving its eyes. It is a great flier capable of making sudden stops and turning midair to quickly chase down targeted prey.
et: Ta näeb 360 kraadi ilma silmi liigutamata. Ta on suurepärane lendaja, kes suudab järsult peatuda ja õhus pöörata, et kiiresti saaki taga ajada.
raw:
It can see 360 degrees without moving
its eyes. It is a great flier capable of
making sudden stops and turning midair to
quickly chase down targeted prey.

label: gWooperPokedexText
en: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.
et: WOOPERid elavad tavaliselt vees, kuid tulevad vahel toitu otsides maale. Maal katavad nad keha kleepuva mürgise kilega.
raw:
WOOPER usually live in water but come
out onto land seeking food occasionally.
On land, they coat their bodies with a
gooey, toxic film.

label: gQuagsirePokedexText
en: A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it does not get very hungry.
et: QUAGSIRE jahib, jättes suu vees pärani lahti ja oodates, et saak sisse eksiks. Kuna ta ei liigu, ei lähe ta väga näljaseks.
raw:
A QUAGSIRE hunts by leaving its mouth wide
open in water and waiting for its prey to
blunder in. Because it doesn't move, it
does not get very hungry.

label: gEspeonPokedexText
en: An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is said to have developed precognitive powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.
et: ESPEON on äärmiselt lojaalne igale TRAINERile, keda ta väärikaks peab. Öeldakse, et tal on välja arenenud ettenägemisvõime, et TRAINERit kaitsta.
raw:
An ESPEON is extremely loyal to any
TRAINER it considers to be worthy. It is
said to have developed precognitive
powers to protect its TRAINER from harm.

label: gUmbreonPokedexText
en: UMBREON evolved from exposure to the moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness and waits for its foes to move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.
et: UMBREON arenes kuu energiaimpulsside käes. Ta varitseb pimeduses ja ootab, et vaenlased liiguksid. Ta keha ringid hõõguvad, kui ta rünnakuks hüppab.
raw:
UMBREON evolved from exposure to the
moon's energy pulses. It lurks in darkness
and waits for its foes to move. The rings
on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

label: gMurkrowPokedexText
en: MURKROW were feared as the alleged bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong interest in anything that sparkles. It will even try to steal rings from women.
et: Kunagi arvati, et MURKROW toob õnnetust. Ta tunneb tugevat huvi kõige sätendava vastu ja üritab isegi naistelt sõrmuseid varastada.
raw:
MURKROW were feared as the alleged
bearers of ill fortune. It shows strong
interest in anything that sparkles. It will
even try to steal rings from women.

label: gSlowkingPokedexText
en: It undertakes research every day to solve the mysteries of the world. However, it apparently forgets everything if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.
et: Ta teeb iga päev uurimistööd, et lahendada maailma saladusi. Kuid ta unustab ilmselt kõik, kui ta peas olev SHELLDER ära tuleb.
raw:
It undertakes research every day to
solve the mysteries of the world.
However, it apparently forgets everything
if the SHELLDER on its head comes off.

label: gMisdreavusPokedexText
en: A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes as its nutrition.
et: MISDREAVUS hirmutab inimesi jubeda nutva kisaga. Ilmselt imeb ta punaste keradega endasse vaenlaste hirmu ja toitub sellest.
raw:
A MISDREAVUS frightens people with a
creepy, sobbing cry. It apparently uses
its red spheres to absorb the fear of foes
as its nutrition.

label: gUnownPokedexText
en: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.
et: See POKéMON on kujult nagu iidsed kirjamärgid. Kuigi uurimine käib, on mõistatus, kumb tekkis enne — iidsed kirjad või erinevad UNOWNid.
raw:
This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text
characters. Although research is ongoing,
it is a mystery as to which came first,
the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.

label: gWobbuffetPokedexText
en: Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back ferociously if its black tail is attacked. It makes its lair in caves where it waits for nightfall.
et: WOBBUFFET on tavaliselt rahulik, kuid kui ta musta saba rünnatakse, lööb ta ägedalt tagasi. Ta pesitseb koobastes, kus ootab ööd.
raw:
Usually docile, a WOBBUFFET strikes back
ferociously if its black tail is attacked.
It makes its lair in caves where it waits
for nightfall.

label: gGirafarigPokedexText
en: A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats grass and tree shoots. While it is eating, its tail makes chewing and swallowing motions as if it were also eating.
et: GIRAFARIG on taimtoiduline — ta sööb rohtu ja puuvõrseid. Söömise ajal teeb ta saba närimis- ja neelamisliigutusi, justkui sööks seegi.
raw:
A GIRAFARIG is an herbivore--it eats
grass and tree shoots. While it is eating,
its tail makes chewing and swallowing
motions as if it were also eating.

label: gPinecoPokedexText
en: A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and waits for prey. While eating, if it is disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.
et: PINECO ripub puuoksa küljes ja ootab saaki. Kui söömise ajal teda keegi puud raputades häirib, kukub ta maha ja plahvatab ootamatult.
raw:
A PINECO hangs from a tree branch and
waits for prey. While eating, if it is
disturbed by someone shaking its tree, it
falls on the ground and suddenly explodes.

label: gForretressPokedexText
en: It keeps itself inside its steel shell. The shell is opened when it is catching prey, but it is so quick that the shell's inside cannot be seen.
et: Ta hoiab end terasest koja sees. Saaki püüdes avab ta koja, kuid nii kiiresti, et selle sisemust ei jõua keegi näha.
raw:
It keeps itself inside its steel shell.
The shell is opened when it is catching
prey, but it is so quick that the shell's
inside cannot be seen.

label: gDunsparcePokedexText
en: Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into the ground backwards. This POKéMON is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.
et: Puuriotsaga sabaga kaevub ta tagurpidi maa alla. Teadaolevalt ehitab see POKéMON sügavale maa alla keerukate käikudega pesa.
raw:
Its drill-tipped tail is used to burrow into
the ground backwards. This POKéMON is
known to make its nest in complex shapes
deep under the ground.

label: gGligarPokedexText
en: It glides without making a single sound. It grasps the face of its foe using its hind and large front claws, then stabs with its poison barb.
et: Ta liugleb ilma vähimatki heli tegemata. Ta haarab tagumiste ja suurte esiküüntega vaenlase näost, seejärel torkab mürgiokkaga.
raw:
It glides without making a single sound.
It grasps the face of its foe using its
hind and large front claws, then stabs
with its poison barb.

label: gSteelixPokedexText
en: STEELIX live even further underground than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
et: STEELIXid elavad veelgi sügavamal maa all kui ONIXid. See POKéMON kaevub teadaolevalt maa südamiku poole, ulatudes üle kilomeetri sügavusele.
raw:
STEELIX live even further underground
than ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig
toward the earth's core, reaching a depth
of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

label: gSnubbullPokedexText
en: By baring its fangs and making a scary face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a little sad at making its foes flee.
et: Kihvu paljastades ja hirmsat nägu tehes ajab ta väiksemad POKéMONid õudusest laiali. SNUBBULL näib aga veidi kurb, kui ta vaenlased põgenevad.
raw:
By baring its fangs and making a scary
face, it sends smaller POKéMON scurrying
in terror. The SNUBBULL does seem a
little sad at making its foes flee.

label: gGranbullPokedexText
en: It has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite.
et: Tal on eriti hästi arenenud alalõug. Suured kihvad on nii rasked, et ta pea vajub viltu. Kui teda ei ehmatata, ei ürita ta hammustada.
raw:
It has a particularly well-developed lower
jaw. The huge fangs are heavy, causing
it to tilt its head. Unless it is startled, it
will not try to bite.

label: gQwilfishPokedexText
en: A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming to be somewhat challenging.
et: QWILFISH kasutab allaneelatud vee survet, et tulistada korraga üle kogu keha mürgiseid ogasid. Ta peab ujumist mõnevõrra keeruliseks.
raw:
A QWILFISH uses the pressure of water
it swallows to shoot toxic quills all at
once from all over its body. It finds
swimming to be somewhat challenging.

label: gScizorPokedexText
en: A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
et: SCIZORi keha on terase kõvadusega. Ta ei lase end tavalistest rünnakutest kergesti häirida. Ta lehvitab tiibu, et reguleerida kehatemperatuuri.
raw:
A SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of
steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary
sorts of attacks. It flaps its wings to
regulate its body temperature.

label: gShucklePokedexText
en: A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its shell while eating stored berries. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.
et: SHUCKLE peidab end kivide alla ja hoiab keha koja sees, süües samal ajal varutud marju. Marjad segunevad ta kehavedelikega ja muutuvad mahlaks.
raw:
A SHUCKLE hides under rocks, keeping its
body concealed inside its shell while
eating stored berries. The berries mix with
its body fluids to become a juice.

label: gHeracrossPokedexText
en: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.
et: Nad kogunevad metsadesse, otsides puude magusat mahla. Ta on täielikult kaetud terasekõva kilbiga. Ta on uhke oma sarve üle, millega ta vaenlasi paiskab.
raw:
They gather in forests seeking the sweet
sap of trees. It is completely clad in a
steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn,
which it uses to fling foes.

label: gSneaselPokedexText
en: A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
et: SNEASEL ronib puu otsa, lüües konksjad küünised koore sisse. Ta otsib valveta pesi ja varastab toiduks mune, kuni vanemad on eemal.
raw:
A SNEASEL scales trees by punching its
hooked claws into the bark. It seeks out
unguarded nests and steals eggs for food
while the parents are away.

label: gTeddiursaPokedexText
en: It licks its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by BEEDRILL.
et: Ta lakub oma käpapadjandeid, mis on mee sees leotamisest magusad. TEDDIURSA teeb ise mett, segades BEEDRILLi kogutud puuvilju ja õietolmu.
raw:
It licks its palms that are sweetened by
being soaked in honey. A TEDDIURSA makes
its own honey by blending fruits and pollen
collected by BEEDRILL.

label: gUrsaringPokedexText
en: In forests, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where an URSARING gathers food. It walks through its forest collecting food every day.
et: Öeldakse, et metsades, kus URSARING toitu kogub, on palju ojasid ja kõrgeid puid. Ta kõnnib igal päeval mööda metsa, toitu kogudes.
raw:
In forests, it is said that there are many
streams and towering trees where an
URSARING gathers food. It walks through
its forest collecting food every day.

label: gSlugmaPokedexText
en: It is a species of POKéMON that lives in volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that, it sleeps near magma.
et: See on POKéMON-liik, kes elab vulkaanilistes piirkondades. Kui ta keha jahtub, kõveneb nahk ja ta ei saa enam liikuda. Selle vältimiseks magab ta magma lähedal.
raw:
It is a species of POKéMON that lives in
volcanic areas. If its body cools, its skin
hardens and immobilizes it. To avoid that,
it sleeps near magma.

label: gMagcargoPokedexText
en: The shell on its back is made of hardened magma. Tens of thousands of years spent living in volcanic craters have turned MAGCARGO's bodies into magma.
et: Ta seljal olev koda on tardunud magmast. Kümned tuhanded aastad vulkaanikraatrites elamist on muutnud MAGCARGO kehad magmaks.
raw:
The shell on its back is made of hardened
magma. Tens of thousands of years spent
living in volcanic craters have turned
MAGCARGO's bodies into magma.

label: gSwinubPokedexText
en: It roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under dried grass. It occasionally roots out hot springs.
et: Ta tuustib toitu, hõõrudes koonu vastu maad. Ta lemmiktoit on seen, mis kasvab kuiva rohu all. Vahel tuustib ta välja kuumaveeallikaid.
raw:
It roots for food by rubbing its snout
against the ground. Its favorite food is a
mushroom that grows under dried grass.
It occasionally roots out hot springs.

label: gPiloswinePokedexText
en: A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat of long hair for enduring freezing cold. It uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.
et: PILOSWINEt katab paks pikkadest karvadest kasukas, mis aitab tal kibekülma taluda. Kihvadega kaevab ta jää alla mattunud toidu välja.
raw:
A PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat
of long hair for enduring freezing cold.
It uses its tusks to dig up food that has
been buried under ice.

label: gCorsolaPokedexText
en: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.
et: CORSOLAd elavad soojades lõunameredes. Kui meri saastub, muutuvad kaunid korallitüved värvituks ja pudenevad räbalatena laiali.
raw:
CORSOLA live in warm southern seas.
If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful
coral stalks become discolored and crumble
away in tatters.

label: gRemoraidPokedexText
en: A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles to forcefully expel swallowed water, then shoot down flying prey. When evolution approaches, it travels down rivers.
et: REMORAID surub kõhulihastega allaneelatud vee jõuliselt välja ja tulistab nii lendava saagi alla. Kui areng läheneb, laseb ta end mööda jõge alla.
raw:
A REMORAID uses its abdominal muscles
to forcefully expel swallowed water, then
shoot down flying prey. When evolution
approaches, it travels down rivers.

label: gOctilleryPokedexText
en: It ensnares its foe with its suctioncupped tentacles before delivering the finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be too strong, it spews ink to escape.
et: Ta püüab vaenlase iminappadega kombitsatesse, enne kui annab lõpplöögi. Kui vaenlane osutub liiga tugevaks, pritsib ta põgenemiseks tinti.
raw:
It ensnares its foe with its suction-
cupped tentacles before delivering the
finishing blow. If the foe turns out to be
too strong, it spews ink to escape.

label: gDelibirdPokedexText
en: It carries food bundled up in its tail. There was a famous explorer who managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.
et: Ta kannab toitu sabas kimbus. Üks kuulus maadeuurija jõudis Mount Everesti tippu ainult tänu sellele, et DELIBIRD jagas temaga oma toitu.
raw:
It carries food bundled up in its tail.
There was a famous explorer who
managed to scale Mt. Everest thanks
to a DELIBIRD sharing its food.

label: gMantinePokedexText
en: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be seen elegantly leaping over the waves. It is not bothered by the REMORAID that hitches rides.
et: Päikesepaistelistel päevadel võib näha MANTINE parvi elegantselt üle lainete hüppamas. Teda ei häiri REMORAIDid, kes end ta külge haagivad.
raw:
On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can be
seen elegantly leaping over the waves.
It is not bothered by the REMORAID that
hitches rides.

label: gSkarmoryPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has a body and wings of steel. People in the past used feathers fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and knives.
et: POKéMON, kellel on terasest keha ja tiivad. Vanasti tehti SKARMORY pudenenud sulgedest mõõku ja nuge.
raw:
A POKéMON that has a body and wings of
steel. People in the past used feathers
fallen from SKARMORY to make swords and
knives.

label: gHoundourPokedexText
en: HOUNDOUR communicate with each other using a variety of cries to corner their prey. This POKéMON's remarkable teamwork is simply unparalleled.
et: HOUNDOURid suhtlevad omavahel mitmesuguste kisadega, et saak nurka suruda. Selle POKéMONi koostöö on lihtsalt ületamatu.
raw:
HOUNDOUR communicate with each other
using a variety of cries to corner their
prey. This POKéMON's remarkable teamwork
is simply unparalleled.

label: gHoundoomPokedexText
en: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns raked sharply back serves a leadership role. They choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
et: HOUNDOOMide karjas on juhiks see, kelle sarved kaarduvad kõige teravamalt taha. Juhi valivad nad omavahel võideldes.
raw:
In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its horns
raked sharply back serves a leadership
role. They choose their leader by fighting
among themselves.

label: gKingdraPokedexText
en: It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor. When it comes up to the surface, it creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow even ships.
et: Ta magab vaikselt sügaval ookeanipõhjas. Pinnale tulles tekitab ta tohutu veekeerise, mis suudab neelata isegi laevu.
raw:
It sleeps quietly, deep on the seafloor.
When it comes up to the surface, it
creates a huge whirlpool that can swallow
even ships.

label: gPhanpyPokedexText
en: PHANPY's big ears serve as broad fans. When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears busily to cool down. Even the young are very strong.
et: PHANPY suured kõrvad on nagu laiad lehvikud. Kui tal palav hakkab, lehvitab ta jahtumiseks usinasti kõrvu. Isegi noored on väga tugevad.
raw:
PHANPY's big ears serve as broad fans.
When it becomes hot, it flaps the ears
busily to cool down. Even the young are
very strong.

label: gDonphanPokedexText
en: A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of attack won't even leave a scratch.
et: DONPHAN on nii tugev, et suudab kergesti vedada kallurit. Ta nahk on karastunud kivikõvaks. Tavaline rünnak ei jäta sellele kriimugi.
raw:
A DONPHAN is so strong it can easily haul
a dump truck. Its hide has toughened to a
rock-hard state. An ordinary sort of
attack won't even leave a scratch.

label: gPorygon2PokedexText
en: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.
et: Inimesed lõid ta teaduse jõul. Talle on antud tehisintellekt, mis laseb tal iseseisvalt uusi žeste ja tundeid õppida.
raw:
It was created by humans using the power
of science. It has been given artificial
intelligence that enables it to learn new
gestures and emotions on its own.

label: gStantlerPokedexText
en: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were once traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this POKéMON was hunted close to extinction.
et: STANTLERi suurepäraseid sarvi müüdi kunagi kunstiteostena kõrge hinnaga. Selle tagajärjel jahiti see POKéMON peaaegu välja.
raw:
STANTLER's magnificent antlers were
once traded at high prices as works of art.
As a result, this POKéMON was hunted
close to extinction.

label: gSmearglePokedexText
en: A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. About 5,000 different marks left by this POKéMON have been found.
et: SMEARGLE märgib oma territooriumi vedelikuga, mis nõrgub ta saba tipust. On leitud umbes 5000 erinevat selle POKéMONi jäetud märki.
raw:
A SMEARGLE marks its territory using a
fluid that leaks out from the tip of its
tail. About 5,000 different marks left by
this POKéMON have been found.

label: gTyroguePokedexText
en: TYROGUE become stressed out if they do not get to train every day. When raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish a regular training schedule.
et: TYROGUEd satuvad stressi, kui nad ei saa iga päev treenida. Seda POKéMONi kasvatades peab TRAINER paika panema kindla treeningkava.
raw:
TYROGUE become stressed out if they do
not get to train every day. When raising
this POKéMON, the TRAINER must establish
a regular training schedule.

label: gHitmontopPokedexText
en: Its technique of kicking while spinning is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense. HITMONTOP travel faster spinning than they do walking.
et: Ta pöörlemise ajal jagatavad jalahoobid on tähelepanuväärne segu rünnakust ja kaitsest. HITMONTOPid liiguvad pöörledes kiiremini kui kõndides.
raw:
Its technique of kicking while spinning is
a remarkable mix of both offense and
defense. HITMONTOP travel faster
spinning than they do walking.

label: gSmoochumPokedexText
en: It actively runs about, but also falls often. Whenever it falls, it will check its reflection on a lake's surface to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.
et: Ta jookseb aktiivselt ringi, kuid kukub ka tihti. Iga kukkumise järel vaatab ta oma peegeldust järvevees, kas nägu ikka pole mustaks saanud.
raw:
It actively runs about, but also falls
often. Whenever it falls, it will check its
reflection on a lake's surface to make
sure its face hasn't become dirty.

label: gElekidPokedexText
en: If it touches metal and discharges the electricity it has stored in its body, an ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.
et: Kui ta puudutab metalli ja laseb kehasse salvestatud elektri välja, hakkab ELEKID käsi ringiratast vehkima, et end uuesti laadida.
raw:
If it touches metal and discharges the
electricity it has stored in its body, an
ELEKID begins swinging its arms in circles
to recharge itself.

label: gMagbyPokedexText
en: If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.
et: Kui MAGBY purskab suust kollaseid leeke, on ta hea tervise juures. Väsinuna seguneb leekide sekka musta suitsu.
raw:
If a MAGBY is spouting yellow flames from
its mouth, it is in good health. When it is
fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with
the flames.

label: gMiltankPokedexText
en: It gives over five gallons of milk daily. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.
et: Ta annab päevas üle 20 liitri piima. Ta magusat piima naudivad nii lapsed kui täiskasvanud. Need, kes piima juua ei saa, teevad sellest jogurtit.
raw:
It gives over five gallons of milk daily.
Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and
grown-ups alike. People who can't drink
milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

label: gBlisseyPokedexText
en: If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur, a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person, however far away, to share an egg of happiness that brings a smile to any face.
et: Kui BLISSEY tajub oma koheva karvaga kurbust, kihutab ta kurva inimese juurde, ükskõik kui kaugele, et jagada õnnemuna, mis toob igale näole naeratuse.
raw:
If it senses sadness with its fluffy fur,
a BLISSEY will rush over to the sad person,
however far away, to share an egg of
happiness that brings a smile to any face.

label: gRaikouPokedexText
en: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning. Its roars send shock waves shuddering through the air and ground as if lightning bolts were crashing down.
et: RAIKOU kehastab välgu kiirust. Ta möire paneb õhu ja maa lööklainetest värisema, justkui lööks alla välk.
raw:
RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning.
Its roars send shock waves shuddering
through the air and ground as if
lightning bolts were crashing down.

label: gEnteiPokedexText
en: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma. It is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that consumes all that it touches.
et: ENTEI kehastab magma kirge. Arvatakse, et ta sündis vulkaanipurskes. Ta purskab tuld, mis neelab kõik, mida see puudutab.
raw:
ENTEI embodies the passion of magma.
It is thought to have been born in the
eruption of a volcano. It blasts fire that
consumes all that it touches.

label: gSuicunePokedexText
en: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gliding elegance. It has the power to purify dirty water.
et: SUICUNE kehastab puhta veeallika kaastunnet. Ta jookseb üle maa elegantselt liugeldes. Tal on vägi räpast vett puhastada.
raw:
SUICUNE embodies the compassion of
a pure spring of water. It runs across
the land with gliding elegance. It has the
power to purify dirty water.

label: gLarvitarPokedexText
en: A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground. It must eat its way through the soil above and reach the surface for it to see its parents' faces.
et: LARVITAR sünnib sügaval maa all. Ta peab sööma end läbi ülal oleva pinnase ja jõudma pinnale, et näha oma vanemate nägusid.
raw:
A LARVITAR is born deep under the ground.
It must eat its way through the soil above
and reach the surface for it to see its
parents' faces.

label: gPupitarPokedexText
en: A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body that it ejects under compression to propel itself like a jet. Its body can withstand a collision with solid steel.
et: PUPITAR tekitab kehas gaasi ja paiskab selle surve all välja, sööstes ise nagu rakett edasi. Ta keha talub kokkupõrget ka tugeva terasega.
raw:
A PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body
that it ejects under compression to propel
itself like a jet. Its body can withstand
a collision with solid steel.

label: gTyranitarPokedexText
en: A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. It roams in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
et: TYRANITAR on nii võimas, et suudab pesa tegemiseks maha lükata terve mäe. Ta rändab mägedes ringi ja otsib uusi vastaseid.
raw:
A TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly powerful,
it can bring down a whole mountain to make
its nest. It roams in mountains seeking
new opponents to fight.

label: gLugiaPokedexText
en: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
et: LUGIA on nii võimas, et isegi kerge tiibade lehvitus võib majad puruks paisata. Seepärast elab ta varjul, sügaval mere all.
raw:
LUGIA is so powerful even a light
fluttering of its wings can blow apart
houses. As a result, it chooses to live out
of sight deep under the sea.

label: gHoOhPokedexText
en: Its feathers--which glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light--are thought to bring joy. It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
et: Arvatakse, et ta suled toovad rõõmu — need hõõguvad seitsmes värvis, olenevalt sellest, mis nurga alt valgus neile langeb. Öeldakse, et ta elab vikerkaare jalamil.
raw:
Its feathers--which glow in seven colors
depending on the angle at which they are
struck by light--are thought to bring joy.
It is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

label: gCelebiPokedexText
en: This POKéMON came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
et: See POKéMON tuli tulevikust, ületades aja. Arvatakse, et niikaua kui CELEBI ilmub, ootab meid helge ja särav tulevik.
raw:
This POKéMON came from the future by
crossing over time. It is thought that so
long as CELEBI appears, a bright and
shining future awaits us.

label: gTreeckoPokedexText
en: It makes its nest in a giant tree in the forest. It ferociously guards against anything nearing its territory. It is said to be the protector of the forest's trees.
et: Ta teeb pesa metsa hiiglaslikku puusse. Ta valvab ägedalt kõige eest, mis ta territooriumile läheneb. Öeldakse, et ta on metsa puude kaitsja.
raw:
It makes its nest in a giant tree in the
forest. It ferociously guards against
anything nearing its territory. It is said
to be the protector of the forest's trees.

label: gGrovylePokedexText
en: Leaves grow out of this POKéMON's body. They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes of its enemies while it is in a thickly overgrown forest.
et: Sellel POKéMONil kasvavad kehast lehed. Need aitavad varjata GROVYLEt vaenlaste eest, kui ta on tihedalt võsastunud metsas.
raw:
Leaves grow out of this POKéMON's body.
They help obscure a GROVYLE from the eyes
of its enemies while it is in a thickly
overgrown forest.

label: gSceptilePokedexText
en: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This POKéMON carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.
et: Džunglis on ta jõud võrreldamatu. See POKéMON kasvatab hoolikalt puid ja taimi. Ta reguleerib kehatemperatuuri päikese käes peesitades.
raw:
In the jungle, its power is without equal.
This POKéMON carefully grows trees and
plants. It regulates its body temperature
by basking in sunlight.

label: gTorchicPokedexText
en: If attacked, it strikes back by spitting balls of fire it forms in its stomach. A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it can't see its surroundings.
et: Rünnaku korral lööb ta tagasi, sülitades tulekuule, mille ta kõhus vormib. TORCHIC ei salli pimedust, sest ta ei näe siis ümbrust.
raw:
If attacked, it strikes back by spitting
balls of fire it forms in its stomach.
A TORCHIC dislikes darkness because it
can't see its surroundings.

label: gCombuskenPokedexText
en: It lashes out with 10 kicks per second. Its strong fighting instinct compels it to keep up its offensive until the opponent gives up.
et: Ta jagab 10 jalahoopi sekundis. Ta tugev võitlusinstinkt sunnib teda pealetungi jätkama, kuni vastane alla annab.
raw:
It lashes out with 10 kicks per second.
Its strong fighting instinct compels it
to keep up its offensive until the
opponent gives up.

label: gBlazikenPokedexText
en: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.
et: Ta õpib võitluskunste, kus kasutatakse rusika- ja jalahoope. Iga paari aasta tagant põlevad vanad suled ära ja nende asemele kasvavad uued painduvad suled.
raw:
It learns martial arts that use punches
and kicks. Every several years, its old
feathers burn off, and new, supple
feathers grow back in their place.

label: gMudkipPokedexText
en: On land, it can powerfully lift large boulders by planting its four feet and heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil at the water's edge.
et: Maal suudab ta neli jalga maha toetades ja pingutades tõsta suuri rahne. Ta magab, mattes end vee ääres pinnasesse.
raw:
On land, it can powerfully lift large
boulders by planting its four feet and
heaving. It sleeps by burying itself in soil
at the water's edge.

label: gMarshtompPokedexText
en: Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand upright. Because it weakens if its skin dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing in mud.
et: Ta karastunud tagajalad lasevad tal püsti seista. Kuna kuiv nahk teeb ta nõrgaks, mängib ta mudas, et niiskust juurde saada.
raw:
Its toughened hind legs enable it to stand
upright. Because it weakens if its skin
dries out, it replenishes fluids by playing
in mud.

label: gSwampertPokedexText
en: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.
et: Kui ta tajub tormi ja tõusulaine lähenemist, kaitseb ta merepesa, kuhjates rahne. Ta ujub sama kiiresti kui jett.
raw:
If it senses the approach of a storm and
a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest
by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as
a jet ski.

label: gPoochyenaPokedexText
en: It savagely threatens foes with bared fangs. It chases after fleeing targets tenaciously. It turns tail and runs, however, if the foe strikes back.
et: Ta ähvardab vaenlasi metsikult, kihvad irevil. Põgenevat sihtmärki ajab ta visalt taga. Kui vaenlane aga vastu hakkab, paneb ta saba jalge vahele ja plehku.
raw:
It savagely threatens foes with bared
fangs. It chases after fleeing targets
tenaciously. It turns tail and runs,
however, if the foe strikes back.

label: gMightyenaPokedexText
en: In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack. They never defy their leader's orders. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
et: Looduses elavad MIGHTYENAd karjas. Nad ei eira kunagi juhi käske. Vaenlased alistavad nad laitmatu koostööga.
raw:
In the wild, MIGHTYENA live in a pack.
They never defy their leader's orders.
They defeat foes with perfectly
coordinated teamwork.

label: gZigzagoonPokedexText
en: Rubbing its nose against the ground, it always wanders about back and forth in search of something. It is distinguished by the zigzag footprints it leaves.
et: Hõõrudes nina vastu maad, ekseleb ta alati edasi-tagasi, midagi otsides. Teda eristavad siksakilised jäljed, mida ta maha jätab.
raw:
Rubbing its nose against the ground, it
always wanders about back and forth in
search of something. It is distinguished
by the zigzag footprints it leaves.

label: gLinoonePokedexText
en: It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run in a straight line. When it spots ponddwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps in and catches it with its sharp claws.
et: Ta on äärmiselt kiire, kui tal tuleb vaid sirges joones joosta. Kui ta märkab vee all tiigis elavat saaki, hüppab ta kiiresti sisse ja püüab selle teravate küüntega.
raw:
It is exceedingly fast if it only has to run
in a straight line. When it spots pond-
dwelling prey underwater, it quickly leaps
in and catches it with its sharp claws.

label: gWurmplePokedexText
en: It sticks to tree branches and eats leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth, which becomes gooey when it touches air, slows the movement of its foes.
et: Ta klammerdub puuoksade külge ja sööb lehti. Niit, mille ta suust sülitab ja mis õhku puutudes kleepuvaks muutub, aeglustab vaenlaste liikumist.
raw:
It sticks to tree branches and eats
leaves. The thread it spits from its mouth,
which becomes gooey when it touches
air, slows the movement of its foes.

label: gSilcoonPokedexText
en: It prepares for evolution using the energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE. It keeps watch over the surroundings with its two eyes.
et: Ta valmistub arenguks energiaga, mille ta kogus juba WURMPLEna. Ta valvab ümbrust oma kahe silmaga.
raw:
It prepares for evolution using the
energy it stored while it was a WURMPLE.
It keeps watch over the surroundings with
its two eyes.

label: gBeautiflyPokedexText
en: Its colorfully patterned wings are its most prominent feature. It flies through flower-covered fields collecting pollen. It attacks ferociously when angered.
et: Ta kirjude mustritega tiivad on ta kõige silmapaistvam tunnus. Ta lendab üle õitega kaetud väljade ja kogub õietolmu. Vihastades ründab ta ägedalt.
raw:
Its colorfully patterned wings are its
most prominent feature. It flies through
flower-covered fields collecting pollen.
It attacks ferociously when angered.

label: gCascoonPokedexText
en: To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides motionlessly beneath large leaves and in the gaps of branches. It also attaches dead leaves to its body for camouflage.
et: Et vaenlaste eest varjuda, peidab ta end liikumatult suurte lehtede all ja okste vahedes. Maskeeringuks kinnitab ta kehale ka kuivi lehti.
raw:
To avoid detection by its enemies, it hides
motionlessly beneath large leaves and in
the gaps of branches. It also attaches
dead leaves to its body for camouflage.

label: gDustoxPokedexText
en: It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from fields and mountains to the attraction of streetlights at night. It looses highly toxic powder from its wings.
et: See on ööline POKéMON, keda tänavalambid meelitavad öösiti väljadelt ja mägedest ligi. Ta laseb tiibadest välja väga mürgist pulbrit.
raw:
It is a nocturnal POKéMON that flies from
fields and mountains to the attraction of
streetlights at night. It looses highly
toxic powder from its wings.

label: gLotadPokedexText
en: This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON across ponds by carrying them on the broad leaf on its head.
et: See POKéMON elab puhta veega tiikides. Ta on tuntud sellega, et veab väikeseid POKéMONe üle tiikide, kandes neid pea laial lehel.
raw:
This POKéMON lives in ponds with clean
water. It is known to ferry small POKéMON
across ponds by carrying them on the
broad leaf on its head.

label: gLombrePokedexText
en: In the evening, it takes great delight in popping out of rivers and startling people. It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on rocks in the riverbed.
et: Õhtul naudib ta suure heameelega jõest välja hüppamist ja inimeste ehmatamist. Ta toitub veesamblast, mis kasvab jõesängi kividel.
raw:
In the evening, it takes great delight in
popping out of rivers and startling people.
It feeds on aquatic moss that grows on
rocks in the riverbed.

label: gLudicoloPokedexText
en: When it hears festive music, all the cells in its body become stimulated, and it begins moving in rhythm. It does not quail even when it faces a tough opponent.
et: Kui ta kuuleb lustlikku muusikat, lähevad kõik ta keha rakud elevile ja ta hakkab rütmis liikuma. Ta ei kohku ka kõva vastase ees.
raw:
When it hears festive music, all the cells
in its body become stimulated, and it
begins moving in rhythm. It does not
quail even when it faces a tough opponent.

label: gSeedotPokedexText
en: It hangs off branches and absorbs nutrients. When it finishes eating, its body becomes so heavy that it drops to the ground with a thump.
et: Ta ripub okste küljes ja imeb toitaineid. Kui ta lõpetab söömise, muutub ta keha nii raskeks, et ta kukub mütsatades maha.
raw:
It hangs off branches and absorbs
nutrients. When it finishes eating, its
body becomes so heavy that it drops to
the ground with a thump.

label: gNuzleafPokedexText
en: A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled at climbing trees. Its long and pointed nose is its weak point. It loses power if the nose is gripped.
et: Metsas elav POKéMON, kes ronib osavalt puude otsa. Ta pikk terav nina on ta nõrk koht — ninast kinni võttes kaob tal jõud.
raw:
A forest-dwelling POKéMON that is skilled
at climbing trees. Its long and pointed
nose is its weak point. It loses power if
the nose is gripped.

label: gShiftryPokedexText
en: It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds. Feared from long ago as the guardian of forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep forest where people do not venture.
et: Öeldakse, et ta saabub külmade talviste tuultega. Teda on ammusest ajast kardetud kui metsade valvurit ja ta elab sügaval metsas, kuhu inimesed ei julge minna.
raw:
It is said to arrive on chilly, wintry winds.
Feared from long ago as the guardian of
forests, this POKéMON lives in a deep
forest where people do not venture.

label: gTaillowPokedexText
en: Although it is small, it is very courageous. It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an equal footing. However, its will weakens if it becomes hungry.
et: Kuigi ta on väike, on ta väga julge. Ta astub võrdsena vastu suuremale SKARMORYle. Kuid ta tahtejõud nõrgeneb, kui tal nälg tuleb.
raw:
Although it is small, it is very courageous.
It will take on a larger SKARMORY on an
equal footing. However, its will weakens if
it becomes hungry.

label: gSwellowPokedexText
en: A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above. It never misses its targets. It takes to the skies in search of lands with a warm climate.
et: SWELLOW sööstab saagile kõrgelt ülevalt alla. Ta ei lähe kunagi sihtmärgist mööda. Ta tõuseb taevasse, otsides sooja kliimaga maid.
raw:
A SWELLOW dives upon prey from far above.
It never misses its targets. It takes to
the skies in search of lands with a warm
climate.

label: gWingullPokedexText
en: It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it soars on updrafts.
et: Ta teeb pesa järsule rannakaljule. Lennates on tal raske tiibu pidevalt lehvitada, seepärast liugleb ta tõusvatel õhuvooludel.
raw:
It makes its nest on a sheer cliff at the
edge of the sea. It has trouble keeping
its wings flapping in flight. Instead, it
soars on updrafts.

label: gPelipperPokedexText
en: It skims the tops of waves as it flies. When it spots prey, it uses its large beak to scoop up the victim with water. It protects its eggs in its beak.
et: Ta lendab madalalt üle lainetippude. Saaki märgates ammutab ta selle suure nokaga koos veega üles. Nokas kaitseb ta ka oma mune.
raw:
It skims the tops of waves as it flies.
When it spots prey, it uses its large beak
to scoop up the victim with water.
It protects its eggs in its beak.

label: gRaltsPokedexText
en: A RALTS has the power to sense the emotions of people and POKéMON with the horns on its head. It takes cover if it senses any hostility.
et: RALTSil on võime tajuda pea sarvedega inimeste ja POKéMONide tundeid. Ta läheb varju, kui ta tajub vaenulikkust.
raw:
A RALTS has the power to sense the
emotions of people and POKéMON with the
horns on its head. It takes cover if it
senses any hostility.

label: gKirliaPokedexText
en: A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create a rip in the dimensions and see into the future. It is said to dance with pleasure on sunny mornings.
et: KIRLIAl on vaimne jõud rebestada ruumi ja näha tulevikku. Öeldakse, et päikesepaistelistel hommikutel tantsib ta rõõmust.
raw:
A KIRLIA has the psychic power to create 
a rip in the dimensions and see into the
future. It is said to dance with pleasure
on sunny mornings.

label: gGardevoirPokedexText
en: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its TRAINER.
et: Ta ilmselt ei tunne raskusjõu tõmmet, sest ta toetab end vaimse jõuga. Ta annab oma elu, et kaitsta oma TRAINERit.
raw:
It apparently does not feel the pull of
gravity because it supports itself with
psychic power. It will give its life to
protect its TRAINER.

label: gSurskitPokedexText
en: They gather on puddles after evening downpours, gliding across the surface of water as if sliding. It secretes honey with a sweet aroma from its head.
et: Pärast õhtust paduvihma kogunevad nad loikudele ja libisevad kergelt üle veepinna. Peast eritab ta magusa lõhnaga mett.
raw:
They gather on puddles after evening
downpours, gliding across the surface
of water as if sliding. It secretes honey
with a sweet aroma from its head.

label: gMasquerainPokedexText
en: It intimidates foes with the large eyelike patterns on its antennae. Because it can't fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself from rain under large trees and eaves.
et: Ta hirmutab vaenlasi antennide suurte silmalaadsete mustritega. Kuna ta ei saa lennata, kui ta tiivad märjaks saavad, varjab ta end vihma eest suurte puude ja räästate all.
raw:
It intimidates foes with the large eyelike
patterns on its antennae. Because it can't
fly if its wings get wet, it shelters itself
from rain under large trees and eaves.

label: gShroomishPokedexText
en: It loves to eat damp, composted soil in forests. If you enter a forest after a long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH feasting on composted soil.
et: Ta armastab süüa metsades niisket kompostitud pinnast. Kui sa lähed metsa pärast pikka vihma, võid näha palju SHROOMISHe kompostitud pinnase kallal pidutsemas.
raw:
It loves to eat damp, composted soil in
forests. If you enter a forest after a
long rain, you can see many SHROOMISH
feasting on composted soil.

label: gBreloomPokedexText
en: It scatters spores from holes in the cap on its head. It loves warm and humid climates. It feeds on trees and plants in fields and forests.
et: Ta puistab eoseid oma pea mütsil olevatest aukudest. Ta armastab sooja ja niisket kliimat. Ta toitub väljade ja metsade puudest ja taimedest.
raw:
It scatters spores from holes in the cap
on its head. It loves warm and humid
climates. It feeds on trees and plants in
fields and forests.

label: gSlakothPokedexText
en: It sleeps virtually all day and night long. It doesn't change its nest its entire life, but it sometimes travels great distances by swimming in rivers.
et: Ta magab praktiliselt kogu ööpäeva. Ta ei vaheta kogu elu jooksul pesa, kuid vahel läbib ta suuri vahemaid jões ujudes.
raw:
It sleeps virtually all day and night long.
It doesn't change its nest its entire life,
but it sometimes travels great distances
by swimming in rivers.

label: gVigorothPokedexText
en: It can't keep still because its blood boils with energy. It runs through the fields and mountains all day to calm itself. If it doesn't, it can't sleep at night.
et: Ta ei suuda paigal püsida, sest ta veri keeb energiast. Ta jookseb terve päeva mööda välju ja mägesid end rahustades. Muidu ei saa ta öösel magada.
raw:
It can't keep still because its blood boils
with energy. It runs through the fields
and mountains all day to calm itself. If it
doesn't, it can't sleep at night.

label: gSlakingPokedexText
en: Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees when fruits come into season. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
et: SLAKINGide karjad kogunevad puude ümber, kui viljad valmima hakkavad. Nad ootavad kannatlikult, kuni küpsed viljad puust alla kukuvad.
raw:
Hordes of SLAKING gather around trees
when fruits come into season. They wait
around patiently for ripened fruits to fall
out of the trees.

label: gNincadaPokedexText
en: It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it probes its surroundings in the pitch-black darkness of soil.
et: Ta teeb pesa võimsa puu juurte vahele. Vurrulaadsete antennidega kombib ta ümbrust pinnase pilkases pimeduses.
raw:
It makes its nest at the roots of a mighty
tree. Using its whiskerlike antennae, it
probes its surroundings in the
pitch-black darkness of soil.

label: gNinjaskPokedexText
en: Because it darts about vigorously at high speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing its distinctive cries for too long induces a headache.
et: Kuna ta sööstab suurel kiirusel ringi, on teda väga raske näha. Kui ta iseloomulikku kisa liiga kaua kuulata, hakkab pea valutama.
raw:
Because it darts about vigorously at high
speed, it is very difficult to see. Hearing
its distinctive cries for too long induces
a headache.

label: gShedinjaPokedexText
en: A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even though its wings remain completely still. The inside of its body is hollow and utterly dark.
et: Omapärane POKéMON, kes hõljub õhus, kuigi ta tiivad jäävad täiesti paigale. Ta keha sisemus on õõnes ja täiesti pime.
raw:
A peculiar POKéMON that floats in air even
though its wings remain completely still.
The inside of its body is hollow and
utterly dark.

label: gWhismurPokedexText
en: Its cries equal a jet plane in volume. It inhales through its ear canals. Because of this system, it can cry continually without having to catch its breath.
et: Ta kisa võrdub helitugevuselt reaktiivlennukiga. Ta hingab sisse läbi kõrvakäikude. Selle süsteemi tõttu suudab ta karjuda pidevalt, ilma et peaks hinge tõmbama.
raw:
Its cries equal a jet plane in volume.
It inhales through its ear canals. Because
of this system, it can cry continually
without having to catch its breath.

label: gLoudredPokedexText
en: It positions the round speakers on its head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves at massive volume. It builds power by stomping the ground.
et: Ta suunab pea ümarad kõlarid vaenlase poole ja ründab teda kõrvulukustavate ultrahelilainetega. Jõudu kogub ta maad trampides.
raw:
It positions the round speakers on its
head to assail foes with ultrasonic waves
at massive volume. It builds power by
stomping the ground.

label: gExploudPokedexText
en: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.
et: Tal on üle kogu keha heli tekitavaid organeid. Ta suhtleb teistega, reguleerides oma kisade tooni ja helitugevust.
raw:
It has sound-generating organs all over
its body. It communicates with others by
adjusting the tone and volume of the cries
it emits.

label: gMakuhitaPokedexText
en: It loves to toughen up its body above all else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave, it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking strenuous training.
et: Ta armastab üle kõige oma keha karastada. Kui sa kuuled koopas värisevat müdinat, on see MAKUHITA, kes rasket trenni teeb.
raw:
It loves to toughen up its body above all
else. If you hear quaking rumbles in a cave,
it is the sound of MAKUHITA undertaking
strenuous training.

label: gHariyamaPokedexText
en: It has the habit of challenging others without hesitation to tests of strength. It's been known to stand on train tracks and stop trains using forearm thrusts.
et: Tal on komme kõhklematult teisi jõuproovile kutsuda. Teadaolevalt on ta seisnud rööbastel ja peatanud käsivarrelöökidega ronge.
raw:
It has the habit of challenging others
without hesitation to tests of strength.
It's been known to stand on train tracks
and stop trains using forearm thrusts.

label: gAzurillPokedexText
en: Its tail, which is packed with nutrition, is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny days they gather at the edge of water and splash about for fun.
et: Ta saba, mis on toitainetest tulvil, on väga vetruv nagu kummipall. Päikesepaistelistel päevadel kogunevad nad vee äärde ja sulistavad lõbu pärast.
raw:
Its tail, which is packed with nutrition,
is very bouncy like a rubber ball. On sunny
days they gather at the edge of water and
splash about for fun.

label: gNosepassPokedexText
en: Its body emits a powerful magnetism. It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold seasons.
et: Ta keha kiirgab võimsat magnetismi. Ta toitub saagist, mille jõud sisse tõmbab. Ta magnetism on külmadel hooaegadel tugevam.
raw:
Its body emits a powerful magnetism.
It feeds on prey that is pulled in by the
force. Its magnetism is stronger in cold
seasons.

label: gSkittyPokedexText
en: A SKITTY's adorably cute behavior makes it highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp growl.
et: SKITTY armas käitumine teeb ta väga populaarseks. Lahingus ajab ta saba turri. Ta ähvardab vaenlasi terava urinaga.
raw:
A SKITTY's adorably cute behavior makes it
highly popular. In battle, it makes its tail
puff out. It threatens foes with a sharp
growl.

label: gDelcattyPokedexText
en: Rather than keeping a permanent lair, it habitually seeks comfortable spots and sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes active at dusk.
et: Tal pole kindlat pesa — ta otsib alati mõne mugava koha ja magab seal. Ta on ööline ja ärkab ellu videvikus.
raw:
Rather than keeping a permanent lair,
it habitually seeks comfortable spots and
sleeps there. It is nocturnal and becomes
active at dusk.

label: gSableyePokedexText
en: It digs branching holes in caves using its sharp claws in search of food--raw gems. A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen only rarely.
et: Ta kaevab teravate küüntega koobastesse hargnevaid auke, otsides toitu — toorkalliskive. SABLEYE varitseb pimeduses ja teda nähakse vaid harva.
raw:
It digs branching holes in caves using its
sharp claws in search of food--raw gems.
A SABLEYE lurks in darkness and is seen
only rarely.

label: gMawilePokedexText
en: Its giant jaws are actually steel horns that transformed. It fools foes into complacency with its adorable gestures, then chomps them with its huge jaws.
et: Ta hiiglaslikud lõuad on tegelikult teisenenud terassarved. Armsate liigutustega uinutab ta vaenlase valvsuse ja ampsab siis oma tohutute lõugadega.
raw:
Its giant jaws are actually steel horns
that transformed. It fools foes into
complacency with its adorable gestures,
then chomps them with its huge jaws.

label: gAronPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor. A new suit of armor is made when it evolves. The old, discarded armor is salvaged as metal for making iron products.
et: POKéMON, kes on rüütatud terassoomusesse. Arenedes saab ta endale uue soomuse. Vana äraheidetud soomus korjatakse kokku ja sellest tehakse rauast tooteid.
raw:
A POKéMON that is clad in steel armor.
A new suit of armor is made when it evolves.
The old, discarded armor is salvaged as
metal for making iron products.

label: gLaironPokedexText
en: When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they fight for territory by bashing into each other with their steel bodies. The sound of their collision carries for miles.
et: Kui kaks LAIRONi looduses kohtuvad, võitlevad nad territooriumi pärast, põrgates terasest kehadega teineteise vastu. Nende kokkupõrke heli kostab kilomeetrite kaugusele.
raw:
When two LAIRON meet in the wild, they
fight for territory by bashing into each
other with their steel bodies. The sound
of their collision carries for miles.

label: gAggronPokedexText
en: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the AGGRON's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
et: Ta raudsarved kasvavad tasapisi pikemaks. Neid kasutatakse AGGRONi vanuse määramiseks. Soomuse süvendeid kannab ta uhkusega lahingumälestistena.
raw:
Its iron horns grow longer a little at
a time. They are used to determine the
AGGRON's age. The gouges in its armor are
worn with pride as mementos from battles.

label: gMedititePokedexText
en: It continually meditates for hours every day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated yoga training, it has tempered its spiritual power so much it can fly.
et: Ta mediteerib iga päev tunde järjest. Range ja pühendunud joogatreeningu tulemusel on ta vaimset jõudu nii palju karastanud, et suudab lennata.
raw:
It continually meditates for hours every
day. As a result of rigorous and dedicated
yoga training, it has tempered its
spiritual power so much it can fly.

label: gMedichamPokedexText
en: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dancelike movement.
et: Rängalt karmi joogatreeninguga omandas ta võime vaenlase tegevust ette aimata. Ta võitleb elegantsete, tantsu meenutavate liigutustega.
raw:
Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it
gained the power to foretell its foe's
actions. It battles with elegant, dance-
like movement.

label: gElectrikePokedexText
en: It generates electricity using friction from the atmosphere. In seasons with especially arid air, its entire body blazes with violent showers of sparks.
et: Ta tekitab elektrit atmosfääri hõõrdumisest. Eriti kuiva õhuga hooaegadel lõõmab ta kogu keha metsikute sädemevihmadega.
raw:
It generates electricity using friction
from the atmosphere. In seasons with
especially arid air, its entire body blazes
with violent showers of sparks.

label: gManectricPokedexText
en: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.
et: Kuna nende läheduses langeb välk, arvati, et MANECTRICid on sündinud välgust. Lahingus tekitavad nad äikesepilvi.
raw:
Because lightning falls in their vicinities,
MANECTRIC were thought to have been born
from lightning. In battle, they create
thunderclouds.

label: gPluslePokedexText
en: It has the trait of cheering on its fellow POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity it releases from its paws, it creates pom-poms for cheering.
et: Talle meeldib teisi POKéMONe ergutada. Käppadest välja lastud elektrit lühistades teeb ta endale ergutustutid.
raw:
It has the trait of cheering on its fellow
POKéMON. By shorting out the electricity
it releases from its paws, it creates
pom-poms for cheering.

label: gMinunPokedexText
en: At a meeting of POKéMON academics, it was announced that simultaneous exposure to electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will promote circulation and boost vitality.
et: POKéMONi teadlaste kohtumisel teatati, et samaaegne kokkupuude PLUSLE ja MINUNi elektriga edendab vereringet ja tõstab elujõudu.
raw:
At a meeting of POKéMON academics, it was
announced that simultaneous exposure to
electricity from a PLUSLE and MINUN will
promote circulation and boost vitality.

label: gVolbeatPokedexText
en: With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the night sky. They move their nests if their pond water becomes dirty.
et: Sabatuled põlemas, lendavad VOLBEATid parves ja joonistavad öötaevasse geomeetrilisi mustreid. Kui tiigivesi mustaks läheb, kolivad nad pesa mujale.
raw:
With their taillights lit, VOLBEAT fly in
a swarm, drawing geometric designs in the
night sky. They move their nests if their
pond water becomes dirty.

label: gIllumisePokedexText
en: A nocturnal POKéMON that becomes active upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200 different patterns have been confirmed.
et: Ööline POKéMON, kes muutub pimeduse saabudes aktiivseks. Ta juhib VOLBEATi parve, et joonistada öötaevasse mustreid. On kinnitatud üle 200 erineva mustri.
raw:
A nocturnal POKéMON that becomes active
upon nightfall. It leads a VOLBEAT swarm
to draw patterns in the night sky. Over 200
different patterns have been confirmed.

label: gRoseliaPokedexText
en: A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich springwater blooms with lovely flowers. The fragrance of its flowers has the effect of making its foes careless.
et: ROSELIA, kes joob toitainerikast allikavett, õitseb kaunite õitega. Ta õite lõhn muudab vaenlased hooletuks.
raw:
A ROSELIA that drinks nutritionally rich
springwater blooms with lovely flowers.
The fragrance of its flowers has the
effect of making its foes careless.

label: gGulpinPokedexText
en: This POKéMON's stomach fluid can even digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can swallow something that is as large as itself.
et: Selle POKéMONi maomahl suudab seedida isegi vanarauda. Ühe ampsuga suudab ta alla neelata midagi endasuurust.
raw:
This POKéMON's stomach fluid can even
digest scrap iron. In one gulp, it can
swallow something that is as large as
itself.

label: gSwalotPokedexText
en: Its powerful stomach acid is capable of digesting almost anything. The one thing in the whole world a SWALOT can't digest is its own stomach.
et: Ta võimas maohape suudab seedida peaaegu kõike. Ainus asi terves maailmas, mida SWALOT ei suuda seedida, on ta enda magu.
raw:
Its powerful stomach acid is capable of
digesting almost anything. The one thing
in the whole world a SWALOT can't digest is
its own stomach.

label: gCarvanhaPokedexText
en: CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making them sink. Although it is said to be a very vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon as it finds itself alone.
et: CARVANHAd ründavad laevu parvedena, pannes need uppuma. Kuigi teda peetakse väga julmaks POKéMONiks, põgeneb ta arglikult niipea, kui leiab end üksi olevat.
raw:
CARVANHA attack ships in swarms, making
them sink. Although it is said to be a very
vicious POKéMON, it timidly flees as soon
as it finds itself alone.

label: gSharpedoPokedexText
en: The vicious and sly gangster of the sea. Its skin is specially textured to minimize drag in water. Its speed tops out at over 75 miles per hour.
et: Mere julm ja kaval gangster. Ta naha eriline pind vähendab vee takistust. Ta kiirus küünib üle 120 km/h.
raw:
The vicious and sly gangster of the sea.
Its skin is specially textured to minimize
drag in water. Its speed tops out at over
75 miles per hour.

label: gWailmerPokedexText
en: While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea, it can survive on land, although not too long. It loses vitality if its body becomes dried out.
et: See POKéMON elab tavaliselt meres, kuid saab hakkama ka maal — ehkki mitte kuigi kaua. Kui ta keha ära kuivab, kaob tal elujõud.
raw:
While this POKéMON usually lives in the sea,
it can survive on land, although not too
long. It loses vitality if its body becomes
dried out.

label: gWailordPokedexText
en: It breathes through nostrils that it raises above the sea. By inhaling to its maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.
et: Ta hingab ninasõõrmetega, mille ta merepinnast kõrgemale tõstab. Kopsud õhku täis tõmmanud, suudab WAILORD sukelduda ligi 3 kilomeetri sügavusele.
raw:
It breathes through nostrils that it
raises above the sea. By inhaling to its
maximum capacity, a WAILORD can dive close
to 10,000 feet beneath the waves.

label: gNumelPokedexText
en: A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can transport a 220-pound load. It has served humans at work since long ago.
et: NUMEL salvestab keeva magmat seljal olevas küürus. Ta on sitke POKéMON, kes suudab vedada 100-kilost koormat. Ta on inimesi tööl teeninud juba ammusest ajast.
raw:
A NUMEL stores boiling magma in the hump
on its back. It is a hardy POKéMON that can
transport a 220-pound load. It has served
humans at work since long ago.

label: gCameruptPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.
et: POKéMON, kes elab vulkaani kraatris. Iga 10 aasta tagant purskavad ta seljal olevad vulkaanid ägedalt. Purske põhjust alles uuritakse.
raw:
A POKéMON that lives in the crater of
a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes
on its back erupt violently. Research is
under way on the cause of eruption.

label: gTorkoalPokedexText
en: It battles using energy it gets from burning coal. When loosing smoke from its nostrils, it lets off a sound that is similar to a locomotive's horn.
et: Ta võitleb energiaga, mille saab söe põletamisest. Kui ta ninasõõrmetest suitsu välja laseb, kostab heli nagu veduri vile.
raw:
It battles using energy it gets from
burning coal. When loosing smoke from its
nostrils, it lets off a sound that is
similar to a locomotive's horn.

label: gSpoinkPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that manipulates psychic power at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms that grow underground.
et: POKéMON, kes juhib vaimset jõudu oma tahtmise järgi. Ta ei lõpeta hüplemist isegi magades. Ta armastab süüa maa all kasvavaid seeni.
raw:
A POKéMON that manipulates psychic power
at will. It doesn't stop bouncing even when
it is asleep. It loves eating mushrooms
that grow underground.

label: gGrumpigPokedexText
en: It stores power in the black pearls on its forehead. When it uses psychic power, it performs an odd dance step. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.
et: Ta salvestab jõu laubal olevatesse mustadesse pärlitesse. Vaimset jõudu kasutades teeb ta imeliku tantsusammu. Ta tantsustiil sai välismaal ülipopulaarseks.
raw:
It stores power in the black pearls on its
forehead. When it uses psychic power, it
performs an odd dance step. Its style of
dancing became hugely popular overseas.

label: gSpindaPokedexText
en: It is distinguished by a pattern of spots that is always different. Its unsteady, tottering walk has the effect of fouling its foe's aim.
et: Teda eristab täppide muster, mis on alati erinev. Ta ebakindel taaruv kõnnak ajab vaenlase sihtimise segi.
raw:
It is distinguished by a pattern of
spots that is always different. Its
unsteady, tottering walk has the
effect of fouling its foe's aim.

label: gTrapinchPokedexText
en: Its big jaws crunch through boulders. Because its head is so big, it has a hard time getting back upright if it tips over onto its back.
et: Ta suured lõuad purevad rahnud katki. Kuna ta pea on nii suur, on tal raske uuesti püsti saada, kui ta seljale kukub.
raw:
Its big jaws crunch through boulders.
Because its head is so big, it has a hard
time getting back upright if it tips over
onto its back.

label: gVibravaPokedexText
en: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA's wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.
et: Ta laseb välja ultrahelilaineid, hõõrudes tiibu teineteise vastu. Kuna VIBRAVA tiivad alles kasvavad, suudab ta lennata vaid lühikesi vahemaid.
raw:
It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its
wings together. Since a VIBRAVA's wings
are still in the process of growing, it can
only fly short distances.

label: gFlygonPokedexText
en: The flapping of its wings sounds like singing. To prevent detection by enemies, it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of desert sand.
et: Ta tiibade kohin kõlab nagu laul. Et vaenlased teda ei avastaks, keerutab ta üles kõrbeliiva pilve ja peidab end selle sisse.
raw:
The flapping of its wings sounds like
singing. To prevent detection by enemies,
it hides itself by flapping up a cloud of
desert sand.

label: gCacneaPokedexText
en: CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick, spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower blooms.
et: CACNEAd elavad kõrbetes, kus praktiliselt ei saja vihma. Ta võitleb, vehkides jämedate ogaliste kätega. Kord aastas puhkeb tal kollane õis.
raw:
CACNEA live in deserts with virtually no
rainfall. It battles by swinging its thick,
spiked arms. Once a year, a yellow flower
blooms.

label: gCacturnePokedexText
en: After spending thousands of years in harsh deserts, its blood transformed into the same substances as sand. It is nocturnal, so it hunts at night.
et: Pärast tuhandeid aastaid karmides kõrbetes muutus ta veri samadeks aineteks kui liiv. Ta on ööline, nii et ta jahib öösel.
raw:
After spending thousands of years in
harsh deserts, its blood transformed into
the same substances as sand. It is
nocturnal, so it hunts at night.

label: gSwabluPokedexText
en: A POKéMON that has wings like cottony clouds. After enduring winter, in which little food is available, SWABLU flocks move closer to towns in the spring.
et: POKéMON, kellel on tiivad nagu vatised pilved. Kui kehv talv on üle elatud, tulevad SWABLU parved kevadel linnadele lähemale.
raw:
A POKéMON that has wings like cottony
clouds. After enduring winter, in which
little food is available, SWABLU flocks
move closer to towns in the spring.

label: gAltariaPokedexText
en: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.
et: Ta ümiseb kauni sopranihäälega. Ta lendab sinitaeva valgete pilvede vahel. Ta laseb suust välja ägedalt kuumi tulekerasid.
raw:
It hums in a beautiful soprano voice.
It flies among white clouds in the blue
sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs
from its mouth.

label: gZangoosePokedexText
en: When it battles, it stands on its hind legs and attacks with its sharply clawed forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters any SEVIPER.
et: Võideldes tõuseb ta tagajalgadele ja ründab teravate küüntega esikäppadega. Iga SEVIPERit nähes ajab ta karva turri.
raw:
When it battles, it stands on its hind legs
and attacks with its sharply clawed
forelegs. Its fur bristles if it encounters
any SEVIPER.

label: gSeviperPokedexText
en: SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals. It counters a ZANGOOSE's dazzling agility with its swordlike tail, which also oozes a horrible poison.
et: SEVIPER ja ZANGOOSE on igavesed rivaalid. Ta vastab ZANGOOSE pimestavale väledusele mõõgataolise sabaga, mis eritab ka kohutavat mürki.
raw:
SEVIPER and ZANGOOSE are eternal rivals.
It counters a ZANGOOSE's dazzling agility
with its swordlike tail, which also oozes
a horrible poison.

label: gLunatonePokedexText
en: It becomes very active on the night of a full moon. This POKéMON was first discovered 40 years ago at the site of a meteor strike.
et: Ta muutub täiskuuööl väga aktiivseks. See POKéMON avastati esmakordselt 40 aastat tagasi meteoorilanguse kohas.
raw:
It becomes very active on the night of
a full moon. This POKéMON was first
discovered 40 years ago at the site of
a meteor strike.

label: gSolrockPokedexText
en: Solar energy is the source of this POKéMON's power. On sunny days, groups of SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb its light.
et: Päikeseenergia on selle POKéMONi jõuallikas. Päikesepaistelistel päevadel seavad SOLROCKid end reas päikese poole ja imevad selle valgust.
raw:
Solar energy is the source of this 
POKéMON's power. On sunny days, groups of
SOLROCK line up facing the sun and absorb
its light.

label: gBarboachPokedexText
en: Its body is covered with a slimy film. The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs in muddy water from entering the BARBOACH's body.
et: Ta keha katab limane kile. See on kaitsekiht, mis ei lase mudase vee pisikutel BARBOACHi kehasse pääseda.
raw:
Its body is covered with a slimy film.
The film acts as a barrier to prevent germs
in muddy water from entering the
BARBOACH's body.

label: gWhiscashPokedexText
en: Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes. In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it continually feeds throughout the night.
et: Kummalisel kombel suudab ta maavärinaid ette aimata. Päeval magab ta tiigi põhja mudas. Ärgates toitub ta pidevalt terve öö.
raw:
Mysteriously, it can foretell earthquakes.
In the daytime, it sleeps in mud at the
bottom of a pond. When it awakens, it
continually feeds throughout the night.

label: gCorphishPokedexText
en: Once it grips prey with its large pincers, it will never let go, no matter what. It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive in any environment.
et: Kui ta on saagi suurte sõradega haardesse saanud, ei lase ta seda mitte mingi hinna eest lahti. Ta on sitke POKéMON, kes tuleb toime igas keskkonnas.
raw:
Once it grips prey with its large pincers,
it will never let go, no matter what.
It is a hardy POKéMON that can thrive
in any environment.

label: gCrawdauntPokedexText
